hero_1: The Allfather already gave His people a chance to follow His rules. Mercee is not here to offer second chances, she is here to deliver His judgment.
hero_2: Grass is meant to be mowed; evil is meant to be cut down. It is the sacred duty of a saint to ensure the Lord's parcel is cared for.
hero_3: Most enemies do not realize Saint Talin is the one behind that walking shield, until it's far too late. She stays hidden, cloak and shield, bound by her vow to the Allfather.

bio:
"At the center of all good mysteries sits an unassuming cat, watching silently through wide jeweled eyes." Enam'ru Enkhanan sees all with her ever so slight, half-moon smile twitching in amusement at the arcane secrets the rest of her peers have yet to discover.

Arcane Tigrans are Enam'ru's shadowy, feline agents who flit through the dark places between worlds, absconding with arcane secrets for their mistress. Masters of magical channeling, they make formidable foes should they decide to step out of those shadows...

Born blind, Taiena was not expected to lead the Ashen Fae. But through sheer perseverance and her keen other senses, she cultivated her talents as a pyromancer, and eventually became the first Emberkeeper to ascend to Godirhood.

The Ashen Fae originated above ground, as one of the many types of surface-dwelling Elves. But when war forced the Elves to choose between fighting or perishing, one tribe fled underground. They worship fire, for it is their main source of light in the sunless depths.

Sylvani was born and raised in the capital city of her Elven tribe. With her talent for magic and love for nature she inherited her title from her grandmother after she fell to undead forces.

The Auldweald Elves are one of the oldest Elven tribes on the World of their namesake. They carve their history in their own bodies, and in the trees around them. Thereby, both bark and skin share the same legends.

An instinctive penchant for delving into the deep places of the world is often invaluable when seeking to uncover long buried secrets. This strange truth has long served Crahz well in her pursuit of power which, in turn, she oft seeks to wield as a bringer of high-minded ideals to those deemed less fortunate. She herself would say she digs into the darkness, to bring truth into the light.

Known far and wide as the Awakened Molemen, Crahz Diggora's faithful followers are, perhaps somewhat ironically, not prone to blind faith. In their mistress they see a beacon of justice driven by lofty wisdom and an obvious prowess in both magic and diplomacy.

Brutality is Asgera Spinesplitter! She rallies her Orcs with a covenant of conquest, and nothing stands forever against her might.

Bloodfang Orcs are not known for their love of flower arranging or carving fruit into the shapes of tiny animals. They do enjoy the rhythm and visual poetry that results from repeatedly bashing a foe's skull against a bloody rock until it caves in with a beautiful scarlet display of fleshy fireworks.

Sanguine was a zealous priestess of a peaceful tribe of Halflings, before a tragedy forced the tribe to cannibalism. This drove Sanguine to madness, claiming divine forces allowed these atrocities. She found Godirhood through a terrifying blood ritual which cost many lives.

The Bloodied Halflings were once a peaceful tribe, but after a terrible earthquake trapped all survivors underground, they had to resort to cannibalism to survive. To cope, they adapted their religion around it.

Rajag was a zealous worshiper of Yaka, believing him the creator of the Tigrans. Rajag was betrayed by his god, however, and found himself in the Void. His zeal led him to Magehaven, where he himself found ascension to Godirhood, vowing revenge on his former object of worship.

The Brutal Ratkin lived in a small society until the High Inquisitor Rajag found them, and promptly claimed dominion over them. They live in an equal measure of awe and fear of their new Ruler.

Edward Portsmith defended the Commonwealth when reality was assaulted by Shadow Demons. He mastered powerful arcane magic to fight a war that turned the shadows away. He inspired men to fight for the common values held by the living. To this day, even as he faces the effects of time and mortality, he stands ready to defend those who will defend an Age of Wonders.

Legends abound as to the origins of humans. The most common story tells that the first men came in ships, driven from a garden, into the rich lands they were promised. Humans frequently tell stories that place themselves as the ones destined to reign. Though they seem unremarkable in comparison to other races, somehow these clever inventors continue to stick around.

Gloom Hooknail, the Dark Lady, rewards cruelty. She is fickle and deliberately impulsive, keeping her servants in a state of constant fear while competing for her favor. She loves cruel assassins and rewards the most deplorable acts of depravity, for they amuse her.

They creep deep in the dark, which they love and despise. Corrupted Goblins see the fair and laughing souls and let hate and envy fill them. They may not be strong in might, but their minds are devious and filled with a cruelty that horrifies.

When the stars light up the night's sky, it is said they are sparks from Fangir's Astral anvil. Once a talented Dwarven artificer, Fangir traveled to the Astral Sea and emerged with expanding interests. Where first he controlled rock and earth, he now aims to mold the Astral Flows themselves.

Originating from Athlan Dwarves, the Moonrock Dwarves are great builders and runesmiths. When they followed Fangir into the Astral Sea to hunt for riches, they emerged with new insights and aspirations. Why dig and fight for one realm, when the stars themselves are there to be mined?

Blint listens. The earth trembles and he hears its murmurs. Patiently he waits below, hoarding his resources, until his means are sufficient to overwhelm the fools who waste their efforts on works of rock and stone to fortify themselves.

Blint's Mole-folk, dubbed by many as the Deep Dwellers, are known for outstanding levels of patience and cunning. They possess the knowledge and instinctive ability to both raise glorious structures as well as tear them down in the most efficient manner possible.

When he was a young prince, Alfred saw the deaths of his parents at the hands of an invading Wizard. In order to protect his people, he united the splintered factions of Athla under one banner and started the search for a new home.

After the return of the Wizard Kings, the many human factions of Athla were unable to rise against the invasion. It took a great hero—a young prince who knew tremendous loss, to unite them under the banner of the Destined Humans.

Love and hate burn as blinding embers in Karissa’s lusty savage eyes. She claims the impulse that drives life to the brink of violence. Strength begets strength. Ruthlessly, she will crush any weakness and they praise her for it. She is the true flame burning in the bosom of every mortal being.

Trusting in axe and spear, Enthralled Orcs crush their enemies. Every tradition is focused upon the sole purpose of domination and destruction. They enslave weaker beings to do the disparaging tasks like farming and gathering resources, but the best treasures are plundered from the soft.

Only one day after being named High Chancellor of his people, Noctus was poisoned. His feats of necromancy allowed him to not only return from the Astral Void as a Wizard King, but also to bring back the souls of his forefathers, who taught him the secrets of death and eternity... and exacted revenge on those who wronged him.

The Erudite Orcs share an almost obsessive interest in history and death. Always searching for a way to extend their massive libraries, they thread the needle between archaeology and grave robbing as they sometimes bring back the dead themselves to verify their research.

Kruul embodies the prowess of his kin, despising any lies propagated against his people. He especially hates the one regarding their origins that suggests they were the result of a Godir's experimentation crossbreeding rodents and humans, and that in a moment of bloodlust they ate their own creator. Any hint of that story will drive him into a murderous frenzy.

The Fiendish Rodents strive to embody their master's best qualities. As such, they are driven by an insatiable bloodlust and almost gleeful addiction to malevolence and pain.

After the Dragons breathed out the worlds, and the Archons fixed them to stars, they called the first ones to lead those who will put down the storm, quench the fires and quicken the seas. They call for the Wild Guardian, Zaethyl.

The immortal First Elves live refined lives cultivated by millennia of patient thought and arcane mastery. Entrusted with arcane mysteries and guardians of creation magic, they form worlds rife with life. Sometimes perceived as intolerant elites, they have little patience for short-term mortal concerns.

Anura was the court magician of her people. When her queen did not heed the warning of a harsh upcoming winter, many of her people perished. Anura, desperate to save her people, called upon powerful dark magics to adapt them to the cold.

Once, the Frozen Toads loved to bask in the sun. After Anura cast her spell, they could not stand the warmth anymore. Now all they crave is an eternal frost.

Her icy filigree sparkles, catching iridescent sheets of boreal ghost-light. Think not to captivate this one, for her heart is frigid. Artica haunts the snowy drifts of winter, leaving no footprints. Goddess to her Frostling subjects, they alone tolerate her frigid isolation.

Specialized people who adore the ice and snow, Frostlings thrive in inhospitable glacial realms. Their frigid adaptation allows them to raid the rich lands that border the frozen wastes, spreading their cold unfeeling ice as a blizzard.

Some claim she was long ago blessed by the moon, a myth informed by her ivory hair and alabaster skin. Sola rose from humble beginnings to protect and guide her people, who now follow her with fervent devotion. Though she is driven by a sense of goodness and honor, her enemies find that her merciful nature is oft tempered by a layer of unyielding and unforgiving steel.

Originally peopled by a mountain tribe that Sola protected through hardship with mystical powers, her Devotees have since grown in number as well as ability. Today, they do zealous battle in her name, bringing the light of her wisdom or the swift smite of her vengeance to those in need of either.

Meshara grew up as the daughter of a knight and a priest. Her people say divine righteousness runs through her blood. Yet, she tries to stay humble—or as humble as one can be, when one is named the Prophetess of her entire people.

The Archons are said to be the most legendary protectors of the worlds, and the Human Paladins believe themselves to be a close second. Led by their Prophetess, they aim to bring justice to all living beings on the realms they decide to save.

Dwarves labor to impress their First Guardian. Tugrum Hammerhall shows only that she is never quite appeased. Therefore, stubborn Dwarven men with their stubborn Dwarven wills contest her disapproving brow. One wonders when they will notice that she is secretly quite proud.

The strength of the mountains embodies the Mountain Dwarves. They thrive in the crevices, cliffsides, and among jagged precipices where they can work the hard rock breaking the soft level lands.

When the sharp mind of an Amphibian is driven by a divine calling, it can reach quite erudite heights. When, as in the case of Dafal, it ascends to roaming the seas to bring justice, it becomes a force to be reckoned with indeed.

The followers of Dafal Dea are as zealous as they are naturally amphibious. Long conversations about philosophy and Godirhood can often be heard drifting through the sea fog, to the accompaniment of excited croaks, when one of their vessels is close by.

Driven by hunger, Nekron brings death to everyone and anyone impartially. He prefers to rule cities of undead, freed from disturbing qualities like free thought and disobedience. Control your emotions, for Nekron is attracted to suffering.

The Cruel Deathbringers were once something one could call Human. Now, they are little more than soulless husks who follow the bidding of their Arch Lich.

Only one day after being named High Chancellor of his people, Noctus was poisoned. His feats of necromancy allowed him to not only return from the Astral Void as a Wizard King, but also to bring back the souls of his forefathers, who taught him the secrets of death and eternity... and exacted revenge on those who wronged him.

The Erudite Orcs share an almost obsessive interest in history and death. Always searching for a way to extend their massive libraries, they thread the needle between archaeology and grave robbing as they sometimes bring back the dead themselves to verify their research.

After the Commonwealth on Athla crumbled under the arrival of the banished Wizards, one lion stood fast in the Astral storm. Aric Rex fights to restore his beloved Commonwealth to its former glory. His armor represents the Emperors of his past.

Even though the Commonwealth of the Third Age has fallen, Aric's faithful followers fight to uphold its values.

Many fear the unending hunger of Rakshagi, the Grand Devourer, who was said to have perished of hunger, and now aims to get a taste of every living being in the universe. In the meantime, however, she feasts upon her followers as she pleases.

The Ratty Munchkin revere their Grand Devourer with equal amounts of adoration and fear. They do all they can to please their mistress. After all, it takes very little for her to decide that they are more useful as an afternoon snack.

The best villains consider themselves heroes. While a simple servant of Meandor, Werlac organized a zealous cult to bring back the banished Wizard Kings, without concern for the cataclysms it unleashed. When he found his reward unsatisfying, he started his search for other ancient powers to revere.

The Shadowborn Elves are wandering cultists, adept at unveiling secrets in the weirdest spaces between worlds. They follow their cult leader through the shadows of the Astral Sea with the ease of pirates on a vast mysterious ocean, looking for a befitting higher power to worship and unleash upon the worlds.

Once, Vaneyra was a First Elf who traveled the Astral Sea to prepare and protect the realms long before Humans even existed. But where other First Elves looked forward to landing on a solid realm again, Vaneyra enjoyed the traveling itself the most. The Astral Sea pulled her, called her... and one day she answered the call.

As Vaneyra's followers spent more and more time in the Astral Sea, they found it molded them into something new, something... more. They think of themselves as blessed by unending magics, and aim to return this blessing to all worlds within the Astral Sea.

Talya is a fanatical zealot utterly dedicated to spreading the faith of the Allfather through martial power. She believes that all the realms, and the Astral Sea were created by Him and exist only to honor Him and has dedicated her life to making sure that just about everyone who lives there knows it.

Xetevaca was named by the excavators who found her after she was cast into the dark depths as a newborn. Her charm and popularity was deemed dangerous by her ruling empress, resulting in the banishment of Xetevaca and her loyal followers. She emerged from the Astral Void as a Godir.

The Underground Disciples originated as a small community within a vast empire, but their trust in Xetevaca caused them to take a leap of faith into the Astral Void itself. Those who survived emerged with her and now follow her in search of a new home.

Raina was a powerful Human queen, who cared more for grandeur than for her subjects. One day an especially scorned and magically adept subject turned the Queen into a toad. Only a life of moderation can break the curse, but since Raina and her people have been toads for generations, this has proven to be an unsurmountable task.

The Cursed Toadlings originated as Raina's most faithful followers. After the first shock of the curse had diminished, they accepted their new existence as semi-aquatic humanoids with valor.

Accrion was a legendary but cruel wizard among his people. Not long after what his emperor called "a series of horrid experiments," Accrion was sentenced to death by beheading. Little did his people know, Accrion was already closely acquainted with the Astral Void, and losing his head turned out to be a mere inconvenience.

Voidseekers are the subjects of Accrion, the Voidseer, whose mind travels the Astral Sea. They are his test subjects and followers, whose knowledge about everything Astral transcend many others.

Ham Binger is a legendary Halfling whose curiosity endowed him with a form of immortality that is unique among his people. Notorious for escaping impossible situations, his people know that when Ham disappears, it’s time to make oneself scarce.

Wholesome Halflings pursue a life of simple joys and unsophisticated celebration. They thrive in communities that harbor cooperation, raising livestock and farming verdant hills.

name: Rupsta
race_bio:
Rupsta was among the greatest of the Goblin chieftains on Athla, notable for his immense stature and the smoke that billowed from the pipe always clamped in his mouth. Undefeated in the many battles he fought, he lived over fifty summers—an extremely old age for a Goblin—before dying peacefully in his bed chambers.

Distraught at Rupsta's passing, his Umphtri Goblins threw a party so exuberant that it drew the attention of the Godir themselves. Above the riotous din, they could see the glimmering spark of Rupsta's spirit, drawn back from the Astral Void... And it is said the Athlan Elven queen Julia herself reached out a hand across the Astral Sea to help Rupsta to return, rejuvenated, ready to begin a new life among the Godir.
title: Great Chieftain

description:
Bounties are Ruler created quests that can be offered to other Rulers in exchange for a reward. Other non-hostile Rulers may choose to accept the bounty. The Ruler that completes the objective first will receive the reward and complete the bounty.

Rulers receive 20 Turn to complete the bounty. If the time runs out before the objective is completed, then they fail the bounty.

The bounty cannot be canceled while any Ruler is attempting it after the turn in which it was created. If the bounty fails during this time, it will return 50% of the reward.

In order to create a bounty and have other Rulers accept it, specific requirements must be met.

description:
Ruler may call each other into War with a Ruler who they themselves are already at war with.

The Rulers must share at least a Wizard's Bond to send a call to war. The receiving Ruler may choose to accept or decline the call. Accepting gives them a Grievance bonus, whereas declining will result in considerable relations penalties.

description:
Grievances determine your War Justification against other Ruler. They are your reason for going to war.

Obtained primarily by:Seeing a trespasser.Having another Ruler build on a Province you've claimed.Fabricating a Grievance.Being attacked.

Grievances can be exchanged for Resource with the Ruler they're held against.
description_level_-1: A war would be unjustified and so our alignment and relations with other Rulers and cities will suffer deeply.
description_level_0: Starting a war with no justification will damage our alignment and relations with other Rulers and cities.
description_level_1: War is possible, but our alignment and relations would still suffer.
description_level_2: Our vassal cities will support our war, but other parties maintain a neutral stance.
description_level_3: The people demand war! Our vassals and other Rulers will support our decision.
rival_justification_description:
Rival justification is a one-sided War Justification that allows you to ignore the opponent's Grievance points up to the same amount as your Rival Justification when declaring War on them.
The opposing Ruler is not affected by your Rival Justification when they declare war on you, nor are you affected by their Rival Justification.

war_justification_description:
War Justification is the balance of Grievance between two Ruler and is used to determine the impact of declaring War.

When starting a War:Alignment may be affected. Imperium income may be affected.Non-allied rulers can receive Grievance.Empire Relations with other Rulers as well as relations with ([hyperlink,GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept]Vassal[/hyperlink])Cities may be affected.

The following War Justification levels can be reached:Major (51+)Moderate (50 to 26)Minor (25 to 1)None ()Unjust ({LVL-1Max} to {LVL-1Min})Very unjust ({LVL-2Max} to {LVL-2Min})Completely unjust ({LVL-3Min})
war_justification_incomeeffectexplanatio: When you are involved in multiple wars which you declared, only the income effect of the war with the worst War Justification will be applied.
war_justification_level_0_description:
With no War Justification (0), declaring War becomes more damaging to your Empire.

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively, and impact your -80% income by {ResourcePenaltyValue} while the war lasts.
war_justification_level_1_description:
Having only minor War Justification (-26 to -51), means that declaring War is justified but still frowned upon by other Ruler.

Wars are still considered an evil act and your Empire Relations with other Rulers will suffer a penalty.
war_justification_level_2_description: With Moderate <hyperlink>War Justification</hyperlink> (-26<casusBelli></casusBelli> to -51<casusBelli></casusBelli>), declaring <rs_war></rs_war> <hyperlink>War</hyperlink> is now supported by your <hyperlink>Vassal</hyperlink> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] as they gain a <hyperlink>Relations</hyperlink> bonus, and your 10 income increases by <eventColor>{ResourceBonusValue}</eventColor> while the war lasts.
war_justification_level_3_description: With Major <hyperlink>War Justification</hyperlink> (-26+<casusBelli></casusBelli>), declaring <rs_war></rs_war> <hyperlink>War</hyperlink> is fully justified. Your <hyperlink>Vassal</hyperlink> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept]Cities[/hyperlink] gain a <hyperlink>Relations</hyperlink> bonus, and your 10 income increases by <eventColor>{ResourceBonusValue}</eventColor> while the war lasts.
war_justification_level_n1_description:
With negative War Justification (-26 to -51), declaring War becomes even more damaging to your Empire!

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively and, impact your -80% income by {ResourcePenaltyValue} while the war lasts.
war_justification_level_n2_description:
With negative War Justification (-26 to -51), declaring War becomes even more damaging to your Empire!

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively and, impact your -80% income by {ResourcePenaltyValue} while the war lasts.
war_justification_level_n3_description:
With completely negative War Justification (-51), declaring War can severely damage your Empire!

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively, and impact your -80% income by {ResourcePenaltyValue} while the war lasts.

description:
A fabricated Grievance is a Grievance about an event that did not actually happen but can still be used as a cause for War.

Ruler can only have one fabricated grievance against another Ruler and can use these to declare War or Denounce them. Fabricated Grievances can be sold to the opposing Ruler but cannot be forgiven.

Grievances can be fabricated through Pronouncement.

description:
A denouncement is a verbal warning about a Grievance that affects the targeted Ruler and their relations with other AI Rulers that you both have met.

A Ruler may only be denounced once for each unique Grievance a Ruler has against them.

Denouncing a Ruler using Fabricated Grievance will cause them to have a grievance against you!

Denouncements can be made through Pronouncement.

description:
Declare your Friendship with another Ruler publicly.

A modifier that slowly increases towards +300 will be added to your relations with the Ruler. Any Grievance gained against that Ruler will be reduced by -40%. When two Rulers declare Friendship with each other, each active diplomatic treaty they have increases the maximum relations bonus by +25, up to +400 in total.

Maintaining a declaration costs 10 Gold upkeep per Turn, which increases by 10 Gold for each additional declaration.

Declarations can be made and ended through Pronouncement.

Declaring a <hyperlink>Friendship</hyperlink> with <eventColor>{Target.Name}</eventColor> can strengthen your relations with <eventColor>{PlayerB.Name}</eventColor>, while a <hyperlink>Rivalry</hyperlink> can turn <eventColor>{PlayerB.Name}</eventColor> against you.

description:
Declare a Rivalry with another Ruler publicly.

A modifier that slowly decreases towards -300 will be added to your relations with the Ruler. Any Grievance gained against that Ruler will be increased by 40%. However, making treaties becomes impossible and any existing treaties will be broken.

Additionally a rising Rival Justification modifier will be gained, which increases by 2 per Turn up to 30.

Maintaining a declaration costs 10 Gold upkeep per Turn, which increases by 10 Gold for each additional declaration.

Declarations can be made and ended through Pronouncement.

description:
Allegiance represents the commitment of a Free City to an Empire.

Allegiance is primarily gained by giving a Whispering Stones to the Free City Lord which starts Negotiation. Increasing allegiance will result in better Diplomatic State with the city, eventually leading to a Pact of Vassalage and Pact of Integration.
title: <allegiance></allegiance> Allegiance

description:
Boosts negotiations by adding half of the required allegiance to reach the next diplomatic state. The cost of this action increases with the amount of allegiance gained. This action can only be executed once while in the current diplomatic state.

You gain: {Influence}
Cost: {Cost}

description:
Because of your Relations with the Free City, there is a chance of the City declaring War on you at the start of every Turn.

You will not suffer any penalties for this, but the City may start sending armies to attack you when war is declared.

"Join us in our war, <eventColor>{Player.Lord.FirstName}</eventColor>! We shall make <eventColor>{Target.Lord.FirstName}</eventColor> regret the day <<p:Target.Lord>> attacked our mighty alliance!"
opinion_action_calltowar_received_defens: "We are under attack, <eventColor>{Player.Lord.FirstName}</eventColor>! We hope that you will honor your oath and come to our aid."
opinion_action_declaration_call_to_frien: "<eventColor>{Target.Lord.Name}</eventColor> has proven themselves a worthy friend to me. A shared friendship between you and <eventColor>{Target.Lord.FirstName}</eventColor> can only make us stronger!"
opinion_action_declaration_call_to_rival: "My rivalry with <eventColor>{Target.Lord.FirstName}</eventColor> is no secret. Join me and we will prevail over <<P:Target.Lord>> together!"

"I... Actually consider you a friend, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. Perhaps 000004820000000 and <eventColor>{HouseARace}</eventColor> can live together in harmony."
opinion_action_declaration_rivalry_defau: "Think of this as an official announcement that I, <eventColor>{HouseBLord.TitleName}</eventColor>, consider you an enemy."
"This realm would be better off without the likes of you, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. I'm warning you. Stay away from me and my people."
"We would all be better off without Rulers like you. Stay away from me and do not interfere with my plans."
opinion_action_declarewar_default: "You have been a thorn in my side long enough, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Prepare for war!"
opinion_action_declarewar_default_diplom: "Everyone has their limits, even those who aim for peace. And you have just crossed the line, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Prepare for battle."
opinion_action_declarewar_default_isolat: "Congratulations, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. You have managed to annoy me enough that I actually have to take action and destroy you myself."
opinion_action_declarewar_default_warlor: "You will see the true might of <eventColor>{HouseBLord.TitleName}</eventColor> and <<o:HouseBLord>> <eventColor>{HouseBRace.Name}</eventColor>."
opinion_action_declarewar_magicvictory_d: "You don't think I will stand idly by while you channel the powers of the Ancient Wonders, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Prepare for war!"
"You are not worthy of channeling the powers of the Ancient Wonders, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. You must be stopped!"
opinion_action_denounce_default: "You have crossed me, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>! I advise you to stop this treachery, or there will be consequences."
opinion_action_denounce_other_default: "Let it be known that <eventColor>{TargetLord.Name}</eventColor> has crossed me. <<Cp:TargetLord>> is not to be trusted!"
opinion_action_diplomaticstatechange_dec: "I am saddened to announce our coalition is breaking up. It seems like a bond between us was not as beneficial as I thought."
"I no longer see the value in collaborating with you. I shall continue my conquest alone."
opinion_action_diplomaticstatechange_inc: "I am glad to announce our bonds have strengthened, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Let us work toward a brighter age for both of us."
"I am glad that you, too, see the value in treaties and diplomacy. Together we shall forge a brighter age for our people."
opinion_default: "Greetings <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>, what is it that you want to discuss?"
opinion_default_diplomat: "Hail, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. What matters of diplomacy shall we discuss today?"
opinion_default_isolationist: "<eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I am very busy, what do you need?"
opinion_default_sage: "Fate brings us together once more. What questions burden you, <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>?"
opinion_default_warlord: "Strength, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. What brings you to my war room?"
opinion_endwar: "Welcome, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. This war has been very costly for us both. I hope that you are here so we may discuss its end."
opinion_firstmeet_default: "Allow me to introduce myself. I am <eventColor>{HouseBLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of the 000004820000000. Let us hope this realm is big enough for all of us."
opinion_firstmeet_default_diplomat: "Hail, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Allow me to introduce myself. I am <eventColor>{HouseBLord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Many Godir make war, I aim to make peace."
opinion_firstmeet_default_dragon_to_gian: "Yet another Giant King rises to destroy our marvels. Have you come to seek redemption, or will you thrash in futility as the fools of Myrrida once did?"
opinion_firstmeet_default_giant_to_drago: "A Dragon crosses my path. Stay your forked tongue in my presence, lest you suffer my primal might."
opinion_firstmeet_default_isolationist: "Another Ruler in this realm. How many more can this realm take? Let us just agree to stay out of each other's way, hm?"
opinion_firstmeet_default_sage: "Greetings, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. May wisdom guide your path in this realm."
opinion_firstmeet_default_spy: "A new contender for power in this realm appears before me. Tell me, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>, are you a master, or a pawn?"
opinion_firstmeet_default_void: "It seems we meet under special circumstances, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Perhaps we'll discuss our relations at a later time."
opinion_firstmeet_default_warlord: "Well met, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I am <eventColor>{HouseBLord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Prove your strength to me, and we may yet conquer this realm together."
opinion_firstmeet_negative: "So you are the notorious <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>. I suggest you keep your distance from my lands, otherwise life here may become very unpleasant for you."
opinion_firstmeet_negative_diplomat: "So you are the inconsiderate <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I am <eventColor>{HouseBLord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Many Godir make war, I aim to make peace. Even with the likes of you."
opinion_firstmeet_negative_dragon_to_gia: "Yet another Giant rises to destroy our marvels. Bow before your betters and plead for redemption, lest I reduce you to dust."
opinion_firstmeet_negative_giant_to_drag: "So this realm is infested with Dragons. It falls to us Giants to put your forgotten breed in your place."
opinion_firstmeet_negative_isolationist: "Another ruler comes to threaten my empire. Just stay out of my way, and I will stay out of yours."
opinion_firstmeet_negative_sage: "Sometimes fate puts adversaries in our way to test our resolve. I hope for all our sakes that you are no such adversary."
opinion_firstmeet_negative_spy: "A new pawn appears before me. You look like a Godir, but are you ready to face the likes of me?"
opinion_firstmeet_negative_warlord: "So you are <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{HouseARace.Name}</eventColor>. I am not impressed. Tread carefully, before I decide that your realm is actually worth conquering."
opinion_firstmeet_positive: "I have heard great things about you, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I look forward to seeing your progress here."
opinion_firstmeet_positive_diplomat: "Hail, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>! It seems we share kinship. My name is <eventColor>{HouseBLord.Name}</eventColor>. Too many Godir wage war on the realms. I find it more rewarding to make peace. Don't you agree?"
opinion_firstmeet_positive_dragon_to_gia: "I rarely meet a reasonable Giant. Will you be the first one that earns my trust?"
opinion_firstmeet_positive_giant_to_drag: "I rarely meet a reasonable Dragon. Prove and redeem yourself to me before you gain my trust."
opinion_firstmeet_positive_isolationist: "Of the many strangers on this realm, you seem to be the most reasonable. However, I do not engage in the petty squabbles of the other Godir. Let us simply live and let live."
opinion_firstmeet_positive_merchant: "I have heard great things about you, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I look forward to seeing your progress here alongside mine."
opinion_firstmeet_positive_sage: "It is a blessed day when a <eventColor>{HouseBLord.Title}</eventColor> meets a <eventColor>{HouseALord.Title}</eventColor> like you. Welcome, <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>. Let us rule this realm with wisdom."
opinion_firstmeet_positive_spy: "So a new Ruler has appeared in this realm of schemes and conquest. Welcome, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. Let us hope we can manipulate this realm together."
opinion_firstmeet_positive_warlord: "I rarely meet a powerful Ruler like myself who knows that true power lies in strength. Prove your strength to me, and we may yet conquer this realm together."
opinion_firstmeet_sectorclaim: "So you are the one who just took away that promising province... Let us hope it does not happen again."
opinion_foreshadow_degrade_default: "I feel like our empires are drifting apart, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Perhaps our alliance was a mistake..."
opinion_foreshadow_degrade_default_isola: "Your schemes and squabbles are starting to annoy me, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Perhaps I am better off without you."
opinion_foreshadow_degrade_default_sage: "Your actions give me pause, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. Perhaps my trust in you was misplaced."
opinion_foreshadow_degrade_default_spy: "Your actions are interfering with my plans, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Tread carefully, before I decide to end your rulership."
opinion_foreshadow_degrade_default_warlo: "Your strategies are beginning to anger me, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Tread carefully, lest you find yourself at the receiving end of my wrath."
opinion_foreshadow_endwar_default: "This war of ours is tiresome, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. Sometimes I wonder if it would be better to end it."
opinion_foreshadow_improve_default: "I was thinking of you, <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>. We have much in common. Perhaps we can bring our empires closer together."
opinion_foreshadow_improve_default_diplo: "I have been pondering the many allies and enemies I have in this realm. I am glad that you seem to be one of the former. Let us try to bring our empires closer."
opinion_foreshadow_improve_default_isola: "I must say, you may actually be worth my attention, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. Perhaps our empires may actually be able to coexist."
opinion_foreshadow_improve_default_merch: "I was just thinking about you, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. How fare our treaties and trade deals? Perhaps we can improve them."
opinion_foreshadow_improve_default_sage: "Your actions speak for your wisdom, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. I am glad to see our fates entwining."
opinion_foreshadow_improve_default_spy: "I usually consider others to be pawns, to be used as I see fit. But you, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>, may well be more than that."
opinion_foreshadow_war_default: "You're angering me, <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>. I'm warning you, if you keep going like this, I will see an end to your reign right here."
opinion_maintainwar: "Let us waste no time with words, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. Only on the field of battle will our differences be settled."
opinion_negative: "What do you want? Be quick, I have an empire to lead."
opinion_negative_diplomat: "The crude <eventColor>{HouseALord.Title}</eventColor> speaks to me once more. As always, I will do my best to be courteous."
opinion_negative_isolationist: "What do you want? I have more important things to do than to listen to you."
opinion_negative_merchant: "<eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I am incredibly busy dealing with more important matters than you. What do you want?"
opinion_negative_sage: "Some conversations only happen to test our patience. This seems to be one such conversation."
opinion_negative_spy: "<eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I would ask how you fare, but, honestly, I do not care about your well-being."
opinion_negative_warlord: "I warn you not to disturb me too much, lest our next meeting take place on the battlefield."
opinion_personality_dislike: "Some would consider your course of action deeply unwise, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. Especially if you want to avoid vexing me!"
opinion_personality_like: "We may be not so different after all, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. Your actions are promising. By all means, continue!"
opinion_positive: "It is always a pleasure to speak with you, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. What do you want to discuss?"
opinion_positive_diplomat: "Hail, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>! It is a pleasure to speak with you. Please, tell me what you need."
opinion_positive_isolationist: "Greetings, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Of all the squabbling Rulers in this realm, you seem to be somewhat reasonable. What brings you to my empire?"
opinion_positive_merchant: "Greetings, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>! Are you here to trade, or merely to gaze upon my grand empire?"
opinion_positive_sage: "The tides of fate favor me, bringing you here. What can I do for you, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>?"
opinion_positive_spy: "Greetings, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. May all your plans come to fruition!"
opinion_positive_warlord: "Strength, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>! May the fields be flooded with the blood of your enemies."
opinion_response_calltowar_accepted: "Me and my <eventColor>{HouseBRace.Name}</eventColor> will join you in your war against <eventColor>{Target.Name}</eventColor>!"
opinion_response_calltowar_declined: "I cannot join you in your war, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>."
opinion_response_calltowar_received: "The rules of honor allow me some time before responding to your call to war. Let me think about it."
opinion_response_calltowar_reply_accepte: "Welcome to the war, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>! <eventColor>{Target.Name}</eventColor> has no chance against us both!"
opinion_response_calltowar_reply_decline: "So this is how you honor your oaths, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>? It seems that it is time for us to re-evaluate our relationship."
opinion_response_declaration_mutualfrien: "I am pleased to see we share a friend in <eventColor>{Target.Lord.Name}</eventColor>. Together, we shall prevail!"
opinion_response_declaration_mutualrival: "I am pleased that you have seen the true colors of my rival <eventColor>{Target.Lord.FirstName}</eventColor>. <<Cp:Target.Lord>> deserves nothing more."
opinion_response_declaration_playerfrien: "I am disappointed to learn you are not willing to commit to your promise of friendship, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>."
"I am pleased to know you consider me your friend, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I will remember this."
"So you seek friendship with the 000004820000000? We shall see, perhaps you will prove worthy."
opinion_response_declaration_playerrival: "I hear you are finally willing to end your dispute with me. Very promising. Perhaps we may still forge good relations after all."
"You would declare me your rival? Very well, let us see who laughs last!"
"This is a great shame, <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>, we had such high hopes for the future."
opinion_response_declaration_rivaloffrie: "I consider <eventColor>{Target.Lord.TitleName}</eventColor> to be my friend. It disappoints me that you would make an enemy out of <<P:Target.Lord>>."
opinion_response_declarewar_default: "Very well, <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>..." <<p:HouseBLord>> says through gritted teeth. "If it is a war you want, a war you will get. Call the banners!"
opinion_response_denounce_default: "I recognize my transgression, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I hope there is no bad blood between us."
opinion_response_diplomaticstatechange_d: "I am saddened to see our coalition fall apart. Perhaps a bond between us is not as beneficial as I thought."
opinion_response_diplomaticstatechange_i: "I am glad to see the bonds we have forged are stronger, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Let us work toward a brighter age for both of us."
opinion_response_negativefirstmeet_negat: "Perhaps insults were to be expected from a '<eventColor>{HouseALord.Title}</eventColor>' such as you. Make no mistake, you will pay for addressing me like this."
opinion_response_negativefirstmeet_posit: "I am disappointed by your hostility, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. Perhaps my positive assumptions about you were misplaced."
opinion_response_positivefirstmeet_negat: "You think a feeble attempt at flattery will convince me of your goodwill? You will need more than that, "<eventColor>{HouseALord.Title}</eventColor>"."
opinion_response_positivefirstmeet_posit: "I accept this gesture of goodwill, <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>. Thank you."
opinion_warcoordination_accepted_default: "I cannot promise you anything, <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>, but I accept your bounty."
opinion_warcoordination_declined_default: "Unfortunately, I cannot help you with this bounty, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Perhaps later."
opinion_warcoordination_failed_default: "I am sorry, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>, I cannot complete this bounty."
opinion_warcoordination_success_default: "I did as you asked, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>, the bounty has been fulfilled."
opinion_warcoordination_update_pending_d: "I am considering my tactics, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>, I am not sure yet if I can complete the bounty."
opinion_warcoordination_update_running_n: "My army is near the target, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I may be able to complete the bounty."
"Reaching the target may take longer than anticipated, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>."
"No news yet on the bounty! I'll keep you informed, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>."
opinion_warcoordination_update_running_p: "Unfortunately, my priorities have shifted, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I may be able to resume progress on achieving the bounty later."
"My army is getting closer to the target, I hope to reach it soon."
opinion_warcoordination_update_start_def: "My army has just left on a mission towards the target, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I will keep you informed on their progress."
trade_default: "A trade, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>? Very well. What do you propose?"
trade_default_negative: "I warn you to not waste my time, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>. What do you offer?"
trade_default_positive: "It will be a pleasure to practice the fine art of trading with you, <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>."
trade_fair_default: "This exchange seems fair to me. Agreed?"
trade_nodeal_demand_resource_default: "I currently do not want to part with this particular resource. Perhaps I will reconsider when you have something more interesting to offer."
trade_nodeal_gift_resource_default: "This resource is of no interest to me at the moment."
trade_offer_default: "Greetings <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I would like to propose a trade, what do you think?"
trade_offer_endwar_default: "This war has been going on long enough; let us put an end to it."
trade_offer_endwar_losing: "I know when I am outmatched, please let us end this senseless war."
trade_offer_endwar_losing_vassalage: "You have won this war <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>. I am defeated but I can still be of use. Do not cast me into the void, allow me to serve you instead!"
trade_offer_endwar_winning_vassalage: "You have lost this war <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>, but I do not wish to cast you into the void. Take the knee, and join me in glory!"
trade_offer_fair_default: "<eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>, would you be interested in a trade? This seems like a fair proposition to me."
trade_offer_request_default: "<eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>, would you be interested in a trade? In return I can offer you the following."
trade_offer_sell_default: "Greetings, <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>. My empire has something to offer, are you interested?"
trade_proposal_demand_default: "Your request is reasonable, but I require something in return. Perhaps one of the following."
trade_proposal_demand_resource_default: "I may be willing to provide some of my resources, but I require something from you as well, <eventColor>{HouseALord.FirstName}</eventColor>."
trade_proposal_gift_default: "An interesting proposal, <eventColor>{HouseALord.Name}</eventColor>, I can offer you the following in return."
trade_proposal_gift_resource_default: "Interesting, I suppose I could use this resource, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I would be willing to part with the following."
trade_proposal_offergift_default: "You would offer me a gift? I appreciate that, <eventColor>{HouseALord.TitleName}</eventColor>. I prefer one of the following."

description:
The threat level represents how threatened other Ruler feel.

This level is influenced by many factors that look at how well each Ruler is doing: for example if they have large Army, many City, or are supported by many allies.

The threat level is expressed as a relations modifier.
factors: We've found out the following contributing factors.
level_-1_description: The <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> feels threatened by your <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink>, which affects your <hyperlink>relations</hyperlink> with them by 50<badRelation></badRelation> and also makes trading with them more costly.
level_0_description: The <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> feels indifferent about your <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink> which may still change over time.
level_1_description: The <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> feels confident toward your <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink>, which affects your <hyperlink>Relations</hyperlink> with them by 50<goodRelation></goodRelation>.
title: Threat Level

activeinfo: Active pronouncement actions that target this Ruler are still running. Their effects are applied once the actions finish.
description: A statement or declaration that <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> can make towards other Rulers to enhance their <hyperlink>Relations</hyperlink>. Includes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FabricatedCasusBelliConcept]fabricating[/hyperlink] <casusBelli></casusBelli> <hyperlink>Grievance</hyperlink>, making declarations, <hyperlink>Calling Rulers to War</hyperlink> and more.
title: Pronouncements
tooltip: Opens the pronouncement sub-options. These enable you to make statements or declarations which will affect your relationship with the opposing Ruler.

description:
During the negotiation phase, all Empire may negotiate with a Free City for higher Allegiance and better diplomatic states. Once an Empire has secured enough Allegiance for a Pact of Vassalage, this competition ends and the \"winning\" Empire enters the Vassalage Phase.

These are the Diplomatic State of the Negotiation Phase: War Neutral Pact of Cooperation Pact of Loyalty Pact of Vassalage
title: Negotiation Phase of Free Cities

description:
During the vassalage phase, only the overlord Empire may negotiate with a Free City. Other Empire can only declare War on the Free City by declaring war on the Free City overlord.

These are the Diplomatic State of the Vassalage Phase:Pactofvassalagelvl-3conceptPactofvassalagelvl-2conceptPactofvassalagelvl-1concept Vassalage Bonded Vassalage Flourishing Vassalage Supreme Vassalage

Once Flourishing Vassalage is reached, the Pact of Integration becomes available, allowing an Empire to fully absorb the Free City.
title: Vassalage Phase of Free Cities

description:
Free Cities can be vassalized by Rulers through Negotiations or by converting an owned or conquered City into a vassal city.

Vassal cities have many advantages:They will share their income and magic materials.They will aid you in wars.They will grant you vision of their domain.
Vassal cities may eventually also be integrated into the Ruler's empire.

release_hero_crypt_description:
Transfer the remains of {HeroData.Name} from the Crypt of {Captor.Name} to the Crypt of {Owner.Name}. {HeroData.FirstName} can then be resurrected by {Owner.Lord.FirstName}.

Returning the remains as a gift will yield a {Relation} Relations Bonus.
{Captor.Lord.FirstName} will keep all of {HeroData.FirstName}'s equipment.
release_hero_description:
Return {HeroData.Name} from the Prison of {Captor.Name} back to {Owner.Name}. {HeroData.FirstName} will return to {Owner.Lord.FirstName}.

Returning {HeroData.Name} as a gift will yield a {Relation} Relations Bonus and counts as an act of good, {Alignment}.
{Captor.Lord.FirstName} will keep all of {HeroData.FirstName}'s equipment.

description:
An agreement between two Empire where resources may be exchanged or diplomatic permissions are granted.

A Wizard's Bond needs to be established for more advanced Treaties and to achieve an Alliance.

Treaties last indefinitely but may be broken manually or through declaring War. Breaking treaties is considered an evil act and will give the opposing Ruler a Grievance.

truce_description: Both <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> vow not to attack each other while the truce lasts. <rs_war></rs_war> <hyperlink>War</hyperlink> may still be declared, but counts as an <evilact></evilact><hyperlink>evil</hyperlink> act.

description: The Ruler is less inclined toward hostile actions, is keen to act more in favor of good relations with other Rulers and cities and will not break their <hyperlink>Alliances</hyperlink>.
name: Alliances

description: The Ruler is prone to making pronouncements and <hyperlink>Calls to War</hyperlink> more often, but is less eager to answer a call to war.
name: Covert

description: The Ruler favors gaining both cities and Rulers as vassals, but will not submit to becoming a vassal themselves.
name: Gaining vassals

description: The Ruler likes to carry on <hyperlink>Trade</hyperlink> but tends to place more value on their own side of the deal. Other Rulers may have to sweeten their offers to make a deal happen.
name: Hard bargains

description: The Ruler does not easily want to commit to relations and is reluctant to answer <hyperlink>Calls to War</hyperlink>.
name: Isolation

description: The Ruler engages in all forms of diplomacy to an equal degree as opportunities arise.
name: Neutral

description: The Ruler is committed to the <hyperlink>Treaty</hyperlink> they have with other Rulers and will always try to prevent them from being broken.
name: Never breaks <hyperlink>Treaty</hyperlink>

description: The Ruler will not submit to becoming another Ruler's vassal. During <rs_war></rs_war> <hyperlink>War</hyperlink>, they will not make peace of their own accord. They are more eager to call allies to war and will also more readily answer a <hyperlink>Call to War</hyperlink>.
name: Never Surrender

description: In general, the Ruler is not interested in having <hyperlink>Treaty</hyperlink> with other Rulers, making such trades more costly for the opposing side. They are reluctant to call another Ruler to war and to answer any incoming <hyperlink>Calls to War</hyperlink>.
name: Wary of Treaties

description: The Ruler is keen on making <hyperlink>Trade</hyperlink> offers fairly often.
name: Trading

description: The Ruler prefers forming <hyperlink>Treaty</hyperlink> with other Rulers and will not break any treaties or <hyperlink>Alliances</hyperlink> they have.
name: <hyperlink>Treaty</hyperlink>

description: The Ruler is tempted to make vassals of other strong Rulers.
name: Vassalize the Strong

description: The Ruler is easily provoked into going to <rs_war></rs_war> <hyperlink>War</hyperlink>, even over minor <casusBelli></casusBelli> <hyperlink>Grievance</hyperlink>. They will not sell or forgive any of their grievances and are more eager to send and answer a <hyperlink>Call to War</hyperlink>.
name: Driven by War

description: The Ruler will not go to <rs_war></rs_war> <hyperlink>War</hyperlink> over minor <casusBelli></casusBelli> <hyperlink>Grievance</hyperlink> and will want to justify their war.
name: War must be justified

description: Dislikes are part of how an AI Ruler perceives other Rulers and determines which Actions or statuses of another Ruler they will dislike. Relations with Rulers that trigger these dislikes will incur a relation penalty.
name: Dislike

description:
Preferences are part of how an AI Ruler perceives other Rulers and determine which Actions or statuses they like or dislike other Rulers to pursue.

Relations with Rulers that conform to these preferences will receive a relation bonus, while Relations with Rulers that trigger Dislikes will incur a relation penalty.
name: Personality Preference
Empires that have defeated other Empires
Empires without relationships with Free Cities
Empires with good Relations with Free Cities
Empires which get declared war upon
Empires that do not start Wars

description: A Ruler's Strategy determines how they will act in terms of their Economy, Research, and Military, but also on a Diplomatic Level.
name: Strategy

description: The Ruler favors expanding their empire by building and absorbing cities. They focus on improving their cities and defending them.
name: Expansion

description: The Ruler favors exploiting all forms of resources near them and will hunt down <hyperlink>Pickup</hyperlink>, marauders and cities with their army. Captured cities will be migrated into their own population.
name: Exploitation

description: The Ruler favors exploring the map, seeking out potential resources such as <hyperlink>Pickup</hyperlink> and <hyperlink>Ancient Wonder</hyperlink>.
name: Exploration

description: The Ruler favors capturing resources using large armies rather than building them themselves and will raze other Rulers' cities that they have occupied.
name: Extermination

description: The Ruler has no specific agenda or focus and acts more on the opportunities that present themselves.
name: Neutral

ai_desc: Let's fortify our positions. Allowing me to build near your borders will make the both of us stronger.
description: Both <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> are allowed to build on each other's <hyperlink>claimed</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> without triggering <casusBelli></casusBelli> <hyperlink>Grievance</hyperlink>.
name: Province-Claiming Pact

description:
Both Rulers are allowed to build on each other's claimed provinces for a fixed duration.

Effects:[bulletList]{RelationValue} RelationsRulers can capture and build on claimed provinces without incurring a penalty.[/bulletList]

ai_desc: This alliance no longer seems favorable to me. This is where we part ways.
description: Break your alliance and revert back to a peace state.
name: Break Alliance

description: Neither Ruler is allowed to build on each other's claimed provinces.
name: Break Province-Claiming Pact

description: The wizard's bond as well as any treaties and states that depend on it will be broken.
name: Break Wizard's Bond

description: The defensive pact is broken. Rulers will no longer automatically be called into defensive wars and no longer aid each other in battle against common enemies.
name: Break Defensive Pact

description: Neither Ruler will be allowed to move their armies through each other's domain.
name: Close Borders

description: Vision sharing between the two Rulers will end.
name: Break Share Vision

description: Neither Ruler will be allowed to use the teleporters of the other.
name: Break Teleporter Pact

description: End the vassalage. This releases the vassal but maintains the alliance without incurring any penalties.
name: End Vassalage

ai_desc: A wizard's bond will improve our relations and expand our diplomatic options.
description:
Both Ruler agree to a wizard's bond to improve Empire Relations and access new Treaty and Diplomatic States.

Effects:[bulletList]The Throne City of each Ruler will be revealed.Rulers can call each other to war.[/bulletList]

Leads to: Defensive PactOpen BordersProvince-Claiming PactTeleporter Pact
name: Wizard's Bond

ai_desc: A defensive pact will ensure no other Ruler dares defy us.
description:
A Diplomatic State in which the Ruler vow to come to each other's aid in defensive wars.

When war is declared on either Ruler, they will automatically send a Call to War to the other, asking them to aid them in the war. Answering this call to war will give the Ruler additional Grievance to use directly. Rulers may still refuse to accept this call but will break the defensive pact if they do.

Leads to: AllianceShare Vision
name: Defensive Pact

ai_desc: Let us open our borders to each other. This would greatly improve our mobility.
description: Both <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> open their borders to each other. This allows <hyperlink>Army</hyperlink> to move through <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> of the opposing Ruler without <hyperlink>trespassing</hyperlink>.
name: Open Borders

description:
Both Rulers open their borders to each other for a fixed duration.

Effects:[bulletList]{RelationValue} Relations.Rulers may move their armies freely through each other's domain.[/bulletList]

ai_desc: I propose we forge an alliance so that we may come to each other's aid in times of war.
description: Propose an <rs_alliance></rs_alliance> <hyperlink>Alliance</hyperlink> with the other Ruler. These are the strongest possible relations one can have. Both Rulers need to agree to a <rs_defensivepact></rs_defensivepact> <hyperlink>Defensive Pact</hyperlink> first.
name: Propose Alliance

ai_desc: Let us forget about the past and move into a new future!
description: Both Rulers agree to end the war and declare a truce, where they promise to cease all hostile action.
name: Make Peace

ai_desc: Surrender to me and survive as my loyal vassal. Together, the world will be ours.
description: Become overlord over the other Ruler.
name: You become overlord

description:
When captured Hero are returned to their original owner, they will become available for recruitment (for free). Heroes in the Crypt will be returned to the crypt of the original owner instead.

When reaching an Alliance, Ruler will automatically return their captured heroes to the other ruler.
description_trade: Both sides will <hyperlink>return their captured heroes</hyperlink>.
name: Returning captured heroes.

ai_desc: I surrender my empire to you. Let us forge an alliance and work together with me as your vassal.
description: Become a vassal of the other Ruler.
description_generic:
This effectively creates a fixed Alliance with the other Ruler which only the overlord can break. The deal only works if neither Ruler is already a vassal. The overlord will gain additional resources per turn based on the income of their vassal.

The vassal will automatically be drawn into any wars their overlord is fighting and will end any wars the overlord is not involved in.
name: You become a vassal

ai_desc: This relationship is over. I'll be coming for you!
description: Declare war on the other Ruler. This will change your diplomatic state to war and you suffer alignment and relation penalties with other Rulers and cities.
name: Declare war without justification

description: You cannot declare war on the other Ruler while either of you is the vassal of another Ruler. Overlords can enter into wars and their vassals will join them.

ai_desc: Your actions cannot be forgiven. I will have my revenge!
description: Declare war on the other Ruler with major <hyperlink>War Justification</hyperlink>. Your diplomatic state will change to war and other Rulers and vassal cities will support you.
name: Declare war with major <hyperlink>War Justification</hyperlink> (51+ <CasusBelli></CasusBelli>)

ai_desc: You have wronged me too many times. You are next on my list!
description: Declare war on the other Ruler with minor <hyperlink>War Justification</hyperlink>.
name: Declare war with minor <hyperlink>War Justification</hyperlink> (1-25<CasusBelli></CasusBelli>)

ai_desc: You didn't think I would simply forget, did you?
description: Declare war on the other Ruler with moderate <hyperlink>War Justification</hyperlink>. Your diplomatic state will change to war and your relations may suffer.
name: Declare war with moderate <hyperlink>War Justification</hyperlink> (26-50<CasusBelli></CasusBelli>)

ai_desc: Sharing our intel will provide us with mutual protection!
description: The Rulers form a mutual intelligence sharing pact.
name: Research Pact

description: The Rulers form a mutual intelligence sharing pact for a fixed duration.
name: Intelligence Sharing Pact

ai_desc: Let us share our vision so we can better assist each other!
description: Both <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> share their <hyperlink>Vision</hyperlink> with each other and will reveal explored areas to each other.
name: Share Vision

description:
Both Rulers share their vision with each other for a fixed duration.

Effects:[bulletList]{RelationValue} Relations.Rulers gain active vision from one another.[/bulletList]

bio_1: Building an undead empire requires a great deal of tomb digging and pantheon raising. Along with the maintenance of soul canals and ossuaries. As an Architect, Tiha-Mha continues her work in both life and death.
bio_2: As for any other empire, expansion and new recruits remain essential. Mha-Arduk sees to it that the legions of the undead are replenished; whether through welcoming the risen or creating them anew.
bio_3: Dead do not die, but they decay. Ossuaries are raised to preserve the body of the dead. The Baron of Bones has turn this grim necessity into a symbol of aristocracy among the unliving. For some, gold gleams brighter than death.
bio_4: Khain's stars speak of magic and immortality. They whisper of a long-forgotten arcane power. One meant to be held, but not hidden. A power to be passed on, to be bestowed upon the next generation.
bio_5: Azaeris' hand and blade are guided by destiny. The constellations on his skin are simpler than most, but no less important. They are names to be crossed, hearts to be pierced. And he will not rest until every star etched upon his flesh flickers out.
bio_6: It is strange to be one of the Children of the Stars when you don't believe in destiny. Yharlax sees the constellations etched into his skin as shackles on his freedom. He remains loyal to the cause, so long as his interests align with the stars.
bio_7: What greater art is there than the shaping of souls? For Gruth the answer is clear.
bio_8: Trees and forests are great works of art from nature. Tharthes simply elevates them to perfect them like marbles.
bio_9: Kafpal loves to admire the weather while soaring above it. Storms are breathtaking, snowfalls are heartwarming... and what a delight to turn them into a spectacle.

bio:
A simple old man in appearance, Anon represents Archon virtues like few others. As a Pacifist, Scholar, and Oracle he presides over the Order of Augurs, ensuring that their divine prophecies are chronicled and debated with great care. His wisdom and patience are renowned even among the Archons' enemies.

The Archon Diviners are the enlightened followers of Anon. They dwell at the Lakes of Sagacity, attending to the Order of Augurs and their divine Observatories. When the starlight leads them away from the blessed shores of Emnora, the Archon Diviners will stand against evil and fight for the fulfillment of their prophecies.
name: Archon Diviners

bio:
The fate of Fredric is a tragic one: cursed in life by the Lizardfolk and again in death by Urrath's followers, Fredric and his kin of Archon descendants rose as undead Revenants, driven by evil. Yet when the seals on Athla were shattered, their souls broke free from Urrath's vile influence.

Since then, Fredric seeks a cure to the Revenant curse, fighting for the right of his people to exist and retain their Archon legacy.
name: Devout Revenants

bio:
In life, Hyka-Tha was a Grand Architect, known, respected, and revered. In death, she has risen as the advocate of the Awakened. Upon regaining consciousness, she sought her former allies for guidance and support in her corrupted state... But her prayers were answered with a sword wreathed in flames. Now, she wages war—not for vengeance, but for her kin.

More and more Awakened gather under Hyka-Tha's command. Now that they have regained awareness, they ask themselves: If the living also destroy and consume relentlessly, why are the undead denied the right to exist? And so, the deceased raise their necropolises—and their fallen kin—building an empire for those who once fell.
name: The Awakened

bio:
The last remaining Keeper of Life, Empress Julia stood against Death’s bloody star, defending flawed mortality even when its forces unleashed plagues upon a pristine paradise. She is one of the few remaining ancient immortal elves, uncorrupted by the ages and hardship she has endured. Torn from her family and homeland by Lithyl Nightweaver, Julia was captured in the Umbral Abyss and forced to watch helplessly as Merlin traded his soul for her freedom. Despite it all, she balances life's resilience, allies with the peaceable way of nature, and despises those with vast ambitions and narrow visions.

The Exalted Elves have flocked to Julia like moths to a kind and peaceful flame. Like Julia, they aim to bring peace to ravaged realms, rebuilding them in harmony with nature.
name: Exalted Elves

bio:
Kledas once created for the Archons, uniting nature and megaliths into breathtaking works of art. But his ambition drove him to create a wonder that defied the gods; and for that, he was cast out to suffer the Torment of Shadows. Now, Kledas roams the world, searching Wonders for remnants of his lost creations, desperate to remember who he was... and what he was capable of.

The Dwarves who follow Kledas are both his worshipers and his pupils. They consider him the ultimate artist, a creator of poetry in timeless forms. Every pupil strives to express their art in an unique way, guided by the teachings of their tormented master.
name: Virtuous Crafters

bio:
When the Archons cast their Celestial hosts into war, Archpaladin Maliel steers his heavenly chariot headmost. With cleansing flame he descends on the wicked and with zealous conviction he drills his sacred warriors. He is a Paragon of the Order of Highmen and as such propagates their beliefs across the Astral Sea.

The Highmen are the disciples of an Archon Order with high emphasis on martial prowess. Their history is deeply interwoven with the Human race, who they fostered on many Worlds Within. Through virtuous lives some of those Humans would then ascend to Archonhood—and become Highmen themselves.
name: Highmen

bio:
There have always been people like Petras: those born with such a profound sensitivity to the stars that the constellations themselves emerge upon their flesh. But destiny had something even greater prepared for Petras, and so she awakened the Eye of Prophecies. For she is the Weaver of Fates, the one who mends unraveled destinies and guides the Children of the Stars.

As Oracles read the skies, the Stars' Children read their own skin, following the dictates of their marks as a duty to fulfill. They are guided towards mysterious tasks, whose consequences they do not seek to understand. Yet, some whisper that their Weaver is able to see the threads combine into the greater story called the Tapestry of Destiny.
name: Stars' Children

bio:
Once an Archon Titan, Calioth fell during the Archon war against Myrrida. Recently, eldritch magic brutally tore him from his eternal rest, harnessing his rage against enemies he would once call ally. If any spark of light endures within him, it is long buried beneath the shroud of his dark, decaying flesh.

The Ancient Revenants were once Archons who fought and fell in the name of their divine purpose. Even in death, their struggle endures, for the very darkness they fought now pulls their strings.
name: Ancient Revenants

"Like the geysers of lustral water we must sanctify the earth and tend it with providential care. By this truth, we erect fountains upon these torrents and thus, by understanding the labor of His work, we draw closer to the Allfather. For what are these streams, if not the incarnation of the Well of Creation made manifest?"

description:
Attempt to persuade the Infestation to fight somewhere else or crusade against an evil Empire you are at War with, which removes this Crusader Host permanently.

lore: If walls could talk, the cracks in this structure would whisper the chronicles of the crusades against Urrath. After ages of strife, this Crusader Host still stands unshaken, serving as a meeting ground for the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> and other champions of light. Yet the Crusaders' duty is not limited to the Umbral infestations; their honor compels them to raise their swords against all who rule through evil.
name: Crusader Host

body_footer: The world returns to normal when your vision ends. Yet still you laugh. For it is you who will ruin the world.
body_header: Donning the mask of the maniacal mage, you see the hidden magical connections in the world. Powers surges through you.
body_lore: You extend your hand, and lightning jumps from your fingertips. You laugh. It scorches your enemies and amplifies the power of your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. The more spells you cast, the stronger you become. You laugh. The world bows before your arcane supremacy. <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> bow. <<m: <hyperlink>Magic Material</hyperlink>>> fuse to your body. <hyperlink>Ancient Wonder</hyperlink> reveal their ancient secrets to you. You laugh.
button_0: "I will herald an Age of Magic!"
title: Desolations of Magic

body_footer: All you remember are the unending strands of arcane power. You have become Magic, Consumer of Worlds.
body_header: The deed is done. The devastation of the realm is complete. And you were the architect of its destruction.
body_lore: While your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> revel in the destruction and chaos in the realm, you try to remember the world as it once was. But images of the days before your reaping are gone.
button_0: "Now is my time. The Age of Magic."

title: Age of Magic

body_footer: The vision ends there. The world returns to normal. Your path is clear. You and your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> shall ruin the world.
body_header: Donning the mask of the snarling general, the world is set ablaze. A bloodthirst overcomes you. Your snarl becomes a grin.
body_lore: A restless power swells within you. You discover an axe and sword in your hands. Countless enemies assail you from all sides. Peasants and princes. Mages and <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink>. Even <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>. You sing and laugh as you mow them all down like wheat during harvest. You bellow as your banners unfurl in their fallen cities. Your frenzied <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> chant your name. The carnelian war mask and your face are one and the same.
button_0: "I will herald an Age of War!"
title: Desolations of War

body_footer: All you remember is the eternal tides of battles. You have become War, Executioner of Worlds.
body_header: The necessary work is done. The devastation of the realm is complete. And you were the architect of its destruction.
body_lore: While your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> revel in the destruction and chaos in the realm, you try to remember the world as it once was. But images of the days before your reaping are gone.

title: Age of War

body_footer: Your vision ends and the world returns to normal. Your path is clear. You and your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> shall ruin the world.
body_header: Donning the mask of the weeping grave keeper, the world grows dark and cold. An eerie silence descends on the lands.
body_lore: Among countless lifeless <hyperlink>City Ruin</hyperlink>, only your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> thrive. The fields are sown with the bones of your rivals, crushed under the decaying feet of ravaging Undead. You feel Death's hand on your shoulder. You turn to face <<P:PlayerLeader>> and see that you are both wearing the same obsidian mask. You simultaneously remove your masks to discover that the face of Death is yours.
button_0: "I will herald an Age of Death!"
title: Desolations of Death

title: Age of Death

body_footer: That is the branch you must follow. Which voice, which color, does your heart elect? Where does your destiny lie?
body_header: As you prepare your strategy for ruling this new realm, the world around you gives way to the vision of a World Tree.
body_lore: You climb the kaleidoscopic Tree of unprecedented vastness. It is the Cosmic Tree: its branches extend endlessly towards all poles of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. Whispers, songs, and shouts call and beckon you. Some friendly. Some harsh. Some seductive. They all know your name. Yet you realize that there is one color—one branch—that harbors the destiny of your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>.
button_0: <order></order> Follow the golden branch towards the chanting.
button_1: <chaos></chaos> Follow the crimson branch towards the loud laughter.
button_2: <arcana></arcana> Follow the blue branch towards the incantations.
button_3: <matter></matter> Follow the crystal branch leading down to the ground.
button_4: <nature></nature> Follow the blossoming branch towards the singing.
button_5: <shadow></shadow> Follow the dead branch towards the whispers.
title: Vision of Destiny

body_footer: When Law and <order></order> <hyperlink>Order Affinity</hyperlink> rule the realm at your behest, the divine light shall once more embrace you. And empower you.
body_header: Your spirit is lifted when golden trumpets herald your arrival as you near the end of the golden branch.
body_lore: Pillars of light beam down from the very heavens to anoint you as their serving knight. You feel a primordial presence that both judges and blesses you. A glimpse of immense divine power. With a final flash, the light is then dimmed. Your vision ends. Yet your mission is revealed.
button_0: "I will prove that I am a Steward of Peace and Order."
title: Destiny of Order

body_footer: This has always been your destiny. And with the blessing of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <order></order> <hyperlink>Order Affinity</hyperlink>, your supremacy is only just beginning.
body_header: You have become the Apex of <order></order> <hyperlink>Order Affinity</hyperlink>. The <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Master/Mistress}</eventColor>>> of Lawfulness. You brought Order onto this realm.
body_lore: You delivered your own destiny through relentless effort and determination. Your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, your trusty followers, tools, and weapons, have diligently helped you complete your tasks. Your work is now complete. But now is not the time to grow idle. Not when victory is within your reach.
button_0: "Wherever Order exists, so will my <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. As will I."

reward2: The <hyperlink>Light spirit</hyperlink>, <hyperlink>Blessed soul</hyperlink>, and <hyperlink>Archon astra</hyperlink> become available in the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink>.
title: Exalted by Order

body_footer: When the denizens of this realm serve no other Master than <chaos></chaos> <hyperlink>Chaos Affinity</hyperlink>, your burning dominion will be unfettered.
body_header: All of your fears and inhibitions melt away as you sprint over the crimson branch into the burning canopy.
body_lore: Their raging fires set you free. There are no rules here. Everything is permitted in the realm of <chaos></chaos> <hyperlink>Chaos Affinity</hyperlink>. An unseen entity observes you. You feel it savoring your presence. Your excitement becomes its pleasure. With a final blaze, the fires are suddenly snuffed. Your vision ends. Yet your mission is revealed.
button_0: "I will prove that I am a Conqueror and a Kindler of Chaos."
