body_footer: When your mastery over magic binds this realm and its secrets, the full extent of your <arcana></arcana> <hyperlink>Astral Affinity</hyperlink> talents are unleashed.
body_header: The blue branch leads you higher and higher, until it disappears from underneath your feet. You float, immersed in <arcana></arcana> <hyperlink>Astral Affinity</hyperlink> essence.
body_lore: The fundamental teachings of the cosmos are archived here. Yet before you can study them, you learn that something ethereal dwells within the lofty library. You cannot see it, but you can sense its presence, like lightning. It studies you for a spell. With a sudden thunderclap, your vision ends. Yet your mission is now revealed, inscribed in your mind.
button_0: "I will prove my devotion to magic as a Scholar of Astral."
title: Destiny of Astral

body_lore: The crystal branches' endless knocking reminds you of smiths hammering and masons hewing. Thick and slender limbs alike have twisted and entwined into awe-inspiring cathedrals of crystalline wood. You sense their architect, concealing itself inside its work. It observes your motions and ponders your appreciation. The vision suddenly ends as the structures collapse. You awake, your mind fixed on your mission.
button_0: "I will prove that I am an Artisan and a Keeper of Materium."
title: Destiny of Materium

body_footer: When your gardens reach the horizon and your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> have multiplied and fortified, you shall be granted full power over <nature></nature> <hyperlink>Nature Affinity</hyperlink>.
body_header: The blossoms' sweet scents invigorate you as you eventually reach the verdant bough's end in the thick canopy.
body_lore: You have arrived in a paradise where everything infinitely expands and grows to fill the great nothingness beyond. Flora and fauna alike curiously notice your presence. As does another sprawling entity, hidden just out of sight. It plants a seed in your thoughts. As it buds, the vision withers away before your eyes. Yet your mission is grafted in your mind.
button_0: "I will prove that I am a Tender of Growth and Nature."
title: Destiny of Nature

body_footer: When you sit in your web of shadows and deceits, the full potency of <shadow></shadow> <hyperlink>Shadow Affinity</hyperlink> is yours to manipulate.
body_header: The dead branch leads you down, not up. You are guided into the coldest and darkest shadows of the Tree.
body_lore: An unspeakable terror dwells here, but you feel no fear, only admiration. The entity extends one of its hooked limbs to grace you. Its touch intoxicates you. You desire more. You drink from a cool well of secrets. But soon light begins to pierce the shadows. You are back in the world. Your vision has ended. Yet your mission is revealed.
button_0: "I will prove that I am a Manipulator, and a Servant of Shadow."
title: Destiny of Shadow

body_footer: This has always been your destiny. And with the blessing of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <shadow></shadow> <hyperlink>Shadow Affinity</hyperlink>, your influence is only just growing.
body_header: You have become the Apex of <shadow></shadow> <hyperlink>Shadow Affinity</hyperlink>. The <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Master/Mistress}</eventColor>>> of Decay. And you have brought <eventColor>{GLOBAL.ShadowConcept.Name}</eventColor> into this realm.
body_lore: You delivered your own destiny through relentless effort and determination. Your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, your trusty followers, tools, and weapons, have diligently helped you complete your tasks. Your work is now complete. But now is not the time to grow idle. Not when victory is within your reach.
button_0: "Wherever Shadow exists, so will my <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. As will I."

reward2: The <hyperlink>Fallen angel</hyperlink>, <hyperlink>Undead titan</hyperlink>, and <hyperlink>Bone dragon</hyperlink> become available in the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink>.
title: Immersed in Shadow

body_footer: As long as the 9 remains at the 62, your destiny cannot be fulfilled.
body_header: You have found the 62 from your visions. But it is not uninhabited.
body_lore: You remember the sinister presence in your dreams. That ominous guardian of the prophesied location of your Paradise. It is a 9 that roars when <<p:EventStackLeader>> notices your presence, even from afar. <<Cp:EventStackLeader>> stands in your way.
button_0: "This 9 must vacate this 62."
title: The Dweller Of Ruins

body_footer: To fulfill your destiny and deliver on the prophecy, you must rebuild a great <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> from these <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
body_header: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> has been removed from the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. Your destiny is within reach.
body_lore: The <hyperlink>City Ruin</hyperlink> call to you. You experience a sense of inner peace and belonging. Amid the rubble of the Ruins lies the Silver Crown from your vision. Blackened by weather and time, a slight polish is all that's required to see the gleaming promise hidden inside. It is the same as these Ruins: they are a broken heap of stones now, but they contain the promise of a <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> beyond reckoning.
button_0: "A fine City these Ruins will make."
title: Clearing the Rubble

body_footer: <<g:sentries,EventHouse>> mock you from the ramparts. You must claim this city from them.
body_header: You near the site of your Prophesied Land. It is the Free City of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>.
body_lore: The 84, led by <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor>, occupy the territory that is yours by divine right. You see the gleaming crown from your vision suspended in the air high over the city. Its sight inspires you and your warriors. It bids you to free <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> from its unrightful occupants.
button_0: "I will oust <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> and <<o:EventHouseLord>> 84 from my city!"
title: Marching on Paradise

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> is ready to become your <hyperlink>Throne City</hyperlink>.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> has fallen to your glorious might. Your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> triumphantly march through its streets.
body_lore: Your craftsmen are already repairing the city gates that your army destroyed moments before. This is your new home. You cannot explain it, but this feels just to you. This is the way the world should be.
button_0: "They were no match for me and my mighty <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>."
title: Paradise Conquered

body_footer: Will you risk angering your people and allow the pilgrims into <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>?
body_header: News of your efforts to build your Paradise travels far and wide. Pilgrims have arrived to settle in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_lore: The pilgrims are <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, kin of your people. They have come from all corners of this realm to join you in your quest to fulfill your Prophecy. Yet their arrival upsets the citizens of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. Why should the pilgrims profit from their hard work, they argue. If you allow them to enter, that will surely upset your population.
button_0: Welcome the pilgrims <population></population> to the discontent <unhappiness></unhappiness> of your citizens.
button_1: Slaughter the pilgrims <evilact></evilact> and feed <food></food> them to your population in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
button_2: Turn the pilgrims away.
button_3: Build <structureprod></structureprod> and furbish <gold></gold> dedicated homes <population></population> for the pilgrims.
title: Pilgrims to Paradise

body_footer: Their threats and insults continue for several hours. Perhaps it is best to end their lives quickly.
body_header: Your efforts to bring about an Age of Death have not gone unnoticed. Crusaders have rallied against you.
body_lore: A company of <eventColor>{RandomWarriorTitle}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{RandomIdol}</eventColor> have marched into your domain. They have vowed to kill the one responsible for delivering so much death on this realm. Three Heroes ride at the head of the company, repeating the same message over and over again: "Evil one! Your reign of death will end by our blades!" shouts <eventColor>{EventHero1}</eventColor>. "Your cursed soul shall be cleansed by our zeal," cries <eventColor>{EventHero2}</eventColor>. "Your cities of decay shall be purged by our holy flames!", roars <eventColor>{EventHero3}</eventColor>.
button_0: "My crypt welcomes you."
button_2: "Wait, you think I am evil?"
title: Death Sentence

body_footer: Those who died will be moved to your <hyperlink>Crypt</hyperlink>. Those who survived ought to join their <<EventHero1<eventColor>{brothers/sisters}</eventColor>>> in arms soon.
body_header: You have defeated the zealous <eventColor>{RandomWarriorTitle}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{RandomIdol}</eventColor>.
body_lore: You have proven their threats empty and their fervor idle. Now they lie at your feet, sacrificed to the great goal you serve, kindling for the cold flames of death.
button_0: "Ever closer creeps the hour of Death."
title: Death Sentence: Aftermath

body_footer: This <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> is nearby, although any new source of the <hyperlink>Magic Material</hyperlink> secured through trade or conquest will do. Will you claim it?
body_header: Your ongoing efforts to ruin the realm with the unfathomable force of Magic are proceeding well. Yet critical components remain missing.
body_lore: You sense you may need <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> to complete a set of <hyperlink>Magic Material</hyperlink> and thus achieve your arcane goals. There is a source not too far from your realm. Its image appears in your mind's eye. You can almost touch it.
button_0: Go forth and obtain the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>.
button_1: Brush off the sensation.
title: Securing the Set

body_footer: Although your scheme has not come into full fruition, the inevitability of your plotted course becomes increasingly apparent.
body_header: You have secured the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>. Your plans are advancing with every hour.
body_lore: You can feel how the <hyperlink>Magic Material</hyperlink> acts as a conduit for the magical energies that course through it. The air in your realm grows a bit thicker and becomes slightly more static. The pressure is building.
button_0: This world shall crumble soon.
title: Magical Match

body_footer: Inspired by the Endailon, you know it in your heart: claiming the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>, you will boost the productivity of your realm.
body_header: While overseeing construction in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, you are suddenly overwhelmed by a compulsion to create. An entity reveals itself to you.
body_lore: You know the entity from your vision. This is the architect of the Cathedral of Crystalline Wood. Within you swells the desire to craft fine tools and build high towers. The entity, the very <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <matter></matter> <hyperlink>Materium Affinity</hyperlink> that was drawn to your realm by your dedication to building, reveals to you a nearby <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>, which harbors secrets to build faster, higher, and better. It then pauses, seemingly observing your response.
button_0: Yes, the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> shall be mine!
button_3: Purge the urge. Reject your innate instincts. <materiumcrisis></materiumcrisis>
button_4: Instruct the citizens of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> to work <structureprod></structureprod>, never rest. <food></food>
title: The Muse of Craft

body_footer: You realize that the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> has departed. But your building fever abides.
body_header: You have claimed the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> and you are struck with an inspired revelation.
body_lore: You instantly have a better understanding of architectural designs, structural integrities, and the qualities of materials. This understanding does not originate from your inner self alone. It was amplified, if not granted, to you by the absolute embodiment of Making: the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <matter></matter> <hyperlink>Materium Affinity</hyperlink>. But the inspiration is fleeting. The Endailon must tend to other creations.
button_0: From the deepest caverns to the highest heavens, we build!
title: Constructive Intervention

body_footer: You realize that the <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> is not a goal, but a means. You ponder your next move.
body_header: Scheming and plotting your next move, a sudden sensation of awe and terror washes over you. A familiar entity reveals itself to you.
body_lore: You have admired its presence before, in the decaying, dark realm of your vision. Before you, stretching out its immense corpus of darkness like the dead of night, is the very <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <shadow></shadow> <hyperlink>Shadow Affinity</hyperlink>. It lay hidden in the shadows you cast on your realm. Some of its hooked limbs point you towards a <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor>.
button_0: Direct your armies to assault the <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor>.
button_1: Channel the Endailon's terror <happiness></happiness> to recruit more warriors <unitprod></unitprod> in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
button_2: Rebuke the invitation of the Endailon. <shadowcrisis></shadowcrisis>
title: The Muse of Deceit

body_footer: The victory nevertheless inspires your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> to serve you in battle. And serve you, they shall.
body_header: The <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> is in ruins, and your warriors collect the spoils. Yet you feel dissatisfied.
body_lore: You wonder if the <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> served another purpose. Perhaps it should not have been obliterated. Perhaps it ought to obliterate. You ponder the manipulations of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <shadow></shadow> <hyperlink>Shadow Affinity</hyperlink>, whose bleak presence you feel receding, slinking back into the shadows of the realm.
button_0: "I will steal your favor, O Endailon!"
title: Concealed Intervention

body_footer: Your cities require <food></food> <hyperlink>Food</hyperlink> to grow. The <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> offers you a succulent feast: hunt the <eventColor>{EvenStackleader}</eventColor>.
body_header: The sight of your expanding cities makes your <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{virility/vivacity}</eventColor>>> grow. Suddenly, an entity reveals itself to you.
body_lore: You have met this entity before in you vision of the ever-growing paradise. You are met by the very <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <nature></nature> <hyperlink>Nature Affinity</hyperlink>, drawn to your blooming domain. Your hunger to expand grows in its presence. The entity shows you a plump <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> roaming nearby.
button_0: Hunt the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> for <<o:EventStackLeader>> meat.
button_1: Your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> desire no meat. Send all laborers <structureprod></structureprod> to the farms! <food></food>
button_2: Refuse to poach the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>.
title: The Muse of Growth

body_footer: Under the wings of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink>, the collected meat multiplies to become a banquet that feeds all citizens in your realm.
body_header: As you harvest the meat of the slaughtered <eventColor>{EventStackleader}</eventColor>, you feel the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <nature></nature> <hyperlink>Nature Affinity</hyperlink> re-emerge.
body_lore: It studies the corpse of the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> with growing curiosity. You expected it to decry the decay, but through the entity you witness the injection of new life in the <<G:carcass,EventStackLeader>>: insects picking clean the bones, fungi growing in the cadaver, and whatever remains will fertilize budding seeds. The Endailon, pleased with life's cycle renewed, grants one last boon before departing.
button_0: "Go forth and multiply, my <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>!"
title: Nutritious Intervention

body_footer: The Endailon inspires you to perform a divine deed. Will you vow to destroy the <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> or appease it some other way?
body_header: Your devotion and authority slowly shape this realm. Pride and exaltation engulf you as an entity reveals itself to you.
body_lore: Surrounded by golden pillars of light, the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <order></order> <hyperlink>Order Affinity</hyperlink> graces you with its presence. It gazes over your domain and the Free Cities you inspire with fatherly approval. Yet you divine that an anomaly irks the entity. A blemish on the orderly lands you govern. A <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> is a source of corruption and chaos. You sense the Endailon's expectations of you.
button_0: I will deliver Order to the realm by destroying the <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor>
button_2: Offer protection <unitprod></unitprod> against the <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> to friendly Free Cities. <allegiance></allegiance>
button_4: Deny the call. <ordercrisis></ordercrisis>
title: The Muse of Harmony

body_footer: It is not often that one as magnificent as yourself graces the realms. Bask in the light of your supremacy.
body_header: The <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> is shattered. This realm is one step closer to perfect order.
body_lore: The <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <order></order> <hyperlink>Order Affinity</hyperlink> abides your work. An Angelic choir then begins to sing. First in whispers, until the light that surrounds the Endailon begins to fade. The choir's voices then build to a crescendo, at which point the entity vanishes with a deafening boom. The light is gone, save for one pillar beaming down from the heavens. It beams on you, crowning your head with golden glory.
button_0: No one is as worthy as you.
title: Divine Intervention

body_footer: Whatever drove them here, defeat the ravagers before they destroy your resources or harm your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>.
body_header: <hyperlink>Marauder</hyperlink> in the realm caught wind of your efforts to tear this world apart in the flames of war. Some agree. Others do not.
body_lore: Some of those who object have arrived at your borders to demand justice and hold you accountable for your misdeeds. They fly no flag other than their own. The one thing more peculiar than the timing of their arrival is the wanton mayhem they cause, as if to provoke you.
button_0: Ravage the ravagers.
title: Just Objections

body_footer: This letter is proof of a blatant attempt to attack you underhandedly. More importantly, you may use it to press your claims against <eventColor>{RivalPlayer}</eventColor>.
body_header: Your warriors have defeated the marauding <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> companions. Among the spoils you discover something surprising.
body_lore: It seems that the marauders' assault was no coincidence. They carry a letter sent by <eventColor>{RivalPlayer}</eventColor>, who expresses <<o:RivalPlayer>> deep fears about your visions of ruin for the realm. The bandits were dispatched to end, or at least hamper, your plans.
button_0: <eventColor>{RivalPlayer}</eventColor> ought to pay for <<o:RivalPlayer>> transgression.
title: Just Cause

body_footer: A slave to the <<o:<hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink>>> will, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> promptly vows to destroy you and your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>.
body_header: By your hand, this realm slowly falls to chaos. Suddenly, an entity drawn to the havoc you wreak reveals itself to you.
body_lore: The entity liberates your soul; its presence ignites your heart. You remember this entity from your vision of the burning canopy. Your actions have drawn the very <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <chaos></chaos> <hyperlink>Chaos Affinity</hyperlink> to your domain. Yet the entity's appetite for destruction is still not satisfied. It surveys the realm and, craving more disarray, wounds the heart of the <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> to incite hatred inside.
button_0: Another City must fall to your burning blades.
button_2: Pacify <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> by purchasing <gold></gold> their swords <unitprod></unitprod> for your army.
button_3: I have no quarrel with <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>. I reject this war. <chaoscrisis></chaoscrisis>
title: The Muse of Conflict

body_footer: This newly kindled battle frenzy will be a useful asset as you continue to wreak havoc in the name of <chaos></chaos> <hyperlink>Chaos Affinity</hyperlink>.
body_header: As your warriors feast amid the ruins of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>, you sense the return of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <chaos></chaos> <hyperlink>Chaos Affinity</hyperlink>.
body_lore: The burning light of the entity exhilarates you. You share its delight as it oversees the crushed walls of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>. Despite your ecstasy, you begin to understand that this war was a favor from the entity. When the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> fixes its gaze on you, you almost explode with fervor. The feeling bursts from you and spreads to all <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> in your realm.
button_0: Death to Order! Glory to Chaos!
title: Discordant Intervention

body_footer: It's uncanny, but you inexplicably feel like satisfying the <<o:<hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink>>> request to obtain <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> will reveal veiled secrets to you.
body_header: One by one, this realm's secrets are uncovered by you. You suddenly feel enlightened when an entity reveals itself to you.
body_lore: You know its identity: the very <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <arcana></arcana> <hyperlink>Astral Affinity</hyperlink>. Remembering your encounter with the entity in the Astral library of your vision, your minds briefly connect. You catch a glimpse of a <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> not far from here. You sense the entity's curiosity: it desires that you claim the substance for yourself. To study it... and potentially for other reasons.
button_0: The Endailon knows best. I will obtain the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>
button_3: Reject the Endailon's mentorship. <astralcrisis></astralcrisis>
button_4: Benefit from the Endailon's presence to extract <mana></mana> cosmic knowledge. <knowledge></knowledge>
title: The Muse of Discovery

body_footer: This is your true reward. The combined resonances of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> and the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> show the location of an unclaimed <hyperlink>Ancient Wonder</hyperlink>.
body_header: You have successfully claimed the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>, which is covered by a thick layer of <hyperlink>mana dust</hyperlink>.
body_lore: The enigmatic <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <arcana></arcana> <hyperlink>Astral Affinity</hyperlink> reappears, yet it focuses on the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>. You sense their inherent magics interacting—an intoxicating experience—when slowly the mana dust rearranges itself into a crude map. It details the path to an <hyperlink>Ancient Wonder</hyperlink> you haven't yet explored. The entity then relaxes again, before turning its attention to something else in the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> and vanishes.
button_0: "I have been blessed by this arcane augury."
title: Arcane Intervention

body_footer: Your architects believe that the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> will speed up construction in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. Will you humor their proposal?
body_header: <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> grows. Both its population and its buildings multiply and become stronger.
body_lore: Excitedly, <<G:architects,EventCity>> present an opportunity to you. They discovered new structural properties in <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>, claiming that it may be mixed into the stone and earth of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> to strengthen it! "If <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> is truly our Paradise," they argue, "Surely only the best materials should be used in its construction, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>."
button_0: Resolve to find the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> for <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
button_4: Decide that <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> currently requires no magical augmentation.
title: Designs of Stability

body_footer: Euphoria spreads among your citizens. Their belief that <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> is their Paradise has never been more ardent.
body_header: You have secured the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>. It will now be incorporated in the construction of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>!
body_lore: News of your achievement spreads fast. The population of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> cheers on the builders and laborers, encouraging them to work better, harder, and faster. The walls and towers of your great city grow ever higher. The chanting of your name is heard far and wide. "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>! Long live <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>!"
button_0: <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> will know no equal in all the realms.
title: Foundation of Stability

body_footer: You are faced with a dilemma: press the attack and win more easily, or hold back to preserve the city's structures.
body_header: Your victory is within reach: the siege of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> has commenced. You've waited a long time for this moment.
body_lore: But a thought slowly overtakes your mind as you oversee the siege preparations. If this city is to be your Paradise, what wisdom is there then in assailing <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> with fire and steel?

button_3: Impel your troops <morale></morale> to minimize damage to <<G:structures,EventCity>>. <structureprod></structureprod>

body_footer: This cannot stand. You are bound by your Prophecy. Reclaim what is rightfully yours! Conquer <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>!
body_header: It is your destiny to build your Paradise on the <hyperlink>City Ruin</hyperlink>. However, <eventColor>{RivalPlayer}</eventColor> beat you to it.
body_lore: It barely matters whether it was malice, ignorance, or happenstance. Your rival has constructed a city of their own on the <hyperlink>City Ruin</hyperlink> that were yours to claim. <<Co:RivalPlayer>> <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> now live, work, and multiply where your <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor> are preordained to thrive.
button_0: The insolence! <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> must be mine!

body_footer: You can leave this war behind you now and focus on your prosperous future in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_header: You have conquered <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> from the unworthy clutches of <eventColor>{RivalPlayer}</eventColor>.
body_lore: Your rival <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> may never fathom why it was so vital for you to settle on these <hyperlink>City Ruin</hyperlink>. You belong to a select company: the chosen few charged with the pursuit of monumental achievements. You have been weighed. And you have been found worthy.
button_0: Today belongs to the potent <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor>!
title: Restoration of Reclamation

body_footer: Which destination belongs to you? The Walled City? The Forest of Debris? Or will you remain inside the Foundations of Clay?
body_header: This realm breathes a scent of fate that affects you. It doesn't take long before you succumb to a dream.
body_lore: You stand amid unfinished Foundations of Clay at dawn, familiar and safe. Heath surrounds you, with only two landmarks in sight. The rising Sun's rays bounce off a crown suspended in the sky, looming over a Walled City atop a steep hill. Meanwhile the Moon illuminates a path of debris leading into a dense forest, where countless eyes gleam beneath its canopies. A thundering voice commands: "Guide your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> towards their Paradise."
button_0: <order></order> Ascend the faraway hill, towards the walled city.
button_1: <nature></nature> Follow the path of debris into the forest of eyes.
button_2: <matter></matter> Plant your feet at the center of the clay foundations.
title: Visions of Promise

body_footer: The dream ebbs away, its message clear. Find the Prophesied Land occupied by the pretenders and conquer it for your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>.
body_header: You arrive at the Walled City. Its gate is barred. Dark figures march along its high ramparts. The way is shut.
body_lore: The crown floating over the city beckons you. Its glow warms your heart and incites a rousing promise in your soul. You see carvings in the city walls. Faded images of your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> and... of yourself! This is your land. This city belongs to you. Yet you are not its <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{lord/lady}</eventColor>>>. Enemies, leering at you from imposing fortifications, stand in your way.
button_0: "By the swords of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, I will win my Paradise!"
title: Promise of Paradise

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> shall deliver unprecedented wealth and productivity for your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. Long may you reign here.
body_header: Your determined labor is finally rewarded. The Great Work is done. The construction of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, your Paradise, is now complete.
body_lore: Your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> celebrate while you reminisce about the vision you had so long ago. Noting the zeal and determination of your people, you wonder if that Vision of Prophecy brought you this monumental achievement, or if the will to win was inside you all along. Or perhaps they are one and the same.
button_0: Now is the time to reap the fruits of our labor.
button_2: We conquered the <eventColor>{EventMonster}</eventColor>. Now we conquer the realm.
button_3: Now is the time to reap the fruits of our labor.\
title: Capstones on Paradise

body_footer: You awake with the urge to find the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and defeat whatever entity dwells there. Your Paradise must be rebuilt.
body_header: The debris of the winding forest path crunches beneath your steps until you finally arrive in a moonlit clearing.
body_lore: The clearing once harbored an ancient city, now scattered into rubble and bones. You find a silver crown with your name engraved on it. These are the <hyperlink>City Ruin</hyperlink> of your Prophesied Land. Then, dark trees that surround the clearing creak and give way to something sinister that has made its lair here. You hear bones crunching. The dream ends there.
button_0: The land now ruined shall blossom again!
title: Paradise, Lost

body_footer: Your Paradise is <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. All you must do to realize its potential is grow your population and keep them happy.
body_header: You stroll between the clay foundations and discover that you navigate its layout with uncanny familiarity. It reminds you of home.
body_lore: Then, the low walls begin to close in on you. You feel cramped. Contained. Inhibited. This will not do. You must expand. Grow. Build. This is to be your destiny. To transform your home into a bastion of vigor and craft. Your resolve repels the encroaching walls. Your dream abruptly ends and you realize: the foundations in your visions were those of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, home of your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>.
button_0: Commence our great work in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
reward: Your <hyperlink>Throne City</hyperlink> gains <eventColor>{amount}</eventColor><happiness></happiness> <hyperlink>City Stability</hyperlink> per <hyperlink>Magic Material</hyperlink> you control.
title: Foundations of Paradise

body_header: You have secured a new home for your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. Paradise is finally yours.
button_0: "From this new seat of power, I shall rule the realm."
title: Conquest of Paradise

body_header: Once, this was a ruined wasteland. Now, your gleaming city stands tall and sturdy. You have reclaimed your Paradise.
button_0: We wrested <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> from the wilderness. Now we conquer the realm.
title: Paradise, Reclaimed

body_footer: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, this world must end by your hand. Choose your tools of destruction." Which mask of destruction will you don?
body_header: You and your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> gaze on this new realm, ripe for the taking, when dark clouds blacken the skies.
body_lore: A terrifying visage appears in the sky: a cackling skull, pierced by blades of ice, fire, and lightning. You suddenly find three masks on three pedestals before you: an obsidian mask of a weeping grave keeper, a carnelian mask of a snarling general, and a lapis mask of a mage laughing maniacally. The earth around you rumbles, shifts, and tears while the skull in the sky screeches your name.
button_0: <arcana></arcana> Become the laughing mage.
button_1: <chaos></chaos> Become the snarling general.
button_2: <shadow></shadow> Become the weeping grave keeper.
title: Visions of Ruin

body_footer: The Host gathers before you and eagerly await your decree.

body_lore: If you have attained the alignment of Pure Good, you could even convince them to launch a final decisive crusade against an enemy of your choice.

button_3: <reputation8></reputation8> <influence></influence> "Honor your oaths, take up arms against <eventColor>{Ruler2.Name}</eventColor>!"
button_4: <reputation8></reputation8> <influence></influence> "For the good of the realm, vanquish <eventColor>{Ruler3.Name}</eventColor>!"
button_5: Leave for now.

To the east, you imagine the looming Cliffs of Sordünn, claimed by the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. The ocean blocks them from your reach—and you from theirs.

<eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> gently closes <<o:Merlin>> eyes. "I am sorry, my old friend." <<Cp:Julia>> whispers, a single tear running down <<o:Julia>> face. "If only fate had been more kind to us..."

body_footer: "As a token of goodwill, I offer you the knowledge to traverse the seas of Sordünn. I also realize you may have more questions for me."
body_header: You are approached by a regal Elven woman. <<Co:Julia>> stature is proud, but <<o:Julia>> eyes betray ages of strife, loss, and hope.
body_lore: "Hail, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>," <<p:Julia>> says. "My name is <eventColor>{Julia.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Julia.Title}</eventColor>. I was sent here by the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> to aid you on this realm." <<Cp:Julia>> gazes upon the coast in the distance, and her voice fades for a moment. "So many worlds, ravaged by the darkness... We must fight back."
button_0: "Who are you?"
button_1: "Do you know anything about the Prophecy that brought us here?"
button_2: "Have you fought the Umbral Abyss before?"
button_3: "I accept your aid. Let us fight the Umbral Abyss, together."
title: The Archon Champion

body_footer: "... But above all, I am a mother. To my two children: Thannis and <hyperlink>Sundren</hyperlink>... In life, and beyond."
body_header: <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> smiles with a profound sadness. "Who am I? That is a hard question to answer..."
body_lore: "I am the daughter of the late Emperor Inioch of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, who I have loved and warred against. I am sister to <hyperlink>Meandor</hyperlink>, who I have warred against and loved. I am-" her voice catches, only shortly: "... Widow to my beloved king Saridas. I have warred, loved, followed, and reigned. I have seen great atrocities and beautiful kindness... I have been an outcast and a queen."
button_1: "Do you know anything about the Prophecy that brought us here?"
button_2: "Have you fought the Umbral Abyss before?"
button_3: "I accept your aid. Let us fight the Umbral Abyss, together."
title: Rebel, Queen, Mother

body_footer: "The Archons may push, but in the end, you decide whether and how this Prophecy is fulfilled. A grand responsibility, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>."
body_header: <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> nods slowly. "I know of the Prophecy of Anon, and I have seen the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> debate its interpretation."
body_lore: "I may be the Champion of the Archons, but I speak for myself when I say: Words carry many meanings, and Prophecies can be as dangerous as they are helpful. I have seen many wise men and women who became blinded by their own radiance. The Archons believe that all impurities need to be purged. I think the Prophecy speaks of an alternative."
button_0: "Who are you?"
button_2: "Have you fought the Umbral Abyss before?"
button_3: "I accept your aid. Let us fight the Umbral Abyss, together."
title: Divine Myopia

body_footer: "I was found by an <hyperlink>Archon</hyperlink> vanguard and led to Emnora. I have learned much about their culture, but I am glad to travel and rebuild the realms again."
body_header: <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> sighs and nods. "I have fought the forces of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> many times before... The final time, I lost."
body_lore: "When the <hyperlink>World Gates</hyperlink> opened, the Empires of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> were already torn by war and conspiracy. We stood valiantly, but... My husband, he was—assassinated. I was captured instead." A bitter tone creeps into <<o:Julia>> voice as she continues: "One day, I was freed, through an act as kind as it was foolish."
button_0: "Who are you?"
button_1: "Do you know anything about the Prophecy that brought us here?"
button_3: "I accept your aid. Let us fight the Umbral Abyss, together."
title: Lithyl's Prisoner

body_footer: <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> pleads: "I implore you to investigate this call, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. I feel it is important."
body_header: As you travel the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> contacts you. "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>, I realize we must focus on our mission, but I sense another presence nearby."
body_lore: "Something, or someone, reaches out to me from the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. My nature rejects the darkness I sense, and yet something deep within me urges me to investigate. It feels twisted, yet familiar, almost as if... No, I must not hope in vain..."
button_0: "I will consider this."
title: Flicker in the Dark

body_footer: After a moment, Julia's tone grows stern: "I have heard much of your endeavors, Sundren... And the ire you provoke."
body_header: You have defeated the last <hyperlink>Umbral Demon</hyperlink> that threatened the entity hidden in the watchtower. Now, a figure emerges from it.
body_lore:
You recognize the figure as a female elf, wreathed in shadows. {Julia.FirstName} gasps. "... Sundren? Is it truly you?"
The harsh gaze of the shadowy elf shifts and her eyes widen. "Mother?!" {Sundren.FirstName} exclaims, and the two of them embrace at last. "I have scoured the Astral Sea for you," {Sundren.FirstName} finally says.
{Julia.FirstName} nods, with tears in her eyes. "My daughter, what pain you have seen."
button_0: Allow the two their conversation.
button_1: "We have no time for this. Tell me why you are here, Sundren." [Skip]
title: Flicker in the Dark: Aftermath

body_footer: "There is a watchtower, where I made my stand. Free me, and I will be in your debt." The voice pauses for a moment. "... Please."
body_header: Your troops enter the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. Immediately, a whisper reaches you, growing into an ethereal voice carried through the heavy air of the Umbral Abyss.
body_lore: "I am on an important mission that will change the war against the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. But these cursed <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> have proven to be... challenging. Help me, so I can finish my quest."
button_0: "I will consider this."
title: Flicker in the Dark: Into the Abyss

body_footer: "<eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> attempts to corrupt the Affinities on the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>. With the power of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink>, I believe we can break Urrath's influence over him instead."
body_header: Sundren continues: "<eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> is currently <hyperlink>Urrath's</hyperlink> most powerful thrall and general. <<Co:Merlin>> mastery of magic has given the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> terrible opportunities."
body_lore: "<eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> has used this realm to initiate experiments, in order to corrupt the other <hyperlink>Affinities</hyperlink> and even the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> themselves. But this connection to the greater magics also provides opportunity for us." <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> lifts her chin proudly. "When a gate is opened, two sides can pass. We can use the powers of the Affinities against <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> and break its grasp on <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>."
button_0: "Go on..."
title: Through Fractured Light

body_footer: "With the power of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> with us, we can confront <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> in his capital... and break <hyperlink>Urrath's</hyperlink> grasp on him."
body_header: You have collected and channeled all six <hyperlink>Affinity</hyperlink> Aspects. <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> approaches you.
body_lore: "Now you have the attention of all <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink>, we can undo Merlin's corruption... both his on his realm, and <hyperlink>Urrath's</hyperlink> corruption on him. It will require us to confront him. There is no doubt he will resist..."
button_0: "Onward."
title: Through Fractured Light: Completed

body_footer: Your soldiers sweep across the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>, clearing out the last infestations of Umbral influence. <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> and this <hyperlink>World</hyperlink> can heal once more.
body_header: You have decided to grant mercy to <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> and end your magical assault on him. <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> kneel next to the corrupted wizard.
body_lore:
"His breath is shallow, but he lives," {Julia.FirstName} says. "The cost of mercy... The Prophecy has been fulfilled."
{Sundren.FirstName} nods. "His path to restoration will be arduous, but at least there will be hope for him." She looks up to you. "Thank you, {PlayerLeader.FirstName}, for granting him this chance."
button_0: A hard-earned victory.
button_1: nah, he deserves to die
title: Mercy and Restoration

body_footer: "Let Urrath embrace all that is and will be. These petty struggles... All will be unmade in the peace of the Void."
body_header: From the eldritch darkness that looms over the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>, a hooded figure appears. "Such perseverance, such... Defiance." <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> says.
body_lore: <<Cg:sad gaze,Merlin>> rests upon you. "You cannot stop the all-consuming darkness. Behold, how deep even the mighty Titans of the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> can fall..." <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> gestures and another Ruler appears in front of you, a <hyperlink>Revenant</hyperlink>, whose undead gaze falls upon you coldly. "<eventColor>{Revenant.FirstName}</eventColor> now too serves Urrath, as all of us will. Through our work, all will cease to be."
button_0: "I will never bow to a fallen wizard like you." <influence></influence>
button_1: Allow Urrath to caress your mind <knowledge></knowledge>, if only for a moment... <evilact></evilact>
title: Darkness Reigns

body_footer: Julia's expression hardens. "You took that choice from me, <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>, as much as <hyperlink>Lithyl</hyperlink> did. And now all other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds[/hyperlink] suffer because of the talents you allowed <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> to corrupt."
body_header:
"Oh, Merlin... What happened to you." {Julia.FirstName} appears, and {Merlin.FirstName} winces, startled.
"Julia? You're- I did not mean for this to happen."
body_lore:
"And yet, you chose this." {Julia.FirstName} says sadly. "What have you done?"
"I did this for you," {Merlin.FirstName} protests. "For..."
"Your actions may have come from love, but they caused so much suffering." {Julia.FirstName} says. "I would have never agreed to what you sacrificed to grant me my freedom... And I think you knew."
button_0: "Perhaps death truly is a mercy." <unit></unit>
button_3: "It is never too late to right what is wrong." <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
title: Love and Suffering

body_footer: "I refuse to kill one of <hyperlink>Athla's</hyperlink> greatest heroes. That is why I am here. I believe I can save <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>, instead of smiting him."
body_header: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> meets Julia's stern gaze. "I did not make my decisions lightly, mother... I am here to shape the war against <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>."
body_lore: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> pauses for a moment. "Do you know who we are facing here, on the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>? Who the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> asked you to fight? Mother, Urrath's greatest thrall is <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>. That is who you are asked to destroy." <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> pales and Sundren's expression darkens as she continues: "I refuse to join the endless wheel of war and destruction."
button_0: Keep listening.
title: Fate's Trail Divides

body_footer: "I hereby grant you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, the Aspect of Shadow, and my aid."
body_header: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> nods. "This realm contains Aspects of each <hyperlink>Affinity</hyperlink>. Channeling them attracts the attention of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink>."
body_lore: "I have already committed myself too closely to the Aspect of Shadow to channel the others. And, seeing how you pierced through the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> where I could not... Perhaps it is time I place my faith in another <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>. I can open <<m:EventGate>> towards the Aspects, near Merlin's old research site. But I ask you to channel them and find a path of redemption for <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>, my mentor... my friend."
button_0: "Join me as a Hero then, <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor>." <unit></unit>
button_3: "I do not require your aid." <influence></influence>
title: The Aspect of Shadow

body_footer: The feeling fades, but you notice that someone—or something—is watching you, asking you to proceed further through the frozen halls.
body_header: Your army, having traversed grand frozen peaks, enters a massive hallway. Several cave-ins block your path, but an icy draft suggests a path forward.
body_lore: You notice these walls are not natural. They were finely crafted by hands bigger than those of any other regular mortal. Suddenly, you are overwhelmed with its beauty. The quality of the material, the craftsmanship, the promise of untold treasures at the end of this hallway... It beckons you further. To uncover its creator.
button_0: Nowhere to go but forward.
title: Giant Empires Fall

body_footer: The awakened Giant regards you with infinite patience. "Why are you here, on this realm of dust and ruin?"
body_header: You enter the grand halls of the Frost Giant who slumbers here and notice how the walls and floor start to rumble as something awakens deeper within.
body_lore: "Godir," the Giant rumbles. "My <eventColor>{GiantRace}</eventColor> and I have slept in ice so the <hyperlink>dark affliction</hyperlink> could not reach us. I have seen many Giant Empires fall, mine will not be one of them. I will not face the darkness alone. Yet, you dug and tore to reach us, to awaken us. Why?"
button_0: "I was sent here by Magehaven."
button_1: "I fight to aid the Archons." <knowledge></knowledge> [relationLvl-3/]
button_2: "I am here for the glory of Myrrida!" <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_3: "I am here to save lost souls." <goodact></goodact>
button_4: "I am here for naught but my own glory!" <influence></influence>
button_5: "I am here to form an alliance against the Umbral Abyss!"
title: Giant Empires Fall: <eventColor>{Giant.FirstName}</eventColor>

body_footer: You approach the frozen capital of the Giant who once ruled here. A rumbling feeling from before pushes you onward, promising treasures and marvels to the one who awakens <<P:Giant>>.
body_header: You fought and dug your way through the frozen cave. Strangely enough, the cold only seems to increase, the deeper you go.
body_lore: The frost-covered walls tell the story of the <hyperlink>Giant Kings</hyperlink> of <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>, their wars against <hyperlink>Dragons</hyperlink> and <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>, and their inevitable downfall. One <hyperlink>Giant</hyperlink> stood high atop the mountain peaks and watched as the realm was finally invaded by the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. The final carving shows how the Giant and <<o:Giant>> people hid underground and encased themselves in ice.
button_0: I will meet this slumbering Giant.
title: Giant Empires Fall: Frozen Dreams

body_footer: "The world crafter, master of creation," <eventColor>{Giant.FirstName}</eventColor> whispers. "It grants you its blessing. A great honor." You feel the power of the creator flow through you. You...
body_header: <eventColor>{Giant.TitleName}</eventColor> nods slowly. "I see..." Then <<p:Giant>> stirs as something else overwhelms your senses.
body_lore: Icicles shatter and rocks tumble as a tremor runs through the underground. You see cracks in the walls open and reveal veins of precious minerals. You feel the ground beneath you shift and mold, as if the realm itself takes a deep breath. You feel the grandeur of the mountains above and the pressure of molten earth below. Infinite clay, infinite potential.
button_0: ... Pull riches <gold></gold> from the earth.
button_3: ... Form a non-living metal servant. <unit></unit>
button_4: ... Call forth a creator of stone and rock. <unit></unit>
button_5: ... Bless your cities with prosperity. <structureprod></structureprod>
title: The Aspect of Materium

body_footer: "I take no joy in seeing our old enemies turned into thralls of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>. But I will not hesitate to strike them down."
body_header: You sense the presence of <eventColor>{Giant.FirstName}</eventColor>. "<eventColor>{Revenant.FirstName}</eventColor>..." <<Cp:Giant>> growls. "I remember <<P:Revenant>>. A Titan of the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>, who fell battling my kin."
body_lore: "Now, <eventColor>{Revenant.FirstName}</eventColor> returns from the dead, a twisted jest of fate. These <hyperlink>Revenants</hyperlink> remind me of the desperate cursed magics of my <hyperlink>kin's</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Traitor Kings</hyperlink>. Could our Traitor Kings have inspired the tainted touch of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> and these fallen <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>? Did my kin's knowledge bring about this realm's doom?"
button_0: "Our holy light shall cleanse this realm's affliction." <orderboon></orderboon>
button_3: "Only through wild magics can we purge ourselves of any thralldom!" <chaosboon></chaosboon>
button_4: "The knowledge we keep will protect us against this cursed fate." <astralboon></astralboon>
button_5: "Even through the Umbral Abyss, nature will prevail." <natureboon></natureboon>
button_6: "Urrath can taint all but gold and rock, so to gold and rock we must turn." <materiumboon></materiumboon>
button_7: "Only by accepting our own shadow can be learn to pass through it." <shadowboon></shadowboon>
button_8: "Through strong bonds <relationLvl3></relationLvl3> we can overcome any threat."
title: Highest Rise, Deepest Fall

body_footer: "The path forward will be risky and costly," <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> warns you. "One misstep can mean it was all for naught. But it is the only way."
body_header: Your siege of <eventColor>{MerlinCapital}</eventColor> is completed. Your troops prepare themselves for a possible final battle at the heart of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> on this realm.
body_lore:
"This is our chance," {Sundren.FirstName} says. "With its defenses breached, I found a way into {MerlinCapital}. At his throne, we can use <> to the greater magics to end Urrath's grasp on him!"
{Julia.FirstName} nods slowly. "The Archons wish for us to smite any Umbral agent without mercy. And yet... Ages ago, {Merlin.FirstName} used his magic to save me from possession. Perhaps it can be done."
button_0: Initiate the ritual to break Merlin from Urrath's grasp.
button_3: "No, Merlin must be defeated and the Umbral Abyss eradicated."
button_4: a
button_5: a
title: The Cost of Mercy

body_footer: <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> connects to the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. Arcane energies twist, and visions of places far beyond your reach threaten to flood your mind. You...
body_header: With effort, <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> shrouds you and <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> in shadows. You sneak past <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> and city guards, into the heart of <eventColor>{MerlinCapital}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
As soon as you enter the throne room, the heavy air of the Umbral Abyss befalls you. "You," {Merlin.FirstName} sighs. "Why do you persevere? You are too late, my experiments are nearly done. Urrath reaches all... Behold."
You can sense {Merlin.FirstName} call upon a twisted form of pure magic. "There it is," {Sundren.FirstName} shouts, "this connection! Channel its Aspect to fight back Urrath's corruption!"

button_3: ... Channel the Aspect of Order.
button_5: ... Channel the Aspect of Astral.
button_6: ... Channel the Aspect of Materium.
button_7: ... Channel the Aspect of Nature.
button_8: ... Channel the Aspect of Shadow.
button_9: ... Give up and fight Merlin directly, as the Archons intended.
title: Corrupted Connections

body_footer: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> screams and blinks you away, outside of <eventColor>{MerlinCapital}</eventColor>. After a short silence, Julia says, softly: "It seems there is only one path forward now. <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> must be defeated."
body_header: You attempt to banish the corruption of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>, but your channeled Aspect does not match the one corrupted by <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>. Your attempt fails.
body_lore:
{Sundren.FirstName} curses. "No, no! This was supposed to work! {Merlin.FirstName}, you taught me this! You were supposed to break free!"
"Foolish girl," {Merlin.FirstName} sighs. "Even your light will flicker and die in the embrace of Urrath..."
{Julia.FirstName} closes her eyes, unable to look on further, as dark tentacles threaten to wrap around her and you.
button_0: So be it.
title: For Naught

body_footer: <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> calls upon forces of wild magic. Demons appear, screaming as eldritch tentacles tear into their infernal flesh. Madness threatens to overwhelm you. You...
body_header: <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> grimaces when you channel the arcane power of Astral. Overwhelmed by its force, Merlin's corrupted connection is replaced with something... pure.
body_lore: An annoyed tentacle quickly snaps the connection, and <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> taps into a different source of magic. You sense how the temperature in the throne room starts to rise, you see how corrupted tendrils reach into demonic figures that rise from the heat. Anarchy, destruction, and rage, corrupted by passivity, disdain, and the craving for the complete undoing of creation.
button_0: ... Channel the Aspect of Chaos.
button_3: ... Channel the Aspect of Order.
button_5: ... Channel the Aspect of Astral.
button_6: ... Channel the Aspect of Materium.
button_7: ... Channel the Aspect of Nature.
button_8: ... Channel the Aspect of Shadow.
button_9: ... Give up and fight Merlin directly, as the Archons intended.
title: Corrupted Connections

body_footer: Corrupted plants burst in your wake. You hear the wailing of animals, desperate to escape the poisonous air that fills the room. You...
body_header: You channel pure Chaos, the heat of its passion burning away the corruption. <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> wails as the emotions that <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> had suppressed for so long crash into him.
body_lore: <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> tears away his connection to Chaos. His gaze snaps to <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor>. "You," he says to her in a voice not his own, "you, too, shall fall... Child of Inioch." The air grows heavy as thorns burst from the ground, glistening with dark poison. <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> winces as she readies herself against the corruption of her powers.
button_0: ... Channel the Aspect of Chaos.
button_3: ... Channel the Aspect of Order.
button_5: ... Channel the Aspect of Astral.
button_6: ... Channel the Aspect of Materium.
button_7: ... Channel the Aspect of Nature.
button_8: ... Channel the Aspect of Shadow.
button_9: ... Give up and fight Merlin directly, as the Archons intended.
title: Corrupted Connections

body_footer: Your armor and the ground beneath you start to crumble and decay under Merlin's arcane pressure. Wealth, the power of the elements, nothing matters under the eye of Urrath. You...
body_header: You channel the growth of Nature, healing the ground beneath you and spreading a rejuvenating aura around you, <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
{Julia.FirstName} sighs in relief. "You will not take me, Urrath!" She shouts, channeling protective growths around her and {Merlin.FirstName}. "Merlin! Fight back! I know you can!"
{Merlin.FirstName} opens his mouth to speak, but an enraged tentacle severs his connection to nature. {Merlin.FirstName} groans and the ground begins to tremble, crushing the young plants that grow into the throne room.
button_0: ... Channel the Aspect of Chaos.
button_3: ... Channel the Aspect of Order.
button_5: ... Channel the Aspect of Astral.
button_6: ... Channel the Aspect of Materium.
button_7: ... Channel the Aspect of Nature.
button_8: ... Channel the Aspect of Shadow.
button_9: ... Give up and fight Merlin directly, as the Archons intended.
title: Corrupted Connections

body_footer: <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> attempts to corrupt another Affinity. Its authority smothers you, claws its way inside of your soul, replacing faith with mindless servitude. You...
body_header: You channel the strength of Materium. The earth roars, a tempest batters <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>, and the building wards itself against the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>.
body_lore: <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> yelps. Desperate and overwhelmed, he grasps for another Affinity, before he looks at you with newfound authority. You feel a light, like the light of an eclipse or a dying sun. It is bright—too bright, and wrong, devoid of any warmth. "Where flames burn brightest, shadows root the deepest," Merlin mutters. "Even the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>... Must fall..."

button_5: ... Channel the Aspect of Astral.

button_7: ... Channel the Aspect of Nature.

title: Corrupted Connections

body_footer: "Quick, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>, channel the final Aspect! He cannot escape the Shadow, the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> is tied to it!"
body_header: You channel the Aspect of Order, its burning light burns away any corruption that threatened it, and you.
body_lore:
{Merlin.FirstName} screams in pain and quickly severs the divine connection. Only one Affinity remains tethered to {Merlin.FirstName} and the Umbral Abyss. The darkest one, its roots interwoven with the Abyss itself. "Death and frost," {Merlin.FirstName} coughs, "never the beginning, never the end..."
{Sundren.FirstName} growls. "You may have corrupted the Astral Void you crawled out of, but you know the Endailon can fight you."

body_footer: Finally, Merlin's gaze becomes sharp and for the first time he seems to truly see the ones before him. "<eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor>... <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor>? What did I... I..." He gasps, and collapses.
body_header: You channel the Aspect of Shadow, its pure power clashing with the corruption of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>.
body_lore: <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> screams, and desperate tentacles strike at the connection, but the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> is too entwined with Shadow to tear away. Eldritch limbs freeze and decay in the cold darkness as the Shadow regains its pure strength, crawling its way to Merlin, tearing at his corrupted arcane power. With all Affinities combined, his connection to <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> weakens.

title: Corruption Severed

body_footer: "You will find our champion in the north. <<Cp:Julia>> may not be an Archon, but <<p:Julia>> will be a powerful ally to your cause."
body_header: Before you can investigate further, a divine chime interrupts your thoughts and you are contacted by an <hyperlink>Archon</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "Hail, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. I am <eventColor>{Anon.FirstName}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Anon.Title}</eventColor>. It was I who recorded the Prophecy that brought you here. 'Tis a strange twist of fate, to write the very Prophecy that forbids me to act upon it. Alas, as an Archon myself, I must abide by it, and will instead provide insight where I can."
button_0: "Tell me more about this Prophecy."
button_1: "Very well, I will find this ally."
title: Divine Mandate

body_footer: "The <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> used to be part of <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>. We believe Traitor's Blood connects to those who stand by <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>. Lastly, we <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> believe ourselves to be the divine guard, and you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> are the new power to rise."
body_header: <eventColor>{Anon.FirstName}</eventColor> nods gravely, recalling his own Prophecy:
body_lore:
"Divine Myopia; Balance Enchained;
Giant Empires Fall; Darkness Reigns;
From Traitor's Blood; Fate's Trail Divides;
Corruption Cleansed, Through Fractured Light;
Divine Guard must Rest; For New Powers to Rise;
Who Weigh the Cost of Mercy; Against a Vengeful Demise."
button_0: "Very well."
title: The Prophecy of Anon

body_footer: <eventColor>{Sundren.Name}</eventColor> was wounded, but has escaped death. It will take some time for her to regrow her strength.
body_header: <eventColor>{Sundren.TitleName}</eventColor> was defeated in battle under your command!
body_lore: Through effort, luck, or something else entirely, she managed to survive the onslaught and made it back to safety, where she appears in a cloud of shadows. She grimaces, a darker expression marking her face before the shadows disappear and she turns to you again. "I have withstood many hardships in the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>. It shall not claim me yet."
button_0: So be it.
title: Sundren Defeated

body_footer: "The Archon High Council urge you to stay on course of your mission: to destroy the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> and all who affiliate with it."
body_header: <eventColor>{Anon.FirstName}</eventColor> approaches you once more. "The <hyperlink>Archon</hyperlink> High Council are happy to see <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Julia.TitleName}</eventColor> reunited. The love between mother and daughter burns strong."
body_lore: "However, I was asked to convey the Archons' stance on <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor>..." <eventColor>{Anon.FirstName}</eventColor> sighs and continues: "Let it be known <eventColor>{Sundren.Name}</eventColor> is a known rogue, a loose blade who unshackled cosmic forces meant to stay bound. Let any who heed her words do so with utmost caution, for her path strays far from order... Much like her grandfather's."
button_0: "I will heed the Council's warning." <unit></unit>
button_3: "The Archons hold no power here, I do what I decree is right." <influence></influence>
title: Blood of Inioch

body_footer: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> interjects. "The Archon High Council are blind to any other interpretation. How are they so sure whose blood this 'Traitor's Blood' is? There are other paths to salvation than through holy fire and blade."
body_header: You have collected multiple Aspects of the Affinities on the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>. <eventColor>{Anon.FirstName}</eventColor> appears before you once more.
body_lore: "It has come to the attention of the <hyperlink>Archon</hyperlink> High Council that you are focusing on a side-track to your mission, coming in contact with the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink>." <eventColor>{Anon.FirstName}</eventColor> pauses for a moment. "The High Council condemns this path, for the Prophecy states that the blood of the traitors <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Revenant.FirstName}</eventColor> must flow."
button_0: "The Archons are right, Urrath must be destroyed." <unit></unit>
button_3: "Sundren is right, there may be other ways." <morale></morale>
button_4: "I will find my own way forward." <influence></influence>
button_5: "I am here to fight, not to discuss Prophecies!" <unitprod></unitprod>
title: Divine Dispute

body_footer: "I believe the Endailon and their Aspects are the Fractured Light mentioned in the Prophecy, and Traitor's Blood... I think that may be... me."
body_header: After you initiate your siege of the capital of <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> appears before you. "Soon we will confront <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> at his throne."
body_lore: "I have been thinking about the Prophecy, especially after <eventColor>{Anon.FirstName}</eventColor> mentioned my grandfather, Emperor Inioch of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>. Inioch once broke an ancient covenant with the Archons, which led to much strife on Athla. My entire family bears its scars, and I have also invoked the Archons' ire. Could it be... Traitor's Blood..."
button_0: "No way to go now but forward."
title: Traitor's Blood

body_footer: What will be the fate of this Angelic envoy?
body_header: After the battle, a radiant flash blinds you—leaving behind an Angelic figure bound in chains.
body_lore: The Angel lifts <<o:EventUnit>> face and speaks with a trembling voice: "At last... the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> have heard my prayers. I implore you—free me from these bonds. I was imprisoned and left to be guarded by those you defeated, destined to be sacrificed. My body no longer has the strength to fight... but my voice still holds. Free me, and I will be your herald."
button_0: "Your intervention in <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> would be most welcome." <allegiance></allegiance>
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventHouseB}</eventColor> calls for your guiding presence." <allegiance></allegiance>
button_2: "May your voice reach <eventColor>{EventHouseC}</eventColor>." <allegiance></allegiance>
button_3: "No reward is needed to do what is right." <goodact></goodact>
button_4: "You will fulfill your purpose as a sacrifice!" <evilact></evilact>
title: Angelic Envoy

body_footer: The  awaits an answer to <<o:OracleUnit>> plea. What will <eventColor>{EventHero.TitleName}</eventColor> do to those who dare to meddle with destiny?
body_header: A hooded figure approaches <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>. Revealing herself as an —those who read the stars in the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>—she proclaims:
body_lore: "Grand Liberator <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>... It was foretold you would arrive in a time of great need. The <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> has fallen into the hands of <<a:EventStackLeader>> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> acolytes. They are forcing us to predict their futures, seeking to exploit this knowledge for their own gain. I escaped the temple to bring you this message... but my sisters remain trapped."
button_0: "Attack!"
button_1: Ask the  for a divination <mana></mana> of the upcoming battle.
button_2: Convince <influence></influence> the  that <<p:EventHero>> will need <<o:OracleUnit>> help to reconquer the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
button_3: Read the stars to predict the enemy's tactics.
button_4: Embrace the shadows to cast a curse upon the acolytes.

button_4: Draw strength from the Astral Plane to keep <<r:EventHero>> alive in <<o:EventHero>> last stand.
button_5: "Not even death dares to bind me."
button_6: "The righteous shall rise once more."

body_lore: "How can this be? Does fate not want me to succeed? Are the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> heralds of fate, and not its detractors? I have much to reflect upon, <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>. This observatory is now yours—please, allow me to serve, so that I might correct my undoing. I possess knowledge that may be of your interest. Ask wisely."

button_2: Consult the oracle about the death of <<o:EventHero>> enemies.

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> troops gather the crystals on their way out. What will <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> do before it all decays?
body_header: As the last undead is defeated, the souls start leaving their empty carcasses, echoing like a cursed choir.
body_lore: The voices of the dead chant one final sentence: "The prophecy was never found. The war against Urrath never ended." The columns begin to crack, and the telescopes rust in an instant, suddenly aging. Ancient relics tumble from their shelves, crashing to the floor. As a massive surge of energy is released, mana crystals form throughout the structure.
button_0: Save one of the relics. <item></item>
button_1: Look through the telescope.
button_2: Harvest the souls of the damned. <souls></souls>
title: Forever in Servitude: Aftermath

hero_is_playerle: Your troops gather the crystals on their way out. What will you do before it all decays?

body_footer: These <hyperlink>Revenants</hyperlink> are cursed to chase a purpose forever just out of their reach. Will <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> free them from their eternal torment?
body_header: When <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> enters the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, everything seems to be working normally—but something uncanny lingers in the air.
body_lore: The oracles continue their duty of seeking for prophecies in the stars. One of them looks through the telescope. As <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> approaches, the figure turns. <<Co:EventUnit>> face has no eyes. A voice forces its way out of <<o:EventUnit>> throat, as if <<p:EventUnit>> was unused to speaking: "We must fulfill our task... find the prophecy... defend the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>..."
button_0: "We shall destroy these tormented souls!"
button_1: Infuse <mana></mana> <<o:EventHero>> units with the power to free the souls.
button_2: Produce <structureprod></structureprod> holy water and consecrate this Observatory before attacking.
button_3: Teach <<o:EventHero>> units how to free their souls.
button_4: "Their souls belong to me."
button_5: "We must embody the light to cast away these shadows!"
button_6: Leave these wretched souls.
title: Forever in Servitude

body_footer: How will <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> face this test of might?
body_header: Several figures stand on the high balconies of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, their silhouettes outlined by a Celestial light behind them.
body_lore:
An ominous voice resonates within the structure: "At last, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>—the hero we’ve been waiting for. But is <<p:EventHero>> ready to take up <<o:EventHero>> role as Champion of the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>? Protect our <eventColor>{ProtectUnit}</eventColor>, and prove that you are not only capable of fighting... but also of nurturing."

<eventColor>{ProtectUnit}</eventColor> must survive the battle to pass the <hyperlink>Archon's</hyperlink> test.
button_0: "Let them witness our glory!"
button_1: Train <unitprod></unitprod> the troops to shield, not to strike.

button_3: Bathe <<r:EventHero>> in the protective light.
button_4: Call upon the shadows cast by the light.
button_5: Embrace chaos to fight the order.
button_6: "We are not ready for this test yet."
title: Test of Might

hero_is_playerle: How will you face this test of might?
Bind the lament of the damned <souls></souls> to your weapons.

body_footer: What great boon will <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> seek?
body_header: You stand victorious with the <eventColor>{ProtectUnit}</eventColor> by your side. The <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> rise, exhausted by the battle.
body_lore: The voice echoes once more in the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>: "The mighty contestant has deemed <<r:EventHero>> worthy. With pride, we name you Champion of the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>. The prophecies of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath's[/hyperlink] downfall speak of a hero—and perhaps, that one is you. Take up these sacred arms, forged to shield the helpless. And before your crusade begins, one final blessing will be granted to you."
button_0: Gain the power to smite your enemies.
button_1: A glorious <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> will join <unit></unit> your army.
button_2: "You have misread the prophecy—you will fall by my hand." <evilact></evilact>
title: Test of Might Surpassed: Aftermath

hero_is_playerle: What great boon will you seek?
