body_header: You withstood the test, but the <eventColor>{ProtectUnit}</eventColor> did not. The <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> rise, exhausted by the battle.
body_lore: The voice echoes once more through the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>: "Mighty warrior—you have not overcome the test. The mantle of Champion is not yours to bear. But your valor in battle cannot be denied, and every blade is needed in the war against darkness. Take up these sacred arms, and before your crusade begins, one final blessing shall be bestowed upon you."
button_0: Be empowered with the radiance of the light.
button_1: A <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> will join <unit></unit> your army.
button_2: "You have misread the prophecy—you will fall by my hand." <evilact></evilact>
title: Test of Might Survived: Aftermath

hero_is_playerle: Which boon will you seek?

body_footer: Which boon will you seek from this divine delegate?
body_header: As the skirmish ends, a blazing light dazzles you. From its splendor, an <eventColor>{AngelUnit}</eventColor> emerges.
body_lore: <<Co:AngelUnit>> layered voice—resonating with a metallic harmony—exclaims: "Be not afraid, for this was your ordeal, and in its glory you have bathed. These foul creatures shall no longer ravage these sacred lands. Rise now, and seize your divine retribution."
button_0: "Uplift the glory of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> in the realm." <allegiance></allegiance>
button_1: Request reinforcements for your crusade. <unit></unit>
button_3: "Your blessing alone shall suffice." <goodact></goodact>
button_4: Strike down the <eventColor>{AngelUnit}</eventColor> in the name of the unholy. <evilact></evilact>
title: Divine Delegate

body_footer: What task will the penitent endure in your service?
body_header: Still captive, a graceful figure stands before you. <<Cp:EventUnit>> wears humble clothes and no shoes, yet there is something divine in <<P:EventUnit>>.
body_lore: <<Cp:EventUnit>> says: "May the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> bless you, my savior. Once, I was among the divine, but now I am nothing more than a penitent. I wander these lands seeking atonement through service to the righteous. Please, allow me to redeem my faults. Tell me—what penance must I endure?"
button_0: "Walk to a city and proclaim <allegiance></allegiance> my glory." <goodact></goodact>
button_1: "March as long as your feet can carry you, exalting <allegiance></allegiance> my name." <evilact></evilact>
button_3: "I will host you in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. Spread your good deeds there." <goodact></goodact>
button_4: Slay the penitent to get <<o:EventUnit>> possessions <item></item>. <evilact></evilact>
title: Fallen From Grace

body_footer: What will you ask from this gentle soul?
body_header: When you approach the Angel's body, a soul rises from it. <<Co:EventUnit>> voice, warm as sunshine, says:
body_lore: "Well met, wayfarer. What you see at your feet is my body, which could not bear the hardships of my imprisonment. But now, my eternal soul is free. Your actions have brought peace to this unfortunate Angel. Allow me to bestow upon you a parting gift."
button_0: "Uplift the glory of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> in the realm." <allegiance></allegiance>
button_1: "Grant healing to those who bled for your salvation." <goodact></goodact>
button_3: "Do not yet depart, your saviors still need your light." <unit></unit>
button_4: Siphon what remains of the soul's light. <evilact></evilact>
title: Ascension

body_footer: The Astral Aspect was not found here, it is probably hidden elsewhere.
body_header: After searching the tower up and down, nothing is found, but then the Aspect speaks to your mind again...
body_lore: "Look 'ere," he begins "I know that you know you've got some queer new thoughts inside o' you that seem to know more than you gone-thought did before. Just... Focus on that new 'wispy' thought, rite? An you'll know where I'm hidden-like! And no, I cannot just say it, lest <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> gone find me. Since he's listening in after all... Now, howay!"
button_0: "I'll find you yet."
title: Out of Sight, Out of...

body_footer: As the remnants of that strange thought fade away, you still hold the fate of the disembodied mind in your hand. What do you do?
body_header: After searching the tower, a peculiar crystal skull is found that suddenly begins to talk!
body_lore: "Knew you'd do it! Ey up, 'tis me! Lo, I'm naught but a disembodied mind now, innit? Well aye, I'll admit 'twas a daft plan, but... Also a last resort, ere <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> gone did me like he did poor old <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>. Well, y'know what's up, rite? Here, I'll go grant you the Aspect of Astral. Now, before it's all gone, you go and tap into that queer thought from before, now won't ye? Then I'll nip m'self outta here, all teleport-like. Ta-ra!"
button_0: Recruit the speaking skull <item></item> to your side.
button_1: Tap into the fading thought to glean greater wisdom. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_2: Destroy the skull <evilact></evilact> and consume its knowledge! <knowledge></knowledge>
title: An Out of Body Experience: Out of His Mind

body_footer: Reality returns, and your mind is now magnified with a profound clarity as you graduate into the Aspect of Astral.
body_header: With a maddening rush, your mind feels suddenly expanded, as if you can hold onto a hundred thoughts all at once!
body_lore: Reality fades away, and with stupendous euphoria your thought-space feels flooded by the omniscience of the cosmos itself. Thinking and knowing coalesce, and it seems as if the thoughts of all beings in existence are available to you now! Though, one clear realization crystallizes above all others, the full knowledge that you are appointed by a higher wisdom—the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of the Astral!
button_0: "I knew this all along."
title: The New Aspect of Astral

body_footer: With a sly grin, <<p:EventHouseLord>> adds, "I would consider it a great honor if you would sponsor my grand project."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> announces <<r:EventHouseLord>> with a nervous cough. "Respected neighbor," <<p:EventHouseLord>> begins, "A moment of your time?"
body_lore: "My rival in the council has challenged my rule with the construction of some lofty monument! I will not be bested, and have therefore devised a most grandiose design that will surely outshine that of my rival!" <<Cp:EventHouseLord>> shows you <<o:EventHouseLord>> extravagant plans, followed by a painful silence. "Unfortunately no one in <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> is willing to sponsor its construction..."
button_0: Refuse to fund this project.
button_1: "I can lend you my craftsfolk <structureprod></structureprod> instead."
button_2: Fund <gold></gold> this opulent project.
button_3: Secretly sell <gold></gold> these designs to the rival of <<o:EventHouseLord>>.
button_4: "Why build your own? Destroy your rival’s monument instead!"
button_5: Propose a more economic redesign <structureprod></structureprod> of <<o:EventHouseLord>> plan.
button_6: "Let us think this one through first, shall we?" <knowledge></knowledge>
button_7: Propose to solve this matter through clever statecraft. <influence></influence>
button_8: "Do not build sterility, plant fertility! <food></food> Let me show you how..."
title: Monumental Donations

body_footer: Smiling, <<p:EventHouseLord>> concludes, "What say you? Will you honor the memory of our late philosopher with an oration?"
body_header: "Glory!" announces <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> with open arms, "My esteemed confederate, I come before you with a wonderful announcement!"
body_lore: "Today, the people of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> celebrate the anniversary of our founding philosopher. As our esteemed friend and a most eminent <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, I graciously invite you to honor us by performing the opening oration! Admittedly, the invitation is a bit sudden, but I am certain a capable Godir as yourself will manage just fine."
button_0: Perform a modestly organized speech. <influence></influence>
button_1: Demand adequate compensation <gold></gold> for your time.
button_2: Just improvise on the spot. <chaosboon></chaosboon>
button_3: Take this time to moralize the importance of philosophy in general. <orderboon></orderboon>
button_4: Use this opportunity to propagandize your own ideology. <shadowboon></shadowboon>
button_5: Accept, but silently invite all to meditate on their ethics inwardly. <natureboon></natureboon>
button_6: Just speak at length about architecture, everybody loves architecture! <materiumboon></materiumboon>
button_7: Perform a philosophical dialog that questions the basics of their principles. <astralboon></astralboon>
button_8: "Never. I will only aggrandize myself!" <influence></influence>
title: An Opening Oration

body_footer: It seems this curious yearning is coming from without, rather than within, some external force appears to be provoking you.
body_header: Realizing that the Chaos Aspect is further ahead, a strange sensation of lean hunger suddenly overcomes you.
body_lore: Without any discernible reason, an unshakable, restless yearning emerges from every fiber of your being, reminding you that you are ever so close to your goal, and yet still so very far away.
button_0: "Keep your guard up."
title: The Aspect of Chaos

body_footer: As you grasp the Aspect of Chaos for yourself, the restlessness subsides, but a new craving remains, one that tastes like more.
body_header: With the taste of victory fresh on your senses, your old, odd hunger subsides, but that unnatural restlessness still remains...
body_lore: Then, it suddenly fuels and spurs on your cravings like a raging wildfire! From the turmoil of your own restlessness a new one emerges that purges all mental clutter until only a grand, satiating awareness of the present remains. And, for a brief, burning instant, you become all with the pandemonium of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of Chaos—and it feels truly exhilarating!
button_0: "I want more!"
title: The New Aspect of Chaos

body_footer: "Say," notices the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, "you seem to poses a worldly mind, how would you define pure good and evil?"
body_header: On the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> stands an army arguing with one-another. "Murder!" says one fighter, "Betrayal!" says another, "Landlords!" utters a third.
body_lore: While watching them argue for a while, their leader, a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> regards your presence and waves, saying, "Salutations. We were sent here by the master of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> to cultivate an understanding of pure of good and evil. We have all been philosophizing this topic at length, but cannot agree on a fitting definition."
button_0: "I cannot say. Come, please study the topic <knowledge></knowledge> with my scholars instead."
button_1: Refuse the inquiry and move along.
button_2: "Questing for knowledge; or its selfish destruction."
button_3: "To do either, solely for the sake of it."
button_4: "The pursuit of wealth; lest it be greed."
button_5: "To safeguard all life; or to cause its corruption."
button_6: "Stability and harmony; versus tyranny and discord."
button_7: "Preserving greatness; or consuming the weak."
button_8: "Enough philosophical prattle, to battle!"
title: Pondering Moral Qualms

body_footer: Before your forces can reach the Aspect, <<p:EventUnit>> teleports deeper into the abyss, <<o:EventUnit>> mad cackling echoes off in the distance.
body_header: Nearing the edge of the abyss, a cackling dance is happening as the Chaos Aspect revels with <<o:EventUnit>> friends.
body_lore: "Hi-hi, ho-ho, ha-ha! What a wonderful time to be alive!" <<p:EventUnit>> cackles, "The whole realm is falling apart and eating itself up! But, ack, what's this, I see? A stranger, touched by khaos and shadow, eh? Say, you are not khoming to khatch me now, are you? Whoah! Hi-hi, ho-ho! No-no! You'll never khatch me, not me! I am khaos inkharnate, whee!"
button_0: Chase after <<P:EventUnit>>.
title: Allegro Chaotica

body_footer: The Aspect of Chaos struggles and will not submit, what must be done?
body_header: After a hazardous chase, the Chaos Aspect has finally been caught and pinned down.
body_lore: "Ho-ho-ho, hi-hi-hi! You khannot khatch me, I am khaos inkharnate! I am–" it suddenly snaps out of it, "Eh? No! I am khaught? Ach! No, no! Let me go! I'll not be tamed!" the Chaos Aspect squirms uncontrollably, "Nay, here, you be Aspekht, eh? Just kill me now! But do not hold me! I wish to see the realm fall to great khaos! I wish to be free! Free!"
button_0: "Join me <unit></unit>, and you will see greater chaos still!"
button_1: Slay the Gremlin.
button_2: Demand payment <gold></gold> for its freedom.
title: Allegro Chaotica: Finale

body_footer: Then, the ethereal bouquet evaporates and your scent is again restored, save for a fading trace of those foreign reflections...
body_header: As your forces enter the abyss, you pick up a faint, unusual scent that stirs up a long lost memory.
body_lore: What started as a single sniff then turns into an off amalgamation of smells, each confusingly blossoming manyfold memories within. Reflections of days long past, and even of times you do not recollect having ever experienced yourself at all!
button_0: "Something fishy is afoot..."
title: The Aspect of Nature

body_footer: Breathing out, the full vigor of the Aspect of Nature bursts forth from within, and with this power you...
body_header: An ethereal breeze brushes past your face, and as you breathe in, you are met by a most welcome scent.
body_lore: Your senses become intoxicated in an all-encompassing sensation of bliss. Memories of cosmic youth enter your awareness, reminding you that, ultimately, all things wither. Just like how balance once fell to corruption, so too, shall corruption pass into restoration. And for a fleeting moment, it feels like the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of Nature itself comforts your person... What has happened before shall happen again.
button_0: ... Revive the withering <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>. <unit></unit>
button_1: ... Share its bounty <food></food> with your population.
button_2: ... Cultivate powers <knowledge></knowledge> to restore the realm.
title: The New Aspect of Nature

body_footer: The  is stuck completing <<o:EventUnit>> immaculate masterpiece and will not leave until <<p:EventUnit>> is done. What does <<p:EventUnit>> need?
body_header: Approaching the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, a loud, frustrated groan is heard, followed by a shout of, "Not now, go away!"
body_lore: A  stands before a marvelous sculpture, chipping off tiny bits with a chisel. "If you must know," <<p:EventUnit>> groans, "we are using this <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> to craft the masterpiece commissioned by <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor>. But, in order to finish it I need... I still need..." <<Cp:EventUnit>> steps back and inspects the impeccable sculpture with a strained gaze. "What do I need?"
button_0: Offer your workshops <structureprod></structureprod> for the  to work in peace.
button_1: Leave the  to <<o:EventUnit>> labor.
button_2: "Impressive work! You deserve a far wealthier <gold></gold> patron, like me." <unit></unit>
button_3: Enact your Materium-inspired hand to finish the piece.
button_4: Declare to all that, "good" is good enough!
button_5: "It is hopeless! You need to give up."
button_6: "You need some sense knocked into you, have at!"
button_7: "Come, when one is tethered from within, take inspiration from without."
button_8: "Truly, when is something ever finished?"
button_9: "Just chop off that one bit and be done with it!"
title: Chipping at a Masterpiece

body_footer: The Nature Aspect appears to be stuck in a never ending cycle, bring it to the nucleus of the labyrinth to break it.
body_header: The Nature Aspect appears severely hurt as it stands there, just mumbling to itself.
body_lore: "I must plant it... I must plant the seed," it murmurs with an exhausted stutter, "No matter if the realm should die tomorrow, the last world tree seed must be planted at the nucleus of the labyrinth! This is my plight. Again, and again, I make this journey, though the corruption be too great to overcome... I must go on."
button_0: Help the Nature Aspect.
title: Of a Labyrinthine Nature

body_footer: "Now, with the world-seed planted, I can finally wither, knowing a new Aspect shall... Take... My... Place—you."
body_header: As your army approaches the Wellspring at the center, the Nature Aspect steps forward in great strides.
body_lore:
He reaches the center, carefully plants the seed in the wellspring then collapses beside it with an exhausted groan.

"I have watched over the {EventRealm} since it was but a seedling realm," it grunts, "Ah, I have seen the Archons come and go, and the Empire of Myrrida rise before them. Yes, I outlasted them all, but for the corruption of Urrath..."
button_0: "So be it."
button_1: Let him die and claim some of his power. (DEPRECATED)
title: Of a Labyrinthine Nature: Germination

body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> presents <<r:EventHouseLord>> with one hand on <<o:EventHouseLord>> heart to speak on behalf of <<o:EventHouseLord>> <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "Salutations, oh <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>," <<p:EventHouseLord>> orates, moving one hand to <<o:EventHouseLord>> chest, "We, the <eventColor>{EventHouseRace}</eventColor>, bid you welcome, and are most curious to discover the designs of our peer. I am named <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Pray, do tell, shall we build bridges on this day, or must we make walls?"
button_0: Assess whether <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> deserves bridges or walls.
button_1: "Build as you wish, my designs remain my own."
title: Meeting Delighted <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>

body_header: The <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> appears before you, studiously massaging <<o:eventHouseLord>> chin, then begins to speak on behalf of <<o:EventHouseLord>> <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "Lo and behold! A Godir, a Godir comes before me at this hour," <<p:EventHouseLord>> ponders aloud while gesturing towards the ground, "In accord with the great plan, I bid you welcome, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. But what is it you bid us in return, I wonder? Indeed, what is it you shall bid us in return?"
button_0: "Let me see if <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> is worthy of my biddings."
button_1: Bid them nothing, for now.
title: Meeting Ponderous <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>

body_header: The <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> steps up with one fist against <<o:EventHouseLord>> chest and speaks on behalf of <<o:EventHouseLord>> <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "Step no further!" <<p:EventHouseLord>> commands with an outstretched hand, "We, Architects of the <eventColor>{EventHouseRace}</eventColor>, shall not invite ruin upon our domain. I, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor>, bid you state your purpose, or leave us to our works." <<Cp:EventHouseLord>> regards you for a space, then raises up <<o:EventHouseLord>> chin. "So, what shall it be?"
button_0: Inspect <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>.
button_1: Leave them be, for now.
title: Meeting Indignant <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>

body_header: The <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> steps back with an upraised chin and speaks on behalf of <<o:EventHouseLord>> <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink>.
body_lore: <<Cp:EventHouseLord>> observes you for a space, then flares up <<o:EventHouseLord>> eyes and announces, "A doom greets us this hour, bringing ruin to our domain. With all the <eventColor>{EventHouseRace}</eventColor> as my witness, I, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> will see to it that your empire shall crumble! Crumble I say!"
button_0: Inspect <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>.
button_1: "You brought ruin upon yourselves!"
title: Meeting Irate <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>

body_footer: “But hold, ye Aspect of Shadow! Who art thou truly?” challenges the Titan, “Art thou an ally come to relieve me, or yet another foe?”
body_header: When approaching the observatory, a deep, magnificent voice suddenly booms out over the main gate.
body_lore: “Praise be! At last, our savior cometh, I hearken thy presence!” declares a grime-soaked <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> appearing behind the gates, “Lo! I alone am last of the Endailon Titans, who, since the <hyperlink>Endailon Crisis</hyperlink>, rejected the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> and their <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink>, and thence pursued closeness with the great Endailon of Order in exile. For many cycles we abode hither, the lone bastion of our kind. But alas, despite our defiant resistance, <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> hath corrupted mine brethren and so wrought chaos upon our house..."
button_0: "I am your ally."
button_1: "I am your foe!"
title: Last Endailon Titan

body_footer: This strange music steals your attention, before wholly fading away, save for that slight, distant ringing.
body_header: As your army approaches the area where <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> said the Order Aspect would be, a sudden sharp whistle fills your inner ear.
body_lore: What starts off as a slight, distant ringing at first, gradually sounds a lot more like.... Like a distant chorus?
button_0: "Curious."
title: The Aspect of Order

body_footer: As the sound fades, you become utterly inspired by the might of the Aspect of Order.
body_header: Your inner ear notices the sound of that Celestial chorus again... Which now fills your spirit with light and rapture!
body_lore: A bright flash overtakes your senses as a great Celestial chorus suddenly crashes down upon you. But you stand like a rock and are thus overcome with exaltation and righteous purpose. As that once foreign music becomes wholly native to your being, you assume its blessed power. Then, what once seemed like a thousand voices, coalesce into one—the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of Order.
button_0: "Onwards!"
title: The New Aspect of Order

body_footer: Chimes and chants resonate in the air, greater forces are listening in to this moment, how will you respond?
body_header: As your army enters the demon infested observatory, that faint, celestial chime echoes again in the distance.
body_lore:
Venturing forth, you cannot help but notice the overwhelming corruptive infestation that creeps out of every crevice and stone. It seems the Endailon Titans are truly making their last stand here, or even that they have already failed.

"Lo, our enemy cometh," observes the {EventUnit}, as <> rests his stern senses upon you, "Ready thyself."
button_0: "To arms!"
button_1: First cast a spell to strengthen your forces.
button_6: Leave the battle for later.
title: Order Under Siege

body_footer: "Speak, O new Aspect of Order, and render thy judgment upon me." The Titan kneels down and awaits your judgment.
body_header: After the battle, the dust settles and the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> speaks up one final time.
body_lore: "Thou hast fought with bravery and valor!" acknowledges the wearied Titan, "Truly, the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of Order is with thee, I doth not doubt it. Nay, it so appears that the age of the Endailon Titans has thus ended. And with it, mine great charge here also... Behold, I now bestow upon thee the 'Aspect of Order', as victorious protector of our ancient seat, the position art justly thine by right. May ye go forth with righteous purpose and thence restore order, where I hath failed!"
button_0: "Arise <unit></unit>, and continue your fight at my side."
button_1: "The age of your kind ends now, perish!" <evilact></evilact>
button_2: "Order is restored, for victory is its own reward." <goodact></goodact>
title: Order Under Siege: Restored

body_footer: It appears that supernatural forces are inspiring your next move.
body_header: Upon deplaning onto the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, a curious new thought suddenly enters into your awareness...
body_lore: It is a thought wholly without words, sounds, or images. Nevertheless, it asserts itself into your consciousness with great clarity, so that you simply just 'know'... "Search towers. Find <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor>."
button_0: Focus further on the thought...
title: Aspect of the Astral

body_footer: "Looky 'ere, would'ye 'mind' securing me before them drat Umbral Demons do, ey? I, ehrm... Done 'stored' meself in one o' these here towers."
body_header: Before you can dwell on your last thought, a strange new voice speaks to your mind directly.
body_lore: "Oy! You there! Splendid, an 'Aspect-initiate'. Rite, a little help would be appreciated," urges the crass speaker, "Gha, as the old Aspect I tried as hard as I could to fight this blasted corruption offa <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>, but bugger me, how I failed... Now, me old body might well be puppeted by <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink>-like, but me mind, at least... Well, that's 'stored away', as a manner of speaking..."
button_0: Help the Aspect and kill his old body. (DEPRECATED)
button_1: Seek out the hidden Aspect.
title: An Out of Body Experience

body_footer: You are invited to enter into the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and fight the demonic animated <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> inside.
body_header: Upon entering the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, a familiar voice forces itself into your mind again...
body_lore: "Oy! What'cha doing in <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> and mine's old <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> study tower? Sorry lot, what's left of it..." Ahead, a mindless <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> floats amidst a cascade of books, jewels, and other magic items. "Look at that! My old body is animated by <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>. Ugh, seems it's hoarding this stuff for Merlin to collect later... Well, now you're here anyway, could ye do us a favor and clobber it for me?"
button_0: Attack the animated <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> head-on!
button_1: Prepare an improvised spell <mana></mana> to sunder the magical defenses of the <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor>.
button_6: "Not now."
button_7: Draw upon your affinity with the Astral to weaken the animated <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>.
button_8: Call on Godebald to taunt his old animated body with crass insults.
title: Time Out of Mind

body_footer: As the treasure slowly disappears, you have only one chance to save the most valuable artifact!
body_header: Upon defeating the animated body, a great crack is heard and the whole tower rumbles, before a familiar voice pops up again.
body_lore: "Yikes, a right spectacle that was! An end of an era, innit? <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> and I used to research the Aspects here, we did. At least, before he gone left to look for the apple o' his eye..." Then, the floor cracks and collapses, revealing the vast <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> beyond it. Screeching and clawing, the body is sucked into the abyss and with it all the items, gems, and tomes previously floating around the space are slowly sucked in as well!
button_0: Save the nearest magic item. <item></item>
button_1: Save the grandest looking journal. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_2: Bugger Merlin (DEPRECATED)
button_3: Save the jewels! <gold></gold>
button_4: "Oy! Grab me drab ledger!" Save the priceless Aspect Research of Godebald! <arcana></arcana>
title: Time Out of Mind: Out of Time

body_footer: "They see your fears," <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> abruptly says. "All must confess to the light or despair!"
body_header: With vertigo you awake in an irenic landscape. Your guide, <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, slowly comes into focus again, smiling.
body_lore: "We have arrived, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <<p:OracleName>> declares, while the visions from the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> still perpetuate within your mind. "This is one of the blessed realms which the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> call Emnora. Here they reside, dwelling on divine amendments and the construction of their mighty temples." As <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> speaks, the <hyperlink>Astral Currents</hyperlink> around you swell again, conjuring up the image of the terrible light that you beheld.
button_0: "I saw thieves, skulking in shadows to steal my treasures <gold></gold>."
button_1: "Sin and mayhem shook the realms. The Age of Obbadoth <influence></influence> was at its dawn."
button_2: "There was no strife <unitprod></unitprod> or emotion. All life subdued in predictable patterns."
button_3: "The Astral Flows <mana></mana> depleted, and there was magic no more."
button_4: "Hunted and cornered, the great beasts <unit></unit> of the realms were driven to extinction."
button_5: "The plebs usurped the throne, forever ignorant <knowledge></knowledge> of its powers unsought."
button_6: "My people <population></population> were reduced to pawns, sacrificed in Magehaven's games of power."
button_7: "The towers of the Archmages <monument></monument> crumbled, their arcane wealth forever lost."
button_dragon: "Vengeful and envious, the Giant Kings slew all dragons <unit></unit> far and wide."
button_giant: "Like ancient Myrrida, the great kingdoms of Giant Kin <structureprod></structureprod> perished in dragon fire."
title: Visions of Exaltation

body_footer: "The gateways between Emnora's Rings are the <hyperlink>Golden ziggurat</hyperlink> on this realm," <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> concludes. "I foresaw your desire to tread there, though I do not know the purpose."
body_header: "The light of truth can burn violently," <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> says. "As an <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, I must ward my eyes from its touch."
body_lore: "You did well, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <<p:OracleName>> continues, "yet your journey towards the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> has only begun. The rings of Emnora are like long-winded stairways to heaven. Except no foot may walk its steps, only a spirit in search of enlightenment. We are on the Fourth Ring where the least divine souls seek ascension. In the First Ring, the Archon High Council confers."
button_0: "There is no magic gateway my arcane wits cannot unriddle."
button_1: "In the sanctuary of these Archon monuments, my prayers find new meaning."
button_2: "There must be other aspirants at these gateways. They may know how to pass."
button_3: "When I threaten to smash their precious portals, the Archons will listen to my demands."
title: Pathways of Ascension

body_footer: "If you are to complete your journey to Emnora," <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> concludes, "you will have to master your fears. In time, you will understand the full meaning of this."
body_header: Having examined the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you are expected by <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "Have you found what you were looking for, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>?" <<p:EventUnit>> asks with a knowing smile. "The answer could only be 'yes'. You may have noticed it by now: on Emnora the hopes and fears of the magically gifted may take tangible shape. It is one of the reasons why only the virtuous and worthy may ascend to the higher rings."
button_0: Thank <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> for <<o:EventUnit>> insights.
title: Pathways of Ascension: Aftermath

body_footer: The Celestial vortex within the arch beckons you to enter. Where do you wish to go?
body_header: Once again climbing the stairs of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you return to the portal chamber at the top.
body_lore: Inside the chamber at the top, the rune-covered arch still rests. As you approach the ancient arch, it suddenly crackles with energy and a star-lit vortex appears in its center.
button_0: Enter the portal to the First Ring.
button_1: Enter the portal to the Second Ring.
button_2: Leave.
button_3: Enter the portal to the Third Ring.
button_4: Enter the portal to the Fourth Ring.
button_5: Examine the arch more closely to unravel its secrets...
button_6: Kneel at the arch to commence your prayers...
button_7: Engage the figure near the other end of the chamber...
button_8: Raise the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> to threaten destruction of the arch...
title: At the Pathway of Ascension

first_other: The dormant portal arch does not offer <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> passage to the higher rings of Emnora. What does <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> do?
first_ruler: The dormant portal arch does not offer you passage to the higher rings of Emnora. What do you do?
no_ruler: The Celestial vortex within the arch beckons <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> to enter. Where does <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> wish to go?

first_other: Climbing the stairs of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> beholds the grandeur of ancient <hyperlink>Archon</hyperlink> architecture.
first_ruler: Climbing the stairs of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you behold the grandeur of ancient <hyperlink>Archon</hyperlink> architecture.
no_ruler: Once again climbing the stairs of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> returns to the portal chamber at the top.

first_other: Inside the chamber at the top, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> finds a rune-covered arch not unlike the <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink> of <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>. The arch is still dormant, without trace of any arcane mechanism that might activate it.
first_ruler: Inside the chamber at the top, you find a rune-covered arch not unlike the <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink> of <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>. The arch is still dormant, without trace of any arcane mechanism that might activate it.
no_ruler: Inside the chamber at the top, the rune-covered arch still rests. As <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> approaches the ancient arch, it suddenly crackles with energy and a star-lit vortex appears in its center.

body_footer: "It is our calling to plunge the <hyperlink>Revenants</hyperlink> into the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes. "Interfere, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, and you too will be smote."
body_header: From the <eventColor>{EventGeo}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> a croaking chorus swells, enchanting yet terrifying, until <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> reveals <<r:EventPlayer>> to you.
body_lore: "Hear our rendition:", <<p:EventPlayer>> chants, <<o:EventPlayer>> vocal sac pulsating with fervor, "We <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> have sailed to the shores of Emnora in search of Archon grace, yet we found denizens as foul as the deep terrors of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. It is the <hyperlink>Revenants</hyperlink> that I speak of, their vile presence imperiling this Celestial sanctuary."
button_0: "The divine chants of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> are inspirational. <relationLvl3></relationLvl3> Let us join in their rousing fervor!"
button_3: "Proceed as you may. We do not take sides in holy crusades."
button_4: "It is not upon you to decide on life and death, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. [relationLvl-3/] It is upon me!"
title: The Wicked We Smite

body_footer: "We are no agents of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> shouts defiantly. "We are <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>!"
body_header: Bearing a scent of fragrant oil, yet also decay, a wrinkled <<EventPlayer<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>> in Archon armor descends the stairs of <<o:EventPlayer>> Necropolis.
body_lore: "I am <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, leader of the ones so unfairly proscribed as '<eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>'," <<p:EventPlayer>> introduces <<r:EventPlayer>>, showing an embittered grin. "My people became doomed twice: once when the Lizardfolk denied us departure in the First Age on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>; and again near the end of its Second Age, when the mark of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> was placed on our Necropolises. We rose as tainted puppets, yet when the seals on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> broke, our <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> became rekindled with faith."
button_0: Continue listening to <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>.
title: Damnation

body_footer: "The <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> will without doubt favor the ones who can put the <hyperlink>Revenants</hyperlink> to rest," <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> concludes. "For they fear what must not be."
body_header: As the chorus of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> subsides, <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> raises <<o:EventUnit>> voice, speaking to you.
body_lore: "The fate of the <hyperlink>Revenants</hyperlink> is a twisted one," <<p:EventUnit>> says, <<o:EventUnit>> words spoken with unusual fragility. "Once <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> in life, their <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> were denied passage to the <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink>—until the most potent Necromancy returned them to unlife, forever stained with the mark of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>." <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> hesitates, then continues: "If there are <hyperlink>Revenants</hyperlink> on Emnora, things do not bode well."
button_0: We will deal with this Revenant threat in time.
title: The Revenant Curse

body_footer: "I can see the emanations at the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> shift," <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> reports. "The path towards Emnora continues, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>."

Then {OracleName} turns to you: "You have done the Archons a great service today, {PlayerLeader}, even if they won't openly acknowledge this."

body_lore: "Hail the <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>," <<p:EventPlayer>> calls out with splendor, "for you are entering the blessed lands of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. I am <eventColor>{EventPlayer.TitleName}</eventColor> and it is upon me to judge who may ascend further to reach Emnora." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> looks over you with <<o:EventPlayer>> radiant gaze. "I see you are a <eventColor>{EventPlayerForm}</eventColor>. A pity."

"I must urge you to turn back, {PlayerLeader}," <> speaks slowly, and you feel an urgent desire to follow <> command. "Leave, while you can, for to reach Emnora, one must stride through cleansing flames."

As you do not recede, {EventPlayer} continues: "By the mandate bestowed upon me through the High Council, I decree my challenge to you. Overcome my divine powers, and I shall grant you passage."
button_0: "Your Celestial hosts shall tremble before me, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>!"

body_header: While the doors to the Third Ring of Emnora have opened wide, <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> has more good news to share.

"A <eventColor>{TitanUnit}</eventColor>, previously in allegiance with <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, is offering you, the <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, <<o:TitanUnit>> fealty."

button_3: Commune with the <eventColor>{TitanUnit}</eventColor> to learn <<o:TitanUnit>> rite of passing souls.
title: Ordeal by Fire: Aftermath

body_footer: "I am <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Title}</eventColor>," the man says, lifting <<o:EventPlayer>> hood. "Yet, who are you?"
body_header: Accompanied by a single scribe, a hooded man, humble yet exalted, awaits you at the bottom of the Ziggurat's stairs.
body_lore: "So the Oracle of Alanor divined the truth," the man speaks, "and there comes 'one, bearing a letter of need, who walks in <<ge:starlight,<eventColor>{EventGodir}</eventColor>>>'." <<Cp:EventPlayer>> looks at the sky, where indeed the constellation of <eventColor>{EventGodir}</eventColor> gleams brighter than any other. "Well then. You must be on your path to Emnora. If that is so, let it be known to you that you have arrived at the Lakes of Sagacity, where the waters can mirror the truth."
button_0: "I am <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>." <influence></influence>
button_3: "I am <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>, Seeker of Truth." <knowledge></knowledge>
button_4: "My name bears no significance in the light of the Allfather." <goodact></goodact>
title: Starlit Revelations

body_footer: "Stroll beneath the domes of our Observatories, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>", <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> ends <<o:EventPlayer>> speech, "and you may yet reach Emnora."
body_header: "A <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, I see," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> repeats pensively, <<o:EventPlayer>> thoughts veiled beneath <<o:EventPlayer>> hood.
body_lore:
"It is rare for a stranger to visit the Lakes of Sagacity," <> continues. "But you are free to enter our houses of wisdom, engross your mind in the presence of our blessed waters; let the prophecies of our Oracles sink in."

"The Allfather's light bespeaks the fate of our cosmos," {EventPlayer} explains empathetically, "yet he who gazes at the Well will drown in its truth. Thus the Order of Augurs watches only its faint reflections, echoed as starlight."
button_0: Agree to study the Order of Augurs' prophecies.
button_4: This is the moment to strike the Archons when they least expect it. <evilact></evilact>
title: Omens and Prophecies

body_lore: "You have shown signs of great wisdom and patience during your stay in these lands, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> says with a glimmer of solemnity in <<o:EventPlayer>> voice. "Both of you gained an understanding of how prophecies can guide our actions and both of you faced their fears, mastering them in different ways."

body_footer: "My name is <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>," the woman introduces <<r:EventHero>>. "And I, too, am on the path to Emnora."
body_header: Wandering the Lakes of Sagacity, you find a lone woman watching the waters. As <<p:EventHero>> notices you, <<p:EventHero>> looks up.
body_lore: "I was told that one has arrived with intentions not unlike my own," <<p:EventHero>> speaks, revealing <<o:EventHero>> fair Elven face. "And though it is my great desire to know more, I must not ask about the Great Umbral War. For it would grieve me too much; while I sit here, idly, reading Astral tea leaves..."
button_0: Continue listening to <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>...
title: The Lady at the Lake

body_footer: "I will follow your lead, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> says with a smile. "The last step of our journey lies before us."
body_header: Together with <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> you climb down the stairway of the last Ziggurat, beholding the seat of the Archon High Council in the distance.
body_lore: Angelic statues and sacred trees flank your path, which winds down to an enormous <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. "It is said," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> whispers, "that the Archons of the High Council have transcended physical shape, becoming a duality of light and soul. To commune with them, we will have to enter their shrine and await their calling."
button_0: Ready your spirit to commune with the High Council.
title: The Archon High Council

body_footer: Imbued with this new meaning, your spirit becomes elevated, basking in the light of <hyperlink>the Well</hyperlink>...
body_header: While the words of the Archon High Council still resonate in your mind, you reflect on the journey behind you.
body_lore: You have ascended the Celestial rings, proving your endurance, valor, and wisdom. Now, in the drizzle of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you at last understand the words of <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor>. 'Emnora' is not this realm, nor the site of the High Council, nor any hallowed ground. It is a state of clarity and peace, a transformation of your inner spirit, a truth beyond the veils of reality.
button_0: ... until it reaches Emnora.
title: The Archon High Council: Aftermath

body_footer: While <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> is safe and sound, <<o:OracleName>> self-rescue drained a noteworthy amount of your mana reserves...
body_header: It had seemed as though <<ge:fate,<eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor>>> had been sealed. Yet in the aftermath of the battle, <<p:OracleName>> returns, emerging from an Astral tear.
body_lore: "That was close," <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> exclaims, still gasping for air. "As an <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> experienced in skirmishes I have developed a unique awareness for my own safety. However, foreseeing death's approach doesn't naturally mean you can cheat it." <<Cp:OracleName>> rips a small piece of cloth from <<o:OracleName>> robe, polishing the orb on <<o:OracleName>> staff. "So let's not get into this again, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, agreed?"
button_0: 'Tis the price of immortality.
title: An Escape Foreseen

body_footer: "You are a Godir, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> appeals to you. "Talk to the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> at the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. Speak of our intentions, convince <<P:EventUnit>> we are not corrupted..."
body_header: "We came to Emnora in search of redemption," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> continues. "Yet we found the passage to the higher rings blocked, our prayers answered by stoic silence."
body_lore: "Do they not see? Our coming is a gift, a willing host offering itself to find a cure for what cannot be cured..." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> sounds desperate, though <<p:EventPlayer>> soon regains <<o:EventPlayer>> composure. "Our pleas remained unanswered for too long. Now we have sinned, capturing an <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to negotiate a talk. We merely ask to be heard, but the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> will not speak."
button_0: "Show me the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, and I will fight for your redemption." <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
title: Desperate Measures

body_footer: "My fate on Emnora is sealed," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes." Yet how may I aid you on your journey, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>?"
body_header: Not long after what transpired at the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> contacts you, overjoyed.
body_lore: "You have performed a miracle, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <<p:EventPlayer>> says, deeply moved. "The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> has now returned to the higher rings of Emnora, where <<p:EventUnit>> will speak in our favor. <<Cp:EventUnit>> fears that our only path to redemption might be through a rite of passing. If that be so, we will be glad to leave the world as Archons at last."
button_0: "I would regard you as a valuable ally <rs_alliance></rs_alliance>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>."
title: Desperate Measures: Aftermath

revenant_betraye: "We may be damned, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> shouts frantically, "but we are left with one vengeful purpose: to destroy you and your people."
Not long after what transpired at the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> contacts you, trembling with rage.

"You have doomed us, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>!" <<p:EventPlayer>> calls out in agony. "I was a fool to trust you in my desperation. Now, our hope of Archon reconciliation has been crushed, a cure made impossible." Violently screaming, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> rips off the mask protecting <<o:EventPlayer>> face, gazing at you as a hateful skull.

button_7: "Leave your lands for my people to settle."
button_8: "I desire no greater reward than that your souls might be saved." <goodact></goodact>
button_9: "So be it!"

button_4: "I will speak with the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, though I cannot promise more."
button_5: "The Archons are right: the Revenant curse mustn't spread." [relationLvl-3/]

body_footer: "So, the Revenant sends another proponent," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> speaks. "Corruption can take many forms, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>."
body_header: Reaching the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, its grand doors are opened by the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>.
body_lore: They silently lead you to the center of the temple, where an <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> is detained within a circle of dark magic. The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> kneels on the ground, sheltered by <<o:EventUnit>> four mighty wings. As <<p:EventUnit>> notices you, <<p:EventUnit>> lifts <<o:EventUnit>> head, slightly. <<Co:EventUnit>> words, brilliant and sharp, resonate through the temple like an ordeal.
button_0: "You are mistaken, <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>. I have come to free you from this prison!"
button_1: "Such pride. Such confidence. By the curse of the Revenants <evilact></evilact>, you shall be my thrall!"
button_2: Leave.
button_3: "Hear me out, <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, for the sake of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>."
title: The <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>

Your troops find a temple of Archon architecture, abandoned and sealed.

There is a distinct scent of lavender and myrrh in the air, like a lingering testament to distant ceremonies when the Archons sanctified the dead. Your troops stride around the structure complex, but the only gate once leading into the temple is blocked from within.

body_footer: "Before you leave, I may bestow upon you my blessing, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> concludes. "Which Celestial calling do you wish to follow?"
body_header: "Your words seem guided by the Allfather, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> says and for a moment a smile illuminates <<o:EventUnit>> face.
body_lore:
<> beckons the present leader of the {EventRace} to come closer, saying <> wishes to speak to {EventPlayer}.

Then the {EventUnit} turns back to you. "I can see your desire to reach Emnora, {EventHero}. Return to the {EventZiggurat} and it will be good."
button_0: "I wish to smite the wicked."
button_1: "I wish to heal the meek."
button_2: "I wish to be a beacon of sanctity."
button_3: "I desire to rend my enemies with freezing decay."
button_4: "I desire to bind all to my corruption."
button_5: "I desire to thrive in death."
title: The <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>: Aftermath

astra_corrupted: "You have awoken the Void within me, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>," the <eventColor>{FallenUnit}</eventColor> speaks. "Which powers do you desire?"
Neither the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> nor the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> <<r:EventUnit>> could stop you. Now dark whispers spread the Revenant curse.
astra_freed: With the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> at the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> slain, the spell binding the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> has been broken.

astra_corrupted:
"Grace to Disgrace
Life to Unlife
To become what you fought
[runicfont]And dwell in Urrath's shadow[/runicfont]"

As the insidious whispers speak, dark tendrils lash out from the deceased corpses of the {EventRace}, covering the {EventUnit} until <> rises again as a {FallenUnit}.
astra_freed: "You have freed me," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> says, spreading <<o:EventUnit>> wings. "And for this I am grateful. I can see your desire to reach Emnora, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>. Return to the <eventColor>{EventZiggurat}</eventColor> and it will be good."

body_footer: "The <hyperlink>Revenant</hyperlink> curse is a corruption of holiness itself," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> ends. "We must ward our Celestial lands from its reach, or all may be tainted."
body_header: "You seem determined," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> says, spreading <<o:EventUnit>> wings. "Yet, compassion is a gift best reserved for the living."
body_lore: "There is sanctity within each soul, be it Man, Elf or Archon," <<p:EventUnit>> explains with gravity. "We <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> watch over the integrity of all <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> as they leave their mortal husks, protecting their journey to rejoin the <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink>. Necromancy, however, is a perversion of the soul. It opens the door to the path of no return. Only the end of their unlife may restore peace to the souls who suffered such fate."
button_0: "We must not let fear control our actions <influence></influence> or Urrath will have won this war!"
button_1: "To achieve the impossible, cure the incurable — what greater calling could there be for the sages <knowledge></knowledge> of the divine?"
button_2: "When we turn our backs on the meek and diseased, we lose the spark of divinity that hallowed our actions." <goodact></goodact>
button_3: Leave, for now.
title: The Price of Unlife

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> expires, <<o:EventPlayer>> body resting as if it found peace at last. Yet you know the works of Urrath can be deceptive.
body_header: Beaten and wounded, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> last words are spoken as if in a feverish, Umbral dream.
body_lore: "The stars are fading, the divine light... devoured," <<p:EventPlayer>> utters, "A blackness thickens, absolute and all-encompassing... The Well eclipsed, forever dessicated... [runicfont]our mouths, Celestial gates no longer[/runicfont]..." Suddenly <<o:EventPlayer>> eyes tear open and <<o:EventPlayer>> hands cramp violently. "Stay with me, brothers!" <<p:EventPlayer>> yells. "My sin must not stain your souls. Flee the ceaseless Void! [runicfont]Flee![/runicfont]"
button_0: Sanctify <mana></mana> the location at which <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> fell. <goodact></goodact>
button_1: Leave the remaining <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> to mourn their leader.
button_2: Stir the darkness, to graft the souls <souls></souls> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. <evilact></evilact>
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: But tremendous Astral shears tear at the vortex. There is no time to enter, only to pull something through...
body_header: Examining the arch, you seek to attune your mind to its arcane emanations.
body_lore: There is a strong Celestial magic dwelling within the arch. You can sense the divine incantations that imbued the arch with its power, yet when retracing their underlying Astral currents they elude your reach. You delve deeper, following the currents through ripples and into the maelstrom. You reach out to its center—and force open a star-lit vortex at the Ziggurat's chamber!
button_0: Summon a divine being <unit></unit> of Emnora.
button_3: Summon a corrupt being <unit></unit> seeking to infiltrate Emnora.
button_4: Summon an Astral being <unit></unit> encircling Emnora.
title: Secrets of Ascension

body_footer: In a shower of revelation you raise your own voice and speak...
body_header: Kneeling at the arch, your mind embarks on a spiritual journey.
body_lore: It is as if your spirit had ventured through the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, visiting the higher rings of Emnora. You see blessed trees and grand statuary. People with Angelic features are traveling the paved roads, entering starlit halls in which oracles speak of the days to come. At last your mind follows their divine emanations, soaring the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, until the vivid image of <hyperlink>the Well</hyperlink> replenishes your thoughts, gently encompassing your consciousness, washing away grief, ambition, sin...

button_3: ... a mantra <mana></mana> of zeal. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_4: ... a mantra <mana></mana> of virtue. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_5: ... a mantra <mana></mana> of light. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_6: ... a mantra of humility. <order></order>
title: Prayers of Ascension
