body_footer: "I can tell you desire to pass yourself, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> concludes. "Allow me to aid you on your journey. Together we will make it through."
body_header: Approaching the figure at the end of the chamber, it steps out of the shadows.
body_lore: "Greetings, fellow <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>," <<p:EventHero>> says. "I am <eventColor>{EventHero.TitleName}</eventColor>. I have observed this <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. Many have come to step through its portal arch, yet they all left disgruntled. Only for two, a devout Simian and an Elven lady in dismay, the starlit vortex opened, but without allowing much insight to be gained about its Celestial magic..."
button_0: "Join me <unitHero></unitHero>, <eventColor>{EventHero.TitleName}</eventColor>."
button_3: "Join me <unitHero></unitHero>, <eventColor>{EventHero.TitleName}</eventColor>, when the time has come."
button_4: "The path to Emnora <influence></influence> is a solitary one."
title: Partners of Ascension

body_footer: "You have summoned me, master!" the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> shouts giggling. "Now command me, O god of destruction!"
body_header: You stand with the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> raised, ready to smash the arch...
body_lore: ... and nothing happens. So you strike the arch with all your might. The ground is shaking, yet the ancient arch shows not even the smallest crack. You strike again, and again, until at last a crimson vortex opens in the arch's center. Before you can enter in triumph however, the vortex collapses again as a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> hops through.
button_0: Accept the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> into your ranks. <unit></unit>
button_3: Kill the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> for training. <xp></xp>
button_4: Command the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to shatter <bindingfragments></bindingfragments> as many Archon relics as <<p:EventUnit>> can find.
title: Shattered Ascension

body_footer: "Do not underestimate <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> urges you. "<<Co:EventPlayer>> divine wrath will unleash when you least expect it."
body_header: In the tension of <<ge:ordeal,<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>>>, <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> comes before you with a warning.
body_lore: "It is a grim twist of fate that you must face the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <<p:EventUnit>> says with a concerned voice. "Their Order is renowned for their martial skills—and belligerence. Since my own leave-taking, their influence among the Archon Orders has diminished. But they remain a force to be reckoned with, their Celestial hosts a fearsome sight to behold."
button_0: "When they descend, we will be prepared."
title: Sacred Warriors

body_footer: At <<ge:command,<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>>> the Celestial hosts of the realm are marching upon your cities.
body_header: The clouds above your cities are breaking as the trumpets of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> are sounded.
body_lore:
Accompanied by their divine clarion call, the voice of {EventPlayer} swells, sublime and terrible:

"Gather, my holy champions!
Focus the sacred light of the Allfather until it burns as a cleansing flame!
Make {PlayerLeader} tremble before your might!"
button_0: Prepare to face the heavenly forces.
title: Call of the Archon

body_footer: Following <<ge:mandate,EventPlayer>>, the Celestial hosts of the realm continue their assault.
body_header: The sounding of trumpets heralds the arrival of another <hyperlink>Crusader host</hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_lore: With a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> at their lead, the holy warriors of the realm show no sign of tiredness or remorse. By now it is clear that in order to stop their attacks, you must overcome <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> <<r:EventPlayer>>.
button_0: "We will endure until <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> is overwhelmed!"
title: Celestial Tenacity

no_cities: The sounding of trumpets heralds the arrival of another <hyperlink>Crusader host</hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> you.

body_footer: "Today I must withdraw," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> speaks as the Ward of the Archons begins to enshroud <<P:EventPlayer>>. "Tomorrow, the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> will face you in replenished glory."
body_header: Amid splintered chariot wheels and shattered Celestial armor, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> stands, defeated but not broken.
body_lore: "Your powers are formidable, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <<p:EventPlayer>> says with forced calm, but you can sense a wrathful torrent raging within <<P:EventPlayer>>. "You have overcome my soldiers, torn down my walls, stridden through cleansing flame. Thus, you have passed my ordeal and I shall honor my word to grant you passage."
button_0: Plan your return to the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
title: <<Cge:admission,<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>>>

player_humanform: "Ascend to Emnora!" <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> calls out while the Ward of the Archons begins to enshroud <<P:EventPlayer>>. "And we may yet meet again as <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>."

"Your powers are formidable, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <<p:EventPlayer>> congratulates you, and there is a strange notion of pride in <<o:EventPlayer>> voice. "You have overcome my soldiers, torn down my walls, stridden through cleansing flame. Truly, you have proven your potential as an Archon aspirant and passed my ordeal."

body_footer: "You must master your fears, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>" <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> prophesies, "or you will succumb to the incarnations of woe."
body_header: Having ascended to the Third Ring of Emnora, <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> appears before you, <<o:EventUnit>> face pale as marble.
body_lore: "The visions are growing stronger, are they not, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>?" <<p:EventUnit>> asks and you know <<p:EventUnit>> needs no answer. "I spoke of this before, as you recall: the <hyperlink>Astral Flows</hyperlink> of Emnora are like dangerous mirrors of each Ascendant's soul. The higher you move up, the stronger your fears will become—until they step through the looking glass, manifesting into phantasms assaulting your sanity and life."
button_0: "I shall be ready when the time has come."
button_3: "My disciplined mind <mana></mana> will push back these visions."
button_4: "I embrace <xp></xp> this opportunity to confront my fears!"
title: Looming Woe

body_footer: The manifestations of your fears are marching on <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_header: Awaking from a nightmare, you find the subjects of your perturbation vividly taking shape.
body_lore: There are scoundrels, looters, thieves, encroaching on your domain to steal your treasures. The most ruthless among them, a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, presents <<o:EventStackLeader>> empty pouch with a grin.
button_0: We must resist!
title: Incarnations of Woe

no_cities: The manifestations of your fears are marching on you!

astral: There are wisps, <hyperlink>Astral Sea Monsters</hyperlink>, cosmic leeches, encroaching on your domain to siphon your arcane wealth. The most horrifying among them, a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, invokes the horrors of the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>.
champion: There are <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink> and their retinue of battle mages, encroaching on your domain to wreak magic havoc on your people. The first of the <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink>, <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, channels a terrible <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>.
chaos: There are zealots, inquisitors, tyrants, encroaching on your domain to enforce uttermost order. The most hallowed among them, a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, recites the commandments for all to follow.
dragon: The very earth trembles as the <hyperlink>Giant King</hyperlink> rise, commanding their kindred to tear down your cities. Towering above all is <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, <<o:EventStackLeader>> <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> lusting for dragon's blood.
eldritch: Shadowy tendrils lash out as the denizens of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> inflict the mark of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> upon the land and your people. Their Sovereign, <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, calls out to you: "[runicfont]Rejoice! Your return is nigh.[/runicfont]"
giant: The skies tear open as the <hyperlink>Dragons</hyperlink> descend with destruction, ready to tear down your cities. Their Elder, <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, roars with primal might, invoking the horrors of <hyperlink>Myrrida's</hyperlink> fall.
nature: There are hunters, slayers, adventurers, encroaching on your domain to hunt all creatures small and tall. The most keen-eyed among them, a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, is wearing the skull of a <eventColor>{AnimalUnit}</eventColor>.
order: There are infernal jesters, ravishers, demons, encroaching on your domain to plunge your people into sin. The most terrifying among them, a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, bares the teeth of <<o:EventStackLeader>> grotesque face.
shadow: There are armed peasants, preachers, so-called 'champions of the meek', encroaching on your domain to instigate your population. The most audacious among them, a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, stages the hanging of a puppet clearly resembling you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>.
wk: The very earth trembles as its elemental incarnations rise, encroaching on your domain to tear down your cities. Towering above all is a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, <<o:EventStackLeader>> gaze imbued with primal fury.

body_footer: While the Archon savants gaze at the fountain, you are left to ponder your own steps.
body_header: Entering the center hall of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you hear the gentle splashing of water.
body_lore: The noise comes from the enormous fountain located right below the cupola roof of the observatory. Most of the savants of the Order of Augurs are watching the fountain and its ever-shifting reflections from a variety of viewpoints within the hall. Their concerted silence is oddly captivating, enticing you to join their meditations.
button_0: Mingle with the Order of Augurs and meditate at the fountain.
button_1: Follow the waters to the courtyard garden.
button_2: Leave.
button_3: Visit the Chamber of Prophecies.
title: Flowing Wisdom

body_footer: While the voice subsides, the Prophecy of Irith still resonates within your mind.
body_header: At the Chamber of Prophecies a beacon is lit. From within its floating light a pure voice recites:
body_lore:
"From darkness whole the sun was born
Its light shaped all, its light gave life
Chromatic rays, through aeons torn
Are captured after sun guard's strife
Lo! once eclipsed, a darkness new
The rising of an Umbral moon
Distorts the light, snarls false and true
Its shadows cast bring sun guard's doom"
button_0: Leave, for now.
button_3: "The 'Umbral moon' has a name. We must fight Urrath till the bitter end!"
button_4: "The 'sun guard's doom' mustn't be irrevocable. The Revenants should be met with compassion <goodact></goodact>, not fear."
button_5: "The 'chromatic rays' are again unbound and the Endailon's raw powers <mana></mana> can restore the old balance."
title: The Prophecy of Irith

body_footer: "It is easy to condemn the past once a prophecy has come to fruition," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes with a smile. "Is it not, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>?"
body_header: While your words still echo through the chamber of prophecies, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> enters the room.
body_lore: "The Prophecy of Irith foretold much ill that would come upon the cosmos," <<p:EventPlayer>> says pensively. "Among it, the sundering of my people." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> points at a relief on the wall, depicting a <hyperlink>Maer</hyperlink> floating through <hyperlink>Astral Currents</hyperlink>. "I know who of the <hyperlink>Gloomwatch</hyperlink> has led you to these shores, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. Tell <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> that <<p:EventUnit>> is welcome to stay at the Lakes of Sagacity as long as <<p:EventUnit>> wishes."
button_0: Agree. There were too many ways this prophecy could unfold.
button_5: Disagree. Despite knowing the future, the Archons made grave mistakes.
title: Flowing Wisdom: Aftermath

body_footer: Mesmerized by the scene, it takes a while until you ponder what to do.
body_header: Echoing from the cupola of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, an ecstatic voice can be heard.
body_lore: The voice belongs to an <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, seated high upon a stand. The <<EventUnit<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>> seems to be shaken by visions, bursting out in exclamations, while <<p:EventUnit>> clutches at the golden poles of <<o:EventUnit>> stand. Several scribes are gathered below the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, noting down <<o:EventUnit>> revelations, while three attendants administer <<P:EventUnit>> with waters and oils to relieve <<o:EventUnit>> feverish frenzy.
button_0: Observe the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> more closely.
button_1: Enter the library wing of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
button_2: Leave, for now.
button_3: Visit the Chamber of Prophecies.
title: Fervid Divination

body_footer: Turning to you the savant adds: "The friends of <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> are welcome guests. By all means, take a look around."
body_header: Entering the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you are joined by <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: Both of you find the Order of Augurs working in silent sedulousness, engaged in various archiving tasks. However as you walk through the cupola hall, hushed whispers start to spread, while the Augurs covertly glance in your direction. At last one of the savants steps up, speaking to <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor>: "It is a great pleasure to welcome you back in this house of wisdom, <<OracleName<eventColor>{brother/sister}</eventColor>>>. You will find that we kept your works in high esteem."
button_0: Climb the stairs to the observatory roof.
button_1: Take <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> to a side room to speak in private...
button_2: Leave.
button_3: Visit the Chamber of Prophecies.
title: A Return Unforeseen

body_footer: "Though as you see," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> ends <<o:EventPlayer>> speech, "this is no ending for an Oracle, only the transition to something new."
body_header: While your words still echo through the Chamber of Prophecies, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> enters the room.
body_lore: "It would seem you are destined for something of great importance," <<p:EventPlayer>> addresses you, smoothing out <<o:EventPlayer>> robe, "for you witnessed a rare moment of true enlightenment. And no less one intertwining with my own prophecy—the Prophecy of Anon. You may have wondered why our prophecies are named after their prophet. It is quite simple: once an Oracle has basked in the light of truth, their divine senses grow dim and they will never again reveal the Allfather's light."
button_0: Thank <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> for <<o:EventPlayer>> insights.
title: Fervid Divination: Aftermath

body_footer: "For disbelievers doubt appears to be the enemy of faith," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes. "Yet it is often he without doubt who is forsaken."
body_header: While your words still echo through the Chamber of Prophecies, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> enters the room.
body_lore: "As you can see, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <<p:EventPlayer>> says, "the interpretation of a prophecy can cause division even among us <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>. In a sense it is the reason why the Order of Augurs exists: so a healthy theological discourse can be had on the matters of cosmic importance. Where other Orders formulate dogmas to guide their followers, we formulate doubt. For it is when we stop doubting that the gravest missteps are taken."
button_0: Agree. The sheep which blindly follows its shepherd can be easily led astray.
button_5: Disagree. Doubt is the chink through which Urrath's whispers may enter.
title: A Return Unforeseen: Aftermath

body_footer: While the voice subsides, the Prophecy of Anon still resonates within your mind.
body_header: At the Chamber of Prophecies, a beacon is lit. From within its floating light a deep voice, which you recognize as <<ge:voice,EventPlayer.FirstName>>, recites:
body_lore:
"Divine Myopia, Balance Enchained;
Giant Empires Fall, Corruption Reigns;

From Traitor's Blood, Fate's Trail Divides;
Darkness Slain, Through Fractured Light;

Divine Guard must Rest, For New Powers to Rise;
Who Weigh the Cost of Mercy, To a Vengeful Demise."
button_0: Leave, for now.
button_3: "Myrrida fell to its hubris. We mustn't repeat their mistakes!"
button_4: "The time of 'Divine Guard must Rest' has come to an end. Magehaven calls upon the Archons <influence></influence> and their might!"
button_5: "On Sordünn the 'Fractured Light' shall be reforged!" <bindingessence></bindingessence>
title: The Prophecy of Anon

body_footer: While the voice subsides, the Prophecy of Miopthera still resonates within your mind.
body_header: At the chamber of prophecies a beacon is lit. From within its floating light a familiar voice—<<ge:voice,<eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor>>>!—recites:
body_lore:
"Young are the children of twilight
Their creative powers unbound
Not ours is their will to guide
In need of a freedom profound
Fear not their dreams in violent night
Ward them from harm and boundaries cold
From cradles shaped to their delight
Their sublime destiny will unfold."
button_0: Leave, for now.
button_3: "We Godir are the 'children of twilight.' Archon dogmas will not hold us back!"
button_4: "Human favoritism has cost the Archons much credibility. Amends <gold></gold> for the other races could change that..."
button_5: "We must learn more <knowledge></knowledge> about the Dreamers and their 'sublime destiny!'"
title: The Prophecy of Miopthera

body_footer: "Allow me to help you interpret the prophecies, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> urges you, "so you can reach the High Council."
body_header: "Or so they say." <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> returns to gaze at the rippling waters.
body_lore:
"Staying at the Lakes of Sagacity has soothed my mind," <> continues after a while. "Observing the Astral Sea, listening to the Order of Augurs, reading Archon tracts about prophecies—it's all part of a journey I did not expect. Yet my heart is too restless to savor these gifts."

"Perhaps it is not my fate to reach Emnora myself. Perhaps,"—{EventHero.FirstName} turns to you again—"I have been brought here as an aide."
button_0: Accept <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> into your ranks. <unitHero></unitHero>
button_3: Invite <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> to your Wizard's Tower <caststrategic></caststrategic> to bolster your magecraft instead.
title: A Fateful Calling

body_footer: "The answer is inherent in these waters," the savant suggests, "hidden yet palpable. Can you read it, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>?"
body_header: Standing amid the savants of the Order of Augurs, one of them quietly approaches you.
body_lore: "The waters of the fountain are entrancing, aren't they?" <<p:EventUnit>> remarks with a muffled voice. "Under their spell, Irith pronounced her fateful prophecy. The ages past and here we still sit, pondering its full meaning: has the 'sun guard's doom' yet come to fulfillment? Or is it the destiny of all <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> to become <hyperlink>Revenants</hyperlink> at last?"
button_0: Decline to read the waters.
button_3: Let your arcane eye <mana></mana> harness the secrets <knowledge></knowledge> of the fountain.
title: A Doom Foretold

body_footer: "I feel the presence of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink>, distant, yet all-encompassing," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> concludes. "Can you sense it too?"
body_header: Entering the garden, you are joined by <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "There dwells a beauty in these Archon gardens that I did not expect," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> says, <<o:EventHero>> eyes closed as <<p:EventHero>> slowly breathes in. "We see the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> as holy warriors, priests, paladins, unaware that they were the worlds' architects and gardeners." <<Cp:EventHero>> draws you to a lush bed of flowers. "If only they had remembered the beauty of all colors. But by culling bad weeds, they condemned their own works."
button_0: "I feel fervor, ardent and rousing." <chaosboon></chaosboon>
button_3: "I feel rancor, cold and relentless." <shadowboon></shadowboon>
button_4: "I feel growth, tangled and rampant." <natureboon></natureboon>
button_5: "I feel industriousness, steady and firm." <materiumboon></materiumboon>
button_6: "I feel unity, structured and harmonious." <orderboon></orderboon>
button_7: "I feel ingenuity, surging and enchanting." <astralboon></astralboon>
button_8: "I am devoid of the Endailon's influence." <influence></influence>
title: Blooming Echoes

body_footer: "I urge you to explore these early Archon works," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> beckons you. "It is enlightening, even if not necessarily in the Archon sense."
body_header: At the library wing of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> you are joined by <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "Getting a glimpse at the wealth of texts debating their prophecies has taught me much about the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>," <<p:EventHero>> says, <<o:EventHero>> fingers slowly moving over the symbols at the bookshelves, denoting their era and category. "They long thought Anon's Prophecy foretold the fall of <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>. Hence, after Myrrida had been sieged down, they withdrew from many <hyperlink>Worlds Within</hyperlink>, since 'Divine Guard must Rest, For New Powers to Rise'. Which in turn facilitated the <hyperlink>Endailon Crisis</hyperlink>..."
button_0: Read about the Allfather and the creation of the Archons. <order></order>
button_3: Read about the spreading of the Astral Sea. <arcana></arcana>
button_4: Read about the Urwilderness and its rampant evolution. <nature></nature>
button_5: Read about the shaping of the Worlds Within through Dragons and Giants. <matter></matter>
button_6: Read about the cosmic uproar during the Endailon Crisis. <chaos></chaos>
button_7: Read about the emergence of Urrath from the Astral Void. <shadow></shadow>
title: Chronicled Aberrations

body_footer: <<Cge:eyes,<eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>>> grow misty as <<p:EventHero>> gazes at the stars above. "We never knew about the cosmic stakes involved. But we all suffered the consequences."
body_header: Reaching the starlit roof of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you find <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> deep in thoughts.
body_lore: "Being confronted with the prophecy that has shaped the lives of my family—and of entire races on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>—is staggering," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> says once <<p:EventHero>> notices you. "The Order of <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> formed around a very specific belief: the belief that Miopthera's Prophecy spoke of the then still young Human race. They let the Elves seed world after world for Humans to inhabit, so they might ascend to Archonhood. Until my father broke their ancient agreement on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>..."
button_0: Console <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> by connecting with the flows <mana></mana> to accentuate the Astral Sea's beauty.
button_3: Leave <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> to <<o:EventHero>> dolefulness.
title: Highmen Tragedies

body_footer: After this last revelation, the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> is taken to a resting place in the chambers behind the cupola hall.
body_header: Moving closer to the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, <<o:EventUnit>> violently called out words become clearer.
body_lore:
"... fractured light, it is fading... tainted by traitor's malformed hands... the daughter, she must rejoin the mother... impossible union of darkness and light..."

The {EventUnit} collapses, carried to rest by <> attendants. As they walk past you, the <{man/woman}>> suddenly draws <> up once more: "On Sordünn... on Sordünn's Cliffs new powers rise!"
button_0: Reflect on the words of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>.
title: A Moment of Prophecy

body_footer: "It was only after the <hyperlink>Gloomwatch</hyperlink> found me in exile that my prophecy—and thus my life—received new meaning," <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> concludes <<o:OracleName>> reminiscence. "Now I foster the <hyperlink>Dreamers</hyperlink>, the true 'Children of Twilight.'"
body_header: Once alone, before you can confront <<P:OracleName>>, <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> already raises <<o:OracleName>> voice:
body_lore: "I knew this conversation would come," <<p:OracleName>> says, touching <<o:OracleName>> temples. "And at this stage you deserve to know more. A long time ago—in a different life—I used to be an Archon of the Order of Augurs. After my epiphany, the consequences of my own prophecy were daunting: the rise of the Order of <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, the dressing of entire worlds for humanity, the growing tensions with other races—I despaired, unable to stop what my words had set in motion."
button_0: Thank <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> for <<o:OracleName>> trust in you.
title: The Archon Renegade

body_footer: The voices fade, allowing your strained mind to rest. You can intuit that their verdict is still to come.
body_header: Standing amid the grand statuary of the High Council a radiant light enfolds your senses. You see visions of flaring spirits, their words of debate echoing through your mind:
body_lore:
"They have shown signs of great promise."
"It matters not. The Deogai are not to be trusted."
"They are not uniform, their voices in discordance."
"The ways of Illaetas are manifold."
"[hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurielLoreConcept]Turiel[/hyperlink] warned us about their ambitions."
"The task we burdened him with drowned him in Shadows."
"There are Shepherds among them, earnest and vigilant."
"Yet there are Butchers, Hatemongers, Defilers."
button_0: Approach the next seat of communion.
title: The Archon High Council: Alpha

body_footer: The voices fade, allowing your exhausted mind to rest. You can intuit that their verdict is near.
body_header: As the radiant light returns, the council's debate continues:
body_lore:
"The beacon was abandoned, the luminaries darkened."
"The custodian's fallacy must not be repeated."
"Their war is our war, our paths coalesce."
"They are susceptible to the voice of Nilfero."
"Its anguish grapples even Emnora."
"Their destiny foretells finality."
"Do their souls not long for Illaetas?"
button_0: Approach the next seat of communion.
title: The Archon High Council: Nu

body_footer: The council's voice fades, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> vanishing in their light.
body_header: From the radiant light a flaring wheel of eyes emerges. Its gaze petrifies your existence, while you hear the council's unified voice:
body_lore:
"Hark, {PlayerLeader}, harbinger of need: the light that you sought is yet kindled inside. Be the torch that emblazes Magehaven's beacons, signaling the return of the Allfather's Host!"

"Hark, {EventHero}, progeny of autumn: the deadness of winter lies behind you. Fear not. Step into the light. In Emnora the buds of spring bloom."
button_0: It is done.
title: The Archon High Council: Omega

body_footer: "I... will need some time to think. Please, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, allow me to withdraw to your Wizard's Tower, for the time being."
body_header: In the heat of the battle, just as <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> is about to fall, the Ward of the Archons suddenly enshrouds <<P:EventHero>>.
body_lore: When <<p:EventHero>> reemerges from the light, <<o:EventHero>> wounds appear to be mended. "I am not sure what happened," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> says, looking at <<o:EventHero>> pristine hands in disbelief. "But it appears that once again there are forces in play that do not want my journey to end."
button_0: Let <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> suspend <<o:EventHero>> duties as your hero.
button_1: Decline <<ge:request,<eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>>>. <happiness></happiness>
title: Divine Intervention

body_footer: "By the power of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Title}</eventColor>," the man says, revealing <<o:EventPlayer>> face. "You shall not pass!"
body_header: Accompanied by a single scribe, a hooded man, humble yet exalted, awaits you at the bottom of the Ziggurat's stairs.
body_lore: "Recede, foul <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>!" the man calls out, raising <<o:EventPlayer>> staff in defiance. "The stars have unveiled to me your vicious machinations. I shall not let you taint these blessed lands. Return to the shadows or you will face the true wrath of the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>!"
button_0: Accept the challenge. Tomorrow, the heavens will be weeping blood.
title: Unhallowed Revelations

surprise_attack: "By the power of the Order of Augurs," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> shouts defiantly, "you shall not pass!"
You strike without warning, yet in a split second <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> raises <<o:EventPlayer>> staff to invoke a shield of starlight.

"Recede, foul <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>!" <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> calls out, enduring behind <<o:EventPlayer>> ward. "The stars have unveiled to me your vicious intentions. I shall not let you taint these blessed lands. Return to the shadows or you will face the true wrath of the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>!"

body_footer: "You are forever condemned, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> exclaims as the Ward of the Archons enshrouds <<P:EventPlayer>>. "In the <hyperlink>Void</hyperlink> you will regret."
body_header: The Lakes of Sagacity are tainted with the blood of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> <<r:EventPlayer>> has been brought to <<o:EventPlayer>> knees.
body_lore: "The stirring evilness of the Pantheon has grown in power beyond our previsions," <<p:EventPlayer>> says slowly, collecting <<o:EventPlayer>> last strength. "Could it be... the Prophecy of Dygenion... I should have seen it earlier."
button_0: Such a fool. My victory was foretold!
title: Wicked Triumph

body_footer: Thick shadows swell at the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, binding its magic to your will. The path to the highest ring, it is open at last.
body_header: Standing at the site of <<ge:fall,<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>>>, you channel <<o:EventPlayer>> lingering arcana to perform a dark ritual:
body_lore:
"From tainted light
To shadows deep
Unholy blight
A key will reap
The holy door
Unshut forevermore."
button_0: Prepare to face the Archon High Council.
title: Unhallowed Revelations: Aftermath

body_footer: The Celestial tempest of the Archon High Council rages. They know you are coming.
body_header: Descending the stairway of the last Ziggurat in sinister triumph, you behold the seat of the Archon High Council.
body_lore: Angelic statues and sacred trees flank your path, which winds down to an enormous <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. Yet as soon as you step onto the path, the tranquility disperses. An unnatural breeze quickly swells into a storm, bending the holy tree lines, and thundering voices, exalted yet disturbed, echo from the walls of the monumental fountain.
button_0: Approach the seat of the Archon High Council.
title: A Council in Turmoil

body_footer: With concerted divine might, the Archon High Council banishes you from Emnora. Yet they cannot undo what you accomplished...
body_header: Reaching the waters of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you become blinded by an all-encompassing light.
body_lore: There are shapes in the light, wrathful, aghast. You imagine you see wings, countless, flapping in terror, while the thundering voices call out your name with such fervor that the heavens themselves are shaken.
button_0: "I... shall... return!"
title: A Council in Turmoil: Aftermath

body_footer: "My duties as your ascended envoy have ended," <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor> calls out, invoking a sphere of starlight around <<r:OracleName>>. "We will meet again as enemies."
body_header: As you strategize your conquest of Emnora, you are interrupted by <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "I have guided you through enigmas and cleansing flame," <<p:OracleName>> says, <<o:OracleName>> face pale as ivory. "But alas, when it comes to you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, my precognition has failed me. Now you seek to bring corruption to the most hallowed lands of my people."
button_0: Let <<P:OracleName>> vanish. <<Cp:OracleName>> will pay for <<o:OracleName>> treason in time.
title: The Departure of <eventColor>{OracleName}</eventColor>

body_footer: "No!" <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> calls out with <<o:EventPlayer>> last strength. "Through the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> our <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> shall swim, unerring, enduring, until we return to... <hyperlink>the Well</hyperlink>..."
body_header: <<Co:EventPlayer>> vocal sac bleeding with every voiced syllable, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> feebly chants <<o:EventPlayer>> own dirge.
body_lore: "Where is the Archon galley with blessed reinforcements?" <<p:EventPlayer>> laments. "Where the lighthouse guiding us to safe havens? The <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> lie squashed upon the shores of battle. Is their fate not worthy of Archon deliverance?"
button_0: Light a beacon <mana></mana>, guiding the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> on their final journey.
button_1: Let <<P:EventPlayer>> die in peace.
button_2: 'Fish' for the afloat souls <souls></souls> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. <evilact></evilact>
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: "What say you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> asks, <<o:EventPlayer>> skin now reaching a yellow hue, "shall we feast in friendship?"
body_header: While your scouts patrol the borders, looking out for the <hyperlink>Revenants</hyperlink> of <eventColor>{RevenantPlayer}</eventColor>, you hear the familiar croaking of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> from afar.
body_lore:
"Righteous {PlayerLeader}," {EventPlayer} chants, <> skin shifting in colors as if relaying a message of its own. "We are pleased to see you joining the crusade against {RevenantPlayer}. The troubled waters near {EventCity} are treacherous to navigate. Yet if we set sail together, our landing will be triumphant!"

"It is customary among my people to seal an alliance with an exchange of food and men," <> continues, revealing a large banquet with presumed delicacies of the {EventRace} behind <>.
button_0: Accept the alliance <rs_alliance></rs_alliance> and an exchange of troops. <unit></unit>
button_3: Accept the alliance <rs_alliance></rs_alliance> and an exchange of food. <food></food>
button_4: Accept the alliance <rs_alliance></rs_alliance>, but politely decline the rest.
button_5: Decline the offer. The war with <eventColor>{RevenantPlayer}</eventColor> is your own.
title: A Warm Breeze

body_footer: "In the name of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> and <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink> I beseech you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>:" <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> ends <<o:EventHero>> call, "stop this madness now, when your soul can still find peace."
body_header: Invading the Lakes of Sagacity, you find a lone Elven <<EventHero<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>>, calling out to you from a distance.
body_lore:
"Leave now, {PlayerLeader}!" <> shouts, <> gentle voice emanating authority. "For these blessed lands deserve to remain in peace. I came here shaken by horrors. Staying with the Order of Augurs has soothed my mind."

"I am {EventHero}, my people sharing a violent history with the Archons," <> continues, revealing <> to you. "Like few others I know the tainted allure of vengeance. When we bear a grudge we invite evil. The path to Emnora leads through forgiveness..."

description: It was during the time of the Great Umbral War, when the denizens of Urrath swarmed the Worlds Within, that many Godir of Magehaven faltered in their faith. For where were the Archons? Had they been defeated, their bastions consumed by the dark tide they could no longer contain? Or had they judged the Pantheon unworthy, abandoning them to their fate?

The Gloomwatch, bound by ancient agreements, refused to speak on the matter. Instead they sent their own emissaries to Magehaven, offering to guide single Godir through the World Gates onto a path towards the Archons.

This is the story of one such Godir and their journey of exaltation.

At long last, through displays of virtue and endurance, the first Godir set foot on the highest ring of Emnora. The Archon High Council, moved by the recounted tragedies of souls claimed in the Great Umbral War, set aside their reservations and decreed the return of the Archons to Magehaven.

As the Celestial battalions emerged from the World Gates, the Pantheon stood in awe, and the Umbral darkness that had shrouded their minds receded.

In a flare of Celestial light the Archon High Council banished the wicked Godir, who had intruded in their most hallowed sanctuary, from Emnora. They beheld the powers of the Pantheon, seeing how their absence was giving rise to terrible new enemies. Thus they decreed the return of the Archons to Magehaven.

As the Celestial battalions emerged from the World Gates, the Pantheon stood in awe, yet the most maleficent Godir whispered of the Revenants and divine corruption...

description: At last the Archons had allied themselves with Magehaven in the war against Urrath—and they brought with them a Prophecy which would prove vital if victory were to be attained: the Prophecy of Anon.

Divine Myopia; Balance Enchained
Giant Empires Fall; Darkness Reigns;
From Traitor's Blood; Fate's Trail Divides;
Corruption Cleansed, Through Fractured Light;
Divine Guard must Rest; For New Powers to Rise;
Who Weigh the Cost of Mercy; Against a Vengeful Demise.

This Prophecy forbade the Archons from getting involved directly, and thus it fell to the Godir of Magehaven to choose one of their own who they deemed powerful enough to fulfill this vital mission. The Archons would lend their strength by sending their champion—an Elven protégé they had taken beneath their divine wings.

Their mission was to liberate the Cliffs of Sordünn—the prophesied fallen realm that was once part of the Giant Empire of Myrrida. This realm was to be reclaimed from the Umbral Abyss and its corrupted Ruler, who was desecrating the lands and its inhabitants through foul magic.
Together the two chosen Godir would unveil truths beyond what the Prophecy of Anon foretold.

And thus, the prophesied Godir judged Merlin and banished him to the Astral Void. By choosing revenge, parts of the Prophecy of Anon remained unfulfilled. Perhaps, the Archons had to admit, there was a different interpretation to the prophecy besides destroying that which was corrupted by Urrath. But now the chance to fulfill the Prophecy had passed.

And thus, the prophesied Godir judged Merlin and banished him to the Astral Void. By choosing revenge, parts of the Prophecy of Anon remained unfulfilled. Perhaps, the Archons had to admit, there was a different interpretation to the prophecy besides destroying that which was corrupted by Urrath. But now the chance to fulfill the Prophecy had passed.

And thus, the prophesied Godir judged Merlin and found him worthy of redemption. By channeling the power of the Endailon the curse of Urrath was broken, and the Prophecy of Anon was fulfilled. Magehaven rejoiced: through the creative power of the Affinities it was not only possible to destroy Urrath's influence, but to restore those fallen to its corruption.
Julia and Sundren remained, bereft of their friend, mentor, and the chance to strike back at Urrath itself. Perhaps, in time, they would find the answers they sought.
With this newfound power of restoration, Archons and Godir finally saw a chance to reclaim what was lost, and to begin turning the tide against Urrath.

race_bio_1:
Be there an ancient artifact to uncover or a cosmic event to unfold, the Wanderer is ever present. Many question whether he follows the Astral Flows to fortune, or whether fortune follows him instead. Is he the moth or the flame?

Bhajif refers to those who follow him as the Lost Travelers, for they walk in the footsteps of a man without direction. When his followers ask Bhajif what path they should take, he always replies: "Travelers, there is no path, for the path is made through walking."

bio:
Logarr started as a soft-scaled shipmate. Through perseverance—and some lucky close-encounters with death—he rose through the ranks to captain his own ship for the glory of his people. But it took an unwinnable naval battle for him to truly show his tactical prowess and ascend to the title of Fleet Captain.

The Crocodile Corsairs cannot imagine a life without sea-salt and sunlight on their scales. Where others cultivate the lands, they rather raid and plunder. When something of importance needs to be discussed they call for a Pond, a form of parlay taking place whilst participants float in a body of water.
name: Crocodile Corsairs

bio:
Having hatched only ten cosmic cycles ago, Aerelazaliar would be considered "young" among his Dragonkin. Perhaps it is his youth that drives his curiosity and kindness towards those his kin would deem inferior. He pays their comments no mind, for Aerelazaliar's gaze drifts beyond his nature of creation and destruction and he dares to question "why".

The Starbred Salamanders were created in Aerelazaliar's own image. It is rare for a Dragon to create their own people, and many wonder what the consequences of Aerelazaliar's "vain splurge in divinity" will be. His people, however, are forever grateful for their draconic father's care.
name: Starbred Salamanders

bio:
Tephradenir is an Elder Dragon who was born together with her world. Mountains and dales formed under her care. After her task was done, she slept... Until she was awakened once more, only to see her world filled with vermin who change and destroy her precious creations. Enraged, she rises to take vengeance upon those who deem her work "imperfect".

A group of primitive cave dwellers hid from Dwarven miners and found an Elder Dragon who slept at the bottom. When she awakened and destroyed the Dwarves—and a big part of the world above—the cave dwellers named her their wrathful goddess. Generations later, few question the decisions of their primal patron.
name: Worldscorcher Cultists

bio:
He arrives in a cyclone of lightning and claims himself to be the Master of Dragons. Few dare to question that claim, for Tempest is indeed known to walk among these primal beings. Even more eccentric and erratic now than he was before being banished to the Void, Tempest's mind is like a brewing storm.

The Draconians were the result of a rare collaboration between wizard and Dragon. As a reward for this endeavor, Tempest claimed half of the resulting hatchlings and has ruled them ever since. Now, after following their master through the Astral Sea itself, the Stormborn Draconians almost share more kinship with Tempest than the Dragons they originate from.
name: Stormborn Draconians

race_bio:
Boszorkan the Arcanist. As one of the younger great Dragons, he seeks the arcane with a singular purpose. Unconcerned for the physical trifles of the other Dragons, his involvement in the Ashen War is one born out of curiosity. Allipavar presents his greatest rival; her destructive nature represents a brake on his seemingly endless advancements. The arcane might Boszorkan wields and extends to his followers is unrivaled and rightly feared.

Boszorkan did not create his followers like many of the other great Dragons. Instead, they were drawn to his service, seeking enlightenment in magic. Boszorkan seems indifferent to their reverence, but uses them as one would use a tool. The Students accept this arrangement, as they have much to learn from the scraps the Storm Dragon leaves behind. They desire above all else to achieve arcane feats that draw the attention of their master, and to perhaps one day be his equals.

The birth of Allipavar the Destroyer—youngest of the great Dragons—sparked great chaos on the realm. Compared to others of her kind, she is a simple creature. Yet, though her purpose may seem crude and brutal, she is the fire that tempers steel, warms the night, and lays low entire civilizations. From those ashes, new life may arise, new creations may be built, new order may be found. Conflict is what drives her, and she understands life only through conflict and strife. The Ashen War may not have formally been sparked by her, but she will certainly end it, one conquest at a time.

The Destroyer's Brood are a primal people, seeking the contest and exhilaration of conflict above all else. Spawned from the first blood shed by Allipavar in combat, they are devoted to her and her fury beyond any doubt. Each of the Destroyer's Brood lives for the contest, each seeking their god's favor through ever greater displays of destruction and ferocity.

The moniker of "Forgefather" was given to Vox'Sebas by his followers, whom he was gifted by his love Sumuskira. Vox'Sebas devotes himself to creativity and innovation, better materials and experiences. He is proud to posses the mightiest hoard of all the great Dragons, some of its contents by his own creation. He is pained by his involvement in the Ashen War, but he believes he must, for an untempered Soncevar would have brought great imbalance. And thus he finds himself in war, facing his love Sumuskira on the field of battle.

The Forgefather's Favored are an unusual people, gifted to him by Sumuskira herself. Though they share traits with their cousins among the Disciples of the Grovetender, they never grew to the size and strength of their natural brethren, instead working the forges and fires of creation. They regard Vox'Sebas as their father, and it is the Favored's greatest joy to create works of art for their father's hoard. On the field of battle they rely fiercely on their creations rather than their own strength.

Sumuskira the Grovetender was one of the first of the great Dragons to be born, along with Vox'Sebas. Sumuskira sparks life, planting the seeds for mortals to emerge. She loves her creations, perhaps a bit too much. Though she perhaps understands that all things must eventually die, she cannot abide the chaos of Allipavar or the cold judgments of her younger sister Kralicavir. Her involvement in the Ashen War is one born out of a desire to extend the life of her creations, to shield them from the strife that might break them, rather than any desire to see her opposition destroyed.

The Grovetender's Disciples are a blessed people, wild and enduring. Sumuskira granted them many gifts and has appointed them her caretakers. The Disciples are perhaps closest to their master of all the peoples serving the great Dragons. They seek to emulate their mother in every way they can, spreading and caring for the gifts of life wherever they go. They fear death more than most, and their obsession with life's gift may be seen by some as foolish, but none can dispute the beauty they spread.

Soncevar the Radiant is a being of laws, uncompromising and unforgiving. He tends to the spirit of mortals, molding the laws and morals of societies as they start to form. A plan exists for all beings on his realm, and it must be seen to an orderly conclusion. The birth of Allipavar brought strife to his ordered world, driving Soncevar to spark the Ashen War to rid the realm of the threat of Allipavar and seeking to contain Kralicavir.

The Radiant Host, beings born of the will of Soncevar himself, seek order in all things. Soncevar made his followers as tools to enforce order where he himself can not be, they are tailor-made for maintaining order and control. Unusually, each Radiant has morals identical to their god, unable to diverge or change, something considered quite distasteful by some of the other great Dragons.

Kralicavir the Collector, the mirror of Sumuskira, is a creature of purpose and conviction. A strict code rules her actions, yet her code would be seen as reprehensible by some. Death is vital for the cycle of life, and she collects the souls of sinners and saints alike. All find a home beneath her dark wings before being whisked away forever. She's considered cold and uncaring by many, but perhaps the most devoted to her duties, even if those duties lead to ostracism.

The Collected represent the Death Dragon Kralicavir's hoard, souls who still have a use in her possession before they are passed on forever. They seek naught but service, working tirelessly and without complaint toward their goddess' goals.

syron_sovereign_bio:
Nykareth was once a Syron, one of the most zealous fighters of the Gloomwatch. Through the Ages, her hatred for the Umbral Abyss began to consume her, and she started to see Urrath's corruption even within the light of creation itself. Shunned for her erratic behavior, Nykareth has become obsessed with smiting those she deems corrupted... But the grounds of her judgments are unclear to all but her.

The Veilstriders are Nykareth's most loyal soldiers, priding themselves on being the last bastion of true faith that stands against the torrent of the Umbral Abyss. They see their ruler's physical transformation as a blessing of the Archons, and as proof that their path is the truly righteous one.

race_ascendedinsectoid_bio:
Naz'ru isn't the smartest of his people, nor the wisest, or most charismatic. Above all, he is the biggest and the most protective, and among the first to shed the corruption of Urrath. Under his rule, the dwellings of the Shadir'ko have evolved into thriving cities.

The Shadir'ko were once mindless thralls under the rule of Lithyl, corrupted by Urrath. Only after ages of neglect were they able to slowly and through much loss find their own identities, which they now viciously defend.
race_wizardsyron_bio:
As a direct descendant of the first Syrons, Aeri grew up in reverence of the history of the Gloomwatch. Yet, as her talents as a Wizard grew, her Torment of Shadows made her question her assigned burden as a cosmic protector. Instead, she decided to offer sanctuary to those who choose simpler lives... Though in the Astral Sea, that in itself is a challenge.

The Free Syrons consist mainly of veterans, and people who declined the duty and honor of the Gloomwatch in favor of a calmer life on the Worlds Within. Yet, when threatened, they will stand their ground next to any other battle-hardened warrior.

bio:
Ra'cheq was, as he himself proclaims, but an insect, living in the dirt and feeding on scraps. Until one day the sun eclipsed, the stars darkened and the world was embraced by Urrath. Ra'cheq was the first to crawl from under the rubble and he believes that is why he was Chosen to lead his newly awakened people to greatness.

Ra'cheq's followers believe themselves to be the chosen disciples of Urrath, their dark god. They are prone to violence and jealousy, vying for their god's corrupted love without hesitation to betray even their own kin if their High Corruptor demands it.

Once, Ryc'Turi was nothing but one drone in the hive-mind of her people, following the orders of their Sovereign Lithyl without question. In her absence, however, Ryc'Turi was the first of her people to take initiative beyond the direct orders she was given. Where this newly-found ambition will lead her, she herself hardly knows.

Born and raised on Tharru'Cath, the Shadac'har know very little beyond oppressive violence and blind loyalty to Urrath and their overlords. Over time, however, they developed the power to communicate with other peoples and started to show an eagerness to build that their former Sovereign would undoubtedly deem mildly concerning.
name: Shadac'har

bio:
Once a powerful Wizard, Lithyl Nightweaver fell to her Torment of Shadows and became Lost, before the dark god Urrath twisted her blind insanity and broken body into something considerably more menacing. After a time of imprisonment wrought upon her by the Elven princess Sundren, Lithyl returns to exact her revenge on her captor, Athla, and the entire Astral Sea.

Not all who wander the Astral Sea are Godir. Many mortals find themselves lost in its depths, forgotten, with no divine power to save them. Still, some may consider oblivion a more merciful fate than to be found by Lithyl Nightweaver, the Harbinger of Urrath, who extends an eldritch hand and strangles those in her grasp until they are nothing but mindless thralls in her game of corruption.
name: Chosen of Urrath

bio:
As a young human prince, Merlin was chosen by the Archon Gabriel to restore the balance of power on Athla. The Wizard's Circle, the All-Devourer, the Shadowborn—as a masterful wizard of the cosmos, Merlin protected the people of Athla throughout the Ages even after he had withdrawn from power, exploring large parts of the Astral Sea. At last he was betrayed by his own love, falling into the clutches of Lithyl Nightweaver in a desperate attempt to save Julia of House Inioch from Urrath's grasp. Now, reshaped into an Eldritch Sovereign through Urrath's vile corruption, all that Merlin desires appears to be for the cosmos to swiftly end so that all suffering and agony of the world may forever be forgotten.

The Umbral Humans are Merlin's instrument of annihilation. They bring oblivion to the realms he treads, as oblivion is what their master desires.
name: Umbral Humans

bio:
Born as a thrall within the Umbral Abyss, O'neron returned his people their freedom when he joined arms with the Wizard Kings of the Second Age on Athla to destroy the All-Devourer. Since then, he has traveled the Astral Sea, reaching other realms of free Syron civilizations. Through the Gloomwatch, he rediscovered his history and heritage, forever linked to Athla.

The Gloomwatch Syrons sail the Astral Sea in search and protection of the Dreamers. They are gifted in the arcane and have developed high versatility when resisting the fell reach of Urrath and its Umbral Abyss.
name: Gloomwatch Syrons

As will-less drones they serve as unceasing warriors, laborers, or as a harvest of souls to satiate the hunger of the <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink>. body_footer: The constellation's new stars cosmically bolster the damage of this realm's <hyperlink>archers</hyperlink> and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]casters[/hyperlink], at the cost of their range.
body_header: Complaints from your archers reach you. Their arrows seem weightier. Astrologers soon find the cause: the constellation of Leana's Draw has changed!
body_lore: New stars have appeared around the "arrow" in the constellation of Leana's Draw. The celestial image now looks like the Huntress is drawing back a javelin on her bow. The alteration somehow affects not just your archers' arrows, but also the magical projectiles of your casters.
button_0: "Let my foes draw closer, if they dare."
title: Sign of the Huntress

body_footer: However, depending on how useful you found their temporary effectiveness, your archers' celebration could be premature.
body_header: The additional stars in the constellation of Leana's Draw have dimmed again, much to the relief of your archers.
body_lore: Your astrologers have several hypotheses concerning the cause of this alteration of the Sign of the Huntress, ranging from prophecies to divine intervention. Regardless, with the stars that elongated the "arrow" in the constellation gone, your <hyperlink>archers'</hyperlink> and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]casters'[/hyperlink] natural range and damage are restored. They shake their weary arms and rejoice.
button_0: "Instruct my mages to study <mana></mana> how to replicate this effect."
button_1: "Let arrows fly far once more!"
button_2: Perform a blood sacrifice to gain the enchantment.
title: Sign of the Huntress: Aftermath

body_footer: Fragments of the shattered world have crashed in every forest, causing them to spread and grow hostile towards your armies.
body_header: When a great World Tree has sufficiently matured, it shoots its seeds off into the Astral Sea towards new worlds.
body_lore: World Trees do not reproduce on their own worlds. Instead, they spread their seeds on distant realms. Should a World Seed find a barren world, it will eventually make it fertile and inhabitable. However, a World Seed finding a lush world will stir the trees and plants that were already there.
button_0: "Be wary of the forests! They are no longer safe!"
title: Invading Sylviculture

body_footer: Will you restore your lands claimed by forests? Or is it more appealing to learn new power over nature?
body_header: After a period of upheaval, a World Seedling from a distant world has taken root, spawning a new <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
body_lore: Peace returns within the realm and balance is restored, as is Nature's wont. Your troops may once again traverse the woodlands safely and unhindered. Yet for all the turmoil the World Seedling caused, you may have an opportunity to benefit from the woody incursion.
button_0: Banish <mana></mana> the invading Forests and revert your provinces to their original terrains.
button_1: The forests are here to stay, yielding us timber. <structureprod></structureprod>
button_2: Learn <eventColor>{EventEnchantment}</eventColor> to have plants aid you in battle.
button_3: No forests grow in your domain.
title: Invading Sylviculture: Aftermath

body_footer: Ravenous parasitic creatures that follow the Astral Leviathan descend upon your realm to feast on life!
body_header: An impossibly deep bellow heralds the arrival of a colossal creature from the far reaches of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>.
body_lore: Although intimidating, the Astral Leviathan does not appear hostile. Yet in its wake follow swarms of malicious <hyperlink>Astral Sea Monsters</hyperlink>, such as <<m:EventUnit>>. What's worse, the Astral Leviathan's deep song makes ethereal creatures such as these parasites more attuned to the reverberations of magic.
button_0: "My empire shall not fall to these leeches from the cosmos!"
title: Ravenous Visitants

body_footer: The Astral parasites that remain on your world, marooned and severed from their cosmic host, will die off soon.
body_header: The Astral Leviathan that circumscribes your world has seemingly lost interest. It drifts away peacefully, after one final bellow.
body_lore: Within a few heartbeats, the colossus has gone from your sight, floating away with an unlikely haste. Most of the invaders that swarmed your world notice its departure and follow its ethereal current.
button_0: "Good riddance."
title: Ravenous Visitants: Aftermath

body_footer: Will Gabriel's Eye bring about a new era of enlightenment, in which wisdom is valued over war? Time will tell.
body_header: Stargazers discover a new star in the sky. Dubbed "Gabriel's Eye," its gleam inspires all rulers to pursue knowledge.
body_lore: Your scholars theorize that the recent disturbance of 73 caused the new star to light up in the firmament. You discern within yourself a rising thirst for knowledge, while your hunger for battle wanes.
button_0: "Perhaps now is the time for peace and wisdom."
title: Starry-eyed Enlightenment

body_footer: Slowly, the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> of this realm revert to their old, warring ways.
body_header: As suddenly as it appeared, Gabriel's Eye is fading again, as are its pacifying effects.
body_lore: You wonder if the ancient wizard had truly fixed its gaze on your world, or if this was a rumor produced by your people's superstition. However it may be, you cannot deny how its presence impacted the realm, pushing an era of enlightenment.
button_0: "The insolent warmongers of this realm must be held accountable."
button_1: "One way or another, this realm shall be mine."
title: Starry-eyed Enlightenment: Aftermath

body_footer: You grin. Fueling the imminent bonfires of <hyperlink>Chaos</hyperlink> will deliver maximum pandemonium.
body_header: You are no stranger to nightly visions of <hyperlink>Chaos</hyperlink>, yet tonight's imagery offers an eerie clarity. An Eye of Fire calls you.
body_lore: The Eye of Fire you see in your feverish vision presents itself to you as a gargantuan ring of flames in the sky. Its gaze will cause lesser lords to break oaths, and demons to ravage the realm. You wake up and realize your world is about to be plummeted into Chaos.
button_0: "My magic <mana></mana> shall fan the flames of Chaos!"
button_1: "My serfs <population></population> shall kindle the flames of Chaos!" <evilact></evilact>
button_2: "The Eye of Fire will incite sufficient mayhem."
title: <chaos></chaos> Eye of Fire: Foreshadowing

body_footer: The entire realm descends into a maddening domain of fiery <hyperlink>Chaos</hyperlink>. May the odds be in your favor.
body_header: A distant world somewhere in the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> shifts in front of <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink>. It is ensnared in the <hyperlink>Chaos</hyperlink> World's radiance, forming an ungodly ring of fire in the heavens.
body_lore: Like a naked Balor eye in the firmament, the Eye of Fire gazes down on your helpless world. Demons and fiends summoned to your world revel in its light, while vassals are driven mad and abandon their oaths and fealty. The Eye's unholy gleam causes the fires on your world to grow, and their flames burn with searing malice.
button_0: "We will weather this evil storm."
button_1: "What madman would reinforce this occurrence?"
button_2: "All according to plan."
title: <chaos></chaos> Eye of Fire

boosted_by_other:
Like a naked Balor eye in the firmament, the Eye of Fire gazes down on your helpless world. Demons and fiends summoned to your world revel in its light, while vassals are driven mad and abandon their oaths and fealty. The Eye's unholy gleam causes the fires on your world to grow, and their flames burn with searing malice.

An unnatural malady incites a madness in your troops, diminishing their mental and physical resistances.

body_footer: In any case, your people wish and pray that they shall never again be submitted to such an ordeal.
body_header: The demon eye in the sky, wreathed in infernal flames, turns away. Perhaps it hungers for another world to consume.
body_lore: The world is given a chance to heal from its smoldering wounds. Vassals once again turn to their lords for guidance and plead for their forgiveness.
button_0: "Back to my ambitions for this realm."
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> must answer for their part in this phenomenon."
button_2: "That was entertaining."
title: <chaos></chaos> Eye of Fire: Aftermath

boosted_by_other:
The world is given a chance to heal from its smoldering wounds. Vassals once again turn to their lords for guidance and plead for their forgiveness.

The chaos revealed to your diviners that {EventPlayer} was among those who fanned the infernal flames of the Eye of Fire, scorching the world permanently. <> weakening malady continues to affect your troops.

body_footer: The realm's <hyperlink>Shield Bearers</hyperlink> may carry broken shields, but they are poised to thrash your enemies in the front lines.
body_header: The "shield" in the constellation of Baradir the Shield Master has broken in twain! Shields and bucklers everywhere spontaneously shatter.
body_lore: Now that their full advantage of shield-wielding is lost, defenders are compelled to focus on their attacks. It is a formidable sight to behold: they strike harder and deeper, paying less heed to their defensive tactics.
button_0: "The best defense is a mighty offense!"
title: Sign of the Cleft Shield

body_footer: Discounting the odd shield bash, this realm's <hyperlink>Shield Bearers</hyperlink> once again favor defense over fierce attacks.
body_header: The "shield" in the constellation of Baradir the Shield Master has restored itself. Your <hyperlink>Shield Bearers'</hyperlink> shields are equally mended.
body_lore: Smiths and armorers repaired or reforged every broken targe and buckler in your realm. Defenders everywhere proudly bear their shields high once again. Having favored their sword-arm over their shields for so long, they reacquaint themselves with their familiar role as protectors.
button_0: "You must train <unitprod></unitprod> your sword-arm even more."
button_1: "Protecting the meek is once more a shield-warrior's calling."
button_2: "By my blood, my shield bearers may hold this starbound power."
title: Sign of the Cleft Shield: Aftermath

body_footer: A thirst for battle rouses your citizens, while your troops are inspired to fight for your cause, instead of your gold.
body_header: Sightings have been reported of Xorn's Javelin, a long-tailed comet that pierces brightly through the nightly sky.
body_lore: Every time this comet passes by a world, its denizens are overcome with an uncanny urge to fight. Already, your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> are ardently lining up to enlist! Meanwhile, your troops in the field are stirred by the omen and passionately fight for your cause, as if Xorn the Disciplined himself leads them.
button_0: "Now is the time to grow my army and conquer!"
title: Portent of Rousing

body_footer: With your coffers replenished, the future looks bright. You cannot wait until Xorn's Javelin returns.
body_header: Xorn's Javelin has traveled out of your sight, and the eagerness for combat that gripped your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> quickly evaporates.
body_lore: But, just as the comet crosses the horizon, it issues one final burst of burning loyalty. Your citizens that cannot fight are inspired to contribute to your war efforts. For each warrior in your army, a donation is made in celebration of the glory of your rulership.
button_0: "Glory to me!"
title: Portent of Rousing: Aftermath

body_footer: You can only witness how your domain slowly erodes into a barren desert.
body_header: From the outer skies above the realm, cosmic winds flagellate the world. Wherever they blow, vegetation is burned or sanded down.
body_lore: Rivers and lakes dry up. Not even the thickest wall or highest mountain can repel the currents. You are at the mercy of the fickle gales issued by the cosmos.
button_0: "We will weather this storm."
title: Cosmic Winds

body_footer: Will you advance the desolate realm's restoration? Or have the sandstorms inspired you to develop new tricks.
body_header: Finally, the relentless cosmic winds recede. The world is given a chance to restore life in the barren deserts.
body_lore: You only vaguely remember what your world used to look like before. Much of what was lush and verdant has been scourged by the dry tempests. There is but one solacing thought: that all your rivals have endured the same sandy ordeal.
button_0: Revitalize <mana></mana> the coarse Deserts and revert your provinces to their original terrains.
button_1: Learn <eventColor>{EventEnchantment}</eventColor> to summon sandstorms in combat.
button_2: Sieve your desert's sands to claim treasures <gold></gold> previously locked in earth.
button_3: Sand does not blanket any of your lands.
title: Cosmic Winds: Aftermath

body_footer: Finding uncorrupted food to harvest has become a nigh impossible challenge, while your soldiers threaten to succumb to pestilence.
body_header: Astrologers warn you of the imminent conjunction of <eventColor>{RandomNatureWorld}</eventColor>, a world of Growth, and <eventColor>{RandomShadowWorld}</eventColor>, a world of Decay.
body_lore: The combined pull on your realm is causing crops to rot as they ripen. The threat of a famine looms. Equally disastrous are the reports of your troops suffering from an unnatural disease.
button_0: "I pray my <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> can digest this affliction."
title: Blightfall Conjunction

body_footer: The realm is healing. Only the most devious would seek to profit from this global disaster.
body_header: The realm is finally permitted respite: the Blightfall Conjunction has ended.
body_lore: Your famished <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> are relieved to find an abundance of fresh foods after such a deprivation. Your warriors, full-bellied once again, stand strong and firm, ready at your command.
button_0: Learn the <eventColor>{EventSpell}</eventColor> spell to curse <evilact></evilact> your enemies with this plague.
button_1: Harvest the souls <souls></souls> of those who succumbed to the Blightfall.
button_2: Let us leave this age of pestilence behind us.
title: Blightfall Conjunction: Aftermath

body_footer: Until the Sea can restore itself, the workings of <eventColor>{GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.TELEPORTER}</eventColor> and <hyperlink>phase-shifters</hyperlink> has been severely disrupted.
body_header: The recent visit of the <eventColor>{EventEntity}</eventColor> has stirred the cosmic cohesion of the firmament.
body_lore: What is usually fleeting in the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, is now earthbound by the lingering aura of the <eventColor>{EventEntity}</eventColor>. The magic property of some particles that allows them to shift from substance into energy, is nullified.
button_0: "My troops better march on."
title: Phase-shift Nixing

body_footer: Deposits of suppressed magical energies are now suddenly released all at once, resulting in a snowfall of <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink> crystals.
body_header: Finally, the comforting hums of <eventColor>{GLOBAL.STRUCTURE_UPGRADES.TELEPORTER}</eventColor> fill the realm once more as their connections are restored.
body_lore: But even while their abilities were disrupted, the teleporters continued to extract sublimated magic from the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. With nowhere else to go, the magical energies were stored with these structures.
button_0: "A welcome serendipity!"
title: Phase-shift Nixing: Aftermath

body_footer: The sun's rays of winter disrupt your world. Snowstorms not only complicate combat, but also freeze the land.
body_header: A substantial celestial crystal is lining up with the sun, turning its light red as ruby and diminishing its heat.
body_lore: The sun is still as bright as ever, but its rays no longer convey their comforting heat. As the welcome warmth withdraws from your realm, snow and ice change your lands to the Evercold. Your citizens seek shelter in their homes, but your troops suffer from sudden blizzards.
button_0: "Winter has come."
title: Rays of Winter

body_footer: Will you drive back the snow that claimed your lands? Or will you draw power from the fleeting rays of winter?
body_header: Finally, the sun releases the cosmic crystal from its pull. Warm rays of sunlight wash over your domain.
body_lore: Yet the otherworldly cold that affected your world is not easily dismissed. But while the icy plains of permafrost formed, your mages have studied the celestial object that caused the solar disruption. They ensure you they can harness some of the crystal's magical properties for your own benefit.
button_0: Thaw the snow with your inner magical fire. <mana></mana>
button_1: Learn the power of <eventColor>{EventEnchantment}</eventColor> from the retreating winter.
button_2: Apply the clarity offered by the cold to gain new insights. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_3: Fortunately, the winter never invaded your territory.
title: Rays of Winter: Aftermath

body_footer: All spellcasting and sources of magic are suppressed while the stars remain dimmed.
body_header: This night, the cries of scholars and mages echo throughout your realm: all the stars' lights have been snuffed!
body_lore: No one comprehends what caused this event, yet your wizards and sorcerers inform you that they sense a dampening of their magical powers. You know they speak true: you felt it too.
button_0: "The sword is mightier than the wand. For now."
title: Astral Eclipse

body_footer: A new age of wizarding and enchantment dawns. Let the magic flow freely from your fingers once again.
body_header: Behold! The stars are reignited one by one! The astral eclipse draws to an end.
body_lore: Within a single night, all the constellations have returned to the firmament. In the distance, flashes of dazzling lights evidence the glee of your mages, who too have discovered the return of their powers.
button_0: "My sorcerous spark returns at last."
title: Astral Eclipse: Aftermath

body_footer: Those slain in combat are imperiled by this curse: to serve the masters of those they fight. In undeath.
body_header: Once, an ancient curse created the Undead on another world. Its echo now encroaches from the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> and envelops your world.
body_lore: The eldritch nebula, dubbed <hyperlink>Melenis's</hyperlink> Kiss by seers, imprints a shared dream on the soldiers of your realm. A dream of menacing hunger and endless waking. A promise of unrelenting thralldom at the mercy of your rivals.
button_0: "A double-edged sword. My troops must be vigilant."
button_1: "They believe I am involved in this? How quaint. How delightful."
button_2: "Curse <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> and her foul tricks!"
title: Melenis's Kiss

body_footer: Now you must decide how to deal with the shadowy chaos it left in its wake.
body_header: <hyperlink>Astral winds</hyperlink> finally carry away [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MelenisLoreConcept]Melenis[/hyperlink] Kiss back into the cosmos, where it will surely haunt another world.
body_lore: Yet its presence undeniably left its stain on your world. Troops who fought loyally for their masters were forced to join the ranks of their sworn enemies. For some Godir, Melenis's Kiss was a blessing. For others, their downfall.
button_0: "My glory <influence></influence> rejects these abominations. They must be destroyed!" <unit></unit>
button_1: "These creatures are imperfect. My dark spells <souls></souls> will mend them."
button_2: "I've grown quite fond of my involuntary conscripts. They may stay."
button_3: Melenis's Kiss did not gift you any Zombies.
title: Melenis's Kiss: Aftermath

body_footer: Volcanic blaze and ruin wreak havoc in your realm. Can you and your armies withstand the heat?
body_header: Astrologers warn you that the sun inches towards your world. Every hour, the fiery orb in the heavens seems larger.
body_lore: They suspect <hyperlink>Yaka</hyperlink>, or one of his overconfident acolytes, is performing an improvident ritual. Global temperatures rise until a flashpoint is reached. Volcanoes violently appear across the world, burning lush lands and renewable resources.
button_0: "If I can keep a cool head, we won't get burned."
button_1: "This wasn't my doing... this time."
button_2: "<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> will burn for this treachery!"
title: Sunstruck Eruptions

body_footer: Will you invest in the restoration of your lands? Or do you suffer the desolation to gain other boons?
body_header: You notice that the days become cooler again, as the sun finally abates its encroachment on your world.
body_lore: The flaming chaos withdraws as the sun reclaims its usual position in the cosmos. Its warmth is once again comforting instead of scorching. Yet the devastation that the sun caused leaves a smoldering mark on your lands.
button_0: Reseed <food></food> the desolated wastelands to restore their lush and life.
button_1: Extract the secrets of <eventColor>{EventEnchantment}</eventColor> from the dying volcanoes.
button_2: "I will conquer <influence></influence> this realm, regardless of any wastelands within my domain."
button_3: Wastelands do not tarnish your domain.
title: Sunstruck Eruptions: Aftermath

body_footer: While builders benefit from the malleable stone, defensive structures suddenly easily crumble!
body_header: The conjunction of the <matter></matter> <hyperlink>Materium Affinity</hyperlink> world <eventColor>{RandomMateriumWorld}</eventColor> and the <arcana></arcana> <hyperlink>Astral Affinity</hyperlink> world <eventColor>{RandomAstralWorld}</eventColor> was foretold. That prophecy is now fulfilled.
body_lore: Magical properties seep into rock and stone, making both more compliant and easier to manipulate. However, the augmented stone cannot discern between chisel and battering ram. Masonry that was built to last now gladly yields to the striking sword.
button_0: A time for building and breaking comes.
title: Stirring Stone Conjunction

body_footer: Will you welcome these stone-faced allies, or shall you bind them within your walls?
body_header: As the Stirring Stone conjunction nears its end, stone and earth are magically stirred from their slumber and begin to move.
body_lore: From within city walls, <<m:EventUnit>> are trying to break free. Binding these spirits to your service is easily achieved, but their release will cause the obliteration of the <hyperlink>Stone walls</hyperlink> that birthed them.
button_0: "A simple sleep enchantment <mana></mana> will keep my walls intact."
button_1: "<<Cm:EventUnit>> <unit></unit> are worth more to me than stone walls."
button_2: "Stone bends to my will. One <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> <unit></unit> won't destroy the walls."
button_3: "It's a good thing I don't have any Stone Walls."
title: Stirring Stone Conjunction: Aftermath

body_footer: The Colossus Moon reigns supreme. Shores cannot contain the seas and thunderstorms flood the lands.
body_header: The full moon draws closer to your world. Its pull on the oceans climbs to unprecedented levels.
body_lore: This is a moon unlike any you've seen before. It glows like a white-hot steel shield. Soon, salty waves stir with such violence that they wash over beaches and cliffs alike. Storm clouds black as ink form over the seas and deluge the continents, their burdens spilling on the saturated surface of the realm.
button_0: "Thunderbolts and lightning do not frighten me."
title: Colossus Moon

body_footer: Can you use these new swamps to your benefit? Or will you erase the scars of the thunderstorms?
body_header: The Colossus Moon finally seems satisfied with the destruction it wrought on the world. It has begun to wane.
