body_lore: Scouts confirm your presumptions. Many provinces on the coast have turned into Swamps after being flooded by the torrential barrages that the thunderstorms delivered.
button_0: Drain new swamps in your domain using earth, wood, and stone. <production></production>
button_2: Learn the secrets of <eventColor>{EventEnchantment}</eventColor> from the thunderous onslaught.
button_3: "The downpour made the lands more fertile. <food></food> My cities will grow."
button_4: Swamps never flooded your domain.
title: Colossus Moon: Aftermath

body_footer: Even though their strikes inflict less damage, your <hyperlink>warriors</hyperlink> will have no trouble meeting your enemies in combat.
body_header: Half of the stars that make up the fabled great sword in the constellation of Ja'Vasqa's Charge have disappeared!
body_lore: The nimble Tigran Warlord represented in the constellation now appears to brandish a short sword. Your warriors feel quickened by the cosmic phenomenon and report a surge in stamina and agility. They may move across the battlefield more deftly, at the expense of brute strength.
button_0: "Charge forth on the wings of victory, my warriors!"
title: Sign Of The Vanguard

body_footer: Some <hyperlink>warriors</hyperlink> delight in the return of their martial strength, while others miss their increased agility. What did you prefer?
body_header: Ja'Vasqa's great sword has been celestially reforged. The stars have returned to complete the constellation.
body_lore: Warriors leading the charge discover that their normal stamina has been restored. Fortunately, the strength in their arms also returned. The time of bolting across the battlefield like a gale of fury has passed. Or has it?
button_0: "My magical talents <mana></mana> may make their haste permanent."
button_3: Perform a blood sacrifice to gain the enchantment.
button_4: "I prefer my warriors strong, not swift."
title: Sign Of The Vanguard: Aftermath

body_footer: Proud <hyperlink>mages</hyperlink> and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPPORT_UNIT]healers[/hyperlink] stand taller than ever before, now that their power is surging. Their decreased speed clearly worries them not.
body_header: The star that represents the "staff gem" in the constellation of Anon's Ascent gleams as bright as the waxing moon.
body_lore: Those who normally tend to the wounded or who empower warriors from afar, sense a hidden power burning inside them. They grow more potent, but the magnitude of their magical might weighs them down.
button_0: "May they ruin their enemies before they reach them."
title: Sign Of The Lumbering Staff

body_footer: <hyperlink>Mages</hyperlink> and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPPORT_UNIT]soothers[/hyperlink] vainly inspect their hands, which yesterday wielded such great magical force. They lament their tempering. Do you?
body_header: Your astrologers had already predicted it: the luminous star in Anon's Ascent returned to its original brightness.
body_lore: While <<m:EventUnit>> wail about the loss of their powers, warriors are keen to point out that they have not disappeared, but merely returned to their original strength.
button_0: "Keeping my mages empowered deserves a personal investment of magic." <mana></mana>
button_2: Perform a blood sacrifice to gain the enchantment.
button_3: "I favor their mobility returning. A slow mage is a dead mage."
title: Sign Of The Lumbering Staff: Aftermath

body_footer: As a servant of <hyperlink>Order</hyperlink>, you are compelled to foster the dawn of this Lodestar. Will you obey your duty?
body_header: A new light has appeared in the heavens. Only you seem to be able to see its gleam.
body_lore: Engulfed by the light of this new star, its peace and purpose fill your spirit: this Lodestar will soon reveal itself to the rest of this world. It shall be a new True North for the allies of Order and Zeal. Let all those who serve its tenets bask in its glorious rays and grow stronger.
button_0: "My inner holy fire <mana></mana> will brighten the star when it comes!"
button_2: "A fast <food></food> shall empower the Lodestar's presence!"
button_3: "I should not interfere with the natural order of the cosmos."
title: <order></order> Dawn of the Lodestar: Foreshadowing

body_footer: The Lodestar has dawned, and it brightly ushers in an age of <hyperlink>Order</hyperlink> and Zeal.
body_header: The world basks in the warm light of a new rising star, quickly dubbed the Lodestar.
body_lore: The Lodestar guides those who follow the path of <hyperlink>Order</hyperlink>: The Celestial, the Faithful, and the Zealous. Vassals feel their hearts and spirits bolstered and launch crusades against their Lords' enemies. Faint harmonies of a chorus resonate in the very foundations of the world, causing all who hear it to quiver.
button_0: "May its dawn nourish my plans."
button_2: "What fanatic bolstered the Lodestar's light, I wonder."
button_3: "As it is was destined to be."
title: <order></order> Dawn of the Lodestar

boosted_by_other:
The Lodestar guides those who follow the path of Order: The Celestial, the Faithful, and the Zealous. Vassals feel their hearts and spirits bolstered and launch crusades against their Lords' enemies. Faint harmonies of a chorus resonate in the very foundations of the world, causing all who hear it to quiver.

Those who stray from the path find themselves Condemned, yet it seems a force other than the Lodestar is to blame for that.

body_footer: After the dawn comes the setting of the Lodestar. The world has grown slightly darker, and less orderly.
body_header: The golden gleam of the Lodestar is slowly fading, and its servants lament its diminishing.
body_lore: Yet the Lodestar's rays permanently touched the hearts of those who beheld it, leaving a vulnerability in their spirits.
button_0: "The light fades. The memory lasts."
button_1: "The truth about <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> is finally brought to light!"
button_2: "I pray the world reveled in the blessings I orchestrated."
title: <order></order> Dawn of the Lodestar: Aftermath

boosted_by_other:
Yet the Lodestar's rays permanently touched the hearts of those who beheld it, leaving a vulnerability in their spirits.

As its last light is swallowed by dark clouds, a celestial whisper carries the name of one of the Heralds of the Lodestar: "{EventPlayer}!"

body_footer: Is this an opportunity? Dare you drive the drifting of the ley lines and summon uncertainty within the world's magic?
body_header: Something feels off. You feel pulled at. Peeled. An inner resonance is off-key. A shift is imminent.
body_lore: You invoke your deep <hyperlink>Astral</hyperlink> attunement to divine the origin of the entrancing sensation. The electrifying realization follows soon: a storm between stars flows over the ley lines of this world. The sorcerous channels of the world are about to drift from their arcane positions. You also sense that this drifting will cause magic to become less predictable.
button_0: "My curiosity ordains such an enchanting <mana></mana> experiment!"
button_2: "My scholars <knowledge></knowledge> will uncover how to further imbalance the ley lines."
button_3: "The ley lines must drift on the Astral flows unhindered."
title: <arcana></arcana> Drifting Ley Lines: Foreshadowing

body_footer: <hyperlink>Astral</hyperlink> tremors ripple through the realms. It is an era in which little is certain, apart from magic growing unpredictable.
body_header: The magical coherence of the world is at risk. The ley lines, the fundamental <hyperlink>Astral</hyperlink> alignment, stray from their courses.
body_lore: A turbulence in the cosmos washes over the deep Astral channels that bind and guide the magic to this world. Your troops are shocked to discover that they have become conduits for lightning magic. Ethereal beings unwittingly amplify magical energies and all spells burst from potency.
button_0: "This world will never be the same again."
button_2: "Which power-crazed wizard delivers us this misery?"
button_3: "Promising results, so far!"
title: <arcana></arcana> Drifting Ley Lines

boosted_by_other:
A turbulence in the cosmos washes over the deep Astral channels that bind and guide the magic to this world. Your troops are shocked to discover that they have become conduits for lightning magic. Ethereal beings unwittingly amplify magical energies and all spells burst from potency.

A mad wizard has been abetting the drifting of the ley lines, causing magical strikes to extend beyond their intended reach.

body_footer: Centuries shall pass before the ley lines' drifting fully halts. Until then, all must suffer the unpredictable shape of magic.
body_header: Having strayed far from their original alignments, the drift of the ley lines is slowing down. <hyperlink>Astral</hyperlink> stability is re-emerging.
body_lore: Spells are less volatile, and the empowering tether that ethereal beings shared the Astral energies is severed. Yet the susceptibility to electrifying magics did not dissipate from your troops.
button_0: "My ambitions require stability too, to lay it on the line."
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>? <<Cp:EventPlayer>> crossed a line with this plot."
button_2: "I will suffer this outcome as an absolute win."
title: <arcana></arcana> Drifting Ley Lines: Aftermath

boosted_by_other:
Spells are less volatile, and the empowering tether that ethereal beings shared with the Astral energies is severed. Yet the susceptibility to electrifying magics did not dissipate from your troops.

And the extended reach of magical strikes also persists. Your scholars inform you that {EventPlayer} is one of those who intentionally pushed the ley lines.

body_footer: Will you embrace your dark desires and torment these fresh recruits? Or are you able to transcend your eldritch instincts?
body_header: Newly recruited <<m:EventUnitB>> are brought before you for inspection. Suddenly, a sense of malicious disgust engulfs you.
body_lore: The eras spent in the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink> scarred your mind. You are unable to look at your subjects and see people. You only see... repulsive miscreants. Their miserable lives in your eldritch hands. "[runicfont]Kill[/runicfont]...", a familiar voice whispers in the back of your mind. You close your eyes and fail to suppress a yearning smile.
button_0: Subject the <<m:EventUnitB>> to your unmitigated carnage. <evilact></evilact>
button_1: Meat <food></food> for your followers in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. <evilact></evilact>
button_2: Maim the <<m:EventUnitB>> and carve a bloody trophy from their remains. <item></item>
button_3: Mold the <<m:EventUnitB>> into a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>. <unit></unit>
button_4: Suppress the instinct <goodact></goodact> and leave the <<m:EventUnitB>> alone. <unit></unit>
title: The Willing Flesh

body_footer: The voices are all vying for your patronage. Which voice shall be yours?
body_header: The voices are back. Relentless allies that accompanied you in the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink> and beyond, before you lost your mind.
body_lore: They were like old friends... and nemeses. They pushed you to greatness, and dragged you down. Yet, beyond the name-calling, the flattery, the tantrums, and the gossip, their words fed you the means to survive when your mind shattered and you became <hyperlink>Lost</hyperlink>. Eventually, you regained your consciousness, your sense of self, and with it... the voices returned. To occupy your mind once again.
button_0: "There is one master above all. Everything can be bought." <gold></gold>
button_1: "To achieve serenity, all must be of one mind... mine." <happiness></happiness>
button_2: "Chaos and ruin are ultimate. Any and all will shatter." <unitprod></unitprod>
button_3: "Life only feeds the Void. Monuments adorn it." <structureprod></structureprod>
button_4: "Incantatum Omnia. [runicfont]Et mana, Magus."[/runicfont] <mana></mana>
button_5: "Rise! Grow! Reproduce! Until our bodies blanket all of existence!" <population></population>
button_6: "Only through dark decay, is truth revealed." <knowledge></knowledge>
button_7: "[runicfont]Bring me Thralls![/runicfont]" <thralls></thralls>
button_8: The silent one, whose terrible thoughts <evilact></evilact> invoke strength.
button_9: Silence the voices. You require none. <influence></influence>
title: The Voices

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> is unmistakably a sinister lair. Nevertheless, pragmatic diplomacy produces unparalleled rewards! Can you afford the dire price of peace?
body_header: "[runicfont]Halt![/runicfont]" The gargantuan <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of the <hyperlink>Umbral Dwelling</hyperlink> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> ominously slinks from the shadows to address you with malicious intent.
body_lore: The <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> houses many surprises and secrets, and the dwelling of the <eventColor>{EventHouseRace}</eventColor> is one of them. "[runicfont]Purpose[/runicfont]?" tries the <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor>, but <<p:EventHouseLord>> then utters: "You... Here why?" A serendipitous glimmer in the dark betrays the presence of warriors in the shadows behind your host, ready to lunge forward at the first sign of weakness.
title: Meeting Tenebrous <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>

button_0: Vow to destroy them! <rs_war></rs_war> <goodact></goodact>

body_footer: To earn the allegiance of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>, you must bleed. Metaphorically, if you're lucky. And <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> won't abide offerings previously given.
body_header: You seek to improve your standing with the <eventColor>{EventHouseRace}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>, and with <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> in particular.
body_lore: The wicked <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> silently waits for you to speak. Ages of servitude at the behest of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> has made <<o:EventHouseLord>> people leery of authority. "[runicfont]Pitiful[/runicfont]," <<p:EventHouseLord>> barks at <<o:EventHouseLord>> lackeys, who promptly produce cramped wheezes: forgotten echoes of chuckles.
title: Enshrouded Loyalty

body_footer: If there is to be peace between your people and the <eventColor>{EventHouseRace}</eventColor>, they will expect a tribute of significant value.
body_header: You seek to negotiate peace with the nefarious <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor>. Your strenuous war with <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> has gone on long enough.
body_lore: The concept of peace is all but alien to the <eventColor>{EventHouseRace}</eventColor>, who are habitually inclined to inflict pain and incite strife in the shadowed plains of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> observes you, intrigued by your request. "[runicfont]Peace?[/runicfont]" <<Co:EventHouseLord>> guttural cackle makes you wonder if you should feel offended..
button_8: Continue your vow to destroy them.
title: A Precarious Truce

body_footer: Whatever you seek to gain from your covenant with <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>, <hyperlink>Umbral Dwelling</hyperlink> customs expect a willing sacrifice, lest you antagonize them.
body_header: You receive troublesome word from <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>. A hunger grows within the <eventColor>{EventHouseRace}</eventColor> that requires sating.
body_lore: Yet this hunger is not driven by famine. They crave a blood-letting. A precious offering, given freely and willingly, that they may consume. Taking delight in the destruction of something you hold dear. Such is the way of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>.
button_1: Make them pay for their impertinence. <war></war>
title: Eldritch Hunger

body_footer: The creatures cautiously await a response. A bribe shan't make these umbrous guards leave. That will require something more... vicious.
body_header: As your army approaches a <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, they discover that the shadowy shapes of warriors from <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> already occupy the landmark.
body_lore: Despite the darkness, the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> has spotted your troops long before they could even discern the silhouette of the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>. Your warriors hear the unnerving murmurs of the Umbral creatures. "[runicfont]Food[/runicfont]," asks one. "[runicfont]Likely[/runicfont]," responds the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, <<o:EventStackLeader>> maw twisted into some sort of ghastly grimace.
button_8: "Their eldritch reign ends here!" <war></war>
title: Shadowy Encounters

body_footer: The shadows push you to find yourself, to find what defines you. It is important. You are important. Who were you? How were you trapped?
body_header: You slumber. There is nothing, only darkness. You cannot move. Who are you? Who were you? It does not matter...
body_lore: Then, the darkness shifts and something nudges your mind. Its touch is dark and cold, but gentle. It pushes you to remember, to wake up. The shadows shift and an image forms: a mighty <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. Is that you? The image changes, showing a cage. It disturbs you, but you are not sure why... Are you trapped?
button_0: I was bringing order to the realms, but was betrayed. <Order></Order>
button_1: I was looking for a new challenge... It won. <Chaos></Chaos>
button_10: I was defeated and became Lost in the Void. Something... found me.
button_2: I was looking for knowledge at the edge of the Astral Sea... I found it. <Arcana></Arcana>
button_3: I was bringing life to forgotten worlds... but found myself drained. <Nature></Nature>
button_4: I was looking for riches to uncover... But my greed was my downfall. <Matter></Matter>
button_5: I was uncovering secrets that were hidden in the darkness... I found this. <Shadow></Shadow>
button_6: (Dragon) I was forming new realms in my image... But was pulled into the darkness.
button_7: (Ascended Champion) I was leading my people towards new horizons... But was captured.
button_8: (Wizard King) I was searching for ways to enhance my power... But I found only doom.
button_9: (Eldritch Ruler) I remember nothing of my past life, if I had any. Perhaps... I was born here.
title: Eldritch Prison

body_footer: The man realizes he is in the presence of a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, and quickly bows. "You are <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, are you not? We must go. It is not safe here."
body_header: The memory fades, but the disturbing feeling remains. You become aware that you cannot move your body. You struggle against the eldritch chains that dare to bind you.
body_lore:
Then you hear the echo of a voice. Vague at first, then louder. "...certain this is <>? Be careful!"
Light pierces through the darkness around you as you break from your prison. You blink against the light as a man gazes up at you. "Torches be praised. <> is with us!"
button_0: "Very well. We should go."
button_1: "Where am I?"
button_2: "Who are you?"
button_3: "Why should I join you?"
title: Awakening

body_footer: "Umbral Demons lurk around us, and the Wardens of 51 have eyes everywhere. We must find sanctuary."
body_header: You ask where you are, and the man answers: "You are in the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> of 51, a realm long forgotten by the light of creation."
body_lore: "51 is a prison realm and breeding grounds for <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink>, ruled by two ruthless Wardens. You, like many of us, are imprisoned here. You breaking from your <hyperlink>Cage of Binding</hyperlink> brings us hope... but we need much more than hope to be free again."
button_0: "Who are you?"
button_1: "Why should I join you?"
button_2: "Very well. We should go."
button_3: "Umbral Demons?"

body_footer: "There are others like us throughout the realm. But they need a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> to unite and lead them."
body_header: The man grins and bows with a quick flourish. "My name is <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{RogueHero.LastName}</eventColor> to some."
body_lore: "Like many, I was imprisoned by the rulers of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>, then enslaved, and forgotten. I managed to break my chains, only to realize that the realm itself is but another cage. I vowed to claim my freedom and found other kindred souls. We made plans upon plans of liberation... But we lack the <hyperlink>spark</hyperlink> to make it happen. This is why I went looking for someone to lead us."
button_0: "Where am I?"
button_1: "Why should I join you?"
button_2: "Very well. We should go."
title: The Syron Thief

body_footer: "We have searched long for a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> who can lead us to freedom. I certainly hope our search ends today."
body_header: The man grimaces. "Why join us? If anything, you are as trapped here as the rest of us, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>."
body_lore: "I was led here by your <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor>, who joined us after escaping their bonds, and convinced us of your potential. You broke from your <hyperlink>Cage of Binding</hyperlink>, but I have also seen enough <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> fall to corruption to know that without us, you will not make it out of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, nor <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>, no matter what powers you alone possess."
button_0: "Where am I?"
button_1: "Who are you?"
button_2: "Very well. We should go."
title: Revolution

body_footer: "One can only leave the Umbral Abyss through <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. I have marked the one I used before, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>."
body_header: You move to start your travels, but <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> stops you for one more moment. "We are currently in the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, a place that poisons the body and mind."
body_lore: "You will find that remaining here for long is lethal, even for a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>. We should leave, fast, but my enterprising nature obligates me to share that many treasures are hidden in the darkness. In my experience it pays to be cautious, but opportunistic."
button_0: "Onwards, then."
title: Safe Haven

body_footer: "I was asked to escort you to our haven. Please, follow me. Your people await."
body_header: You step through the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and feel a breeze of cold air. <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> breathes in deeply. "We made it."
body_lore: You feel as though a weight is lifted from your shoulders. Looking back, you notice a shift in the darkness behind you, as if your very shadow is relieved to be free from the corruption of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. Before you can investigate further, <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> digs into a pile of rocks to reveal a bag of gold and crystals. "We cannot rest yet, the Wardens of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> patrol the realm."
button_0: "Very well, point me there."
title: Out of the Abyss

body_footer: "It pays to destroy them sooner rather than later... But we currently barely have the power to defend ourselves, let alone to take the battle to the source."
body_header: As you move through the oppressive darkness of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> stops you. "Be wary," <<p:RogueHero>> whispers. "We approach a <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>."
body_lore: "This one slumbers, but it is heavily guarded and if we linger in its territory, we will surely be attacked. I snuck past when I searched for your prison. Over time, it will grow and expand its influence." <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> glares at the writhing nest at the edge of your vision.
button_0: "I will keep that in mind."
title: Slumbering Corruption

body_footer: <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> bows with a flourish. "Your throne awaits, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. Get settled, for tomorrow the true fight for our freedom begins."
body_header: Through a passage between mountains you enter a strangely welcoming sanctuary. Barren ashlands and <<m:EventGate>> make way for forests and a city, hidden in a valley.
body_lore: As you wander further, you see people emerge from hiding spots, some of whom you recognize as your very own <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor>. They gather excitedly as you approach. "We provide sanctuary for any wandering soul," <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> explains. "Your people are resilient and loyal. They helped turn our haven into a city, and notified me of your prison. Your arrival gives them hope."
button_0: Claim your city and your throne.
title: Safe Haven: Aftermath

body_footer: "<<m:SanctuaryStructure>> will take some time and resources to build, but the rewards are considerable. Who knows, you may yet conquer the darkness itself!"
body_header: As you continue your journey through the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, you see a light in the distance. <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> looks up and smiles. "A <eventColor>{SanctuaryStructure}</eventColor>!"
body_lore: "Sanctuaries like these help one remember that light exists, even in the darkest depths of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. They can only be built on top of beacons of light. I asked some of us to build one whilst we searched for your prison, they must have finished it recently. Claiming these yields many rewards, including respite from the <eventColor>{ShadowSickness}</eventColor>."
button_0: "Very well."
title: Beacon of Light

body_footer: "To truly liberate our people, we must open the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. It is the only way to freedom."
body_header: After settling in your newly found capital <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, you are once again approached by <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Greetings, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. I hope you find our sanctuary accommodating."
body_lore: "You will find many of your people here are escaped prisoners of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>. Through time, we have gathered here, building up our strengths, protected by a mountain ridge the Wardens of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> rarely traverse. We gathered information about a hidden <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink>, used by the Harbinger of Urrath herself not long ago. With you, we have hopes to claim it and see the light again."
button_0: "I will find and open this World Gate. Tell me how."
title: Gate of Tharru'Cath

body_footer: You, <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor>, and all the other allies you found along the way step through the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>. The <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> awaits!
body_header: You made your way to the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>, and your people eagerly await your blessing to step through.
body_lore: On the precipice of victory, <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> joins you. "I have learned many things during my imprisonment on <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>. The <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> has grown in the shadows, evolving through the corruption of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>. Lithyl Nightweaver has left with a considerable host of <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink>, threatening <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> and <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>. I must warn my people of this invasion. But for now, the sweet scent of freedom awaits beyond the <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink>!"
button_0: Onward!
title: <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> Victory: To the Stars

werlac_path: You step through the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>, leaving the despairing allies you betrayed behind.

The prisoners of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> await your blessing to step through the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>... But then you release its control to <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor>.

Shocked, the prisoners of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> see <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor> almost dismissively signal <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> to attack. As you look back at the resulting carnage, you see one face in the crowd, fuming with hatred: <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor>. He shouts something at you, but it does not matter. <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor> smiles slyly as you pass <<P:Werlac>>: "Have fun in <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. The Harbinger of Urrath can use an ally like you."

body_footer: "It is a pity to see your potential go to waste. If only you had joined the right side of history..."
body_header: Perhaps surprisingly, you meet an Elf who is not in chains. In fact, <eventColor>{Werlac.TitleName}</eventColor> seems to control many guards on this realm.
body_lore: <<Cp:Werlac>> appraises you. "So this is the face of the rebellion my scouts warned me about. It is unfortunate to meet under these circumstances, but as a Warden of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> I can not allow insurrection. Soon, you and all the <hyperlink>Wizard Kings</hyperlink> who dismissed me will be nothing but a thrall under the rule of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> and I."
button_1: "I will fight for my freedom if I must."
button_4: "Wait, perhaps we can come to an agreement..."
title: The <eventColor>{Werlac.Title}</eventColor>

body_footer: "Cease your struggle. Harmony awaits. Surrender your mind to us, or fade into oblivion."
body_header: You have heard the dreaded <eventColor>{InsectoidRace}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> chitter about. Now, you meet their leader, the <eventColor>{Insectoid.Title}</eventColor>.
body_lore: <eventColor>{Insectoid.TitleName}</eventColor> speaks with hisses and clicks. "We have heard of the escaped prisoner who brings dissonance to our harmony. Return to your <hyperlink>Cage of Binding</hyperlink> and join us after your glorious metamorphosis. You will become one with us and Urrath, and we will please <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> and His Harbinger. The trill of our exaltation will resonate within the entire <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>."
button_1: "I will fight for my freedom if I must."
button_4: "I am looking to join you in the glory of Urrath. Please, allow me to join your hive."
title: The <eventColor>{Insectoid.Title}</eventColor>

body_footer: By defeating <eventColor>{Werlac.Name}</eventColor>, you have claimed the necessary knowledge about the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> to the 000004. Some of his former followers even kneel before you and ask to join you.
body_header: <eventColor>{Werlac.TitleName}</eventColor> was defeated. His cult followers scatter, suddenly insecure about their future on <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: One of the <eventColor>{WerlacRace}</eventColor> speaks up. "By besting our <eventColor>{Werlac.Title}</eventColor>, did this <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> not prove <<p:PlayerLeader>> is worthy of our reverence? Will it not be the <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> who leads us to our rightful glory?" The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> leads you to Werlac's treasury. "Please, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, take whatever you please. May <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> bless your prowess!"
button_1: "Anyone is free to join <population></population> the right side of history." <happiness></happiness>
button_4: "You may leave, but you will not be forgiven <influence></influence> for how you treated the prisoners of Tharru'Cath."
button_5: "You will die as entertainment <happiness></happiness> for the people you imprisoned." <evilact></evilact>
button_6: "Prove yourself by fighting on my side." <unit></unit>
title: Shadowborn Undone

body_footer: Your troops turn to you as the <eventColor>{InsectoidRace}</eventColor> flee, lost without their hive mind. "What should we do with them, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>?"
body_header: You have defeated the insectoid armies of the <eventColor>{Insectoid.Title}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>. <<Co:Insectoid>> voice echoes through the last of <<o:Insectoid>> fallen armies as they scatter.
body_lore:
"We are but one of many tendrils of Urrath. We will return to his embrace, where we will be reborn anew. Then you will see what a fool you are to fight the inevitable."
As the voices fade, you notice magic reverberates through them. The secret about the {EventStructure} to the {WorldGateWonder}.
button_1: "Leave them be. They are of no importance."
button_4: "Squash them <unitprod></unitprod> like the insects they are." <gold></gold>
button_5: "Catch <unitprod></unitprod> and study <knowledge></knowledge> them. Their connection to Urrath may be of use."
button_6: "Catch <unitprod></unitprod> them and put them to work <production></production> in our city. They seem obedient enough."
title: The <eventColor>{Insectoid.Title}</eventColor>: Defeated

body_footer: <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> is under your control and your victory is secured. Do you uphold your pact with <eventColor>{Werlac.TitleName}</eventColor>?
body_header: You have conquered the prison realm of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>. With the realm under your control, freeing your allies and opening the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor> becomes trivial.
body_lore: You lead your people through the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, and valiantly assault the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>. At its precipice, however, you are approached by none other than <eventColor>{Werlac.TitleName}</eventColor>. You made a deal with <<P:Werlac>> and <<p:Werlac>> expects you to uphold it. The agreement was this: your freedom, for control of the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>.
button_0: Deny <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor>, free <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>.
button_2: Uphold your pact: give control of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> to <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor>.
title: <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> Victory: A Shadowborn Deal

body_footer: GO for it
body_header: Now you can go to the World Gate
body_lore: Good luck
button_0: I will
title: Collected all Parts

body_footer: "I heard you are looking for the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>. As a war-drone, I was tasked with guarding the potential locations of its connected <eventColor>{EventGate}</eventColor>. I would join the liberation of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>, if you would have me."
body_header: You have fought your way to the mysterious defector of the <eventColor>{InsectoidRace}</eventColor>. <<Cp:BattleHero>> lowers her <eventColor>{BattleHeroWeapon}</eventColor> when <<p:BattleHero>> notices you.
body_lore: "You- you are <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>?" <<Cp:BattleHero>> wipes ichor from <<o:BattleHero>> brow. "Thank the hive, I thought I would die here. They call me <eventColor>{BattleHero.FirstName}</eventColor>. I was a war-drone for the <eventColor>{Insectoid.Title}</eventColor>, until my head was smashed in and I stopped hearing the song of the hive. I realized the truth about <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>, and what His corruption does to my people."
button_1: "Join me and we will fight for freedom." <unit></unit>
button_4: "I have no use for <eventColor>{InsectoidRace}</eventColor>. Share your information and leave."
title: Meeting the <eventColor>{BattleHero.Title}</eventColor>

body_footer: "Lastly, only the Wardens of 9, <eventColor>{Werlac.Name}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Insectoid.Name}</eventColor>, know how to open the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> to the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>."
body_header: <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> laughs awkwardly. "Unfortunately, both the location and means to activate the <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink> are currently unknown to us... But we know where to learn more."
body_lore: "Our legends speak of an elusive wizard, who traveled here long ago. His fate is unknown, but he may have left knowledge behind. Next to that, we have heard rumors of desertion within the ranks of the <eventColor>{Insectoid.Title}</eventColor>; they may prove informative allies. Furthermore, we have heard of a prisoner who was used to control the <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink>."
button_0: "I will investigate these leads."
title: Finding the World Gate

body_footer: <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> points to the distance. "We have all we need to open the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> to the <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink>. Please, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, lead us to freedom."
body_header: You have collected everything necessary to activate the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>. You are once again joined by <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "This is the closest I have ever been to being free from this wretched realm. I must contain myself to not celebrate before we step through, but oh, I can already feel the sun on my face..." <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> sighs. "More and more people break their chains and gather in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, their stories echo through <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>. They have faith, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>, in you."
button_0: "To the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>!"
title: Finding the World Gate: Aftermath

body_footer: "I am no stranger to the call of this Abyss. I will not give in."
body_header: You encounter an echo of the wizard who resided here. As his magic nestles in your mind, you see the shadowy reflection of a wizened human man.
body_lore: "I find myself in the oppressive darkness of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> once more, something I sacrificed everything to avoid. But I must reacquaint myself, if only to save her. I must find her. If not in my name, then the name of the fallen King Saridas, and her daughter who fought so valiantly in her name."
button_0: Continue your search.
title: Scattered Memory: Return to the Abyss

body_footer: The image fades, with a last thought. "I hear whispers as I rest, even with my protective wards. Yet, I worry only for her..."
body_header: You find another echo of the elusive wizard, in front of a <hyperlink>Cage of Binding</hyperlink>. He is interrogating the being within.
body_lore: "I managed to make contact with Lithyl Nightweaver, the invader of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>. I confirmed it was she who killed Saridas... and took Julia. I can sense her madness. To know that Sundren herself captured this monster fills me with pride. But, as time and space shift around us, I realize this Lithyl Nightweaver is the only hope I have for freeing Julia."
button_0: Continue your search.
title: Scattered Memory: Fallen Herald

body_footer: "If there is a chance for Julia to return, must I not take it? Lithyl was defeated before, surely I can do so again."
body_header: You find another echo of the elusive wizard. His thoughts become more and more desperate. "Lithyl is toying with me."
body_lore:
"With all my might, I cannot break her. Even the Cage of Binding seems to only empower and feed her madness. Meanwhile, I am tormented by visions of Julia, trapped in the Umbral Abyss... Lithyl only smiles."

"Perhaps I can offer a pact... Julia's freedom, for Lithyl's. I would be a fool to suggest it, but..."
button_0: Continue your search.
title: Scattered Memories: Pact of Corruption

body_footer: <<Cg:Expression,Werlac>> turns cold. "Our pact, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>. Hand the 9 to me, and I will grant you and your <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor> your freedom."
body_header: You enter the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> into the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, to make your way to the 9. A familiar voice contacts you, however, heard by all others in your realm.
body_lore:
"The {PlayerLeader.Title} of Tharru'Cath, So eager to claim <> freedom..." {Werlac.TitleName} says. "Did your allies really think it was this easy? We made an agreement, remember?"
{RogueHero.FirstName} speaks up. "What is that snake talking about? What agreement?"
{Werlac.FirstName} laughs heartily. "The naive {RogueHero.Title} of {RealmName}, of course <> does not know."
button_0: Honor the deal you made with <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor>, betray the prisoners of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>.
button_1: Refuse to give up the 9, break your pact with Werlac.
title: A Deal is a Deal

body_footer: "I will pry control of the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor> from your void-cursed hands, if it is the last thing that I do. I am not letting you leave. Curse you and your name, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>!"
body_header: You honor your deal with <eventColor>{Werlac.Name}</eventColor>, and hand over any control of the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor> to him. <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> approaches, fuming. "How could you?!"
body_lore: "I thought you a savior, a hero, a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> to revere! I would have followed you through the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> and back, and you- you sold us. You sold me, and my freedom. I will never forgive you."
button_0: "So be it."
title: Betrayal

body_footer: "You will grant me control of the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>, by choice or by force."
body_header: You deny <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor> his due of the deal you made. <<Cp:Werlac>> smiles coldly. "Unfortunate. But not unexpected."
body_lore: <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor> scoffs. "I bent the entire ruling class of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> to my will, did you really think you could outmaneuver me so effortlessly? If you refuse to uphold our covenant, I will force your hand."
button_0: "So be it."
title: Trust and the Untrustworthy

body_footer: "Incite your rebellion. Then, when you are at the precipice of escape, you will hand control of the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor> to me. I will crush the resistance of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>, and grant you and your <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor> your freedom."
body_header: <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor> chuckles. "A deal? What would you have to offer me? Unless..."
body_lore: "Yours is not the first insurgence I have had to hunt down. The embers of revolution have proven very elusive—especially to those witless <eventColor>{InsectoidRace}</eventColor>, and I know my strengths lie beyond direct confrontation. You, it seems, have gathered the rebellion around you. Impressive, and useful. I can order my <eventColor>{WerlacRace}</eventColor> to be blind to your... mischief."
button_0: "Sounds like a deal, <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor>."
button_1: "I would be a fool to trust one like you. I decline."
title: Douse the Embers

body_footer: You step through the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>, leaving the despairing allies you betrayed behind.
body_header: Your allies eagerly await your blessing to step through the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>... But then you release its control to <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: Shocked, the prisoners of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> see <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor> almost dismissively signal <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> to attack. As you look back at the resulting carnage, you see one face in the crowd, fuming with hatred: <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor>. He shouts something at you, but it does not matter. <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor> smiles slyly as you pass <<P:Werlac>>: "Have fun in <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. The Harbinger of Urrath can use an ally like you."
button_0: The Astral Sea awaits!
title: <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> Victory: Burning Bridges

body_footer: You, <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor>, and all the other allies you found along the way step through the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>. The <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> awaits!
body_header: You made your way to the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>, and your people eagerly await your blessing to step through.
body_lore: You have learned many disturbing things during your imprisonment on <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>. The <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> has grown in the shadows, evolving through the corruption of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>. Lithyl Nightweaver has left with a considerable host of <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink>, threatening <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> and <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>. But for now, the sweet scent of freedom awaits beyond the <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink>. With you as their <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, your <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor> can overcome everything, even the Umbral Abyss itself.
button_0: Onward!
title: <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> Victory: To the Stars

body_footer: The <hyperlink>Maer</hyperlink> residing within the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> has been corrupted by the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. Something, or someone, needs to interrupt their song.
body_header: As you draw near the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you feel a humming resonate within you. An eerily beautiful song draws you in.
body_lore: In the shadows, you see the floating movements of a graceful being with a long tail. It almost looks like a mermaid... It lures you in, invites you into the darkness. Any attempts to communicate are cut short as the being suddenly screams in frustration, and you, too, feel their pain. They are trapped here, and something festers inside them.
button_0: "If we must fight you to free you, we will!"
button_1: Flee the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
button_2: Protect your troops <mana></mana> from her corrupted song.
title: Song of Corruption

body_footer: <eventColor>{MageHero.FirstName}</eventColor> sighs. "Thank you, for severing me from <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>. Once, I used my song to open the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>. I can do so again, for you."
body_header: You have defeated the <hyperlink>Maer</hyperlink> within the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. <<Cp:MageHero>> sinks to the ground, <<o:MageHero>> song turning to sobs.
body_lore: <<Cp:MageHero>> speaks softly, hugging <<r:MageHero>>: "Long ago I met a wizard, wandering the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, searching for his lost love. I guided him to the answer: a monster called Lithyl... He freed his love, and lost himself. I helped his Elven queen to escape, but I was captured... My song, twisted... I never saw either of them again."
button_0: "I can use a Maer like you on my side." <unit></unit>
button_1: "You should find a place to hide until the World Gate is open."
title: Song of Corruption: Aftermath

body_footer: Your path to freedom is blocked only by <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> and <<o:EnemyUnit>> troops.
body_header: Your <hyperlink><<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> enters the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>, an ancient structure that was once built by the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>.
body_lore: Remarkably untouched by the corruption of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, its latent magic hums through any who enter. As <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> approaches the dormant <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink> in its center, however, <<o:EventHero>> path is blocked by <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor>. With a grim expression, <<p:EnemyUnit>> readies <<o:EnemyUnit>> weapon. Any chance of negotiation has passed.
button_0: "None will stand in my way! Attack!"
button_1: Leave the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
title: The <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>

hero_is_playerle: You enter the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>, an ancient structure that was once built by the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>.

Remarkably untouched by the corruption of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, its latent magic hums through any who enter. As you approach the dormant <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink> in its center, however, your path is blocked by a <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor>. With a grim expression, <<p:EnemyUnit>> readies <<o:EnemyUnit>> weapon. Any chance of negotiation has passed.

body_footer: Finally, the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor> is in your hands, and freedom awaits.
body_header: You have defeated the final resistance at the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>. Without further thought you move past them.
body_lore: Through all you have learned, you recite the incantation <eventColor>{MageHero}</eventColor> has taught you. An arcane humming fills the halls around you as the <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink> activates. Recalling the echoes of the wizard of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, you set its destination, <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>. Energies of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> converge as the World Gate opens.
button_0: Claim your freedom.
title: The <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>: Opened

werlac_path: Finally, the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor> is delivered to <eventColor>{Werlac.TitleName}</eventColor>, and your freedom awaits.
You have defeated <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor>. As <<p:EnemyUnit>> sinks to <<o:EnemyUnit>> knees, you pass <<P:EnemyUnit>> and move to the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>.

Through all you have learned, you teach <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor> the incantation <eventColor>{MageHero}</eventColor> has taught you. An arcane humming fills the halls around you as the <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink> activates. Recalling the echoes of the wizard of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, you recite its destination, <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>. Energies of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> converge as the World Gate opens.

body_footer: It seems like you will have to fight your way to the possible defector of the <eventColor>{InsectoidRace}</eventColor>.
body_header: When your troops enter the oppressive darkness of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> once more, you hear the sounds of battle in the distance.
body_lore: It is too dark to see, but you can hear the screeches of what sounds like <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> fighting... other Umbral Demons? This must be the desertion within the ranks of <eventColor>{Insectoid.TitleName}</eventColor>, that <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> spoke of.
button_0: Nothing will stand in the way of my freedom.
title: The <eventColor>{BattleHero.Title}</eventColor>

body_footer: Collecting the echoes of the elusive wizard may provide information on the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>.
body_header: As your troops enter the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, they feel shivers running down their spines. Powerful magics linger here.
body_lore: One of your troops returns from the darkness and reports a broken <hyperlink>Cage of Binding</hyperlink> in the middle of a spiraling landscape. Around it, traces of powerful magic can be seen, shimmering in the dark. "We could not interpret the magics, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, but they seem to be echoes of the wizard who traveled here."
button_0: "I will piece this story together."
title: Scattered Memories

body_footer: "Some Umbral Demons gather in city-like dwellings. My people say they can even be communicated with, though I never tried."
body_header: "You don't know what <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> are?" The man frowns in disbelief. "I suppose you were caged for a long time..."
body_lore:
"Umbral Demons are corrupted monsters, twisted through the prolonged influence of the Umbral Abyss. I believe they were once known as Shadow Demons."
You notice a shift in the darkness nearby, almost as if it is angered by these words. The man does not seem to notice and continues: "Umbral Demons devour any bane you place on them. But they fear light, fire, and the power of spirit."
button_0: "Where am I?"
button_1: "Who are you?"
button_2: "Very well. We should go."
button_3: "Why should I join you?"
title: Umbral Demons

body_footer:
"I saw the way Julia looked at me as she fled. Can't she see? All I did was for her... I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry..."
[runicfont]Embrace Urrath, Merlin. Give into your darkness.[/runicfont]
body_header: You find the final echo. The thoughts are rushed and barely coherent. "I was a fool to think I could outplay <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>."
body_lore: "As I freed Lithyl, I realized my mistake. Julia, forgive me, I doomed us all. Already I sense our location shift, and I can feel <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> in my mind like I did the All-Devourer, tearing at my memories, searching for secrets of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>... No. I will not let it. I will shatter my mind before Urrath claims it."
button_0: Dig deeper into the corruption. [runicfont]Gaze into the Abyss.[/runicfont]
button_1: Memorize the knowledge of World Gates and shake off the corruption on your soul.
title: Shattered Memories: [runicfont]Into the Void[/runicfont]

body_footer: <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> is under your control and your victory is secured.
body_header: You have conquered the prison realm of <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>. With the realm under your control, freeing your allies and opening the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor> becomes trivial.
body_lore: You lead your people through the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, and valiantly travel to the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>. <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> approaches you. "Freedom awaits, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. I admit, I did not expect you to make it this far. I must rejoin my people so we can continue our fight against <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>. But know that you made an ally here, today."
button_2: "To the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>!"
title: <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor> Conquered

body_footer: <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> was wounded, but has escaped death. It will take some time for <<P:RogueHero>> to regain <<o:RogueHero>> strength.
body_header: <eventColor>{RogueHero.Name}</eventColor> was defeated in battle under your command!
body_lore: Through effort, luck or something else entirely, <<p:RogueHero>> managed to survive the onslaught and made it back to safety. <<Cp:RogueHero>> coughs before wiping the dirt of <<o:RogueHero>> tunic. "I have withstood many hardships on <eventColor>{RealmName}</eventColor>. It shall not claim me yet."
button_0: So be it.
title: <eventColor>{RogueHero}</eventColor> Defeated

body_footer: The shadows around you deepen as you feel the dark presence intensify. Do you reach out, or do you recoil?
body_header: Your quest for the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor> progresses. As the days pass, you cannot shake the feeling that you are being watched.
body_lore:
You often have to suppress the urge to look behind you. Is it the Umbral Abyss, affecting your mind? Or is it something more?

One night whilst you are alone, the darkness seems even deeper than before. The scent of death and decay weighs on you like a suffocating blanket.
button_0: Gaze into the darkness, ignoring any feeling of discomfort.
button_1: The shadows are no stranger to me, I welcome them.
button_2: Ignore the feeling, you are above silly superstition.
title: Dark Presence

body_footer: You realize you stand before an avatar of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowConcept]Shadow[/hyperlink]. Cold, deathly tendrils reach out to you. You...
body_header: Dark energies coalesce in your shadow as it rises above you. The pressure of mortality weighs heavy on you, even as a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>.
body_lore: You realize this is the presence that has been with you from the start, since you were locked inside your <hyperlink>Cage of Binding</hyperlink>. It shifts, showing you a vision of tendrils from beyond the void, corrupting death, decay and rebirth. A force beyond darkness, beyond <hyperlink>Shadow</hyperlink>. You whisper its name: <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>, and the entity shimmers in cold frustration. It cannot fight that which taints its very essence. But you can.
button_0: ...Accept its blessing in your fight against Urrath. <knowledge></knowledge> <unit></unit>
button_1: ...Reject its influence.
title: Vision of Shadows

body_footer: <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor> smirks. "Soon you will be forgotten, like all the others who attempted to thwart me before."
body_header: <eventColor>{Werlac.FirstName}</eventColor> gazes upon you with pure disdain. "<rs_war></rs_war> <hyperlink>War</hyperlink> it is."
body_lore: "You are not the first 'chosen one' I have needed to crush, nor will you be the last. Do you really think I allowed you to roam around freely? My spies are everywhere. I think it is time that they emerge."
button_1: "Have at thee!"
title: Wrath of the Shadowborn

body_footer: "Be careful, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>. The Umbral Abyss changes any being within. Let us hope this prisoner is not fully lost, yet."
body_header: Your troops enter the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> through the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> that should lead to the imprisoned being mentioned by <eventColor>{RogueHero}</eventColor>.
body_lore: Immediately, you notice a haunting melody, echoing through the darkness. Your troops are pulled towards the center of the area, some even need to be restrained from swimming across the waters. "It is rare to find water in the Umbral Abyss," <eventColor>{RogueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> says. "If this being was truly used to open the <eventColor>{WorldGateWonder}</eventColor>, they must be powerful."
button_0: Investigate the area.
title: A Haunting Melody

body_footer: This bastion of light was overrun by darkness. Its corrupted inhabitants screech as they approach from the shadows...
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> comes across the ruins of a castle in the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, which show signs of a terrible war long past.
body_lore: There is no way this was built by <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink>. As <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> studies an etching of a ritual in the broken wall, <<p:EventHero>> realizes this was once a bastion for the <hyperlink>Syrons</hyperlink> of old, who stood against the darkness of the Umbral Abyss until it overwhelmed them. Abandoned weapons and the signs of battle scar the hallways.
button_0: "We will hold this fortress! To arms!"
button_1: Invoke the Syron ritual to protect your army against the darkness.
button_2: Flee the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
button_3: "By the creed of the <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, we shall hold fast!"
button_4: Use your connection to the shadow to strengthen your troops against it.
button_5: [runicfont]Feed, brothers[/runicfont]—Appease the Umbral Demons through a sacrifice of thralls. <thralls></thralls>
title: Fallen Bastion

hero_is_playerle: You come across the ruins of a castle in the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, which show signs of a terrible war long past.

There is no way this was built by <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink>. As you study an etching of a ritual in the broken wall, you realize this was once a bastion for the <hyperlink>Syrons</hyperlink> of old, who stood against the darkness of the Umbral Abyss until it overwhelmed them. Abandoned weapons and the signs of battle scar the hallways.

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> picks up the object and the gloom of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> lessens. <<Co:EventHero>> army stands in awe, awaiting orders.
body_header: After dealing with the <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink>, <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> and <<o:EventHero>> army investigate the ruins further.
body_lore: Deep within the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, more details about what could have been the final moments of the battle are revealed. As the onslaught of <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> continued, the <hyperlink>Syrons</hyperlink> were driven further into the bastion. At the scene of the Syrons' final stand, <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> finds an object, untainted by the <hyperlink>Umbral Corruption</hyperlink>. It shimmers in the dark, emitting a faint, warm light.
button_0: Take everything you can. <gold></gold>. The fallen have no use for it.
button_1: Share your victory and the spoils with the realm. <influence></influence>
button_2: Study <knowledge></knowledge> the history of the Syrons and their ancient protections.
button_3: The fallen shall serve me, one way or the other. <evilact></evilact>
button_4: Honor the fallen Syrons through an ancient funeral rite. <goodact></goodact>
title: Fallen Bastion: Aftermath

hero_is_playerle: You pick up the object and the gloom of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> lessens. Your army stands in awe, awaiting orders.
After dealing with the <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink>, you and your army investigate the ruins further.

Deep within the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, more details about what could have been the final moments of the battle are revealed. As the onslaught of <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> continued, the <hyperlink>Syrons</hyperlink> were driven further into the bastion. At the scene of the Syrons' final stand, You find an object, untainted by the <hyperlink>Umbral Corruption</hyperlink>. It shimmers in the dark, emitting a faint, warm light.

body_footer: The Cage of Binding seems to be the source of arcane energies running through the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
body_header: As <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> travels through the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, shadows make way for a looming <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, its pinnacle covered by darkness.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> ventures inside, and quickly notices chaotic energies, coalescing in the center of the spire. There, an eldritch being slumbers, neither dead nor alive, captured in a <hyperlink>Cage of Binding</hyperlink> in an unending state of un-being. A prison, or an abandoned experiment? <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> gather around the cage, feeding on its arcane energies.
button_0: Free the eldritch being, prepare for battle!
button_1: Use your knowledge of the arcane to weaken the eldritch being before freeing it.
button_2: Leave the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
button_3: Use your knowledge of the arcane to weaken the eldritch being before freeing it.
button_5: [runicfont]You are safe[/runicfont]—Invoke a Rite of appeasement before opening the Cage.
title: Dark Arcana

hero_is_playerle: As you travel through the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, shadows make way for a looming <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, its pinnacle covered by darkness.

You venture inside, and quickly notice chaotic energies, coalescing in the center of the spire. There, an eldritch being slumbers, neither dead nor alive, captured in a <hyperlink>Cage of Binding</hyperlink> in an unending state of un-being. A prison, or an abandoned experiment? <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> gather around the cage, feeding on its arcane energies.

body_footer: "I thank you for freeing me from my prison. I have much to atone for. Anything you ask, I will provide."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> freed the caged Eldritch Sovereign, and after a moment of rage and confusion, <<p:EnemyUnit>> rises once more.
body_lore: "After all my attempts, it takes a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> to free me from the grasp of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>... I apologize for my rage. A <hyperlink>Cage of Binding</hyperlink>, it does things to the mind. Long ago, I attempted to make a deal with dark forces. Soon, I realized my mistake... but when I attempted to break free, I was captured in this cursed cage."
button_0: Ask <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> to bind some Umbral Demons to your will.
button_1: Use the Cage of Binding once more to drain and kill <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>. <evilact></evilact>
button_2: Ask <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to spread the word of your deeds, here. <influence></influence>
button_3: "Your freedom is the only reward I need." <goodact></goodact>
title: Dark Arcana: Aftermath

hero_is_playerle: You freed the caged Eldritch Sovereign, and after a moment of rage and confusion, <<p:EnemyUnit>> rises once more.

body_footer: Will you leave the strange monsters to their terrorizing or attack them?
body_header: As your troops move to attack the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> collection of <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink>, the enemy squeals and submits.
body_lore: Undulating flesh and writhing tentacles weave around in a grotesque show of panic while your weapons surround the group of eldritch horrors from the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. While terrifying in aspect, these beings seem to have no fight in them. At least not for you...
button_0: "Put them down!"
button_1: Allow them to flee and spread their terror in a rampage across the realm. <evilact></evilact>
button_2: Satiate their hunger <mana></mana> so they will not harm anyone and allow them to flee. <goodact></goodact>
button_3: [runicfont]Join me[/runicfont] - Claim them as your thralls. <thralls></thralls>
title: Umbral Submission

body_footer: Stories of charmed people straying into the mists and disappearing spread as an evil rumor. Ere long, there may be no one left to defend.
body_header: As the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> lay siege to <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, an uncanny song creeps into the streets and homes of the <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
"Come, our children, come out to play
To Duatha we stride with glee
No last escape, no place to flee
The Duathadae on rainbow's ends
Open their mouths, raise their hands
Forever you will stay"
button_0: "I trust my troops to end this siege in time!"
button_2: "Let us open the gates <siegehealthdamage></siegehealthdamage> to lure the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> into our defensive lines!"
button_3: "Fey magic is a curious enigma... to study and suppress."
button_4: "I am the only one whose whispers may mess with the minds of my subjects!"
button_5: "Within these mighty walls <garrison></garrison>, no one shall get in or out!"
title: Alluring Voices

final_raid: To the dismay of your <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor>, even this terrifying song is charming the people, leading them outside the walls to a gruesome fate.

"Come, naughty children, come out to cry
From Duatha you took with grief
Our {EventRelicName}, accursed thieves
Your own {EventBodyPart} we will tear out, mangle
Grind down, carve up, gouge and strangle
Forever you will die"
ilandra_waking_sleep:
"Wake now, children, open your eyes
The Fey would never tell you lies
Follow us through the mist
Where pain and grief cease to exist
Embrace there, children, do not weep
Our Slumbering Queen's eternal sleep."
luth_aerial:
"Come, children, you have naught to fear
There is a land, far from here
Swiftly brought on winds of cheer
To Duatha, where none shall hear
Your screams and cries that ring out clear
In darkness you will die, my dear."
raven_tharic:
"Little children, Tharic calls
Leave your beds, leave your halls
Join the children of Raven
Duatha is their haven
Better to follow Duathadae
Lest your end is nigh."
ventrogh_devourer:
"Heed our voices, hear our song
In Duatha you belong
Beyond the veil, we attest
There's a party, you're the guest
Brought before the wicked beast
When it kills you, we will feast!"

body_footer: Looking behind, you reflect on the hardships on the journey to Arcalot.
body_header: Arcalot, at last! Through clashing front lines and spreading Umbral darkness you have guided your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> into the eye of the storm.
body_lore: The hastily erected city of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> is a testament to the <eventColor>{EventRaceTrait}</eventColor> of your people and a much welcomed shelter. Indeed the area it is overlooking appears to be surprisingly quiet and devoid of <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink>—too quiet perhaps. It is a golden opportunity for everyone to rest before pressing onward towards <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> and her eldritch forces.
button_0: "We battled our way <xp></xp><hp></hp> through waves of Umbral Demons."
button_1: "We were ambushed by a powerful Eldritch Sovereign and I wrested secret knowledge from her."
button_2: "We found hidden passages under the deep shadows of the mountains."
button_3: "We sacrificed many to rescue a fellow Godir <unitHero></unitHero> in need."
button_4: "[runicfont]Humans, Elves, Umbral Demons—they are all thralls![/runicfont]" <thralls></thralls>
title: A Moment of Respite

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> is the general of this invasion. When you finally meet <<P:EventPlayer>>, there will be more at risk than the Battle for <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> itself.
body_header: While your people establish themselves in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, your gaze already turns northwards, to the heart of the invasion.
body_lore: There, at the shores of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, where the Elves once arrived on this world, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> is preparing her eldritch ritual to plunge <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> into darkness. Surrounded by large Umbral hosts and the overwhelming presence of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>, reaching <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> will be perilous. You must learn more about <<o:EventPlayer>> ritual and scout ahead before charging in.
button_0: "She is the herald of Urrath's corruption and must be smote <unitprod></unitprod> in the name of the Archons!"
button_1: "Her powers are admirable, but she lacks respect for the established Godir <mana></mana> of Magehaven."
button_2: "She brought death to my people, and I vow <influence></influence> to avenge them!"
button_3: "Seeking her out can be deadly, but bears a promise of immense rewards <gold></gold>."
button_4: "[runicfont]We are one in the eyes of Urrath.[/runicfont]" <knowledge></knowledge>
title: Shadow of the North

body_footer: Realizing that the fate of this world dangles on a string, your Astral Flows within pulsate violently, threatening to burst open. You channel their raw powers, summoning...
body_header: You have encountered all <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> fighting for Arcalot. While you contemplate the cosmic forces at play, a magic tension is slowly charging your body.
body_lore: <eventColor>{Lithyl}</eventColor> is sacrificing thralls to power up <<o:Lithyl>> eldritch rite. In this <<p:Lithyl>> is aided by <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>, who has become an instrument of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> and its Umbral corruption. Through their ritual they seek to poison the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and corrupt the very essence of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>.
button_0: ...a <eventColor>{NatureUnit}</eventColor>. <nature></nature><unit></unit>
button_2: ...a <eventColor>{ChaosUnit}</eventColor>. <chaos></chaos><unit></unit>
button_3: ...a <eventColor>{OrderUnit}</eventColor>. <order></order><unit></unit>
button_4: ...a <eventColor>{AstralUnit}</eventColor>. <arcana></arcana><unit></unit>
button_5: ...a <eventColor>{MateriumUnit}</eventColor>. <matter></matter><unit></unit>
button_6: ...a <eventColor>{ShadowUnit}</eventColor>. <shadow></shadow><unit></unit>
button_7: [runicfont]A denizen of greatest malice![/runicfont]<unit></unit>
title: Shadow of the North: Aftermath

body_footer: "Before we speak of the darkness ahead, may I hear who so valiantly fought their way into this valley?"
body_header: "This one doesn't seem to be growing any tentacles yet, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.LastName}</eventColor>..." –a distant voice echoes down the <eventColor>{EventGeo}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, before a middle-aged man clad in kingly garments comes into focus.
body_lore: "Well met, friend! I am <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> of the <hyperlink>Covenant</hyperlink>, and this is <eventColor>{Meandor.TitleName}</eventColor>." <<Cp:EventPlayer>> introduces <<o:EventPlayer>> partner, a Dark Elf. "We are glad to see another <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> make it through."
button_0: "I am <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, honored to meet you." <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_1: "Meet <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, bane of the Covenant!" [relationLvl-3/]
button_2: "My name is of no interest to strangers in war."
title: March of the Covenant

body_footer: "Until we can overcome <<ge:defenses,<eventColor>{Lithyl.FirstName}</eventColor>>> we may only delay the ritual by destroying <<o:Lithyl>> thralls before they can be sacrificed."
body_header: "Your fondness for pleasantries in this pressing hour is astonishing, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.LastName}</eventColor>." <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> interrupts the conversation.
body_lore: "Urrath's grasp on Arcalot is strong, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <<p:Meandor>> says, turning to you. "Everyone in the valley who is not protected by the might of a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> has fallen to the Umbral corruption. <eventColor>{Lithyl.FirstName}</eventColor> is harvesting thrall after thrall to power her eldritch ritual. Soon <<p:Lithyl>> will be ready."
button_0: "They lost their souls to the Umbral Abyss."
title: Lost Souls

body_footer: "The foul ritual of <eventColor>{Lithyl.Name}</eventColor> must be stopped," <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> concludes <<o:EventPlayer>> introduction, "for the sake of all forevermore."
body_header: The astral projection of a flying dove announces the peaceful arrival of <eventColor>{EventPlayer.TitleName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "May the light of the <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink> shine upon you in this hour of darkness, brave Athlans," <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> says with a gentle bow. "Long ago, when my people had dwelt in uttermost enthrallment, we found allies on this world to fight alongside till death and victory. Such an oath of friendship shall now be renewed."
button_0: Continue to listen.
title: A Candle in the Dark

body_footer: "First, we only heard that the war of the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> is not going well," <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> says. "Now we are busy fighting the living proof."
body_header: "<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>!" the energetic call of <eventColor>{Meandor.Name}</eventColor> is heard from afar. "You are late."
body_lore: "And you have changed," <<p:Meandor>> adds, eying <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> from top to bottom. "When did the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> convert you? A pity, I always liked your arcane pragmatism. Though I suppose it can help me gain some answers. It has been a long time."
button_0: Continue to listen.
title: Reunification

body_footer: "There is an old pilgrim's path of the <hyperlink>Gloomwatch</hyperlink> well inside the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> of Arcalot. Those who dare to walk it, can find a torch to burn away <<ge:darkness,<eventColor>{Lithyl.FirstName}</eventColor>>>."
body_header: "The <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> responds, "did not convert us, old friend. They are our brothers and forebears; our allies and adversaries; our avengers and judges." <<Cp:EventPlayer>> smiles. "It is complicated."
body_lore:
"In the days of the All-Devourer my enslaved kin had lost even the knowledge of their own legacy. When we turned from hunted to hunters there was much to unveil." {EventPlayer.Name} turns pensive for a moment as if <> is reliving the journey of the {EventRace}.

"We are part of the Gloomwatch now, tending the Dreamers and protecting them from Urrath, the declared enemy of all life."
button_0: "Only a truthful soul can reveal such path into light." <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_1: "We need more than pilgrim's weapons <unitprod></unitprod> to defeat the eldritch hordes of Urrath."
button_2: "What you describe sounds shady at best. I will investigate and watch my back!" [relationLvl-3/]
button_3: "A pilgrim's path inside the Umbral Abyss? You have my attention."
button_4: "[runicfont]Your presence is insulting, serf.[/runicfont]" <thralls></thralls>
title: The Flame of Revelation

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventTome}</eventColor> appears to have chosen to reveal itself to you. Does it judge you worthy? Do you judge it worthy?
body_header: Still deep in thought, you are startled by a sudden burst of fire at the ground below the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
body_lore: Investigating the source, you find a heavy book, inscribed with runes of burning zeal, still smoldering like a Fireforge Stone. It is the <eventColor>{EventTome}</eventColor>! How and why it was hidden here in the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> remains a mystery, but it clearly demonstrates the past exchange of knowledge and magic between the <hyperlink>Gloomwatch</hyperlink> and the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>.
button_0: Take the <eventColor>{EventTome}</eventColor>.<knowledge></knowledge> It is made to fight the Gloom!
button_2: Use the <eventColor>{EventTome}</eventColor> as an offering <knowledge></knowledge> to the true fire-masters of Obbadoth!
button_3: Reject the <eventColor>{EventTome}</eventColor>. Your faith preaches protection, not destruction <goodact></goodact>.
title: The Flame of Revelation: Aftermath

body_footer: "<eventColor>{Lithyl.FirstName}</eventColor> is defiling my kindred's forgotten heritage. I feel it in the bleeding earth, hear it from the weeping trees. Soon <<o:Lithyl>> ritual will be complete."
body_header: Enshrouded within a swarm of butterflies, the graceful figure of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> offers <<o:EventPlayer>> aloof welcome.
body_lore:
"The leaves are falling rapidly this season," <> says, a glint of sorrow resonating in her voice. "Only this winter may last until all sylvan wonders have perished, no return. Is that not so, {PlayerLeader}?"

Then, turning to {Meandor.Name}, <> continues: "It should be no surprise to see your kind arrive second in Arcalot, when the Shad'rai have already dented the enemy lines. Be it Storm Cult, Wizard's Circle, or Covenant, you unerringly choose the feeble side, {Meandor.FirstName}."
