button_0: Await <<ge:reaction,Meandor.FirstName>>.
title: Withering Glory

body_footer: "If you indeed put a dent in the enemy lines, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> concludes, "let us press onward together, instead of lamenting the loss of a battle not fought."
body_header: "Your ability to unsee the long list of <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> failures is astonishing," <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> replies bluntly. "But let's leave these arguments aside while we have a common enemy to fight."
body_lore:
"There must be truth in your words about Elven secrets still buried in Arcalot. Talic's reports of old always left me unsatisfied, though I should not be too surprised after what happened to Raven Tharic." For a moment {Meandor.FirstName} stops, as if lost in thought, <> mental wards allowing a rare glimpse of <> tired mind.

"If it must be," <> continues, firmly again, "we will dig up any remaining mud of House Inioch's past. Whatever it takes to stop {Lithyl.FirstName}."
button_0: "Indeed, the Shad'rai are the ones who will see this war through!" <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_2: "Our enemy's enemies must be our friends, for now..."
button_3: "Trusting a Shad'rai? I'd rather feed my hand to a hungry Magebane." [relationLvl-3/]
title: Truces and Truths

body_footer: "Give in to my calling, give in to the whispers inside." <<Cge:words,EventPlayer.FirstName>> boom violently in your head: "Together we will reshape the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>!"
body_header: With an otherworldly voice, ear-splitting and terrible, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> foretells the beginning of Urrath's Age.
body_lore: "Halt in awe, people of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, and gaze at Urrath's splendor!" <<p:EventPlayer>> calls out, revealing <<o:EventPlayer>> true, eldritch form. "For you too shall be relieved of your mortal flesh and remade in the image of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>! I have witnessed the corruption of Magehaven's <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>. Their petty conflicts will cease to plague the realms once all <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> are one with Us."
button_0: Shut out the voices and pick up arms.
title: The Harbinger of Urrath

body_footer: The <eventColor>{Alfred.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> raises the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>: "Tonight we burn the Umbral hells!"
body_header: "Hear my oath, accursed witch, defiler of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>!" the trembling shout of <eventColor>{Alfred.Name}</eventColor> can be heard.
body_lore:
"I pledge myself to the destruction of the Abyss
To smite the Umbral
To incinerate the Gloom
Until the spawn of Urrath turn to ashes
And the leech seeds of corruption are expunged!"
button_0: Join the battle for Arcalot.
title: A Champion Unleashed

body_footer: "When it is done, there will be no more pain." The mental grip of <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Name}</eventColor> chokes your consciousness. "Bow down to <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>. Inside the Void, the promise of infinite peace resides."
body_header: "So many ambitions. So much suffering." Two sorrowful eyes invade your mind, constricting and eclipsing your very thoughts.
body_lore: "Aye, young apprentice," the voice beyond the eyes continues, while a grizzled hooded figure slowly comes into focus. "Your arrival grieves me for I was once not unlike you. Despair not, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. All things come to an end." From underneath the robe long tenacious tentacles emerge, clutching at the fabrics of your innermost fears.
button_0: Unable to break free you await your doom.
title: Into the Cosmos Never More

body_footer: "My strength is dwindling. I cannot ward the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> forever." <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> shrouds <<r:EventPlayer>> in a veil of glistening foliage. "Best the storm, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>! Save <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>!"
body_header: "Spare us your false wisdom, old man!" A flourishing burst of energy rejuvenates your mind as 51 spreads <<o:EventPlayer>> wings in defiance of <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
"Your tainted roots have not yet reached Athla, and neither will they claim {PlayerLeader}!"

The {EventPlayerType} turns to you. "The situation is dire, {PlayerLeader.Title} of the {EventRace}. {Merlin.Name} and {Lithyl.Name} seek to enter the {EventStructure} and poison Athla in dark communion. Athla is dear to me. She restored my children after Urrath's wrath had laid waste to this world in ages past. She must not die."
button_0: "It will be my honor to fight side by side with an Elder Dragon." <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_2: "Today we join forces for Athla's sake!"
button_3: "I don't need the aid of a glorified lizard to reach my goals!" [relationLvl-3/]
title: The Touch of the Grovetender

body_footer: "To break their eldritch ritual, both <eventColor>{Lithyl.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> must be cast <hyperlink>into the Void</hyperlink>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes. "Enter the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> to lend your strength to <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>! Kindle the light within!"
body_header: "Keeping calm in this baleful hour is no easy feat, is it, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>?" <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> approaches you with a knowing smile.
body_lore:
"We of the Gloomwatch have a saying: from the darkest nights the brightest candles are drawn." {EventPlayer} uncoils an enchanted map depicting the Astral Sea. "This," <> points at a flowing well at the center, "is the Allfather. And these" {EventPlayer.FirstName} gestures towards a number of chalices spread across the map, "are the Dreamers. They are the children of the Allfather and the Gloomwatch has given them service throughout the ages."

Eventually {EventPlayer.FirstName} puts <> finger on a chalice seething with foul ooze: "This is Athla. The poison of {Lithyl} is drowning her in nightmares. If we don't hurry, she will die."
button_0: Understood!
title: Gloom and Glory

no_oneron: To break their eldritch ritual, both <eventColor>{Lithyl.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> must be cast <hyperlink>into the Void</hyperlink>. Only then may <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> be saved from this invasion of Urrath's design.
In this baleful hour, you are reminded of <<g:words,EventPlayer.FirstName>> about the <hyperlink>Gloomwatch</hyperlink> and the <hyperlink>Dreamers</hyperlink>.

To <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> seemed to be more than just a <hyperlink>World Within</hyperlink>. When <<p:EventPlayer>> spoke, it had an almost intimate connotation as if <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> was like a person <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> loved and served. Given the circumstances it seems wisest to seek out the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> yourself. To find answers—and to delay <eventColor>{Lithyl}</eventColor> in <<o:Lithyl>> vile ritual, if you can.

body_footer: As the Umbral darkness languishes, you slowly realize that it is truly over. The battle for Arcalot and <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> is won!
body_header: The earth itself groans and the winds sigh in relief as the eldritch grasp of Urrath's generals on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> is lifted.
body_lore: With <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> banished and <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> fled in madness into the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, the Nightweaver Ritual has been broken and the poisoning of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> averted in time. You can sense the gratitude of the <eventColor>{EventThrallCount}</eventColor> souls that escaped being consumed as a twisted thrall sacrifice. The free people in Arcalot rejoice and praise the names of the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> who ended the abyssal onslaught.
button_0: The tales of this victory will be told in the ages to come.
title: Gloom and Glory: Aftermath

body_footer: "The fight must be taken into the <hyperlink>Umbral</hyperlink>," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> continues. "I know the ways to strike <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> where it hurts. You have the troops..."
body_header: The world around you falls silent, and deep shades shroud your vision. Before you can react, a cold metal blade is pressed against your throat.
body_lore:
"You better not move!" a voice whispers in the darkness and an ice-cold hand touches your temple. "You still seem to be yourself, {PlayerLeader}. Good."

The blade is withdrawn and the sleek figure of {EventHero} reveals <>, still holding {EventItem}. "From the night without end I have returned to lend my aid in this hour of Athlan doom," {EventHero.FirstName} says with a subtle greeting gesture.
button_0: Accept <<g:help,EventHero.FirstName>>. <unit></unit>
button_1: Ask <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> to return to <<o:EventHero>> shadows.
title: Return from the Shadows

body_footer: "What <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> knew, we may never learn," <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> concludes <<o:EventPlayer>> monologue. "But now <<o:Merlin>> knowledge is aiding the enemy. All invaders must die."
body_header: "<eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>!" <<g:cry,EventPlayer.FirstName>> reveals genuine sadness. "Why, old friend? Did I guide you through death to watch you become this?"
body_lore: The aged prince of House Inioch murmurs and gestures as if <<p:EventPlayer>> is mourning the dead. Then <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> opens <<o:EventPlayer>> eyes again, still deep in thought. "Arcalot, the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>—what fools we have been! Diluting our own history. Falling into the ancient web of my father's lies. During the Mending, all Elves gathered in Arcalot. Julia and Saridas channeled the magic of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. They should have seen it. I should have seen it!"
button_0: Leave <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> to <<o:EventPlayer>> thoughts.
title: Elven Flashbacks

body_footer: As the Umbral darkness languishes, you slowly realize that it is truly over. The battle for Arcalot and <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> is won!
body_header: The earth itself groans and the winds sigh in relief as the eldritch grasp of Urrath's generals on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> is lifted.
body_lore: With <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> banished and <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> fled in madness into the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, the Nightweaver Ritual has been broken and the poisoning of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> averted in time. You can sense the gratitude of the <eventColor>{EventThrallCount}</eventColor> souls that escaped being consumed as a twisted thrall sacrifice. The free people in Arcalot rejoice and praise the names of the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> who ended the abyssal onslaught.
button_0: The tales of this victory will be told in the ages to come.
title: Gloom and Glory: Aftermath

body_footer: "I will await you in the darkness, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>!" <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> grows fleshy tendrils to lash at a new-forming Umbral gate, but you sever <<o:EventPlayer>> grasp.
body_header: As the Harbinger of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> is overpowered by mortal weapons and magic blasts, <<o:EventPlayer>> broken body is kept alive by powerful dark magic.
body_lore: "You cannot escape corruption!" <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> shrieks, while <<o:EventPlayer>> shattered limbs perform one last macabre dance. "The voice of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> whispers in every shadow. Its ceaseless embrace stirs every water, soaks every realm. From the darkest depths of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, the <hyperlink>arcane currents</hyperlink> wash its tangled nightmares ashore."
button_0: Banish <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> into the Astral Void.
title: Back to Oblivion

body_footer: In the blink of an eye, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> tears open an astral rift and vanishes into the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. Yet <<o:EventPlayer>> last words still resonate in your mind: "Life is a fallacy. Nothingness is eternal."
body_header: In the face of certain obliteration, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> shows no sign of fear, only sorrow.
body_lore: "Existence is pain," <<p:EventPlayer>> utters slowly, and you notice your own heart grow heavy. "Why must you all prolong it?" A feeling of cold isolation creeps down your spine. You can't shake off the thought that this must be what the erstwhile leader of Evermore's Wizard's Circle is feeling deep inside as the only human emotion left. <<Cp:EventPlayer>> truly is a lost wizard.
button_0: While <<g:escape,EventPlayer.FirstName>> is troublesome, it won't endanger the purging of Arcalot.
title: The Lost Wizard

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> is performing an eldritch rite to bind <eventColor>{Serena}</eventColor> to Urrath's will.
body_header: Words of evil enchantment echo down the mountain slopes surrounding Arcalot. It is the voice of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, calling upon <eventColor>{Serena}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
"Stand still, {Serena.Title} of the {EventRace}.
Listen to the whispers inside.
Embrace Urrath's gift; the seed you have carried since the Second Age.
I have sensed you for long, {Serena.FirstName}.
[runicfont]Join Us, join your kindred souls![/runicfont]"
button_0: Observe the outcome, unable to intervene.
title: Eldritch Rite of Corruption

body_footer: "I look at the Umbral, and I can see its natural beauty. To spread its tangled forests and nurture its sorrowful birdsong will be my life's work."
body_header: With clear agony on <<o:EventPlayer>> face, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> becomes wrapped in eldritch lashes. When <<o:EventPlayer>> body becomes visible again, <<p:EventPlayer>> is tainted by the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "I hear you, sister, herald of the one truthful voice," <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> says, opening her eyes again. "Since the touch of the All-Devourer, I had walked as if in a false dream. [runicfont]Only now, my destiny is fulfilled.[/runicfont]"
button_0: <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> has lost <<o:EventPlayer>> sanity. <<Cp:EventPlayer>> is with the enemy now.
title: The Mark of the All-Devourer

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> is performing an eldritch rite to bind <eventColor>{Alfred}</eventColor> to Urrath's will.
body_header: Words of evil enchantment echo down the mountain slopes surrounding Arcalot. It is the voice of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, calling upon <eventColor>{Alfred}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
"Champion of Athla, temper your hatred.
Since we met, our fates have been intertwined.
Though called adversaries, we have much in common.
The unity you seek I found and propagate.
[runicfont]In Urrath's embrace, everyone will act as one.[/runicfont]"
button_0: Observe the outcome, unable to intervene.
title: Eldritch Rite of Corruption

body_footer: The accumulated fire vortex of the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> is discharged as a lightning bolt of holy flame. In the distance, the surprised cry of <eventColor>{Lithyl}</eventColor> echoes the rumbling thunder.
body_header: With clear agony on <<o:EventPlayer>> face, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> becomes wrapped in eldritch lashes. Then, a sudden burst of flame casts the dark tendrils aside and <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> reappears, fiery and furious.
body_lore: "Burn in hell, insidious locust!" <<p:EventPlayer>> shouts, shrugging off the eldritch ashes still lingering on <<o:EventPlayer>> body. Then <<p:EventPlayer>> raises the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> and inflames its hilt, the flame slowly growing towards the blade's tip. "This one is for my parents!"
button_0: It is time to bring down the <eventColor>{Lithyl.Title}</eventColor>!
title: A Champion's Defiance

body_footer: The corruption of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> binds <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> in nightmares. You can sense her powers dwindling as the glowing shapes—her thoughts?—are fettered by the eldritch lashes.
body_header: Going down the winding stairway beyond the bark of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you become surrounded by an otherworldly light, first dim, then ever more intense until you lose perception of anything else.
body_lore:
As if in a vision, you begin to make out moving, blurry, shapes within the yellow glow: Creatures, people, monumental structures building up and moldering again within instants, short glimpses of forming landscapes. You cannot say whether these ever shifting images are Athla's dreams, memories or previsions of the things to come.

Suddenly, you start noticing black glistening tentacles, hunting the shapes, constricting and strangling anything they can reach. Their dark tangle sprawls violently, threatening to eclipse all light.
button_0: Offer your arcane wealth <mana></mana> to strengthen Athla.
button_1: Bond with Athla <nature></nature> through the deep roots of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
button_2: Banish as many of the eldritch lashes with your arcane might <arcana></arcana> as you can.
button_3: Nourish Athla with your very own astral <hp></hp> essence.
button_4: Leave the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. You can return later.
title: Athla, the Dreamer

body_footer: The shrine's voice falls silent, leaving you to ponder its words in the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>.
body_header: At the base of the first <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, an ancient stone tablet rests. While examining its engravings, the following message resonates in your mind:
body_lore: "In the Days Before, the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> raged and the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> waged their war. When the <hyperlink>World Prison</hyperlink> was built, Irith of the Scrying Fountain foresaw the aftermath of <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> exile and it was ill. For from nothingness the great <hyperlink>Nemesis of the Archons</hyperlink> would be born. Yet few of her kinsmen heeded her warning."
button_0: Continue on the pilgrim's path.
title: The Plate of Foresight

body_footer: The shrine's voice falls silent, leaving you to ponder its words in the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>.
body_header: At the base of the second <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, an ancient stone tablet rests. While examining its engravings, the following message resonates in your mind:
body_lore: "Condemned by the High Council, the disciples of Irith went into hiding. At last they were found, and their judgment was near. But behold! Irith called upon the mercy of the <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink>, and her people grew fishtails and fins of pure aether, escaping into the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. Henceforth they were called the <hyperlink>Maer</hyperlink>."
button_0: Continue on the pilgrim's path.
title: The Plate of Transformation

body_footer: The shrine's voice falls silent, leaving you to ponder its words in the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>.
body_header: At the base of the third <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, an ancient stone tablet rests. While examining its engravings, the following message resonates in your mind:
body_lore: "The shadows of <hyperlink>the great Nemesis</hyperlink> spread, and hence the <hyperlink>Maer</hyperlink> wept unceasing, and their tears deepened the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. They prayed to the <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink>, pleading for a means to fill the Void from whence the Nemesis came. The <hyperlink>Maer</hyperlink> upheld prayers for 100 cycles. Until the coming of the <hyperlink>Dreamers</hyperlink>."
button_0: Continue on the pilgrim's path.
title: The Plate of the Advent

body_footer: The shrine's voice falls silent, leaving you to ponder its words in the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>.
body_header: At the base of the fourth <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, an ancient stone tablet rests. While examining its engravings, the following message resonates in your mind:
body_lore: "In their service and protection of the <hyperlink>Dreamers</hyperlink>, the <hyperlink>Maer</hyperlink> were bound to the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. Yet they knew <hyperlink>the great Nemesis</hyperlink> would threaten the Allfather's children both from the sea and on land. Thus they gathered in large numbers and Irith performed a ritual of great magnificence such that from every second Maer new legs would sprout. Sundered from their brethren, yet still united within the <hyperlink>Gloomwatch</hyperlink>, these <hyperlink>Syrons</hyperlink> walked the <hyperlink>Worlds Within</hyperlink>."
button_0: Continue on the pilgrim's path.
title: The Plate of Sundering

body_footer: The shrine's voice falls silent, leaving you to ponder its words in the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>.
body_header: At the base of the last <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, an ancient stone tablet rests. While examining its engravings, the following message resonates in your mind:
body_lore: "We <hyperlink>Syrons</hyperlink> of Athla's Ward share one oath: to nourish her dreams, fend off nightmares, ease her slumber. To fight <hyperlink>the great Nemesis</hyperlink> and burn all fruits of its corruption. This we pledge to the <hyperlink>Gloomwatch</hyperlink> with our lives—which we forfeit when our word is broken."
button_0: Conclude your pilgrimage of the Gloomwatch.
title: The Plate of Vigil

body_footer: The <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of <hyperlink>Shadow</hyperlink> engraves the words of a dark incantation in your mind. "Use this. Remove the Umbral pests." Its presence fades and <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> returns.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> gasps as shadows pour from <<o:EventHero>> mouth, and <<o:EventHero>> body shifts into a dark, spectral state. When <<p:EventHero>> speaks, <<o:EventHero>> voice is no longer <<o:EventHero>> own.
body_lore: "Then let us not waste more time." The entity possessing <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> moves <<o:EventHero>> hand like a puppet, conjuring the shadow image of an <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. "This infestation," it sighs with the voice of a thousand dead, "must be purged. All vermin must die. The servant of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> will lose focus. We shall be untainted."
button_0: While <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> regains <<o:EventHero>> senses, you prepare your troops for the Umbral Abyss.
title: Unholy Union

body_footer: Spurts of flame turn <<g:body,EventPlayer.FirstName>> to ashes. Yet you can sense <<o:EventPlayer>> soul wandering off to the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>.
body_header: The cities of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> are smoking in Gloom. <<Co:EventPlayer>> people, the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, lie slain or enthralled. Yet <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> will not yield.
body_lore: "Remember this day," <<p:EventPlayer>> shouts, "when the <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Title}</eventColor> fell. When the other brave <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> picked up <<o:EventPlayer>> torch and pushed back the Umbral darkness." <<Cg:skin,EventPlayer.FirstName>> starts to char with black scars smoldering on <<o:EventPlayer>> face. "While you fight, <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> can have no victory!"
button_0: The battle for Arcalot is not over yet!
title: The Broken Champion

body_footer: With a light movement of <<o:EventPlayer>> hands, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> reduces <<r:EventPlayer>> to dust. It seems clear that <<p:EventPlayer>> will try to return to <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>.
body_header: Acknowledging the overwhelming odds, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> lowers <<o:EventPlayer>> guard.
body_lore: "The Umbral darkness is growing. <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> hungers for <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>. Soon it could be over..." The Prince of Shadows looks tired, worn and <<o:EventPlayer>> powers depleted. "It is true that there can be mercy in permanent death." <<Cp:EventPlayer>> examines <<o:EventPlayer>> aged wrists. "Sadly, I cannot allow myself this luxury yet."
button_0: One day, <<o:EventPlayer>> desire for death shall be fulfilled.
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>

body_footer: The light intensifies, until a bright flash takes <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> from this world. You cannot dare say if <<p:EventPlayer>> left or died.
body_header: As the darkness creeps up on <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, ready to devour <<o:EventPlayer>> soul, the <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> prays.
body_lore: "Forgive me, <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, for failing in your defense. <hyperlink>The great Nemesis</hyperlink> was too strong. He is poisoning your dreams. I know he can't corrupt you, but he will kill you." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> becomes engulfed in light, a lone beacon within utter blackness. "Keep resisting! There are others still fighting the shadows, let your dreams guide them to a new dawn!"
button_0: Athla may yet be saved.
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>

body_footer: Entwined in <<o:EventPlayer>> own vegetal shelter, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> leaves this world; a lone flower adorning <<o:EventPlayer>> tomb.
body_header: Within tainted grass and shriveling trees, the blooming powers of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> fade away.
body_lore: "Alas! I weep for this world, for its meadows and forests, its moorlands and jungles. And I weep for you, <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, beloved bringer of fauna and flora." The <eventColor>{EventPlayerType}</eventColor> of Nature spreads <<o:EventPlayer>> wings, spanning a dome around <<o:EventPlayer>> colossal body. Rampant vines start sprouting from the ground, quickly overgrowing the dome.
button_0: Even the <<m:EventPlayerType>> fall before Urrath.
title: The Fall of the Grovetender

body_footer: <<Cg:tears,EventPlayer.FirstName>> disperse into the air, forming a mist clinging to <<o:EventPlayer>> slender figure. At last <<p:EventPlayer>> vanishes within, departing like a true Fey.
body_header: In <<o:EventPlayer>> hour of doom, assailed by horrid nightmares, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> comes to <<o:EventPlayer>> senses.
body_lore: "So many lies. So much treason." The <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> hides <<o:EventPlayer>> face in <<o:EventPlayer>> hands. "Inioch, the All-Devourer, <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>—I have been but a pawn in their games of power. I sowed scorn, hatred, and vengeance. I thought myself a blessing, was I the blight instead?"
button_0: <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> has paid for <<o:EventPlayer>> past wrongs, doubly so.
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>

joined_umbral: Black tentacles lash out from the ground beneath <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, forming an <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. body_header: As the <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> surrounding the destroyed <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> are cast into oblivion, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> steps from the shadows, murmuring a dark incantation:
body_lore:
"Night to night.
Shadow to shadow.
The taint of gloom
Dispersed in Netherice.
To restore the darkness silent."
button_0: Marvel at the sight of the natural shadow plane.
title: Shadow Purge

body_lore: "[runicfont]Only Urrath is eternal. The people of Athla will fall![/runicfont]" The <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> utters what can only be words of menace and mockery. The countless eyes of the <hyperlink>Umbral Dwelling</hyperlink> seem to watch every single step inside their dark domain, while its teeth and spikes crawl on many limbs to prey upon the victims of their corruption.

description: Escape a prison on the edge of the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>. Join a rebellion against its wardens, and lead your people towards freedom. Reveal a plot that will decide the fate of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> and the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>.
hero_01_bio: Zwen'Tywan was raised in the ruins of the Umbral-cursed Syron homelands. Scavenging to survive hardened his soul, and when he was of age he joined the Syron nomads in their fight against the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. Even being captured and taken to Tharru'Cath could not diminish his spark and hatred for everything Umbral.
hero_02_bio: Unde'Xani was hatched as a war-drone of the Shadac'Har, bred to find and destroy any rebellion within Tharru'Cath. She cannot count how many prisoners fell to her axe. It took a blunt force to her head for her connection to the hive-mind to be broken, and to see the corruption of Tharru'Cath and its Wardens.
hero_03_bio:
Azanya was a solitary Maer who encountered a wandering wizard in the far reaches of the Astral Sea. Touched by his story and quest to find his lost love, Azanya eventually guided him to a dark realm named Tharru'Cath. She ignored her urge to flee the threatening darkness until it was too late, and both she and her wizard friend were captured. Since then, the corruption of the Umbral Abyss has twisted her into something she barely recognizes.

The Enthralled Syrons are defined by their imprisonment on Tharru'Cath, where they laid eyes on their mythical ruler for the first time. Through better and worse, they follow their ruler's guiding song with a near-mindless fervor.
name: Tharru'Cath
victory_text: You have claimed the realm of Tharru'Cath. With that, you are free to travel to Magehaven and beyond, whilst the threat from the Umbral Abyss spreads through the Astral Sea.

description: Long ago, during the Second Age, beings born from corruption and darkness flooded the Astral Sea and invaded the world of Athla. After a fierce war the invasion was defeated and the monsters, then known as Shadow Demons, were driven back into the shadows from whence they came.

However, at the edge of the Astral Sea the eternal conflict between the mythical Archons and Shadow Demons raged ever on, and their dark corruption evolved. Even on the realms that were cleansed from their presence, dark scars remained that would never truly heal. Thus this eldritch darkness was given a new name: the Umbral Abyss.

On the precipice between the Void and Astral Sea, a realm lay hidden from the forces of light. Its name was Tharru’Cath, and it had long been lost to the Umbral Abyss. It was where captives and lost souls were imprisoned and twisted into Umbral Demons, and where their ruling Sovereigns prepared to strike back at the Godir of Magehaven.

Tharru’Cath was a place of darkness and abandoned hope. And yet, amidst the despair of its forsaken thralls, whispers of rebellion echoed through the air. They craved only a beacon to guide them; a Godir to release them from their captivity and set ablaze the flames of revolution.

This is the tale of the imprisoned Godir who bore that spark of rebellion.

Thus, in the shadowed depths of Tharru’Cath, the embers of rebellion flared to life and its prisoners rose in unison to claim their freedom, aided by the Endailon of Shadow itself. Despite fierce resistance and betrayal, Magehaven would hear of Tharru’Cath and the dread it harbored.

Thus, in the shadowed depths of Tharru’Cath, the embers of rebellion flared to life and its prisoners rose in unison to claim their freedom. United in their purpose and led by an imprisoned Godir, they broke their chains and opened a World Gate that granted them escape to Magehaven.

Thus, in the shadowed depths of Tharru’Cath, the embers of rebellion flared to life. Yet, before its prisoners could claim their freedom, they were betrayed. The Godir they trusted sold their only hope of escape to the ambitious warden Werlac, who took control of the World Gate to impress his new masters and aid the forces of darkness.

Elsewhere, as the Archons waged eternal war against the Umbral Abyss, rumors echoed through the Astral Sea, speaking of a mythical force of corruption and evil emerging from the depths. Known to be the father of the Umbral Abyss and the origin of Shadow Demons, this enemy of creation itself was called Urrath… And it was steadily drowning out the light.

It was revealed that none other than Lithyl Nightweaver, the first to invade when the World Gates were opened, had broken free from her imprisonment and renewed her ambitions to conquer Athla as a Harbinger of Urrath. Evolved and empowered by the secrets of the Abyss, she and her forces were already on their way…

description: When the warnings from Tharru’Cath reached Magehaven, they were met in quick succession with disbelief, indecision, and then panic. The words of the impending invasion of Athla surged through the Astral Sea like a lightning bolt, and many a Godir native to Athla dropped everything to hurry back to the world’s defense.

Yet they were all doomed. Before strong defenses could be assembled, the Umbral Abyss opened its baleful maw. All across Athla the scars of the Second Age burst asunder and through Umbral Gates unleashed a plague of eldritch demons. Like locusts, this dark tide began to engulf all Athla in a war that knew only corruption and death.

But the heroes of Athla stood strong. Champions and Wizard Kings, Shad’rai and Covenant—they all fought with valor as one, united by this terrible foe. As they battled wave after wave of the Umbral Demons, one fear manifested itself in their minds: what if the worst was yet to come? Where was the leader of this invasion? Where was Lithyl Nightweaver?

At last, scouts returned from the inland of the once blessed continent with evil tidings: in Arcalot, where the Elves of the First Age had set foot on Athla, Lithyl was preparing a world-ending eldritch ritual. To confront her, many Godir marched on Arcalot, hidden in the heart of the Stormpeak Mountains. This is the tale of one such Godir.

Through might and magic, at the brink of doom, Lithyl Nightweaver was banished back into the darkest depths of the Astral Void. Without the leadership of their Sovereigns, the umbral hordes slowly crumbled beneath the combined forces of the Athlan Godir. Victory, at last!

Yet the aftermath of Urrath’s attack brought new sorrows. There were dead to lament, horrors to forget and corrupted to cure. Sundren, wreathed in shadow magic, ventured into the Umbral Abyss to root out the remaining seeds of evil. In her wake followed the other Godir, wary of the dark arts she was embracing, remembering Merlin’s terrible fate.

When the sad tale of Merlin reached Magehaven, it almost got lost in the shuffle of Godir reporting incursions of Urrath’s umbral hordes across the Astral Sea. O’neron and his Syron were besieged by questions about the Archons, yet they would only speak of the Gloomwatch, the Dreamers and the Eternal Conflict. While the battle for Athla was over, the war against Urrath had just begun.
Return to <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> and stand against the sheer force of the Umbral invasion. Meet returning friends and enemies and save a world on the brink of doom.
name: Arcalot

description: Tutorial on the Umbral Abyss
title: The Umbral Abyss

description:
You have entered the Umbral Abyss!
Great rewards and abundant resources await as you explore and conquer within this World Map Layer.
instruction: The Umbral Abyss is a hostile place, inhabited by powerful <hyperlink>Umbral demon</hyperlink> that mass in locations like Umbral Nest <hyperlink>Infestation</hyperlink>. In addition, your <hyperlink>Army</hyperlink> suffer from <hyperlink>Shadow sickness</hyperlink> while within the Umbral abyss.

description: To survive in the Umbral Abyss, you must build <hyperlink>Sanctuary Outpost</hyperlink>, which protect your <hyperlink>Army</hyperlink> from <hyperlink>Shadow sickness</hyperlink>. This will also allow you to annex <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> in the Umbral Abyss.
instruction:
Sanctuary Outpost can only be built on Province with a Beacon of Light. These can be found while exploring the Umbral Abyss and by defeating Umbral Nest Infestation.
Sanctuary Outposts cannot be used to found City.
title: Beacons of Light

description: Tutorial on Umbral Dwellings
title: Umbral Dwellings

description:
You have met an Umbral Dwelling!
These Dwelling are teeming with Umbral demon and spread Gloom as they expand throughout the Umbral Abyss and into the other World Map Layers.
instruction: Therefore they are a threat that should be destroyed. A destroyed Umbral Dwelling will leave behind a <hyperlink>Beacon of Light</hyperlink>.

description:
You can also choose to befriend the Umbral Dwelling in order to gain unique bonuses.
To access these, you must reach an Eldritch Pact. This can be done by increasing Allegiance with the Umbral Dwelling.
instruction:
Umbral Dwelling are always considered Evil 3 unit property and will not accept a Whispering Stones. For Evil Ruler, Allegiance will slowly increase over time.

Fulfilling the Umbral Dwelling's Evil demands will also increase Allegiance.
title: Offerings or destruction

description: Tutorial on Umbral Gates
title: Umbral Gates

description:
You have encountered an Umbral Gate!
Umbral Gates are portals to the Umbral Abyss, which is a layer on the World Map filled with both bounty and peril.
instruction:
Umbral Gates are the only way to access the Umbral Abyss layer. They are spread around on all layers in the World Map.

Within the Umbral Abyss are valuable Resource Node, unique Pickup, and exotic Visit Site.

description: Be aware that terrain near Umbral Gates and in the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> are affected by <hyperlink>Gloom</hyperlink>.
