bio:
In a harsh society where the strongest thrived, Fauster was the weakest chick in a nest of seven. It was his intelligence and social aptitude that helped him survive and even thrive. Fauster has since then more than made up for his physical disadvantage and become the Avian Reavers' Master Alchemist.

The society of Avian Reavers took shape by their ruler's discovery of alchemy and Magelock weaponry, which revolutionized their so-called "primitive" heritage into a society of science and more efficient shows of force. Before, one's tail feathers decided one's social successes. Now the size of their guns and explosions matter most.
name: Coppertalons

bio:
Ever the resourceful and honest dreadnought, Edward Portsmith has been a beacon of hope for many who still uphold the values of the Commonwealth. Since the World Seals on Athla were opened, his legend has only grown. Playing the role of the hero, however, can take its toll on those who don't process their own torment.

The soldiers of the Commonwealth were the first line of defense when the World Seals on Athla were opened, but rather than glorious battle they found themselves adrift in the Astral Sea. After what seems like an eternity of torment, the Commonwealth Remnants struggle to uphold the values they once stood for.
name: Commonwealth Remnants

bio:
A powerful and cunning sorceress of Athla, Laryssa Mirabilis has played a pivotal role in forming the Torchbearers, who revealed a grand conspiracy involving Athla's most powerful nations. After being cast adrift together with her companion Edward Portsmith, Laryssa has used her skills to keep her people alive and their ideals upheld.

Laryssa's followers are those who value the spirit over the letter of the law. Rather than a supreme ruler, the Commonwealth Philosophers are led by a council that Laryssa represents. To these sorcerers, politics and intrigue are like a game of chess, and they take glee in playing it.
name: Commonwealth Philosophers

bio:
With scarlet wings and piercing emerald eyes, Xandera the Phoenix signals her readiness to the potential enemies of her people—which means to everyone. As the Yukara of the Krazura she is believed to be the current reincarnation of the first Krazuran Yukara, possessing great knowledge and wisdom. But the recollections of millennia of hardships and betrayal have rendered her cautious and unforgiving towards outsiders.

Knowledgeable and gifted in the arcane, the Krazura still resemble their distant ancestors in many ways. However ages of isolation within Grexolis have dulled their astral instincts and eroded their civilization, to the point that only a minority of Manuhari's inhabitants still call themselves Krazura.
name: Krazura

bio:
A warlord of high principles and standards, Valery of House Avernos represents the best the fallen Commonwealth once stood for. When dedicated to a cause, her loyalty is beyond question, though after the Shad'rai invasion on Athla she yet has to find a new cause worthy of her vow.

The soldiers of the Commonwealth were the first line of defense when the World Seals on Athla were opened, but rather than glorious battle they found themselves adrift in the Astral Sea. After what seems like an eternity of torment, the Commonwealth Remnants struggle to uphold the values they once stood for.

description: Chaotic energies make emotions run high.<bulletlist><bullet>Each strategic <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>, all <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> gain a stacking negative <hyperlink>Empire Relation</hyperlink> modifier with each other.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Chaotic Influence

description: Waging war is discouraged on this realm.<bulletlist><bullet><casusBelli></casusBelli> <hyperlink>Grievance</hyperlink> are less impactful.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Motivated Truce

description: These are the followers of Alchemy, whose goal is the understanding of all matter through study and experimentation. Their mastery over matter brings prosperity in their society... and victory in their wars.
name: Followers of Alchemy

description: These are the Masters of Antimagic. Be it from a past grudge or just curiosity, they have specialized in suppressing and outright nullifying magical effects.
name: Masters of Antimagic

description: These are the Masters of Constructs, great smiths and engineers that have made manual labor redundant. If it were up to them, only their magnificent war machines would have to set foot on the battlefield.
name: Masters of Constructs

bio: They believe peace and quiet is vital for study, and will fight to ensure that peace and quiet is achieved.
lore: They seek only to be left alone to their studies and will aggressively protect their studious isolation from any disturbances.
name: Hermit Kingdom

description: <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> gain +15% <knowledge></knowledge> <hyperlink>Knowledge</hyperlink>, +15% <food></food> <hyperlink>Food</hyperlink>, +15% <structureprod></structureprod> <hyperlink>Production</hyperlink>, and +20 <happiness></happiness> <hyperlink>City Stability</hyperlink> income when their <hyperlink>Domain</hyperlink> does not border the <hyperlink>Domain</hyperlink> of any other <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> or <hyperlink>Outpost</hyperlink>.
Grievances inflicted by other empires encroaching on your territory are increased by +100%.

bio: They believe everything must be reclaimed and reforged stronger.
lore: They believe anything can be reforged into something better, but before that can be done, it must be reclaimed.
name: Reclaimers

description: Gain <hyperlink><bindingessence></bindingessence> Binding Essence and <bindingfragments></bindingfragments> Fragments</hyperlink> for clearing <hyperlink>Infestation Spawner</hyperlink>, clearing <hyperlink>Ancient Wonder</hyperlink>, <hyperlink>Razing</hyperlink> <hyperlink>City</hyperlink>, and <hyperlink>Pillaging</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink>.

The realm is a lush jungle, surrounded by Astral Void.<bulletlist><bullet>Tropical <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> and forest <hyperlink>Province Feature</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Common[/abilityblue].</bullet><bullet>River <hyperlink>Province Feature</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Common[/abilityblue].</bullet><bullet>Arctic, desert, and desolate <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Rare[/abilityblue].</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Lost Jungle

description: The realm is home to many birds, civilized and wild.<bulletlist><bullet>Avian <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Common[/abilityblue].</bullet><bullet><hyperlink>Great bird nest spawner</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Common[/abilityblue].</bullet><bullet>Bird <hyperlink>Unit</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Common[/abilityblue].</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Birds of Paradise

description: This realm is protected by a powerful <hyperlink>Progenitor golem</hyperlink>, which will periodically launch attacks on any enemies of the native <hyperlink>Krazura</hyperlink>.
name: Warden of Manuhari

description: Every 2 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>, enemy units:<bulletlist><bullet>Sustain <eventColor>{CONDEMNATION_STRIKE_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Spirit}</eventColor> <damageSpirit></damageSpirit> <hyperlink>Spirit Damage</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Have a base <eventColor>{CONDEMN_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of becoming <hyperlink>Condemned</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Condemning Surge

description: When a friendly unit dies, all adjacent enemy units:<bulletlist><bullet>Suffer <eventColor>{MARTYRDOM_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Spirit}</eventColor> <damageSpirit></damageSpirit> <hyperlink>Spirit Damage</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Become <hyperlink>Condemned</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Martyrdom
prop_description: When this unit dies, all adjacent enemy units:<bulletlist><bullet>Suffer <eventColor>{MARTYRDOM_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Spirit}</eventColor> <damageSpirit></damageSpirit> <hyperlink>Spirit Damage</hyperlink></bullet><bullet>Become <hyperlink>Condemned</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>

description: Every 2 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>, a random friendly unit:<bulletlist><bullet>Gains <hyperlink>Bolstered defense</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Gains <hyperlink>Strengthened</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>This effect then applies to adjacent friendly units and is repeated.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Cascading Empowerment

description: Every 2 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>, enemy units:<bulletlist><bullet>Have a base <eventColor>{MISFORTUNE_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of gaining <hyperlink>Misfortune</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Wave of Misfortune

description: Every 2 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>, 3 random enemy units have a:<bulletlist><bullet>Base <eventColor>{GHOSTFIRE_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of being inflicted with <hyperlink>Ghostfire</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Base <eventColor>{ELECTRIFIED_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of being inflicted with <hyperlink>Electrified</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Base <eventColor>{FROZEN_RESISTANCE>ResolvedStrength}</eventColor>% chance of being inflicted with <hyperlink>Frozen</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Elemental Bane

description: Each turn, a random unit of the owner's enemies, and adjacent enemy units:<bulletlist><bullet>Sustain <eventColor>{METEOR_SHOWER_UNIT_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Fire}</eventColor> <damageFire></damageFire> <hyperlink>Fire Damage</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Sustain <eventColor>{METEOR_SHOWER_UNIT_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Physical}</eventColor> <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> <hyperlink>Physical Damage</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Minute Meteors

description: A <hyperlink>Decaying zombie</hyperlink> is summoned next to one of the owner's units every 2 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>.
name: Open Graves

description: Every <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>, 2 random units of the owner's enemies suffer:<bulletlist><bullet><eventColor>{COSMIC_BOLT_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Fire}</eventColor> <damageFire></damageFire> <hyperlink>Fire Damage</hyperlink></bullet><bullet><eventColor>{COSMIC_BOLT_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Shock}</eventColor> <damageLightning></damageLightning> <hyperlink>Lightning Damage</hyperlink></bullet><bullet><eventColor>{COSMIC_BOLT_DAMAGE>DAMAGE>Frost}</eventColor> <damageFrost></damageFrost> <hyperlink>Frost Damage</hyperlink></bullet></bulletlist>
name: Cosmic Bolts

description: A <hyperlink>Gremlin unit</hyperlink> is summoned next to one of the owner's units every 2 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>.

To achieve the Seals Victory, an Empire needs to accumulate enough points from capturing and holding Seals.

Seals are found throughout the world and can be captured at any time. For each seal you have captured, you gain 1 point each Turn. During this time, Seal defenders will spawn every few Turn at one of your claimed Seals and attempt to take back the Seal from your control. If you control more Seals, they will spawn more often.

The Seals Victory has to be enabled by adding one of the Seal Realm Traits.
name: Seals Victory

other: It is clear <<p:<eventColor>{Player.Name}</eventColor>>> is going for a <hyperlink>Seals Victory</hyperlink>. You will either need to prevent <<P:<eventColor>{Player.Name}</eventColor>>> from holding Seals, or hold Seals of your own.
you: As long as you have an army on the Seal, you will earn points towards a <hyperlink>Seals Victory</hyperlink>. Beware, for the Guardians of the Seal will attempt to reclaim it!
Seal Defenders have spawned
You have captured a Seal
You lost a Seal

other: <eventColor>{Player.Name}</eventColor> will currently achieve Seals Victory in 0000045 turns
unmet: An unmet Ruler will currently achieve Seals Victory in 0000045 turns
you: You will currently achieve Seals Victory in 0000045 turns

text: Your ally <eventColor>{OtherPlayer.Name}</eventColor> has activated the dormant World Seals and gained control of them, banishing all other Godir from this realm. After the resulting cataclysms, the people have no choice but to accept you and <eventColor>{OtherPlayer.Name}</eventColor> as their only Godir for Ages to come.

You have activated the dormant World Seals and gained control of them, banishing all other Godir from this realm. After the resulting cataclysms, the people have no choice but to accept you as their sole <eventColor>{OtherPlayer.Title}</eventColor>.

description:
An ancient workshop infested with rampant mechanical creations.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.
lore: Few question the morality of machines, as a weapon is meaningless without its wielder. However, the war machines that emerge from the derelict workshop know no master but their collective directive. Having long outlasted their mortal creators, the workshop and its hosts now have one priority: to feed the engines that drive the creation of their own kind.
name: Derelict Workshop

body_footer: "Each of these locations will bring forth reinforcements for <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor>, for as long as they persist. My advice would be to conquer them, or to prepare defenses before we are overwhelmed."
body_header: A rumbling thunder in the distance announces the arrival of even more adversaries. "That magic..." <eventColor>{Laryssa.FirstName}</eventColor> says. "He is summoning reinforcements."
body_lore: "Before he left, <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor> and I were working on small-scale assembly teleporters, that would allow him to distribute war machines across the realm with haste. He is a very smart man," <eventColor>{Laryssa.FirstName}</eventColor> says somberly. "This has made him a hero on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, and a dangerous adversary to his enemies. Unfortunately, currently that means us."
button_0: "I will consider this."
title: Ironclad Reinforcements

body_footer: "This assembly teleporter is ruined beyond repair, but I can trigger one final charge. What would you use it for, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>?"
body_header: As you claim the last location of the Commonwealth reinforcements, your troops search for the technology that allowed <eventColor>{Edward.Name}</eventColor> to call on troops so consistently.
body_lore: They find the machine in a barracks, destroyed by Edward's troops before they were overrun. <eventColor>{Laryssa.FirstName}</eventColor> sighs. "<eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor> did not want the technology to fall into the wrong hands. This machine is old <hyperlink>Krazura</hyperlink> technology, adapted by <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor> and me. Had I known he would be using it like this..." her voice falters, and she shakes her head.
button_0: "Summon more war machines... on our side!" <unit></unit>
button_1: "Use it to channel more magic from the Astral Sea." <mana></mana>
button_2: "I will study it myself to learn more about teleportation."
title: Ironclad Reinforcements: Aftermath

body_footer: Alfred's expression hardens. "It saddens me to see a hero fall to the fever of war, O <eventColor>{Edward.Title}</eventColor>, but I cannot allow your threats against my allies to go unanswered."
body_header: As Edward's "liberation" of the realm develops, <eventColor>{Alfred.FirstName}</eventColor> attempts to reason with him.
body_lore:
"You were one of the Torchbearers who united the nations of Athla," {Alfred.FirstName} says, "but the Wizards on this realm are not your enemy. We aim to bring unity to Magehaven."
For a moment, {Edward.FirstName} seems distraught, but then anger returns: "Unity? The Commonwealth was unity. Wizards only know deceit. Your mind is poisoned, and I will not allow you to hinder me. Surrender, or perish."
button_0: Stand together with Alfred.
button_1: Do not interfere.
title: Divided We Fall

body_footer: "I hereby proclaim the Sehiran Settlement a failed experiment. Resolve this conflict as you please, whilst I focus on more pressing matters." <eventColor>{Broker.FirstName}</eventColor> ends the conversation.
body_header: A war has broken out between you and another participant of the Sehiran Settlement. <eventColor>{Broker.FirstName}</eventColor> appears. "That did not take long..."
body_lore: "This initiative for peace was an admirable one, but it seems it was doomed to fail. I am not too surprised, but I am disappointed. Meanwhile, the situation in <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink> becomes more and more tense. Something seems to be affecting the minds of all <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>. It was foolish of me to expect you all to resist its effects."
button_0: "Unfortunate."
title: The Sehiran Settlement: Failed

body_footer:
"{Lithyl.FirstName} has returned. My time for vengeance has come!" {Alfred.FirstName} yells.
{Sundren.FirstName} closes her eyes for a moment. "No, {Alfred.FirstName}, I am not her."
body_header: Some time after your conversation with <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor>, you are approached by the other residents on this realm. "Was that who I think it was?!" <eventColor>{Alfred.FirstName}</eventColor> demands to know.
body_lore:
"{Sundren.FirstName}, my niece... why don't you reveal yourself for all of us," {Broker.FirstName} says with a slight smile. "We have so much to talk about."
Reluctantly, {Sundren.FirstName} joins the conversation. Before she can speak she is interrupted by {Alfred.FirstName}. "YOU! Answer me, deceitful elf!" His hand reaches for his weapon in a sudden surge of bloodlust. "You are {Lithyl.TitleName}. You destroyed my kingdom and killed my father and mother!"
button_0: "Explain yourself further, <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor>!"
button_1: Disengage from this conversation.
title: Lithyl, Sundren

body_footer: "I decided to take on the mask of <eventColor>{Lithyl.FirstName}</eventColor>. If <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> could not unify Athla alongside her, perhaps <eventColor>{Lithyl.FirstName}</eventColor> could unify them against her."
body_header: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> sighs. "Yes, I was <eventColor>{Lithyl.Name}</eventColor> and yes, she is the one who invaded <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>. But I was not her, then."
body_lore: "When the <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink> opened, <eventColor>{Lithyl.Name}</eventColor> was one of the first <hyperlink>Wizards</hyperlink> to invade Athla. I stood alongside your parents when she arrived, <eventColor>{Alfred.FirstName}</eventColor>. It was not until decades later that she and I fought in a deadly clash. I re-emerged from the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> victorious, her mask in my hands." Sundren's expression hardens. "When I came back, Athla had returned to its old petty conflicts. None would listen or act on the horrors I had seen."
button_0: Continue to listen.
button_1: "I have heard enough."
title: Lithyl Nightweaver

body_footer: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> turns to you. "I would aid you to sever the influence <hyperlink>Chaos</hyperlink> has over <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor>. He is a hero of Athla, and a friend. He deserves this mercy."
body_header: "For so long I vowed to avenge my father and mother," <eventColor>{Alfred.FirstName}</eventColor> says. "...I don't know what to believe anymore. I... I need time to think."
body_lore:
"You played us all for fools," {Broker.FirstName} says to {Sundren.FirstName}, "a feat I had not expected from anyone on that side of my family."
{Sundren.FirstName} grimaces. "Believe me, Uncle, deceiving you was not the goal, but merely a necessity. I must continue my search for the other Endailon. But first..."
button_0: "If you wish to resolve the problems you have caused, join me here." <unit></unit>
button_1: "It is best you leave. I can resolve this without your aid." <influence></influence>
title: Ends and Means

body_footer: <eventColor>{Sundren.Name}</eventColor> was wounded, but has escaped death. It will take some time for her to regrow her strength.
body_header: <eventColor>{Sundren.TitleName}</eventColor> was defeated in battle under your command!
body_lore: Through effort, luck or something else entirely, she managed to survive the onslaught and made it back to safety, where she appears in a cloud of shadows. She grimaces, a darker expression marking her face before the shadows disappear and she turns to you again. "I have withstood many hardships in the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>. It shall not claim me yet."
button_0: So be it.
title: Sundren Defeated

body_footer: You ponder your options how to best catch the attention of an influential <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> who might be reasoned with.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> ignores your attempts to speak of peace, turning <<o:EventPlayer>> back on your conversation.
body_lore: It is clear that the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> have suffered too much betrayal and aggression from foreigners in the past and the present. Their trust will not easily be won, but there must be someone among their people with at least the willingness to listen to you.
button_0: Send out heralds <influence></influence> to proclaim your good intentions for Manuhari.
button_1: Raise your inner voice <mana></mana> to call out to the mystics of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>.
button_2: Have your cities deliver gifts <production></production>,<unitprod></unitprod>,<food></food> to the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> as tokens of your good will.
button_3: Befriend the birds of Manuhari to win them as messengers with the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>.
button_4: None of these options are worth the effort.
title: Voice of Reason

body_footer: "I trust your words of peace, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> concludes, "but the <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Title}</eventColor> will not easily be persuaded. There might, however, be a way..."
body_header: Speaking with a melodic voice, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> is requesting audience with you, the <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
"I have heard of your good intentions, {PlayerLeader}. Allow me to welcome you and your {PlayerRace} on Manuhari." {EventHero.FirstName} performs an elaborate series of wing beats. "You must excuse the {EventPlayer.Title}. <> is wise beyond comprehension, but the memories from millennia of betrayal and suffering can be a burden on <>."

"I am just a simple counselor. But now that the Everdark has ended, my people will need to relearn to trust and cooperate with foreigners—or we will perish in this changed world, where the stars of the Sky Beyond are rearranged."
button_0: Listen to what <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> proposes.
title: Voice of Reason: Aftermath

body_footer: You will need to stay attentive and form your own opinion. Whether you seek to quench this war or fan it, your actions will define the fate of Manuhari.
body_header: Having seen the realm and heard more about the ongoing conflict, you reflect on the situation at hand.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> and the <eventColor>{NativeRace}</eventColor> are locked in a terrible war, that much is clear. Other than that there are many unknowns. While it seems like the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> are the obvious aggressors in this conflict, the sudden reappearance of the <eventColor>{NativeRace}</eventColor> and their home world raises the question of whether they had been sealed within <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink> and if so, why.
title: Manuhari Besieged

body_footer: Both <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{NativePlayer}</eventColor> had to acknowledge the grandeur of your deeds. With your goals achieved, your legend spreads further to <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>.
body_header: Through cunning and leadership you have brought the fighting on Manuhari to an end.
body_lore: Not long ago, you were a foreigner to this realm. Today the dense jungle and meandering streams of Manuhari invoke a sense of familiarity and echo the tale of your actions.
title: Manuhari Besieged: Aftermath

button_0: Complete this chapter of your journey.
I will do what it takes, one way or another.

body_footer: "Time is scarce. My hideout might no longer be safe. Please meet me in the <eventColor>{EventGeo}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>."
body_header: Overlooking your recently established throne city of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, you sense the skillful <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> gently invading your mind through a vision.
body_lore: "Bless the currents of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>—my desperate plea has been answered!" <<Cg:voice,EventHero>> echoes relief. "I thank you and your followers, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, for putting your own lives in jeopardy for a noble purpose. The <eventColor>{NativeRace}</eventColor> native to this world and the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, my former comrades in misfortune, are caught in a relentless war—and neither side will appreciate the appearance of a new faction."
button_0: Wait for the vision to end.
title: A Call for Aid

body_footer: "It may not seem like I have much to offer in return, but I'm a sorceress... How may I best surprise you?"
body_header: With <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> at your side you return to <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "I thank you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, for coming to my aid," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> says, and you notice <<p:EventHero>> is less tense now that <<p:EventHero>> is in safety. "Being adrift within the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, trying to shield our troops from the <hyperlink>torment</hyperlink> while slowly running out of rations, then witnessing everyone losing their sanity when salvation seemed imminent—I have seen better days in the past. But I will recover."
button_0: "I will be delighted to learn more <knowledge></knowledge> about your sorcery."
button_1: "I would be surprised if a sorceress like you had no personal stockpile of mana <mana></mana> to share..."
button_2: "Choose an apprentice <unit></unit> among my people, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>!"
title: A Call for Aid: Aftermath

body_footer: "Flee these lands of our protection, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, and return to the <hyperlink>Sky Beyond</hyperlink>! The <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> will invoke their wrath upon any invaders."
body_header: A flurry of colorful wings accompanied with the tweeting songs from a thousand beaks heralds to you the arrival of <eventColor>{EventPlayer.TitleName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "Then it is true what the flying eyes have descried, and the Serpent has shed its tail to grow a second head." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> stares at you as if <<p:EventPlayer>> is attempting to pierce your <hyperlink>soul</hyperlink>. "But let it be known that the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> are no helpless foe—the ingenuity and indomitable will of <hyperlink>our ancestors</hyperlink> lets our spirits soar high and plunge the Serpent into the abyss."
button_0: Serpent? Sky Beyond? Admit your confusion.
button_1: Explain that the Sky Beyond knows many creatures. You are not the Serpent.
button_2: All you hear is violence and you sign up for it in blood <rs_war></rs_war>.
title: The <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Title}</eventColor> of Manuhari

body_footer: "Why else would you have come to this hidden world of mysteries. Speak quickly, be you friend or foe!"
body_header: With gun salutes and soldiers clad in razor sharp armor at <<o:EventPlayer>> side, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> gives you a pompous, yet tense, welcome.
body_lore: "Greetings, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>! Have you come to join the noble cause of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> and liberate the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> from the <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink> invaders far and wide? We bring technology and progress to the peoples subdued by vile magic, arming them to fight back and reclaim their homes. It is the dawn of a new <hyperlink>Commonwealth</hyperlink>, a league among worlds which will bring peace and prosperity."
button_0: "I have come to join the efforts of your Commonwealth."<relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_1: "You speak of peace, but is it not true you are besieging the natives of this world?"
button_2: "The invader is you, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. I will rise to the defense of the innocent <eventColor>{NativeRace}</eventColor>!"[relationLvl-3/]
title: Smoke and Thunder

body_footer: <eventColor>{Broker.FirstName}</eventColor> appears. "I sense the same energies around this "<eventColor>{Edward.Title}</eventColor>" as I do in <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>. Whoever <<p:Edward>> was, <<p:Edward>> is now a danger to the realm. <<Cp:Edward>> must be stopped."
body_header: After <eventColor>{Edward.TitleName}</eventColor> left to prepare his war machines, an emergency conclave is called on the Sehiran Oasis.
body_lore:
"I did not settle here to be provoked like this," {Noctus.FirstName} exclaims.
{Alfred.FirstName} is surprised. "That was {Edward.Name}, a legend on Athla. Surely we can bring him to reason..."
"Even {Karissa.FirstName} seems startled. "Those war machines... They are unlike anything I have seen before."
button_0: "So be it!"
title: Naught but Dread

body_footer: <eventColor>{Laryssa.FirstName}</eventColor> guides <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor> to safety.
body_header: You have defeated <eventColor>{Edward.TitleName}</eventColor>. He and his war machines lie before you, broken. He looks up, several emotions fighting for dominance.
body_lore: Before you can decide on his fate, you are interrupted. "No!" yells <eventColor>{Laryssa.FirstName}</eventColor>, who leaps in front of <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor> to protect him. "Please, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, we need him alive—he is the best example of this chaotic influence we have. You need him, we need him!" With a grunt, she lifts <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor> on her shoulder. "There has been enough bloodshed on this realm."
button_0: Very well.
title: The Last Dreadnought, Defeated

body_footer: "The rules of this Trial are simple. All participating Godir will either settle their differences or compete for the emerged <<m:EventStructure>> on this realm. Waging wanton wars is... discouraged."
body_header: You step in the desert sands of the Sehiran Oasis. The air is hot and dry, whipping sand across your face.
body_lore:
Still, the air is clearer here than on Magehaven, where the smallest spark seems to ignite arguments among all Godir residing there. Before you can ponder further you are approached by none other than {Broker.TitleName}.
"Greetings, {PlayerLeader.TitleName}. You have arrived at the Sehiran Oasis, where you will attempt to settle the differences between other Godir through a form of competition."
button_0: "Why are we doing this?"
button_1: "Get to the point already!" (skip)
title: Sehiran Oasis

body_footer: "Whilst I try to return some sense of order to Magehaven, you will settle your differences so the Pantheon can once again concentrate on more important concerns."
body_header: <<G:expression,Broker>> darkens. "When I first found <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, it was a refuge for <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> who found themselves adrift in the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. Now..."
body_lore: "...Since the <hyperlink>World Vault</hyperlink> was opened by my ambitious niece and those <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> fools, anarchy has overtaken the <hyperlink>Pantheon</hyperlink>." <eventColor>{Broker.FirstName}</eventColor> shakes <<o:Broker>> head in disgust. "It saddens me to admit that of the entire Pantheon, you lot currently seem to be the most 'reasonable'."
button_0: Continue to listen.
title: Anarchy in Magehaven

body_footer: With these last words, <eventColor>{Broker.FirstName}</eventColor> severs the connection, leaving you and any other participants on this sandy realm.
body_header: "The Sehiran Oasis was chosen as the cradle of this initiative. You will find the three other participants have settled around it."
body_lore: "In my past experiences, it is common for simpler minds to revert to skulduggery. Especially now, petty violence seems to be the first response for many <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>. As such, I am interested in the outcome here." A thin smile creeps across Meandor's face. "Good luck, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. Perhaps you can show us all violence is but one of many ways to resolve a conflict."
button_0: I will settle these disputes... one way or another.
button_1: I make my own rules.
title: The Sehiran Trials

body_footer: "There is one adversary left. I cannot join you, but I can offer you support from Magehaven."
body_header: You have forged an alliance with all three other participants of the Sehiran Oasis. <eventColor>{Broker.TitleName}</eventColor> appears to congratulate you.
body_lore: "Despite the many challenges you managed to achieve a peace between different <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> on this realm. You have done what many, including me, assumed impossible. But danger still looms. The wizards of <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink> are still influenced by something, and I feel like this <eventColor>{Edward.TitleName}</eventColor> is related, somehow."
button_0: "Grant me the secrets of your dark magic, Meandor, so we can withstand this adversary!"
button_1: "Raise some soldiers for us in the Sehiran Oasis." <unit></unit>
button_2: "United we shall persevere. My allies are all I need." <influence></influence>
title: The Sehiran Trials: Settled

chaos_known: Despite the influences of <hyperlink>Chaos</hyperlink>, you have forged an alliance with all three other participants of the Sehiran Oasis. <eventColor>{Broker.TitleName}</eventColor> appears to congratulate you.

"Despite the many challenges you managed to achieve a peace between different <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> on this realm. You have done what many, including me, assumed impossible. But danger still looms. The wizards of <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink> are still influenced by something, and I feel like this <eventColor>{Edward.TitleName}</eventColor> is related, somehow."

body_footer: "When I heard of this amusing initiative, I volunteered. Besides, I sense the heat of battle in the desert winds... This may become more interesting than we think." <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> winks at you.
body_header: A gust of heat announces one of the participants of the Sehiran Settlement. "Greetings, grand <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{Karissa.TitleName}</eventColor> smiles. "Surprised to see me?"
body_lore: "After my visit to <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> and the constant war raging there, I grew... bored. It is amusing to stoke arguments between the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> of <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, but without true carnage the strife of old wizards becomes bland rather quickly."
button_0: "Let us exchange knowledge on war <unitprod></unitprod>, <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor>... Just in case."
button_1: "Peace must be earned through honest strife. We shall put ourselves to the test!" <chaos></chaos>
button_2: "The instinct to protect yourself from harm is natural. Let us thrive, together!" <nature></nature>
button_3: "We will surely speak again in the future."
button_4: "The only passion I feel is my disgust for you, unholy wench!" <order></order>
title: The Mistress of Fire

body_footer: <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> winks. "How do you suppose we celebrate this alliance, mighty <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>?"
body_header: You have forged an alliance with <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor>, the <eventColor>{Karissa.Title}</eventColor>. She approaches you, a genuine warmth underneath her sly smile.
body_lore: "I have to admit, when I set foot on the Sehiran Oasis I did not expect to resolve our differences in any way but bloodshed. But you have impressed me, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>, despite other... less approachable guests. Perhaps we can truly make a difference in <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink> after all."
button_0: "Statues shall be erected in every city to celebrate our bond!" <influence></influence>
button_1: "A feast! The <eventColor>{KarissaRace}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor> shall join <unit></unit> in unbridled revelry!" <chaosboon></chaosboon>
button_2: "A fertility festival <food></food>, to honor the spirits of nature that brought us together!" <natureboon></natureboon>
button_3: "This alliance will be written in blood. We must combine our efforts to train more soldiers!" <unitprod></unitprod>
title: Passionate Alliance

body_footer: "<hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink> has become an unreasonable cesspool of petty arguments. I believe we can write history here, in the Sehiran Oasis."
body_header: You are greeted by the dusty smell of parchment, and, oddly enough, the scent of dried bones. Another participant appears before you and nods.
body_lore: "Allow me to properly introduce myself. I am <eventColor>{Noctus.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Noctus.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{NoctusRace.Name}</eventColor>. I represent my people and the <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> of our forefathers, who aid us even in death. As you may know, I am closely acquainted with death and betrayal, which seems to be inevitable even for those who want nothing but gain and to share knowledge."
button_0: "As a gesture of goodwill, I will grant you access to my archives." <knowledge></knowledge>
button_1: "Our intellectual goals align, <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor>. I look forward to what we can achieve together." <arcana></arcana>
button_2: "We can indeed learn much from the dead. Let us write history, together!" <shadow></shadow>
button_3: "We will surely speak again in the future."
button_4: "Your experiments are an affront to nature, <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor>. I will not stand for it!" <nature></nature>
title: The Eternal Archivist

body_footer: "<hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink>, <hyperlink>Ascended Champion</hyperlink>, or anyone else, in the end we are all <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> and share a responsibility for all the peoples in the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>."
body_header: A cheer and trumpets announce the arrival of another participant: <eventColor>{Alfred.TitleName}</eventColor> of Athla. "Hail, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor>."
body_lore: "With the other <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> here, many of my counselors think me mad for participating in an initiative like this. The <eventColor>{Alfred.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{AlfredRace}</eventColor> in an honorable competition with <hyperlink>Wizard Kings</hyperlink>? But I have learned our natures do not define us, and that unity can be found in the most surprising places." <<Cp:Alfred>> smiles. "Let our actions and alliances speak louder than our differences."
button_0: "Let us break bread <food></food>, <eventColor>{Alfred.Title}</eventColor> <eventColor>{Alfred.FirstName}</eventColor>, so we can soon negotiate further."
button_1: "Let us bring peace and order to the Oasis, and Magehaven." <order></order>
button_2: "We must all acknowledge our violent nature, only then can we surpass it." <nature></nature>
button_3: "Let us bring prosperity to these auspicious deserts." <matter></matter>
button_4: "We will surely speak again in the future."
button_5: "Your reliance on alliances makes you weak. A true Godir can fight <<o:PlayerLeader>> own battles!" <chaos></chaos>
title: The Athlan Unifier

body_footer: "I am glad to call you my ally. What shall history say about us, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>?"
body_header: You have forged an <rs_alliance></rs_alliance> <hyperlink>Alliance</hyperlink> with <eventColor>{Noctus.TitleName}</eventColor>. He approaches you and bows deeply in respect.
body_lore: "When I was told about this Trial, I had little hope of resolving it in any peaceful way. But I am glad to have found a kindred spirit in you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. We truly are writing history and may yet be able to bring reason to this realm and <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>."
button_0: "We will be remembered for our creeds and wisdom." <influence></influence>
button_1: "We will be remembered for unveiling the many secrets of the Astral Sea." <astralboon></astralboon>
button_2: "The dead will whisper about our achievements for ages to come!" <shadowboon></shadowboon>
button_3: "We shall be remembered for our knowledge and wisdom." <knowledge></knowledge>
title: Writing History

body_footer: "I am glad to have you on my side, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>! What will our first decree be as we bring the Sehiran Oasis together?"
body_header: You have forged an <rs_alliance></rs_alliance> <hyperlink>Alliance</hyperlink> with <eventColor>{Alfred.TitleName}</eventColor>. He approaches you with a smile and spreads his arms.
body_lore: "Great <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>! I am glad we have reached an alliance. I knew these Trials were not in vain. No matter our origins, together we can protect the innocent people of all realms from those who mean harm."
button_0: "All bards and town criers shall promote unity and harmony between our peoples!" <influence></influence>
button_1: "All of us, young and old, must stand together <unitprod></unitprod> against the dangers to come." <orderboon></orderboon>
button_2: "All will bless the spirits of nature for our shared prosperity." <nature></nature>
button_3: "We shall build grand structures <structureprod></structureprod> to celebrate our shared prosperity." <materiumboon></materiumboon>
button_4: "All of us must provide <gold></gold> so we can prepare for the challenges to come."
title: Unity Above All

body_footer: "Anyone interfering with our quest for liberty and peace will be considered an enemy. Tread carefully." Before you can answer, he leaves.
body_header: The sounds of a strange thunder rumble in the distance, where dark clouds rise from the desert. A stern looking man appears before you.
body_lore: "You are witness to the arrival of the <eventColor>{EdwardRace.Name}</eventColor>! We have survived torment to liberate the realms from all invading <hyperlink>Wizard Kings</hyperlink> and those who support their rule. What they have stolen, we will retake. What they have destroyed, we will rebuild. I see this realm was invaded by the wizards <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor>. Do not be afraid, for your liberation has arrived."
button_0: So be it...
title: The Last Dreadnought

player_is_ally: "I will cleanse the entire Astral Sea of the curse of Wizard Kings and those who support them, including you. Do not resist."
player_is_wizard: "I will cleanse the entire Astral Sea of the curse of Wizard Kings like you. Do not resist."

player_is_ally: "You are witness to the arrival of the <eventColor>{EdwardRace.Name}</eventColor>! We have survived torment to liberate the realms from all invading <hyperlink>Wizard Kings</hyperlink> and those who support their rule. What they have stolen, we will retake. What they have destroyed, we will rebuild. As the ally of the invading Wizards <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor>, you are just as guilty as them."
player_is_wizard: "You are witness to the arrival of the <eventColor>{EdwardRace.Name}</eventColor>! We have survived torment to liberate the realms from all invading <hyperlink>Wizard Kings</hyperlink> and those who support their rule. What you have stolen, we will retake. What you have destroyed, we will rebuild. We will free the realm from monsters like <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor>..." His gaze shifts to you, "...And you."

body_footer: "There is a different way to subdue the <eventColor>{Edward.Title}</eventColor>. Rather than defeating him in combat, use the <<m:EventStructure>> on this realm to lock him in. We can stop his rampage and cure him of his affliction!"
body_header: Whilst the others are reeling from the arrival of <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor>, you are approached by a sorceress who introduces herself as <eventColor>{Laryssa.TitleName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>! She says, catching her breath. "I traveled here as soon as I could. I see <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor> has already arrived. There is not much time to explain, but I know him well, and he is not behaving like himself. I am not sure what ails him, but if you carry any love for <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> and its hero, hear my plea."
button_0: "I will consider this." <unit></unit>
button_1: "Your words are merely excuses. I deny your request."
title: Sealed from Chaos

body_footer: Edward's voice is hoarse as he whispers: "What have I done?"
body_header: As your control over the <<m:EventStructure>> on the realm reaches a pinnacle, you can feel its connection to the Astral Sea is fully under your control.
body_lore: You sense the ebb and flow of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, the ripples it leaves on the realm. And you sense <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor>, as raw <hyperlink>Chaos</hyperlink> surges within him. With effort you sever his connection to the surging forces of chaos and as it leaves him he sinks to his knees. <eventColor>{Laryssa.FirstName}</eventColor> rushes towards him and for the first time since they left the Astral Sea on their broken landship, he truly sees her.
button_0: "Welcome back, <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor>."
title: Sealed from Chaos

body_footer: "We must gain full control of the <<m:EventStructure>> on this realm, so we can capture <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor> and cure him."
body_header: You have gained control of an <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. <eventColor>{Laryssa.FirstName}</eventColor> is pleased. "A good first step. With these, we can save <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor>!"
body_lore: "The <<m:EventStructure>> were once activated on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> by a wizard named Merlin. The one who controls the <<m:EventStructure>> controls everything that enters or leaves this realm, including the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> itself. In the hands of a novice, these Seals can bring terrible cataclysms. But with the knowledge I gained, we can use them to capture <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor> and stop his rampage across the realms."
button_0: "Bringing the <eventColor>{Edward.Title}</eventColor> to a halt is my only goal." <goodact></goodact>
button_1: "I can feel the power surging through the Seals. I shall channel it!" <mana></mana>
button_2: "With these Seals I shall become the sovereign ruler of this realm!" <influence></influence>
title: Claimed Seal

body_footer: "Your treachery leaves me no choice. My righteous march cannot be stopped!"
body_header: Your increasing control over the <<m:EventStructure>> has caused disturbances in the realm which have not gone unnoticed. Now, <eventColor>{Edward.TitleName}</eventColor> approaches.
body_lore:
"What are you doing, {PlayerLeader.Name}? Do not think I do not feel the disturbances in the Astral Flows! If you think you can use some cursed eldritch magic to stop me, you are not only foolish, you are no better than any other Wizard King!"
{Laryssa.FirstName} tries to intervene. "Edward, please, you're not yourself..." And for a moment there is a hint of doubt and pain in his eyes. Then, an angry red glimmer returns.
button_0: "So be it!"
title: Unveiled Suspicions

body_footer: "I know what affects <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor> and the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> of <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>. With your permission, I will elaborate."
body_header: Suddenly, you sense another presence, requesting permission to enter the realm. "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, if I may..." <eventColor>{Sundren.Name}</eventColor> says.
body_lore:
"Before you respond, I ask you to allow me to elaborate. After Grexolis, I left to find the Endailon... It seems you all found them before I did."
"It saddens me to see {Edward.FirstName} so affected. The journey through the Astral Sea must have taken its toll. And perhaps I bear some responsibility for his current state."
button_0: "Speak, Sundren."
button_1: "I have no use for traitors and deceivers. Begone."
title: Torchbearer, Vaultbreaker

body_footer: "As participants of the Sehiran Trials, we demand to know what you learned about these Seals, and what you plan to do with them!"
body_header: You have gained more control over the <<m:EventStructure>>. This has gained the attention of the other settlers on this realm.
body_lore:
{Noctus.FirstName} is the first to respond. "I have encountered these Seals before. My knowledge of them is limited, but I am intrigued."
{Karissa.FirstName} pouts. "You're not secretly doing something without us, are you? That would not be courteous..."
{Alfred.FirstName} nods sternly. "It seems only fair for you to share what you have discovered, especially considering the danger of {Edward.FirstName} in the north."
button_0: Share what you know about the <<m:EventStructure>>.
button_1: "All of Magehaven will know it was I who rediscovered the legendary Seals on this realm!" <influence></influence>
button_2: Keep your secrets.
title: Sealed Secrets

body_footer: The angrier <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor> becomes, the more Karissa's smile grows. Do you interfere?
body_header: During a diplomatic gathering, a discussion between <eventColor>{Noctus.TitleName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Karissa.TitleName}</eventColor> starts... heating up. "You lecture me on morality, <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor>?"
body_lore:
"{Karissa.FirstName} laughs mockingly. "Aren't you the one who regurgitates the souls of his own forefathers to fuel his undead engines of war? At least my {KarissaRace} know that their labor ends with death!"
{Noctus.FirstName} is barely withholding <> rage, his cheeks a dark green. "How dare you! You inspire cannibalism and raiding for the sake of violence! My experiments serve only to increase our collective knowledge!"
button_0: "<eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> is right. You have no right to lecture her on morality, <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor>."
button_1: "<eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor> is right. There is a greater purpose to his actions, unlike yours, <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor>."
button_2: "<eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor>, we Wizard Kings should stand together despite our different... views."
button_3: Leave them to their squabbles.
title: Morals Among Wizard Kings

body_footer: "What do you think, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>? Are <hyperlink>Ascended Champion</hyperlink> better than Wizards, as so many with their granted powers believe? Or are Wizards better, for taking what they have earned?"
body_header: "Admit it," <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> says to <eventColor>{Alfred.Title}</eventColor> <eventColor>{Alfred.FirstName}</eventColor> with a grin. "You hate me, you hate what I am."
body_lore:
"It was a Wizard who invaded Athla and killed your kin. Someone like me. Do I provoke you? Enrage you?"
Alfred's jaw tightens. "Whatever game you are playing, {Karissa.FirstName}, I am not joining in."
{Karissa.FirstName} continues: "You pretend to be accepting, but you, too, fear Wizard Kings. Why is it that people love those who are granted power, but hate those who take it? What is so great about self-righteous passivity?"
button_0: "Wizard Kings have withstood torture and truly worked for their powers."
button_1: "Ascended Champions are better. Power should not be taken, but granted."
button_2: "I am not joining this argument."
title: Inciting Argument

body_footer: <eventColor>{Alfred.FirstName}</eventColor> looks at you. "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>, what do you think? Is the torture—" <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor> harrumphs—"...Experimenting of Lost Wizards immoral, or justified?"
body_header: During a diplomatic gathering, <eventColor>{Alfred.Title}</eventColor> <eventColor>{Alfred.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Noctus.Title}</eventColor> <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor> have an argument. "I cannot condone your experiments, <eventColor>{Noctus.FirstName}</eventColor>." <eventColor>{Alfred.FirstName}</eventColor> says.
body_lore:
"Your experiments on Lost Wizards are... immoral. They may be monsters, but they are tortured souls who used to be people, like us."
{Noctus.FirstName} scoffs. "It is typical for those of lesser intellect to fear science they do not comprehend. My experiments serve the greater good. As you say, Lost Wizards are tortured souls. How is this fate, to serve my pursuit for knowledge, worse than an eternity in the Astral Void?"
button_0: "Experimenting on Lost Wizards is immoral. They were once like you and me."
button_1: "All is allowed for the sake of science."
button_2: Withhold any comment.
title: Price of Knowledge

body_footer: "My wards and distance render me unable to delve deeper, but your presence on the Sehiran Oasis may enable you to see what affects this human <eventColor>{Edward.Name}</eventColor>."
body_header: As your troops enter the domain of <eventColor>{Edward.TitleName}</eventColor>, you start to sense something is affecting the realm.
body_lore: <eventColor>{Broker.FirstName}</eventColor> appears. "So you sense it too. There has been a shift in the energies in the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. I am starting to suspect this is the cause of the 'erratic' behavior of the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> in <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, but I am unsure of its origin. I have warded myself against any unwanted influences, but this also impairs my ability to look deeper into the cause."
button_0: Reach out to the strange energies surging through the Astral Sea.
button_1: Avert your eyes.
title: Erratic Energies

body_footer: "My wards render me unable to delve deeper, but your increasing control of the <<m:EventStructure>> may enable you to see what affects everyone."
body_header: As your control over the <<m:EventStructure>> grows, you start to sense something is affecting the realm.
body_lore: <eventColor>{Broker.FirstName}</eventColor> appears. "So you sense it too. There has been a shift in the energies in the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. I am starting to suspect this is the cause of the 'erratic' behavior of the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> in <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, but I am unsure of its origin. I have warded myself against any unwanted influences, but this also impairs my ability to look deeper into the cause."
button_0: Reach out to the strange energies surging through the Astral Sea.
button_1: Avert your eyes.
title: Erratic Energies

domain_version: "My wards and distance render me unable to delve deeper, but your presence on the Sehiran Oasis may enable you to see what affects this human <eventColor>{Edward.Name}</eventColor>."
As your troops enter the domain of <eventColor>{Edward.TitleName}</eventColor>, you start to sense something is affecting the realm.

body_footer: The energies seem threatening, but also... liberating. Ever shifting, ever enraged, ever alive. You...
body_header: The chaotic energies of the realm collide in a cacophony of sounds, scents, visions and emotions which threaten to overwhelm your senses.
body_lore:
Rage soars through your body, followed by the greatest joy and the deepest despair. In the midst of this ever-changing maelstrom you sense an identity, an entity, observing your response. It is not here, not truly. But its presence is... everywhere, surging through the entire Astral Sea.

"These energies," {Laryssa.FirstName} says, "I have felt them too... mainly around {Edward.FirstName}."
button_0: ...Accept them.
button_1: ...Denounce them! <orderboon></orderboon>
button_2: ...Deflect them. <astralboon></astralboon>
button_3: ...Ground yourself against them. <natureboon></natureboon>
button_4: ...Protect yourself against them. <materiumboon></materiumboon>
button_5: ...Ward yourself against them. <shadowboon></shadowboon>
button_6: ...Rejoice in them! <chaosboon></chaosboon>
button_7: ...Reject them.
title: Vision of Pandemonium

body_footer: "The <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> fight a war they cannot win alone, so I had to free entities powerful enough to make a difference. Now I aim to limit the... unfortunate side effects."
body_header: As <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> joins you, she explains further: "I believe <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor>, and the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> of <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, are influenced by the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink]."
body_lore: "The Endailon are very powerful entities that originate from the start of creation. They brought balance to the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, but also destruction. So the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> locked them in the World Vault <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink>. A great wizard taught me about them before he disappeared, and until I can find him, I must continue his work in his stead."
button_0: "I accept your explanation."
button_1: "If you wish to resolve the problems you have caused, join me here." <unit></unit>
button_2: "Your methods were dishonorable, but your goals seem noble. That, I can accept." <orderboon></orderboon>
button_3: "Sometimes destruction leads to regrowth in a never-ending cycle. I can accept that." <natureboon></natureboon>
button_4: "The truly strong will be able to withstand anything these Endailon can cause." <materiumboon></materiumboon>
button_5: "Any powerful cosmic entity deserves to be known—and perhaps channeled." <astralboon></astralboon>
button_6: "For some, deception is a second nature that I can hardly judge." <shadowboon></shadowboon>
button_7: "Unfortunate? I find the chaos enlightening!" <chaosboon></chaosboon>
button_8: "None of this justifies your deceit. Begone." <influence></influence>
title: Endailon of Chaos

body_footer: <eventColor>{Laryssa.FirstName}</eventColor> was wounded, but has escaped death. It will take some time for her to regain her strength.
body_header: <eventColor>{Laryssa.Name}</eventColor> was defeated in battle under your command!
body_lore: Through effort, luck, or something else entirely, she managed to survive the onslaught and made it back to safety. "That was close, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>," she says. "Let's not try that again, shall we?"
button_0: So be it.
title: Laryssa Defeated

body_footer: With <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Laryssa.FirstName}</eventColor> in tow you travel to Magehaven to resolve the strife there.
body_header: You have stopped the incursion of <eventColor>{Edward.TitleName}</eventColor> and brought a sense of peace to the Sehiran Oasis.
body_lore: As <eventColor>{Laryssa.FirstName}</eventColor> tends to <eventColor>{Edward.FirstName}</eventColor>, who slowly comes to his senses, <eventColor>{Broker.FirstName}</eventColor> appears in front of you once more. "This Trial has resulted in a perhaps unexpected outcome, but with our findings and these humans' testimonies, I should be able to return a sense of control to <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>. I urge you to return here with them, so we can resolve this entire affair."
button_0: Onwards!
title: Sehiran Oasis: Victory

body_footer:
"I am destruction! I am liberation! I am the {Edward.Title} of the Commonwealth! I will not be defeated!"

Violent energies coalesce around {Edward.FirstName}... heralding the approach of dangers beyond the Astral Veil.

title: Contained Constructs

hero_is_playelea: Rejected constructs shamble towards <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>. A <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> trips and promptly explodes in a fountain of molten steel. Will <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> attack?
After stepping into the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you find yourself on an ancient, dusty plateau of stone and steel.

Soon, you discern lumbering shapes of <<m:EnemyUnit>> and other machines. One scratches at a column and, judging from the groove's depth, has done so for centuries. Another marches jerkily in tight circles. Suddenly, someone loudly trips over a steel plate that a <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> dropped! The machines take notice. One by one, their heads rotate towards your troops, locking onto targets.
Enchant the constructs' heads to rotate and lock onto yourself.

body_footer: As your troops clear out the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you permit yourself to take one of the machines' treasures. Which one?
body_header: For the first time in centuries, silence returns to the ancient <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. The constructs are finally still and at peace.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> investigates the ancient site. Faded glyphs and colorful mosaics reveal to <<P:EventHero>> that the plateau was originally created by the <hyperlink>Ancient Krazura</hyperlink>, but later used to detain constructs that showed defects, were overtly volatile, or that were discarded for other reasons. Upon entering the long-forgotten repository, the decaying constructs' behavior modules immediately assumed your troops were acute threats.
button_0: Take the ancient <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>.
button_1: Haul away the copious gold armor pieces <gold></gold> that litter the floors.
button_2: Reanimate <unit></unit> an immobilized <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>.
button_3: Learn the secret of <eventColor>{EventSpell}</eventColor> by studying the exploded constructs.
title: Contained Constructs: Aftermath

button_0: "Nothing I can't kill! Attack!"
button_1: "I know this! <knowledge></knowledge> "Dragon" is the answer! Adjust your defenses, troops!"
button_2: A rapidly developing dragon? Nature's laws forbid your forced evolution!
button_3: "Whatever it is, it won't catch us today! Retreat!"
title: Sequestered Developments

hero_is_playerle: You step through the gate of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and are engulfed by a sea of lush leaves and warm winds.

A writhing cacophony of birdsong welcomes you. You breathe in the humid air and experience a pull, as if propelled forward. You sense movement in the nearby undergrowth. A small critter leaps out and agonizingly evolves into a <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> before your very eyes! Then, without warning, a gale topples nearby trees. An enormous Construct lands in the clearing it created.

body_footer: "One final riddle remains", the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> groans. "What mortal bounty should I bequeath unto you?"
body_header: Its creatures defeated and wings clipped, the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> shrieks with the sound of steel wire twining, then crashes to earth.
body_lore: It lifts its head one last time and speaks: "Your puzzled expression amuses me. Have you not invaded my domain to steal my secrets? My creators, praise their feathers, tasked me to protect this hidden sanctuary. I adapted myself and those I was tasked to protect... And still I failed." The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> sighs, and you are reminded of an iron flagpole creaking in a storm.
button_0: Learn the spell of <eventColor>{EventSpell}</eventColor>!
button_1: Request the verdant <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. <item></item>
button_2: A <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> for your army. <unit></unit>
button_3: Obtain the 1!
title: Sequestered Developments: Aftermath

body_footer: A luxuriously garbed <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink> reveals <<r:EventGodir>>: "I am <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor>, <<EventGodir<eventColor>{God/Goddess}</eventColor>>> of Wealth! Take my hand and stay a while!"
body_header: Upon entering the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> shields <<o:EventHero>> eyes from the blinding sunlight bouncing off white sands and golden idols.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> is inside an arena, amidst a dozen gold statues. Most of them are rooted in gold puddles that spot the white sandy plains. Soldiers. Servants. Beasts. Furniture and food. All wrought from gold—Wait! Did that statue just move?! Then, <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> hears snickering. "My, my," a raspy voice resounds throughout the arena. "Have they lifted my exile at last?"
button_0: "You may take my cold steel, <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor>!"
button_1: Those puddles of gold seem treacherous! Cast preemptive counter spells. <mana></mana>
button_2: Mutter an incantation to shield your troops from unexpected aureate hexes.
button_3: No, thanks! Retreat from this gilded realm and seal the gate.
title: Touch of My'dhas

hero_is_playerle: Upon entering the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you shield your eyes from the blinding sunlight bouncing off white sands and golden idols.

body_footer: As My'dhas spends <<o:EventGodir>> final breaths, your troops collect <<o:EventGodir>> hoard. How else will you profit from My'dhas's demise?
body_header: Your warriors proved more than <eventColor>{EventGodir}</eventColor> and <<o:EventGodir>> golden host bargained for. The impoverished <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink> lies at your feet.
body_lore: "Not quite... hnng! ... the golden destiny I had coined for myself," the fallen <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> smirks through the pain. "How precious! First, my rivals enviously seal me away." My'dhas coughs up gold blood. "And when my prison opens next, vault robbers arrive to raid my treasures!" The self-proclaimed <<EventGodir<eventColor>{God/Goddess}</eventColor>>> of Wealth spits scornfully. "Take my riches. May you choke on them."
button_0: Procure the radiant <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. <item></item>
button_1: Extract the enchantment <mana></mana> from My'dhas's bewitched body.
button_2: Reanimate <unit></unit> an intact <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> that remained dormant.
button_3: Steal a fraction of My'dhas's enchantment to create a <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor>. <unit></unit>
title: Touch of My'dhas: Aftermath

body_footer: This <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> takes you for a savior. Reflecting on your decision to venture to Manuhari, you cannot help but smile.
body_header: As the vision ends, you begin to take in the details of your surroundings.
body_lore: The sight of the lush tangled flora; the buzz of colorful birds shrieking and squawking as they constantly switch from layer to layer of the verdant thicket; the smell of sprayed water, a refreshing echo of a distant waterfall, the static tension of profound magic inhabiting the land—the sensations of Manuhari's jungle are enticing, overwhelming, even intrusive.
button_0: "I have indeed come to bring peace <goodact></goodact>."
button_1: "I came to tame the wild creatures <unit></unit> of Manuhari."
button_2: "The myths <knowledge></knowledge> surrounding the ancient <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> bode power."
button_3: "I must study the astral flows <mana></mana> of this forgotten world, unknown to all."
button_4: "My people thrive in conflicts <happiness></happiness> like this one and the opportunities they bring."
button_5: "This intervention will spread my legend <influence></influence> of restored order."
button_6: "War parties in need are excellent trading victims <gold></gold>."
button_7: "I shall exploit their weakness <unitprod></unitprod> <evilact></evilact>, so foolishly revealed."
title: Freed Lands of Manuhari

body_footer: "Now that you are here, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, I offer you my services to bring an end to the conflict on Manuhari in any way necessary."
body_header: Approaching the scene of a large broken landship, carefully placed arcane markings lead you to <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "Well met, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>!" <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> says, leaving concealment. "What you see here are the sorry remains of the vessel to which I—and all the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>—owe our lives. Alas, it only led to more misery..." <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> sighs. "<hyperlink>Edward Portsmith</hyperlink>, the leader of our company, provoked the war with the <eventColor>{NativeRace}</eventColor>, only to leave the realm soon after. He left <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> in charge. <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> is an honorable person and might be reasoned with, if <<o:EventPlayer>> loyalty to Edward doesn't betray <<P:EventPlayer>>."
button_0: Accept <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> <unit></unit> into your army.
button_1: Install <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> as an arcane counselor <knowledge></knowledge> in your wizard's tower.
title: Meeting the Sorceress

body_footer: "Now, we are at open war with the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>—a war I did not seek, but intend to win."
body_header: "Excellent. All <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{brothers/sisters}</eventColor>>> in arms are welcome to serve the cause of our new <hyperlink>Commonwealth</hyperlink>." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> salutes you enthusiastically.
body_lore: "We have a problem," <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> continues, abruptly changing topic, "involving the locals of this realm, which is detrimental to the campaigns of our Supreme Leader <hyperlink>Edward Portsmith</hyperlink>. The <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> have acted adversarial since our first contact. We tried to negotiate a permit of settlement, yet their <eventColor>{NativePlayer.TitleName}</eventColor> insisted we should abandon all weapons, which we couldn't."
button_0: Allow <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> to continue.
title: The War of Manuhari

body_footer: "Our Supreme Leader <hyperlink>Edward Portsmith</hyperlink> sent message of rare materials he encountered during his campaigns across the Astral Sea, which would quicken our war production further. We could confirm the occurrence of two such materials, <eventColor>{EventMaterial1}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{EventMaterial2}</eventColor>, on Manuhari. Will you help us obtain them?"
body_header: "The <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> are at a natural strategic advantage," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> continues to explain.
body_lore: "They know the terrain, are greater in numbers and have the infrastructure to supply their soldiers. We on the other hand are few and foreign to these lands - but we have two things the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> lack: technology and efficiency! The furnaces and forges of our assembly lines are worked by night and day, combining dreadnought war machines with devastating <hyperlink>Magelockloreconcept</hyperlink> weaponry."
button_0: "Consider it done."
title: Mechanized Production

indirect_join: "Excellent." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> smiles. "All aid is welcome for the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> are at a natural strategic advantage."

body_footer: "As our ally, I want you to benefit from these advances, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. I am willing to share: weapons, knowledge, troops—choose what matches your strategy."
body_header: You have obtained <eventColor>{EventMaterial1}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{EventMaterial2}</eventColor> for the new <hyperlink>Commonwealth</hyperlink>. <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> is gratified.
body_lore: "Thanks to your contributions, our war production has reached new peak efficiency. It reminds me of the invention of Mana-Fuel Cells back on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> and its promise of power and prosperity for the common man."
button_0: Ask for soldiers <unit></unit> trained with magelock weapons.
button_1: Ask for the latest weapons <item></item> developed by the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>.
button_2: Ask for supplies <bindingfragments></bindingfragments> to devise experimental weapons of your own.
button_3: Ask for insights <knowledge></knowledge> into mechanical constructs.
title: Mechanized Production: Aftermath

body_footer: The rumbling thunder of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> is drawing closer. With the large crystal in sight, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> must act quickly.
body_header: As <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> combs through the rock formations, at last the secret entrance indicated by <<ge:scouts,EventPlayer.FirstName>> is revealed.
body_lore: Inside, <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> finds <<r:EventHero>> in a large cavern system sizzling with arcane energies. The cry of the Thundershriek echoes through the tunnels, while <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> carefully moves forward. Reaching the last chamber, <<p:EventHero>> is dazzled by the sight of an enormous floating crystal. Without a doubt this crystal must be linked to the Thundershriek's mysterious powers.
button_0: Charge at the crystal to put an end to the Thundershriek!
button_1: Flee.
title: Cave of the Thundershriek

body_lore: While the troops keep scouting the cavern for remaining enemies, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> examines the broken remains of the Thundershriek and its crystal, both masterful creations from a distant age and a clear testament to the magecraft and craftsmanship of the <hyperlink>Ancient Krazura</hyperlink>.
button_0: Grind the shards down into binding essence <bindingfragments></bindingfragments>.
button_1: Decorate your throne room <influence></influence> with the Thundershriek armor.
button_2: Embed the crystal shards into a <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> <item></item>.
