bio:
Used as payment for an infernal pact, Albata and the Redfeathers were cast into the depths of the Azh'Ruun Pit. But the Demons had bitten off more than they could chew. The Matron and her tribe escaped their imprisonment and learned the ways of the Fiends, feasting upon them and fleeing the infernal realm.

In their Demonic odyssey, the Redfeathers lost their connection with their Primal Spirit. Yet in Obbadoth, they forged a bond with the Inferno Hounds, which became their animal guide. Now the barbarian tribe and its leader seek the one responsible for their sacrifice, even if they have to go back to hell to find answers.
name: Redfeathers

bio:
Ever close-lipped and withdrawn, Arachna kept her double role as member of the Circles of Evermore and Witherbloom a secret throughout the Ages. Only now, as the Mistwalkers invade the Worlds Within more openly, rumors of her allegiance with the Duathadae are beginning to spread. When Arachna weaves her cold webs and enchantments, Onoka, the Queen of Whispers, shows her eerie smile.

The Weaving Mistcrawlers are relatives of the Spider Queen herself, distant descendants of the turned Raven Tharic and his Mistwalkers. With them by her side, Arachna has spent ages weaving schemes, ensnaring first Athla and then all Magehaven in her web of lies.
name: Weaving Mistcrawlers

bio:
At the gleeful crack of her whip, DaDa Yuah commands urgency and impatience in the hearts of mortals. To get stuff done, to reach greater speeds, or simply lose oneself to existential anxiety. Once that fear is allowed to fester, she inevitably becomes the angry little devil on their heels.

Before her, dash the Bolting Houndmasters, hunters of laggardly spirits and all those who eventually tarry before the infernal whip of impatience. They are the rabid and restless servants of the Harridanmother, and they must not, and cannot sit idle.

The Disciple of Ilandra has taken upon herself to defend the Pellari, becoming a paragon among her kind. For it is rare to see one of the animalistic folk of Duatha ascend to Godirhood. As a native of the realm, Auntie Lobelia enjoys the favor of the Duathadae, who regard her actions with far greater benevolence—at least compared to the other disciples in the Circle of Witherbloom.

The ancient tongues tell that the Skittish Pellari were already there when the Fey first came into being. And when the latter took control and became the favorites of Duatha, the fearful hares endured by retreating deep into the Burrow Downs. To them, fear is not cowardice, but survival.

Kana and Grump were once two chieftains of the Blood Clan, distant, degenerate descendants of Myrrida's mighty [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant Kings[/hyperlink]. In a feud, the two rival tribes fought each other to extinction. Only Grump survived; he devoured the body of Kana and grafted her head onto himself in the delirium of battle. Thus, they became one, the Twineater.

Lured to Duatha, Kana-Grump became the Disciple of Ventrogh in the Circle of Witherbloom, leading the Voracious Vermin. Those known to be the most ravenous inhabitants of the realm, insatiable creatures willing to devour even themselves under the orders of their gluttonous master. The rodent pest have eagerly taken up the task of hunting rebels beneath Duatha's surface. A place they call, in hungry whispers, Marrow Downs.
name: Voracious Vermin

bio:
Bound and taken captive, our jovial Ham Binger was brought before the Duathadae. But just before he was devoured, a strange Fey magic whisked him away... once again. In his defense, this time not even he knows how it happened. Yet now he has become the Chosen of the Fey and the leader of the Burrow Downs rebellion.

The Burrowing Pellari welcomed Ham with open paws. Changed by Fey magic, he has fully embraced life among the Pellari. It has been a long time since the Burrow Warden has felt like he belongs. And so, his days of running are over; it is time to defend his home.
name: Burrowing Pellari

bio:
One of the last living Traitor Kings of old Myrrida. Istarnech Gold-Curser, he who denied the Allfather before his peers and ate several treasures of the Eternal Council. For this, he was chased out and down before finding shelter in eternal devotion to "the Need."

The Avaricious Wolves are a terribly greedy bunch. All are born in servitude to the Demon Overlord of Avarice, thus their loyalty lies not so much with Istarnech, but rather with the giant hole in his stomach that litters all the treasures he eats across the floor.

Perisher of weaker hearts and prime Aspect of Chaos: Karissa—formerly "the Red"—whose dormant, primal being has been liberated by the Chaos Endailon. Now, she is reborn as "the Fury," harbinger of change, undoer of order, and the indomitable spark destined to set the Worlds Within ablaze—one heart at a time. Through her, Chaos shall reign completely across the Astral Sea, and the old order shall be buried under her raging heels. And a new one shall arise from its ashes, one where all shall praise her. Praise her and rage on!

The Enchanted Chaotes are but savage animals in the eyes of orderly mortals, but they care nothing for such idle judgments. For they are the followers of Karissa and her very weapons of undoing, before whom all shall ultimately perish. "For Chaos! For Karissa!" they shout in their rampant march, "Our One and Only Mistress!" And they are marching for your gates.
name: Enchanted Chaotes

bio:
After attacking the Worlds Within as an Eldritch Sovereign in the Great Umbral War, Merlin was at last freed from Urrath's grasp on the Cliffs of Sordünn. Now the voices are gone, but not the guilt. Unable to trust himself, the Tarnished Archmage has covered his body with spells, wards, and amulets, going so far as to inscribe them into his own flesh. Damping his magic powers for the safety of those he swore to protect.

The Horwynd are an ancient and secretive people. When the Circle of Deogai were formed in ages past, the Horwynd devised the Shrouded Isles to undermine Archon supremacy. Though they only insinuate their motives for doing so or for seeking out Merlin at this point of time.
name: Horwynd

bio:
As life evolves in the Worlds Within, so too does death. Nekron has ascended into a new and even more corrupted form, with the power of Urrath coursing through his necrotic body. The Archreaper now masters every domain of undead magic, and he intends to spread them to bring an Age of Death to the entire Astral Sea.

After the seals on Athla were broken, Nekron did not join the invasion of the Shad'rai. Instead, he waited until he could return to Evermore unnoticed. There, he has been raising the Evermore Wights, lingering souls of the elves who once sought their last peace beyond Athla.
name: Evermore Wights

bio:
At his young age, Palas had already achieved the rank of Master Archivist, guarding the knowledge and secrets of the Great Library of Xandrias. Yet his curiosity led him to read a grimoire from the forbidden section, which cursed his eyes, nearly shattered his sanity, and unleashed dark powers within his library.

The Cryptic Archivists were once part of the School of Shrouding. But obsessed by lost magic, they drifted away from the Horwynd. Now Palas and the laconic librarians look for a master. Someone capable of teaching them how to keep the dark secrets of the library under control.
name: Cryptic Archivists

bio:
After the military campaigns of the Third Age, Reskar Scapeshaper continued his efforts to restore the blessing of the Dragons to his kin. Uniting many Draconians under the same banner, Reskar's quest received new meaning when the Elder Dragon Sumuskira the Grovetender visited him after Lithyl's thwarted invasion of Athla.

Guided by visions from the Primal Dragon of Nature, the Rootseeker Draconians and their Emissary have embarked upon a new journey to reclaim the lost legacy of their ancestors—a legacy that predates even the First Age of Wonders.
name: Rootseeker Draconians

bio:
Distant descendants of the Horwynd, the ancestors of Soaring Boltwing lived for generations alongside the Dwarves of an exiled realm. Yet the pride of the Vindicator chafed against the restraints and limitations imposed by those he deemed inferior, mere "cave-dwellers." And so, he led his people away, seeking a place where his kind would be granted the honor they deserved.

The Skyshatter Fowl arrived in Duatha with their leader, who became the Disciple of Luth in the Circle of Witherbloom. In his wake, they claimed what they saw as their rightful place, hunting those who dwell beneath the surface. A fitting twist of fate, one that surely amuses the proud birds.
name: Skyshatter Fowl

bio:
Exiled as a child with dangerous magic abilities, Symon learned the hard way what it means to be different. When the wizards of Evermore had left Athla in pursuit of the Shadow Demons, Symon followed his sensitive arcane instincts to Evermore, where he found an Eldritch Leviathan waking up beneath the island. With great presence of mind Symon enchanted the Leviathan back into sleep, keeping solitary vigil while Athla became locked from Evermore through the seals of the Third Age. During this time Symon studied the cosmic secrets left behind by the Circle, but over time the endless struggle with the Leviathan and its desire to break free have taken their toll.

The Flowborn Halflings are a reflection of Symon's solitude, phantom images created to fight against the isolation and sorrow of being forgotten. They are a masterwork of illusion, almost a perfect remembrance of that distant memory when he was happy.
title: Awakener

bio: Calling himself a Cosmic Wanderer, the mysterious mage keeps his identity concealed. He claims to have come to Evermore in search of the <hyperlink>Astral Endailon</hyperlink>, but his true motives remain a mystery.

The antisaint of all forsaken souls, who is whispered to govern the power to undo misfortune, illness, and even old age. In darkness and in shame, Walburgis is the last refuge of many shunned and forgotten mortals who desperately summon him into their hearts each night, even though he is foul and his fruits are rotten.

The Bloodgurgler Legion is believed to be the physical manifestation of the Great Bloodgurgler, who moves through the spirits of his foul and filthy children. To eat the sickly and the elderly and gurgle up their rotten ichor whenever they bleat out in relish, or in their hideous warcries.

He who smote Obbadoth into submission. Ysariel, son of Maliel, a lonesome, "fallen [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archon[/hyperlink]" who, after countless failed attempts, eventually established the infamous Circle of the Azh'Ruun Pit through an illicit pact—after which he was banished from Emnora. Now, abandoned by his own and twisted through millennia of forsaken servitude, Ysariel has become the only thing standing between the Astral Sea and the raging Demon Overlords, bound below the Pit.

In this mission, he stands united with the Brotherhood of Ysariel, his sworn Pact Brothers and Sisters, who stand by his side, forever. As does he, by theirs—through fire and temptation.

button_3: Sacrifice captives of the <eventColor>{DaDaYoRace}</eventColor> to Balorboss! <evilact></evilact>
button_4: Salvage <<o:DaDaYo>> Demonic powers <production></production> before <<p:DaDaYo>> fades away entirely. <evilact></evilact>
title: Salvation from Impatience

body_footer: While the <eventColor>{Istarnech.LastName}</eventColor> is slowly digested into <<r:Istarnech>>, <<o:Istarnech>> <eventColor>{IstarnechRace}</eventColor> scurry away in mortal panic and <eventColor>{IstarnechCapital}</eventColor> is free for you to decide on. Razing and dismantling it now will break the nearby chain.
body_header: Toppling over, <eventColor>{Istarnech}</eventColor> groans and grumbles aloud as gold-froth emerges from every orifice. "No, the Need calls! The hunger pangs, they are insufferable!"
body_lore: With another <hyperlink>Demonic Prince</hyperlink> gone, <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> is one step closer to total anarchy.
button_0: Raze and dismantle the Chain of Greed, now! <evilact></evilact>
button_3: Sacrifice captives of the <eventColor>{IstarnechRace}</eventColor> to Balorboss! <evilact></evilact>
button_4: Salvage <<o:Istarnech>> Demonic powers before <<p:Istarnech>> fades away entirely. <evilact></evilact>
title: Salvation from Greed

body_footer: With a firm stance, <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> readies to protect their mysterious plight as <<o:EventUnit>> awaits your answer...
body_header: Approaching the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, a curious yet determined <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> steps up to halt your entry.
body_lore: With unblinking eyes, the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> spontaneously orates aloud: "Passage through is barred to all but those who know the answer hereto: Born in bloom, I warm the sky; I crimson fade as death drifts by; I sleep beneath a quilt of white; Then rise again in lush delight. What am I?
button_0: "You are the changing seasons."
button_1: "I have no time for this, to arms!"
button_2: Answer this inquiry by summoning the spirit of the seasons.
button_6: Ponder this question away from the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
title: The Fourfold Enigma

body_footer: Empowered by the seasonal torrent, the rabid <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> works itself up into a fury, refusing anyone near <<P:EventUnit>>.
body_header: The tower before you stands swathed in a raging torrent of warped seasons. And at its gate, growls a horrid abomination...
body_lore: "Wiz-ard, ach!" coughs the abominable <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>. "Magbar kill wiz-ard, ach-khu! You make <hyperlink>season gods</hyperlink> wither and eat you. You warp Fey magicks so seasons go bad, you make Magbar all ugly, ugly and sad! Grrr-kuu, Magbar kill! Ach-khuuu, I kill you!"
button_0: Attack the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>.
button_1: Strengthen your troops <mana></mana> with the seasonal torrent.
button_2: Attempt to master the spellwarped mists and seasons.
button_7: Reach out to soothe Magbar's swelling rage.
button_8: Leave Magbar and the Arcanum, for now.
title: The Wrath of Seasons

body_footer: More <<m:EventUnit>> slink forth to listen, as <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> seethes: "Let's feud no more, but sow our grief; Let's heal <hyperlink>Duatha</hyperlink> and reap relief."
body_header: As the seasonal torrent reaches its climax, <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> flutters up in riled anguish. "Stop, don't cleave what crawls and grieves!"
body_lore: Cowering, Magbar looks up to <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>, all riled-up. "Born of blight, bent from right; wizard hands have sparked Fey spite. They seasons torn, its cycle shorn; <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> thus claw and mourn. But not by hate we mend this fate; no, fight the right, unmake the scorn. Mistlings, rise! Shed off the lies; embrace your spite, but make it wise."
button_0: Draw on the seasons for its power. <mana></mana>
button_2: Strengthen <<G:speech,<eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>>> to win Magbar over. <unit></unit>
button_3: Raid the tower for its secrets <knowledge></knowledge>, while <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> speaks on.
title: The Wrath of Seasons: Subsided

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> furrows <<o:EventPlayer>> brows. "Traces of their history can still be found on various <<m:EventStructure>> throughout the realm. Find and activate them, so that we might gain the leverage of wits."
body_header: Before the morning's departure, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> draws you aside with a hushed whisper. "Do you know what a <hyperlink>Circle of Deogai</hyperlink> is? There is a rather puzzling one here on <hyperlink>Duatha</hyperlink>."
body_lore: "See here, our primary foes are each members of an old <hyperlink>Archon</hyperlink>-sanctioned [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CircleOfDeogaiLoreConcept]Circle[/hyperlink], long ago established here to control their waxing powers," explains <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Though, as is becoming pressingly more evident, they are not quite as contained, nor as 'administered' accordingly. Now, when Milina spirited me to freedom I learned that these very 'Disciples' are not the original circle-members at all..."
button_0: "I will consider this."
title: Leverage of Wits

body_footer: After a brief, pensive pause, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> looks up with a troubled smile. "Hmm... the plot thickens, as they say."
body_header: Upon puzzling the various <<m:EventStructure>> scribbles together, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> exlaims: "Dear <hyperlink>Duatha</hyperlink>, this forms a map to a <eventColor>{EventStructureB}</eventColor>!"
body_lore: "How fascinating to be reminded of these. Why, I've heard rumors of such devices being employed by the <hyperlink>Wizard Kings</hyperlink> of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, though never quite confirmed—it was all a rather 'mortally tabooed subject,' if memory serves. But see here, to the surprise of no one the original Duathan circle did exactly that. Though I fear... ominously so."
button_0: "Tell me what is on your mind."
title: Leverage of Wits: Mapped Out

body_footer: "I suspect," mulls <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>, "that <hyperlink>Duatha's</hyperlink> troubles are interwoven with whatever secrets lay shrouded beyond that portal. We would do well to uncover them."
body_header: "Wizardly secrets, my good fellow," puffs <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>, "of a most unsavory kind, I do fear."
body_lore: "Spells don't just pop out of nowhere," hums <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Their primary avenue of creation being through empiricism. Long ago, an age of 'unfettered experimentation' flourished that triggered <hyperlink>such manner of cataclysms</hyperlink> that the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> deemed it right to intervene. <hyperlink>Administrative circles</hyperlink> were thereafter established to ensure a more, say, lawful continuation of wizardly business everywhere. Yet... many assimilated Archmages did not quite fancy these new restrictions..."
button_0: "I shall uncover these secrets."
title: A Circle Shrouded

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> looks up, drained of <<o:EventPlayer>> merry demeanor. "If so, do you think the <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> forays merely echo the trauma <hyperlink>Duatha</hyperlink> suffered?"
body_header: While your troops salvage <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> appears again with an emotive smile to sit with you in silence.
body_lore: "So," puffs <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> as <<p:EventPlayer>> breaks the silence, "sadly, it appears my suspicions were on point. The original <hyperlink>Circle of Deogai</hyperlink> was a cabal of Archmages hellbent on dissecting <hyperlink>Duatha's mysteries</hyperlink> and her beloved creations. And under <hyperlink>Horwynd</hyperlink>-bought shroud, one pursued unscrupulous trials of a most abhorrent fashion. Presumably, this wrought the nightmares now plaguing Duatha and vexed the <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> into their present temperament..."
button_0: Ponder on this for a while... <knowledge></knowledge>
title: A Circle Shrouded: Uncovered

body_footer: Upon various crumbling gates and archways the same repeating motto is engraved, reading: 'Bounteous be the Fey Arcana...'
body_header: Entering beyond the ichorous veil of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, a still and opaque domain appears. One reeking of mildew and decayed aspirations.
body_lore: All about your troops, the ruined vestiges of a once vast institute of learning peeks out under the stranglehold of an all-encompassing overgrowth. A quick survey of the ruins reveals ample evidence that this haunted place was long ago abandoned in what must have been an anguished scramble.
button_3: "Onwards."
title: A Reclaimed Collegium

body_footer: "Wiz-ard...? Wiz-ard! Khuuu, nay! Begone, go a-way," weeps the growling voice from the mists. "Magbar must not stay. Khuhuhu, nay."
body_header: Trudging through the misty wild growth, all halt before a ghastly growling wail, crying: "Khuuu! Hurts and lies, skewers and cries!"
body_lore: "Khuuu! Why lies say to Magbar, to me?" laments the growling voice deep from the mist, "When I shows you fair-lands of Fey and fair-y! You smiles and you treats, you pets and talks sweets. But hurts Magbar's friends when I goes for to sleep. Kuhuhu, Magbar in pain!"
button_3: Chase after the ghastly voice.
title: Abominable Secrets

body_footer: "Khuuu! No stabs me with skewers, no pull me apart," wails the ghastly voice, "no jab me with magicks and jinxes in heart! Khuhuhu, nay..."
body_header: Further up ahead, that ghastly voice again weeps out in raspy coughs: "Khuuu-ach, island no go! Ach, island no go!"
body_lore: "Khuuu, oh nay, no! No hurt Magbar, I no want to go!" sobs the ghastly voice. "Magbar is friend, no drag I to evil island. Khuhuh, I no make angry <hyperlink>sun-men</hyperlink> here come, nor punished they wiz-ards to make all so glum. So why angry with Magbar, why hurt I with pain? Magbar your friend—ach, nay never again!"
button_3: Chase after the ghastly voice.
title: Thaumaturgical Trauma

body_footer: "Gold... I need your gold!" grumbles the mad, <hyperlink>Elder Giant</hyperlink>, "Feed me your damned gold!"
body_header: A hungry rumbling enters your awareness, followed by the loud, booming grumbling voice of <eventColor>{Istarnech.FirstName}</eventColor> " Gold! Gold! Istarnech hungers for your gold!"
body_lore: It appears that <<p:Istarnech>> is out for another sacrifice for <<o:Istarnech>> insatiable appetite for gold and will not leave until this accursed need is sated.
title: Demonic Prince of Greed

body_footer: "Now!" threatens <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Vow upon your immortal soul that you shall protect the Circle as my <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>, or reveal yourself as a servant of evil and face my wrath!"
body_header: As the light of Order withdraws from you, the broken light of <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> envelopes you whole with its bleak, sullen aura... "Yea sinner, I saw you deal with that demon."
body_lore: "Make no mistake, <eventColor>{Liztia}</eventColor> is a villainous trickster most foul who has eluded my blade for too long," scorns <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Ample experience has wizened me to the fact that <<p:Liztia>> only reveals <<r:Liztia>> when some fiendish catastrophe is imminent. Precisely as I feared... and whatever ploy might be at play, <<p:Liztia>> thought you the right <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> for <<o:Liztia>> sinful act."
button_0: "I regret my sin, and swear this pact to atone." <goodact></goodact>
button_3: "Pha, spare me your judgments 'Fallen Archon!' I sin as I please." <evilact></evilact>
title: Casting Aspersions

body_lore: "The sinful offers of <hyperlink>Obbadoth's</hyperlink> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DemonicPrinceLoreConcept]Demonic Princes[/hyperlink] can be deceptively convincing," scoffs <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Though rarely do they bargain so freely with newcomers to the Pit. I suspected foul play before, but now sense a deeper conspiracy at work.. Nevertheless, I will not allow it to unfold under my watch."

body_footer: "We <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> seek, then twist their beak! Then for Auntie <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> I gives a squeak! And when she come, she'll surely peek; how Pellari of stinky cages reek!"
body_header: "Auntie <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>, who just us meet, once cheerfully with <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> treat," mutters <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: A sombre note falls over <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>. "It like sprout-blight feels to see Auntie torn; twixt <hyperlink>Fey Lord</hyperlink> praise and Fey Lord scorn! I wish to Auntie, we could show—somehow; how <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> hurts <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> now..." <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> stomps <<o:FeyGuideName>> little head with balled fists, then gasps: "Oh, wow, wow, wow! I... I know how!"
button_0: "That's a great idea!"
button_4: "No. I prefer war, actually."
title: The Beaktwister Plot

body_footer: "This... is not the way of Spring," growls <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> with a distraught gait. "Has <hyperlink><eventColor>{FeyGodName}</eventColor></hyperlink> been taking me for a fool?"
body_header: Upon vanquishing the Mistwalkers, <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> makes a muted call, that somehow still echoes far. Then, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> appears, saying, "I knew you'd come back to me."
body_lore:
"Auntie, Auntie, come and see;" chimes {FeyGuideName}, "how bad a'bruised Pellari be. By {EventRace} fang, and claw, and spear; all are in cage, in pain, and fear!"

{EventPlayer.FirstName} observes the cage riddled camp awhile in pained silence. "I... I did not know. "{FeyGodName} promised all life a chance to blossom. How could <> do this... to me?"
button_0: Convince <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> to join the Pellari struggle.
title: The Beaktwister Plot: Aftermath

body_footer: "This befoulment of Spring must end!" announces <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>. "I renounce this perverse Disciple's mantle and shall join the <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> cause!"
body_header: With a pained grimace, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> ponders <<o:EventPlayer>> moral quandaries for what feels like the longest instance ever obliged upon <hyperlink>Duatha</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "Spring is the bloom after death's embrace," quotes <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> in humming song, "The hope of new life, before the lengthening of days. The call to sprout and break the fast; for all living things to strengthen, at last." Swallowing <<o:EventPlayer>> hurts, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> concludes, "<hyperlink><eventColor>{FeyGodName}</eventColor></hyperlink> urged us to break our fast unyielding; as befits the predator in Spring... But this has crippled our game of its fair chance to repopulate!"
button_0: Celebrate joyfully on the streets! <happiness></happiness>
button_3: Celebrate with a grand picnic! <food></food>
button_4: Celebrate with a bold military parade! <morale></morale>
title: Disciple No More

body_footer: Henceforth, your will is no longer your own! And though <<p:PlayerLeader>> might sinisterly smile on the outside, inside, <<p:PlayerLeader>> was silently screaming to be released...
body_header: Upon signing the contract, a dark and sinister laugh echoes out from every corner of void about you. "I am pleased that you failed to read what was just signed..."
body_lore:
Then, the darkness overtakes you, and you feel your muscles atrophy, your mind obliterated, and your neck snap back as the dark laughter is all that you henceforth know and fear. Though you might try and fight it, there is no use... you just signed your free will over to Pseumodius, who now shall forever puppet your every move.

And thus, wherever {PlayerLeader.Name} was hereafter seen, <> were on a mission for their hated Demon Overlord...
button_0: Scream without words!
title: Your Will is No Longer Your Own!

body_footer: "See these here <<m:EventStructure>>? If you truly want to destroy the realm—and I know you do—I highly urge you to ignore everyone else and activate three of these instead..."
body_header: "Ah, drat, you are a reader," snaps a much different voice than before, "I hate readers... Well now, perhaps you are not as witless as you appear."
body_lore: <<g:façade,<eventColor>{Liztia}</eventColor>>> drops like a silken cloth and underneath appears a strangely familiar face. "Allow me to introduce myself, <eventColor>{Frikka.Name}</eventColor>, we might have met before on <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink> or elsewhere. Seeing how you are not interested in joining my ranks, perhaps you'd be more amenable to... poking your nose where it isn't welcomed? To, say—cause some 'highly catastrophic mischief,' hmm?"
button_0: "I will consider this."
button_5: "Wait, were you not the one who gave the Gildercoil away?"
button_6: "Why don't you show me the way?"
title: Abetting the Deceiver

frikka_prevailed: "Ah, tsk-tsk," cackles <eventColor>{Liztia}</eventColor> as <<p:Liztia>> wards off your advances. "A most admirable attempt, I must admit. Allow me to reward your efforts..."
frikka_unmasked: With a quick motion you dispel the magical disguise of your opponent, who steps back with a sinister laugh. "Most impressive!" booms another voice, "I suppose you refuse my Pact, then?"

body_footer: "Can you keep... a secret?" grins <eventColor>{Frikka.FirstName}</eventColor>, "A diabolically catastrophic secret, that is?"
body_header: Upon activating the last <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, a familiar voice appears again behind you. "My, my, haven't we been a busy little bee..."
body_lore: From the shadows, <eventColor>{Frikka.FirstName}</eventColor> appears with a sinister grin. "Rejoice, my wicked solicitant, for the tools of catastrophe will soon be at your fingertips."
button_0: "Go on, I'm listening..."
title: Abetting the Deceiver: Complete

body_footer: "Which reminds me, I should pursue that sultry old <hyperlink>Urvatogh</hyperlink>, now that he's subdued... " muses <eventColor>{Frikka.FirstName}</eventColor> to <<r:Frikka>>. "Anyway, how about those <<m:EventStructure>>?"
body_header: "Ha! I didn't 'give away' anything to anybody," grins <eventColor>{Frikka.FirstName}</eventColor>, as a dark, diabolical ghost of a laugh echoes out of the void around you.
body_lore: "No, I merely... 'planted it' upon the right <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> to claim the liability. <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink> needed to 'expire,' and who better to take the blame than an overly ambitious <hyperlink>Shad'raite</hyperlink>? Indeed, now the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> and the <hyperlink>Vampires</hyperlink>—and many more horrors besides—are freed again to press their vengeance upon the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>... and soon, we'll join the ranks. I mean—my <hyperlink>Overlord</hyperlink> will, of course."
button_0: "I will consider this."
title: Sowing Seeds of Deception

body_footer: "Calamitous temptations await your command," grins <eventColor>{Frikka.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Go, explore the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> that has just been revealed. And feel free to desecrate <eventColor>{EventStructure_B}</eventColor>, on the way..."
body_header: "Now then, as <hyperlink>Demonic Prince</hyperlink> of Deception, I know my marvelous reputation well precedes me," boasts <eventColor>{Frikka.FirstName}</eventColor>. "But what I am about to reveal to you is no lie, indeed..."
body_lore: "Remember that little welcome gift I promised you first?" continues <eventColor>{Frikka.FirstName}</eventColor>. "You passed my preliminary tests, which I put in place to ensure I entrust this 'highly classified information' to the right instrument... You see, a confidential cabal of <hyperlink>Demon Overlords</hyperlink> have long been plotting to escape the wretched Pact we signed with <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. And there's a little loophole we much desire to exploit."
button_0: "I will consider this."
button_5: "Why don't you show me the way?"
title: Calamitous Temptations

body_footer: "Did you know the Pact of the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> terminates if <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> should fail to protect <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>?" grins <eventColor>{Frikka.FirstName}</eventColor> maliciously. "I hereby gift you a legion of <<m:EventUnit>>, enjoy the wrecking."
body_header: With the hulking <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> rising all about you, and its key in your hand, a familiar presence again emerges from behind. "Thus, the long awaited Demonwake dawns..."
body_lore: Slow clapping, <eventColor>{Frikka.FirstName}</eventColor> emerges from the shadows. "Now the instructions you have been waiting for. All about us stands a vast prison complex of sinners, each of whom have pledged their mortal <hyperlink>soul</hyperlink> to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DemonicOverlordLoreConcept]Demon Overlord[/hyperlink], and perished since. We have secretly secured each from returning to<hyperlink>the Well of Creation</hyperlink>, and now this legions is wholly at our disposal for... truly despicable ends."
button_0: "Gladly."
title: Calamitous Temptations: Behold

body_footer: Wholly unrivaled, you are now both Chaos Manifest and Evil Incarnate upon <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink>! And this... well, this is only just the beginning.
body_header: Thus, an evil laughter bubbles up within you, the likes of which only <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> can arouse.
body_lore: Before you, the Hellion scourge emerge from hiding while Demons scramble about in chaotic turmoil. For their <hyperlink>Demonic Princes</hyperlink> are defeated and the <eventColor>{Ysariel.LastName}</eventColor> is banished to the Nether Realms—thus breaking the <hyperlink>Circle of Deogai</hyperlink> that long held the now thoroughly humiliated <hyperlink>Demon Overlords</hyperlink> in place. But, most heinous of all, the <eventColor>{Karissa.Title}</eventColor> is vanquished from this realm...
button_0: Laugh most maniacally!
title: Maniacal Aspect

body_footer: Wholly unrivaled, you are now both Shadow Made Flesh and Evil Incarnate upon <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink>! And this... well, this is only just the beginning.
button_0: Laugh most maleficiently!
title: Maleficence Aspect

body_footer:
"What say you, we finally unchain that old {Beast} of mine, for old-time's sake, while we set our sights on some repulsively, greener pastures abroad..." laughs {Balorboss}.

"And you, my Demonic <{Prince/Princess}>> of Evil shall lead the vanguard!"
body_header: DLC@SECRETSOFTHEARCHMAGES@STORY_EVENT@1229_1379@BODY_HEADER
body_lore: "You have made me mighty proud, my <hyperlink>Demonic <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Prince/Princess}</eventColor>>> of Evil</hyperlink>," booms the roaring voice of <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor> in your heart. "However, now that <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> is fully ours—and even <eventColor>{Ysariel.Title}</eventColor> is finally bubbling below—this realm has become... despicably lacking in Carnage potential. And I so detest a world without Carnage. In fact, now that the Pact of the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> is made undone, I say: all <hyperlink>Other Worlds</hyperlink> should be ours to subvert!"
button_0: Laugh most diabolically!
title: Royally Diabolic

body_footer: Your reign as Evil Incarnate upon <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> begins now, and thus your laughter shall fall upon
button_0: Laugh! Laugh aloud!
title: Evil Incarnate

body_footer: As the holy chorus slowly recedes from your consecrated soul, a Blessing of Order becomes yours to claim, and you wish for...
body_header: Suddenly, a distant chorus of Celestial magnificence graces your ears. As you focus upon its wordless song, a radiant sensation overcomes you wholly...
body_lore:
Then all the world fades into a brilliance so foreign to Obbadoth that it feels utterly inconceivable... and yet, it persists.

With it comes a consciousness of the cosmic affinity of Order, gracing your soul with arduous virtue and righteous purpose. In embracing this Higher Force, you know that an even greater reward is now bestowed upon you.
button_0: ...the forces of order <unit></unit> to strengthen your armies.
button_3: ... the ultimate affinity of order to be made available.
button_4: ... the highest wisdom of order to be bestowed upon you.
title: Graced by Higher Forces

order_bound: Then, you behold the Celestial chorus descending from above to strengthen your virtuous quest! And with it, a final boon is made available, and so you wish for...

body_footer: "Never use this spell, <eventColor>{Player.FirstName}</eventColor>," urges <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Pray, leave it sealed here— where it belongs."
body_header: Upon exiting the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> a familiar voice reaches out to you, weighed down with a deep sense of guilt. "I know of your exploits, <eventColor>{Player.FirstName}</eventColor>."
body_lore: "Understand..." continues <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>, "I was raised and devoted to <hyperlink>Archon ideals</hyperlink> since birth. Expulsion from Emnora... I did everything to reverse the resulting malediction. Yet, all I begot was the accursed essence of my purgatorial affliction. This heinous spell is its result. And though my <eventColor>{YsarielRace}</eventColor> adopted it willingly, its very existence mortifies me."
button_0: "I will consider this..."
button_3: "My Brother, I too shall share your burden."
title: Form of the Fallen

body_footer: Then, the sky rumbles overhead as an explosive flash erupts before your very eyes! From the blinding light two awesome figures clash: a mighty, dark angel and an ascended idol of fire.
body_header: As you arrive at the summoning point provided in the distress call of <eventColor>{Ysariel}</eventColor>, you are met by a roaring earthquake coming from the very bowels of this world.
body_lore: All about you in the boiling air, fierce demonic energies clash against the dim, straining spirit of Order, all whirled about in an elated cacophony of raging Chaos. <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> appears to be in an absolute state of turmoil as the earth quivers beneath your feet and the black clouds above your head race about in ominous patterns...
button_0: Peer through the bright flash.
button_1: "I swear my Soul to no man."
button_2: "Bring it! Smite me, you disgraced buffoon!"
button_3: (Ignore me, I'm just here to test the game.) | TEMP
title: Hail the Chaos

body_footer: Desperate, <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> turns to you, "Quickly <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, aid me in protecting <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>!" Gleefully, <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> charms you also, "No, no, my new favorite. Let's break it all—together."
body_header: Lo, before you, <eventColor>{Ysariel}</eventColor> clashes face-to-face with none other than <eventColor>{Karissa}</eventColor>!
body_lore:
"Back you foul Witch of Chaos!" growls {Ysariel.FirstName}, "By the Allfather, thou shalt not unmake my accursed Circle, nor release the Demon scum wholly upon the Astral Sea—begone!"
{Karissa.FirstName} licks <> lips and flashes <> maddening eyes. "Tsk, tsk, my handsome Ace," coaxes <>. "The Chaos Endailon invites all to break the old order. So go on, give up already; give in... to me."
button_0: Side with <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>.
button_4: Side with <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor>.
button_5: Side with neither, let them fight it out.
title: Pick Your Destiny

body_footer: <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> challenges you to swear an Unbreakable Pact of Brotherhood with <<P:Ysariel>>, or threatens you with righteous violence, if you refuse. How do you respond?
body_header: With an explosion of fire, <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> is slain, though not defeated. After a brief pause to catch <<o:Ysariel>> breath, <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> lands before you in all his fallen glory—and <<p:Ysariel>> salutes you.
body_lore: "Welcome to <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink>, <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>," acknowledges <<p:Ysariel>> . "You have heeded my summons, for this I offer you my gratitude. However, be you my <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>, or be you my enemy? Prove your intent now: swear a 'Pact of Brotherhood' with me—swear it upon your immortal soul—so we may restore the forsaken order of the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>, together. But if you dare refuse me, I shall smite you down!"
button_0: "By my soul I swear it: We shall be Brothers!"
button_1: "I swear my soul to no man; yet I vow to restore order." <goodact></goodact>
button_2: "Bring it! Smite me you disgraced buffoon!" <evilact></evilact>
button_3: Join <<g:side,Karissa.FirstName>>.
button_4: Challenge <eventColor>{Karissa.Name}</eventColor> instead!
title: <eventColor>{Ysariel.LastName}</eventColor>

karissa_bound: <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> turns around and winks at you with a hot sigh. "Well, my big <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{boy/girl}</eventColor>>>, are you coming, or what?"

With a blaze and a curse, <eventColor>{Ysariel}</eventColor> burns to ash before <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> who savors <<o:Ysariel>> incineration with heated breaths. "Until next time, my handsome Ace..."

<eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> grabs a handful of <<o:Ysariel>> ashes, softly kisses it in <<o:Karissa>> hand before blowing it into the air. Without even acknowledging you, <<p:Karissa>> turns away, walks up to the edge of the crater, and basks in the heat of <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> for a moment. Then <<p:Karissa>> stretches her arms wide and releases a wild Scream of Chaos, so loud it reverberates across the realm!

body_footer: Thus you behold the <hyperlink>Circle of 1229</hyperlink>, a vast, ancient, diabolical capitol of chaos, carnage, and infernal magicks.
body_header: Nearing the central underground domain, all are overcome by the searing heat of the underworld, and the rancid stench of sulfur and burning flesh.
body_lore: At the very center of the vast cavernous reach there suffers the '<eventColor>{Beast}</eventColor>.' A Hellion titan, who is believed to have once fought against the <hyperlink>Demon Overlords</hyperlink> in ages long past. But now, it is chained up and tortured for all eternity. All about it, the furious maddened sounds of battle echo out from every corner of the Pit—the mad Carnage Ritual which all Demonkin here partake to appease their infernal masters.
button_0: "I am going to need a bigger army..." <unitprod></unitprod>
button_1: Study this devilish atmosphere intently. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_2: Tap into <mana></mana> the chaotic atmosphere of the Pit. <chaos></chaos>
title: Behold: 1229!

button_3: Revel in the carnage, you are home!

body_footer: While the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> shatters behind <<P:Karissa>>, <<g:face,<eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor>>> warps from breathtaking beauty to maddening fury all in the span of a heartbeat—and you...
body_header: Upon nearing <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, a sight like no other burns into your retinas: <eventColor>{Karissa}</eventColor> <eventColor>{Karissa.Title}</eventColor> has arrived here before you!
body_lore: "Oh, you savage animal, you want to rip me apart," <<p:Karissa>> observes, "I can see it in your eyes, <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>. Go on, give into the fury, the lust, it is divine! I should know; the <hyperlink>Chaos Endailon</hyperlink> released me and I can do so for you too. For I am she: no mere Aspect, oh no, the Chaos, it is me! And this neutered world shall soon know my revolution and be reborn by it! Ha! Hahaha!"
button_0: ... Give in, scream! Scream in fury! <chaos></chaos>
button_1: ... Avert your eyes from temptation. <goodact></goodact>
button_2: ... Swallow the rage. <mana></mana>
button_3: ... Cut through the ravishment: attack!
button_4: ... Call your Sworn Brother to your side!
title: Come Closer

body_footer: "Go, rebuild the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>," commands <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. "And should you ever face darkness or temptation within the Pit, then call upon me: <eventColor>{Ysariel.Name}</eventColor>, thy sworn Brother!"
body_header: "<eventColor>{Player.FirstName}</eventColor>, my <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>!" exclaims <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> as <<p:Ysariel>> embraces you firmly. "Together, we are now the last line of defense against the total outburst of evil upon the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>."
body_lore: "Since the destruction of <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink>," laments <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>, "the heinous forces of the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> are again returned to the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. Thus, the <hyperlink>Chaos Endailon</hyperlink> has sent forth its vile Aspect to wreak havoc here upon the realm—whose order it is my lonesome charge to uphold. And yea, that <eventColor>{Karissa.Title}</eventColor> be a wicked witch, most foul! <<Cp:Karissa>> must ultimately be slain, for the Pact of the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> to hold. But first; I urge you to claim a seat at my <hyperlink>fractured Circle</hyperlink>..."
button_0: "<eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>, my Brother. Until we meet again."
button_5: "Wait, first tell me what to expect in <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>."
button_6: "By the highest forces of Order <order></order>, I pledge to restore this Circle!"
title: We Are the Last Line

order_bound: "Go, rebuild the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>," commands <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. "But should you bear challenge to the sanctity of my <hyperlink>Circle</hyperlink>, then I shall smite you down!"

<eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> stares at you with wide, vicious eyes shimmering with the fractured light of order. "Have you come to deliver us from evil? Fool, <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> will destroy you—but I shall refuse no aid."

body_footer: "Normally, the <hyperlink>Overlords</hyperlink> never leave their seats unclaimed, especially not the five Chain Cities that hold the <eventColor>{Beast}</eventColor>..." <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> stares off in a brooding mood, "They are plotting something, I can sense it..."
body_header: With the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> in your possession, <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> again descends from above and smiles a faint, warm smile, "Well done, my <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>, welcome to the <hyperlink>Circle of the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor></hyperlink>."
body_lore: "This Seat is normally reserved for the Chief <hyperlink>Demonic Prince</hyperlink> of <hyperlink><eventColor>{Bealoroth}</eventColor></hyperlink>," explains <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Long ago, I granted each <hyperlink>Overlord</hyperlink> the right to seat their chosen champions at this <hyperlink>Circle of Deogai</hyperlink>. Eleven seats there were once, though only four now remain... 'Tis the product of the vile <eventColor>{Karissa.Title}</eventColor>—who has wrecked the Pit with <<p:Karissa>> ceaseless foray—yet, I also suspect some foul ploy on the part of the Overlords...
button_0: "What next, my Brother?"
button_2: "Tell me more about this Circle."
title: Bound By Carnage

order_bound: With the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> in your possession, <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> again descends from above with a cynical frown. "You succeeded... somehow. Fortune favors you, for now..."
"What next?"

body_footer: The awesome and terrible presence of a <hyperlink>Demon Overlord</hyperlink> reaches out to you from the infernal depths of the <hyperlink>Obbadothan Nether Realms</hyperlink>. Lo, it is <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>!
body_header: Upon entering the smoking ruins of <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, a scream comes out at you that shakes the very Azh'Ruun Pit to crumble!
body_lore:
"Run, fool! Run! <> is coming for you!" the voices of a thousand Imps shout out in wicked glee, before their hellish chorus fades into a singular, booming roar that drowns out all:

"Bwahaha! Too late, you wretched gremlin! It is I: {Balorboss}, <> whom mortals call {Bealoroth}—Overlord of Overlords, Ruler of the terrible Nether Realms that lie beneath Obbadoth, and Chiefest of all Evils! Behold, puny Godir, fear me and despair!" roars <>—terribly so.
button_0: Tremble! Despair! <unit></unit>
button_3: Stand your ground. <influence></influence>
button_4: "Pha! I laugh in the face of Evil." <goodact></goodact>
title: Baloric Phenomenon

body_footer: <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink> erupts in a laughter that rocks the cavern floor, "Bwahaha! If you want the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, then sell me your damned soul for it, fool. Me; <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>, Overlord of Overlords!"
body_header: "Oh, crud! You? Stand against me? Me, <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink>? Get out of here! Go on, shoo!" bellows the <hyperlink>Demon Overlord</hyperlink>. "Hold now, you are actually serious? You stand... against—ME?!"
body_lore: "Bwahahaha! You got guts, kiddo!" grunts <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink>. "I like guts in my flesh-bound minions. What say you, we make a little deal, eh? You sell me your wretched soul, and in return I shall grant you <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and the awesome Power of Balors! Which is mine to command! Me! For I am <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>, Demon Overlord of Overlords upon <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink>, and Chiefest of all Evils!"
button_0: "<eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>, my Infernal Master! At last, I have found you!" <evilact></evilact>
button_4: "I do not fear you! This city shall be mine."
button_5: Call upon your Sworn Brother, <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> to aid you.
button_6: Pray to the Higher Forces of Order for protection!
title: Pact With the <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>

karissa_bound: The scorn of <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink> roars across the Pit: "Perish before the power of <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>, you wretched gremlin. Go get <<P:PlayerLeader>> boys! Bwahahaha!"

ysariel_bound: "Oh, crud! You? Stand against me? <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink>? Get out of here! Go on, shoo!" bellows <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>, before stopping with a hellish grunt. "Wait. You are... actually... 'pactbound' to that brat, <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>?"

karissa_bound: "Bwahahaha! Oh I see," bellows <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink>, "You are cuckolded by my new nemesis, the <hyperlink>Chaos Endailon</hyperlink>! And now you think yourself a real big-shot, eh? Well, his <eventColor>{Karissa.Title}</eventColor> may have ruined my <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>... and defeated that weakling <hyperlink>Demonic Prince</hyperlink> who I assigned to it, earlier... and... and all: BUT I DON'T CARE!"
ysariel_bound: "Pha!" grunts  <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink>, "<eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>? That delusional savior? No one takes <<P:Ysariel>> seriously, anymore. And why should we? If it wasn't for that wretched pact we signed—after the Hellion Wars—why, <<p:Ysariel>>'d be smoldering in hellfire by now! Though, I got to admit, that boy knows <<o:Ysariel>> way with the sword. Oh yeah, <<p:Ysariel>> has kept the Carnage going for... duh... eons? Ages? I lost count—and also, I don't care! <<Co:Ysariel>> death is nigh! And <<o:Ysariel>> pitiable, wretched soul is mine! Mine, you hear me? MINE!"

body_footer: "Go forth, my Minion! Slay them! Slay them all, dammit, I cannot wait to see you do it!" applauds <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink>. "Here, take <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and make me proud! I BELIEVE IN YOU, KID! Wreck 'em all good for me!"
body_header: "Oh, crud! You are serious! Bwahahahaha! YES! Yes! Yeah!" booms the voice of <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink> through the chasm of the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>. "All souls belong to me! For I am <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>!!"
body_lore: "We're gonna do this!" shouts <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink>. "Listen up kid, this Pit is mine! Mine I tell you! And there is nothing I hate more than a world WITHOUT CARNAGE! You hereby signed your wicked soul over to me—and so bind an Unbreakable Pact with a mighty Demon Overlord from the great terror world, that is the Netherrealms of Obbadoth! Serve me well, and the Power of Balors shall be yours to command!"
button_0: "Hail <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>! My Demon Overlord!" <evilact></evilact>
button_2: "Wait, not my soul? What have I done?!"
title: Pact With <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>: Signed and Sealed

body_footer: And suddenly, the presence of the <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink> vanishes from the Pit. Just like that.
body_header: With a warcry that rocks the Pit, <eventColor>{Ysariel.Name}</eventColor> descends from above: "Be gone, foul demon! Remember our Pact!" <<p:Ysariel>> shouts, as <<p:Ysariel>> swoops down with <<o:Ysariel>> bright, flaming sword in hand!
body_lore: It remains awfully silent as it seems <hyperlink><eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor></hyperlink> is reluctant to answer... But then <<p:Balorboss>> shouts out aloud: "CRUD! Crud! Cruuuuuuuuud!" roars <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>. "Damn you, <eventColor>{Player.FirstName}</eventColor>! The Pact of <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> prevents me from slaying a Sworn <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>> of <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>! Damn <<P:Ysariel>>! Damn <<o:Ysariel>> pitiable, wretched soul! It is mine! MINE! Mine, I tell you!—Wuaaaaargh!"
button_0: "Good riddance! <eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor> is defeated."
button_3: Shrug in indifference. | DEPRECATED
button_4: "<eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>? My Master, no! Return to me, please!" <evilact></evilact> | DEPRECATED
title: Ysariel Summoned: Pissed Angel!

body_footer: "Hold the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> at all cost," commands <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>, "then fuel this realm with Carnage! Aye, 'tis a wicked quest, but take heart my <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>, thine prey be the scum of chaos; so show them no mercy!"
body_header: The <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> keeps the <eventColor>{Beast}</eventColor> in place, while the Carnage Ritual keeps the <hyperlink>Demon Overlords</hyperlink> at bay. These are the duties upheld by the <hyperlink>Circle of <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor></hyperlink>.
body_lore: "The <hyperlink>Great Evils</hyperlink> of this place are contained here by the pact I signed with them, long ago," scorns <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. "<hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> is an ancient and powerful <hyperlink>World</hyperlink>, whose diabolical magic comes from the repulsive energies of Carnage. It feeds the Overlords and thus sates them enough to remain here. But, should the Carnage Ritual ever cease... then our pact shall be made undone. And the Demon Overlords shall be freed from the confines to, once again, sate their vile hunger upon the <hyperlink>Worlds Within</hyperlink>!"
button_0: "Trust in me, my Brother!"
button_5: "I will consider this."
title: Show Them No Mercy

order_bound: "Hold the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> at all cost," commands <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>, "then fuel this realm with Carnage! And remember, thine prey be the scum of Chaos; so show them no mercy!"
"It will be done."

body_footer: With the currents stabilized a grim realization dawns on you both. "Our labor is not yet completed," acknowledges <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. "It is time we rid this precarious order of its final threat."
body_header: With the last sacrifice of Carnage made, an alien tranquility betides the Pit, followed by stern praise, "Glory be, <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>," chimes <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>, "the duty is done."
body_lore: For a strange, still moment, <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> and you can clearly comprehend the vile magical currents of <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> harmonize. In so doing, Ysariel's breathing deepens into bitterness. "I have not sensed such order in the Pit like this for a long time..." laments Ysariel, with a grim sigh, "It—angers me somehow, yet I do not know why."
button_0: Draw upon the strange, stabilized aura of tranquil Carnage. <mana></mana>
button_4: Let your scholars study this perfect paradox of orderly chaos. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_5: Pray to Higher Forces for protection in the upcoming battle. <unit></unit>
title: Show Them No Mercy: Ritual Sated

order_bound: With the last sacrifice of Carnage made, an alien tranquility betides <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>. While the chaotic energies of carnage paradoxically tranquilize in a strange, orderly way, <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> appears silently beside you.

body_footer: "Yea, <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>," admits <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> fiercely, "I battled the Hellions beside the <hyperlink>Demon Overlords</hyperlink> to earn their trust. And upon our victory, I stated my case, and bargained... and bargained, until they relented. Thus, Throne I became. Though, my false brothers in Emnora spat me out for it!"
body_header: <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> eyes you with a deep rooted spot of sorrow. "After the <hyperlink>Cataclysms</hyperlink> that shook the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> sought to contain the unchecked powers of wizards and their calamitous ilk."
body_lore: "<hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> was an utter cesspool of wickedness, back in those days," curses <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Ceaseless, was the warring of Demons and Hellions, and all the Carnage fed them all with incredible power. Left to their own devices, the spawn of evil threatened to outrival even the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>! Thus, I came here, intent on establishing a <hyperlink>Circle of Deogai</hyperlink> that might control the scourge. Alas, that the High Council already had forsaken this mission, long ere it ever began... Still, I persisted. And, against all odds, I achieved what none in Emnora thought possible!"
button_0: "What next, my Brother?"
button_3: "Even the worthiest cause may be undone by wicked deeds." <order></order>
title: Deliberations of Evil

order_bound: <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> glances at you sideways with a secretive scornful frown. "The rest is history, I am now Throne of a <hyperlink>Circle of paramount importance</hyperlink>, and we must forthwith restore it."

body_footer: "Yea, the <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink> has struck the hour!" cheers <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> Judgment is come for the <eventColor>{Karissa.Title}</eventColor>. Let us expel <<P:Karissa>> forthwith!"
body_header: "Go now, <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>" affirms <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> with a cordial smile. "For it is not yet the time for celebrations and partings."
body_lore: "Now is the hour that we must strike the <eventColor>{Karissa.Title}</eventColor>" proclaims <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Though <<p:Karissa>> might be an immortal <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, <<o:Karissa>> defeat here shall banish <<o:Karissa>> spirit from <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> and so allow us to seal <<o:Karissa>> away for good."
button_0: "Judgment cometh!"
title: Onwards to Victory

body_footer: <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> sniffles away <<o:Ysariel>> hot tears, as <<p:Ysariel>> stands before you. "I relieve you of our Pact, my valiant <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>. Go now from this wretched place. Yet... though you be free, know this: I shall pray in earnest that we might meet again, one day."
body_header: "<<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>!" exclaims <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> as <<p:Ysariel>> races forward to embrace you. "Glory! Glory, we have done it! We have saved the Pit, and you have saved us all!"
body_lore: <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> suddenly stops before you, trembling all over. "Yea, thus my labor as Throne continues, and my sacrifices were not in vain... thanks to your efforts. All the <hyperlink>Worlds Within</hyperlink> should owe you their eternal gratitude, though they likely will never show it. But hearken to this <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>, silent deeds of righteousness are the foundation upon which all bright futures are built. Regardless, I bid you go forth and take pride; boldly tell others of our deeds here today."
button_0: Embrace your Brother, one last time.
title: Forsaken, yet Unbroken

order_bound: "Go, tell them of your victory here today. I shall continue my solemn watch of  as its Throne." With that, <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> reaches out <<o:Ysariel>> hand and regards you with reverence.
As the old order returns to <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Ysariel.Name}</eventColor> presents himself before you with a solemn frown and a curious twitch in his cheek.

"<eventColor>{Player.Name}</eventColor>," begins <<p::Ysariel>> "I was wrong about you. You did what I could not... Resist the pull of evil, persist against all odds, and thus establish a virtuous order upon a realm bound by malicious chaos." <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> pauses for a moment to swallow <<o:Ysariel>> pride and swelling tears. "You have indeed come to deliver us all from evil and for this, I am ever grateful. As, I am sure, all the Worlds Within will be."

button_2: "Order has been restored on Obbadoth."

order_bound: Unyielding Virtue
""Yea, the <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink> has struck the hour! Judgment is come for the <eventColor>{Karissa.Title}</eventColor>. Expel <<P:Karissa>> forthwith!"
"Go forth, ye Paragon of Order," commands <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> with swallowed pride, "the Pit still needs our blades drawn."

body_footer: <eventColor>{Istarnech.FirstName}</eventColor> looms slowly closer to consume your gold <gold></gold>, even where you stand! With molten, gold-froth on <<o:Istarnech>> lips, <<p:Istarnech>> grumbles, "Gold... Gold! Insatiable is the hunger of Istarnech!"
body_header: The earth rumbles to footsteps the weight of mountains. Thus, you behold the protector of the <eventColor>{IstarnechCapital}</eventColor>. <<Cp:Istarnech>> who rejected the <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink> and stole the knowledge from the <hyperlink>Eternal Council</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{Istarnech.FirstName}</eventColor> hungers for your gold!" bellows the fiery <hyperlink>Giant</hyperlink>. "Your gold, yes! Consume it, I must! Never there is enough. No... never. All is fuel for 'the Eternal Need,' my <hyperlink>Demon Overlord of Avarice</hyperlink>—she, who is born out of pride! [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TraitorKingsLoreConcept]Traitor King[/hyperlink] of <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>, men call me—<hyperlink>Demonic Prince of Greed</hyperlink>. <eventColor>{Istarnech.Name}</eventColor> is my name, and your damned gold, I must devour!"
button_0: "Here, take my gold <gold></gold>. Eat it!" <evilact></evilact>
button_3: "Hmmm, maybe just... a little gold <gold></gold>?"
button_4: "Hold! Take this trinket, instead." | DEPRECATED
button_5: "Starve, foul Traitor King!"
title: Rex Hoarder: Beware His Wolves!

body_footer: <eventColor>{Walburgis.FirstName}</eventColor> stands before you, and <<p:Walburgis>> is foul! Foul to behold, but oh so desirable. For <<o:Walburgis>> power! The power that <<p:Walburgis>> can grant you? It is irresistible... or is it? The choice is yours:
body_header: Just like that, <eventColor>{Walburgis.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Walburgis.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{WalburgisRace}</eventColor> and protector of the <eventColor>{WalburgisCapital}</eventColor> appears before you.
body_lore: A soft, fatherly voice speaks from behind you, it whispers: "Do you offer me love? Or do you offer me war?" The <eventColor>{Walburgis.LastName}</eventColor> speaks to you without making a sound, even though a vile spume of black blood gurgles out of <<o:Walburgis>> filthy, filthy mouth as it eerily stutters along to the words caressing in your ears.
button_0: "I offer you love <influence></influence>, not war!" <evilact></evilact>
button_3: Do not answer him...
button_4: "Nothing but war, never love!"
title: You Will Not Be Saved!

body_footer: <<Cp:DaDaYo>> looks at you and grins the grin of a devil, then <<p:DaDaYo>> shouts out aloud: "Idle hands are my favorite plaything, so let me whip them up for you."
body_header: <eventColor>{DaDaYo.Name}</eventColor> and protector of <eventColor>{DaDaYoCapital}</eventColor> jumps before you at the crack of a whip! <<Cp:DaDaYo>> looks at you and smiles a broad, toothy smile the size of a shark's mouth.
body_lore: "Welcome to the Infernal Jungle, pup," grins <eventColor>{DaDaYo.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Here, we always welcome fresh meat, because they all grind down so easily! Save for absolute loafers and lazybones, the despicable taint of which I sense to be awfully present amongst your <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor>..."
button_0: Refuse <eventColor>{DaDaYo.FirstName}</eventColor> near your people.
button_3: "<eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor>! My Sworn Brother!"
button_4: "<eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor>! My One and Only Mistress!"
button_5: "<eventColor>{Balorboss}</eventColor>! My Demon Overlord!" <evilact></evilact>
button_6: "Stay your whip, foul fiend. To war!"
button_7: Allow <eventColor>{DaDaYo.FirstName}</eventColor> to grind a segment of your people down... <evilact></evilact>
title: Breakneck Bustler

body_footer: "After all," whispers <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> as <<o:Ysariel>> soul erupts in flame, "who cares if my star should fade... in a <hyperlink>sea of millions</hyperlink>..."
body_header: Without any warning, the flickering presence of <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> enters your awareness. <<Cp:Ysariel>> is defeated, yet strangely, <<o:Ysariel>> soul slowly burns out of existence.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{Player.FirstName}</eventColor>..." the flickering voice of <eventColor>{Ysariel.FirstName}</eventColor> speaks to you. "I have failed... My mission ends now, and with it, my sinful soul must finally burn in the Nether Realms, for I signed it away to <hyperlink><eventColor>{Bealoroth}</eventColor></hyperlink> to earn my throne of torment... Our mission is lost, <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>. Go, abandon all, while you still can! Warn <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink> and leave me to my doom..."
button_0: Abandon all hope.
button_3: "Well, I certainly don't."
button_4: "Bwahaha, Balorboss awaits you arrival Fallen Archon. Burn!"
title: One Less Light

body_footer: <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> flashes <<o:Karissa>> maddening eyes. "Show me your <chaos></chaos> <hyperlink>Chaos Affinity</hyperlink>, big <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{boy/girl}</eventColor>>>: give in to it completely, then scream your heart out into its cosmic blaze! We'll find each other there..."
body_header: You walk up to <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> who bites <<o:Karissa>> lip with a wicked grin to see you. "Hmm... Do you have what it takes? I cannot yet tell, how... 'exciting.'"
body_lore: "Ah. Chaos," sighs <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor>, releasing <<o:Karissa>> lip, "this world is brimming with it, yet its true potential has long been neutered by the stranglehold of Order. I have come to break its chains, and all are welcome to join. Yes, everyone, even you! Yes... well... if you can handle the heat—if you can handle... me." Karissa takes a suggestive step back as her whole body ignites in flames.
button_0: "I will find you there!"
button_5: Release a wild Scream of Chaos!
button_6: "There is not enough room on Obbadoth for us both. Test me at your peril!"
title: Fiery Overture

body_footer: <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> flashes <<o:Karissa>> eyes and pouts <<o:Karissa>> lips in feigned innocence. "How would you like to... tear asunder all of <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink>, and rebirth it—together—with me?"
body_header: Upon expanding your <chaos></chaos> <hyperlink>Chaos Affinity</hyperlink>, a hot, familiar sensation caresses your mind. And with a wild whoosh of flame and mad cackles, <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> appears again before you.
body_lore: "Yes!" cheers <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> as <<Cp:Karissa>> fixes <<P:Karissa>> whole attention onto you. "Oh, my Roaring One," teases <<p:Karissa>>, "I just now sensed your distinct, vigorous signature in the great cosmic blaze and instantly knew you had stayed true..." <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> glances away with a queer smile while <<p:Karissa>> toes the floor, before concluding in a whisper, "...to me."
button_0: "I would love nothing more!"
button_2: Demand <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> to explain <<r:Karissa>>.
button_3: "Cease your farcical advances, vixen. I shall destroy this realm alone!"
title: Chaos Hurlant

chaos_hurlant: <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> stands back with awe as she beholds your wild Scream of Chaos, before flashing <<o:Karissa>> ravenous eyes at you.

"Yes..." <<p:Karissa>> snarls, "Yes! Give it to me, my Roaring One. You are the stimulant I have been longing for, another Primal Being brimming with pure chaos! I just love it! Oh, how I love to hear you roar... for me: for '<eventColor>{Karissa.LastName}</eventColor>.'"

body_footer: "So we burn it!" laughs <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Raze and dismantle the five Chain Cities holding their <eventColor>{Beast}</eventColor> in place! Then we unleash it upon <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> and burn this <hyperlink>Circle</hyperlink> down! Burn it all down!"
body_header: <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> cackles louder and louder until <<o:Karissa>> furious love fills your heart. Through it, a liberating spirit flares up from within, maddening you with an uncontrollable, violent urge to rage!
body_lore: "Yes! Yes! Yes!!" screams <eventColor>{Karissa.FirstName}</eventColor> with a deranged grin. "Let's skip the coquetry my Roaring One. <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> was once a world utterly rife with chaos, but since the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> choked the virility out of it, why; the Fiends here have become but... impotent little imps. All ages since, the sullen tyranny of 'Archon Order' has subdued the true potential out of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, and this simply can no longer do..."
button_0: "Yes, I love it!"
title: Break the Chains: For the Fury!

body_footer: As the <eventColor>{Beast}</eventColor> regrows its strength, and <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> lies in shambles, a great sensation of ruinous pride enters your heart. Victory is near.
body_header: With all the Chains broken, the <eventColor>{Beast}</eventColor> writhes and roars in its Pit. Ages of torment have weekend the Hellion Titan, but—in time—its power shall be regained.
body_lore: "Wicked fool!" shouts the anguished voice of <eventColor>{Ysariel.Name}</eventColor>, "You know not what you have done! This act spells doom for the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> at large, do you not see this? Soon, the Demons shall again feast upon the <hyperlink>Worlds Within</hyperlink> without mercy. However, so long as my Throne still stands. <hyperlink>Allfather's</hyperlink> wrath shall be rendered upon you!"
button_0: Laugh <morale></morale> at <<o:Ysariel>> misfortune and empty threats.
title: Unfettered and Furious

ysariel_defeated: "Wicked fool!" screams the anguished spirit of <eventColor>{Ysariel.Name}</eventColor> out from the fiery abyss below, "You know not what you have done! This act spells doom for the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> at large, do you not see this? Soon, the Demons shall again feast upon the <hyperlink>Worlds Within</hyperlink> without mercy. And made enemy of the <hyperlink>Demonic Overlords</hyperlink>. They shall come for you, as will the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>!"

body_footer: "Though we must not underestimate <eventColor>{Symon}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> adds, still agitated. "<<Cp:Symon>> has become a true master of the arcane."
body_header: From within the turmoil of the swarming ethereal armies of the Eldritch Leviathan, a single voice calls out to <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, gentle and familiar.
body_lore:
"{EventPlayer}, my love," the voice says, while the figure of an Elven woman —{EventHero}!— comes into focus. "Why did you leave me on the Cliffs of Sordünn? We could have lived... happily ever after."

But lo! It is only an Astral apparition, mocking reflection of <{EventPlayer.FirstName}>>. For a long moment {EventPlayer} is struck motionless, with unseeing eyes. But then they light up with anger. "That foolish boy," <> grumbles, while waving about as if it could disperse the illusion. "Those years of isolation must have untaught all <> manners."
button_0: Prepare to deal with <<ge:phantasms,<eventColor>{Symon.FirstName}</eventColor>>>.
title: Love and Mirrors

body_footer: "Receive the <eventColor>{EventTome}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> declares solemnly. "May it aid you in ending this crisis."
body_header: Only moments after <eventColor>{Symon}</eventColor> left, disappointed, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> reaches out to you.
body_lore:
"I am glad, {PlayerLeader}," {EventPlayer} says with a smile, "that it was you who sought me out on that barren Astral island. For not many would have breasted the waves of the Eldritch Leviathan like you did, nor resisted <{Symon.FirstName}>>."

"I was never your master, my friend, but I have one last arcane secret to offer. Knowledge, that for ages was only reserved for the chairmen of the Circle of Deogai."
button_0: Accept the <eventColor>{EventTome}</eventColor>.
button_3: Ask <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> to indulge in your own arcane research <knowledge></knowledge> instead.
title: Cosmic Initiation

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> is breaking <<ge:spell,<eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>>>, waking up the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>!
body_header: The <hyperlink>Astral Flows</hyperlink> start to converge near <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, where the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> rests in enchanted sleep. They carry the echoes of <<ge:voice,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>>:
body_lore:
"Disperse, Astral anchor,
let the mana flow unbound.
Shower the sleeper in the sea
with the shards of your falling star.
How disenchanting!"
button_0: Hurry up with the creation of new Astral anchors.
title: Astral Disjunction

switched_sides: Continue your assault on the remaining Anchor Cities.

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> collapses, <<o:EventPlayer>> chronosphere rolling down a slope.
body_header: With all <<o:EventPlayer>> illusions and magical wards shattered, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> <<r:EventPlayer>> breaks down on <<o:EventPlayer>> knees.
body_lore:
"I guess that's it," <> calls out, gasping for breath. "Serves me right for trying to be the good kid for too long. Did you ever baby-sit a Leviathan?" {EventPlayer} tries to laugh, but <> voice cracks.

"But now our fates are too intertwined; I cannot leave. It's a shame—I'll never reach that Empire... of the Ex..."
button_0: "It is over."
title: The Broken Avatar

body_footer: What remains is the image of <<ge:perturbed face,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>>, like you first saw it on that barren isle within the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, imprinted on your memory.
body_header: Encircled by nightmares and enemies, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, the dethroned arbiter of Evermore, closes <<o:EventPlayer>> eyes to meditate.
body_lore:
The tentacles underneath <{EventPlayer.FirstName}>>, previously kept calm and in check, suddenly lash out in all directions. Yet they become obstructed by a barrier of light sparking up around {EventPlayer} within a split second.

This sphere of confinement, where Urrath's hold assaults the labyrinthine wards of <{EventPlayer.FirstName}>>, floats up into the air like a bubble, until it vanishes through an Astral Rift.
button_0: "We have failed..."
button_1: "It was a necessary sacrifice."
title: Abjuration Sphere

body_footer: From <<ge:broken staff,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>>, rampant vines begin to sprout, growing into vegetal shelters around <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> and other <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. The shelters pulse with a green light; thereafter left empty.
body_header: Seeing <<o:EventPlayer>> kindred scattered and slain <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> sends out a final prayer to <<o:EventPlayer>> goddess.
body_lore:
"O Great Mother," <> supplicates, "the Eldritch Leviathan, bane of the Draconians, has returned to wreak havoc on your children. We fought hard to subdue it, but its power is beyond our own, crushing all resistance."

{EventPlayer.FirstName} musters <> last strength to ram <> staff into the ground. "I beseech you, Great Mother, save those unworthy of your grace!"
button_0: They are with the Grovetender now.
title: Grovetender's Mercy

body_footer: The sanguine barrier implodes, taking <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> to <<o:EventPlayer>> phylactery beyond Evermore.
body_header: Even with <<o:EventPlayer>> limbs dangling from a twisted and mangled body, the skull of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> still shows a vicious smile.
body_lore: "We are wasting our time here," <<p:EventPlayer>> declares, while drawing in blood from the surrounding sunless lands. "The Horn of the Dead remains untraceable—for now. But death is patient; it will be reclaimed eventually." The conjured blood coalesces around <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>, forming a sanguine barrier. "Despair not, my mindless minions," <<p:EventPlayer>> ends <<o:EventPlayer>> speech, "for you will rise again in my name when the next Blood Moon dawns."
button_0: Damned be that lich.
title: Death Eternal

body_footer: "If you want to find me, ask your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> friends about Gylamir." Then <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> teleports away to the Leviathan, disappearing into the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>.
body_header: Evermore bursts asunder as the Eldritch Leviathan rises from its ancient sleep.
body_lore:
Now that the creature can be seen in its full otherworldly splendor, everything beside it is reduced to insignificance.
