Even the ruins of the mighty Wizard's Throne are like dust lost in the gills of this behemoth. As the shockwave of destruction approaches you, you notice a warding sphere spanning around yourself, protection yet prison at once.

{EventPlayer} comes into focus, showing an exculpatory gesture. "I'll admit it," <> says laughing, "I have trust issues. But don't feel sour; I won't forget that I owe you one."
button_0: Curse that little weasel.
button_1: Remember <<o:EventPlayer>> last words, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> owes you; big-time.
title: Awakening

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> raises <<o:EventPlayer>> grimoire and you feel yourself being pulled away, rushing through <hyperlink>Astral Currents</hyperlink> until you see that barren rock where you first found <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>...
body_header: Producing a last, dulled squeal, the Eldritch Leviathan comes to rest beneath Evermore, returning to its deep slumber.
body_lore:
"It is done," {EventPlayer} declares, the tentacles underneath <> coat calmly adrift. "Now the time of vigil will begin; while someone needs to attend to poor {Symon}. <> collapsed the moment the Leviathan fell silent."

"As for you, {PlayerLeader}, it seems the trust in you was misplaced. I suggest you think about what you did today."
button_0: This is the end of this journey.
title: Deep Slumber

body_footer: Footer
body_header: Hiding in their fortified burrows, the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> at last recognize the familiar faces among your troops and send forth their leader, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
"Bless the lords of plenty!" {EventHouseLord} calls out overjoyed, hugging those who can't escape <> reach. "We heard of your grand feats against the Pale Ones in this undelightful, so very undelightful time of strife. You are surely looking for our heroic protector, Mister {EventPlayer}? You will find him down the tunnel {EventDirection} {EventHouse}."

"But before you hurry along," {EventHouseLord} adds quickly, as if <> truly feared your departure, "I must insist that you taste our {EventFood}! It's due time for luncheon after all."
button_0: Inspect <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> for further negotiations—and <eventColor>{EventFood}</eventColor>.
button_2: End the conversation with <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> for now.
title: Meeting Hard-Pressed <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>

body_footer: A nightshade sprouts, enclosing <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> in a single black berry. Then the berry disappears—plucked by the fading voice of Onoka, Queen of Whispers.
body_header: With <<o:EventPlayer>> webs severed and <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> lured into a deadly trap <<r:EventPlayer>>, a voice begins to whisper, first soft, then biting:
body_lore:
"O my wither weaver spider
So vulnerable, so frail your legs, eightfold
'Consume her!' they clamor; 'the obloquy!'
But oh! Not my bittersweet, lo!
Crawl home, to Witherbloom
Dry my nocturnal tears."
button_0: <<Cp:EventPlayer>> is gone from the Burrow Downs for good.
button_1: Collect the scattered and abandoned spider eggs. <unit></unit>
button_2: Seal the echo of this rhyme within the shadows. <shadow></shadow>
title: <<ge:Failure,EventPlayer.FirstName>>

body_footer: Fuming and fighting, the giant becomes blobbier and hotter until <<p:EventPlayer>> combusts! And is then devoured whole by <hyperlink><eventColor>{FeyGodName}</eventColor></hyperlink>—leaving only a glittering, golden gut.
body_header: Inescapably hungry and angry, <eventColor>{Kana}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Grump}</eventColor> start clubbing one-another with <<o:EventPlayer>> bare fists.
body_lore: "You dumb rot, this your fault," growls <eventColor>{Kana}</eventColor> chomping on one arm. "Ow! No, this your fault, lump-brain!" screams <eventColor>{Grump}</eventColor> as <<p:Grump>> grasps <<g:shoulder,<eventColor>{Kana}</eventColor>>> and begins to tear at it. In this way, the giant pummels <<r:EventPlayer>> into blobbier bits, while a hot, fuming glow emanates off <<o:EventPlayer>> outline.
button_0: Sell the gut like a massive gold nugget! <gold></gold>
title: <<ge:End,EventPlayer.FirstName>>

button_1: Reforge the gut into a magic keepsake <item></item>
button_2: Sacrifice this gut to the cosmic inferno! <chaos></chaos>

body_footer: At the unnatural titter of birds, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> is rapidly overgrown and consumed by <hyperlink>Ilandra's</hyperlink> weeds. Leaving nothing behind, but a rich composted heap.
body_header: A shocked tear erupts from <<g:eyes,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>> as a single green sprout emerges from <<o:EventPlayer>> snout.
body_lore: "No, no, no," growls <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> as <<p:EventPlayer>> plucks the sprout away. But in an eyeblink, a dozen more pop from <<o:EventPlayer>> skin. <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> madly claws and tears as many sprouts off <<o:EventPlayer>> body as possible. But it is no good, for every sprout removed, a dozen more emerge, growing twice as fast as the previous.
button_0: Take the magic compost to grow your crops. <food></food>
button_1: Erect a monument of victory on this spot. <influence></influence>
button_2: Meditate on this spot and feel its vital nutrients. <nature></nature>
title: <<ge:End,EventPlayer.FirstName>>

body_footer: Inescapably, the rumbling of <eventColor>{FeyGodName}</eventColor> roars aloud and as it reaches <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> on the run, it devours <<P:EventPlayer>> instantly, leaving only a single magnificent feather to drop down like an autumn leaf...
body_header: Panic strikes <<g:eyes,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>> as a bright flash strikes in the distance.
body_lore: "No, my <hyperlink>Duathadae Lord</hyperlink>," screeches <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> as <<o:EventPlayer>> feathers slowly drop off, one by one. "Not me, do not devour me! Have I not fed your desires for many years? Do I not deserve another chance?" As feather after feather drops, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> realizes no one is listening and bolts off in fear.
button_0: Adopt this feather as a quill for your study. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_1: Grind this feather into a potent concoction. <mana></mana>
button_2: Absorb this feather into the greater Astral aura. <arcana></arcana>
title: <<ge:End,EventPlayer.FirstName>>

body_footer: Thus, a thick mist pours out from the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> that drowns all the realm and any <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> scrambling in panic before its swelling tide.
body_header: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>," the fading voice of <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> calls out to you, "I fear... my fortune has run out."
body_lore: Then, with a silent gasp, <<G:spirit,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>> appears dragged before the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and the eager attention of all the <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> are drawn upon <<P:EventPlayer>>. "Useful" chime the four voices in chorus, as <<G:power,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>> is suddenly siphoned off <<o:EventPlayer>> helpless spirit with great intensity. "F... flee!" chokes <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>.
button_0: "The mission is lost..."
title: Mist-Drowned Fortune

body_footer: As mists faded and clouds parted before the shimmering sun, a bright rainbow graced down upon the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. Thus, Pellari rejoiced; the Burrow Downs were saved, at last.
body_header: In this way, the fearful <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> were warded off and <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> emerged before the reclaimed <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
body_lore: All around the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> and Fey alike raised songs of hope and warding as <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> scaled its steps. At its summit, <<p:EventPlayer>> emerged alongside <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> to channel <hyperlink>Duatha's dreaming spirit</hyperlink> through the gifts of the <hyperlink>Geassadae</hyperlink> to slowly unravel the realm's afflicted nightmare. Powerless against these mounting forces, the <hyperlink>Duathadae's servants</hyperlink> dissipated like mists before the sun.
button_0: Rejoice!
title: All The Colors of Hope

body_footer: At the brink of a frenzy, <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> must embrace one of the seasons for the next stage of <<o:FeyGuideName>> Fey life. Where do you steer <<o:FeyGuideName>> volatile struggle?
body_header: Pondering the numerous perils and close escapes on the Burrow Downs, you become dragged into an argument of <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>—with <<r:FeyGuideName>>!
body_lore:
"Master Wizard, oh, oh!" <> moans anxiously, "it is time for {FeyGuideName} to grow!" The little sprite stutters and flutters erratically, while <> body keeps changing form and colors from morning to evening and back.

"Spring is my lover, ever young and green."
"Autumn lunges out at my foes, makes them scream!"
"Summer kindles my heart, warms my friends."
"Winter bites cold, murders hope, meets their ends!"
button_0: Towards the caress of spring.
button_3: Towards the warmth of summer.
button_4: Towards the tumult of autumn.
button_5: Towards the cruelty of winter.
title: A Seasoned Destiny

body_footer: "Now what does a spider do when her victims are caught in her trap?" <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> asks as the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> reveals <<o:EventUnit>> terrible visage. "She feasts."
body_header: While the rebels valiantly stand their ground against the <hyperlink>Duathadae's</hyperlink> disciples, thick mists creep down the Burrow Downs once more, foreboding new ill.
body_lore:
"Scatter, little Pellari, while you can," the insidious words of {EventPlayer} resound from the mists. "Did you think you could truly challenge the lords upon Witherbloom's throne? They granted you sanctuary, protected you from the cruel wizards beyond. But oh, how naughty Duatha's children have become."

"I have observed the pitiful struggles of the other disciples long enough," <> continues, while the shape of a large stag appears beside <>. "They gave me time to spin my threads, weave my spells."
button_0: Defend the rebellion from <<ge:sinister forces,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>>.
title: Hour of the Mistcrawlers

body_footer: "I suspect you too have come to Evermore to unriddle this enigma," the mysterious mage remarks. "May I interest you then in some exchange of gathered insights?"
body_header: Traversing the scarred ruins of Evermore, you come upon a lone mage occupied with the various trinkets strapped to <<o:EventPlayer>> chain belt. At last <<p:EventPlayer>> notices you.
body_lore: "Well met, stranger," <<p:EventPlayer>> calls out, <<o:EventPlayer>> face hidden behind a mask. "I am a Cosmic Wanderer, searching the <hyperlink>Worlds Within</hyperlink> for the <hyperlink>Astral Endailon</hyperlink> and exploring how the very fabrics of magic are reshaped by its influence. There is a deeply intriguing anomaly present on this realm. Could it even be...? We must find out the truth in time."
button_0: "Let us share knowledge <knowledge></knowledge> and solve this mystery together." <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_3: "I will consider this."
button_4: "I will not trust a stranger hiding behind a mask." [relationLvl-3/]
button_5: "You are lying. You have plundered Evermore's Shrouded Isles. <casusbelli></casusbelli> Show your intentions!"
title: Traces of Mystery

clues_found: In vain you had followed the footsteps of the mysterious mage throughout Evermore's Shrouded Isles. Now, when you least expected it, he suddenly appears before you.

body_footer: "You never told me why you sought me out on that barren rock, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> asks, suddenly turning to you. "Or you told me and I didn't listen."
body_header: Evermore. Since you arrived on its Astral shores, an ancient magic washes up, out and over you. <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, after observing from a distance, approaches you at last.
body_lore: "You too can feel it, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <<p:EventPlayer>> remarks, gazing afar. "Despite the passing of ages and disasters, Evermore's spell still befuddles. To the Elves it offered healing; to the <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink> squandered immortality. To the <hyperlink>Shadow Demons</hyperlink> it was mere sustenance; to me unloved home." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> slowly clasps <<o:EventPlayer>> grimoire with <<o:EventPlayer>> corrupted arm. "The cosmos is ancient and some things are better left undisturbed. Evermore's magic is being meddled with, and we must find out by whom."
button_0: "The devouring winds whispered your name. From the Withered Worlds <matter></matter> they carried me hither."
button_1: "I am your judge <order></order>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. You will atone for your sins."
button_2: "I took my chances. <chaos></chaos> Would I twaddle, barter, kill? The die decides."
button_3: "I observed the Astral Flows <arcana></arcana> and foresaw a tsunami..."
button_4: "To invite you to the lands of my people <nature></nature>, where the most tormented souls can find healing."
button_5: "I came to herald your nearing end, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>." <shadow></shadow>
button_6: "I sought guidance in the mastery of the arcane arts <knowledge></knowledge>."
title: Tides of Magic

body_footer: The grip loosens, and the world slowly returns into focus. "Go now," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> finishes. "Study the echoes below the shattered throne. Remember to not remember."
body_header: "Master and apprentice," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> repeats, rephrasing your words. "That cannot be. Instead, Evermore itself will be your teacher."
body_lore: "I was the arbiter of <hyperlink>Athla's</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Circle of Deogai</hyperlink>," <<p:EventPlayer>> continues, changing the subject, while you start feeling a nagging strain inside your head. "I sat there on the Wizard's Throne, seeking cosmic balance. But it was all for naught." The strain intensifies, slowly obfuscating your thoughts. "For I was one with the enemy; <hyperlink>Urrath's</hyperlink> agent!" <<ge:clasp,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>> eclipses your self, reduces the world to one voice, <<ge:voice,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>>. "You must understand, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>: my words cannot be trusted! My thoughts cannot be trusted!"
button_0: Still dazed, prepare to seek out the broken Wizard's Throne.
button_3: Strike back at <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. <mana></mana> Prove your mind's strength! <xp></xp>
button_4: Speak a prayer <mana></mana> for <<ge:tormented soul,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>>. <goodact></goodact>
title: The Broken Circle

astral: "Remarkable," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> replies with a smile. "The <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> should have sought you out in my stead."
chaos: "Curious," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> states, "immensely curious. Yet how do you know your die isn't manipulated?"
materium: "Then you traveled far, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> replies, "for little more than a mystery."
nature: "A compelling offer," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> replies, "but I would only bring doom to your people."
order: "By all means, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> says with true enthusiasm. "Observe and judge."
shadow: "Let us hope you are right, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> says with gravity. "It is my greatest desire."

body_footer: Reaching out to the presence beyond the Broken Throne, you...
body_header: Drawn to the brim of an enormous crater you gaze at a desolation of floating ruins, broken wards, and a shattered tower piercing the sky: the Broken Throne of Evermore.
body_lore: Even now, millennia later, the <hyperlink>Fracture</hyperlink> in the <hyperlink>Astral Flows</hyperlink> echo the destruction liberated from within the Wizard's Throne when <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> cast the spell that activated the <hyperlink>Seals</hyperlink> on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>. However, within the turmoil of flickering magic and mana-draining pulls you can sense a vast presence, intangible yet overpowering. Could this be the voice of Athla calling to you through her <hyperlink>dreams</hyperlink>?
button_0: ...clutch a creature <unit></unit> encircling the presence.
button_7: ...tap into the currents <mana></mana> it provokes.
button_8: ...allow it to act on your consciousness.
title: The Broken Circle: Aftermath

body_footer: "And if we explore the Shrouded Isles," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes <<ge:words,<eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>>>, "we may find the source of the Astral disturbances. <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, are you ready to comb through Evermore's most well-guarded secrets?"
body_header: "To summarize:" <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> at last responds, "your people came to <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, conjured secret islands with Evermore's wizards—and none of this was found out thereafter? Remarkable."
body_lore: "We know how to keep our secrets," <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> replies, raising <<o:EventHero>> plumy eyebrows. "As for the <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink>, our agreement ensured their own mortal discretion. Nevertheless, nothing is safe forever." <<Cp:EventHero>> unfolds a map and points at various marked locations: "These are the Shrouded Gates leading to the Isles hidden beyond Evermore. Someone has started to plunder the arcane secrets guarded within those Shrouded Isles; soon thereafter the Astral disturbances on Evermore began."
button_0: Agree to explore the Shrouded Isles linked to Evermore.
title: Secrets of the Archmages

button_7: Demand <influence></influence> a pawn <item></item> from <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> to pledge for <<o:EventHero>> truthfulness.
button_8: Inquire <knowledge></knowledge> about the Shrouded Gates and their surroundings.

body_footer: "Together," <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> ends <<o:EventHero>> talk, "<hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> and <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> created the Shrouded Isles, isolated pockets within the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, hidden from the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>."
body_header: While your people still build up their foothold at Evermore's shores, you find yourself summoned to a meeting with <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> and the messenger of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
"When the Archons established their Circle of Deogai throughout the Worlds Within," the messenger, called {EventHero}, begins, "the Circles' Wizards soon felt the chains of Archon rules and leadership. No longer could they freely explore the secrets of the arcane; no, they had been reduced to mere stewards of Archon order." {EventHero} pauses, as if <> expecting {EventPlayer} to interrupt <> monologue.

Then, <> continues: "My people have a long tradition of preserving and guarding magical secrets. They made an offer to the most ambitious Godir of the Circles..."
button_0: Await <<ge:reaction,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>>.
title: An Ancient Agreement

body_footer: "Brace yourself," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> ends <<o:EventPlayer>> speech, "from Karissa's secret Isle one must expect the worst."
body_header: Entering the shadows of the enormous <eventColor>{EventStructure2}</eventColor>, you are joined by <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> who beholds the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "To <hyperlink>Karissa</hyperlink>, the life of mortals was always just a plaything," <<p:EventPlayer>> explains, while <<o:EventPlayer>> well hand carefully examines the various glyphs and charms woven into <<o:EventPlayer>> attire. "Fickle as a flame, she drove her Orcs to uttermost violence—or granted unexpected mercy. To tell the truth, I never understood her loyalty to me during the Second Age. Maybe she had simply decided to like me."
button_0: Prepare to enter the Shrouded Gate.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Karissa's Past

body_footer: "The gate to Yaka's Isle is close," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> ends, "though I'm slightly surprised there are no statues of Yaka pointing at its location."
body_header: Standing at the feet of two enormous statues watching over the sand-sunken ruins of <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, your are joined by <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "This is <hyperlink>Yaka</hyperlink>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> explains, picking up a stone fragment of the foremost toe. "It's how he appeared to the Azrac during the First Age, how he raised the Tigrans during the Second and probably how he set foot on Grexolis during the Fourth Age. The 'God of Fire' was always too concerned with enforcing the worship of his followers to even notice the machinations of his supposed allies."
button_0: Prepare to enter the Shrouded Gate.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Yaka's Past

body_footer: "The secret gate of <hyperlink>Fangir</hyperlink> lies near," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes. "Now that its concealing spell has been broken, it is hidden in plain sight."
body_header: Exposed to the Devouring Winds blowing from the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you are joined by <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "This was the Wizard's Tower of <hyperlink>Fangir</hyperlink>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> explains, "master of earth magic, inventions, and buildcraft—and a friend. He stood against the Conspirator Wizards of Evermore during the Second Age, and again on <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink> when they called themselves <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink>. Long gone are the days when he would drop the use of magic in fear of the <hyperlink>Shadow Demons</hyperlink>. Now, Fangir molds the <hyperlink>Astral Flows</hyperlink>, binding the light of the stars in enchanted runes."
button_0: Prepare to enter the Shrouded Gate.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Fangir's Past

body_footer: "The secret entrance to Mab's Shrouded Isle lies near," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> indicates. "Things could get muddy in there."
body_header: Climbing down the bleak dungeons leading to the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you are once again joined by <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "These festering halls were once the domain of Mab," <<p:EventPlayer>> narrates, while renewing the wards protecting <<o:EventPlayer>> back. "The Goblins called her 'Mother Mab, but what a cruel mother she was. Only many generations after Mab's departure did the Goblins slowly begin to appreciate things unrelated to filth, anguish, or destruction again."
button_0: Prepare to enter the Shrouded Gate.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Mab's Past

body_footer: "You should move with caution," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> warns, "the unnatural mist near Arachna's gate does not bode well."
body_header: Cutting through the webs surrounding the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, your troops are aided by <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "Spiders, of course!" <<p:EventPlayer>> calls out, incinerating the remaining webs with some well-placed fire spells. "Though it would be a deadly mistake to reduce <hyperlink>Arachna</hyperlink> to her affinity for spiders. Just like her eight-legged denizens, Arachna loves to lure unwary <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> into her traps. As I heard, even <hyperlink>Meandor</hyperlink> fell victim to her woven enchantments back on <hyperlink>Auldweald</hyperlink>."
button_0: Prepare to enter the Shrouded Gate.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Arachna's Past

body_footer: "I am surprised that Marinus knew of the Shrouded Isles," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes. "The <hyperlink>Horwynd</hyperlink> were very thorough as it seems."
body_header: Carefully prowling through the hostile gloom engulfing the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, your troops find <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, examining the Umbral corruption.
body_lore: "How the <hyperlink>Umbral invasion</hyperlink> has scarred all <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>," <<p:EventPlayer>> says, sighing. "During the Second Age, this used to be the tower of Marinus and around it lay the pastoral lands of the Halflings. Focused on trade and the riches of the seas, Marinus was one of the few <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink> who valued peace and prosperity over domination and war."
button_0: Prepare to enter the Shrouded Gate.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Marinus' Past

body_footer: "Behind Serena's gate," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> warns, "you will find the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. There is no doubt about it."
body_header: In the woods enshrouding the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, the vicious growth of the Gloom is spreading like a disease.
body_lore: "<hyperlink>Serena</hyperlink>, alas..." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, who suddenly appeared beside your troops, utters. "You did not deserve this fate. Despite your blind hatred towards most non-Elven races. Despite the treachery committed against <hyperlink>Julia</hyperlink> and Gabriel. Despite foolishly wandering into the All-Devourer's trap. For no one does." The tentacles on <<ge:back,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>> mimic the movements of the Umbral trees.
button_0: Prepare to enter the Shrouded Gate.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Serena's Past

body_footer: "Nimue is a powerful <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> warns. "You must enter her Isle with great caution."
body_header: Following a cliff line of Astral barrens, your troops come upon <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, who is watching the waves.
body_lore: "The waters have calmed ever since <hyperlink>Nimue</hyperlink> left <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>," <<p:EventPlayer>> remarks, while the devouring winds blow from the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. "Even within the <hyperlink>Circle</hyperlink> she was infamous for her capriciousness and vanity. Some days she bewept the poor souls she had drowned; on others, she raged like a vicious maelstrom. Though all this pales in comparison to the gruesome tales told about the <hyperlink>Enchanted Archipelago</hyperlink>. The <hyperlink>Torment of Shadows</hyperlink> must have brought out the worst in her."
button_0: Prepare to enter the Shrouded Gate.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Nimue's Past

body_footer: "Be prepared for the uttermost cold," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> warns. "For that is where Artica's creations thrive."
body_header: Amid the frosty <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> awaits your troops, wrapped up in <<o:EventPlayer>> mantle.
body_lore: "The frozen lands, where blizzards rage and northern lights enchant the skies, have always been the domain of <hyperlink>Artica</hyperlink>," <<p:EventPlayer>> explains, while warding off the freezing wind. "Her bond with the Frostlings always appeared to run deeper than for most other <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink>. Not only in myths has her relation to the Frost Queens been speculated about. Blood is thicker than water; or ice, in this case."
button_0: Prepare to enter the Shrouded Gate.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Artica's Past

body_footer: "Behind the portal we will find," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> reflects, "if this Isle is the doing of Anon—or of someone intent on covering their tracks."
body_header: Climbing the hallowed colonnade up from the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, your troops find <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> waiting for them at the top.
body_lore: "Now, this is an interesting enigma," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> explains, while <<o:EventPlayer>> corrupt hand trembles slightly. "<hyperlink>Anon</hyperlink>, whose prophecy foretold my rescue from the <hyperlink>Pitiless Void</hyperlink>, is an Archon. Yet the <hyperlink>Horwynd</hyperlink> devised the Shrouded Isles to hide knowledge from the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>. Then why or how could Anon build a Shrouded Gate on Evermore?"
button_0: Prepare to enter the Shrouded Gate.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Anon's Enigma

body_footer: Whatever is happening to Evermore, it shakes the foundations of what is left of the broken island.
body_header: While you and your allies still search for the source of the Astral disturbances, you come to witness their material impact.
body_lore: Ruins crumble, clefts spread through the barren soil, and mountains groan as the entire island of Evermore begins to shake. An otherworldly sound pulses from below, sometimes deep as the ocean, sometimes sharp as a razor, then again whistling in an almost melodic fashion. After a while, the tremors subside and a dead silence ensues.
button_0: "Time to hurry up with our search."
title: Cosmic Tremors

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> has become an <hyperlink>Eldritch Sovereign</hyperlink>, channeling <<o:EventPlayer>> necromantic powers to raise the deceased Elves of the first ages.
body_header: Carrying the scent of pestilence and decay, long lines of <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> stage the arrival of their grim master <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "Death to all, and death specifically to you, <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor>," <<p:EventPlayer>> declares with a cold grin. "You may have denied me my triumph in the Second Age, old man, but even then you were always one step behind. You didn't realize why the All-Devourer liberated the Wizard Kings of the <hyperlink>Circle</hyperlink>, nor did you find the marks of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> I placed on the <hyperlink>Archon Necropolises</hyperlink> throughout <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>. Now behold my latest creations, a late gift to the fading lineage of House Inioch."
button_0: Await <<ge:reaction,<eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>>>.
title: The Reaper of Evermore

body_footer: "There is a simple way to learn if Evermore's disturbances are <<ge:doing,<eventColor>{Nekron.FirstName}</eventColor>>>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes, staring at you. "Will you return the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> to rest?"
body_header: "Your weakness is not my concern, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{Nekron.FirstName}</eventColor> retorts. "Where you succumbed, I triumph."
body_lore:
"What about you, {PlayerLeader}?" {Nekron.FirstName} asks, suddenly addressing you. "Why would you follow a 'broken pawn'? Don't mistake me for a servant of Urrath. A master of death can bestow eternal gifts of <> own, and knows many friends throughout the Worlds Within, weaving a new Dominion..."

"Let's not waste our time here," {EventPlayer} cuts off {Nekron.FirstName}, "{PlayerLeader}, this is one Shrouded Isle less to explore, for you heard what to expect from {Nekron.FirstName} '{Nekron.LastName}'."
button_0: Vow to take down <eventColor>{Nekron}</eventColor> <rs_war></rs_war> and contain <<o:EventPlayer>> undead plague.
button_4: Wait how the situation unfolds. There may be other enemies lurking on Evermore.
title: Shrouded Enemies

body_footer: "The blood of day and night is fighting to the death," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> proclaims with a sadistic grin. "Who will survive?"
body_header: Searching the dungeons below <<ge:broken throne,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>> your troops find a chamber with a still ongoing blood ritual.
body_lore: There is a <eventColor>{SunGuardian}</eventColor> enchained at one end of the chamber and a <eventColor>{MoonGuardian}</eventColor> at the other. Both are trapped within a sanguine bond that is being nourished by a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>.
button_0: Order the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to be slain and save the <eventColor>{SunGuardian}</eventColor>. <unit></unit>
button_2: Order the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to be slain and save the <eventColor>{MoonGuardian}</eventColor>. <unit></unit>
button_3: Overcharge the ritual <evilact></evilact> to blood-infuse both guardians. <unit></unit>
title: Shrouded Enemies: Aftermath

body_footer: Suddenly <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> recedes a step. "Is that you, <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor>?" <<p:EventPlayer>> shouts, clasping <<o:EventPlayer>> ornate staff more firmly.
body_header: New life sprouts and blooms on Evermore's desolate soil, as a dignified Draconian druid approaches you.
body_lore: "May peace be upon you, O foreign mages," the druid calls out, endowing you with a white lotus as a token of friendship. "I am <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. The distant heritage of my people has led us to these troubled shores. We seek the echoes of a forgotten age when Evermore was still an ingrained part of Athla."
button_0: Await <<ge:reaction,<eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>>>.
title: An Unexpected Welcome

body_footer: In all this, you can't shake off the strange feeling that you are being watched and that the destruction witnessed thus far was only the beginning.
body_header: Once again the ruins of Evermore tremble, shaken by a cosmic disturbance of even greater intensity.
body_lore: This time the Astral currents wash over you, pulling your mind to whence they came as they recede. Your mental eye clings to the mountains <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, and you conclude that this must have been the epicenter of the disturbance; and hence where you must direct your next moves.
button_0: "It's time to brace ourselves for what is coming!"
title: Into the Storm

body_footer: An eldritch Leviathan is breaking through Evermore's crust, wreaking havoc upon the sundered island.
body_header: Nearing the mountains <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, your troops are knocked down by a shockwave of destruction.
body_lore: Mountains burst and rocks crumble as a gargantuan creature tears apart the material realm. Its enormous tentacles breach through the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>, creating <eventColor>{EventStructure2}</eventColor> in its wake. Even through the thundering destruction you can hear the otherworldly sounds once more, now recognizing them as the bellowing of the creature.
button_0: Assemble your allies.
title: Into the Storm: Aftermath

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> has resurfaced, breeding destruction and a plethora of ethereal creatures in its wake.
body_header: Another earthquake ruptures Evermore, as the Eldritch Leviathan continues to shake off the overlaying material crust.
body_lore: With each breach the sheer size of the enormous creature becomes more apparent. You remember the words of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, saying that "Evermore was once an ingrained part of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>" and can't help wonder to which degree the Eldritch Leviathan shaped the history and identity of the isle.
button_0: Prepare to create an Astral anchor.
button_1: Prepare to defend the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
title: Eldritch Wake

body_footer: If no Leviathan Landmark is bound in time, all will be lost!
body_header: Squealing from the Void below Evermore, the Eldritch Leviathan begins to fully awaken.
body_lore: Through the ages the Eldritch Leviathan lay hidden beneath Evermore. Now the ravaged isle lies destroyed, scarred by the craters where the colossal body parts have broken through. Even more Astral Sea monsters emerge throughout the realm, drawn into the fight for freedom of their gargantuan ancestor.
button_0: "We must breach through!"
title: Nearing End

switched_sides: Defend the Leviathan Landmarks at all costs!

body_footer: "I suggest you don't attempt to stop us," the masked mage ends his speech, "or this will get utterly unpleasant."
body_header: In vain, you had followed the footsteps of the mysterious mage throughout Evermore's Shrouded Isles. Now, when you least expected it, he suddenly appears before you.
body_lore: "I guess it is time," he says, fiddling with a chronosphere strapped to his chain-belt. "Since you were all so kind"—he snaps his fingers and draws in <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor>—"to join me for the Leave-Taking, it would be impolite to not hold a speech." He raises a small chalice: "After many, many years, some spent better, some spent worse, my volumetric inmate and I"—he gestures towards the Leviathan—"have decided to break out and leave this inhospitable island."
button_0: Await <<ge:reaction,<eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor>>>.
title: Confrontation

masked_symon_mee: While the life-or-death struggle against the Eldritch Leviathan rages on, the mysterious mage seeks you out once more, at last determined to show their true colors.

body_footer: "Neither of you can stop this," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes, tossing the emptied chalice to you. "So don't make this hard on me."
body_header: "No, <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> responds firmly, "I cannot trust you on this. No offense; it's the tentacles." <<Cp:EventPlayer>> laughs.
body_lore: "As for the other <hyperlink>Circle</hyperlink> Wizards,"—<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> waves dismissively—"I had excessive time to study their petty characters. No, they wouldn't understand." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> pauses <<o:EventPlayer>> speech for a moment as the otherworldly squeal of the Eldritch Leviathan can be heard in the distance. "None can understand," <<p:EventPlayer>> then reaffirms, clenching <<o:EventPlayer>> fists. "All <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> share an intrinsic fear of the incomprehensible. When it comes to the eldritch they know only destruction or domination. But I will prove there is another way..."
button_0: So be it.
button_4: Symon is right!
title: The Avatar of the Leviathan

body_footer: Once <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> left, you look around the scenes of devastation and the Broken Wizard's Throne in the distance. And you can't help but wonder: was this a beginning or an end?
body_header: With the avatar of the Eldritch Leviathan defeated, the colossal creature slowly succumbs to <<ge:enchantments,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>>, returning to its deep slumber.
body_lore:
"It is done," {EventPlayer} declares, the tentacles underneath <> coat calmly adrift. "Now the time of vigil will begin; while someone needs to attend to poor {Symon}."

"But all this mustn't be your concern, {PlayerLeader}; not today at least. For today you should rest, recover from the battle for Evermore. Tomorrow, the secrets of the cosmos still await you."
button_0: A book knows many chapters.
button_7: All good tales must end eventually.
title: The Avatar of the Leviathan: Aftermath

body_footer: The illusory hordes of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> are launching a final attack on <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. Defend it at all cost!
body_header: With three Astral anchors enchaining the body parts of the Eldritch Leviathan, the colossal creature is beginning to return to its deep sleep.
body_lore:
While the movements of the Leviathan calm down, its Avatar {EventPlayer} is mustering <> full arcane strength, conjuring phantasmal armies to assault the anchor city {EventCity}.

It is a terrifying sight to behold mirror images of Elder Dragons, Giant King, and Eldritch Sovereign march side by side, all determined to disrupt the spell cast on the Leviathan.
button_0: "Victory is nigh!"
title: Phantasmal Upheaval

switched_sides: The illusory hordes of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> are launching a final attack on <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. Join their assault before it's too late!

body_footer: Shaken and drained your soul seeks a path through this Astral turmoil, back to Magehaven.
body_header: Evermore bursts asunder as the Eldritch Leviathan rises from its ancient sleep.
body_lore: Now that the creature can be seen in its full otherworldly splendor, everything beside it is reduced to insignificance. Even the ruins of the mighty Wizard's Throne are like dust lost in the gills of this behemoth. As the shockwave of destruction reaches you, you look out for <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, but it is already too late.
button_0: "We have failed..."
title: Awakening

body_footer: Once <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> left, you look around the scenes of devastation and the Broken Wizard's Throne in the distance. And you can't help but wonder: was this a beginning or an end?
body_header: Producing a last, dulled, squeal the Eldritch Leviathan comes to rest beneath Evermore, returning to its deep slumber.
body_lore:
"It is done," {EventPlayer} declares, the tentacles underneath <> coat calmly adrift. "Now the time of vigil will begin; while someone needs to attend to poor {Symon}. <> collapsed the moment the Leviathan fell silent."

"But all this mustn't be your concern, {PlayerLeader}; not today at least. For today you should rest, recover from the battle for Evermore. Tomorrow, the secrets of the cosmos still await you."
button_0: A book knows many chapters.
button_1: All good tales must end eventually.
title: Deep Slumber

body_footer: While <<ge:chatter,<eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>>> goes on and on, you reflect on the dangerous path ahead. Luckily, you brought some specialists...
body_header: Still befuddled by the flurry of sensations within the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you hear the chittering voice of your Fey guide, <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>, prancing around you.
body_lore: "No time to sleep, no time to peep! Make haste, Master Wizard, don't waste your breath. Deep in <hyperlink>Duatha</hyperlink>, the slow find death." The words sputter from <<ge:mouth,<eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>>> like water from a fountain. Anxiously fluttering up and down, the little sprite awaits a reaction. "We mustn't stay in the mist. They see, they find, they twist. <hyperlink>Our lords</hyperlink>, they love to play. We are the pawns and must obey."
button_0: The <eventColor>{CultureUnit}</eventColor> <unit></unit>, paragon of your people's military traditions.
button_3: An undead minion <unit></unit> bound to my will. <shadow></shadow>
button_4: A heavenly helper <unit></unit>, bringing light to this darkness. <order></order>
button_5: An elemental spirit <unit></unit> unleashed from the Astral flows. <arcana></arcana>
button_6: A fiendish assistant <unit></unit> used to torment and hell. <chaos></chaos>
button_7: My trusted companion <unit></unit> "<eventColor>{PetName}</eventColor>". <nature></nature>
button_8: A tireless construct <unit></unit> without remorse or fear. <matter></matter>
title: Down the Rabbit Hole

body_footer: Rubbing <<r:FeyGuideName>> eyes, <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> looks up with a bitter smirk and finishes <<o:FeyGuideName>> rhyme: "...I tooks some of your mana."
body_header: With a messy poof and a raspy cough, <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> spirits back into existence beside you, <<o:FeyGuideName>> eyes sullen and coat disheveled.
body_lore: For a brief moment <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> passes you a silent cranky glance. "Back I am... flim-flam," <<p:FeyGuideName>> chatters with a cough, "bam-bam... peh..." Then, <<p:FeyGuideName>> dusts off <<o:FeyGuideName>> coat and starts to groom <<r:FeyGuideName>> back into shape, while humming: "Ri-ma, ra-ma..."
button_0: "Welcome back."
title: Dawnusk Resprouts

body_footer: Moments later, the area becomes shrouded again. But you have seen enough: the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> have arrived here first.
body_header: Entering the large cavern with the supposed <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> hideout, the mists briefly clear, revealing a terrible scene.
body_lore: Ravaged and caved in, the burrows of the <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> smolder in the dim darkness. Pale figures patrol the pathways, rounding up the surviving <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> and forcing them into cages, like animals. At the heart of the gutted hideout, a crude encampment has been raised, adorned with the skull of a stag, dreaded symbol of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> and their Scourges.
button_0: Keep a close eye on <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>...
title: A Homely Hideout: Aftermath

body_footer: "They do not grudge, they do not judge," the little sprite ends <<o:<eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>>> speech, "<hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> welcome all in their comfy halls."
body_header: "Swift, Master Wizard, to the shelter, go, go! <<ge:friends,<eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>>> dwell near in their cozy burrow."
body_lore: While <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>—through movements and gestures—continues to hurry you along, <<p:<eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>>> tells you more about these 'friends' waiting ahead: "<hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> have fur, feather, claw; tail, snout, beak, paw. From Duatha's oldest dreams they came. They brought her joy, she gave them names. But, oh, nasty things did the Fey, woe betide...! Remaining <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> in the caverns now hide."
button_0: Tell <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> to lead the way.
title: A Homely Hideout

body_footer: Completing <<o:FeyGuideName>> eerie transformation, <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> is determined to take on the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> and liberate <<o:FeyGuideName>> <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> friends.
body_header: Shaken by the destruction of the hideout, <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> sobs, while <<o:FeyGuideName>> skin and wings begin to change colors.
body_lore:
"Poor friends, here it ends," <> whines, growing increasingly purple. "{FeyGuideName} failed. Now the pale ones will take us, break us..."

"No!" <> suddenly calls out with renewed fervor and <> eyes flash up like ghost lights. "WE take them, break them, strangle their throats, mangle their coats; sinew and bone, stashed below stone..." <> sharpens, like a cold wind piercing through a shelter's cracks: "Vile walkers will kneel; peel; squeal. Beweep their ordeal."
button_0: "It is the only way forward."
title: Ghastly Revelations

body_footer: "Our rescue must be celebrated!" <<p:EventUnit>> concludes with irritating elation. "Do you fancy some honey brew and blackberry pies?"
body_header: With the <eventColor>{EnemyRace}</eventColor> vanquished, the surviving <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> gather around you, curious and grateful. One of them, a mole, speaks up.
body_lore: "Friendly hero, you are our savior!" <<p:EventUnit>> calls out, shaking <<o:EventUnit>> own hands in uncontrollable joy. "The Pale Ones do us ill. See, poor Maple here got his paws scratched and Sunshine's fur got all squeezed when she was stuffed into that awful cage. And then all the others"—the mole peeks at the scene of destruction, but quickly turns <<o:EventUnit>> head back, smiling again.
button_0: Say nothing, baffled by the question.
title: Ghastly Revelations: Aftermath

body_footer: "The seasons they fly," <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> explains, still chuckling, "on Duatha, winter is always nigh."
body_header: As you continue to follow <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> through the fogged tunnels, a rejuvenating breeze carries the smell of fresh leaves into the underground.
body_lore: "Oh, spring," <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> begins to chant, while mushrooms and moss sprout in large patches where the wind had touched the barren stone, "new life you bring. You sprang, you sprung; tickled my tongue. Then, like a bee, stung; flung your poisonous dung—while the birds sung to the morning, still young." The sprite giggles, blissfully looping the loop.
button_0: "We must learn to adapt to this ever-shifting realm."
title: Beckoning of Spring

body_footer: Deeply grateful, the liberated <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> joins the fight to rescue <<o:EventUnit>> brethren.
body_header: Your troops have forced open a cage of the <eventColor>{EnemyRace}</eventColor> and freed another <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "Oh, praise be the good seasons!" exclaims the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> with great elation. "We were sure as shucks that we'd end up as <hyperlink>Fey Lord</hyperlink> stew! Thank you stranger, me and my kin are ever at your service!"
button_0: "Together, we will tear down the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>!"
title: Ghastly Revelations: Liberated <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>

body_footer: "Great hero," the mole explains, turning back to you, "we will shape our new home to your designs. This city in your honor, how should we adorn it?"
body_header: In this moment, <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> joins the conversation. <<Cp:FeyGuideName>> is back to <<o:FeyGuideName>> happy self again, scurrying and chattering.
body_lore:
"A feast is good," <> says, "but not so soon. How would you feast without cup or spoon? A new shelter is needed, sturdy and tall. To work, quick, quick, then we dance at nightfall."

"{FeyGuideName}!" the mole calls out in excitement. "Come, let me cuddle your cheeks, you little snuggle bug!" After an extensive hug he continues: "You're right, my friend. We cannot live in this rubble and must reach the surface. The Pale Ones had concealed the path upwards, but their magic is lifted."
button_0: "With rich quartz and gemstones <gold></gold> from the burrows deep."
button_4: "With enchanted mushrooms and will-o'-wisps <mana></mana> from your underground gardens."
button_5: "With icons of retained Pellari freedom." <influence></influence>
button_6: "With the skulls <souls></souls> of the slain <eventColor>{EnemyRace}</eventColor>."
title: A New Shelter

body_footer: "It must not be like this, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> says tentatively, "there is still time to put the Leviathan back to sleep, seek a concerted solution..."
body_header: "<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, is that you?" <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> asks calmly, yet <<o:Merlin>> expression betrays <<o:Merlin>> sorrow. "I see you have carried a burden far greater than anyone could have asked you to do."
body_lore: "You do remember me, <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> replies as <<p:EventPlayer>> dispels <<o:EventPlayer>> mask. "I am impressed." <<Cp:EventPlayer>> shows a sarcastic smile. "Unfortunately you are late, about one and a half ages late. Though I do not blame you; when you have a whole world to worry about, what is a lone fledgling mage who stumbled upon a creature from the beginning of time? Nothing that can't be sealed away..."
button_0: Continue observing their conversation.
button_3: Hear out Symon
title: Unmasked and Unbound

body_footer: "It's no betrayal when <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> told you to distrust even <<o:Merlin>> thoughts," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes with gleaming eyes. "Say, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, are you in for the journey?"
body_header: While your armies clash with the swarming denizens of the Eldritch Leviathan, its declared avatar <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> appears before you once more.
body_lore:
"I must apologize, {PlayerLeader}," <> begins, inspecting the trinkets on <> belt chain. "During our last meeting I only focused on the master, disregarding the apprentice; or whichever title you fancy. {PlayerLeader.Title}?"

"What would you say," {EventPlayer} continues, "if I told you there was a whole new world to explore, untouched by Magehaven's Godir and the endless struggle between Urrath and Archons? I have the knowledge and the vessel, but could use a capable partner. All it takes are some nudges to keep {Merlin} from spoiling our Leave-Taking..."
button_0: Join <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. <rs_alliance></rs_alliance>
button_4: Stay true to <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> and stopping the Leviathan.
title: The Leave-Taking

body_footer: "If you want to find me, ask your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> friends about Gylamir." Then <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> teleports away to the Leviathan, disappearing into the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>.
body_header: With <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> defeated, the enchantments on the Anchor Cities crumble, setting the Eldritch Leviathan free.
body_lore:
Now that the creature can be seen in its full otherworldly splendor, everything beside it is reduced to insignificance. Even the ruins of the mighty Wizard's Throne are like dust lost in the gills of this behemoth. As the shockwave of destruction approaches you, you notice a warding sphere spanning around yourself, protection yet prison at once.

{EventPlayer} comes into focus, showing an exculpatory gesture. "I'll admit it," <> says laughing, "I have trust issues. But don't feel sour; I won't forget that I owe you one."
button_0: Curse that little weasel.
button_7: Remember <<o:EventPlayer>> last words, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> owes you; big-time.
title: The Leave-Taking: Aftermath

body_footer: "The <hyperlink>Astral Flows</hyperlink> are disturbed," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> reads out the ciphers, "someone is watching us."
body_header: Arriving at the Shrouded Gate, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> searches the area for traces of <<o:EventHero>> people.
body_lore:
"We {EventRace} have a long tradition of devising and inscribing magical ciphers," {EventHero.FirstName} explains, while <> inspects the various stone formations surrounding the portal. "It is always fascinating to find a message written in a system we stopped using ages ago."

"Ah, yes," {EventHero} calls out at last, halting at an eroded rock. "The portal guardians left us a clue, though it isn't much."
button_0: Memorize the clue.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Ciphers and Truths

body_footer: "A masked figure approaches," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> reads out the ciphers, "lonesome and tall-grown."
body_header: Arriving at the Shrouded Gate, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> once again searches the area for traces of the guardians.
body_lore:
"My people study the mystic teachings following four distinct schools of magic," {EventHero.FirstName} explains, while <> inspects even the tiniest rocks. "Each school is seated on a different branch of our mighty Tree of Knowledge. And each school is bound to assign their share of graduates to the duty of guarding Shrouded Isles throughout the Astral Sea."

"Here!" <> suddenly calls out, picking up a pebble. "Another message."
button_0: Memorize the clue.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Schools of Magic

body_footer: "A secret is buried beneath this island," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> reads out the ciphers, "deeper than what we guard."
body_header: Arriving at the Shrouded Gate, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> once again searches the area for traces of <<o:EventHero>> people.
body_lore:
"For us {EventRace}, the watch over the Shrouded Isles is not merely a duty," <> explains, inspecting the portal, "it is a calling. Ages ago, when the cosmos was in turmoil, we bewept the fate of our distant brethren, the Krazura. They inspired us to preserve what otherwise would have been forgotten."

{EventHero} points at a stone plate, ignoring that <> is the only one who can decipher its message.
button_0: Memorize the clue.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: An Avian Legacy

body_footer: "There is no defense," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> reads from the pendant, "against a cosmic barrage."
body_header: Arriving at the Shrouded Gate, you find <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> in a mournful mood.
body_lore:
"All these Horwynd," <> says pensively, "vanished—dead." <> picks up a large pendant buried between the rocks. "You must know, {PlayerLeader}, that only the most venerated students are elect to become guardians of sun and moon. Their ritual of ascension is celebrated by all Horwynd during the yearly 'Solunacrum.'"

{EventHero} dusts off the pendant, which seems to hold another, this time more obviously placed, message.
button_0: Memorize the clue.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Eclipse

body_footer: "The Astral ripples we pursue do not carry the footprints of the Void," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes. "This isn't Fangir's doing, I am certain of it."
body_header: At <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, your troops find a <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> picks it up.
body_lore:
"You have chosen a perilous path to walk, my friend," <> says, talking to <>. "Do you think you will triumph where the Unmakers failed?"

{EventPlayer} hands over the {EventItem}. "Use this with care," <> remarks, then continues to explain: "When I shattered the Wizard's Throne to seal Athla, devouring energies not unlike those of the Fracturing became liberated and scarred Evermore. Fangir must have returned to his Isle during the Fourth Age, investigating this anti-magic I had unleashed."
button_0: Claim <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and the Isle.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Fangir's Ambitions

symon_revealed: "If we can survive the Eldritch Leviathan," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes, "I will need to search for <hyperlink>Fangir</hyperlink>. I owe it to him."

body_footer: "It's an Orrculator Locket," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> explains. "Don't fiddle with its modulations or the guardians won't recognize the message."
body_header: Nearing the Shrouded Gate, your troops are stopped by <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
"Halt, {PlayerLeader}," <> warns, "for this Isle has not yet been breached and my brethren still guard its portal. Their codex demands they defend the Shrouded Gate, even against us Horwynd, but if you show them this token they will grant you free passage."

{EventHero} hands you an intricate disk not unlike an astrolabe embedded within a pendant. It displays ornate etchings of celestial bodies, emblems of the four magic Horwynd schools and symbolism related to smithcraft and forging.
button_0: Thank <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Wardens of Sun and Moon

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> places the restored tear in a small hole on the ground. The charred plate slides away, revealing the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. "Fascinating," <<p:EventPlayer>> says.
body_header: Still standing amid the screaming echoes of <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you notice <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> appear, inspecting the frozen shards on the ground.
body_lore: "There are not many <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> who are aware of <hyperlink>Karissa's</hyperlink> elemental origins," <<p:EventPlayer>> explains while carefully mending the shattered tear piece by piece. "I myself never gave the myth much credence that she and <hyperlink>Artica</hyperlink> fell from the skies of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> within a frozen meteor. But when I saw them fight each other as sisters of fire and ice, I suddenly understood that their fates were intertwined."
button_0: Claim <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and the Isle.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Elemental Secrets

body_footer: Despite <<o:EventUnit>> appalling appearance, it is clear that the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> seeks care, like an abandoned child.
body_header: As your troops reach <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> emerges from the bog, sniffing at them inquisitively.
body_lore: "Ghrmm-sniff, who comes to Morvo?" <<p:EventUnit>> asks, licking <<o:EventUnit>> pimpled throat pouch. "Has the Mother returned for <<P:EventUnit>>? Or does she send Morvo fresh fodder?" The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> bares <<o:EventUnit>> foul teeth. "Brothers and sisters always so hungry, leave nothing for poor Morvo."
button_0: Give this Morvo into the custody of your troops. <unit></unit>
button_1: Keep Morvo as a curiosity <influence></influence> for your court.
button_2: Feed Morvo <evilact></evilact> to <<o:EventUnit>> voracious siblings inside the <eventColor>{EventInfestation}</eventColor> to poison them.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Mab's Creations

body_footer: "I'll have to keep this," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> apologizes as <<p:EventPlayer>> pouches the Eye of <hyperlink>Onoka</hyperlink>. "Though I found something else that may serve as compensation."
body_header: Struggling through barriers of ice, webs, and mists, your troops at last reach <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, where <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> asks them to hush.
body_lore: "Where the Mistwalkers lurk," <<p:EventPlayer>> whispers, "one mustn't disturb the silence." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> carefully searches the numerous niches carved into the structure until <<p:EventPlayer>> withdraws a small object from one of them. "It would appear that Arachna's loyalties were never fully dedicated to the <hyperlink>Circle</hyperlink>," <<p:EventPlayer>> remarks, presenting the Eye of <hyperlink>Onoka</hyperlink>. "Perhaps this is why her actions always seemed so far removed from the central conflicts striking Athla."
button_0: Claim <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and the Isle.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Arachna's Duplicity

body_footer: "I'm sure Marinus will forgive me for spoiling his treasure," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> says with a smile. "And if he doesn't, it's still one of my lesser sins."
body_header: Reaching the heart of the idyllic Isle you find <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> resting at <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "A garden," <<p:EventPlayer>> calls out with delight, "a secret garden! What simple treasure in a world of cosmic wars." For brief moments <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> loses <<r:EventPlayer>> in the fragrance and beauty of the surrounding flora. "Speaking of treasures," <<p:EventPlayer>> then adds, inspecting the arcane structure again, "I would be surprised if there wasn't any literal wealth stashed away in here." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> pokes around until <<p:EventPlayer>> uncovers a keyhole at the pedestal of a decorative statue.
button_0: Claim <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and the Isle.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Marinus' Wealth

body_footer: "I am last," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> ends <<o:EventUnit>> tale. <<Cp:EventUnit>> also suffers from the Umbral malady.
body_header: Inside the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> of <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> your troops find a lone <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, surrounded by creeping gloom.
body_lore: "Once... a glade, enshrouded," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> mumbles slowly with a deep, creaking voice. "The Sylvan Wolf roamed freely... sanctuary's guardian. Then came... the Umbral Vulture. The meadow fell sick... grass, trees, and beasts inflicted. The Umbral malady... carried off the Sylvan Wolf. The Umbral Vulture... feasted."
button_0: End the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> before it dies to the gloom.
button_1: Nourish the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> <mana></mana> to imbue it with new life force <unit></unit>.
button_2: Bind the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> <unit></unit> through its Umbral corruption. <evilact></evilact>
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Serena's Corruption

body_footer: While <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> speaks, a burning greataxe rises from the ground behind <<o:EventPlayer>> back. But before it can strike <<P:EventPlayer>> down, you snatch it with your arcane pull.
body_header: Claiming <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> returns to investigate the breached structure.
body_lore: "As it appears," <<p:EventPlayer>> says, "the secret hiding behind <hyperlink>Yaka's</hyperlink> ego is an even bigger ego. A bit uninspired for a Wizard who was the first on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> to tamper with magics that would alter entire races." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> takes another aimless look around. "Or perhaps", <<p:EventPlayer>> adds pensively, "there is another secret sunk beneath these sands, which these excessive displays of self-centeredness are supposed to divert from."
button_0: Claim <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and the Isle.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Yaka's Ambitions

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> arranges the corals in a puzzling pattern and plunges them into the closest Astral Rift. "This is for you, <hyperlink>Azanya</hyperlink>."
body_header: Now that your troops have eradicated the penguin threat they are joined by <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, who marvels at the colorful reef grown around <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "If there is one trait of <hyperlink>Nimue</hyperlink> I can relate to," <<p:EventPlayer>> says, picking up washed up corals, "it is her fascination with the <hyperlink>Maer</hyperlink>. The endless depths of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> are uncharted waters even for most Archmages, and to imagine the foreign wonders of the ancient Maer civilization lost somewhere within that insurmountable space is exhilarating."
button_0: Claim the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and the Isle.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: The Sea Beyond

body_footer: "If only you brought true death, <eventColor>{Nekron.FirstName}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> says with a sigh, "but you merely deny the dead their peaceful end."
body_header: "I see you haven't changed your ways one bit, <eventColor>{Nekron.FirstName}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> replies calmly, though <<o:EventPlayer>> corrupted hand appears to be restrained with great force.
body_lore: "But you bring no news to one who was the broken pawn of the enemy." Twitching tentacles attempt to crawl out of <<ge:robe,<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>>>, but immediately flinch as if struck by a flame. "In the reflection of the <hyperlink>Pitiless Void</hyperlink> everyone is a puppet, <eventColor>{Nekron.FirstName}</eventColor>. Urrath's magic cannot be wielded without succumbing to its corruption."
button_0: Keep following their debate.
title: The Price of Power

body_footer: "Sumuskira the Grovetender visited you?" <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> repeats. "Good. I got an outstanding, albeit painful, impression of that Dragon."
body_header: "<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>!" <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> speaks out with solemnity. "It is I indeed, and your vigilance is well-appropriate for the gloom of the enemy still poisons my veins."
body_lore:
"Tell me, {EventPlayer.FirstName}," {Merlin} then asks, "how did things fare for you during the incursions of the Fourth Age? I am pleased to see you still alive."

"The mountains beyond Ralikesh are vast," {EventPlayer} gives <> vague response. "After the Umbral eclipse, my tribe became blessed by the sudden attendance of the Great Mother. She showed me visions of a distant past, when her children, our ancestors, throve on all Athla."
button_0: Remind the two of the Astral disturbances.
title: The Grovetender's Scion

body_footer: "Excuse our rambling conversation, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> at last says, turning to you, "A storm is brewing on Evermore, and I hope we will weather it together."
body_header: "So you have noticed it too?" <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> asks, carefully examining the skies.
body_lore:
"The voice of the Great Mother turned ominous when she mentioned Evermore," {EventPlayer.FirstName} continues. "She called it the 'shiver', the place where the 'eldritch Leviathan' decimated her children and woke up Athla."

"After arriving on Evermore, we searched the {EventStructure} and found a portal to a small isle within the Astral Void. We learned much about how the accursed Tempest once used the weakness of Dragonkin to mold new Draconians. However, he knew nothing of this eldritch Leviathan."
button_0: "A friend of <eventColor>{Merlin}</eventColor> is a friend of mine." <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_4: "When the storm erupts, we shall see."
button_5: "I cannot trust a stranger when we are looking for a powerful mage plundering Evermore's secrets." [relationLvl-3/]
title: Traces of a Cataclysm

body_footer: Footer
body_header: Header
body_lore: Lore
button_0: Reward 1
button_2: Reward 2
button_3: Reward 3
title: Traces of a Cataclysm: Aftermath

body_footer: "With Mister <<g:tactics,EventPlayer>>, we have mounted a dashing insurgency against these vile Disciples, but the tide is turning fast, the Mistwalkers are at our doors. You must help us, oh please!"
body_header: On the early, misty morrow, a bloodied <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> errant appears before you in great distress. Letting <<P:EventUnit>> into your new court, <<p:EventUnit>> quickly relates <<o:EventUnit>> ill tidings...
body_lore: "<<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Master/Mistress}</eventColor>>> Hero, word of your heroic arrival spread quickly after our <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> kin returned to their burrows," heaves the poor, bloodied creature. "But there, most found our refuge besieged, besieged I tell you! Oh woe, that sinister Disciples of the <hyperlink>Dark Fey Lords</hyperlink> are now after our valiant leader, Mister <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, with a vengeance! For <<p:EventPlayer>>, after freeing <<r:EventPlayer>> most dashingly from their clutches, became the champion of our struggles."
button_0: Turn to <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> to demand further explanation.
title: The Siege of the Burrow Downs

body_footer: "By channeling Duatha's dreams <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> arose in Milina's whim," urges <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>. "<<Cp:EventPlayer>> must not fail, we must prevail; ere the <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> take <<P:EventPlayer>>!"
body_header: <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> giggles as you turn to <<P:<eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>>> for answers. "The truth was known, the path was shown; <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> still needs rescue, is this not so?"
body_lore: "When <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> was come, to <hyperlink>Duatha</hyperlink> lands; the <hyperlink>Fey Lords</hyperlink> him did bind," titters <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>, "They shackled <<P:EventPlayer>>, then brought to trial, with mockery in mind! But yea, behold, our <hyperlink>Geassadae</hyperlink> wished, that <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> would make escape! So touched was <<P:EventPlayer>>, by Milina sweet, to lead the <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> scrape. Milina, O Milina, my mistress, our divine! She it is, who <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> made to seek you out, in time."
button_0: Accept this quest in full support of the Pellari cause!
title: Milina's Whim

body_footer: "<eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>, you little rascal, I knew you'd pull through," chimes <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Come all, come join us for tea as we introduce ourselves and discuss 'battle plans'..."
body_header: Reaching the confines of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor> darts off forward towards an open, underground square where many figures huddle around a steaming pot.
body_lore: In the midst of this gathering, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> looks up with a warm smile. "<eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>? Back so soon, are we? And who is this you bring...?" <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> beams with pride upon seeing you. "By the <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink>, what a capital fellow—hullo there! Oh, a mighty, fine business this is becoming, I feel luck to be squarely on our side. Surely, <hyperlink>Milina</hyperlink> smiles in her Geasan slumber."
button_0: Join the rebel assembly for tea.
title: Milina's Chosen: Aftermath

button_7: Question <knowledge></knowledge> <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> why <<p:EventPlayer>> is here.

button_4: Accept this quest, reluctantly; weary of further Fey trickery.

body_footer: "Scurry away before <<g:thunder,<eventColor>{FeyGodName}</eventColor>>>," threatens <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>. "You and those little dirt-rodents will be mist-fare before the splendor of me, '<hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>'. I have set my sights on you..."
body_header: A mocking raptor's screech, announces the arrival of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. "Ugh, where do they keep finding such... miserable riffraff?"
body_lore: With unblinking eyes, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> probes your mind. "Fall rains down on all, especially to those who rise too recklessly. I have known plenty of <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> like you. Think you can resist the <hyperlink>true masters</hyperlink> of this land because you've squashed a couple of Mistwalkers, do you? Hmpf. You and <<g:wretched<eventColor>{Ham.FirstName}</eventColor>>> <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> rabble will change your tunes soon enough."
button_0: "You do not impress me, you windbag. To war!"
button_3: Flatter <influence></influence> <<g:ego,<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>>>.
title: Run Before the Thunder

body_footer: "You will see <eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>, call out to old Auntie when you do," snaps <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, before turning to you. "And you... Either turn in <eventColor>{Ham}</eventColor> to me before any more <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> get hurt. Or become prey."
body_header: With a combative snarl, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> prowls before you. "Another outland <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>? Come to <hyperlink>Duatha</hyperlink> to plunder her bounties, or to aid our hunt for rebels?"
body_lore: "<eventColor>{FeyGuideName}</eventColor>, do not trust that <eventColor>{Ham}</eventColor>, return to Auntie <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>! Remember the old stories of the first <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> who defiled this land," growls <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>. "They caused the nightmares that tormented <hyperlink>Duatha</hyperlink>! So curse that <eventColor>{Ham}</eventColor> for dragging the <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> into <<o:Ham>> selfish wars. <<Cp:Ham>> is cruel to make them <<o:Ham>> pawns. But we Duatha-born are the Godir now..."
button_0: "No one threatens me. To war!"
button_3: "I will consider this."
title: Spring's Out on the Prowl

body_footer: "We kills it, then eats it!" grumbles <eventColor>{Grump}</eventColor>. "Nah, we captures it an' tosses it into the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, for <hyperlink><eventColor>{FeyGodName}</eventColor></hyperlink>, ghahaha!" argues <eventColor>{Kana}</eventColor>, and on and on...
body_header: "Can we eats it?" rumbles a deep, slobbering voice. "No! That one's good sport for <hyperlink><eventColor>{FeyGodName}</eventColor></hyperlink>, you glob-gob!" gutturally screeches another.
body_lore: With a stomp and a belching chuckle,  enters to land <<o:Grump>> and <<o:Kana>> vicious sight onto you. "Ah shuddup, that's luncheons, says I!" grumbles <eventColor>{Grump}</eventColor>. "Yous a'ways eat'n them, you snot-rot! <hyperlink><eventColor>{FeyGodName}</eventColor></hyperlink> fancy's 'em reeeal squealing-like. So best be leaving this'un all squiggly-piggly for the Summer Master, eh!" The two heads bicker and belch back and forth like this for an abominably long time before you.
button_0: "I will end your bickering myself, to war!"
button_3: Slink away unnoticed while <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> bicker on...
title: Bickering Summer Griddle

body_footer: "The bleak, perishing power of our lady <hyperlink><eventColor>{FeyGodName}</eventColor></hyperlink> be upon you all," curses <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Soon... very soon. Watch out for the unweaving strands of your imminent doom."
body_header: Skitter, skitter sound the chitinous legs of a dark, bone-chilling approach, before <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> appears out from the murk.
body_lore: "Mistwalker blood is on your palms, <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, admit it," insists <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> with a dark hiss. "Unlike <hyperlink>Duatha's</hyperlink> Fairy playthings, they actually serve a noble purpose. And each of their deaths evokes a chittering vengeance to be spun out from the cold, hollow of darkness."
button_0: "So be it."
button_3: "Wait, aren't you a renowned Athlan Godir? What brings you here?"
title: Eightfold Hiemal Oath

body_footer: "We must acquire the entire <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>," urges <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, "to cast a spell of Milina-make that banishes the <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> from the Realm. And you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>, are the right <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Hero/Heroine}</eventColor>>> for the job. What say you?"
body_header: After many bustling introductions over tea and biscuits—and the occasional seconds—<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> finally rises to speak: "I say our primary point of attention must be the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> atop the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>."
body_lore: "Indeed, there are many like it," continues <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>, "to which, the Mistwalkers bring their prisoners, and 'try' them in their abominable 'Court of Mockery.' But, as we all know, the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> is far older than even the <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> themselves. And, therefore, it still retains a power through which the <hyperlink>Geassadae</hyperlink> can channel their magicks. This, I submit to you, is the crux of my plan:"
button_0: Accept this quest, solemnly.
button_4: "Aye! I will claim the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>."
title: To Court With Mockery

body_footer: Lit up by the sun's ray, a single <hyperlink>Pellari</hyperlink> whelpling begins to sing a lullaby of hope. To which many others soon follow, one after another.
