body_header: At last, the key areas around the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> are secured, and with it, a bright sun ray broke through the Fey clouds and mists.
body_lore: But as the remaining <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> retreat and the scattered Disciple's forces regroup at the edge of the conquered terrain, a terrible aura emerges from the trees. Rumblings of thunder, agitated twittering of strange birds, the fell hiss of steam, and the howling of winter winds all coalesce against the golden radiance of the heavens.
button_0: Join the swelling chorus.
title: To Court With Mockery: Aftermath

body_footer: "This will sound like madness," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes, "but I need you to push through and create an anchor, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. An anchor large enough to enchain a creature of Evermore's size..."
body_header: "The Eldritch Leviathan, bane of our ancestors!" <eventColor>{Reskar}</eventColor> calls out in disbelief, <<o:<eventColor>{Reskar}</eventColor>>> people rallying behind <<P:Reskar>>. "It never left Evermore."
body_lore:
"It all makes sense now," {EventPlayer} adds, while the tentacles underneath <> robe mimic the Leviathan's movements. "The Astral disturbances were but the yawning of the colossal creature awakening from its ancient slumber; a magically induced slumber as it appears."

"I hate to interrupt these musings," {EventHero} speaks up, "but this Leviathan brought some family. And what's more, I espy the mysterious mage we've been seeking, or rather, phantasmal reflections of her or him. They spearhead the emerging Astral Sea Monsters."
button_0: Prepare to battle your way to the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
title: The Sleeper Beneath Evermore

body_header: Underneath the mountains <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, a shockwave of destruction is unleashed.

body_footer: "O cunning regents upon Witherbloom's throne," the leader of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> calls out, "render your judgment upon these unwilling offerings!"
body_header: While the heat of summer bedazzles your thoughts, your inner eye perceives visions of a macabre scene...
body_lore: You see long lines of frightened captives climbing the winding stairways hewn into an ancient rock formation. As they reach the last plateau, the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> force their victims to enter a mistflooded basin. Once the last captive has entered the mists a dark Feysong swells, while stone-carved effigies of the four <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> rise like columns from the ground, until they tower above all.
button_0: Observe the outcome of this 'trial,' unable to intervene...
button_3: Channel magic <mana></mana> from your surrounding domain to disrupt the ritual.
title: Court of Summer

autumn: While the autumn wind reaps and whirls around the foliage of the last season, your inner eye perceives visions of a macabre scene...
spring: While rampant growth rejuvenates the land, your inner eye perceives visions of a macabre scene...
winter: While heavy snowfall starts to becloud the skies, your inner eye perceives visions of a macabre scene...

body_footer: Silently, the transformed captives join ranks with the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. From the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> they march out, ready to spread fear throughout the Burrow Downs...
body_header: The eyes on the effigies of the <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> light up as their ominous voices pronounce a single word: "Worthy!"
body_lore: From the mouth of each effigy, a stream of butterflies emerges, coalescing into one colorful swarm encircling the basin. The mists therein begin to waft more violently, like seething lava, and muffled gasps and screams can be heard. At last, the butterflies disperse and the figures inside the mist begin to move again, tottering. Yet as the first captive steps outside the basin you shudder, for they are no longer captives—they have become <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>!
button_0: Let the visions fade away.
title: Doomed to Live

body_footer: The <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> have siphoned the life from all captives, bestowing part of the reaped power upon their Disciples.
body_header: The eyes on the effigies of the <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> light up as their ominous voices pronounce a single word: "Unworthy!"
body_lore: From the mouth of each effigy, a stream of butterflies emerges, coalescing into one colorful swarm encircling the basin. The mists therein begin to waft more violently, like seething lava, and screams of terror and anguish can be heard. When the butterflies disperse at last, the basin is empty. But the mists have changed color, dyed a disturbing lavender, flowing into the effigies as if the <hyperlink>Duathadae</hyperlink> were absorbing the lifeforce captured within.
button_0: Let the visions fade away.
title: Doomed to Die

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> hands over the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. "Wield this with care," <<p:EventPlayer>> remarks. "One day Artica's life might depend on it."
body_header: While the winds still howl at <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> appears, inspecting the bottled flame.
body_lore: "I have heard many theories about elemental siblings," <<p:EventPlayer>> explains, gazing at the unthawed frescoes of <hyperlink>Artica</hyperlink> and <hyperlink>Karissa the Red</hyperlink>. "One of them makes the claim that despite their fundamental opposition, elemental siblings will never fully destroy their sisters or brothers. For it would result in their own death." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> opens the bottle, liberating a darting flame which melts down the bottle, violently reshaping it into a <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>.
button_0: Claim <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and the Isle.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Elemental Fates

body_footer: "We found the abandoned study rooms of our primary suspect," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> concludes. "The remaining question is just, where to find them now."
body_header: Reaching the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> of the Isle, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> joins your troops, pensively.
body_lore: "Whoever set up this Isle had a lot of time to spend here," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> remarks, scanning the surroundings. "All these study areas covering the different facets of the arcane give testament to true thirst for knowledge—and an abundance of loneliness." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> picks up a pair of enchanted boots left on an artificing table. "These are made to walk where no foot can get a grip. The <hyperlink>Astral Flows</hyperlink> are only tread by the desperate."
button_0: Claim the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and the Isle.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Arcane Studies

symon_met: "How could I miss so long what <eventColor>{Symon}</eventColor> found thereafter?" <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> asks <<r:EventPlayer>>. "This is all my fault."

"Oh, <eventColor>{Symon}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> calls out with a sigh, "you gave it your best to struggle through your imprisonment. All these study areas covering the different facets of the arcane give testament to true thirst for knowledge—and an abundance of loneliness." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> picks up a pair of enchanted boots left on an artificing table. "These are made to walk where no foot can get a grip. The <hyperlink>Astral Flows</hyperlink> are only tread by the desperate."

body_footer: "If you insist on wasting your time," <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> replies, clearly disgruntled, "go and activate those Obelisks."
body_header: In the <eventColor>{EventGeo}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, your troops find a monolithic structure, adorned with pristine, mysterious carvings.
body_lore:
"This is an Ancient Obelisk warding the secret entrances to Shrouded Isles," {EventHero} explains, as <> and {EventPlayer} enter the scene. "Without the Obelisks, even their makers wouldn't be able to find the Shrouded Gates. But none of that matters. For we already revealed all the Gates on Evermore."

"I would not be so sure about that," {EventPlayer} objects, smiling. "On Evermore it is a good precaution to expect the unexpected."
button_0: Set out to find more Obelisks.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Ancient Obelisks

body_footer: The revealed Shrouded Gate lies at the very heart of Evermore, close to the Broken Wizard's Throne.
body_header: Activating the third Ancient Obelisk, its carvings illuminate as their spell is set in motion.
body_lore:
It resonates, producing chiming sounds from a distant time, and then washes over Evermore. "Impossible!" {EventHero} calls out as the shape of a Shrouded Gate emerges from its magic concealment.

"Even now, not all the secrets of Evermore have been unraveled, it seems," {EventPlayer} remarks enthusiastically. "Though you should be prepared for more resistance at this gate, {PlayerLeader}."

"Indeed," {EventHero} confirms, slowly regaining <> composure, "if this gate was guarded by any {EventRace}, I would know about it."
button_0: "I will claim whatever knowledge rests inside."
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Mysterious Isle

body_footer: "How can a man spread the very thing which he vowed to fight?" the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> calls out in desperation. Then <<p:EventUnit>> vanishes.
body_header: Entering the Mysterious Isle your troops find themselves in a cursed, desolate environment.
body_lore:
A shadowy figure is roaming the area. It doesn't seem to perceive your troops, fully engulfed in its own lamentations.

"I cannot undo what I have done," the figure speaks, "nor rewind the threads of destiny I tainted. Those weren't my lips that touched the cursed object, or the ploy would have been in vain. But still, it happened through my designs, my hands, my orders..."
button_0: Keep exploring the Isle.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Echoes of Execration

body_footer: "I am not even worthy of this purgatory!" the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> screams, smelting away in <<o:EventUnit>> own fire.
body_header: Your troops continue their path through the Mysterious Isle, traversing chasms of boiling lava.
body_lore:
A flaming figure emerges from the molten earth. Like the other one before, it shows no reaction to your troops, instead spitting out heated accusations.

"The High Council granted me absolution—absolution!" the figure bursts out. "Have they lost all sense of reality? And worse, they entrust me with a Circle of Deogai, returning me to the place of the unspeakable. Haven't they noticed my burning guilt? Is this their device of punishment?"
button_0: Keep exploring the Isle.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Echoes of Atonement

body_footer: An <hyperlink>Archon</hyperlink> host, led by a <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> appears. "Perpetrators?" the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> calls out, interrupting <<o:EventUnit>> forging. "Leave! My work hasn't finished!"
body_header: Inside the Arcanum, you find a shining apparition floating above the center altar. Its words echo throughout the structure.
body_lore:
"The accursed horn, it has been retrieved at last!" the voice jubilates. "Now the true work begins. I must thank the {EventRace} for devising the Shrouded Isles; this Arcanum will be my enclave, my smithy of purification."

An exalted chant resounds, carrying the words of litanies and incantations, accompanied by the rhythmic chimes of a Celestial hammer.
button_0: Attack the Arcanum guardians.
button_1: Clever Attack
button_2: Leave, for now.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Echoes of Purification

no_ruler: Inside the Arcanum, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> finds a shining apparition floating above the center altar. Its words echo throughout the structure.

body_footer: "Gabriel found catharsis in undoing the High Men legacy of the First Age," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> sums up, "through his work as the arbiter of Evermore's <hyperlink>Circle</hyperlink> and on the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>."
body_header: With the Arcanum defenders overcome, a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> appears, holding an ornate horn with a golden skull.
body_lore:
"My work here is finished", the spirit speaks, "but the struggle against darkness is eternal, as is my guilt." <> hands you the {EventArtifact}: "Blow this wherever you can, {PlayerLeader}. It will guide all souls back to the Well. There can never be too much mercy."

As the spirit fades away, {EventPlayer} suddenly enters the Arcanum. "So it is true," <> says slowly, "and it was Gabriel who brought the Horn of the Dead to Athla. He never revealed to me his burdens; but I saw in the Pitiless Void that he is with the High Council now."
button_0: Encourage <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> to liberate <<r:EventPlayer>> from <<o:EventPlayer>> own prison of guilt. <goodact></goodact>
button_1: Embrace the path of mercy laid out by both Gabriel and <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. <goodact></goodact>
button_2: Claim the other works of Gabriel's purification <unit></unit> from the Arcanum.
title: Secrets of the Archmages: Echoes of Mercy

body_footer: A stream of blood shoots out from <<ge:hands,<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>>>, forming a sanguine link with the Leviathan.
body_header: Black clouds loom at the rim of the Eldritch Leviathan's craters as the cursed words of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> resound throughout Evermore:
body_lore:
"Nameless One, from darkness deep
Hear this witchery in your sleep
Eldritch veins of eldritch blood
[runicfont]Will unleash the crimson flood![/runicfont]"
button_0: Observe the ritual's outcome.
title: Sanguine Ritual

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> has revealed <<o:EventPlayer>> vampiric powers, unleashing them on all Evermore.
body_header: A welter of high-pitched shrieks shakes Evermore as the lands surrounding the void of the Eldritch Leviathan become soaked in blood, turning Sunless.
body_lore: "The Crimson Age is at its dawn," <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> declares, while hordes of blood-infused creatures move in the twilight. "All across the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, the <hyperlink>agents</hyperlink> of the Blood Dominion rise, acting from the shadows. Before the <hyperlink>Great Umbral War</hyperlink> is over, the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> of <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink> will be but nescient thralls serving the Blood Reckoning's true heirs."
button_0: "This fight will get bloody!"
title: Blood Dominion

body_footer: Using 8 as a mighty anchor, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> has bound the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> in magical sleep.
body_header: The city of 8 stretches across the rim of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. Atop its tallest building stands <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, <<o:EventPlayer>> <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> held up high, shouting an incantation:
body_lore:
"Wake not, Nameless One, where though shalt sleep.
Rejoin the dreams of Athla old.
This anchorage of rock shall keep
Though fettered in this astral mold."
button_0: Ward 8, so the spell will not be broken.
title: Anchored Sleep

switched_sides: Prepare to attack <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> and break the anchor.

description: Through skillful persuasion, you have become Merlin's new apprentice. Accompany him on his search for cosmic balance, returning to the mythic realm of Evermore. Uncover the secrets of the crumbled <hyperlink>Circle of Deogai</hyperlink>—and wield your newfound skills to fight the sinister powers sleeping in Evermore's shadows.
name: Evermore
reveal_shrouded_gates_tooltip: You explore the map areas around all Shrouded Gates.

description: You have enchanted the Eldritch Leviathan back into slumber, preventing Evermore's complete destruction!
You have liberated Symon and the Eldritch Leviathan from their imprisonment on Evermore.

description: When the prophecy of Anon had been fulfilled and Merlin wrested from Urrath’s control, the Godir of Magehaven rejoiced, hoping Merlin’s powers and knowledge of the enemy would turn the tide in the Great Umbral War. Yet Merlin, guilt-ridden and drained, barely mustered the strength to repulse them. He walked the streets of Magehaven as a tired old man, dismissing friends and foes alike.

Until one day Merlin disappeared, and no traces of him were to be found. Only a vague rumor persisted that Merlin had become a recluse, imprisoning himself in meditations, on a floating island somewhere within the Astral Sea...

Alas, the Astral Flows can be treacherous and a man of once great power cannot hide from the cosmos forever. A messenger of the Horwynd, an ancient owl people attracted to arcane secrets, was the first to find Merlin’s Astral refuge. She talked in riddles, alluding to a quest of dire importance. Thereafter came many mages, some impatient, others tenacious, seeking his mentorship. Merlin ignored them all.

At last the Horwynd messenger grew desperate, speaking more openly: Her people had sensed rippling echoes in the Astral Flows, signs of unusually strong magic activity—leading back to Evermore. Evermore. Hearing that name roused Merlin from his meditations. He looked at the messenger and the one Godir who had outlasted all other aspirants. Then he conceded.

This is the tale of their return to Athla’s broken Wizard’s Throne...

description: And so, owing to the heroic intervention of a brave Godir, the enormous eyelids of the Eldritch Leviathan closed once more. At the top of Evermore's broken Wizard's Throne stood Merlin, inheriting Symon's burdensome task of sustaining the Leviathan's enchantment. Yet as Merlin gazed at the ancient creature, he encountered a feeling swelling inside himself that he had presumed left behind in a distant life: curiosity.

Tearing asunder the material crust of its age-long prison, the Eldritch Leviathan left behind Evermore, floating away into the Astral Sea. At its colossal slope hung Symon, cheering in elation, overwhelmed by the sheer infinite number of worlds glimmering tantalizingly in the distance. He thanked the bold Godir who had chosen to support their daring liberation—and to not fear the unfathomable.

Thus, the Duathadae's servants were cast out from the Burrow Downs and the realm was astir with joy, as Pellari folk—young and old—resurfaced to celebrate. They joined the Fey rebels in the Mistflow Gardens, where Ham Binger channeled Milina's magic to evoke a spirit of friendship and love. New hope was kindled that one day the Geassadae would be freed from their enchantment and return laughter and merriment to all of Duatha.

description: Since the Dawn of Ages, Obbadoth—birthworld of the Fiends—was shaped by carnage. Here, demons and hellions clashed amongst one another in ceaseless strife, while their Overlords ever feasted upon the raw, chaotic energies it produced. Fearing this infernal tide might one day engulf all other worlds, the Archons sent forth their greatest champions to vanquish the spread and contain it.

Though the Archons battled against Fiend-kind for many ages, neither their zeal nor divine might proved able to halt the spread. On the contrary, their relentless campaigning only further fueled the carnage energies that empowered their enemies. Realizing the error of their ways, the Archon High Council called them all back—but one champion never answered the call...

Determined to succeed, or driven to madness, the young champion Ysariel instead resorted to forbidden measures. Rather than opposing the Demon Overlords, he offered them a pact: if they agreed to forever remain upon Obbadoth, he would personally feed their hunger for carnage with zealous strife. In return, a Circle of Deogai would be established, seated entirely by their Demonic Princes.

Though this contract ultimately contained the Demon spread, it horrified the Archons utterly. And for defying them, Ysariel was thereafter exiled in disgrace. Yet, his Circle silently abided well into the present age. It was therefore a matter of great concern to the Godir of Magehaven, when Ysariel reached out, one day, with a desperate plea for aid...

This is the tale of the Godir who answered his summons.

description: Thus, the true, unfettered spirit of Chaos was set loose upon the Astral Sea, at large. For the complete destruction of the Azh'Ruun Pit not only freed the Demon Overlords from their pactbound confines but also set them clawing at the throats of their ancient Hellion adversaries, once again.

Thus, the Circle of the Azh'Ruun Pit was protected from the relentless onslaught of Karissa and the infernal schemes of the Demon Overlords below. With it, the old order held firm and all unknowing denizens of the Astral Sea could continue their lives, ignorant of the greater evils that lurked beneath Obbadoth—at least, for now.

Bit by bit, sparks of anarchy ignited across many Worlds Within. As brother turned against brother, Wizards openly forged pacts with Demons, and the forces of order suddenly found themselves besieged from all fronts. All this, orchestrated before the wicked laughter of a Godir whose very name henceforth sparked fear across the Astral Sea.

Blessed by the cosmic forces of Order, this nigh-improbable ordeal was ultimately achieved through the hard, principled labor of one, exalted Godir of note. Indeed, their deeds thereafter forged a bright legend that would inspire generations of heroes to brave all impossible odds in the just pursuit of triumph.

Bit by bit, sparks of anarchy ignited across many Worlds Within. As brother turned against brother, Wizards openly forged pacts with Demons, and the forces of order suddenly found themselves besieged from all fronts. For an unstoppable tide had erupted, ushered in through the fury of Karissa and the Godir whom she now favored above all others—her much adored partner in Chaos.

The Circle's throne remained stoically seated by Ysariel, who was forever left touched by the extraordinary bond he had shared in that time. Though, thereafter, he became even more pensive and sequestered than before, often seen standing alone, staring up towards the stars. Perhaps in longing for one particular Godir to visit him, once more.

description: While the Great Umbral War raged on, exhausting Magehaven's Godir and their allies, other forces, both forgotten and new, stirred in the shadows, silently exploiting this opportunity to challenge the established balance of power. Chief among those rising forces were the Mistwalkers, servants of the Duathadae, who were dreaded for their raids—called the Toll of Seasons—throughout the Astral Sea.

The Mistwalkers had become more active than ever before, dragging the populations of entire worlds to their Fey realm of Duatha. And unlike in the past, they no longer left the raided lands, instead establishing permanent presences watching over the spreading mists. Rumors of Godir, captured and turned by the Fey lords to carry out their sinister orders, were whispered in fear, even in the untouchable towers of Magehaven.

In the wake of these rumors, a solitary sprite called Dawnusk emerged from Duatha, searching the Worlds Within for a Godir who would answer his plea for help. For the legendary adventurer and storyteller Ham Binger had fallen victim to the Toll of Seasons and been brought before the Duathadae for judgment.

Trust was scarce for the words of a Fey in these times of fear, and Dawnusk had to rely on his elusive Fey magic to escape the anger of many a Wizard who would try to capture or kill him. But at last the sprite found a bold Godir willing to venture into the Fey realm and rescue Ham Binger.

So they took a deep breath, strode into a Fey fissure, and plunged into the mists of Duatha...

bio:
To some, he is the divine progenitor who sired perfection into existence through the Pureblood Archvampires; while to others he is but a mythological monster who once terrorized the Astral Sea in a bygone age. Yet to one alone, he shall forever be remembered as the gallant Pale Prince of Roses...

Urvatogh the First Vampire, Blood Emperor Eternal of the Crimson Reign, and Deathless God who died yet rose again. His Grand Dominion of Drevanya once spread far and wide, until deepest betrayal sealed him away within a crypt, to fade beyond memory into myth. Here, he slumbers in perpetuity, though certain cults tell that he shall one night rise again to bring about a coveted reckoning of blood.

His Eternal Attendants are but animated remnants of a now long-forgotten race. They once served the family of the Pale Prince of Roses, back in brighter days.
name: Eternal Attendants

bio:
What she wouldn’t have given for a normal life. Griselda was once a lively girl who enjoyed the simple things, until an unknown Vampire took it all away. Dedicating herself to vengeance ever since, her long hunt has made her stoic and bitter. Too often has she seen good people's lives destroyed by the unending hunger of Vampire-kind. Determined to end it all, Griselda has devoted herself and her whole family to eradicating the parasitic tumor at its root—one Archvampire after another.

Aiding her to the best of their abilities are her own devoted clan, the Stoic Dawnwatchers. Resourceful vagabonds and tough wayfarers all, they have been away from home for so long that most barely even remember where it was in the first place...
name: Stoic Dawnwatchers

bio:
Archvampire, Prince-Consort Wtorakh stands at the peak of the pureblood bloodline, second only to his own Sire: the Deathless God himself. He is accomplished amongst his peers for siring a substantial number of Elder Vampires, though equally infamous amongst his own brood for abandoning them shortly after their embrace. Since his true obsession rather lies in the unholy art of blood revelry—a dark and cultish practice, readily exercised by his crazed flock of followers: the 'Ravishing Blood-Revelers.'

This race of fallen Elves long ago welcomed and worship Vampire-kind as elevated deities. Now, all devote themselves to the darkest excesses of carnal revelry, each desiring nothing more than to be embraced next.
name: Ravishing Blood-Revelers

bio:
It is said that the Great Bat was wounded and its blood fell from the sky. When Guindy first drank that vibrant liquid, he felt himself ascend. His senses sharpened, his strength grew unstoppable, and his endurance knew no bounds. For generations he ruled his tribe as a ruthless chieftain, now he rules them as a wise deity—the Apex Predator.

To the Crimson Gazers, vampirism is the natural culmination of their kind. They already hunted the night, devoured their enemies, and showed no mercy. In the wild, you are prey or predator. Nothing else.

The Blackrose Baron is the subject of legends and tragic tales. They say his Vampire ascension was never his choice. They whisper that he was bitten in battle, facing a being as old as the blood-curse itself. They say he was shunned like a plague and imprisoned in his own city by the neighboring Dwarven kingdom... And that, consumed by an uncontrollable hunger, he devoured his family and his people.

Legends also claim that the Black Marchers are the descendants of the Dwarves who sealed the Baron’s fate. After generations of thralldom and the bites of their master, they have become perfect vessels, capable of quelling Ursul's thirst for revenge.

The Bathoris name traces back to the ancient Dominion of Rued Drevanya, where Vampire society reached its zenith. Though the glory of that empire has long since faded, the Marquess continues to host the grand balls of old times for those daring enough to attend... And those who fail to keep up with the court intrigues often end up as its appetizer.

To escape the torment of sunlight, Varnas established his court in the underground, accessible only through the family crypt. There he has fashioned a race of servants, feeding Goblins with his own blood and that of bats. Some whisper that the Shrieking Bats are also his creation, though none dare speculate on the manner of their breeding.

Two ages ago, Ymbria performed a blood ritual that granted her a perverse immortality. Aided by an ancient tome of questionable origin, she sacrificed her entire cult and concocted a potion from their blood. Yet it did not bestow the eternal beauty she craved. Instead, her body remains in a perpetual state of decay, something that can only be rectified by feeding upon the living.

Ymbria has rebuilt her cult under the teachings of the tome's author. He who now whispers profane rites in her mind, He who now calls upon her, demanding to be awakened again. The Cult of the Blood Rite follows their priestess, who obeys the call in hope of attaining true immortality.

Eldest of Archvampires and notably first to be turned, the prickly Princess Consort Mavelith stands at the peak of the pureblood bloodline, second only to the Deathless God himself. Infamously ruthless, cold and cruel, the Grave Archdam eagerly doles out torment in her hungry pursuit to obtain dominion over all others—the more resistant her victim, the more enticing they become.

She perfected her torturous obsessions upon a race of hysterical beings, feared as the Flagellant Screechers. Warping their souls and minds so that they desire pain more than food or drink. Many whip themselves up into an ecstatic frenzy before charging into the fray, all slobbering and howling, hankering to attain harm, or even death.
name: Flagellant Screechers

lore:
"Following the blood rivers upstream, my Orcs found the literal heart of the Sunless Lands, beating within the trunk of a defiled World Tree. Soon after, they succumbed to the Blood Parasites, devoured from the inside. Some say the heart's infection is a curse from the ancient times, others call it the vile progeny of Vampiric cults. Me, I call it perfection."

— Karissa the Red, Blood Rites throughout the Ages

lore:
"An alluring flower, trapping its victims in a thorny prison. From their drained blood crimson crystals bloom. My druids, wearing pendants of this Blood Glass, feel rejuvenated at dawn, as if its siphoned life force was bestowed upon them. Yet in nightly whispers they invoke the name of the Pale Prince, and I wonder: is it wrong to harness his curse?"

— Sylvani Laurel, Survival within the Sunless Lands

body: The moon bleeds through an open wound, staining the sky crimson. Animals flee to hide, villagers bar their doors, and the creatures of the dusk rejoice in its glow. For the night is red and ruled by horrors.
body_footer: During its eclipse, the Blood Moon empowers all <hyperlink>Vampires</hyperlink> and allows them to roam freely throughout the world.
body_header: The sky darkens into scarlet. The Blood Moon, summoned by <eventColor>{BloodMoonPlayer}</eventColor>, eclipses the light of the sun.
button_0: Prepare for the red night.
happening_header: The sky darkens into scarlet. The Blood Moon eclipses the light of the sun.
title: Blood Moon

no_ai_lords: This is the Moon of Blood

player_is_caster: The sky darkens into scarlet. The Blood Moon you summoned eclipses the light of the sun.

no_ai_lords: This is the Moon of Blood

body_footer: From what crimson well will you quench your thirst? Whose blood will satiate the craving?
body_header: Your fangs itch. Flashes of red blur your vision. Your body craves blood. You can suppress your unholy desires no longer.
body_lore: You sense the heartbeats of the mortals that surround you. <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>. Animals. Your trusted lieutenants and your prisoners of war. You try to shake off the craving. It is not becoming of a <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{lord/lady}</eventColor>>> of your standing, after all. But the bloodlust relentlessly grows until the roars of your hunger drown out all other sounds. Blood. You must drink blood.
button_0: "No one will miss a few <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> <souls></souls> from <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. <happiness></happiness>"
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> is feeble anyway. <<Co:EventHero>> blood will invigorate me." <xp></xp>
button_2: "I will feast on cattle." <food></food>
button_3: Drink dead man's <souls></souls> blood, despite its harmful effects. <hp></hp>
button_4: Devour your thralls <thralls></thralls> to still the hunger.
button_5: Consume <eventColor>{EventHeroB}</eventColor>, chained in your prison.
title: The Craving

body_footer: The camp of the Vampire Hunter and <<o:EventStackLeader>> entourage is located <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. Vanquish <<P:EventStackLeader>>, lest they beset you.

body_header: The origin of Vampires is tied to the legendary substance commonly called <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>, which invigorates Vampires and generates bloodlust.
body_lore: The <hyperlink>Archvampire</hyperlink>, your ancestral lords, would craft swords, rings, and crowns from the glass to display their wealth and authority. The windows of their ancient palaces would be made from <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> panes, transforming the bright rays that pierce them into a revitalizing red light. The greatest of kings had whole covens of trusted lieutenants equipped with masterful <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> weaponry.
button_0: "The <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> will be a great help in my conquests!"
button_2: "Flaunt <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>? I will erect a statue <structureprod></structureprod> of myself <influence></influence> instead!"
button_3: "I have no interest in the follies of dusty kings."
title: Glass of Crimson

body_footer: Acquiring the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> boosts your magic item production. The blacksmiths may even finish one weapon for one <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> immediately!
body_header: Holding a shard of <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>, you faintly sense a pulse. You feel its invigorating effects. And your growing hunger.
body_lore: Your blacksmiths arrive to inform you that their forges are ready. They are eager use this material to craft biting blades and deflecting plates. Your <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> in particular can benefit from the improved armaments that the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> can provide. You give the signal, and your grinning blacksmiths haul the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> away to their shadowed smithies.
button_0: Forge a <eventColor>{DefenderItem}</eventColor> <item></item> for <eventColor>{DefenderHero}</eventColor>.
button_1: Forge a <eventColor>{MageItem}</eventColor> <item></item> for <eventColor>{MageHero}</eventColor>.
button_4: Forge a <eventColor>{RangerItem}</eventColor> <item></item> for <eventColor>{RangerHero}</eventColor>.
button_5: Forget Heroes. Mix it in with my regular troops' armaments. <unitprod></unitprod>
button_6: "My Heroes have abandoned me. I shall create a weapon for myself." <item></item>
button_7: Forge a <eventColor>{RitualistItem}</eventColor> <item></item> for <eventColor>{RitualistHero}</eventColor>.
button_8: Forge a <eventColor>{SpellbladeItem}</eventColor> <item></item> for <eventColor>{SpellbladeHero}</eventColor>.
button_9: Forge a <eventColor>{WarlockItem}</eventColor> <item></item> for <eventColor>{WarlockHero}</eventColor>.
title: Glass of Crimson: Aftermath

body_footer: If you wish to learn more about your foresires, build <researchpost></researchpost> <hyperlink>Research Post</hyperlink> to study the history of your bloodline more profoundly.
body_header: As an <hyperlink>Elder Vampire</hyperlink> <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, you are descended from a great line of <hyperlink><<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Archsires/Archdams}</eventColor>>></hyperlink>. But which one?
body_lore: There were many clans, covens, and houses in the sunless past of your kind. Each vaunted their own talents, strengths, and skills. And while you thirst to learn where your ambitions take you, knowing the origin of your power may prove useful. Scribes and scholars already work tirelessly to uncover hidden magics, but will need bolstering to study your lineage.
button_0: Build the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.ResearchPostConcept.Name}</eventColor> to fortify your scholastic capacities.
button_2: You know <knowledge></knowledge> enough. It is willing hands <thralls></thralls> you lack.
button_3: Let the past rot. Your focus is dominating the future.
title: Lore of the <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Archsires/Archdams}</eventColor>>>

body_footer: Tapping this new well of power already strengthens you. How will you use this discovery to shape your domain?
body_header: The last of the <researchpost></researchpost> <hyperlink>Research Post</hyperlink> has been raised and already your scribes report a breakthrough.
body_lore: They successfully translated ancient scrolls, written in a dead language, which harbors the annals of one of the dark children of the <hyperlink>Blood Emperor Eternal</hyperlink>. Comparing these annals to the dynasty tree of your <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{sire/dam}</eventColor>>>, you can trace your lineage all the way back to <eventColor>{EventPhrase}</eventColor>
button_0: Use the knowledge to attract recruits for your army. <unitprod></unitprod>
button_1: Exploit this insight to cement your high class <influence></influence> status.
button_4: Announce this discovery to reinforce the pride <happiness></happiness> of your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>.
button_5: Adduce your lineage to bind more thralls <thralls></thralls> to your will.
button_6: Accept this knowledge as proof of your devotion <devotion></devotion>
title: Lore of the <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Archsires/Archdams}</eventColor>>>: Aftermath

body_footer: So many thralls to spare! Surely you can find a better use for them than to congest your <hyperlink>Vampire Castle</hyperlink>?
body_header: Thralls gather in your keep in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. They are huddled up in throngs, occupying your deepest dungeons and deadliest laboratories.
body_lore: Thralls are a symbol of your influence over lesser folk. Stripped of their wills and lusts, they follow your every order without pause or objection. But to Vampires, thralls should not be kept idle. The most cunning Vampire princes and consorts issued hordes of thralls to execute their dark biddings. Many of yours are unspent, as is their potential.
button_0: Flay thralls <thralls></thralls> to entertain <morale></morale> your coven.
button_1: Spend thralls <thralls></thralls> to curry favor with lesser lords. <allegiance></allegiance>
button_11: <shadow></shadow> Drain thralls <thralls></thralls> to learn <knowledge></knowledge> more about the Cosmos.
button_12: Too many thralls? No such thing. Bring me more! <thralls></thralls>
button_2: Parade your thralls <thralls></thralls> to display your lordship. <influence></influence>
button_3: <chaos></chaos> Send thralls <thralls></thralls> to work the forges <unitprod></unitprod> in your smithies.
button_4: <arcana></arcana> Spend thralls <thralls></thralls> to draw mana <mana></mana> from the Astral Sea.
button_5: <order></order> Deploy thralls <thralls></thralls> as tax <gold></gold> collectors.
button_9: <matter></matter> Issue thralls <thralls></thralls> to delve in your quarries. <structureprod></structureprod>
title: Throngs of Thralls

body_footer: <<Co:Emperor>> crypt is said to lie beneath the blood-soaked mound of a shattered heart. Find it, for the one who unseals it shall decide the future fate of all Vampire-kind.
body_header: The <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink>, first of all Vampires, was long ago laid to rest upon this realm. <<Cp:Emperor>> awaits the coming of one who shall instigate a reckoning of blood.
body_lore: Hated or beloved, the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> is an enigma venerated by secretive blood cults throughout the ages. They long preached the coming of an event, so named the 'Blood Reckoning.' A time when <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> returns from banishment, and the hallowed blood of the Deathless God will either be spilled or once again reinstated to even greater glory!
button_0: "The reckoning is at hand."
title: Crypt of the Deathless God

body_footer: The figure turns to dust before the eyes of <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>, leaving <<P:EventHero>> with a request to save the blighted village. What will <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> do?
body_header: From the corner of <<o:EventHero>> eye, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> senses it. Limping and badly wounded, a figure approaches <<P:EventHero>>, gesturing for help.
body_lore:
"Please, we cannot take it anymore. Something terrible is stalking our village, taking our people. I managed to get here to ask for help. But my children... my family, they are still there."

<<Co:VillageSoulHero>> eyes suddenly fix on <<o:VillageSoulHero>> own lethal wounds. With a look of terror, <<p:VillageSoulHero>> says, "But be careful... it seems I did not make it out alive."
button_0: Burn the damned place down—the curse must not spread.
button_1: Search for survivors; someone may still live.
button_4: Connect with the source of the evil that haunts the place.
button_5: Leave the lost soul.
title: The Blighted Village

hero_is_playerle: The figure turns to dust before your eyes, leaving you with a request to save the blighted village. What will you do?
From the corner of your eye, you sense it. Limping and badly wounded, a figure approaches, gesturing for help.

body_footer: This is not over. One final deed remains.
body_header: After slaying the last creature, the village should have been cleared. Yet something is wrong, this place still feels haunted.
body_lore: The houses rot in silence, dilapidated, abandoned. Yet you felt it, no sense of peace came after killing the last monster. A dark presence lingers, whatever cursed this place is still here. You see it in the shadows of the town. Their shapes do not match the buildings
button_0: Prepare the fuel. Light the torches. Set this town ablaze.
button_1: Enter the village—someone must still live.
button_4: Tap into the dark presence.
title: The Blighted Village's Curse

body_footer: The fate of the this domain lies in your hands. What will you do?
body_header: The fire cleanses the corruption on this land. Blazes engulf the buildings, the shadows, the curse.
body_lore: You cannot tear your gaze from the flare. Not only the village burns, the flames are consuming something else that lingers in the air. You can hear it shriek and twist. You can see the fire turn black at its touch. Nothing escapes the inferno. But once the land is burned, you may choose what becomes of it.
button_0: Ban <influence></influence> anyone from settling here. <renown></renown>
button_1: Reshape the land <unitprod></unitprod> into farming fields <food></food>.
button_4: Reconstruct the foundations.
button_5: Vampire lord option or other lord option (WIP)
title: The Blighted Village: Ablaze

body_footer: What will you do? (WIP)
body_header: A newborn maggot cries, it is wounded and lost. (WIP)
body_lore:
Its eating the village supplies. 
 
A maggot for free, do you want it? (WIP)

button_1: Kill the maggot <goodact></goodact> (WIP)
button_4: Study the maggot <knowledge></knowledge> (WIP)
title: The Blighted Village - Weeping (WIP)

body_footer: The fate of the family is in your hands. What will you do?
body_header: No house holds a living soul. None but one, the door of which creaks open as you approach.
body_lore: The inhabitants of the house creep out of it. A parent and two children, famished and afraid. You can see the corruption running through their veins, they may turn into the same monsters that hunted them. The adult speaks with a broken voice: "We have little left... but you can keep this heirloom, if you grant us safe passage."
button_0: Let them join <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. <unhappiness></unhappiness> <goodact></goodact>
button_1: End them, you cannot let the curse spread.
button_4: Free them <mana></mana> from the malefice <goodact></goodact>.
button_5: Dispel the shadow's energy to lift their curse. <goodact></goodact>
button_6: Unravel the chaos energy to lift their curse. <goodact></goodact>
title: The Blighted Village: Survivors

body_footer: Though worn and frayed, the mantle yet hums with ancient power. You will need your <hyperlink>Item Forge</hyperlink> to mend it.
body_header: Though no wind blows, a ragged cloak stirs across the surface. As if sensing <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>'s presence, the cloak veers toward <<P:EventHero>>.
body_lore:
From the mantle a ghostly presence emanates, barely holding the fabric. A weary voice echoes: 
"The <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>... binds my bloodline to this world. It must be mended... before my family name vanishes." 
With <<o:SoulHero>> last words, the spirit withers, leaving the mantle to fall at your feet. Like the shed skin of something no longer of this world.
button_0: "This lineage shall not be consigned to oblivion."
button_1: "This burden is not mine to bear."
title: Forefather's Cloak

hero_is_playerle: Though no wind blows, a ragged cloak stirs across the barren earth. As if sensing your presence, the cloak veers toward you.

From the mantle a ghostly presence emanates, barely holding the fabric. A weary voice echoes: 
"The <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>... still binds our bloodline to this world. It must be mended... before we become extinct." 
With <<o:SoulHero>> last words, the spirit withers, leaving the mantle to fall at your feet. Like the shed skin of something no longer of this world.

body_footer: The ghost yearns for the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>. What will you answer?
body_header: You have reforged the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>. From the patched cloak rises the spectral figure, <<o:SoulHero>> outline now clear and <<o:SoulHero>> presence revitalized.
body_lore: With your very essence, you have rekindled the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor> that was mine... and my ancestors', of course. Your generosity is... delicious, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>; but I would hate to test it further. Allow me to return this garment to its rightful place myself, so that—under my name—new blood may clothe it once more."
button_0: "Take it and remember who saved your lineage." <influence></influence>
button_1: "The attire is attuned to me now." <item></item>
title: The Cloak's Owner

body_footer: The spirit whom you assisted was no lost soul, but a Vampire cloaked in need. What will you decree?
body_header: People have been disappearing in your realm. The reports from your investigators have allowed you to find the perpetrator, <<o:SoulHero>> hands still bloody.
body_lore: The ghost you once aided now shows <<r:SoulHero>> before you as a Vampire, the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor> draped over <<o:SoulHero>> shoulders. "We meet again, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. I owe you an explanation," <<p:SoulHero>> says with a grin. "Vanquished and in desperation, I poured the last of my essence into my cloak, hoping to hide and regain my strength. The very cloak you restored to its full glory."
button_0: "So long as you serve <unitHero></unitHero> me, you may quench your hunger <population></population> <evilact></evilact>."
button_1: "You will not escape my judgment."
button_4: "Know your place fledgling, you will serve <unitHero></unitHero> me and feast outside <thralls></thralls> my domains."
title: Cloak of the Vampire

body_footer: The apparition is bound by wrath and grief. Will <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> answer her cry?
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> hears a heartbroken cry; a scream of pain that has no wound; a ghost wearing an eternal grimace of agony.
body_lore:
Gesticulating between sobs, she says: "What kind of world is this where there is no justice? What kind of pain is this, that not even death can silence it? My children... my poor children."
Her grief bursts into fury as she claims: "You will not escape me! I can sense your stench, 73."
button_0: "I will claim your vengeance."
button_1: Leave the tormented soul.
title: Fair Lady's Lament

body_footer: The wrath of the specter knows no bounds. Will you persist with her quest for vengeance?
body_header: After the recent battle, amid the fallen, the vengeful apparition rises upon her terrified victim.
body_lore:
"What have I done to you," cries the man. "You may not be him—but you carry the same stench of evil. The stench of one capable of spilling the blood of their own offspring," responds the specter. And after lunging at him with all her rage, she leaves the man lifeless. 
"It was not him, we must continue searching," says the apparition.
button_0: "I will continue till you rest in peace."
button_1: "I cannot follow you, you have lost your way."
button_4: "This carnage needs to cease."
title: Fair Lady's Vengeance

body_footer: The wrath of the specter knows no bounds. Will you persist with her quest for vengeance?
body_header: After the recent battle, amid the fallen, the vengeful apparition rises upon her terrified victim.
body_lore:
"How did I wrong you," exclaims the man. 
"You may not be him—but the same evil stench clings to you. The stench of one who abused the very soul they swore to love," responds the specter. And after lunging at him with all her rage, she leaves the man lifeless. "It was not him, we must continue searching," says the apparition.
button_0: "I will continue till you rest in peace."
button_1: "I cannot follow you, you have lost your way."
button_4: "This carnage needs to cease."
title: Fair Lady's Vengeance

body_footer: The wrath of the specter knows no bounds. Will you persist with her quest for vengeance?
body_header: After the recent battle, amid the fallen, the vengeful apparition rises upon her terrified victim.
body_lore:
"I am not him, I've never met you," cries the man. "Maybe not—but you wear the same stench of evil. A stench that smells like lies, betrayal and torture," responds the specter. And after lunging at him with all her rage, she leaves the man lifeless. 
"It was not him, we must continue searching," says the apparition.
button_0: "I will continue till you rest in peace."
button_1: "I cannot follow you, you have lost your way."
button_4: "You need to stop this carnage."
title: Fair Lady's Vengeance

body_footer: The apparition has shown her true faces. How will you respond?
body_header: The visage of the apparition twists and splits in impossible grimaces, forming multiple faces and showing her true nature, that one of a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
Their voices cry out: 
"We are the suffering of those who were abused. We are the anger of those who died in agony. We are those who never knew justice.
They took our sanity. They took our lives. They took everything we had.
They will not take our tears. They will not take our rage. And you will not take our revenge!"
button_0: "You will accept death—willingly or not."
button_1: "Perhaps our goals are, in fact, aligned."
button_4: "Walk on, but I shall not walk beside you."
button_5: <reputation8></reputation8> "I cannot fathom your pain, but together, we can eradicate evil." <unit></unit>
title: Fair Lady's Faces

body_footer: With <<o:SoulLoverHero>> unfinished business concluded, the ghost fades away. What will <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> do?
body_header: A ghost manifests in front of <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>. <<Co:SoulLoverHero>> gaze, drenched in tears that never fall, implores for help.
body_lore: "Your presence... calls to me... You can aid me. I fade, I am coming undone, I don't want to leave; not now that I can be with my beloved. We spent a lifetime trying to reach one another, but we met only in death. Please, bind us. Bind our souls in our wedding ring, so we may always be together."
button_0: "Rest your soul now, I will honor your wishes."
button_1: "You know not what you ask for."
title: Nuptial Demise

hero_is_playerle: With <<o:SoulLoverHero>> unfinished business concluded, the ghost fades away. What will you do?
A ghost manifests in front of you. <<Co:SoulLoverHero>> gaze, drenched in tears that never fall, implores for help.

body_footer: You have but a moment before the soul of the consort is lost forever. What will you do?
body_header: As the soul is embedded to the ring, a flare of spectral light erupts. A second spirit manifests in its shine.
body_lore:
"No! What have you done?! Where is <<p:SoulHero>>?!" With a glance at the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>, <<p:SoulLoverHero2>> understands. "Oh my dear, my sweet dear, what have you done? You were the last tether that held me here. I yearned to depart together... wherever the journey... takes... us." 

Before almost fading, the soul cries "I do not... want to be... alone... again."
button_0: Break the ring, allowing both souls to pass. <mana></mana>
button_1: Bond both souls to the ring. <item></item>
button_4: "You shall be together—but nay in life, and nay in death." <evilact></evilact> <unit></unit>
title: Till Death Do Us Part

body_footer: The ghost who once begged for your help now stands before you—<<o:SoulHero>> soul disfigured by vengeance. What will you do?
body_header: Ever since you chose to keep <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>, whispers plague the corners, with words you can not make out.
body_lore: You are never alone, even when the room is empty. The murmurs seize upon you in your moments of rest, they have been growing louder and louder. Suddenly, a voice—shattered, incomplete, yet bound together—whispers with perfect diction: "There is no true slumber for the wicked." The spirit appears before you, his lust for vengeance has deformed <<o:SoulHero>> soul, turning him into a <eventColor>{LivingFogUnit}</eventColor>.
button_0: Face the vengeful spirit.
button_1: "What is a wicked soul to a necromancer?" <souls></souls>
button_4: "In the name of all that is sacred, be gone, foul presence!"
button_5: Sever <<o:SoulHero>> connection to the realm of the living.
title: Cloak of Vengeance

body_footer: The spoils of the fray lay in the field. What will you do with them?
body_header: With the skirmish over, the battlefield emanates a solemn stillness. A ghostly force manifests in the distance.
body_lore:
She appears again, the spirit who led you here, rising beside the target of her rage. But something is wrong; they both seem confused.

Your mind comes back to the aftermath of the battle. Not much is left after the fight, but enough for you to be able to take advantage of it.
button_0: Trade the goods for gold. <gold></gold>
button_1: Yield them to your scholars. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_4: Commit them to your city, 7. <happiness></happiness>
title: Spoils Of The Fray

body_footer: You will have to come back later.
body_header: A presence obscures the air, but its form is veiled.
body_lore: The soul will only manifest upon greater wills, like the one of heroes and Rulers.
button_0: Leave the lost soul.
title: Lost Soul

body_footer: <hyperlink>Vampires</hyperlink> are no longer empowered by the Blood Moon and once again suffer the consequences of walking in the light of day.
body_header: The Blood Moon wanes, and the fear of light returns to those who bask in darkness.
body_lore: The sun rises behind the fading moon, restoring color to the world. Its rays breathe life into the meadows and kindle hope in weary hearts. The creatures of the dusk retreat to their lairs, sheltered by the shadows within them.
button_0: Bid farewell to the red night.
title: Blood Moon: Aftermath

body_footer: The voices shout for <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> to follow them. Will <<p:EventHero>> find the origin of their suffering?
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> can sense their presence. Not one, not two, but an amalgamation of ghosts. All talking at the same time.
body_lore: "Stop them. Help us. Our flesh... our souls... consumed." One of the voices tears itself free from the amalgam, "They are trying to create it. The essence of life, the tincture, the stone of immortality." Then, as one, they speak again. "One to turn lead into gold. One to turn death into life. But magic demands a cost, and it was us."
button_0: Track where they lead.
button_1: Leave the lost souls.
title: Blood And Soul

body_footer: The energy lies before you, awaiting transmutation by your will.
body_header: The last cultist falls. Blood and flesh are consumed by the ritual circle, completing the rite.
body_lore: As the fallen are absorbed into the blood sigil, a crimson energy erupts. Waves surge outward, swirling into a violent vortex. With each turn it contracts, condensing into a scarlet anomaly. It calls to you. It is power—raw and unbound, waiting to be shaped.
button_0: Create a <eventColor>{BloodGlass}</eventColor> in the area.
button_1: Dispel the energy <mana></mana>. Free the souls <goodact></goodact>.
button_4: Shape the energy into the essence of life needed to forge the immortality stone.
title: Blood And Soul: Aftermath

hero_is_playerle: The voices shout for you to follow them. Will you find the origin of their suffering?
You can sense their presence. Not one, not two, but an amalgamation of ghosts. All talking at the same time.

body_footer: What haunts this village is no mere curse, but a living sickness: conscious, ravenous, unbound. What will you do with it?
body_header: You close your eyes and reach for the presence that plagues this village. It is shapeless, old, patient.
body_lore: The presence is conscious. Flashes of memory seize you: a man in red, experimental rituals of blood and souls. A sickness that infects the blood, blood that infects the soul, soul that shapes the body into its wicked reflection. Then you understand, you are seeing through the eyes of those taken by the illness. The illness is the presence itself.
button_0: Feed <mana></mana> and let the presence consume the village <evilact></evilact>, completing its metamorphosis <unit></unit>.
button_1: Allow the presence to infect you <hp></hp>, granting you its power <xp></xp>.
button_4: Isolate the sickness <unitprod></unitprod>, your scholars will learn <knowledge></knowledge> from it and avoid it from spreading.
title: Dark Presence

hero_is_palyerle: The apparition is bound by wrath and grief. Will you answer her cry?
You hear a heartbroken cry; a scream of pain that has no wound; a ghost wearing an eternal grimace of agony.

body_footer: Your troops have freed this land from this menace. But a trail of ghostly hoofprints leads the way to an uncertain location.
body_header: The dead cavalry lies defeated, yet their ghosts find no rest.
body_lore: The souls of knights and horses rise from their remains. Compelled by an imperative force, they spur their steed and gallop away. Only the Beheaded Knight resists the urge, for an instant <<p:RiderSoulHero>> turns towards you. Yet for that brief moment, you feel <<o:RiderSoulHero>> desperation, as if <<p:RiderSoulHero>> no longer commands his own actions.
button_0: Track the equine apparitions.
button_1: Leave the knights' souls.
title: Decapitated Cavalry

body_footer: The head of the ghost flies away, carried by an unknown entity.
body_header: A ghost manifests in front of <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>. Unaware of <<o:EventHero>> presence.
body_lore: As if still alive, the ghost strolls along, speaking to a figure that is not there. Suddenly, <<p:HeadlessSoulHero>> turns, with fear across <<o:HeadlessSoulHero>> face. You hear the ghostly thunder of galloping hooves drawing near—and then, SHUNK! <<Co:HeadlessSoulHero>> head is severed, flying from <<o:HeadlessSoulHero>> shoulders. An unseen force snatches it from the ground and vanishes into the distance.
button_0: Track where it leads and face the beheader.
button_1: Leave the lost soul.
title: Headless Victim

hero_is_playerle: A ghost manifests in front of you. Unaware of your presence.

body_footer: The head of the headless horseman lies in your hands. Will this be the end of <<o:RiderSoulHero>> duty?
body_header: The dead have returned to their graves. The cemetery lies in peace once more.
body_lore: Beside the statue of the knight lie several severed heads and scattered bones, encircled by runes painted in blood. The necromancers used these remains to summon the cavalry and bind them to their will. One head radiates a daunting energy, an aura you recognize from the Beheaded Knight.
button_0: "Your oath is not yet fulfilled." <item></item>
button_1: The lost souls <souls></souls> are yours to claim.
button_4: Cleanse the curse <goodact></goodact> and leave your banner behind. <influence></influence>
title: End Of My Duty

body_footer: The cemetery seems to hide great dangers.
body_header: The report from your scout is brief: the ghostly trail ends in a grim graveyard.
body_lore: The message is hastily written with a shaky hand: "I think I can hear chanting within the graveyard. My mount refuses to approach the area any further. But through the gate I glimpse a group surrounding a large statue of a knight on his steed. Tombs here are empty, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. Please beware."
button_0: Prepare your troops.
button_5: Leave the lost souls.
title: Where My Bones Rest

body_footer: The spirit longs for you to raise a great palace where <<p:FluteSoulHero>> can perform <<o:FluteSoulHero>> music.
body_header: A gust of wind whistles a melody. Carried by the same breeze, a spirit takes form.
body_lore:
<<Co:FluteSoulHero>> flute sings with a dancing rhythm, yet each note drags along the ground with a heavy gloom. The spirit notices <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>'s presence and exclaims:
"Can you hear me? You can hear me! It has been decades since anyone could. You... You serve a <eventColor>{EventPlayerType}</eventColor>... With <<o:LeaderType>> magic, <<o:LeaderType>> whole kingdom could hear my song! Please, build a great stage where I may play."

body_lore:
The song echoes through the high chambers that bear your name, your emblem, your very essence. Amplified by your empire’s bond with the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, the melody spreads across every corner of your domain. When the final note fades, the spirit turns to you:
"Thank you. I have always longed to play for an entire kingdom. Before I vanish, allow me to grant you something in return."
button_0: "Leave your flute so we can still hear your music."
button_1: Keep playing, so people will come to my kingdom.
button_4: Sing a song in my name.
title: Last Symphony: Aftermath

body_footer: The spirit offers <<o:KingSoulHero>> aid in your new reign. What will you ask of <<P:KingSoulHero>>?
body_header: The ghost of the dead monarch appears at your side as you reclaim <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "The usurper is gone, and my domain rests now in your hands. How sweet is victory, and how fleeting. My time here is over, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>. Yet before I depart, I still hold some strength within me. Allow me to offer one last gift to this resurgent kingdom."
button_0: Access to <<o:KingSoulHero>> private archives. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_1: Ancient treatises on commerce, to be invoked at your will. <gold></gold>
button_4: A commendatory letter, addressed to the free cities of the realm. <allegiance></allegiance>
title: Dethroned: Aftermath

body_footer: It seems the former monarch of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> lingers, demanding vengeance against the usurper of <<o:KingSoulHero>> throne.
body_header: A spirit appears before <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>, babbling and flailing in fury. <<Co:KingSoulHero>> voice rises into a bitter rant:
body_lore: "Cursed be <<p:CityRuler>>! May <<o:CityRuler>> schemes fester and poison <<o:CityRuler>> own blood, may <<o:CityRuler>> bile burn <<P:CityRuler>> from within! <<Cp:CityRuler>> wanted me dead, for <<p:CityRuler>> coveted my kingdom. And now I am dead, and my kingdom is <<o:CityRuler>>. Know this, the one who reigns in <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> is no rightful Ruler. I will not depart this world until I have had my revenge!"
button_0: "I will execute your revenge."

You are stronger than the curse, you can take it.

The march advances in two long lines, each ghostly pilgrim clutching a lit candle. All save one, the figure at the front. Cadaverous and grim, <<p:PilgrimHero>> carries a heavy banner, <<o:PilgrimHero>> hollow voice calls to <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>:
"Mercy, bear my burden, if only for a moment."

body_footer: "If you want my blood, then bring me the Obsidian Rose from <eventColor>{Emperor.FirstName}</eventColor>’s crumbling palace and lay it before my feet. The offer is made little '<hyperlink>Elder</hyperlink>.' I’ll be watching you, ta-ta."

body_lore: "Yes, I have decided, you may stay," grins <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>. "Doubtlessly, you came here to unseal that stinking crypt of my rotting husband, <eventColor>{Emperor.FirstName}</eventColor>. But in order to do that, one first needs my exalted blood, with which that place is thoroughly sealed. However, if you so intend to slay that wretched bastard, then I might be open to make a little—trade..."
button_0: "I will consider this."
button_1: "I will have your blood for plucking my heartstrings!" <influence></influence>
button_2: "No thanks."
title: Key to my Heartstring

resist_wife: <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> erupts in a tittering cackle. "Oh how delightful! Your petty resistance is simply... Mhh, irresistible. I must have more of it!"

body_footer: <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> <<o:Wife>> maleficent stare probes your sight and pricks your very heartstring... "Tell me, my sweet, what brings you to my dominion?"
body_header: Strange shadows blind your senses, then a sharp whisper enters your inner ear... "What is this I find, an unfamiliar '<hyperlink>Elder Vampire</hyperlink>' roving my realm? After all this time."
body_lore: From the deepest darkness appears the terrifying shape of an <hyperlink>Archvampire</hyperlink>, <eventColor>{Wife.TitleName}</eventColor>, fabled author of the Tome of Torment and first wife of the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> <<Cr:Emperor>>. <<Cp:Wife>> inspects you with a predatory gaze, then lifts <<o:Wife>> chin and produces a faint, fanged grin. Suddenly, your chest starts to ache! It appears <<p:Wife>> is casting some sort of spell on you.
button_0: "To awaken the Deathless God." <xp></xp>
button_1: Remain silent.
button_2: "That is none of your business!" <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_4: Resist <<P:Wife>> spell. <mana></mana>
button_5: "I have come for blood, yours in particular!"
title: The Grave Archdam

body_footer: <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> trembles all over in fury. "In fact, this is the request I make of you by granting my blood to open <<Co:Emperor>> stinking crypt... Kill <<CP:Emperor>>!"
body_header: "Splendid!" squeals <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>. "My, oh my, you seem to know the way to a Vampire’s heart with deadly precision. We might share a common interest there, my sweet."
body_lore: <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> studies the Cruor Rose with a fey, melancholic frown. "This bloody rose was grown for <<Co:Emperor>>... <<Co:Emperor>> damned witch..." <<Cp:Wife>> shuts <<P:Wife>> eyes for a moment and presses the rose against <<o:Wife>> bosom. Then, <<P:Wife>> eyes flare open with a blood-lusting stare. "Yes. I want <<P:Emperor>> dead!"
button_0: "I will take care of everything." <rs_alliance></rs_alliance>
button_1: "No thanks. Now hand me your blood!"
button_2: "Anything, for a price..." <thralls></thralls>
button_3: "Whatever you want. First strengthen me through pain!" <xp></xp>
title: Key to my Heartstring: Earned

body_footer: With <<Po:Emperor>> crypt now unsealed and vacant, the crown inheritance of '<eventColor>{Emperor.Name}</eventColor>' remains yours for the taking—title, throne, and all...
body_header: By your hand, the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> has been defeated. An act that is felt by <hyperlink>Archvampires</hyperlink> far and wide, all across the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>.
body_lore: Though they might not yet know your name, all Archsires and Archdams will know you by your deeds, and forever fear you for it! For, if one Vampire could slay the deathless—Sire of all—what then stops the Spawn from rising up against their own Sires in complete and total anarchy? Thus, by this credence dawns a new blood-stained age for all Vampire-kind.
button_0: "Blood for blood!"
title: Crypt of the Deathless God: Shattered

body_footer: None have since entered <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>, until now. As a destined night dawns at the distant howling of wolves, you are left to reflect upon the reason why you have come here...
body_header: Before you spans a sunless realm of myth and legend, older than the oldest memories of even most <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>. Here, the pureblood lineage long ago began and reached its historic zenith.
body_lore: In those bygone days, Vampire-kind ruled a blood-hungry dominion that terrorized the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. Back then, all purebloods were united under an 'eternal emperor,' now only remembered as the '<hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink>'. Whether through hubris or betrayal, this dominion of terror ultimately crumbled and was banished into <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink> for reasons long forgotten.
button_0: "Betrayal undid our greatness, but I aim to restore it once again!" <influence></influence>
button_1: "Hubris caused the downfall of Drevanya, I intend to finish the job."
button_2: "The night summoned me here, its children <unit></unit> shall show me the way."
button_3: "Who cares about the past? I only hunger for blood!" <xp></xp>
title: Night Falls on Rued Drevanya

body_footer: Who do you give the Cruor Rose to? (TEMP)
body_header: You got the Obsidian Rose. (TEMP)
body_lore: Give this rose to one of the consorts to gain their trust and be offered an alliance. (TEMP)

button_1: Give Rose to Prince Consort Wtorakh (TEMP)
