body_footer: <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> fingers <<o:Husband>> glistening lip as <<p:Husband>> secretly casts a spell on you that boils your blood. "Show me how a proper Vampire greets their superior."
body_header: An odd bubbling and boiling occurrence enters your awareness, followed by a low hiss... "My, oh my... What a quaint, anomalous toy do I here espy?"
body_lore: From the corner of your eye, you see a hot, crimson mist erupt, out of which a blood soaked figure emerges with distinguished poise: the fabled <hyperlink>Archvampire</hyperlink>, <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>. "After ages of solitude, I am finally graced with a fresh new face—and what a face it is... Are you 'one of mine,' perhaps? No matter, I do so believe introductions are in order, wouldn’t you agree? Or has your generation abandoned their manners as they once did the <eventColor>{Emperor.Title}</eventColor>?"
button_0: Bow down low and courteously. <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_1: Simply regard <<P:Husband>> in silence.
button_2: Stand tall and scoff at <<P:Husband>> in defiance! <influence></influence>
button_3: Offer <<P:Husband>> a fresh sacrifice of blood. <thralls></thralls>
button_4: "No one is my superior. Perish you clown!"
title: Boiling First Impressions

body_footer: "If you pledge to me, your fabulous Prince, <<p:Husband>>, the Obsidian Rose from the palace of the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink>. Then I would be open to sharing a drop of my purest blood."
body_header: "Charmed, surely," smiles the <eventColor>{Husband.Title}</eventColor> with a nod. "Ah youth, reminds me of myself at that age, skirting etiquette and insolence. So bold, so brazen."
body_lore: "Let us conduct business, shall we," begins the <eventColor>{Husband.Title}</eventColor>. "I know everything about you, <eventColor>{Player.Name}</eventColor>. Seeking to open the crypt of our hallowed '<eventColor>{Emperor.Title}</eventColor>,' are you not? For this purpose one would need the blood of <<Co:Emperor>> Consorts—like mine. Now, owing to your... somewhat... remarkable introduction, I daresay I’m budding the desire to—potentially—entertain your dashing enterprise. In exchange, naturally, for a trifling sacrifice."
button_0: "I will consider this."
button_1: "I will have your blood for boiling mine!" <influence></influence>
button_2: "No thanks."
title: Key to my Desire

bow_low: "Why, my dear supplicant," acknowledges <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>, as <<p:Husband>> makes an aristocratic bow in return, "You grace your Prince with a truly savory class of courteousness."
resist_husband: "Oh? You, an <hyperlink>Elder</hyperlink>, dare defy me? An <hyperlink>Archvampire</hyperlink>?" chuckles <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> with a bestial snarl. "How delicious, how delectable, how... Debonair!"

body_footer: <<Cp:Husband>> slowly crushes the Obsidian Rose in <<o:Husband>> fist and licks the black sap from <<o:Husband>> palm. "Can you keep a little secret, my new found ally?"
body_header: "For me? Oh, you shouldn’t have," feigns <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>. "Why, what a gorgeous, magnificent specimen; as, of course, is the rose..."
body_lore: Nosing the rose, <<p:Husband>> looks up at you with a slow blink. "Ah, the smell of true love," smiles the <eventColor>{Husband.Title}</eventColor>, "How null... Well, go on, then. Let us entertain this magnificent enterprise of yours, hmm? Imagine we were to awaken the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink>, then what? Praise and glory? Oh no, I must warn you: my Sire is no fairytale and pleasing <<CP:Emperor>> is folly indeed. No, our ancient Creator, splendid as <<Cp:Emperor>> may be, is a most wickedly evil mind who accepts no equals—if you 'catch my drift...'"
button_0: "But of course, my Prince." <rs_alliance></rs_alliance>
button_1: "No thanks. Now hand me your blood!"
button_2: "For a price <thralls></thralls>, of course."
button_3: "My Prince, you flatter me. Secrets are my specialty."
title: Key to my Desire: Won

body_footer: "If you are also out to slay this 'Deathless God,' then I have an offer to make," <<p:Huntress>> proposes, slowly lowering <<o:Huntress>> arms.
body_header: A foul mortal stench enters your nostrils. Then, a dark, stalking figure appears in sight. "I know a Vampire when I see one."
body_lore: Keeping <<P:Huntress>> hand close to <<P:Huntress>> weapon, <<p:Huntress>> nevertheless regards you with a dark smirk. "You are not from around here, are you? I reckon you also seek to uncover that so-called '<hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink>' of yours, no? Well, so do I, <eventColor>{Huntress.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>. My reasons require no explanation, I expect."
button_0: Listen to her offer, for now...
button_1: “I know a hunter when I smell one, prepare to die!” (DEPRECATED)
title: Two Predators Crossing

body_footer: "Declare war on both <eventColor>{Wife.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Husband.FirstName}</eventColor>," announces <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> grimly. "So I know I can trust you. We kill the Consorts, get their blood, and slay <hyperlink>Urvatogh</hyperlink> once and for all. What say you?"
body_header: <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> returns you a thin, honest smile. "Thank you for hearing me out. I’ll get to the point."
body_lore: "My research tells me that the crypt of this '<hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink>' is locked with a blood rite, cast by <<o:Emperor>> Consorts," explains <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Most of these fled the realm before it got sealed, save two: <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>. So they stand in our way. Fortunately, they also hate each other's guts, so, if you want to open that crypt, this is what we do..."
button_0: "I will think about it."
button_1: "Why should I trust a Vampire Hunter? Be gone!"
button_2: "You dare waste my time, die!" <influence></influence>
button_3: "It is already done." <influence></influence>
title: Enemy of My Enemy

body_footer: <<Cp:Huntress>> cocks <<o:Huntress>> crossbow and passes you a determined glance. "Let's go hunt some Vampires."
body_header: "Nicely done," chimes <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> with a slightly perplexed grimace.
body_lore: "I'll be honest, I doubted you'd do it. With us being on different sides of the aisle, so to speak. But now that you've declared war on both those <hyperlink>arch suckers</hyperlink> I'm quite eager to see this through to the end." <<Cp:Huntress>> rummages in <<co:Huntress>> pouch, then glances up at you, before tossing over a jangling bag. "Don't worry, it's gold. That's your first half of the bounty, because now things are gonna get real serious, real soon."
button_0: "Tell me your plan." <rs_defensivepact></rs_defensivepact>
button_1: "Thanks for the gold, fool. Now die!" <evilact></evilact>
button_2: "I need more gold <gold></gold> than this before I start listening."
title: Enemy of my Enemy: My Friend

badass: <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> stares at you with <<o:Huntress>> mouth slightly agape, before correcting <<r:Huntress>> with a surprised smirk.

body_footer: <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> grins lustily, "There's no begging for mercy now. I will see you in my dungeons!"
body_header: For a brief moment, <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> curls <<o:Wife>> lip and casts you a disheartened glance.
body_lore: "Aw..." <<p:Wife>> sighs airily, "Looks like you prefer the path of pain, what a pity. Well, for you at least. I, instead, will be looking forward to making you squeal, my naughty little <hyperlink>Elder</hyperlink>."
button_0: "So be it."
title: Pain and Treachery

body_footer: "My mind is set," grins the <eventColor>{Husband.Title}</eventColor> as <<p:Husband>> looks away. "Rue this day, churl. You will soon learn your rightful place."
body_header: For a brief heartbeat, or even two, <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> frowns and casts you a pained glance.
body_lore: "Oh well," begins <<p:Husband>>, with a nonchalant flick of <<o:Husband>> wrist, "What else was I to expect from the boorish likes of an '<hyperlink>Elder Vampire</hyperlink>'? No matter, it seems I must obtain my adoration 'the usual way...' By force."
button_0: "So be it."
title: Boiling Betrayal

body_footer: "This is where you come in, my sweet," smiles <eventColor>{Wife.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Take my blood, seek out <<Co:Emperor>> crypt and slay that vile swine for me! It would free me from <<Co:Emperor>> influence, at last!"
body_header: "Oh, I like you," observes <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> with a toothy grin. "Trust you even. This is why I shall reveal the truth to you, and only you."
body_lore: "I was <<Co:Emperor>> first victim, you know. And when <eventColor>{Emperor.FirstName}</eventColor> turned me, <<Cp:Emperor>> cast a mind control curse that prevented me from ever harming <<CP:Emperor>>. Oh, I hated being a Vampire, and <<Cp:Emperor>> enjoyed making me suffer. I begged for death, but <<Cp:Emperor>> refused me every time. So, I vowed to see <<CP:Emperor>> destroyed! Yet... All this time I was powerless to do so myself."
button_0: "Let us slay <<CP:Emperor>>, together." <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_1: "Anything, for a price..." <gold></gold>
button_2: "No thanks, I will go it alone."
title: Blood for Blood

body_footer: Far off, a wolf howls into the night, signaling the dawning of a new age for all Vampire-kind. With the throne now vacant, it is yours to claim—and share.
body_header: As the dust of war settles and a new moon rises over this realm, <eventColor>{Wife.FirstName}</eventColor> appears besides you with an uncannily earnest smile. "Freedom..." <<p:Wife>> whispers.
body_lore: "I have lost count of the ages that this wretched bastard tormented me. To see <<P:Emperor>> defeated, fills my cold unalive heart with... With..." Suddenly, <eventColor>{Wife.FirstName}</eventColor> grasps <<o:Wife>> chest with a sigh. Then glances over at you with a wide, toothy grin and curious, pearly eyes. "What?" <<p:Wife>> scoffs, as a slight blush fills <<o:Wife>> face. "Do not just look at your Princess like that, do something."
button_0: Offer <eventColor>{Wife.FirstName}</eventColor> your hand.
title: Blood for Blood: New Moon

body_footer: "You, however, can do what I could not," teases the <eventColor>{Husband.Title}</eventColor>. "Go to <<Co:Emperor>> crypt, and end the <eventColor>{Emperor.Title}</eventColor> for good! Then, I will be free!"
body_header: <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> sighs. "Being an <hyperlink>Archvampire</hyperlink> is not all that it seems..."
body_lore: "I was there when our kind was 'born,' when <<Co:Emperor>> blessings were first distributed. And so too, <<Co:Emperor>> curse... To be bound to the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> for all eternity, and to follow <<Co:Emperor>> dominant will like some wretched puppet on bloodied strings. Ugh, <eventColor>{Emperor.FirstName}</eventColor> made me do... 'unspeakable' things, and I had no will to deny <<CP:Emperor>>. So yes, I admit it, I conspired with <eventColor>{Wife.FirstName}</eventColor> and the others to seal <<CP:Emperor>> away! For, as <<Co:Emperor>> wretched spawn, I could not slay <<CP:Emperor>>..."
button_0: "Let us end <<CP:Emperor>> together, my Prince." <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_1: "For a price <gold></gold>, of course."
button_2: "No thanks, I will go it alone."
title: Thirsting for Regicide

body_footer: Far off, a wolf howls into the night, signaling the dawning of a new age for all Vampire-kind. With the throne now vacant, it is yours to claim—and share.
body_header: As the dust of battle settles, a new moon rises above Drevanya. And at this moment <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> comes before you with a devilish grin.
body_lore: "Oh my, the taste of freedom," whispers <eventColor>{Husband.FirstName}</eventColor>. "It is the most—wonderful thing! And to think I have you, my dearest <eventColor>{Player.FirstName}</eventColor>, to thank for it." A silent moment passes as <eventColor>{Husband.FirstName}</eventColor> just eyes you with curious delight. "The imperial throne of Drevanya is looking awfully 'empty,' wouldn’t you agree? What say, you and I warm it up a little? I know just the spell."
button_0: Take <eventColor>{Husband.FirstName}</eventColor> up on <<o:Husband>> offer.
title: Thirsting for Regicide: Quenched

body_footer: <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> looks into your eyes with furious determination. "<eventColor>{Emperor.FirstName}</eventColor> must be stopped. Go, lead the way to the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, only a Vampire can enter it."
body_header: "Before we begin," sighs <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor>, "I think it is important that you know what we are up against..."
body_lore: "You probably don’t need to be told what is at stake here, but let me spell it out for you, regardless. <eventColor>{Emperor.FirstName}</eventColor> sired the <hyperlink>Archvampires</hyperlink>, like <eventColor>{Wife.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Husband.FirstName}</eventColor>. These, in turn, sired most <hyperlink>Elder Vampires</hyperlink>, like yourself. If <eventColor>{Emperor.FirstName}</eventColor> were to return, all Archvampires and their spawn would instantly flock to <<o:Emperor>> side. Together, they would unleash an unstoppable, united front against all the <hyperlink>Worlds Within</hyperlink>!"
button_0: "Let us slay this 'Deathless God', together."
button_1: "On second thought, I will go on alone."
button_2: "Ignorant fool. I long to see all Vampires united! Now die!" <evilact></evilact>
button_3: "Yes <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor>, look into my eyes..." <evilact></evilact>
title: Death to the Deathless God

body_footer: Far off, a wolf howls into the night, ushering a new age for Vampire-kind. What the future holds, none can tell, and perhaps it is better this way.
body_header: With <<o:Emperor>> banishment complete, the crypt of the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> lies in ruins before you and your job here is done.
body_lore: "Impressive stuff," observes <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> with a remarkable hint of awe. <<Cp:Huntress>> stands besides you for a while and takes in the devastation you wrought. "I mean it, you know. You prevented the <hyperlink>Archvampires</hyperlink> from reuniting under a common master, once more. I gotta admit, I never thought I’d feel any kind of admiration for a Vampire in my life, but you... Well, you changed everything." <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> stops and chuckles. "What is your name, anyway?"
button_0: Walk off into the night.
title: Unsung Hero of the Night

body_footer: Prepare yourself well! Explore the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> to come face to face with the <hyperlink>Vampire Progenitor</hyperlink> <<Cr:Emperor>> and bring about the long awaited Blood Reckoning.
body_header: With the blood of the Consort in your possession, you can finally unseal the crypt that drew you to this realm, all along.
body_lore: All Vampire-kind draw their origin from a single source: the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink>, the Sire of all, <<Cp:Emperor>> who spread <<Co:Emperor>> blessing and <<Co:Emperor>> curse upon the <hyperlink>Worlds Within</hyperlink> from the <hyperlink>First Brood</hyperlink>, to eventually even you. The sunless lands, the rivers of blood, the hunger and the power, all these came about through <<Co:Emperor>> awesome and terrible power.
button_0: "I am the reckoning."
button_1: ... Feast on your thralls for blood. (DEPRECATED)
button_2: ... Feast on your thralls for glory. (DEPRECATED)
title: Sepulchral Pilgrimage

body_footer: Far off, a wolf howls into the night. With the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> defeated, <<o:Emperor>> throne and title remains vacant for the taking...
body_header: Blood for blood! By your hand, <eventColor>{Emperor.Name}</eventColor> was defeated and the legends of his 'deathless' greatness were proven false.
body_lore: This was the 'Blood Reckoning' that ushered in a new age for all Vampire-kind, one freed from the oppressive inheritance of their creator. Your actions on this realm leveled the hierarchy order which long segmented Vampire-kind, since time immemorial. For if you, an <hyperlink>Elder Vampire</hyperlink> could topple the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> without consequences, what then stops the Lesser Vampire Spawn from rebelling against their own Sires in turn? No, your legacy shall surely inspire generations of Vampires who will strive to follow in your footsteps.
button_0: "My legacy will be undying."
title: A Legacy Undying

body_footer: "<eventColor>{Player.FirstName}</eventColor>, my deliverer," <<p:Emperor>> darkly declares. "I have dreamed of this very moment for days beyond number. And now, like a prayer made flesh, you have come. Welcome."
body_header: A stark, haunting melody reverberates across the light-abandoned halls and corridors of dark stone that makes up the underground necropolis beneath the bleeding mound.
body_lore: Following the music to its source reveals a forgotten city of the dead, welled all in a majestic, yet sorrowful leitmotif, reminiscent of a long lost love. Then, the music abruptly ends and a tyrannical silence wholly conquers the auricular void, a silence so intense it creates a gaping vacuum into oblivion itself. Yet, from that void, a deep, sonorous voice emerges drenched in immemorial sovereignty and remorse...
button_0: "Reveal yourself."
button_1: (DEPRECATED)
button_2: Fight and defy the Deathless God! (WIP)
title: Prelude to a Moonless Dark

body_footer: "We begin at once. Destroy everyone left upon the realm, leave no soul alive, or unalive. I care not how it is done, but baptize new Drevanya wholly with their blood!"
body_header: For a brief instance, <eventColor>{Emperor.FirstName}</eventColor> closes <<Co:Emperor>> eyes and sheds a single tear. Then, <<Cp:Emperor>> flashes <<Co:Emperor>> eyes with imperial resolve. "Drevanya shall rise again."
body_lore: <<Cp:Emperor>> looks at you, and a darkness falls over <<Co:Emperor>> face. "We shall unleash a Blood Reckoning upon the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> that will stir fear in the hearts of all. Starting with my flawed creations, <eventColor>{Wife.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Husband.FirstName}</eventColor>, those seditious and ungrateful miscreants who still call themselves my Consorts, as any who dare stand to oppose us."
button_0: "Thy will be done."
button_1: "Behold, I have already done as you wish!"
title: Reckoning Upon the Traitors

body_footer: "Join me in union, <eventColor>{Player.FirstName}</eventColor> and together we shall dominate the wide <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> with a Vampire dominion grander than before."
body_header: With the whole realm covered in the blood of traitors, <eventColor>{Emperor.Name}</eventColor> appears beside you with a dark, pensive glance. "You have done well."
body_lore: <<Cp:Emperor>> sighs, then turns to you with a distant smile. "When I was a younger man," begins <<Cp:Emperor>>, "I made the mistake of satiating the void in my unalive heart with the idle comfort of indulgent Consorts. Ever since, I have had an eternity to reconsider my childish appetites and come to understand that partnership is, ultimately, a union of power. And on this day, <eventColor>{Player.FirstName}</eventColor> you are the most powerful Vampire I have ever known."
button_0: "The reckoning is ours."
title: A Reckoning Unequaled

body_footer: Hissing whispers eminate from the shadow-veiled chasm found below the sacrifical altar... (DEPRECATED)
body_header: You sacrificed the Paramour's Pledge and cleared the crypt, but did not discover the Deathless God... (DEPRECATED)
body_lore: The stiffened Vampire corpse was a ruse, this is not the Deathless God. Where could He be found? The heart is gone, the fountain of blood is all syphoned into the floor... But wait! Upon inspecting the altar a peculiar outline is detected in the dais, the ebony, carven altar can be moved to reveal a great, abbysmal chasm underneath. (DEPRECATED)
button_0: "Could it be?"... (DEPRECATED)
title: Desecrating the Unholy Crypt (PLACEHOLDER EVENT)

body_footer: Lo, this is the vacated <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. Its shadowed halls and corridors are said to harbor unspeakable secrets, as well as a single rose of legendary splendor...
body_header: Upon yonder hill dawns an awesome yet doleful structure. It appears abandoned though it still emanates a powerful, evil aura.
body_lore: The grounds before the rose-choked palace are marked by blood-soaked swamps, reeking with the odious stench of death. Its silent inner courtyard is fended off with a vast creeping wall of razor sharp thorn bushes, overseen by petrified gargoyles that ward off unwanted visitors... They protect the unhallowed place where countless lives of mortals were sacrificed in ancient blood rites and orgies in the bygone days when the <hyperlink>Blood Emperor Eternal</hyperlink> reigned supreme.
button_0: Press on.
title: Palace of the Pale Prince

body_footer: The endless corridors of the maze bend and wind with uncanny vastness. All who enter it always exit the very same way they came in...
body_header: High upon a rocky protrusion stands the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, surrounded by a vast, living maze of rose-choked hedges.
body_lore: This fiendish maze exudes a terrible ancient aura born of a blood magic most foul, long ago woven by the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> <<Cr:Emperor>>. Approaching it, one can hear the faint, ghastly wailing of a thousand sacrificed victims. The tributary souls to the <eventColor>{Emperor.Title}</eventColor>, back in the heyday of Drevanya's splendor... Now, their unending suffering feeds and twists the rose-choked foliage of their own prison.
button_0: Dispel <mana></mana> the warding spell protecting the maze.
button_1: Abandon the maze, for now.
button_2: Follow the voice of Princess Consort Mavelith. <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_3: Follow the voice of Prince Consort Wtorakh. <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
title: Blood Swamped and Amazed

have_quest: The endless corridors of the maze bend and wind with uncanny vastness. But a familiar voice strokes your mind and guides your way onward, towards a host of thorned, skeletal protectors...

body_footer: The Obsidian Rose gleams like a gem. It is a living, immortal plant exuding a powerful aura of shadow magic, and now it is yours.
body_header: Upon defeating the host of undead rose guards, the Rose Palace of the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> is free to explore.
body_lore: At the sound of a thunderstrike, the great doors decorated with the insignia of a rose, open. Beyond lies a rose chocked palace filled with countless many abandoned ballrooms and drawing rooms caked all in dried splashes of blood. Ascending the dusty stairs leads you to the top-most tower. Its doors open to reveal a curious glasshouse, filled with many withered roses. But in its center grows a single Obsidian Rose, so magnificent it boggles the mind!
button_0: Give the Obsidian Rose to Princess Consort Mavelith. <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_1: Give the Obsidian Rose to Prince Consort Wtorakh. <relationLvl3></relationLvl3>
button_2: Take the rose for yourself and siphon its power! <mana></mana>
button_3: Claim this bounty of shadow and scrutinize its power. <shadowboon></shadowboon>
button_4: Obtain this marvel of nature and use it to enhance your crops! <natureboon></natureboon>
title: The Obsidian Rose

have_quest: Take it for yourself and siphon its power. <mana></mana>

body_footer: A mad rapture overcomes the cultists as they all charge at you, knives in hand. As many more figures emerge from the shadows of the chamber...
body_header: Like the motions of a dream, the great stone doors that sealed this crypt for untold ages, open before you without sound or vibration; vanishing, as if they never actually existed...
body_lore: Stepping into the blackness beyond, you are overcome by the scent of bedrock, blood, and candle wax. Before long, a narrow, candlelit chamber reveals itself, attended by a host of hooded figures all murmuring around a rose chocked statue of the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink>. With your arrival, the cultists all look up, their eyes sparkling with raptured delight. "The reckoning," one cultist cackles. "The hour of the Blood Reckoning has come, at last! Brothers and sisters, rejoice! By the Deathless God, let our blood be spilled in celebration—spill it now!"
button_0: "Retreat!"
button_1: Spill their blood!
title: Raptured for the Reckoning

no_key: The last line reads: "In His body forever undying, but in our memory hereafter unlived. May He rest in misery."
Before you stands a grand, abandoned blood-fountain memorial. It is built around a massive, elaborately inscribed stone slab, which reads:

"Two rose-torn lovers spilled blood and conceive a curse; a sunless land drenched in rivers of red. One broken heart conjured new lovers coerced; to never be true loves, but servants instead. Thirteen consorts neglected, pledged their blood here to amerce; and sealed thus their Sire in perdition and dread."

body_footer: Moving the statue reveals a hidden, blood-well leading even further down into the bowels of the earth. And deep from within its eternal darkness echoes the faint haunting sound—of music.
body_header: Red! Red! Red! After the battle, the whole chamber is drenched in blood and bodies covering everything so completely in crimson it nigh stirs your Vampiric bloodlust to delirium.
body_lore: But as you stand there, up to your ankles in blood, listening to the sound of your own breath, a sudden clarity enters your awareness: If this crypt was sealed, how did these mortal cultists get in? And where is <<Cp:Emperor>>? Where in damnation is the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink>? You sharpen your senses and search every corner of this remarkably small crypt, but find nothing. However, after a while, you notice how all the blood in the room drains towards the foot of the statue...
button_0: Follow the music to its source.
title: Rhapsody of a Reckoning

body_footer: '<eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>' and '<eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>'. Surely these must know <<Co:Emperor>> unhallowed name, perhaps if you simply ask them? (DEPRECATED)
body_header: Following the mysterious pull has led you to a dark and hallowed mound, where it was said all vampire-kind once originated. (DEPRECATED)
body_lore: In its southern shadow stands a monument, bathed in blood. It lists the names of those who were witness to the birth of Nightborne Sire in <<Co:Emperor>> ascended vampire form. At its top are the names of <<Co:Emperor>> unholy consorts, most of which are violently scratched through, save for two... (DEPRECATED)
button_0: I might consider this. (DEPRECATED)
title: Bloodied Stele (WIP)

body_footer: To unseal the crypt, one needs to seek out <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>, and obtain their blood—one way or another.
body_header: So, the crypt of the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> is sealed with the blood of <<Co:Emperor>> Consorts, and only their blood can make it undone.
body_lore: Little is actually known about the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> besides cultic myth and legend. But amongst <hyperlink>Elder Vampires</hyperlink> it is well known that the Deathless God created the First Brood, the dreaded <hyperlink>Archvampires</hyperlink>. Of this brood, <<Cp:Emperor>> selected a harem of Consorts whom <<Cp:Emperor>> bound to <<Co:Emperor>> indomitable will. It appears, however, that they conspired to lock their Deathless God away in this crypt. How and why, well, only the remaining Consorts could tell.
button_0: "I know what to do."
title: Spouse Hunting

body_footer: Either oblige the Consorts in their quest, or defeat them in battle and collect their blood from their corpses. The choice is yours...
body_header: You have found both <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>, and both acknowledged they sealed the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> with their blood.
body_lore: Both seemed eager to obtain this Obsidian Rose, their reasons why remain unclear... Regardless, a decisive choice now rests on your consciousness: will you oblige them in their little challenge and hope they will stay true to their word, or will you draw their blood by force?
button_0: Obtain the Obsidian Rose, if only for now.
title: Spouse Hunting: Found Your Match

button_1: Pursue the bloody path of war!
button_2: Press on, and torture a Thrall <thralls></thralls> or two to woo <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>.
button_3: Press on, and sacrifice a Thrall <thralls></thralls> or two to woo <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>.

button_1: "I should, perhaps, remain vigilant..." (DEPRECATED)
button_2: "I do not care either way; I only crave blood!" (DEPRECATED)

body_footer: What was once sealed with blood shall soon be unsealed with it. Defeat either <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> or <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> to obtain their blood.
body_header: It is only natural for Vampires to rival their peers. From life to unlife, from Spawn to Sire, from peer to rival, from <hyperlink>Elder</hyperlink> to <hyperlink>Archvampire</hyperlink>.
body_lore: Yes. Inevitably, all Vampires sire new spawn. The 'Sire,' or 'Dam,' is thereafter the steward and overlord of their progeny, often governing their every action. That is, until the spawnling eventually becomes powerful enough to rival their maker... This ruthless powerplay of dominance dictates the lifecycle of virtually all Vampires: one either dominates, or is themselves dominated. So what will it be?
button_0: "Their blood will be mine."
title: Climbing the Food Chain

body_footer: You have obtained the exalted blood of an <hyperlink>Archvampire</hyperlink> Consort. Though... Do you really need all of it to open the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>?
body_header: <eventColor>{ConsortKilled}</eventColor> is defeated! Now, the once pale, sunless earth is stained with the pure blood of an <hyperlink>Archvampire</hyperlink>.
body_lore: Unlike the <hyperlink>Elder Vampire</hyperlink>, only a limited select brood of <hyperlink>Archvampires</hyperlink> was ever sired into existence by the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink>—let alone made into <<Co:Emperor>> Consort. Now, by your fangs, there exists even one less upon the realm of <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>!
button_0: Abstain from your hunger <goodact></goodact>, you are greater than this. <influence></influence>
title: Climbing the Food Chain: Near the Top

button_2: "The blood of the Consort is already mine!"

got_blood: You have obtained the exalted blood of an <hyperlink>Archvampire</hyperlink>. Press on to the  to awaken the <hyperlink>Progenitor of all Vampire-kind</hyperlink>.

button_2: Commit Diablerie <evilact></evilact> and consume a portion of this exalted blood! <xp></xp>
button_3: Cast a Hemoc Rite <thralls></thralls> with this exalted blood to expand your reign. <food></food>
button_4: Collect all the blood, but reserve a portion for your studies. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_5: "The Blood Reckoning draws near!" <influence></influence>

body_footer: "Slay either <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> or <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor>, and get their blood. Then we can open the crypt and put an end to <eventColor>{Emperor.Name}</eventColor>."
body_header: <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> regards you with a studious stare. "All right, now for the easy part of the plan."
body_lore: "Let's do what I do best, and see if you do too. Kill Vampires. Then, you do what your kind does best: all that wretched blood voodoo, to open the crypt. As established, we will need the blood of the Consorts to perform your—rite, so you know what that means?"
button_0: "The hunt is on."
button_2: "That is a terrible plan. I am going my own way."
button_3: "Their blood is already mine." <influence></influence>
title: The Hunt is On

body_footer: <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> looks up at you with an impatient glint in <<o:Huntress>> eye. "Your move, partner."
body_header: With <eventColor>{ConsortKilled}</eventColor> defeated, <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> approaches you with an ambitious glint in <<p:Huntress>> eye.
body_lore: "Impressive work—'partner', " grins <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor>. "With this blood we can open the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> and do what was long thought impossible. My, how I have dreamed of this moment, and to think it would happen with a bloody Vampire by my side, pha!" <<Cp:Huntress>> stares off into the distance for a moment, then whispers, "Mother would be proud..."
button_0: "Time to hunt the big game, partner." <rs_alliance></rs_alliance>
button_2: "Partner? This blood is mine and mine alone, perish!" <evilact></evilact>
button_3: "I do not need a partner, I need gold." <gold></gold>
title: The Hunt is On: Success!

superbadass: <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> steps back and gasps. "H– How? Who?..." <<p:Huntress>> stutters with wide eyes. "That is some superior huntsmanship!"

body_footer: <<Cp:Emperor>> reaches out <<o:Emperor>> hand and whispers, "Arbiter of the Blood Reckoning, reveal to me what I have longed to learn for all eternity: shall we reign together, forever; or will you be my coveted destruction?"
body_header: From the lightless void, two ivory fangs emerge, followed by eyes blazing like portals into the <hyperlink>Endailon of Shadow</hyperlink> itself. <<Co:Emperor>> exalted gaze arrests your full attention.
body_lore: "Thank you for unsealing me, my peerless progeny," confides <eventColor>{Emperor.Name}</eventColor>. "And what a magnificent Vampire you are... All My sealed slumber I have dreamed of your arrival <eventColor>{Player.Name}</eventColor>. Yet now, witnessing you here before Me, in all your majestic perfection, I must declare: you are a sight more glorious than dreams could ever conceive."
button_0: Join the Deathless God at <<Co:Emperor>> awakened side.
button_1: Vow to destroy the Deathless God!
title: Face of the Fanged Creator

body_footer: DEPRECATEd
body_header: DEPRECATED
body_lore: DEPRECATED
button_0: DEPRECATED
title: DEPRECATED

body_footer: <<Cp:Emperor>> glances at you longingly for a space, before turning away and drawing <<o:Emperor>> weapon. "Blood for blood."
body_header: For a brief instance, <eventColor>{Emperor.FirstName}</eventColor> smiles upon you with earnest affection. "You are exactly as I had hoped you would be, my progeny of doom."
body_lore: "Oh, how I hunger for your best attempt at my life, <eventColor>{Player.FirstName}</eventColor>," laments <eventColor>{Emperor.Name}</eventColor> with bitter melancholy. "Though my longing might very well be in vain, as always. Regardless—come, let us join in this black dance of bloodshed I am eternally fated to perform."
button_0: "Blood for blood."
title: Reckoning Upon the Creator

body_footer: <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> studies you with calculative intent. "So tell me, are you still considering my offer, or what?"
body_header: In your moment of determination, <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> reaches out to you.
body_lore: <<Cp:Huntress>> eyes you with a nasty smile. "I've been keeping my eyes on you. You are up to something, aren’t you?"
button_0: "I am, just be patient."
button_1: "No, I am going my own way."
button_2: "You; spying on me? This means war!"
title: Bloody Conflict of Interests

body_footer: Yes, here lies the Crypt of the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink>. Though, from a distance, it shows no obvious entry. Better inspect it up close.
body_header: All about you lies a blood moor, far, far older than any <hyperlink>Elder Vampire</hyperlink>. The rancid air is stale and thick with decay.
body_lore: Rivers of blood seep down the great hill, leading towards a deep depression in the earth. There, in a misty corpse-ridden vale, you find a large, overgrown monument from antiquity. It appears to be—an ancient sepulcher? Or perhaps even a crypt.
button_0: Continue your quest.
title: A Sepulcher Sealed Shut

body_footer: Heaving from exhaustion, a crazed cackle emerges from <<o:Wife>> trembling form. "Very well. Lesson learned: Never. Trust. Anyone. Ever! Time to kill. Kill. Kill!"
body_header: For a long instance, <eventColor>{Wife.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> stares at you with wide perplexed eyes, <<o:Wife>> mouth agape and trembling.
body_lore: "You..." <<p:Wife>> seethes with a dry throat. "You vile wretched liar! You cursed rat, you! I will tear your throat out for this! I’ll pull your fangs and tear you limb from limb, I’ll... I’ll..." <<Co:Wife>> face and body tremble with a fit of hysteria as <<p:Wife>> throws <<o:Wife>> head back and screams out to the sky like a banshee!
button_0: "Time to kill, indeed."
title: Deep Stinging Betrayer

body_footer: "N–no matter," <<p:Husband>> stammers with a vile, widening grin. "'Tis my fault entirely for trusting the inferior class. This error shall be corrected shortly, with furious determination!"
body_header: <eventColor>{Husband.TitleFirstName}</eventColor> looks at you with red-hot, furious intent. <<Co:Husband>> nostrils flare and steam comes out from <<o:Husband>> skin.
body_lore: "How could you do this to me," <<p:Husband>> demands with a growling tremor in <<o:Husband>> voice. "To me? <eventColor>{Husband.TitleName}</eventColor>! You impudent peasant! You do not know what you have done! You do not..." <<Cp:Husband>> corrects <<r:Husband>> with a dismissive gesture of <<o:Husband>> trembling hands.
button_0: "Do your worst."
title: Hot Blazing Betrayer

body_footer: "You made it personal now, sucker," <<p:Huntress>> grins darkly. "I'm gonna carve a stake with your name on it. Come and get it!"
body_header: <eventColor>{Huntress.FirstName}</eventColor> turns towards you with a look of stupefied surprise on <<o:Huntress>> brows, before spitting out a silent curse.
body_lore: "Well, can’t say I'm entirely surprised," <<p:Huntress>> grumbles. "Hurt? Sure, a little. But surprised? From being backstabbed by a no-good, lousy Vampire? Nah, it's in your vile, blood-sucking nature, isn’t it? Wretched abominations; the whole lot of you!"
button_0: "Your death will be my pleasure."
title: Bloody Double Crosser

body_footer: "Come, cease your struggle, my ecstasy," offers <eventColor>{Emperor.Name}</eventColor>. "Join my side, where you rightfully belong! And together, we shall unleash a reckoning that shall inspire terror into even the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>!" (DEPRECATED)

body_lore: "<eventColor>{Player.FirstName}</eventColor>, I admire your fighting spirit," coaxes <<p:Emperor>>. "Indeed. You are ethereally magnificent as you grace the earth with your grand, impeccable sense of purpose. The very ground beneath your feet is utterly unworthy of your presence, and it fills me with rapturous, elevated pride to know that you are my progeny. My ultimate creation, perfection made flesh." (DEPRECATED)

body_footer: With a shudder, a realization dawns... Was this, <eventColor>{Emperor.Name}</eventColor>? Did <<Cp:Emperor>> truly just reach out to you?
body_header: Suddenly, a curious, cold breeze brushes your senses. It carries an eerie murmur, a whisper from the beyond...
body_lore: Sharpening your Vampiric senses, you notice how the ghastly sigh contains audible words. "My... Deliverer..." it says. "Come... Come to me. Unseal it... Unseal the Crypt..."
button_0: "I will find you yet!"
title: Whispers from the Crypt

emperor: Ruler starts with additional structures unlocked and extra heroes.

alt_struct_descr: This now long shunned and overgrown sepulcher was long ago erected both to entomb the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> and to memorialize the creation of all Vampire-kind. Legend tells that a kingdom of roses once prospered upon this hill, where, one day, two lovers met and ultimately bled to death. Through this unholy ordeal, the first Vampire arose who, thereafter, sired many more.

Countless blood orgies were had within the walls of this accursed place. And through the sacrifice of untold many souls, an evil spell was woven about it, arresting the whole estate in time—warding off both ruin and looters. For an enchanted, thorny maze creeps about it, which is said to protect a singular, true love’s rose cultivated within the top-most tower.

description: As an <hyperlink>Elder Vampire</hyperlink>, return to the rued origin realm of all Vampire-kind. Foil or court its two feuding <hyperlink>Archvampire</hyperlink> guardians, as you venture to uncover the mythical Crypt of the <hyperlink>Deathless God</hyperlink> and bring about a long awaited reckoning of blood.
name: Rued Drevanya

description: Ages ago, in a time when the forces of elemental might roamed the cosmos, a prince betrayed his lover and through this bloodshed was accursed. Thus arose a being of great power and allure, neither dead nor alive, who fed on the living and prospered in shadows: The first Vampire.

This Vampire would spread his curse of power and damnation through his lethal 'kiss.' Through this, he became the Deathless God; a scourge who invaded and enthralled entire realms. And yet, after being born from betrayal, betrayal would be his downfall... For unrest rose from within.

False love sealed the Deathless God in a crypt, and the unrest that followed damned him and his entire Realm to the World Vault called Grexolis. As the first Vampire was reduced to myth and legend, the Vampires who remained were hunted down or fled into the shadows.

But then, after Ages of banishment, the realm of the undying first Vampire emerged from Grexolis' oblivion. Few remembered the cruel Deathless God, but many Vampires knew the myth of the Blood Reckoning, when the Deathless God would awaken once more and the Age of Vampires would begin.

This is the story of the Vampire who would bring forth this Blood Reckoning.

custom_prediction_01: Continue with the Huntress Quest, but end your own. (For now...)
custom_prediction_02: Ends the Huntress Quest, continue on your own.

description: Thus by the hand of his progeny the Deathless God was raised from his dark slumber, and at his royal command the scattered Vampire aristocracy were summoned to the imperial crypt of Drevanya. There they paid homage to the Deathless God and the Godir who freed him.

Thus, the Deathless God was slain by one of his own progeny. This Blood Reckoning was felt by all Vampires far and wide, and in their cold and blackened hearts stirred the anxious fear of anarchy... And opportunity.

The legends of Urvatogh’s cruel greatness would once again impel the Worlds Within to shudder, for his long avowed Blood Reckoning had only just begun... with his savior beside him, expected to abide in his shadow forever.

With his crypt now unsealed and vacant, the title, throne, and Dominion of the Blood Emperor Eternal would belong to the Vampire Godir who had banished him. Together with a newfound consort, this Godir would bring about the new Age of Vampires.

With his crypt now unsealed and vacant, the title, throne, and Dominion of the Blood Emperor Eternal would belong to the Godir who had banished him. And it was this Godir who would bring about the new Age of Vampires.

With his crypt now unsealed and vacant, the title, throne, and Dominion of the Blood Emperor Eternal would once again fall to oblivion, as the hunt against Vampires waxed fierce... Even by their own kin.

hero_bio_1:
Xorn used to be a mercenary commander, hired by the former Elven Court on Athla. As the Umbral Demons invaded, Xorn found himself fighting alongside former enemies. Ever stoic and true to his name, it is said he ascended when he fell holding off an Eldritch Sovereign and its armies—an act of bravery still lauded among his people.

Originating from a mercenary army, the Othrakar have since developed a culture and morality of their own. Their myths and legends consist mostly of acts of heroism and overcoming great odds, which is also why they hold their leader in such high reverence.
hero_bio_2:
Aya's gaze has always drifted beyond the limits of the physical realm. It was her mind that elevated her to become guide to her people and ascended her to Godirhood. She has seen many futures and guides her people through them with kindness, but prejudice.

The Simians of the Open Hand value wisdom and harmony above all else, aiming for a life of peace and study. Once threatened, however, they use their inner strength to exploit the weaknesses of their adversaries.
hero_bio_3:
Megaira was born in the fires of her burning parental home. Since then she has fought for her place in the world of the Pyrekin. She has slain many who challenged her, and even more who happened to be in her way, with tooth and fist if necessary. Thus, she was given the title of Thornfist.

The Pyrekin believe they were born from the heart of the flame that devours the worlds, and thus they need to feed the flame in their hearts. No challenge unanswered, no deed undone, they charge into battle like an inferno and burn all they deem unworthy.
hero_bio_4:
When his name is whispered on a realm, everyone starts to prepare for war: Woko Ulang, the Apex Slayer, invokes fear even in the most ferocious warriors, for his blade strikes true and his heart knows no respite. After he slew the Elder Jade Dragon Shoqwuna on his home world, Woko Ulang started to travel the Astral Sea, seeking opponents worth striking down.

The Warring Jungleborn are the relentless tide which Woko Ulang unleashes on the realms he enters. They are agile fighters, jumping from liana to liana, and they will carry the drums of war to anyone unable to flee their rapid expansion in time.
hero_bio_5:
Ever watchful and bold, Grand Vindicator Skonyru judges those who threaten the meek, descending upon them with grim anger. Said to originate from a forgotten kingdom in which the larger and smaller races lived together in harmony, Skonyru is determined to carry on the legacy of his forebears—a noble mission which earned him the allegiance of the Graceful Judges.

Since Skonyru saved them from the pitiless forges of Khir Uranon, the Vigilant Smithlings have been his loyal and dexterous followers. Through their special bond, the inner fire of the ogrekin was invoked within them and they became gifted in the carving of runes, making their formidable smithworks able to withstand almost any kind of harm.

button_1: "You are free to leave, but I will not aid a rebellion."
button_4: "Your trust in me is misplaced, you are my prisoner now!" <evilact></evilact>
title: Voice of the People

body_footer: <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> readies <<r:IntrigueHero>> to ascend to the throne of <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerCapital}</eventColor>.
body_header: You have taken <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerCapital}</eventColor>. As your soldiers flood its streets, <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.Name}</eventColor> marches to the capital, gathering a large following behind <<P:IntrigueHero>>.
body_lore: Before long, <eventColor>{IntrigueHero}</eventColor> stands before the throne which belonged to <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. "Finally, our strife has come to an end." <<Cp:IntrigueHero>> turns to the gathered crowd before <<P:IntrigueHero>>: "Citizens of <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerCapital}</eventColor>, this is the start of a new dawn. No more shall a tyrant rule the <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerRace}</eventColor>! No longer shall we kneel for unworthy <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>!" The crowd cheers wildly.
button_0: Support the new Rule of <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerRace}</eventColor>.
button_7: Take this chance to assassinate <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> before <<p:IntrigueHero>> can ascend. <evilact></evilact>
title: Voice of the People: Aftermath

body_footer: "I and the 000004 are in your debt, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. Name your reward."
body_header: The 000004 have a new <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>: <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore:
Having been removed from <> throne by <> own former subjects, {IntriguePreviousRuler.TitleName} is sent to the Astral Void.

"This was inevitable," {IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.TitleName} says. "The people demand their pound of flesh. Let us hope this ends the bloodshed and injustice in {IntrigueVictimPlayerCapital}." <> turns to you. "This would not have been possible without your aid."
button_0: "I will need supportive allies on this realm. Join me, to victory!"
button_1: Share your resources <gold></gold> <mana></mana> <food></food> <knowledge></knowledge> with my city <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>."
button_2: "Ruling an Empire is hard for the uninitiated. Become my vassal instead."
title: Long Live the <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>

body_footer: You have thoroughly destroyed any sense of unity within the Empire of <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>.
body_header: You order your soldiers to assassinate <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> on the brink of ascension. <<Cp:IntrigueHero>> stares at the knives protruding from <<o:IntrigueHero>> body in disbelief.
body_lore: Without another word, the would-be <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.Title}</eventColor> slumps to the floor, blood pooling around <<P:IntrigueHero>>. The <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerRace}</eventColor> wail in agony at the loss of their liberator.
button_0: "This is what happens to those who defy a Godir's rule." <influence></influence>
button_1: Loot <item></item> and claim <<g:body,IntrigueHero>> <unit></unit> for your own crypt.
button_3: Reinstate <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> and force <<P:IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader>> into submission.
title: Et tu, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>

body_footer: "May this siege be over soon," <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> says, staring at the city. "So my people need not suffer any longer."
body_header: You have reached <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerCapital}</eventColor>. As you initiate the siege, <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> steps forward, clearly visible from the walls.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerRace}</eventColor>!" <<Cp:IntrigueHero>> shouts, "Brothers, sisters! I have returned, with the aid and support of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>! We are not alone, we are many, we can never be silenced! Rise up against the tyrant <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>!" A faint cheering can be heard from the walls of <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerCapital}</eventColor>, followed by the sounds of riots and unrest within.
button_0: Continue your siege.
button_1: Take this chance to assassinate <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> before <<p:IntrigueHero>> can fulfill <<o:IntrigueHero>> quest. <evilact></evilact>
title: Voice of the People: <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerCapital}</eventColor>

body_footer: "This means war, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>."
body_header: Shortly after liberating a prisoner of <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, you are contacted by the <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> <<r:IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader>>.
body_lore: <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> speaks coldly: "You underestimate me if you think I am unaware of what you are planning. Your only goal is to sow dissent, and I will not accept it." A thin smile creeps across <<o:IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader>> face: "Luckily nothing unites a people more than a common threat."
button_0: "So be it."
title: No Good Deed

body_footer: "We cannot banish the <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, but you can. Please, <eventColor>{IntriguePlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. Destroy that vile demon. Save the 000004..."
body_header: You rescued a group of refugees from a demonic assault. Battered but grateful, the survivors gather around your army.
body_lore: The last thing the concerned citizen told you before <<o:IntrigueVictimUnit>> demise, was about the summoning of <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. Upon inquiry, one of the refugees limps forward. "You mean the 2?" <<Cp:IntrigueVictimUnit>> says, despite hushed warnings from <<o:IntrigueVictimUnit>> comrades. "I... I know where it is. But I must warn you, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. This was not the work of a simple cult."
button_0: "The fleeing 000004 are welcome in my Empire." <population></population>
button_1: "Your trust in me is misplaced. Hand over your possessions <gold></gold>, or die." <evilact></evilact>
button_2: "I will keep this in mind."
title: Fiendish Takeover: Aftermath

body_footer: The remaining <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerRace}</eventColor> have no choice but to await your judgment on their fate. How do you address them?
body_header: You have defeated <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> and taken <<o:IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader>> capital, amidst a brewing rebellion.
body_lore: Your armies storm into the former capital, dissuading any further unrest. The fall of the grand Empire echoes through the realm, and any rumors of rebellion and prisoners disappear with those who flee your expected wrath.
button_0: "As this Empire falls, remember the might of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>." <influence></influence>
button_2: "The <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerRace}</eventColor> will be aided <food></food> during these times of uncertainty." <goodact></goodact>
button_3: You do not address the people. You loot the city. <gold></gold> <evilact></evilact>
title: Rebellion: Crushed

body_footer: You sense an arcane power rise around <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.FirstName}</eventColor>. If you let <<P:IntrigueHero>>, <<p:IntrigueHero>> will ascend to become the <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> of the <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerRace}</eventColor>.
body_header: <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> snarls. "I was imprisoned because '<eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>' <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> is afraid of <<o:IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader>> very own subjects, and the power of the <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerRace}</eventColor>."
body_lore: "<<g:power,IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader>> is dwindling, <<o:IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader>> capital taken, and thus I must guide my people." Before long, <eventColor>{IntrigueHero.FirstName}</eventColor> stands before <<o:IntrigueHero>> people. "Proud <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerRace}</eventColor>, our strife has come to an end! No more shall a tyrant rule over us! No longer shall we kneel for unworthy <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>!" The crowd cheers wildly at the return of their <hyperlink><<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink>.
title: Voice of the People

lore: <helpcolor>Scripture describes how the First Elves visited all <hyperlink>Worlds</hyperlink> to seed them with life. This magnificent tree stands as a testament to that age. It is said the souls of these First Ones still reside within it, sometimes manifesting themselves as the Entwined, eternally bound to protect its growth.</helpcolor>
name: World Tree

description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <happiness></happiness> <hyperlink>City Stability</hyperlink> per <farm></farm> <hyperlink>Farm</hyperlink> and <forester></forester> <hyperlink>Forester</hyperlink> in <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Domain</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Friendly <hyperlink>Unit</hyperlink> in <hyperlink>Domain</hyperlink> are healed for 30 <hyperlink>{<hp></hp>}</hyperlink> at the end of each strategic <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Adds <hyperlink>Spring fairy</hyperlink>, <hyperlink>Summer fairy</hyperlink>, <hyperlink>Autumn fairy</hyperlink>, and <hyperlink>Winter fairy</hyperlink> to the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
lore: <helpcolor>This lush location is fed by a magical wellspring that flows directly from the fey realm. Mystical waters attract all manner of creatures, unaware that they are potential victims to tricks of the fairy folk. Though what a fairy considers mischief, can be potentially deadly to others! Even the most powerful beings should proceed with a measure of caution.</helpcolor>
name: Hidden Wellspring

description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <knowledge></knowledge> <hyperlink>Knowledge</hyperlink> per <quarry></quarry> <hyperlink>Quarry</hyperlink> in <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Domain</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Can be set as a <hyperlink>Unit</hyperlink> deploy location.</bullet><bullet>Adds the <hyperlink>Brewer ogre</hyperlink> and <hyperlink>Butcher ogre</hyperlink> units to the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
lore: <helpcolor>The ruins of a massive stronghold dating back to an age when the first civilizations made a stand against rampant, gargantuan monsters and magical storms. Although battered, its weathered walls still offer a degree of protection to those within as well as those nearby during times of strife.</helpcolor>
name: Castle Ruins

description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink> per <conduit></conduit> <hyperlink>Conduit</hyperlink> in <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Domain</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Adds the <hyperlink>Astral keeper unit</hyperlink> unit to the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
lore: Powerful <hyperlink>Astral Currents</hyperlink> converge at this location. Rather than forming an ordinary Mana Node, these energies have crystallized into a forest of shimmering trees. Intricate branches and deep, meandering root systems suggest an interconnectedness to much in the universe; <<c:<hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink>>>, <hyperlink>Worlds</hyperlink>, even ages. Time and space have no meaning here.
name: Crystal Forest

description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink> per <quarry></quarry> <hyperlink>Quarry</hyperlink> in <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Domain</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Adds the <hyperlink>Stormscale serpent</hyperlink> and <hyperlink>Plague serpent</hyperlink> units to the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
lore: <helpcolor>An ancient cavern that heralds from the time of this world's creation, during an era when Dragons and Giants molded the very lands into physical form. Within these natural sanctuaries, the first creatures found shelter as the world outside violently settled into place. To this day, the cave itself remains a sanctuary for those that are able to find their way to it.</helpcolor>
name: Ancient Cave

description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink>, +2 <knowledge></knowledge> <hyperlink>Knowledge</hyperlink>, and +1 <souls></souls> <hyperlink>Soul</hyperlink> (if obtainable) for each <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> in <hyperlink>Crypt</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Adds the <hyperlink>Corrupt soul</hyperlink> unit to the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
lore: <helpcolor>A sinister necropolis crafted by the ancient Shad'rai. Its tunnels and burial chambers seem to expand, almost as if they are alive and seek to accommodate any new inhabitants throughout the ages. This tomb doesn't merely hunger for the bodies of the dead, it yearns to feast upon their very <<c:<hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink>>>.</helpcolor>
name: Lost Tomb

description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <knowledge></knowledge> <hyperlink>Knowledge</hyperlink> per <researchpost></researchpost> <hyperlink>Research Post</hyperlink> in <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Domain</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Adds the <hyperlink>Blessed soul</hyperlink> unit to the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
lore: <helpcolor>This hidden temple complex is forgotten by time. Herein did the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> once worship the <hyperlink>Allfather</hyperlink>. However, the light that aided the masses in connecting with the divine has long since been extinguished. The site's once grand halls now attract cultists and sinister entities seeking to awaken and twist its power.</helpcolor>
name: Secret Temple

description: <bulletlist><bullet><hyperlink>Magic origin</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Unit</hyperlink> require -50% less <gold></gold> <hyperlink>Gold</hyperlink> and <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink> base <hyperlink>Unit Upkeep</hyperlink> in this <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Domain</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Adds the <hyperlink>Phoenix</hyperlink> unit to the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
lore: <helpcolor><hyperlink>The Archon civilization</hyperlink> raised these monolithic structures at great cost. Scholars speculate they were once utilized as portals to other <hyperlink>Worlds</hyperlink>. However, with the ziggurat's original builders now long gone, those with opportunistic and potentially sinister motives come to try and unravel its forgotten powers.</helpcolor>
name: Golden Ziggurat

lore: <helpcolor>A truly grandiose forge that draws its heat directly from the blazing depths of the world. Legends tell that Titans once utilized these great tools for their grand designs and that the first-born Dwarves may have even emerged from these primordial sites.</helpcolor>
name: Magma Forge

description: <bulletlist><bullet>Unlock the <hyperlink>Wizard's Bombardment</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Siege Project</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Adds the <hyperlink>Bone dragon</hyperlink> unit to the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>

While some powerful force seems to have destroyed the tower and long vanquished its owner, dangerously arcane energies still seep from within the ruins.</helpcolor>

description_active_raid: From the mists the 42 have emerged to lay siege to 1.
description_city_lost: The 42 and their terrifying allies have captured your city of 1. Every <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>, the city will lose <population></population> <hyperlink>Population</hyperlink> and <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink>. If 1 isn't liberated in time, the 42 will raze it to the ground!
description_city_lost_otherplayer_a: As the mist in the realm of 40 clears away, only ruins and ghosts remain of 1. It is as if the city and its inhabitants vanished within the mists.
description_city_lost_otherplayer_b: The mists have vanished and the 42 are gone. Only time will tell when or where they will strike again...
description_city_razed: The mists have vanished and the 42 are gone. Only time will tell when or where they will strike again...
description_crisis_defeated: You have repelled the assault of the 42, pursued them to the Fey realm, and destroyed their relic of power. They will no longer plague this realm with their raids of submission and mass abduction.
description_crisis_defeated_final: You have repelled the final assault of the 42. They lack the power to return from their Fey realm, making you the undisputed owner and channeler of the <eventColor>{FEY_INVASION_RELIC_NAME}</eventColor>.
description_crisis_defeated_otherplayer_: 40 has cleared away the mists on . <<Cp:FEY_INVASION_TARGET_PLAYER>> proclaims <<r:FEY_INVASION_TARGET_PLAYER>> a savior of the realm, telling wild tales about vanquishing murderous Fey folk armed to defeat even a Godir.
description_crisis_defeated_other_player: 40 has defeated the 42 on . <<Cp:FEY_INVASION_TARGET_PLAYER>> proclaims <<r:FEY_INVASION_TARGET_PLAYER>> a savior of the realm, for the 42 will never return to terrorize the realm.
description_new_raid: Thick mists have spread near the city of <eventColor>{FEY_INVASION_TARGET_CITY.Name}</eventColor>. Rumors of dark figures and people disappearing sow panic among the populace, which is seeking your protection.
description_new_raid_final: The mists near the city of <eventColor>{FEY_INVASION_TARGET_CITY.Name}</eventColor> herald the beginning of the final 42 assault. Any available defenses must be mustered!
description_new_raid_otherplayer_a: Stories of a creeping mist haunting the land of <eventColor>{FEY_INVASION_TARGET_PLAYER.Name}</eventColor> are spreading throughout the realm. It is said the city of <eventColor>{FEY_INVASION_TARGET_CITY.Name}</eventColor> has started to vanish within the shroud.
description_new_raid_otherplayer_b: The mists near the city of 1 herald the beginning of a 42 assault against 40.
description_pact_ended: With the defeat of 40, the 42 regard their part of the agreement fulfilled. We should not expect them to still honor the former non-aggression pact and prepare for their possible return.
description_pact_ended_failure: There are rumors that the 42 have lost their <eventColor>{FEY_INVASION_RELIC_NAME}</eventColor> and made a pact with another faction to retrieve it. We must expect the worst from these traitors and prepare for their possible hostile return.
description_portal_closed: The entrance to the Fey realm has vanished, and the 42 are gone. Until the next time the mists spread...
description_portal_revealed: The 42 have been driven back! As the mists dissipate, an entrance to the Fey realm has been revealed. This is the opportunity to follow them and strike back—but soon the entrance will collapse.
description_portal_sealed: The entrance to the Fey realm was shattered, and the 42 are gone. Until the next time the mists spread...
description_raid_aborted: Irritated by the destruction of their target 1, the 42 have withdrawn into the mists. Only time will tell when or where they will strike again...
description_raid_aborted_otherplayer_a: As the mist in the realm of 40 clears away, the scenes of destruction only hint at the terror that was hidden within.
description_raid_defeated_otherplayer_a: The mists in the realm of 40 have cleared away. Many tales surrounding the horrors that plagued the city of 1 are spreading throughout the land.
description_raid_defeated_otherplayer_b: The 42 have been driven back by 40 and retreated to the Fey realm. Until the next time the mists spread...
description_relic_denied: You have denied the 42 the return of the <eventColor>{FEY_INVASION_RELIC_NAME}</eventColor>. Full of wrath, they are preparing their final assault to reclaim it.

fortification_damage_description:
Fortification Damage represents the speed at which a Siege progresses to breach the defenses of a City

Fortification Damage is subtracted from Fortification Health of the City during a Siege until it is reduced to 0.

Fortification Damage in a Siege comes from:A base value of 10Siege Project the besieger is undertaking.Besieging Unit with Siege breaker that are adjacent to the City.
fortification_health_description:
Fortification Health represents how long the duration of a Siege will be on a City. The greater the Fortification Health, the longer the Siege will take.

During a Siege, the besieger will try and reduce the City's Fortification Health to 0 by dealing Fortification Damage. Fortification Health cannot increase during a Siege.

City Defense Structure are the primary source of Fortification Health.

A City with Fortification Health still requires any Wall structure to be present before a siege is required.

alignment_description:
Determines how Free City and other Empire see you. Affected by Ruler traits and various actions.

Affects relations with Free City and Empire with Neutral or better Alignment. In addition a Good Alignment (or better) will increase the chance of positive random events occurring, while an Evil Alignment (or worse) will make negative random events more likely.

High Culture has an Alignment Agenda.

Empire Relations for each Alignment level: {PureGoodMinValue} to {PureGoodMaxValue}: Pure Good: {PureGoodRelationValue} {VeryGoodMinValue} to {VeryGoodMaxValue}: Very Good: {VeryGoodRelationValue} {GoodMinValue} to {GoodMaxValue}: Good: {GoodRelationValue} {NeutralMaxValue} to {NeutralMinValue}: Neutral: No effects{EvilMaxValue} to {EvilMinValue}: Evil: {EvilRelationValue} {VeryEvilMaxValue} to {VeryEvilMinValue}: Very Evil: {VeryEvilRelationValue} {PureEvilMaxValue} to {PureEvilMinValue}: Pure Evil: {PureEvilRelationValue}

Competitors are Ruler that have at least negotiated a Pact of Cooperation with a Free City and are actively negotiating with that City.

Competing Rulers will receive a Grievance against a Ruler that vassalizes their desired city.
declared_war_strength_equal: Our forces are just about equally matched.
declared_war_strength_stronger_combined: Our combined allied forces are stronger.
empire_relation_description:
Represents the degree to which two Empire are on good terms with one another.

Good Empire Relations are required to negotiate a Wizard's Bond and Treaty. Eventually good relations can lead to an Alliance.

Bad Empire Relations increase the chance of War being declared.

Empire Relations can be improved by:High AlignmentPronouncementGiftsTrades
house_description:
Free Cities are City that do not belong to an Empire. They have a Free City Lord with whom it is possible to negotiate.

With a higher Diplomatic State, a Free City offers:Trading. Recruitment Point for the Rally of the Lieges.Shared Income.

When an Empire reaches the highest Diplomatic State with a Free City, the city may become part of that empire through a Pact of Integration. Alternatively War may be declared to acquire the Free City through conquest.
independent_city_dipl_state_description:
The diplomatic state with a Free City is the formal expression of their Allegiance. A newly met Free City will be on neutral terms with an Empire (in some cases War is declared instantly). By sending their Free City Lord a Whispering Stones, the Allegiance of the Free City with that Empire will improve over time.

Higher Allegiance leads to better diplomatic states with more valuable benefits. This negotiation process is divided into the Negotiation Phase and the Vassalage Phase, which eventually leads to the Pact of Integration.
independent_city_neutral: Neutral diplomatic state with a Free City
independent_city_relation_description: Relations with a <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> represent their opinion of a Ruler. The relation value can affect the amount of <hyperlink><allegiance></allegiance>Allegiance</hyperlink> gained during <hyperlink>Negotiation</hyperlink> and with very low relations the free city may also declare <rs_war></rs_war> <hyperlink>War</hyperlink> when on the <rs_neutral></rs_neutral> <hyperlink>Neutral</hyperlink> diplomatic state.
independent_city_trade_description:
Free City will offer several trade options to Ruler that share at least a Pact of Cooperation with the City.

Trade options consist of resource exchanges as well as any Magic Material located in the domain of the city.

A Free City will only agree to one active trade at a time, after the trade has expired a new trade can be made.
independent_city_war_description:
A state of War with a Free City means that Army can engage in Combat and City can be attacked.

During war, Free Cities will occasionally send armies to attack their enemies.

Wars end through defeat on either side or by negotiating peace.
negotiations_collected_description: There are two different types of negotiations:<bulletlist><bullet><hyperlink>Negotiation</hyperlink> between <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet><hyperlink>Negotiation</hyperlink> between Rulers and <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
negotiations_description:
Negotiations increase the Allegiance of a Free City leading to better Diplomatic State with an Empire.

Negotiations happen automatically when a Whispering Stones is assigned or the city is vassalized.

Wars end through defeat on either side or peacefully when:Two Empires negotiate a Truce.By negotiating Peace with a {GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept.Name}.

Dwellings are independent City that are inhabited by specific types of Unit.

Like Free City they:Have a Free City Lord.Have diplomatic standings with you that can be improved to gain benefits.Do not belong to an Empire.

Dwellings are not affected by Realm Traits or Spell that affect Free Cities.

A Free City Lord or Lady is the designated ruler of a Free City. They represent their {GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept.Name} in all diplomatic interactions with an Empire and fight for their city as Hero on the World Map.

When the Free City Lord dies (and their Free City has not been conquered or integrated) they will be replaced by their heir, who will become the new Free City Lord after 3 Turn. The free city will not be able to cast Combat Spell until this has happened.

you dominate this world under the banners of newly formed alliances, proving that strong diplomatic bonds can be more powerful than the largest of armies. In trust and unity, we march forward to a better tomorrow.
header: The journey of <eventColor>{Player.Name}</eventColor>
last_man_standing_alliance_victory_text: A victor stands proudly upon the remains of their enemies. You subjugated this world through force, as the empires of the past did before you. When the dust settles, you will discover whether your cause was just, or if you merely fanned the flames of entropy.
magic_astral_alliance_victory_text: Your ally <eventColor>{OtherPlayer.Name}</eventColor> has become the Archmage of Astral. Your people look up in awe as you rise together, Astral flows surrounding you and <<P:OtherPlayer>>. Reality itself bends to your will as you welcome the Age of Astral.
magic_astral_victory_text:
Your people look up in awe as you rise above your empire, floating on magical currents. Reality bends to your will and magical rifts open as you call forth the Age of Astral.
Well done, Archmage.
magic_chaos_alliance_victory_text: Your ally <eventColor>{OtherPlayer.Name}</eventColor> has become the <<OtherPlayer<eventColor>{Lord/Lady}</eventColor>>> of Chaos. Your people watch in awe as you stride forth together, leaving madness and destruction in your wake. A red dawn shines upon the realm as you welcome the Age of Chaos and claim your victory.
magic_chaos_victory_text:
Your people watch in awe as you stride forth, leaving madness and destruction in your wake. A red dawn shines upon the realm as you call forth the Age of Chaos.
Well done, <{Lord/Lady}>> of Chaos.
magic_materium_alliance_victory_text: Your ally <eventColor>{OtherPlayer.Name}</eventColor> has become the Creator of Materium. Your people watch in awe as you join <<P:OtherPlayer>> and sink your feet into the earth. The realm trembles and reforms beneath your gaze as you welcome the Age of Materium.
magic_materium_victory_text:
Your people watch in awe as you sink your feet into the earth and raise your arms. The realm trembles and reforms beneath your gaze, and you call forth the Age of Materium.
Well done, Creator.
magic_nature_alliance_victory_text: Your ally <eventColor>{OtherPlayer.Name}</eventColor> has become the <<OtherPlayer<eventColor>{God/Goddess}</eventColor>>> of Nature. Your people watch in awe as you stride together. Tree and beast bow before you, heeding the primordial call of their <<OtherPlayer<eventColor>{God/Goddess}</eventColor>>>. A new dawn shines upon the realm as you welcome the Age of Nature.
magic_nature_victory_text: You have become the <<OtherPlayer<eventColor>{God/Goddess}</eventColor>>> of Nature. Your people watch in awe as you stride to the center of your empire. Tree and beast bow before you, heeding your primordial call. A new dawn shines upon the realm as you call forth the Age of Nature and claim your victory.
magic_order_alliance_victory_text: Your ally <eventColor>{OtherPlayer.Name}</eventColor> has become <<OtherPlayer<eventColor>{God Emperor/God Empress}</eventColor>>>. When you dismantle a Province Improvement of the matching type this will subtract progress from the quest.
