city_battlement_structure_description:
Battlement Structures are a type of City Defense Structure which spawns Battlement obstacles directly behind the walls in Combat during a Siege.

Battlement obstacles provide buffs for units standing inside them.

When multiple Battlement Structures are built, only the most powerful Battlement obstacles will be present in Combat.
city_cap_description:
The number of City your Empire can control.

Exceeding your City Cap results in -25% City Income to all your City for each City above City Cap.

Your City Cap can be increased through Empire Development
city_cap_description_short:
The number of City you can control without suffering economic penalties.
City Cap can be increased through the Empire Development tree.
city_cap_penalty: -25% City Income due to 0000041700000536 <<m:City>> over the City Cap
city_cap_warning_description:
Each city you have over the City Cap reduces income of all of your City.

If you proceed, you will have exceeded the cap by {Citiesover} City and your City will suffer an income penalty of {Incomepercentage} City Income.

Your City Cap can be increased through Empire Development
city_cap_warning_title: Warning: You are about to go over the City Cap
city_defense_structure_description:
City Defense Structures are City Structure that typically grant Fortification Health and provide defensive benefits in Combat during a Siege.

There are different types of Defense Structures:Wall StructureTower StructureSupport StructureBattlement Structure
city_description:
Cities are located on the World Map. Cities are built by upgrading an Outpost or conquered through War.

A city may either belong to an Empire or be a Free City.

The Domain of a city expands according to its Population. Cities provide City Income, which can be improved by adding City Structure and Province Improvement.
city_found_cost: Cost of founding a new city:
city_income_description: City Income is the amount of <hyperlink>Resource</hyperlink> a <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> generates each <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>.
city_morale_description:
City Stability represents your overall control over a City.
High Stability boosts Food, Draft, and Production income.Low Stability reduces all City Income.Very Low Stability can lead to the city losing Province.
It drops as the city's Domain grows, and can be regained by building certain City Structure.
80 to 100: Harmony.40 to 79: Orderly.10 to 39: Stable.-9 to 9: Neutral.-39 to -10: Unstable.-79 to -40: Unrest.-100 to -80: Rioting.
city_morale_description_rioting: -50% <hyperlink>City Income</hyperlink>. There is a chance that the provinces might defect from the city.
city_name_allready_exists: A city with this name already exists!
city_repair_province_reminder: A ruined province can be rebuilt!
city_ruins_description: Remnants of a <hyperlink>City</hyperlink>. Can be rebuilt into a city for a cost.
city_structure_description:
City Structures provide economic bonuses for the City they are built in.

They usually cost Production and Gold, and are built using the Structure Queue.
city_support_structure_description:
Support Structures are a type of City Defense Structure which adds Combat Enchantment to the Combat in a Siege.

These Combat Enchantment add tactical benefits to the Defender in Combat.

Multiple Support Structures can be built and active in one City.
city_tower_structure_description:
Tower Structures are a type of City Defense Structure which spawns Tower units in Combat during a Siege.
Tower units are typically long range units that cannot move and act automatically.

When multiple Tower Structures are built, only the most powerful Tower units will be present in Combat.
city_wall_structure_description:
Wall Structures are a type of City Defense Structure which adds the requirement to Siege the City before hostile armies can attack.

They also define the Wall obstacles present in Combat during a Siege.

When multiple Wall Structures are present, only the strongest Wall obstacle is present in combat.
combat_map_spells_description:
These are Spell that are cast during Combat, using Combat Casting Point.

Types of Combat Spells are: Buff Spell Combat Enchantment Combat Summon Spell Damage Spell Debuff Spell Healing Spell
concept_empire_development_description:
Contains Empire Skill that can improve your empire's economy and unlock important abilities such as Seafaring and Tunneling.

Empire Skill become available when enough Affinity Progress has been attained towards that particular Affinity. Available Empire Skill can be unlocked at any time by paying their Imperium cost.
concept_empire_skill_description:
Unlocks Empire-wide bonuses or grants powerful one-off rewards. Acquired via Empire Development.

Empire Skills require certain levels of Affinity to unlock.
concept_speed_march_description:
Forced March can be used to force your units to move further on the World Map than they would normally be able to in a single Turn.

When Forced March is activated units gain 100% of their Move Point but lose 30% of their current {}. They also become Exhausted for 2 Turn. Forced March costs 10 Mana per unit in the army.

The ability to use Forced March can be unlocked through Empire Development .
contact_info_description: Receive direct contact information for another <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> of the <eventColor>{Race.Name}</eventColor> race and establish a relationship. Their location in the realm will not be revealed, but diplomatic interactions and effects will be enabled.
contact_info_description_colonies: Receive direct contact information for another <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> of the <eventColor>{Race.Name}</eventColor> race and establish a relationship. Making contact will reveal <eventColor>{NumCities}</eventColor> <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> belonging to the target Ruler and diplomatic interactions and effects will be enabled.
continue_anyway: Do you want to continue anyway?
create_world_description: A realm of your own creation
crypt_description:
When you defeat an enemy Hero in combat, they have a chance to go to your Prison or your crypt.

The remains of these heroes can be sold to get their equipment and some gold.
culture_filtering_description: Select the cultures that can be chosen for <hyperlink>Player</hyperlink> and <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink>. Independent spawners may still use disabled cultures.
custom_region_bundle_selection_descripti: Realms generate using 1 category of <hyperlink>Handcrafted Region</hyperlink>. Select which categories can be randomly picked from when a realm is generated.
dead_lord_tooltip: The Lord or Lady of this house is dead. A new one will be chosen in a few turns.
delete_are_you_sure_faction: Are you sure you want to delete this faction?
delete_are_you_sure_pantheon_hero:
Are you sure you want to expel this Ruler from the Pantheon?

You can still play with this ruler after expelling them; rulers are restored to the library or custom factions list, but lose any Ascension Trait and Race Transformation.
delete_are_you_sure_realm: Are you sure you want to delete this realm?
devour_hero_satiated_error: Hero is Satiated on Blood and cannot feed for
devour_hero_tooltip: Have a Vampire consume this hero, granting it <hyperlink><xp></xp> Experience</hyperlink> and moving the devoured hero to the crypt. This will impact your relations with <eventColor>{Owner}</eventColor> by <eventColor>{RelationModifier}</eventColor><badRelation></badRelation>. This is an act of evil, <eventColor>{AlignmentModifier}</eventColor><evilact></evilact>.
devour_hero_tooltip_generic: Have a Vampire consume this hero, granting it <hyperlink><xp></xp> Experience</hyperlink> and moving the devoured hero to the crypt. This is an act of evil, <eventColor>{AlignmentModifier}</eventColor><evilact></evilact>.
dismantle_tooltip:
Dismantle the structure and remove it from the city.

50% of the resources spent on constructing the upgrade will be returned.
dominated_unit: This unit has been magically dominated by the enemy.
dormant_description: Dormant skills do not grant any gameplay effects and cannot be reset.
echo_casting_tooltip:
Echo casting allows the use of Astral Echoes to replace casting points, letting the user cast spells beyond the limit their casting points would otherwise allow.

Tactical spells that cost more Combat Casting Point than remain may substitute them with Astral Echoes.
Strategic spells may be rushed while they are priming in the spellbook, costing Astral Echoes to substitute the remaining World Map Casting Point.
echo_infusion_tooltip:
Echo Infusion allows the use of Astral Echoes to empower Magic origin units granting them additional ranks.

The cost of this infusion is based on the remaining Experience required before the unit reaches the next rank.
empire_description:
An empire consists of a Ruler, their Army, City and Domain.

An empire that has lost both its Ruler and Throne City is defeated.
empire_dragon_type_warning: Ascended Dragons cannot change their starting affinity.
empire_progression_max_points_reached: Maximum number of Empire Progression Points reached!
excavation_description:
Excavation is a World Map ability available to Unit which allows them to dig through tunnels and clear out Province in the Underground that lies underneath Earthen terrain.

Excavation can open up new paths, uncover buried Treasure, or even discover hidden Location.
execute_hero_tooltip: Execute this hero, moving them to your crypt. This will impact your relations with <eventColor>{Owner}</eventColor> by <eventColor>{RelationModifier}</eventColor><badRelation></badRelation>. This is an act of evil, <eventColor>{AlignmentModifier}</eventColor><evilact></evilact>.
execute_hero_tooltip_generic: Execute this hero, moving them to your crypt. This is an act of evil, <eventColor>{AlignmentModifier}</eventColor><evilact></evilact>.
exiled_unit: Unit is exiled to the Umbral Abyss
exit_confirmation: Are you sure you wish to leave this realm?
fixed_teams_description: Teams are fixed and cannot be changed during the game. Each team starts at war with every other team, and most diplomacy is disabled.
fog_of_war_description:
Hexes on the World Map that have been previously revealed but you currently have no vision of through Army or Location owned by you are covered by Fog of War.

Hexes within Fog of War appear darker than when revealed by vision, but will still reveal terrain types, roads and Location. Neutral and Hostile Army are not visible within Fog of War unless sensed by Sensing Range.

Through Treaty and Diplomatic State you may reveal other City. But they will still be covered by Fog of War.
form_filtering_description: Select the forms that can be chosen for <hyperlink>Player</hyperlink>, <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> and independent spawners.
founding_description:
Outpost can be transformed into City by spending Imperium.

Pay attention to your City Cap when founding new cities, you will suffer economic penalties if you have too many cities!
generate_ruler_settings: Select what options will be used for generating new factions.
giant_description: Giants are more than the brutal monsters they are often portrayed as, for these world-builders of old know the lands like no other. The society of people following them has realized this and look to them for guidance, despite their monstrous heritage.
governor_description:
A Governor is a Ruler or Hero assigned to govern a City.

Each hero has a Governance Trait that determines the bonuses they give to their city. These bonuses can be increased with Renown earned from fulfilling the hero's Ambition.

A Ruler is always the Governor of their Throne City.
governor_switch_warning: Unable to switch governor as this is the Throne City!
governor_tooltip_intro: While <hyperlink>Governor</hyperlink>, the governed <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> gains benefits based on the <renown></renown> <hyperlink>Renown</hyperlink> Level of this <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink>.
happiness_description: Happiness is used as an income for the happiness event. Positive happiness leads to a happiness event. Negative happiness leads to unrest and riots.
heroesoverview_devourtargettitle: Who will feed on this hero?
hero_cannot_afford: Cannot afford the recruit cost for this <<<hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink>>>.
hero_cap_confirm:
Recruiting this hero will cause your empire to go over your Hero Cap. This hero will cost additional Gold to recruit and cost 50% each turn until the cap is increased or a hero dies.

Are you sure you want to recruit this hero?
hero_cap_description:
The hero cap represents the number of Hero your Empire can support.

You cannot recruit more heroes beyond the cap. The cap will increase automatically as the game goes on. You can spend Imperium to increase it instantly.
hero_cap_description_short: The number of <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> your <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink> can support.
hero_cap_warning: Your <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink> has reached its <unitHero></unitHero> <hyperlink>Hero Cap</hyperlink>. New <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> cannot be recruited until the cap increases.
hostage_diplomacy_tooltip: The Dark Subculture "Cult of Tyranny" uses heroes in their prison to take control of Free Cities and exploit Vassals.<bulletlist><bullet>Defeated <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> belonging to <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> become Hostages in your <hyperlink>Prison</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Hostages provide <hyperlink><allegiance></allegiance>Allegiance</hyperlink> every turn and count as an assigned <whisperingStone></whisperingStone> <hyperlink>Whispering Stones</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Conquered Cities released as Vassals also immediately grant you a Hostage.</bullet><bullet>When Vassalizing a city that belonged to another <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink>, all <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> of that empire in your prison become hostages of this new Vassal instead.</bullet></bulletlist>
house_trespassing: An army of <eventColor>{HouseBCapital.Name}</eventColor> was found invading our domain.
house_trespassing_description: A hostile army belonging to <eventColor>{HouseBCapital.Name}</eventColor> was found invading our domain and may set out to attack us. We should attack them instead, or negotiate an end to our war with them.
house_upgrade_set_integrateinfo: Once integrated, the special units of this city remain available through the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink> and the city keeps contributing +3<recruitmentPoints></recruitmentPoints> <hyperlink>Recruitment Point</hyperlink>.
hurry_production: Instantly complete this item based on the leftover resources needed.
hurry_production_blocked: It is not possible to hurry production on this structure.
hyperlink_description: As you can see, this tooltip opened as you hovered over the hyperlink. Now try hovering over this <hyperlink>Hyperlink</hyperlink> to open a tooltip within the tooltip!
increase_herocap_cantafford: You cannot currently afford the costs of increasing the hero cap
increase_herocap_tooltip: Immediately increase the <unitHero></unitHero> <hyperlink>Hero Cap</hyperlink> by 1 for a cost of <eventColor>{BoostCost}</eventColor>.
insufficient_funds_description: You don't have the <gold></gold> <hyperlink>Gold</hyperlink> or <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink> to pay this unit's <hyperlink>Unit Upkeep</hyperlink>. It will suffer a -50 <happiness></happiness> <hyperlink>Morale</hyperlink> penalty, and there is a chance it will desert your armies.
invalid_celldata: Invalid hex selected; cannot build here
in_domain: Cannot build this structure in a player's domain
keeper_description:
The Race Keeper is the Ruler whose Empire has the biggest presence of a race, through owned City and Vassal. You are always the Keeper of the race you start with.

To become the Keeper of a Race you need to have {GLOBAL.MISC.RACE_POPULATION_THRESHOLD}% of the race's Population in your Empire. If the race already has a Race Keeper you need {GLOBAL.MISC.RACE_POPULATION_OVERTAKE_THRESHOLD} Population more than them to take it from them.

To become the Keeper of another player's starting race the player would have to be defeated first.

The Race Keeper is the only Ruler who can apply Major Race Transformation and Minor Race Transformation.
keeper_requirement: PopulationThreshold<population></population> <hyperlink>Population</hyperlink> is needed to become the <hyperlink>Keeper</hyperlink> of this race.
leader_problem: There is a problem with player playerID's Ruler! Please contact the mapmaker to fix this!
leader_type_filtering_description: Select the ruler origins that can be chosen for <hyperlink>Player</hyperlink>.
login_with_paradox_account: Log in with your Paradox account
lore: Lore
matter_shared: Materium <hyperlink>Affinity</hyperlink> <matter></matter> relates to physical magic. It is associated with resource extraction, transmutation and mastery over the mundane physical world.
met_player_while_concealed:
Diplomatic interactions have not been triggered and the other Ruler is unaware of our presence. We can choose to engage with and meet the Ruler or to remain concealed.

This message will be shown only once. Remaining concealed means you will need to meet the Ruler through other means or by standing adjacent to them.
migrating_description: Migrating a <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> makes it part of your <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink> under your direct control, replacing its original race and culture with yours.
militaryaid_available: Cities that are loyal to you have put forward a list of draftable units.
militaryaid_boost_tooltip:
[tooltipHeader]Muster the Lieges[/tooltipHeader]
Costs: {CostString}

This reduces the time until the next Rally starts by {Reduction}, which costs {CostString}. The cost is determined by the number of you have and the duration until the next Rally. After the boost, the remaining duration will be {RemainingTurns}.
militaryaid_boost_warning_alreadyboosted: [fireCol]Cannot Boost: Already boosted! You can boost again when the next Rally starts[/fireCol]
militaryaid_boost_warning_cantafford: [fireCol]Cannot Boost: Cannot afford the boost costs![/fireCol]
militaryaid_boost_warning_nopoints: [fireCol]Cannot Boost: You currently have no recruitment points in the next Rally.[/fireCol]
militaryaid_notarget: There is no target city for the units to spawn!
militaryaid_recruit_description: Select the city where the units should be recruited to. The army will arrive in 2<turn></turn>.
militaryaid_recruit_tooltip:

[tooltipHeader]Recruit Units[/tooltipHeader]
Costs: {CostString}, {Duration}
Upkeep: {Upkeep}

Hires the selected army which will spawn at {City.Name} after {Duration}.

[tooltipHeader]Recruit Units[/tooltipHeader]
Costs: {CostString}, {Duration}

Hires the selected army which will spawn at {SettlerUnit.SettlerCityName} after {Duration}.

Gift the selected army to {House.Name}. The army will spawn as static defenders at {House.Name} after {Duration}.
militaryaid_reinforce_joinmission_descri: Select a vassal city from which troops will join the next mission.

Gift the selected army to {House.Name}. The units will spawn when {House.Name} sends out their next army to attack/defend and will be added to the army to aid in their mission.
militaryaid_reinforce_patrol_tooltip:
[tooltipHeader]Patrol {House.Name}'s Domain[/tooltipHeader]
Costs: {CostString}, {Duration}

Gift the selected army to {House.Name}. The army will spawn at {House.Name} after {Duration} and will patrol their domain.
militaryaid_reinforce_tooltip:
[tooltipHeader]Reinforce Vassal[/tooltipHeader]
Costs: {CostString}, {Duration}

Gift the selected army to one of your vassals. The army will spawn as defenders at the vassal's capital after {Duration}.
militaryaid_wait: Your loyal cities are still assembling a new roster of units.
mortal_champion_description: Mortal Champions are the chosen heroes of their people. It takes dedication and resolve to make a stand among the other powerful beings of this universe. To underestimate these Rulers would be a fatal mistake.
multi_stack_controller_instructions: To add this stack to the selected stacks
multi_stack_mkb_instructions: Shift + <leftmousebutton></leftmousebutton> to add this stack to the selected stacks
name: Name
name_too_few_chars: The name must contain at least 1 character.
name_too_many_chars: The name contains too many characters!
nature_shared: Nature <hyperlink>Affinity</hyperlink> <empirenature></empirenature> governs the energies of life, promoting growth and revitalization. It is associated with farming, druidism and control over the living world.
negotiate_tooltip: Negotiate trade deals, change the Diplomatic State, form treaties, send gifts or make demands.
not_all_trait_points_spent_description: You have not spent all of your trait points. Are you sure you want to continue?
not_enough_gold_hurry_production: You don't have enough gold to hurry production.
no_map_cells_collected: Data on <eventColor>{STRING.NumCells}</eventColor> map cells has been collected
no_map_data_found: No new map data was found
order_shared: Order <hyperlink>Affinity</hyperlink> <order></order> is the power that brings structure to the Cosmos and to the lives of mortals. Associated with light, faith, justice, and the government of empires.
out_of_sync_try_reload: The game is out of sync with the other players. Press reload to try to automatically fix this.
overwrite_savegame_warning_content: Are you sure you want to overwrite save game <eventColor>{STR_FileName}</eventColor>?
pantheon_ascendedskillunlock: The effects of this skill unlock when the hero reaches level: <eventColor>{UnlockLevel}</eventColor>
pantheon_ascendedtransformation_descript: Ascended transformations are <caststrategic></caststrategic> <hyperlink>Race Transformation</hyperlink> that a <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> had when they ascended to the <hyperlink>Pantheon</hyperlink>. The ascended transformations only apply to the Ruler (not their race) when they next appear on a realm.
pantheon_ascended_description:
An ascended Ruler has proven worthy to join the Pantheon and can be selected to appear as either a recruitable Hero or as Ruler.

Ascended Rulers may receive an Ascension Trait and can keep Race Transformation for when they next appear on a realm.
pantheon_ascensiontrait_description: An ascension trait is received by a <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> upon conquering a realm. A Ruler can only have one ascension trait and can choose a trait based on the <hyperlink>Tome</hyperlink> they have unlocked on the realm.
pantheon_ascensiontrait_description_shor: A <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> can have one <hyperlink>Ascension Trait</hyperlink> which empowers them on their next conquest as either a Ruler or <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink>.
pantheon_cheat_noxp: [errorcolor]No XP was rewarded because a cheat was used[/errorcolor]
pantheon_delete_tooltip: Expel this <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> from your <hyperlink>Pantheon</hyperlink>. They will be available in the library or be restored to the custom factions list and remain playable, but lose any <hyperlink>Ascension Trait</hyperlink> and <caststrategic></caststrategic> <hyperlink>Race Transformation</hyperlink>.
pantheon_enable_disable_tooltip: Depending on this setting, this Godir will show up as a recruitable <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> or an AI <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink>.
pantheon_intro_desc:
<hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink> is a sanctuary between worlds. From here, powerful Rulers called <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> venture to realms within the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. 

As you conquer realms, other Godir will gather in Magehaven and join your Pantheon. 
You will also gather Pantheon Experience, which unlocks new options for creating your Godir and their followers. Your Pantheon will tell your story of the Fourth Age of Wonders.

Step through the <hyperlink>World Gate</hyperlink>. Your first adventure awaits!
pantheon_points_desc: Gather Pantheon points to unlock new customization options for your Godir in Magehaven.
pantheon_points_frontend: <eventColor>{PantheonPoints}</eventColor> Pantheon points available. <eventColor>{PantheonXP}</eventColor>/<eventColor>{PantheonXPPerLevel}</eventColor> Pantheon XP for the next point.
pantheon_points_gained_by: Pantheon XP is gained through many actions such as Conquest, forming alliances, unlocking new <hyperlink>Tome</hyperlink>, advancing your <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> and exploring the world.
pantheon_points_limit: If you amass enough Pantheon Points to unlock everything, you will not gain additional Pantheon points as your Pantheon gains levels.
pantheon_points_session: <eventColor>{PantheonPoints}</eventColor> Pantheon points earned in this session so far. <eventColor>{PantheonXP}</eventColor>/<eventColor>{PantheonXPPerLevel}</eventColor> Pantheon XP for the next point.
pantheon_requires_connected: Requires a connected item to be unlocked
personality_ai_tooltip:
The AI personality is an optional setting which determines the personality of a Ruler when you encounter them as an AI controlled Ruler in different sessions. This setting does not affect your empire when you are playing as this Ruler.

The personality affects the choices and behavior of AI Rulers in terms of Diplomacy, Research, Economy, and Military. When using the Default option, the system will pick a personality based on the starting Affinity and Alignment of your custom Ruler when it is AI controlled.
personality_default_tooltip: The default personality makes sure that the system will choose a personality for this <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> automatically when it is AI controlled. Each personality has ties to one or several <hyperlink>Affinity</hyperlink> and may also have a preferred <hyperlink>Alignment</hyperlink>, the combination of these, at the start of a session, determines which personality will be chosen automatically for your ruler if you encounter them as an AI ruler.
personality_hidden_desc: The personality of this ruler is unknown, though it can be discovered through interaction or by triggering their personal preferences.
personality_like_description: Informs how they respond to the actions of other empires
personality_strategy_description: Informs their behavior on the Strategic Map
pillaging_description:
Some locations such as Province Improvement cannot be Razed but can be pillaged instead, granting Resource rewards.
When a province improvement is pillaged it is turned into Ruins.Ruins can be rebuilt at the cost of Gold.Ruins from enemy City can be Annexed to your own.
player_description: A player is a human or AI commanding an <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink> and its <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink>.
player_name_set_description: Your Paradox account does not have an associated social name set up. Please provide your preferred player name to play in multiplayer mode.
player_name_set_fail_already_taken: This name is already taken. Please try another one.
player_trespassing: <eventColor>{HouseBLord.Name}</eventColor> was found trespassing in your domain
player_trespassing_description: You will receive <eventColor>{CasusBelliPoints}</eventColor><casusBelli></casusBelli> for each turn that a Ruler you are not at war with is trespassing in your domain. This can be used to denounce or declare war on that Ruler.
population_buy_tooltip: Instantly increases your <population></population> <hyperlink>Population</hyperlink>. The cost is determined by the number of <turn></turn> turns required to increase the <population></population> population.
population_description:
Population represents the size of a City. It allows the City to build new Province Improvement and expand its Domain.

Population increases with Food income and requires Population Upkeep.
population_upkeep_description:
Each Population in a City costs 3 Food and 5 City Stability.

Negative Food income can lead to Starvation!
preparing_attack_tooltip: The next <hyperlink>Army</hyperlink> from <eventColor>{House.Name}</eventColor> will be ready in <eventColor>{Duration}</eventColor><turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>. If the target is set to None, then the army won't spawn until after a target is selected.
preparing_defense_tooltip: The next defensive <hyperlink>Army</hyperlink> from <eventColor>{House.Name}</eventColor> will be ready in <eventColor>{Duration}</eventColor> <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>. When there are no ongoing wars, the <hyperlink>Freecitytype</hyperlink> can only send out armies to defend specified cities.
prison_description:
When you defeat an enemy Hero in combat, they have a chance of going to your prison or your Crypt.

Heroes in your prison can be granted their freedom to get their equipment and to improve relations with the Free City or Ruler they belong to.

Certain Heroes can never go to the Prison:Free City Lord cannot go to Prison, and will go to the Crypt instead.Marauder Heroes cannot go to Prison, and will go to the Crypt instead.Ruler can never be captured, and will go to the Void instead.
production_queue_description:
Production Queues in City allow for the construction of City Structure and recruitment of Unit.

Production and Draft resources are used up when building the first item in the Production Queue. Items in the queue can be reprioritized after being added.
razing_description:
Army can remove an empire's Domain from a province by razing the Outpost or City at its center. Province Improvement cannot be razed, but can be Pillaged instead.

Razing cities leaves behind ruins which can be rebuilt at the cost of Imperium.
reinforcement_rule_description:
The Reinforcement Rule allows up to 3 friendly Army that are within 3 hexes of a Combat engagement on the World Map to join one of the combatants.

There are exceptions to this rule. Combat while exploring an Ancient Wonder only allows 1 Army to participate on each side. Furthermore, Army in Location such as Infestation Spawner or City under Siege will not join <Combat >> outside of their Location.
release_hero_tooltip: Release this hero from your prison. They will return to their home, improving your relations with <eventColor>{Owner}</eventColor> by <eventColor>{RelationModifier}</eventColor><goodRelation></goodRelation>. This is an act of good, <eventColor>{AlignmentModifier}</eventColor><goodact></goodact>.
release_hero_tooltip_generic: Release this hero from your prison. This is an act of good, <eventColor>{AlignmentModifier}</eventColor><goodact></goodact>.
request_military_aid_description:
This is where you can draft Unit into your empire or to help defend Vassal Cities using Recruitment Point.

The pool of available units consists primarily of units made available to you by loyal City and annexed Ancient Wonder. The number of units available depends on how many Recruitment Points you have available. The units made available by cities will be randomly selected based on the units that city can produce, focusing on higher tier units.

Rallies will be held every 15 Turn and only at that point will the pool of units and the number of points you can spend refresh. You can, however, use a boost to halve the amount of remaining turns once per Rally.
requires_city_tier: Recruitable in cities with Town Hall <<R:<eventColor>{RequiredCityTier}</eventColor>>>
respec_confirm_message: You are about to reset all of this hero's learned skills. Are you sure?
ritual_of_alacrity_description: Units standing on the center of this city or outpost restore 50 <hyperlink>{<hp></hp>}</hyperlink>, 100 <movementgeneral></movementgeneral> <hyperlink>Move Point</hyperlink>, and remove <hyperlink>Exhausted</hyperlink> from <hyperlink>Forced March</hyperlink>. The city or outpost has a 3 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink> cooldown before it can use this again.
ritual_of_alacrity_tooltip:
Players can activate the Ritual of Alacrity on any owned Barbarian Outpost and City.

When activated, friendly Unit on the center of the Outpost or City will restore 50% {}, 100% Move Point, and removes Exhausted from Forced March.
routed_unit: This unit has been routed, but will reappear in a nearby city shortly.
ruler_void_description: When a <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> perishes during battle or otherwise, they will be cast into the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>. If that Ruler still holds their <hyperlink>Throne City</hyperlink>, they will materialize there in 3 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>. If that Ruler has lost their <hyperlink>Throne City</hyperlink>, their <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink> is defeated. While in the Void, the Ruler's empire is in chaos and subject to the following penalties:<bulletlist><bullet>-20 <happiness></happiness> <hyperlink>City Stability</hyperlink> in each city.</bullet><bullet>Governor bonuses are not applied.</bullet><bullet><hyperlink>Research</hyperlink> is paused.</bullet><bullet>No <hyperlink>Spell</hyperlink> can be cast.</bullet><bullet>Active <hyperlink>Magic Victory</hyperlink> spells are canceled and their progress reset.</bullet></bulletlist>
save_prompt_text:
You have made some unsaved progress. Do you want to save your game before exiting?

Your save data will be saved as "{STR_FileName}".
sector_selector: Choose a province <eventColor>{STR_Buttontag}</eventColor> in which to build a <eventColor>{STR_StructureUpgradeName}</eventColor> for <eventColor>{STR_CityName}</eventColor>. This will replace the current upgrade in that province.
select_spell: Select a spell to cast or prepare
sell_equipment_rewards_desc: Disenchanting destroys the equipment rewards in exchange for <bindingessence></bindingessence> Binding Essence and <bindingfragments></bindingfragments> Fragments. Are you sure you want to do this?
sensor_range_description: Sensing Range is the number of hexes within which the presence of <hyperlink>Unit</hyperlink> can be detected in the <hyperlink>Fog of War</hyperlink>.
shadow_shared: Shadow <hyperlink>Affinity</hyperlink> <empireshadow></empireshadow> relates to the realm of death, decay and ice, as well as deception and instilling and exploiting weakness.
shared_opposing_affinity: <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink> or <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> with opposing affinities will suffer relation penalties.
single_army_warning: Can only be entered by 1 <hyperlink>Army</hyperlink> led by a <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink>!
special_province_improvement_description:
Special Province Improvement are built from the Production Queue and replace an existing Province Improvement.

Effects can include:Improved income based on adjacent Province.Army effects in and around the Special Province Improvement.Army spawn points.Army visit bonuses.

Special Province Improvements are unlocked with Tome and cultures.
speed_march: Activate <hyperlink>Forced March</hyperlink>: Units gain <eventColor>{movepoints}</eventColor> of their <movementgeneral></movementgeneral> <hyperlink>Move Point</hyperlink> but lose <eventColor>{hitpoints}</eventColor>% of their current <hyperlink>{<hp></hp>}</hyperlink>. They also become <hyperlink>Exhausted</hyperlink> for <eventColor>{turns}</eventColor> <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>. Forced March costs <eventColor>{cost}</eventColor> <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink> in total.
spell_description: Spell Upkeep is paid each <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink> on the <hyperlink>World Map</hyperlink>. Each spell has its own <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink> upkeep.
spell_overcharge_tooltip: <hyperlink>Combat Spell</hyperlink> may gain overcharge, granting them increased effectiveness based on the type of spell:<bulletlist><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> <hyperlink>Damage Spell</hyperlink> gain +25% damage.</bullet><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> <hyperlink>Healing Spell</hyperlink> gain +25% healing.</bullet><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> <hyperlink>Buff Spell</hyperlink> gain +2 <hyperlink>Bolstered resistance</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> <hyperlink>Debuff Spell</hyperlink> gain +2 <hyperlink>Sundered resistance</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> <hyperlink>Combat Enchantment</hyperlink> allow another spell to be cast that turn.</bullet><bullet><casttactical></casttactical> <hyperlink>Combat Summon Spell</hyperlink> gain +2 <hyperlink>Strengthened</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
stack_in_the_way: Another army is in the way
starting_conditions_easy_description: Start with +50% starting resources and a larger initial army.
starting_conditions_hard_description: Start with +50% starting resources and a smaller initial army.
starting_conditions_normal_description: Start with normal starting resources and a standard initial army.
starvation_description:
When Population Upkeep is higher than Food income, the city's Population will starve.

Starvation leads to Population dying and a Province Improvement leaving the city every 3 << Turn>>
strategic_map_description: The World Map is where <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> are built, <hyperlink>Army</hyperlink> are moved, and <hyperlink>Location</hyperlink> are explored.
structure_queue_description: The Structure Queue is where <hyperlink>City Structure</hyperlink> are built by spending <gold></gold> <hyperlink>Gold</hyperlink> and <structureprod></structureprod> <hyperlink>Production</hyperlink>.
subtracted_weakness: Subtracted from <resistance></resistance> <hyperlink>Resistance</hyperlink> or <defense></defense> <hyperlink>Defense</hyperlink> to calculate damage sustained from <eventColor>{STR_DamageChannelName}</eventColor>.
surplus_description:
Knowledge, Production or Draft that is left over once research, construction or recruitment is completed.

This surplus will automatically be spent on the next item that you choose to research, build or recruit.

Surplus can only be kept for a single Turn
sustained_spells: Your sustained spells with a per turn upkeep
switch_turn_mode_classic: You are currently in Simultaneous Turns mode. Do you want to switch to Classic Turns? (All players will regain their turn in this round.)
switch_turn_mode_simultanious: You are currently in Classic Turns mode. Do you want to switch to Simultaneous Turns?
switch_turn_mode_simultanious_next_round: The turn mode will be changed to Simultaneous Turns in the next round. Do you want to cancel and go back to Classic Turns?
tactical_combat_description:
Combat occurs when an Army encounters an enemy Army, or while exploring Ancient Wonder.

Combat occurs on a separate map and is Turn-based.

With the Reinforcement Rule, up to 6 armies can participate in the battle.

The battle is won by the last combatant that has Unit left.
throne_city_description: Your Throne City is the capital of your <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink>. Losing it and your <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> simultaneously ends your <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink>.
throne_city_tooltip_missing: The <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> does not have a <throne></throne> <hyperlink>Throne City</hyperlink>. They will be defeated if their leader dies while not having a throne city to return to.
throne_city_tooltip_notdiscovered: You have not yet discovered the location of the <throne></throne> <hyperlink>Throne City</hyperlink> belonging to this <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink>.
tome_description:
A Tome is a collection of Spell, Unit and other skills that you can Research. Tomes also have initial bonuses you get for free.

Tier 1 tomes are always available, to unlock higher tier tomes:Research 2 Tomes of any tier.Tier 3 tomes require you to have 3 points of a single Affinity.Tier 4 tomes require you to have 6 points of a single Affinity.Tier 5 Tomes require you to have 8 points of a single Affinity.
Tomes can contain:SpellUnitSpecial Province ImprovementCity StructureSiege Project
tooltip: Tooltip
tooltip_description: Well done! Use this useful feature to learn about concepts and systems as you go. You can string together tooltips endlessly, however older ones will close as you go <hyperlink>deeper</hyperlink>.
too_far_to_annex: The province is too far away to annex.
too_few_chars: The text must contain at least 1 character.
too_many_chars: The text contains too many characters!
trade_away_casus_belli: The Ruler trading away the <casusBelli></casusBelli> <hyperlink>Grievance</hyperlink> receives an Alignment modifier:
trade_colony: This is a city. Trading it will transfer the following provinces:
trade_sector: Trading this province will instantly transfer ownership to the receiving Ruler. Trading will only succeed if the province is not occupied or being razed. Any units residing on the province center that belong to the previous owner will be moved away.
turn_description:
The unit of time in which Player carry out all of their actions.

On the World Map, turns take the form of either Classic Turn or Simultaneous Turn.

Turns during Combat are taken one Player after another.
turn_mode_changed_classic: <eventColor>{STR_Username}</eventColor> changed the turn mode to: Classic Turns
turn_mode_changed_simultaneous: <eventColor>{STR_Username}</eventColor> changed the turn mode to: Simultaneous Turns
turn_mode_changing: (Change will be applied on next round.)
underground_description: The layer of the <hyperlink>World Map</hyperlink> that can be accessed with Underground Passages.
units_can_act: You still have units that can act. If you end turn now, they will enter <hyperlink>Defense Mode</hyperlink>.
unit_description:
Units are the forces that make up your Army.

Units can explore the World Map and engage in Combat.

Can be recruited in City or summoned using Spell.

Units require Gold or Mana upkeep each Turn.
unit_upgrade_upkeep_description: Each <caststrategic></caststrategic> <hyperlink>Unit Enchantment</hyperlink> has its own upkeep cost in <gold></gold> <hyperlink>Gold</hyperlink> and <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink> which is added to the <hyperlink>Unit Upkeep</hyperlink> of each <hyperlink>Unit</hyperlink> that is using it.
unit_upkeep_description:
Each Turn on the World Map, you must pay Gold and Mana to maintain your Unit. High tier units also require Imperium. If you cannot afford this, your units will lose Morale!

A unit's upkeep depends on: Unit tier Unit Enchantment
Some Empire Skills and Hero Skills can reduce the Gold and Mana upkeep, but never below 50% of its value.
vassal_income_tooltip: The income you receive from your vassal depends on their resources and the state of your relations with them. Improving your relations with the <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> will increase how much they are willing to share with you.
vassal_team_description:
One player in each team is the Overlord, while the other players are his Vassals. The overlord has control over diplomacy, and vassals may not leave the team without their permission.

A player can be assigned as Overlord in the settings menu.
viability_description:
Viability describes how likely it is for a Ruler to complete the Bounty objective.
Other Rulers may not be at war with you if they want to accept the bounty. They must also have met the target Ruler or Free City, and AI controlled Rulers must be at war with the target.

For AI controlled Rulers, their army power and proximity to the target are also taken into account, as well as how strongly the target is defended. The viability also influences the chances of AI controlled Rulers accepting the bounty.
vision_range_description: Vision Range is the number of hexes that remove <hyperlink>Fog of War</hyperlink>.
war_coordination_pve_tooltip_target: Select the targeting mode for when the <hyperlink>Freecitytype</hyperlink> sends out an army to attack.
war_coordination_pve_tooltip_target_auto: The <hyperlink>Freecitytype</hyperlink> will automatically select the closest <hyperlink>Ruler</hyperlink> and send out armies to attack them.
war_coordination_pve_tooltip_target_defe: The <hyperlink>Freecitytype</hyperlink> will send armies to the location and defend it against hostile armies.

description:
Cities belonging to players of the Feudal Aristocracy subculture gain an associated House.
The Governor becomes the Liege lord of that city's House.Units produced in that City gain that City's House, gaining reduced upkeep and increased health regeneration while in their Liege lord's army.Units belonging to the house additionally gain a powerful boost in combat while in the army of their Liege lord.These benefits increase based on the Liege lord's Renown Level.In addition, when the Liege lord gains Renown, the units belonging to their house gain a small amount of Experience.

Units summoned on the Strategic Map or gained through events join the house of the most powerful nearby friendly army.
Units recruited through Rally of the Lieges gain the House of the City they're recruited to.

When a Governor is first assigned to a City, you may choose the House's name and banner.
This can be edited at any time in the same manner one changes the city's name, by clicking the name in the city panel.

description:
Infusions are individual improvements that can be put on created items in the Item Forge. These can be Passive Properties, Active Abilities or Damage Channels.

An Infusion has an Infusion Point cost, which increases the cost to forge that item.

Each Infusion after the first also increases the total price of forging the item by 20%.
name: Infusion

description:
Every Infusion has a specific Infusion Point cost ranging from 1 to 5. Normally an item can have no more than 5 Infusion Points.

The Infusion Point total determines the Item Tier as follows:Item Tier I: 1 or 2 Infusion PointsItem Tier II: 3 Infusion PointsItem Tier III: 4 Infusion PointsItem Tier IV: 5+ Infusion Points
name: Infusion Point

description:
The Item Forge is used to create new custom hero items. Forging items costs Binding Fragments, Gold, and time. Only a single item can be forged at a time.

The cost and time to forge an item depend on the amount of Infusion Point used to forge the item. The amount of Infusion also increases the cost.

The Infusions available are dependent on the types of Magic Material that you have collected. Collecting more of the same Magic Material will unlock more powerful Infusions.

The Item Forge can be build in your Wizard Tower.
description_short: The Item Forge is used to create new custom hero items.
name: Item Forge

description:
An item's tier is an indication of its power. The damage of Primary Weapons increases with each tier based on what type of weapon it is.

In the Item Forge, the item tier is determined by the amount of Infusion.
name: Item Tier

If a City has a Wall Structure and you wish to conquer it, you first need to besiege it and breach its defenses.

A Siege can be initiated by attacking any of the 7 City hexes with at least 1 Army led by a Hero which must remain adjacent to the city until the siege is completed or else the Siege is lifted.

While sieging the City's Fortification Health is lowered by the besieger's Fortification Damage.

Siege Project can be used to speed up the siege by dealing more Fortification Damage. They can also remove defenses and give the besieger an advantage.

Once Fortification Health reaches 0, the attacker can move into the City for a decisive battle.
name: Siege

description:
Siege Projects can be used during a Siege to speed up the siege by adding more Fortification Damage. They can also remove defenses and give the besieger an advantage.

Siege Projects can only be added and removed in the Turn the Siege was initiated.

You can only have as many siege projects added as you can have slots. More slots can be gained through Empire Skill.
name: Siege Project

subtitle: This realm's connection to the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> is unusually strong. Mana seeps into everything on this realm, allowing incredible feats of spellweaving otherwise impossible.
A realm that long ago lost most of its water, plagued by sandstorms, yet blessed with plentiful mana-retaining crystals.

This realm prohibits the forming of interconnected empires, instead great city states dominate. The local free houses are powerful and prideful, but contribute much to those that earn their allegiance.

A once vibrant realm, condemned to eternal decay by an unspeakable evil. Though the condemnation is long forgotten, the scars are still as apparent in the land, as they are in the eternally restless undead.
This Realm's hostile surface forces prospective empires into its cavernous underground.

One of the many realms of <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink>, dominated by a cruel and powerful Demonic Prince. Few are foolish or ambitious enough to aspire claiming such a hostile realm, yet those few still come.
Once the opulent kingdom known as Vossin dominated this realm. Now only ruins remain as three brothers squabble over its remains and the people suffer.

race_bio:
Darman Voss is the rightful heir according to many, a weakling not worth following according to others. He refused to act when his brother Skogan split from the Kingdom, further fracturing the kingdom as Jarlan went to extreme measures to reunite it. He is a diplomat at heart, seeking peace at any cost, many would think him weak for this, yet the lives of his subjects are prosperous and stable in spite of the kingdom's fracturing.

His Loyalists are a people of principles, lawful to a fault and eager to serve.

Jarlan Voss, second son of the late king, had no aspiration to rule, but as the kingdom split and his brother refused to take up arms, he took action instead. He was exiled, and now he leads a people seeking the rebirth of Vossin against both his brothers. Jarlan is a warrior through and through, and he vows to not rest until Vossin is whole once more.

Jarlan's Secessionists consist of much of the warrior class of old Vossin. Hardy and dedicated to the cause, they believe in might over diplomatic prattle.

Skogan Voss, bastard son of the late king, was shunned by many, but made a name for himself as a powerful healer. He came to lead a faction of devoted healers, but unknown to many he had bigger plans. He would seize his father's kingdom and turn it toward a singular purpose: Ascension. When the time came however, his influence was not as effective as he'd hoped. The secession of the provinces where he held the most sway plunged the kingdom into chaos, now he seeks to reunite the kingdom under his own rule and complete his plan.

Skogan's Fanatics consist of his devout followers, healers, covert agents and ambitious warriors. Each of the Fanatics sees themselves as eventually usurping the position above them, yet direct violence is prohibited, thus schemes and plots are plentiful in their domain.

description: Beasts and monsters never cease nesting in this realm.<bulletlist><bullet><hyperlink>Infestation</hyperlink> emerge in unoccupied <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> every 10 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>

This realm has seen brutal conflict in the past.<bulletlist><bullet><minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Rare[/abilityblue].</bullet><bullet><hyperlink>City Ruin</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Common[/abilityblue].</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Ruined Realm

combat_property_description: At the end of the attacker's <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>:<bulletlist><bullet>60% base chance for units of suffering <hyperlink>Blinded</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
display_description: Units in this <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> suffer:<bulletlist><bullet><hyperlink>Sandstorms unit property</hyperlink></bullet><bullet><hyperlink>Combatproperty sandstorm</hyperlink> in combat</bullet></bulletlist>
unit_property_description: This unit is in a sandstorm and subject to the following:<bulletlist><bullet>This unit <hyperlink>Cannot regenerate</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>This unit suffers -2 <hyperlink>Vision Range</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>This unit gains <hyperlink>Universal camouflage</hyperlink></bullet></bulletlist>

description: This realm suffered a great scarring in the past, marking it with death and dividing the land.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of two massive landmasses separated by an uninhabitable, desolate ocean.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Scarred Divide

description: This realm's climate is marked by scorching heat.<bulletlist><bullet>Desolate <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Common[/abilityblue].</bullet><bullet>Arctic, Temperate and Highlands <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Absent[/abilityblue].</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Scorched Climate

description: This realm consists of one large landmass pocked with lakes of lava.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm features a single massive landmass.</bullet><bullet>This realm features lakes of lava.</bullet><bullet>Each <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink> shares a single landmass.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Lava Lakes

description: The heat in this realm's Deserts and Desolation is as infamous as it is withering.<bulletlist><bullet>A [abilityred]Scorching Heat[/abilityred] is present in [abilityred]Desert[/abilityred], [abilityred]Desolate[/abilityred], and [abilityred]Lava[/abilityred] provinces.</bullet><bullet>Units in these provinces suffer -2<defensefire></defensefire> <hyperlink>Fire Protection</hyperlink>, gain +2<defensefrost></defensefrost> <hyperlink>Frost Protection</hyperlink>, and cannot heal outside of combat.</bullet><bullet>[abilityred]Scorching Heat[/abilityred]: each turn during Tactical combat, each unit has a base 30% chance of suffering <hyperlink>Burning</hyperlink> for 3<turn></turn> turns.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Scorching Heat HIDE
property_description: This unit is in a province suffering [abilityred]Scorching Heat[/abilityred] and suffers -2<firedefense></firedefense> while gaining +2<frostdefense></frostdefense>

description: An Astral ruler known only as "the Librarian" rules an empire on this realm.<bulletlist><bullet>The Librarian <hyperlink>The librarian leader</hyperlink> starts with powerful Astral Skills.</bullet><bullet><hyperlink>The librarian leader</hyperlink> starts with +1 additional <hyperlink>City</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet><hyperlink>The librarian leader</hyperlink> gains accelerated <hyperlink>Research</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Whoever defeats <hyperlink>The librarian leader</hyperlink> is [abilityblue]Victorious<abilityblue></abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: The Librarian

description: Lethal Thunderstorms ravage this realm.<bulletlist><bullet>[abilityred]Thunderstorms[/abilityred] occur during Tactical Combat.</bullet><bullet>[abilityred]Thunderstorm[/abilityred]: each turn, 1–3 random units take 20 <damageLightning></damageLightning> <hyperlink>Lightning Damage</hyperlink> and each unit on the battlefield suffers <hyperlink>Wet</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Thunderstorms

description: The realm is a tropical paradise, with golden sands, rolling jungles, and the occasional swamp.<bulletlist><bullet>Tropical, swamp, and forest <hyperlink>Province Feature</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Common[/abilityblue].</bullet><bullet>Arctic, desert, and desolate <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Rare[/abilityblue].</bullet><bullet>Blossom Orchard <hyperlink>Resource Node</hyperlink> and Prestigious Statue <hyperlink>Pickup</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Abundant.[/abilityblue]</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Tropical Realm

description: The affinities blur and blend on this realm, allowing access to tomes otherwise restricted.<bulletlist><bullet><hyperlink>Tome</hyperlink> have no <hyperlink>Affinity</hyperlink> requirements.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Unbound Tomes

description: Civilization only thrives underground on this realm, forcing the throne cities of each empire underground.<bulletlist><bullet>Each <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink> starts <hyperlink>Underground</hyperlink>, regardless of any adaptation traits.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Underground Start

description: This realm is awash with Astral power, and spells flow freely without limit, though they require more mana to channel.<bulletlist><bullet>Can now cast multiple <hyperlink>Combat Spell</hyperlink> per <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet><hyperlink>Combat Spell</hyperlink> cost 200% more <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink> to cast.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Unlimited Power

description: A land-dominated realm divided in two by an impassible void.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of two massive landmasses separated by Astral Void.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Void Divide

description: This realm is crumbling into the Astral Void.
name: Void Oceans

description: This realm is dominated by a single, enormous connected landmass surrounded by Astral Void on all sides.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm consists of a single massive landmass surrounded by impassable Astral Void.</bullet><bullet>Each <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink> shares a single landmass.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Void Pangea

description: This realm consists one large landmass pocked with impassible void.<bulletlist><bullet>This realm features a single massive landmass.</bullet><bullet>This realm features lakes of Astral Void.</bullet><bullet>Each <hyperlink>Empire</hyperlink> shares a single landmass.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Void Pockets

combat_property_description: Every 2 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>, a marker is placed. Then, after 1 <turn></turn> the ground will erupt and units within 1 <range></range> of the marker will suffer 10 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> <hyperlink>Physical Damage</hyperlink> and 10 <damageFire></damageFire> <hyperlink>Fire Damage</hyperlink>. Random affected hexes will gain <hyperlink>On Fire</hyperlink>.
description: Volcanic activity rages beneath this realm's desolate regions.<bulletlist><bullet>All surface combat in desolate <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> is affected by <hyperlink>Combatproperty volcanic eruption</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Units in desolate <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> suffer <hyperlink>Volcanic heat unit property</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>
display_description: Units in this <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> suffer:<bulletlist><bullet><hyperlink>Volcanic heat unit property</hyperlink></bullet><bullet><hyperlink>Combatproperty volcanic eruption</hyperlink> in combat</bullet></bulletlist>
marker_description: When this expires, the ground will erupt and units within 1 <range></range> will suffer 10 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> <hyperlink>Physical Damage</hyperlink> and 10 <damageFire></damageFire> <hyperlink>Fire Damage</hyperlink>. The target hexes will gain <hyperlink>On Fire</hyperlink>.
name: Volcanic Eruptions
unit_property_description: This unit is in a province affected by volcanic activity and subject to the following:<bulletlist><bullet>This unit <hyperlink>Cannot regenerate</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>This unit suffers -3 <defensefire></defensefire> <hyperlink>Fire Protection</hyperlink>, but gains +3 <defensefrost></defensefrost> <hyperlink>Frost Protection</hyperlink>.</bullet></bulletlist>

description: This realm is in an unnatural state of flux, warping and transforming constantly.<bulletlist><bullet>Each strategic <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turn</hyperlink>, all unowned surface provinces have a small chance of transforming their <hyperlink>Province Feature</hyperlink> to new ones.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Warping Wilds

description: Wild animals are common on this realm, replacing all other infestations and Ancient Wonders.<bulletlist><bullet><hyperlink>Animal</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Unit</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Common[/abilityblue].</bullet><bullet><hyperlink>Animal</hyperlink> <hyperlink>Infestation</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Common[/abilityblue].</bullet><bullet>Constructed <hyperlink>Ancient Wonder</hyperlink> such as Ziggurats are [abilityblue]Rare[/abilityblue].</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Wildlands

description: Due to the rich past of this realm, there are many Ancient Wonders present.<bulletlist><bullet><hyperlink>Ancient Wonder</hyperlink> are [abilityblue]Common<abilityblue></abilityblue>.</bullet></bulletlist>
name: Wondrous Past

description: This realm is shaken by cosmic events, from altered Astral Flows to misaligned stars.
name: Cosmic Happenings

description: This realm is affected by the "Toll of Seasons," where mysterious Fey folk emerge from the mists to attack the cities of the unwary.
name: Toll of Seasons

description: In this realm, intrigue and skulduggery are rampant. A diverse set of Rulers will increase the chance of occurrence.
name: Intrigue Happenings

description: Lost souls wander this realm. Either cursed or driven by unfinished business, they seek help.
name: Lost Souls

description: The content can appear in this realm.
name: Automatic

description: The content will be blocked in this realm.
name: Never

description: The content will be prioritized, giving it a much higher chance of appearing in this realm.
name: Prioritized

description: The roads of this realm are often traveled by Wandering Merchants, offering exotic mounts, valuable information, and even the services of a martial trainer.
name: Wandering Merchants

description: These people are Followers of Astral. They have begun to unravel the mysteries of the arcane. They use creatures from the Astral Sea and devices to empower their spellcasting.
name: Followers of Astral

description: These people are Initiates of Astral. They have learned to use basic spells and enchantments to bolster their armies.
name: Initiates of Astral

description: These people are Masters of Astral. They have discovered the secrets of the cosmos. They can manipulate time and space and use advanced spells to manipulate the flow of magic.
name: Masters of Astral

description: These are the Masters of Beasts. They have formed a strong connection with the animals of the world, and most of their residents are powerful and ferocious beasts.
name: Masters of Beasts

description: These people are Followers of Chaos. They commune with mischievous demons and seek the greatest pleasures in life and on the battlefield.
name: Followers of Chaos

description: These people are Initiates of Chaos. They wield uncontrollable fire and aim to subjugate their enemies.
name: Initiates of Chaos

description: These people are Masters of Chaos. They call on demonic powers to serve them and practice vile magic that breaks the minds of men and beast alike.
name: Masters of Chaos

description: These are the Masters of Creation, Giants and their cousins who helped shape the world and have a strong connection to the earth.
name: Masters of Creation

description: These are the Masters of Demons. They bend demons to their will and call upon cruel infernal powers to fulfill their desires.
name: Masters of Demons

description: These are the Masters of the Ethereal. They see the world differently than most, peering into a realm beyond, where the living, dead, and otherworldly beings mingle.
name: Masters of the Ethereal

description: These are the Masters of Flora. They have become of one mind with the trees and their spreading roots. Entire forests come to life to protect the lands of these people.
name: Masters of Flora

description: These are the Masters of Frost. They thrive in the cold where others would freeze to death. They have mastery over frost magic, and among them are many creature of the cold.
name: Masters of Frost

description: These people are Followers of Materium. They create wondrous buildings and use their magical control of the physical forces of the world to enhance their equipment and manipulate the world.
name: Followers of Materium

description: These people are Initiates of Materium. They craft warriors to fight for them and imbue their weapons and armor with magical enchantments.
name: Initiates of Materium

description: These people are Masters of Materium. They value material wealth above all else. They can transmute the physical world to their liking, from creating gold for their own to boiling magma for their enemies.
name: Masters of Materium

description: These people are Followers of Nature. They are able to control the forests and fields and borrow the aid of magical forest creatures.
name: Followers of Nature

description: These people are Initiates of Nature. They learned to work and live together with the animals and plants of Mother Nature.
name: Initiates of Nature

description: Being Masters of Nature, the roots of 0000049300000706 run deep through the nearby forests. It is said that once per year the citizens leave their homes and travel the realm, tending to the life of the forests as a form of pilgrimage.
name: Masters of Nature

description: These are the Masters of Necromancy. They have overcome death itself and become undead. They use armies of the dead and dark magic to overwhelm their foes.
name: Masters of Necromancy

description: These people are Followers of Order. They follow their laws to the letter. They seek to spread their beliefs and hunt down any who dare oppose them.
name: Followers of Order

description: These people are Initiates of Order. They organize themselves according to their beliefs to stand strong together.
name: Initiates of Order

description: These people are Masters of Order. Their word is law, to be followed as a divine mandate. The heavens bless them, while they inspire awe in any who do not follow them.
name: Masters of Order

description: These people are Followers of Shadow. They are experts in molding flesh and bone to their will. They cause dread and fear to those who oppose them.
name: Followers of Shadow

description: These people are Initiates of Shadow. They dabble in the dark side of magic. They can often raise the Undead or cast frost spells.
name: Initiates of Shadow

description: These people are Masters of Shadow. They have transformed themselves to gain newfound powers. Their mastery over Shadow grants them powerful magic that can either kill you, or remove you from this plane altogether.
name: Masters of Shadow

description: Determines how many Guild structures a City may build.
name: Guild Slot

name: Astral Root Node

name: Fishing Ground

description: A large vein of valuable gold.
name: Gold Vein

description: A rich vein full of iron.
name: Iron Deposit

description: Magical currents converge at this location.
name: Mana Node

description: This Root Node has been converted to the <matter></matter> <hyperlink>Materium Affinity</hyperlink> and is overflowing with power. It will contribute to Magic Victory.
name: Materium Root Node

description: This Root Node has been converted to the <nature></nature> <hyperlink>Nature Affinity</hyperlink> and is overflowing with power. It will contribute to Magic Victory.
name: Nature Root Node

A lush oasis full of nutritious food.
name: Oasis

description: This Root Node has been converted to the <order></order> <hyperlink>Order Affinity</hyperlink> and is overflowing with power. It will contribute to Magic Victory.
name: Order Root Node

description: A bloom of valuable pearls.
name: Pearl Reef

description: Roaming herds on lush fields.
name: Pastures

description:
A Root Node is a Location where the magical flows of the realm converge into a single source of power.

Root Nodes can be converted to an Affinity through a World Spell. Converted Root Nodes give additional resources and contribute to the Magic Victory.
lore: As a Godir's might grows, they begin to gain an almost innate understanding and attunement to places of powerful resonance. Root Nodes are physically manifest confluences of ambient magic present throughout the land. The mightiest of Godir can sense these locations and even manipulate and alter the latent magics therein to reflect their own affinities.
name: Root Node

description:
Requires this location to be within your Domain or occupied by one of your Unit. Replaces this ruined node with a , providing income and bonuses again.

The cost of this action decreases per Turn till it reaches a minimum cost.
name: Restore Node

description: This Root Node has been converted to the <shadow></shadow> <hyperlink>Shadow Affinity</hyperlink> and is overflowing with power. It will contribute to Magic Victory.
name: Shadow Root Node

description: Now that you have claimed this <hyperlink>Ancient Wonder</hyperlink>, you can add it to your domain by annexing it to a City. If you have no city nearby, you can found an <hyperlink>Outpost</hyperlink> in an adjacent sector and annex it with that.
instruction: Ancient Wonders provide unique units to the <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink> as well as large amounts of resource income, including valuable <influence></influence> <hyperlink>Imperium</hyperlink>, when they are added to your empire.
name: Ancient Wonder Annexation

description: You have annexed an <hyperlink>Ancient Wonder</hyperlink> which will now provide you with a powerful yield in one of your <hyperlink>City</hyperlink>.

The domain of one of your cities has expanded to a coastline. Provinces in the water can be annexed like any other province, and the first Province Improvement built in the water will automatically become that city's harbor. The harbor of a city is the location where any new ships that are built in that city will appear. Expanding your city onto the water will unlock further city structures.
name: Rule the Seas

description: You have found a friendly free city! Now that you have established contact, you may provide them with a <whisperingStone></whisperingStone> <hyperlink>Whispering Stones</hyperlink>. This artifact will sway their relation with you over time, until they are ready to become your vassal.
name: Negotiating with Free Cities

description: You have found a friendly <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink>! Now that you have established contact, you may investigate them and decide how to negotiate.
instruction:
If you have a Whispering Stones, you can give one to them. Otherwise, your culture may provide you with other ways to gain Allegiance over them.

Once enough Allegiance is gained, the Free City will become your Vassal, and they can be integrated. This will turn them into a fully functional city under your direct control.

Be mindful of your City Cap to evaluate whether you want to integrate a free city or keep them as a vassal!

description:
Now that you have a second scout, you will need more powerful armies to claim the valuable locations you may come across in the realm. You can gain access to new kinds of units through research and upgrading your cities.
Bear in mind, Scouts are not meant for combat, so build your Army wisely.
name: Making a Full Army

description: Now that you have a sufficient army, you are ready to expand and conquer. Armies are expensive, so put them to good use. Send them out with a <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> to gain <hyperlink><xp></xp> Experience</hyperlink> and discover new <hyperlink>Resource Node</hyperlink> or potential <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> locations.
description_2: Don't forget to build more units. As your empire grows, you will need more armies and it's a good idea to start building them early!

description: You are about to begin exploring your surroundings. While the wide world holds plenty of things to find, two of the most valuable places you can come across are <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> and <hyperlink>Ancient Wonder</hyperlink>.
name: Exploration

description: You have discovered an <hyperlink>Ancient Wonder</hyperlink>! It now needs to be explored before it can be claimed. Only armies led by a <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> can explore Ancient Wonders. While exploring, you can encounter obstacles which can be overcome in various ways, though they can always be cleared through <hyperlink>Combat</hyperlink>.
name: Ancient Wonder Exploration

description: Ancient Wonders are some of the most valuable locations that can be found in a realm. There are three different tiers of Ancient Wonders; bronze, silver and gold. The higher the tier of an Ancient Wonder, the more challenging it will be to claim for your own.
name: The Ancient Wonders

description: In order for your cities to grow large and prosperous, it is key that they have enough food income for healthy population growth. To expand on a city's food income, you can build farms in surrounding provinces and build city structures that provide food income.
name: A Healthy City

description:
Your new Outpost is finished! You can turn it into another city by spending Imperium.

Cities develop over time and are the main source of income for your empire.

Be mindful of your City Cap however, as going over this cap will reduce the income of all your cities.
name: A New City
summary: Tutorial about founding cities from outposts

description: Congratulations, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>! Your new city is finished and can start growing. Be aware that <food></food> <hyperlink>Food</hyperlink>, <structureprod></structureprod> <hyperlink>Production</hyperlink>, and <unitprod></unitprod> <hyperlink>Draft</hyperlink> are not shared across cities, so each city is responsible for its own growth and construction.
instruction: If you already have a second <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink>, you can assign this hero to be your city's new <hyperlink>Governor</hyperlink>, granting it extra bonuses.

description: Infestations are dangerous locations which will continue to send armies your way, burning and pillaging your realm... unless you strike first, of course.
name: The First Infestation

description:
You have established your first contact! Once enough Allegiance is gained with a Free City and they have become your Vassal, they can be integrated.

Integrating a free city will turn them into a fully functional city under your direct control. Be mindful of your City Cap to evaluate whether you want to integrate a free city or keep them as a vassal!
name: Vassal Integration

description:
A Free City has successfully been integrated into your Empire, granting you complete control over its resources and production.

If the city is of a different race to your own, you will be able to build that race's units. You can also migrate the city to your own race in the City Information screen. This is an Evil act, however.

Once enough Allegiance is gained with a Free City and they have become your Vassal, they can be integrated.

Integrating a free city will turn them into a fully functional city under your direct control. Be mindful of your City Cap to evaluate whether you want to integrate a free city or keep them as a vassal!

Heroes are powerful units just like your Ruler. An army can contain multiple heroes, but be mindful that support hero skills which affect the whole army will only be given to the units of that army by the hero that is the army leader. The highest level of hero will always be the army leader.
name: Worthy Hero

description: Once your Ruler gains enough experience, they will level up. Each time they level up, you may pick a single hero skill in either Warfare, Battle Magic or Support. Every five levels your hero may choose a signature hero skill. These are powerful abilities unique to heroes that can turn the tide in combat and will permanently alter the affinity of that hero.
name: Lead by Example

description: Not all <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> you may come across will belong to your opponents. <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> are small neutral factions that can be vassalized, integrated, or conquered. Speed is of the essence, as once a <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> swears an <hyperlink><allegiance></allegiance>Allegiance</hyperlink>, it becomes impossible to convince them to join you instead. A vassalized city will provide units for your <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink>.
name: The First Free City

description: You can select multiple armies at once, allowing you to move them in groups.
instructions:
Select an army you own.Use SHIFT+ to select another army you own.Use to move the first army.The second army will move to get as close as it can to the first.
You can select up to 6 armies in this way.
instructions_controller:
Select an army you own.Use to select another army you own.When you move the first army, the second army will move to get as close as it can to the first.
You can select up to 6 armies in this way.
summary: Tutorial on moving multiple armies at once.
title: Selecting Multiple Armies

description: You have managed to defeat your first infestation! Infestations are often found near <hyperlink>Resource Node</hyperlink>, so they are good places to put <hyperlink>Outpost</hyperlink>.
description_2: Once built, your Outpost can be upgraded into a new <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> by spending <influence></influence> <hyperlink>Imperium</hyperlink>.
instruction:
Outposts can be used to Claim nearby provinces, and can collect resources from Resource Nodes in their domain.

You need a Hero to construct an Outpost in a province.
instruction_2: Cities can also make use of <food></food> <hyperlink>Food</hyperlink>, <structureprod></structureprod> <hyperlink>Production</hyperlink>, and <unitprod></unitprod> <hyperlink>Draft</hyperlink>, unlike Outposts which can only collect <gold></gold> <hyperlink>Gold</hyperlink>, <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink> and <knowledge></knowledge> <hyperlink>Knowledge</hyperlink>.
name: Expansion through Outposts

description: The arcane research of your empire is struggling. If we wish to unlock more tomes of power and the spells they contain, we should invest in building structures in our cities that yield knowledge income.
name: More Knowledge Required

description: As is often the case, knowledge is power. To gather information on your surroundings, scouts are of utmost importance due to their speed and vision range. Without them your rivals might find and claim valuable locations before you do!
name: Preparing to Scout

description: Now that you have a second scout and a sufficient army, you are ready to expand and conquer. Armies are expensive, so put them to good use. Send them out with a <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> to gain <hyperlink><xp></xp> Experience</hyperlink> and discover new <hyperlink>Resource Node</hyperlink> or potential <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> locations.
name: Expand and Conquer

description: Your armies need purpose to pay for their upkeep. The common usage for armies during peace times is clearing of Marauder Guards and Infestations around your Empire.
title: To Battle

description: One of your tomes of magic contains a powerful new spell capable of transforming your people. These spells will add powerful bonuses to your people as well as alter how they look. There are both minor and major transformations. A race can have multiple minor transformations, though some cannot be combined with others. A race can only ever have one major transformation.
name: Transformative

description: The speed of turning a free city into your vassal can be boosted by spending Imperium. This can be useful should another empire compete with you in gaining their allegiance. description:
There are many paths to victory in this realm, but they all need the right strategy. You can expand your empire far and wide to become the dominant power within the realm, use magic to bend the very land to your will, or use force and military prowess to crush all those who stand in your way.

Evaluate your progress to victory by tracking a victory condition through the quest panel on the top-left.
