description:
Great choice, {PlayerLeader.Title}! You have chosen a victory condition which will guide you towards success!
You can always change strategies when necessary.

negative: "Starting a war with <eventColor>{House.Name}</eventColor> will be your undoing, and I will watch with pleasure as your armies are eradicated."
neutral: "A war with <eventColor>{House.Name}</eventColor> is not something to be taken lightly. Take caution with your current path."
positive: "<eventColor>{House.Name}</eventColor> deserves to be eradicated from the surface of this world. Good luck on your quest."

negative: "Enjoy your victory while it lasts. You will be the next to fall."
neutral: "Your annihilation of <eventColor>{Player.Name}</eventColor> will not be without consequences."
positive: "Well done! <eventColor>{Player.Name}</eventColor>'s empire is defeated. This brings us both a step closer to claiming victory."

negative: "Hah, you may be the rising star now, but it won't last. Sooner or later, my empire will rise above all!"
neutral: "You are at the top now, but can you maintain your current stature?"
positive: "You are proving to be a wise leader, the <eventColor>{Player.Race}</eventColor> are fortunate to be led by one such as you!"

negative: "We have heard nothing of importance about you for some time. I have a feeling that you're staying quiet to further your nefarious plans."
neutral: "The rest of the world has not heard of your actions for a while. This silence can either be good or bad."
positive: "I haven't heard anything about your accomplishments in a while. Hopefully you are doing well in your efforts to grow your empire so we may rise from the ruins together."

negative: "You think befriending <eventColor>{House.Name}</eventColor> will help secure your path to victory? It will be my empire that rises above all."
neutral: "Improving your relations with <eventColor>{House.Name}</eventColor> may lead to short term gains. Sustaining those relations, however... Can you trust them?"
positive: "Good, a diplomatic approach will assure victory. I hope that we may both profit from your relation with <eventColor>{House.Name}</eventColor>."

negative: "We've been keeping track of your capability rankings; you are the most pathetic Ruler, and that is how it should be."
neutral: "You are at the bottom of the capability rankings now. It's your choice to live with that or rise above it."
positive: "Don't give up yet! This isn't over—you could still rise in the ranks of this world."

event: The game will end in 2 rounds. The Ruler with the highest score will achieve victory!

description:
The Empire with the highest score when the turn limit is reached is victorious.

There are 5 categories which influence your score: Military, Diplomacy, Economy, Expansion and Research. How well you do in each category compared to the other Ruler is what determines your overall score ranking. This is dependent on many variables, these are some examples:Military: Draft income, army power, and killing enemies.Diplomacy: Having allies and Vassal, avoid wars, and don’t cause Grievance.Expansion: Amount of City and Food income.Research: Knowledge and Mana income.Economy: Gold and Production income.
name: Score Victory

description:
A gathering of eldritch creatures from the Astral Sea has claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.
lore: Hosts of otherworldly foes have managed to break through in places where the veil between our world and the Astral Sea is weak or has been ruptured. Eerie battle cries and strange magics fill the air as this tide of danger washes onto the shores of our reality. Should such rifts be left unchecked, these foes may sweep through our lands without mercy.
name: Astral Rift

description:
A band of bloodthirsty brigands has claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.
lore: Few know what drives the hearts of mortals. Oft it is greed, valor, or simply hunger. When the common cause grows large enough, men and women of like minds will find each other in secret places. Smoke from campfires and makeshift forges drifts among shoddy tents and huts of these haphazard armies. It is from here that they assault the surrounding lands with relentless impunity.
name: Brigand Camp

description:
A flock of dangerous birds has claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.
lore: Feathers, bones, and baubles litter the nesting grounds of these gigantic kings and queens of the sky. The sound of hungrily consumed flesh and bone, interspersed with loud chirping and monstrous squawks, carries over the nests of these avian behemoths. Oftentimes their presence is so potent that lesser beings will join their flock, raiding the surrounding areas for gifts, food, and other forms of tribute.
name: Great Bird Nest

description:
A cabal of crazed cultists has claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.
lore: Eerie otherworldly shrieks mingle with the terrified whimpers of sacrificial victims-to-be. A cloud of oily smoke from hundreds of ritual candles blankets the area. Here, dark summoners invoke creatures from distant worlds and send them out to wreak havoc on the lands beyond.
name: Ritual Circle

description:
A flight of mighty dragons has claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.
lore: A dragon's nest is a sight that instills terror, awe... and many similar feelings one might have when in the presence of something deep and primal. Whether the inhabitant of the nest is an ancient dragon, born in the age of giants, or a younger wyvern, denizens of the surrounding lands should beware. Or better yet, flee...
name: Dragon's Lair

description:
Nautical horrors have claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion parties.
lore: Shanties warn of the Forsaken Cove, where monsters lurk beneath the waves and sunken ships rise from the depths. It was once a notorious den of pirates, cursed by a sailor's widow after they murdered her husband. Now the cove marks the edge of the world, a border even the bravest sailors should not cross. Beware! Here be monsters.
name: Forsaken Cove

description:
A throng of vile monsters has claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.
lore: Nature is seldom good or evil. It is hungry, territorial, and protective of its young. Nests and dens such as these are home to various beasts of the wild, whose natural ferocity and power of tooth, claw, or beak may prove more than a match for the sharpest steel.
name: Small Monster Den

description:
A horde of vile monsters has claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.
lore: The crunch of half-chewed bones underfoot and the overwhelming scent of past victims drifting through the air mark this den a home of monsters. From ancient giants, shapers of the world, to vicious trolls, still incensed at the loss of their deep domains, one might expect any type of powerful creature and their minions to emerge.
name: Large Monster Den

description:
A roving band of pirates has claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion parties.
lore: Freebooters laugh as they smuggle goods along the waves and pirates raze the villages by the sea and riverside, plundering all they desire. The call of the sea resonates with these men and women who congregate in hidden coves and bays. Raucous singing can be heard in these places, accompanied by the smell of stale, stolen ale wafting through the humid air.
name: Pirate Cove

description:
A mass of haunted undead has claimed this region.
If left unchecked, they will grow in strength, expand their territory, and send out invasion armies.
lore: The dead often grow restless in troubled times. In places like graveyards, where they are all conveniently amassed in a single, sometimes less than final, resting place, this can be fatal for others. Whether driven by dark magic, a confluence of ambient spiritual energy, or some other source of ire from beyond the veil, hordes of the Undead rise with one need... to feast upon the flesh of the living.
name: Haunted Graveyard

body_header: After arduous travels, the bubbling waters of the refreshing <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> seem very inviting to <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventHero>> army. The peaceful murmur of the stream is punctuated by playful laughter.
body_lore: "Don't just stand there!" calls a welcoming, seductive voice, joined by a chorus of laughter. Fair <<m:EnemyUnit>> are frolicking in the waters of the spring. They beckon invitingly with their bare arms, blocking out the humanoid shapes floating lifelessly under the surface. The <<m:EnemyUnit>> call out, almost imploring with eager requests. "Join us! Come bathe with us..."
button_0: "It's a trap! Attack!"
button_1: Order your troops to avert their eyes before attacking the <<m:EnemyUnit>>.
button_3: "Do not give in to temptation! Our faith will guide us through this!"
button_4: Back away from these temptresses.
title: Bait and Bathe

hero_is_playerle: The <<m:EnemyUnit>> beckon to you to join them in the waters. As your troops approach, their smiles darken. "Come on in! Do not resist."

After arduous travels, the bubbling waters of the refreshing <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> seem very inviting to you and your army. The peaceful murmur of the stream is punctuated by playful laughter.

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> smiles. "I don't have much I can offer you except my gratitude, brave <<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>>. The <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> is yours."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> emerges victorious from the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>. One final <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> approaches, arms raised. "Did I miss all the fun?" She asks playfully.
body_lore: She continues: "Those hags tricked people only to drown them for sport. They even tried it on me, once, before chasing me away. I'm glad they're..." she pauses to choose her words carefully, "... gone." I'm not like them, I've always wanted to leave the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> and learn about the world, rather than drown everyone."
button_0: "We are only interested in the riches <gold></gold> your treacherous sisters looted."
button_1: "We will take the fruits and plants <food></food> you grow here."
button_2: "Join us, <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor>. <unit></unit> Then you can learn all that you desire."
title: Bait and Bathe: Aftermath

hero_is_playerle: The <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> smiles. "I don't have much I can offer you except my gratitude, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. The <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> is yours."

"I am only interested in the riches <gold></gold> your treacherous sisters looted."
"I will take the fruits and plants <food></food> you grow here."
"Join me, <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor>. <unit></unit> Then you can learn all that you desire."

body_footer: She smiles coldly as ice creatures rise from the pristine snow. "Come embrace the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, and be preserved."
body_header: After traveling some distance in the hot midday sun, <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> heads toward a wellspring, expecting refreshment...
body_lore: Despite the heat of the day, the wellspring is frozen solid. Upon its surface sits a family of ducks, frozen in ice. A woman, crowned in glittering icicles, glides closer over the frozen waters. Ice spreads from beneath her icy bare feet. She gingerly caresses the frozen animals, before her head snaps toward <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Warm blood disturbs my tranquil lake."
button_0: "Time to break the ice! To arms!"
button_1: Use magic <mana></mana> to protect yourself from the cold.
button_3: Stoke your inner fire to withstand the cold.
button_4: Flee from the icy cold.
title: The Frozen Lake

hero_is_playerle: After traveling some distance in the hot midday sun, you head toward a wellspring, expecting refreshment...

Despite the heat of the day, the wellspring is frozen solid. Upon its surface sits a family of ducks, frozen in ice. A woman, crowned in glittering icicles, glides closer over the frozen waters. Ice spreads from beneath her icy bare feet. She gingerly caresses the frozen animals, before her head snaps toward you. "Warm blood disturbs my tranquil lake."

body_lore: Pickpockets roam the streets and thugs raid houses in the night. Shopkeepers have resorted to paying gangs for "protection," but this has led to conflict between city districts. It won't be long before the city falls into rioting and anarchy.
button_0: End this anarchy <happiness></happiness> by deploying your full garrison <unitprod></unitprod>.
button_1: The city doesn't "fall" to chaos. It is healed by it!
button_2: Call in support from <eventColor>{PlayerCapital.Name}</eventColor> to help <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> recover. <unitprod></unitprod> <gold></gold> <happiness></happiness>
button_3: Arrest the families of the criminals and execute <population></population> them all. <evilact></evilact> <happiness></happiness>
button_4: "I have no time for this."
title: City of Outlaws

body_footer: There is no reasoning with <eventColor>{EventNimue}</eventColor>. You can only liberate the realm by defeating her.
body_header: You meet <eventColor>{EventNimue.Name}</eventColor> herself, her eyes seething with hatred and insanity.
body_lore: "You! Intruder, trespasser! What are you doing in my realm?! Your ugly, so-called "<eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>" taint it with imperfection! No matter. You will be easily destroyed by my beloved <eventColor>{EventNimueRace}</eventColor>, and then I will use your essences to empower my people even further! You should be grateful, then you will be a part of true perfection."
button_0: "War it is!"
title: The <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor>

body_footer: "If you truly aim to free us from her, help my people to no longer live in fear. Destroy the infestation and defeat the hunters who threaten us."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader}</eventColor> sighs with relief. "We have waited so long for a benevolent <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> to help us."
body_lore: "Ever since <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor> discarded us, we have been living in fear. Her thralls hunt our people as if we were trophies, and the wildlife torments us everywhere we go. I try to convince my people we could grow strong enough to fight back, but their fear is... deep-rooted. Meanwhile monsters close in on us. Soon, there will be no place left for us to flee to."
button_0: "I will aid you and your <eventColor>{EventPlayerRace.Name}</eventColor>."
button_1: "I have no time for this quest."
title: The <eventColor>{EventPlayerRace.Name}</eventColor>

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> rubs <<o:EventPlayerLeader>> temple. "If you wish to convince me, convince the <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> of your good intentions first. I respect <<o:EventHouseLord>> insights."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader}</eventColor> harrumphs. "You have stories about my goddess? Lies, no doubt..." <<Cp:EventPlayerLeader>> pauses for a moment. "Very well, I must respect the rules of negotiation."
body_lore: "Through my duties, I have met others with whom I share good contacts. Some tell the strangest stories about the goddess' love... turning to wrath. But that can't be! These people, they fell out of the goddess' grace, but I'm sure that's a misunderstanding. She would never truly drown us... Would she?" <<Cp:EventPlayerLeader>> winces, as <<p:EventPlayerLeader>> is being scolded by something you cannot hear.
button_0: "Very well, <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. I will convince <<P:EventHouseLord>>, and you."
button_2: "I have no time to mingle with minor cities."
title: Voice of Reason

body_footer: Returning here with a <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> will allow you to take over the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> peacefully.
body_header: Your army encounters troops from <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> guarding a <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: The troops, led by a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, call out from afar. "State your intent. Where is your leader? We have orders to speak with no one but true <hyperlink>Heroes</hyperlink>."
button_0: Arrange a diplomatic audience with <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: Attack! This is the opportunity to strike!
button_3: Disengage and let them be.
title: <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> Guards of the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>.

body_footer: "Something here... affects me." <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> says. "I do not trust my senses. I will follow your lead, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>. We should find what ails the Eternal Court."
body_header: You arrive at the realm called the Eternal Court. Even though the flowers bloom and birds sing, the air feels... stale.
body_lore: You are joined by <eventColor>{Sundren.TitleName}</eventColor>, who frowns upon arrival. "This is not how <hyperlink>Auldweald</hyperlink> was described to me. As one of the origin worlds of the Elves, it was to be lush, and grand. Deep down, all Elves long for this world, but..." <<Cp:Sundren>> suddenly winces and grabs her head. "I hear... do you hear that? Whispers... Something is very wrong in this realm."
button_0: "I will investigate what happened here."
title: The Eternal Court

body_footer: "Now, the only task left is to escort <eventColor>{Meandor.TitleName}</eventColor> to Magehaven to meet the Covenant."
body_header: You have freed the Eternal Court from its curse, thereby saving an important part of <hyperlink>Auldweald</hyperlink> from certain doom.
body_lore: It will take time for the forests of Auldweald to recover, but you made it possible. The <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> who were trapped within can now move on to <hyperlink>the Well</hyperlink>, and beyond. <eventColor>{Sundren.TitleName}</eventColor> nods sternly.
button_0: 'Tis good to be a Godir.
button_1: Stay until Sundren has found the source of these voices.
title: The Eternal Court: Victory

sundrenquest_not: "I still have unfinished business on this realm. I would ask you to remain here to lend your aid. But... I cannot force you, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>."

You have broken the curse that affected Meandor and the Eternal Court. Before you can escort <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> to <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, however, <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> approaches you.

"Congratulations, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. You have broken the spell on <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor>, and thereby saved the Eternal Court from its deathly curse. However... I still feel haunted, even now the curse is broken. Perhaps a remnant still lingers... Keeping me here."
Leave her to return to Magehaven, victorious!

body_footer: "I believe <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> is afflicted by a powerful spell, and I have located apparitions that seem to be connected to it. However, I cannot properly investigate them myself."
body_header: <eventColor>{Melenis.FirstName}</eventColor> laughs scornfully. "If you wish to change the fate of this realm, you should deal with my husband."
body_lore: "I ventured here to find him, hoping our reunion would lead to a renewed alliance. But he has become pathetically obsessed with the fate of all <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> within the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. Whenever I dare to even come close to his translucent pets, he calls me a "mortal traitor" and threatens to attack me. Me! I tried to reason with him, but he pays me no heed. Disappointing."
button_0: "I will visit the sources you mention."
button_2: "Defeating <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> in battle is a better way to solve his affliction!"
button_3: "If anything afflicts this realm, it is you, Melenis! Prepare for war!"
title: Web of Madness

body_footer: "A powerful Godir must claim this realm to change its fate. Perhaps.. that Godir should not be me."
body_header: By eliminating its sources, you have broken the spell which has kept Meandor occupied for so long. You are contacted by the <eventColor>{Meandor.Title}</eventColor> himself.
body_lore:
"A haze.. is lifting. Did you do this, {PlayerLeader.TitleName}? Perhaps not all who visit are invaders, after all."
His gaze drifts toward the ghostly realm around him. "It seems even I cannot give myself the solace I yearn for. During my... affliction, I have set things in motion that I cannot undo alone. More and more souls will be pulled here."
button_0: "Accept your defeat, then, <eventColor>{Meandor.TitleName}</eventColor>, and leave this realm so I can resolve what you caused."
button_6: "I propose an alliance. Let us claim this realm and free its souls, together!"
button_7: Leave the <eventColor>{Meandor.Title}</eventColor> to journey through the void for now.
title: Web of Madness: Aftermath

meandor_defeated: His words fade. "What have I done... In my absence... free the realm from my curse."
By eliminating its sources you have broken the spell which has kept Meandor occupied. Even through the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink> he manages to contact you.

"In the void, I feel a haze is... lifting. Did you do this, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>? I see now that I was... afflicted. I have set things in motion that I cannot undo. Even now... I sense how more and more <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> are pulled toward the realm I created. They will soon fall victim to predators from the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>..."

body_footer: Meandor's voice booms throughout the realm. "I will not be left for dead again, I will not let this court fall again. The Eternal Court will remain preserved and silent. Forever!"
body_header: <eventColor>{Meandor.Name}</eventColor> appears, furious. "I warned you to leave me be, and yet you insist on disrupting my peace?!"
body_lore: "All you mortals are the same, envious of our superiority. You could not let us live, and now you cannot leave me to mourn. My father was a fool for trusting you the first time you set foot on <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, as was my sister!"
button_0: "If it takes a war to disrupt this lifeless realm, so be it."
title: Meandor Fights Back

body_footer: "Are you here to aid me in this quest for death and oblivion? Or will you join the many cursed <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> on this realm?"
body_header: <eventColor>{Melenis.Name}</eventColor> greets you with a cold smile. "Ah. Another lost soul, roaming this realm of death and destruction."
body_lore: "My husband may want to relive his memories, but I cannot sit still while he focuses on the ghosts from his past." She sighs, frustrated. "I will not stop until every <hyperlink>world</hyperlink> in the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> is nothing but dust, stopping the cycle of destruction and creation at the desolation in between. I had hoped my husband would join me, but he is... afflicted."
button_1: "I am here to claim this realm."
button_2: "Our goals align, <eventColor>{Melenis.FirstName}</eventColor>. Together, we shall build an empire of bones!"
button_3: "If anything afflicts this realm, it is you, Melenis! Prepare for war!"
title: Meeting <eventColor>{Melenis.Name}</eventColor>

curse_broken: "I will not stop until every realm, every <hyperlink>world</hyperlink> in the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> is nothing but dust, stopping the cycle of destruction and creation at the desolation in between. I ventured here to find my husband <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor>, hoping our reunion would lead to a renewed alliance. But even now that the curse on my husband is broken, he seems pathetically passive."

body_footer: Meandor snarls. "I am Godir! I raise the dead and command the spirits! How dare you lecture me in my own domain!"
body_header: You enter the ghostly domain of <eventColor>{Meandor.TitleName}</eventColor>. "You!" he says. "Invader! Tormenter. Why can you not let me be?!"
body_lore: Sundren pitches in. “Meandor, Uncle, please. The <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> of the <hyperlink>Covenant</hyperlink> need you... I need you. I do not wish to fight you, but I will if I must. I too know loss, but this is no way to rule. You and your realm lie stagnant… You cannot reverse the past, no matter how much you wish for it.”
button_0: "You are being tricked, Meandor. There is a curse affecting you."
button_1: "There is no use in reasoning with Meandor right now."
title: Domain of the <eventColor>{Meandor.Title}</eventColor>

body_footer: Meandor rubs his temple, haunted once more. "No, you are only here to take advantage of my grief. Leave! Leave..."
body_header: You speak of the curse that affects Meandor. His expression grows more troubled with every word you speak.
body_lore: "A... curse?" He says. "Impossible, no <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> could trick me - but... the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink>... Is it because of the Gildercoil? They want to use it - it is a key..." Invisible strings seem to pull on him, and his expression hardens once more. "No. I am the <eventColor>{Meandor.Title}</eventColor>, first son of Inioch. You mortals attempt to mislead me and take my rightful throne."
button_0: "Casting you into the void will be a mercy, Meandor."
title: Domain of the <eventColor>{Meandor.Title}</eventColor>: Continued

body_footer: "I will preserve every soul that arrives here..." <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> does not seem interested in negotiations with you in his current state.
body_header: You meet the Ruler of this realm, the <eventColor>{Meandor.Title}</eventColor> himself. <<Co:Meandor>> gaze is absent; he seems to look right through you.
body_lore: “So, I meet <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. Are you here to become a part of my Eternal Court? Or are you intruders, here to ransack my realm as Humans did my father’s? All Elves are connected to this world. When they are torn from life, many Elven <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> attempt to return here. So many never make it, becoming lost. I will not let that happen again.”
button_0: Continue to listen to his mutterings.
button_1: "There is no reasoning with you. To arms!"
button_2: "Just stay out of my way."
title: Meeting <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor>

body_footer: You could send the lowly <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor>, one of your <whisperingStone></whisperingStone> Whispering Stones, to start gaining influence over <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of the <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> trembles before you, clearly aware of your <hyperlink>reputation</hyperlink> in the realm.
body_lore: "Salutations, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. We are... impressed with the methods you use to expand your realm. We <eventColor>{EventHouseRace.Name}</eventColor> humbly ask you to respect our territory and independence nonetheless."
button_0: "Let me assess whether <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> deserves my attention."
button_2: "Enjoy your freedom... for now."

body_footer: "Please, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, share some of your wisdom with me so I can pass it on to my people!"
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> approaches you regarding a matter of research and philosophy.
body_lore: "As a <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventHouseRace.Name}</eventColor>, I am expected to write a journal, to be added to our grand library. I have chosen to devote mine to the philosophies of the greatest Godir on the realm. Of course I immediately thought of the greatest <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> in the realm—you! It would be an honor if you would share your ideologies with me."
button_0: "Only from destruction can one build anew. <chaosboon></chaosboon>."
button_1: "Life is circular. <natureboon></natureboon> From ashes we grew, like others from ours."
button_2: "Concepts are but writings in the sand until they are materialized. <materiumboon></materiumboon>"
button_3: "Only the most righteous and lawful can find salvation. <orderboon></orderboon>."
button_4: "To gain wisdom, we must advance the limits of the known <astralboon></astralboon>."
button_6: "Rulers must remember that benevolence and honor trump all other virtues." <goodact></goodact>
button_7: "Only in death <shadowboon></shadowboon> can spirit and body reach their individual potential."
button_8: "We are defined by the impressions we leave <influence></influence> on others."

body_footer: "We boast about our feats and achievements," <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> shouts over the noise. "Won't you join in?"
body_header: To celebrate your brotherhood, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> has invited you to a competition—one less bloody than the usual type.
body_lore: A rowdy crowd has gathered in the great hall of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>. Several <eventColor>{EventHouseRace.Name}</eventColor> stand on tables and chairs, waving tankards while yelling battle cries and thumping on wooden furniture. The crowd cheers. A <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> shows <<o:EventUnit>> scars and loudly boasts about <<o:EventUnit>> latest adventure.
button_0: Boast about your vast empire <influence></influence> and its people.
button_1: Boast about the lucrative trade in your empire <gold></gold>.
button_3: Boast about your martial feats and impressive <morale></morale> armies.
button_6: "I could never compete with the great braggarts of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>."
title: Crowing Competition

body_footer: "Pray tell, as a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, which layer of our society do you think deserves the most appreciation and support?"
body_header: Your supporter, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>, asks your opinion on a matter of society and civilization.
body_lore: "The <eventColor>{EventHouseRace.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> believe in a clear structure of society," <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.FirstName}</eventColor> says. "We, noble Rulers of the land, provide protection to the clergy who provide wisdom, and the peasantry working the fields. We cannot eat our military prowess, and the peasantry will fall to chaos without our rulership."
button_0: "Me, of course. I am above all."
button_1: "Scholars and priests <knowledge></knowledge> are the spiritual core of our domains."
button_3: "You noble Lords and Ladies <influence></influence>, who carry the weight of responsibility."
button_6: "The peasants and serfs <food></food> are the base of all society."
title: A Question of Class

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> offers you an object forged by the smiths of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> as a gift. Which one do you pick?

body_lore: <<Cp:EventHouseLord>> takes you to a street filled with the clamor of forges and smithies. "We of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> believe a soldier is only as good as the quality of their armaments, so we strive for the best." <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> stops at a shop and gestures at some finely crafted objects. "We offer you one of our products, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, to show our appreciation."
button_0: The protective <eventColor>{EventItem1.Name}</eventColor> <item></item>, covered in intricate runes.
button_1: The impressive <eventColor>{EventItem3.Name}</eventColor> <item></item> that shines in the light of the forge.
button_3: The finely crafted <eventColor>{EventItem2.Name}</eventColor> <item></item>, a worthy prize despite its size.
button_6: "Since you appreciate me so, I accept all three objects <item></item>."

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> offers you one item from the odd auction table. What do you bring to <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>?

body_lore: The grand hall is dark, except for a lit stage where eerie curiosities are displayed. "Amusing, isn't it?" <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> says. "Recreation for those burdened with too much power and gold. Of course, lords less... cultured frown upon most of what is sold here. But that is precisely why this so interesting. Tell me, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, which of these objects intrigues you?"
button_0: "The cursed notebook <knowledge></knowledge> of the Frozen Hermit, to enhance my library."
button_1: "The farmer's head <food></food> in a jar, to keep my citizens motivated." <evilact></evilact>
button_3: "The Obsidian Throne <influence></influence>, to impress other Rulers of the realm."
button_6: "This dark auction must visit my empire <shadowboon></shadowboon>. My people will love it."
button_7: "The <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor> <item></item>, to dominate the battlefield."
title: Dark Bidding

body_footer: The "Children of the <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>" seek your blessing as they assemble to celebrate their zeal. What do you say?
body_header: A newly found cult has become very popular among the general populace in your city <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>. They preach in your name.
body_lore: Followers of this cult have spread across the city, into nearly every industry of the town. The cult preaches a doctrine of hard work and selflessness. The whole movement makes your citizenry very productive. Instead of hoarding their wealth, they seek to share their abundance, out of gratitude to you and because of your benevolence.
button_0: "Raise your tools, my <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>, and build <structureprod></structureprod> the future of our empire!"
button_1: "Honor your scholars <knowledge></knowledge>, my <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> and write our history!"
button_2: "Let the people thrive and grow <food></food>, my <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>!"
button_3: "Before I was Godir, I was like you. I am not to be worshiped." <goodact></goodact>
button_4: "I may be Godir, but I am not to be worshiped." <goodact></goodact>
title: Cult of Personality

body_footer: The Eye of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> rules <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> with an iron fist. They expect you to guide their piercing gaze.
body_header: A new cult called the "Eye of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>" has risen in your city <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: Followers of this cult have spread across the city. The priests claim you are all-seeing and all-knowing, and thus preach a doctrine of unquestioning submission to you. The whole movement makes your citizenry very obedient, be it out of reverence or out of fear for the cult's punishments. They are known to make "heretics" disappear.
button_0: "Build temples and structures <structureprod></structureprod> in my name, until your backs break."
button_1: "A cult of war <unitprod></unitprod>! The strongest may join my glorious conquest."
button_2: "As your radiant <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, relinquish all of your possessions <gold></gold> to me."
button_4: "Let my entire empire know <influence></influence> that their <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> sees and knows all."
title: The Eye of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>

body_footer: The guildmaster looks at you. "Which approach do you prefer, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>?"
body_header: You have treated your citizens in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> well. Now, the citizens wish to invite the people of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> to celebrate.
body_lore: A local guildmaster titters excitedly. "We were thinking of organizing a collective festival, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. It seems the <eventColor>{EventHouseRace.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> love our <eventColor>{RandomFood}</eventColor>, and they promised to share one of their delicacies in return. We're planning on musical performances, a grand market, a feast for all... These festivities will be a great opportunity to strengthen our bonds with their city!"
button_0: "A shared festival with <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> will help us all."
button_1: "Invite <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> and all <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> to celebrate in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>!"
button_2: "Festivities for foreigners are unnecessary. We must care for our own." <happiness></happiness>
button_4: "This wealth should flow into the economy <gold></gold> of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>!"
title: <eventColor>{RandomFood}</eventColor> Festival

body_footer: "Your blessing would hallow this celebration, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. Would you share a few words for our fallen brethren?"
body_header: Your citizens in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> host a celebration during which they placate the dead so their deceased loved ones may rest peacefully.
body_lore: A magistrate explains: "To keep the dead from rising and wreaking havoc, our citizens share stories and happiness during festivities around the city's crypt. That way, the deceased know we're doing fine without them, and they can continue their journey without needing to come back and haunt us."
button_0: "Your sacrifice allowed my empire to prosper <influence></influence>. Enjoy your rest."
button_1: "While you rest, others will wake <population></population> in your stead."
button_2: "Great cities like <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> are built <production></production> because of your sacrifice."
button_4: "Fear not the rising dead! <shadow></shadow> Witness how useful <unit></unit> they are."
title: Cadaver's Cavalcade

body_footer: "The effects of these so-called Slumber Spores are temporary, but they may help <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> overcome these... challenging times."
body_header: You have neglected the needs of your citizens in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, causing unrest. An expert apothecary proposes a unique solution...
body_lore: <<Cp:EventUnit>> bows and explains with a nasal voice, "All my life, I've pursued the study of magical fungal infestations that dot this world. I have located one variety whose spores induce a strong sedative effect. If you find it advisable, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, one might shower the restless congregations of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> in these spores."
button_0: "Deploy the spores throughout <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> <mana></mana> to calm its populace."
button_1: "Deploy the spores and execute <population></population> the sedated troublemakers." <evilact></evilact>
button_2: Do not unleash the spores upon your people. Well, not yet...
title: Slumber Spores

body_footer: "This cannot go on, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. Your city will rot from the inside!" How will you end the corruption?
body_header: Corruption rules your city of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, its people governed by crooked guards and fraudulent guild masters. A citizen explains the situation to you.
body_lore: The citizen kneels before you in deference, but speaks with a boldness that increases with every word. "My <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, corruption has festered in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> for far too long. Disease, chaos, and poverty reign in the streets, while the guild leaders buy luxuries. The guards themselves raid our houses and rob us instead of protecting us!"
button_0: Cull the city guard <unitprod></unitprod> to weed out their corruption.
button_1: Punish the fraudulent guild leaders <gold></gold> for their missteps.
button_2: "I will deal with the unrest within <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> later."
button_4: Slow the city's growth <food></food> until the corruption is pushed out.
title: Corruption in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>

body_footer: Will you allow the pitiful <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and other beings to leave this world behind, or will you attack?

body_lore: Originating from the depths of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, these creatures are driven by a hunger not for flesh, but for the arcane. This craving now drives them toward <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>. Your citizens are terrified, begging you to protect them from these <hyperlink>monsters</hyperlink> that surpass their capacity of comprehension.

button_1: Feed them enough <mana></mana> to put the entire <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor> to rest.

button_3: These creatures are no match for <<g:defenses,EventCity>>. Let them come.
title: Monsters Beyond Comprehension

body_footer: The fearsome <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> has emerged from the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor>, <<o:EventStackLeader>> greedy gaze locked on <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
body_header: Your citizens in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> are terrified of a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> who spawned from the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor> nearby and now threatens your domain.
body_lore: This creature was once a proud mage, traveling through the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> to uncover its secrets and treasures. Instead of finding treasures, however, the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> met with <<o:EventStackLeader>> demise, succumbing to the twisted nature of the sea between worlds. This turned <<P:EventStackLeader>> into a <hyperlink>monstrosity</hyperlink>—a being that only lusts for more power, and survives solely upon the knowledge <<p:EventStackLeader>> possessed before.
button_0: Call upon the arcane <mana></mana> to banish the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> from your lands.

button_3: This mage has fallen before and <<p:EventStackLeader>> will do so again if <<p:EventStackLeader>> dares to oppose me.

button_0: "No, you all die!" <evilact></evilact>
button_1: "Nay, I grant you all mercy. Take your troops and go." <goodact></goodact>
button_2: "You all live, but <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> swears loyalty to me." <unit></unit>
button_3: "You all live, but <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> will be my prisoner."
