body_footer: "We humbly request that you leave the <eventColor>{EventGeo}</eventColor> near 3 for <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> approaches you to settle a territorial dispute.
body_lore: "We of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> are impressed by the expanse of your <eventColor>{PlayerRace.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. Although it now seems that we have a misunderstanding considering one of your possible territorial claims." <<Cp:EventHouseLord>> clears <<o:EventHouseLord>> throat. "My city, <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>, is rapidly expanding. We need more space for our people. The area in question was claimed by us for that reason."
button_0: "Very well. <<EventGeo<eventColor>{That/Those}</eventColor>>> <eventColor>{EventGeo}</eventColor> shall be yours."
button_1: "Thank you for disclosing which area I must claim for my empire." <evilact></evilact>
title: Clash of Claims

race_is_playerra: "We of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> are impressed by your rulership over our brethren <eventColor>{PlayerRace.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. Although it now seems that we have a misunderstanding considering one of your possible territorial claims." <<Cp:EventHouseLord>> clears <<o:EventHouseLord>> throat. "My city, <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>, is rapidly expanding. We need more space for our people. The area in question was claimed by us for that reason."

body_footer: <<G:eyes,EventHouseLord>> meet yours in sinister anticipation. "This prisoner's fate is yours to decide, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>."
body_header: Before negotiations with <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> resume, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> greets you. <<Cp:EventHouseLord>> is flanked by two guards holding a malnourished man in chains.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> bares <<o:EventHouseLord>> teeth with an unsettling grin. "To honor your might, I offer you this gift for our mutual entertainment! We caught this miscreant trespassing in my private forest." The prisoner scoffs and prepares to object, but a quick punch to the gut from the <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> knocks the wind out of him. The fire in his eyes, however, remains.
button_0: "What madness befalls you? Release <goodact></goodact> this man!"
button_1: "I'd rather we continue our negotiations."
button_2: "Sacrifice <evilact></evilact> him in Urrath's name!"
button_3: "This outcome is so predictable. True entertainment comes from chaos."
button_4: "A fine addition for my army of the damned! <evilact></evilact>"
button_5: "Greetings, unfortunate trespasser. You decide which foot stays attached. <evilact></evilact>"
title: Grim Entertainment

body_footer: "Please, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, will you share some of your prosperity with my starving city?"
body_header: The kind <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> appears before you with a gaunt face.
body_lore: "Noble <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, a dark era has befallen <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>. My people are famished; the harvests failed and our storehouses lie empty. Mothers can not feed their children, my city guard is mutinous... I fear many of my proud citizens will starve before this sad time is over."
button_0: "<eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> will help you <food></food> through this famine." <goodact></goodact>
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> will help you <food></food>... for a price." <gold></gold>
button_2: "I have nothing to spare for <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>. [relationLvl-3/] Find another solution."
button_3: "If your people are starving, they are better off under my care."
title: <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> in Peril

body_footer: "With your permission, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, we shall set sail to find these people and their Rulers."
body_header: Your <<m:EventUnit>> report interesting sightings from beyond the horizon.
body_lore: One of them approaches you. "My <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, we have seen ships of unknown origin on the western horizon, and trodden underground passages in the east. It seems that some of <<G:creations,EventNimue>> have survived her wrath. Perhaps they can even be persuaded to join you on your quest to liberate the realm."
button_0: "I shall find these stranded creations."
title: Stranded Creations

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor> keeps this realm in a drowning embrace, but resistance slowly spreads. Perhaps others can be convinced to join your cause.
body_header: You have met the other Rulers in this realm, both <<G:stranded creations,EventNimue>>. Talk of your arrival spreads across the realm.
body_lore: Exiles of all kinds flock to your <hyperlink>Throne City</hyperlink>, calling you their savior. They all share the same story: their people were once favored by <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor>, but then abandoned when she grew disappointed with them. Disenchanted with their goddess, they flock to you for deliverance.
button_0: Allow these exiled people to live in your cities. <population></population>
button_1: Dismiss these exiles. You are their liberator, not their caretaker. <influence></influence>
title: Stranded Creations: Aftermath

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> is unpopular across the realm, rumored to delight in foul "delicacies." Yet, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> asks you to endorse their feast.
body_header: Your friend, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> is hosting a feast and appears before you, dejected.
body_lore: "I have a favor to ask, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>," <<p:EventHouseLord>> says, before <<p:EventHouseLord>> takes a deep breath. "I will host a feast soon, for all the nobles of this realm. I already paid for everything—bards, beverages, and so forth, but so far it seems no one will attend. If a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> like you would endorse it, however..."
button_0: "Very well. I will endorse you." <influence></influence>
button_1: "You disgust your guests. Why should my reputation suffer alongside yours?"
button_2: "A suitable offering <gold></gold> would persuade me to vouch for you." <influence></influence>
title: <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> Party

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> is not so easily convinced, but you have sown the seeds of doubt in <<o:EventPlayerLeader>> faith.
body_header: Through negotiations with the <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>, you have persuaded <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader}</eventColor> to consider that your goals of stopping <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor> may be justified.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> looks distraught. "<eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> tells me you are reasonable, but your words, they cannot be true. <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor>, she's in my head—whispering still... Did she really drown all those people? Are the stories true? They can't be..." <<Cp:EventPlayerLeader>> winces once more. "I need time to think. I thank you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, for your efforts."
button_0: "I only wish for freedom for all who reside in this realm." <goodact></goodact>
button_1: Use the confusion of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> to lure a few of them to your cause. <evilact></evilact>
title: Voice of Reason: Aftermath

war_with_loyalis: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> is not so easily convinced, but you have instigated a peace and sown the seeds of doubt in <<o:EventPlayerLeader>> faith.

<eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> looks distraught. "<eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> tells me you are reasonable, but your words, they cannot be true. <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor>, she's in my head—whispering still... Did she really drown all those people? That can't be... I am already at war against you!" <<Cp:EventPlayerLeader>> winces once more. "I need time to think. I cannot fight you anymore. Not with the questions I have."

body_footer: "Leave this realm, intruder! Or you will feel the wrath of our beloved <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor>!"
body_header: You encounter a group of trackers who were stalking a group of <eventColor>{EventPlayerRace}</eventColor>. They look at you with feverish hatred in their eyes.
body_lore:
It is clear they have been altered by strong magic. These are creations of {EventNimue.FirstName}, doing her dirty work.
"Intruders," the {EventStackLeader} shouts. "Are you here to stop the {EventNimue.Title} from creating her beloved children? We will never let you! We carry the glorious burden of cleansing the imperfect from this realm. We will prove ourselves worthy of her love!"
button_0: "Your hunt is over. Surrender or die!"
button_1: Leave these hunters to their task.
button_2: Break Nimue's enchantment <mana></mana> on these thralls, leaving them to realize what they've done.
title: Hunters of the <eventColor>{EventPlayerRace.Name}</eventColor>

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> requests for you to consider peace between you and <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> laments your ongoing war.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>," <<p:EventHouseLord>> says, "I have seen the folly of our war. Please, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, would you consider a truce? Hasn't enough blood been spilled over this realm?"
button_0: "You may be right. Let us end the bloodshed."
button_1: "This war has only just begun, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.FirstName}</eventColor>."
title: Request for Peace

body_footer: The Covenant urges you to visit the native city of <minorcity></minorcity><hyperlink>Edendam</hyperlink> which should be near you. Its people may be of aid for your investigation.
body_header: The voice of an unknown <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> reaches you from beyond the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. The Godir of the <hyperlink>Covenant</hyperlink> hope you arrived safely."
body_lore: "My name is <eventColor>{CovenantRuler.Name}</eventColor>. I was one of the Godir who heard the song of the being called <hyperlink>Elya</hyperlink>. I am glad you volunteered to investigate. We of the Covenant must act upon any call for help, but first we must verify these allegations against <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor>."
button_0: "Very well, I will do as the Covenant suggests."
title: Call of the Covenant

body_footer: "The fate of this realm lies in your hands. For this, the Covenant has decided to lend its knowledge. Ask, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, and you shall receive."
body_header: After reporting the state of the drowned city you encountered, the <hyperlink>Covenant</hyperlink> sends an answer.
body_lore: "We are deeply saddened to hear about the fate of the city we asked you to visit. It seems the words of <hyperlink>Elya</hyperlink> are true, and that the Water Wizard <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor> has drowned these people. This is worse than we thought. We urge you to approach <eventColor>{EventNimue}</eventColor> with the utmost caution."
button_0: "Grant me the knowledge to sail the seas, so I may traverse this realm of islands."
button_1: "Grant me the knowledge of Expert Seafaring, so I may traverse this realm at unprecedented speeds."
button_2: "Grant me the knowledge of Expert Seafaring, so I may traverse this realm at unforeseen speeds."
button_3: "My <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> and I require no aid from any other Godir." <influence></influence>
title: Call of the Covenant: Aftermath

body_footer: "If good <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> truly exist, please, deliver us from her wrath."
body_header: A ruler of an unmet people slowly comes out of hiding, addressing you with gathered courage. "You.. are not <eventColor>{EventNimue}</eventColor>."
body_lore: "I am <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>, Ruler of the <eventColor>{EventPlayerRace.Name}</eventColor>. Once, we were the goddess' favorites, until she became... disappointed with us. She drowned so many of us when we fled her wrath. We have survived by staying hidden, but her power grows with every creature she builds and drowns. Please, you must stop her, before she catches us."
button_0: "Tell me what I can do to help."
button_1: "Just stay out of my way."
title: Meeting <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> sounds desperate. "The <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor> will love us again!"
body_header: You meet <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventPlayerRace.Name}</eventColor>. <<Cp:EventPlayerLeader>> eyes you and puffs up <<o:EventPlayerLeader>> chest.
body_lore: "My name was given to me by the <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor> herself! As blessed children of <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor> we only aim to please her. Unfortunately, she has deemed us—imperfect. Without her guidance, we have taken it upon ourselves to patrol and protect the realm. I know she will love us again if we prove ourselves worthy."
button_0: "Is there anything I can do to convince you of the true nature of your goddess?"
button_1: "Just stay out of my way."
title: Meeting <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> sighs and nods. "Lead us to our freedom, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>."
body_header: You have formed an alliance with <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventPlayerRace}</eventColor>. A shrieking voice echoes from the south of the realm.
body_lore:
"{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}! You DARE to make alliances with invaders?!" The voice of {EventNimue.FirstName} shrieks. "I should have drowned you weaklings when I had the chance! Next time, I will be more thorough!"
{EventPlayerLeader.TitleName} flinches under the verbal assault, but then <> straightens <> back. "We are not weak. We will no longer run from you, {EventNimue.FirstName}." <> says.
button_0: "Together we will bring an end to the terror of the <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor>."
title: Discarded Alliance

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> sighs and nods. "It is my duty to free this realm alongside you. Lead the way, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>."
body_header: You have formed an alliance with <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventPlayerRace}</eventColor>. A shrieking voice echoes from the south of the realm.
body_lore:
"{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}! You DARE to make alliances with invaders?!" The voice of {EventNimue.FirstName} shrieks. "I should have drowned you the first time you disappointed me. My beloved {EventNimueRace} will eradicate you overgrown failures!"
{EventPlayerLeader.TitleName} straightens <> back. "It seems you were right about our goddess, {PlayerLeader.FirstName}."
button_0: "Together we will bring an end to the terror of the <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor>."
title: Shifting Loyalty

body_footer: "Whoever killed <<P:EventPlayerLeader>>, thank you for doing my dirty work. You will meet the same fate at the hands of the <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor> and her <eventColor>{EventNimueRace}</eventColor>!"
body_header: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader}</eventColor> was defeated. <<Co:EventPlayerLeader>> <eventColor>{EventPlayerRace}</eventColor> scatter, terrified.
body_lore: Cackling laughter reaches your ears. "So those miscreants are finally dead! Good riddance to them! <<Cp:EventPlayerLeader>> wanted to play <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, and now <<o:EventPlayerLeader>> essence will empower my new, better children. Surely, my next experiment will be perfect!"
button_0: "You will be next, <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor>."
title: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader}</eventColor> Defeated

nimue_defeated: With <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> defeated, you are one step closer to victory over the Enchanted Archipelago.

<eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> is cast into the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>. Echoing laughter chimes across the realm, as if it were an echo of the fallen <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor>. If anything, <<o:EventNimue>> experiment has failed <<o:EventNimue>> final test... To stand against you.

body_footer: "Whoever killed <<P:EventPlayerLeader>>, thank you for doing my dirty work. You will meet the same fate at the hands of the <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor> and her 40!"
body_header: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader}</eventColor> was defeated. <<o:EventPlayerLeader>> <eventColor>{EventPlayerRace}</eventColor> gather together, fearful but bravely facing <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor> herself.
body_lore: Cackling laughter reaches your ears. "And that is the end of <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. <<Cp:EventPlayerLeader>> did not live up to <<o:EventPlayerLeader>> name, did <<p:EventPlayerLeader>>. Of course, I already knew that. <<Cp:EventPlayerLeader>> wanted to play Godir, and now <<o:EventPlayerLeader>> essence will empower my new, better children. Surely, my next experiment will be perfect!"
button_0: "You will be next, <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor>."
title: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader}</eventColor> Defeated

nimue_defeated: With <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> defeated, you are one step closer to victory over the Enchanted Archipelago.
<eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader}</eventColor> was defeated. <<Co:EventPlayerLeader>> <eventColor>{EventPlayerRace}</eventColor> gather together, fearful but brave.

<eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> is cast into the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>. Echoing laughter chimes across the realm, as if it were an echo of the fallen <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor>. If anything, <<o:EventNimue>> experiment has failed <<o:EventNimue>> final test... To stand against you.

body_footer: You must claim this realm to stop it from succumbing to the Astral Sea.
body_header: You have defeated <eventColor>{Meandor.TitleName}</eventColor>, the wizard who had altered this world into a realm of ghosts and reminiscence. However...
body_lore: The oppressive cloud of death remains. It seems that even Meandor could no longer control the incursion of <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> on this realm, which in turn attracts creatures from the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. The veil between <hyperlink>Auldweald</hyperlink> and the Astral Sea grows thinner and thinner...
button_0: This is but one step on the way to victory.
title: Meandor Defeated

body_footer: "All invaders in this realm will be eradicated. This Court will be Eternal." The apparition of <eventColor>{Inioch.TitleName}</eventColor> can not be negotiated with.
body_header: You are greeted by an apparition. Once, this was a powerful emperor, but now merely a fragment of his <hyperlink>soul</hyperlink> is left.
body_lore: <<Cp:Inioch>> does not seem to notice <<o:Inioch>> own incorporeality. "You address <eventColor>{Inioch.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Inioch.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{IniochRace}</eventColor>, Ruler of the <eventColor>{IniochCity}</eventColor>. I will not allow my throne to be taken, not by <hyperlink>Archon</hyperlink> "law" nor by lesser mortals. The <hyperlink>Valley of Wonders</hyperlink> is mine and mine alone, forever, as is my eternal birthright. All who oppose me are nothing but usurpers."
button_0: "So be it."
title: Meeting <eventColor>{Inioch.TitleName}</eventColor>

body_footer: "Please, allow me to visit the sources of the voices I keep hearing."
body_header: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> approaches you, disturbed. She rubs her temples.
body_lore: "The realm, it—whispers to me. I hear voices, of those I thought long lost. They call me. They ask for me... to meet them. I can no longer ignore these voices. Please, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, I must go to them."
button_0: "Very well, we shall venture there."
button_2: "Focus, Sundren. We have a realm to claim."
title: Dark Losses

saridas_met: "Please, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, I beg you to end this torment. The <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> of my father and brother must not remain trapped on this realm."

"My father and brother, their voices keep haunting me. They keep calling for me, calling me—terrible things. They blame me, they want me to join them. I can't—I can't go through the <hyperlink>Torment of Shadows</hyperlink> again."

body_footer: "Now I have freed my brother and father, I feel strengthened in my quest. Thank you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>. I will not forget this."
body_header: <eventColor>{Sundren.Name}</eventColor> breathes deeply after the spirit of her father and brother have faded. She stares into the distance before she speaks.
body_lore: "My father and brother died because I could not protect them, and during my <hyperlink>Torment of Shadows</hyperlink> I have seen dangers even we <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> can barely comprehend. I must protect those who cannot protect themselves. For this, I must make hard choices, do things others may not understand. And currently that means breaking the curse on my uncle, by any means necessary, so he can lend his aid in turn."
button_0: "Together, we can free this realm."
title: Dark Losses: Aftermath

curse_broken: "My father and brother died because I could not protect them, and during my <hyperlink>Torment of Shadows</hyperlink> I have seen dangers even we <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> can barely comprehend. I must protect those who cannot protect themselves. For this, I must make hard choices, do things others may not understand. This is why I wanted to talk to my uncle. Only he can understand."

body_footer: The people of <eventColor>{EventHouseB.Name}</eventColor> seem very eager to help you crush <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_header: The obliging <eventColor>{EventHouseBLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouseB.Name}</eventColor> offers <<o:EventHouseBLord>> help during your war with <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "Great <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>! It has come to my attention that you have finally seen the true colors of the horrible <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>. I would like to offer you my finest warriors to aid you in your war."
button_0: Welcome the units <unit></unit> from <eventColor>{EventHouseB.Name}</eventColor>.
button_1: Ask them to train <unitprod></unitprod> your own soldiers instead.
button_2: Ask for funds <gold></gold> for your war chest instead.
title: Enemy of Thine Enemy

body_footer: "Now that you know what I am doing here, I must kill you. Meandor must not awaken from the spell I wove."
body_header: <eventColor>{Arachna.TitleName}</eventColor> seems surprised to meet you. "I should have known this day was coming. You caught me, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>."
body_lore:
"Let it be known it was not my intention for {Meandor.FirstName} to turn this realm into a well of Souls. I merely aimed to keep him... distracted."
"Who ordered you to do this?!" {Sundren.FirstName} demands to know. "The Shad'rai?!"
{Arachna.FirstName} answers coldly: "Unlike many others in this web of Godir, I act on my own volition. I saw a problem and I solved it, for now."
button_2: "What spell did you weave?"
button_3: "Enough talk, Arachna! War it is!"
title: Meeting the Spellweaver

body_footer: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> snarls and <eventColor>{Arachna.FirstName}</eventColor> laughs, an unnerving sound. "Perhaps Meandor will trap your <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> here too, after I defeat you."
body_header: <eventColor>{Arachna.FirstName}</eventColor> smiles. "Tricking the legendary <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> was easy, actually. Every <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> has their strings to pull. I merely weave webs with them."
body_lore: "I learned <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> was snooping around the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink>. But I could not defeat <<P:Meandor>> and even if I did, he would undoubtedly crawl back to <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>. So instead, I used the ghosts of his past to keep him occupied. Have you met them yet? His father, especially, was a challenge, since only a fracture of his soul was roaming Auldweald. But I made do."
button_2: "Enough talk, <eventColor>{Arachna.FirstName}</eventColor>! Prepare for battle!"
title: Confession of the Spellweaver

body_footer: You have defeated <eventColor>{Arachna.TitleName}</eventColor>, breaking a part of the spell which kept <eventColor>{Meandor.Name}</eventColor> occupied. The <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> on the realm seem unaffected, however.
body_header: You have defeated <eventColor>{Arachna.TitleName}</eventColor>. Her spiderlings skitter off, chittering in the dark.
body_lore: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> perks up. "A part of the pressure on my mind has lifted. The painful memories, the feelings of grief and wrath... They are slowly diminishing. I still feel them, but I can deal with them, now." <<p:Sundren>> shivers. "The whispers remain, though. We must hurry, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. I fear for the fate of this realm."
button_0: "One step closer to victory."
title: The Spellweaver, Defeated

body_footer: <eventColor>{Arachna.FirstName}</eventColor> laughs, her <eventColor>{ArachnaRace.Name}</eventColor> skittering around her. "Go forth, my children! Make mother proud!"
body_header: You enter the domain of <eventColor>{Arachna.TitleName}</eventColor>. It seems a final battle looms.
body_lore: "Fighting on the front lines is not my preferred style, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>. I take pride in my more... subtle approaches to conflict. However, as you have entered my domain, you leave me no choice. Let us see if your soul lingers in my web as well!"
button_0: "Your days are numbered, Arachna!"
title: Domain of the Spellweaver

body_footer: "I will not fight you, <eventColor>{EventHero.TitleName}</eventColor>. Remove the threads that bind me to the spell cast by that spindly witch, hiding underground."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> enters the tomb dedicated to the Lost Mother, <eventColor>{Eleanor.TitleName}</eventColor>. She herself appears, frustrated.
body_lore: "I was an empress, the wife of <eventColor>{Inioch.TitleName}</eventColor>, returning here after giving life to the crown prince of the <hyperlink>Valley of Wonders</hyperlink>. Now I am used as a mere pawn to bewitch my very own son! I will not stand for this. I demand that you free my son from this disgrace." She gestures and faint lines appear around her, like webbing... or the ropes of a puppeteer.
button_0: Use your connection to death and souls to free the soul of <eventColor>{Eleanor.TitleName}</eventColor> from the spell that affects her.
button_10: Leave the tomb of the <eventColor>{Eleanor.Title}</eventColor>, until you've gathered enough (<eventColor>{EventCheckStrength}</eventColor>) <hyperlink>Affinity</hyperlink> to break the spell.
button_5: Use your mastery of the arcane to reach into the Astral Sea and break the spell.
button_6: Use your powers of growth and healing to undo the curse of death, freeing <eventColor>{Eleanor.TitleName}</eventColor>.
button_7: Call upon the powers of chaos to destroy this spell with fire and old-fashioned violence.
button_8: No curse can withstand holy justice. Invoke your divine powers to break this spell.
button_9: Using your powers of matter, pull the webs into the physical realm to break them.
title: The Lost Mother

body_footer: "Before I go, answer the Empress of the <hyperlink>Valley of Wonders</hyperlink>. Why are you here, on this realm?"
body_header: <eventColor>{Eleanor.TitleName}</eventColor> nods as the webs disappear. "Good. Now I can rest once more."
body_lore: "My <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> visited me often. He has seen so much loss. I fear he even feels guilty for my death, although there is no need. I am at peace. And I am proud to see my child has grown to become even more powerful than Inioch was. Thank you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, for granting me, my son, and the <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> of our proud Elven homeworld the peace they deserve."
button_0: "I am here to save this realm and to release the souls who wander here." <goodact></goodact>
button_3: "I am here to compete with the masters of shadow and death." <shadowboon></shadowboon>
button_4: "I am here to reshape this realm to my vision." <materiumboon></materiumboon>
button_5: "I am here to turn this realm into a paradise once more." <natureboon></natureboon>
button_6: "I am here to test my mettle and claim this realm through contest!" <chaosboon></chaosboon>
button_7: "Because it is a Godir's duty to protect the realms." <orderboon></orderboon>
button_8: "I am here to uncover the many secrets the Astral Sea has to offer." <astralboon></astralboon>
button_9: "I am here to claim this world for myself alone." <evilact></evilact>
title: The Lost Mother: Aftermath

body_footer: <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> pulls in more souls, but with them, other dangers approach from the Astral Sea...
body_header: The fragment of <eventColor>{Inioch.TitleName}</eventColor>, former ruler of the <hyperlink>Athlan</hyperlink> Elven Court, evaporates into thin air. <eventColor>{Meandor.TitleName}</eventColor> appears before you, seething with rage.
body_lore: "You DARE to attack <eventColor>{Inioch.Title}</eventColor> <eventColor>{Inioch.Name}</eventColor>, my father, in his own court?! I should have known, you are all nothing but treacherous wretches, out to destroy everything beautiful in the cursed <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. No matter. I will save all souls of <hyperlink>Auldweald</hyperlink> and the Astral Sea!" Before you can react, <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> raises <<o:Meandor>> arms and pulls in even more <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink>.
button_0: Allow these new dangers to appear.
button_1: Use your magical prowess <mana></mana> to stop the dangers from the Astral Sea from appearing.
button_3: End the curse that tormented Meandor.
title: Defeated <eventColor>{Inioch.TitleName}</eventColor>

meandor_defeated: A part of the curse that affected Meandor is lifted, but the roaming spirits remain. With them, danger approaches from the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>...
quest_done: "These visions... What is happening? Is my mind playing tricks on me? What are you doing to me?" Meandor mutters to himself, confused, as the last part of his curse is broken.

meandor_defeated: The fragment of <eventColor>{Inioch.TitleName}</eventColor>, former ruler of the <hyperlink>Athlan</hyperlink> Elven Court, evaporates into thin air.
quest_done: The fragment of <eventColor>{Inioch.TitleName}</eventColor>, former Ruler of the <hyperlink>Athlan</hyperlink> Elven Court, evaporates into thin air. <eventColor>{Meandor.TitleName}</eventColor> appears before you, bewildered.

meandor_defeated: With the apparition, a powerful spell cast on this realm seems to weaken. With <eventColor>{Meandor.TitleName}</eventColor> already defeated, many <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> sigh a sigh of relief. However, they remain trapped.
quest_done: "You DARE to attack Emperor Inioch, my father, in his own court?! You—You are nothing but invaders, out to get the Elven Court--" he pauses, as the threads from the spell weaken around him. "I—you... My father..."

body_footer: "I believe <eventColor>{Meandor.TitleName}</eventColor> is the cause of all this. His undead consort <eventColor>{Melenis.TitleName}</eventColor> arrived recently and claimed a throne in the south. She may know more."
body_header: <eventColor>{ElfSurvivor.FirstName}</eventColor> inhales deeply. "It all started after <eventColor>{Meandor.TitleName}</eventColor> settled here. He is a savior of many, but I fear he has gone mad."
body_lore: "When <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> arrived in this realm, he was welcomed with open arms, as any Elf would be. However, as time passed he grew more... disturbed. He would mutter about past betrayals and speak to 'people' no-one else saw... But we dared not intervene. Not long after, <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> started to roam."
button_2: "Thank you, <eventColor>{ElfSurvivor.TitleName}</eventColor>."
title: Curse of the Eternal Court

body_footer: "I must protect this realm, every soul. None must leave, all must be preserved. My beloved Elven Court, eternal... as it should be."
body_header: Meandor continues. "There is irony in seeing how mortals rush to their inevitable deaths. So many eternal lives, lost to foolish mortal ambition."
body_lore: "My first attempts to bring back the dead were... flawed. It brought back my father, <eventColor>{Inioch.TitleName}</eventColor>, but he was not the same. The undead have their uses, but they lack - soul. The answer was right in front of us. We were using <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> as currency, whilst they themselves are the key. I must preserve their souls."
button_0: "There is no reasoning with you. To arms!"
button_1: Leave the <eventColor>{Meandor.Title}</eventColor> to his visions... for now.
title: Mutterings of a Mad <eventColor>{Meandor.Title}</eventColor>

body_footer: It seems as though a band of pyromaniacs have claimed this heap of stone, and are now spending their time setting captured wildlife ablaze.
body_header: As <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> approaches the smoking ruins of a once proud castle, <<p:EventHero>> notices a faded sigil above the charred gate.
body_lore: Through the ages, this keep has been home to many beasts and vagabonds, leaving it in ruins. <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> smells smoke as <<p:EventHero>> enters the gate. A red glow illuminates the corridors close to the courtyard where cackling laughter and fearful screaming can be heard. There <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> sees the dancing shadows of a <eventColor>{EnemyUnit.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EnemyUnit>> followers. They are setting several pyres ablaze, to which frightened animals are tied.
button_0: Attack the firestarters!
button_1: Use your magical prowess <mana></mana> to protect your army from the blaze before entering.
button_2: Leave.
button_3: Channel water to douse the flames before entering.
title: Smoke and Ruins

hero_is_playerle: As you approach the smoking ruins of a once proud castle, you notice a faded sigil above the charred gate.

Through the ages, this keep has been home to many beasts and vagabonds, leaving it in ruins. You smell smoke as you enter the gate. A red glow illuminates the corridors close to the courtyard where cackling laughter and fearful screaming can be heard. There you see the dancing shadows of a <eventColor>{EnemyUnit.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EnemyUnit>> followers. They are setting several pyres ablaze, to which frightened animals are tied.
Use your magical prowess <mana></mana> to protect yourself and your army from the blaze before entering.

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor> you have discovered seems to belong to <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_header: With the pyromaniacs gone, <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventHero>> companions are free to search the rest of the ruins.
body_lore: <<g:soldiers,EventHero>> free the tormented animals, who quickly flee the keep. Upon further inspection, <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> notices that the pyromancers left behind stashes of scorched loot throughout the building. Among it <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> discovers a <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor>, engraved with the same sigil as <<p:EventHero>> saw above the castle gate. It looks very valuable once <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> has wiped away the soot.
button_0: Finders, keepers. <item></item>
button_1: Return the <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor> to <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: Display the <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor> in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
title: Smoke and Ruins: Aftermath

no_house: The origins of the <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor> you have discovered are unknown.
no_house_playerl: The origins of the <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor> you have discovered are unknown.

hero_is_playerle: With the pyromaniacs gone, you and your companions are free to search the rest of the ruins.

Your soldiers free the tormented animals, who quickly flee the keep. Upon further inspection You notice that the pyromancers left behind stashes of scorched loot throughout the building. Among it you discover a <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor>, engraved with the same sigil as you saw above the castle gate. It looks very valuable once you have wiped away the soot.

body_footer: "We are merely traders of a... specific livestock. Are you interested in our merchandise?"
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> approaches the castle carefully. It seems abandoned, but distraught voices can be heard from within the castle walls.
body_lore: Inside <<p:EventHero>> notices caged animals and a group of scared captives, bound and guarded by captors led by a <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor>. The latter sees <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> and bows. "Ah, a customer!" <<p:EnemyUnit>> says with a sly grin. "Welcome to our humble merchant caravan."
button_0: Attack the captors!
button_1: "We will buy <gold></gold> your stock. All of it."
button_2: Leave.
button_3: Destroy the locks on the animals' cages before engaging the captors.
button_4: "You had better flee before you invoke the wrath of the spirits haunting this keep!"
title: Castles and Captives

hero_is_playerle: You approach the castle carefully. It seems abandoned, but distraught voices can be heard from within the castle walls.

Inside, you notice caged animals and a group of scared captives, bound and guarded by captors led by a <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor>. The latter sees <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> and bows, grinning slyly. "Ah, a customer!" <<p:EnemyUnit>> says. "Welcome to our humble merchant caravan."
"I will buy <gold></gold> your stock. All of it."

body_footer:
Sundren whimpers as the spirits beckon her.
"Join us in death. Join us in eternity. You know you want to."
body_header: You meet the ghosts of two regal Elves, ruling the ghostly city of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>. <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> gasps. "Father! <eventColor>{Thannis.FirstName}</eventColor>! This... this isn't possible..."
body_lore:
"Hello, Sundren," the {Saridas.Title} and his son, {Thannis.FirstName} say in unison. "Daughter, sister. It has been a long time. We have missed you."
{Sundren.FirstName} recoils, covering her ears. "No," she begs, "make it stop..."
"You did not save us," the two spirits continue, "when we were betrayed, when we were killed. You were weak, tried to hide your dark side. You can unmask, now. Join us."
button_3: "Do not listen to them, Sundren! We must fight to release them from their curse!"
title: Dark Losses: Father and Brother

body_footer: The captives from <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> anxiously await their fate.
body_header: The slavers are gone and the surviving captives gather around <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: From amidst the captives, a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> steps forward. "We are civilians under the protection of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>." <<p:EventUnit>> says. "We were ambushed on the roads near this castle and brought here... What do you plan to do with us?"
button_0: Capture the civilians yourself <evilact></evilact>, intimidating <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>. Surprise!
button_1: Release the civilians to return to <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: "The soldiers <unitprod></unitprod> from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> will escort you home to <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>." <goodact></goodact>
button_3: "Soldiers <unitprod></unitprod> from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> will escort you home." <goodact></goodact>
button_4: Send the civilians on their way.
title: Castles and Captives: Aftermath

no_house: The released captives are grateful for your arrival. How do you proceed?
no_house_playerl: The released captives are grateful for your arrival. How do you proceed?

We are eternally grateful for the rescue, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>!"

hero_is_playerle: "My soldiers <unitprod></unitprod> from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> will escort you home to <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>." <goodact></goodact>

body_footer: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> embraces her father and brother one last time, before they fade away.
body_header: The ghost of <eventColor>{Saridas.TitleName}</eventColor> is defeated. He and <eventColor>{Thannis.FirstName}</eventColor> appear in front of <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> one last time.
body_lore:
"We can see clearly, now that we are freed from this realm. We are sorry, {Sundren.FirstName}. We did not intend to fight you -this realm, it affects the soul. Thank you for releasing us."
{Thannis.FirstName} steps forward. "We must go now. I see a darkness in you, sister. Do not let it overtake your heart. Honor me by protecting those who cannot protect themselves." He smiles.

"Someday, we will meet again."
title: Bittersweet Goodbyes

body_footer: "Welcome, intruders!" <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> grins. "Have you come to reignite the flames of our passion with your essence?"
body_header: It is said only fools would disturb the eternal bedchambers of <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>> <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor>. This, however, does not stop <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: In the center of the tomb <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> finds a large altar with several preserved corpses draped around a decorated <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>>, looking like sleeping lovers even after centuries of being buried. Suddenly the decorated corpse stirs and opens <<o:EnemyUnit>> eyes, <<o:EnemyUnit>> undead lovers following suit. Raspy voices echo through the tomb as they arise and beckon <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>.
button_0: "This debauchery must end! To arms!"
button_1: "I give you the essence of the people <population></population> of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>." <evilact></evilact>
button_2: Leave.
button_3: Use your knowledge of the undead to weaken the <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>> and <<o:EnemyUnit>> companions before attacking.
button_4: "You call this passion? Watch me..."
title: Eternal Bedchambers

hero_is_playerle: It is said only fools would disturb the eternal bedchambers of <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>> <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor>. This, however, does not stop you.

In the center of the tomb you find a large altar with several preserved corpses draped around a decorated <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>>, looking like sleeping lovers even after centuries of being buried. Suddenly the decorated corpse stirs and opens <<o:EnemyUnit>> eyes, <<o:EnemyUnit>> undead lovers following suit. Raspy voices echo through the tomb as they arise and beckon you.

body_footer: The lich <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>> bows. "I am yours, <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>, as is my wealth. I no longer have need of it."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> has defeated the undead <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>> and <<o:EnemyUnit>> lovers. The <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>> rises once more and claps <<o:EnemyUnit>> hands, impressed.
body_lore: <<Co:EnemyUnit>> raspy voice once again echoes through the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>. "You have impressed me, <<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>>. Not many are able to do so. You have ignited passions within me I had long forgotten. For that, I wish to thank you."
button_0: Take <<o:EnemyUnit>> <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> and leave the undead <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>>.
button_1: "Rest now forever, <eventColor>{EnemyUnit.Name}</eventColor>. That is all I can ask." <goodact></goodact>
button_2: Recruit <eventColor>{EnemyUnit.Name}</eventColor> <unit></unit> later.
button_3: Ask <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> to share <<o:EnemyUnit>> ancient knowledge <knowledge></knowledge> before leaving <<P:EnemyUnit>> to rest.
button_4: Recruit <eventColor>{EnemyUnit.Name}</eventColor>. <unit></unit>
title: Eternal Bedchambers: Aftermath

hero_is_playerle: The lich <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>> bows. "I am yours, o <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, as is my wealth. I no longer have need of it."

You have defeated the undead <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>> and <<o:EnemyUnit>> lovers. The <<EnemyUnit<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>> rises once more and claps <<o:EnemyUnit>> hands, impressed.

<<Co:EnemyUnit>> raspy voice once again echoes through the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>. "You have impressed me, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. Not many are able to do so. You have ignited passions within me I had long forgotten. For that, I wish to thank you."

body_footer: "I have tried to investigate, but I could not venture far. Nevertheless, I will share everything I know."
body_header: You meet <eventColor>{ElfSurvivor.TitleName}</eventColor>, who leads what seems to be the few remaining living souls on this realm. "Thank the Allfather for your arrival, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>!"
body_lore: "The Eternal Court, this realm on our beloved homeworld, was once a beautiful place," <eventColor>{ElfSurvivor.FirstName}</eventColor> laments. "Now, a terrible curse has taken it. <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> of the dead roam like the living. Many who lived here either fled or perished themselves, their souls unable to move on. Something - or someone, is keeping them here."
button_0: "Go on..."
title: Meeting the Elves of Auldweald

body_footer: "Nothing you can say can convince me now. This is war, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader}</eventColor> harrumphs. "You wage war against the fair <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> in this realm and now claim my goddess is the evil one?!"
body_lore: <<Cp:EventPlayerLeader>> grinds <<o:EventPlayerLeader>> teeth. "I must respect the rules of negotiation, so I will not strike you down where you stand. You chose to defeat the <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> I was sworn to protect. Nothing you say about the <eventColor>{EventNimue.Title}</eventColor> can convince me. I grant you this chance of leaving, or to gather your armies."
button_0: "So be it."
title: Too Late for Reason

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventRuler.TitleName}</eventColor> offers <<o:EventRuler>> aid as a <hyperlink><<EventRuler<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink> under your command in this realm! Do you accept?
body_header: You receive a message from <eventColor>{EventRuler.TitleName}</eventColor>, sent through the far currents of the Astral Sea.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, I received word about your campaign in this realm. I am impressed by your efforts and hereby formally offer my aid. Allow me to fight as your <hyperlink><<EventRuler<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink>. Together we shall claim this realm and show all <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> the power of our <hyperlink>Pantheon</hyperlink>!"
button_0: "I welcome your aid, <eventColor>{EventRuler.TitleName}</eventColor>!" <unit></unit>
button_1: Currently, I cannot accommodate your arrival, but I will welcome your aid in the future. <eventColor>{EventRuler.TitleName}</eventColor>."
button_2: "I do not need for help from other Godir at this moment."
title: A Godir's Aid

body_footer: Will you commit to building more <farm></farm> <hyperlink>Farm</hyperlink> per the proposal of the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>?
body_header: The <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> Council sends their chief deputy to meet you with a request.
body_lore: The deputy bows deeply before <<p:EventUnit>> speaks. "If the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> are to be victorious in this realm, we need to grow our borders, expand our cities... feed our people. In order to do so, your Council proposes to claim more farmland. Your empire will grow and your people will be grateful."
button_0: "Very well. I shall see to it that more farmland is cultivated."
button_1: "Wanton expansion is not the only path toward victory. Soon, you will learn."
button_2: "Satisfaction only leads to meekness. I need my people hungry, ready to fight <unitprod></unitprod> for their next meal!"
title: Quest for Cultivation

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> requests the release of <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> from your prison.
body_header: You receive a plea from <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> regarding their imprisoned hero <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "We know you hold <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> captive. We may just be one city compared to your grand empire, but <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> is a great <hyperlink><<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink>, an example to our city and all <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>. <<Cp:EventHero>> should not languish in a prison cell. Do the honorable thing. Allow <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> to return to <<o:EventHero>> people."
button_0: Release <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>.
button_1: Demand a ransom <gold></gold> before releasing <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>.
button_2: Reject the request to release <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>.
button_3: "You appeal to my honor? <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> will die for your insolence! <evilact></evilact>"
title: Let <<P:EventHero>> Go

body_footer: Your people are grateful for this prosperity and gather to hear your wisdom. What message do you proclaim to your <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>?
body_header: The first sowing of the season has passed, and returned to you a pleased <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> Council deputy.
body_lore: "A grand day for the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>!" The deputy proclaims. "With this new farmland our people thrive and our cities will expand greatly. Your wisdom truly knows no bounds, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. The Council of the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> is grateful."
button_0: "Nurture the crops <food></food> that I have given you."
button_1: "Magic is what drives us. Bring offerings to the spirits <mana></mana> of the land."
button_3: "True honor for the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> lies in military service." <unitprod></unitprod>
title: Quest for Cultivation: Aftermath

body_footer: "Give us what we want, and we will remember your generosity the next time the winds and tides bring us to <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>."
body_header: Dreaded pirates from an <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> are intruding in your domain near <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>! They demand a parlay.
body_lore: Their captain, a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, greets you. "Greetings, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. We are proud sailors, we travel the sea and take what we want with her blessing. And now her benevolent tides have brought us to the shores of your fine city of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, with the promise of gold... Of course, there is no need for violence, if we can come to an agreement."
button_0: Pay <gold></gold> the pirates so they leave <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
button_1: Offer enough gold <gold></gold> to appease the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor> for a while.
button_2: "You are nothing more than brigands on boats. Your ships will break on the shores of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>."
button_3: "I have a better offer. Become my privateers <influence></influence> and enjoy the luxuries of looting under my banner!"
title: Benevolent Tides

body_footer: "Perhaps, together, we can convince <<P:EventPlayerLeader>> of Nimue's true nature... If you prove yourself to be truly different from her."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of the <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> greets you. "I must admit, I am happy to meet you. Did <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> send you?"
body_lore: "I am an old friend of <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> and one of <<o:EventPlayerLeader>> most trusted advisors. We have supported each other through many hardships, including the moment when <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor> first discarded my people, and soon after, <<o:EventPlayerLeader>>... Although <eventColor>{EventPlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> still denies the truth. Myself-- I had my time to grieve. Now, I merely wish for the freedom of the people on this realm."
button_0: Enter negotiations with <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: Leave them to their survival.
title: Meeting <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>, Voice Of Reason

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> desperately pleads to be released from your prison.
body_header: Prison guards relay a message from <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>, who has been your prisoner for a while.
body_lore: "Resisting the great <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor> was a grave mistake," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> says. "I see that now. I can no longer go on like this, I was not born to die in chains. Please, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, I can give information, knowledge, I will do anything if you let me breathe fresh air again!"
button_0: "Swear loyalty to me, then I will release you." <unit></unit>

button_1: "We have a message for your <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor>."
button_2: "Your suspicions are correct! To arms!"
button_3: "At ease, we are merely passing through..."
title: Not a Step Closer!

hero_is_playerle: These soldiers from <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> clearly do not trust your intentions.
Hostile guards from <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> call out from defensive positions when you approach.

"Halt, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>! Not a step closer!" their leader shouts, arms crossed, standing in front of <<g:banner,EventHouse>>. "You can't fool or intimidate us. We heard all about you! We'll be keeping an eye on you, so don't try anything!"
"I have a message for your <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor>."
