body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> requests the body of <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> so they can bury <<P:EventHero>> in their own crypt.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> has a request for you regarding <<o:EventHouseLord>> deceased hero <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>, resting in your <hyperlink>Crypt</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "We entrusted our beloved <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> to you, and now <<p:EventHero>> has died a hero’s death under your command. Please, allow us to take <<P:EventHero>> home so <<p:EventHero>> can rest with <<o:EventHero>> ancestors."
button_0: Deliver the body of <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> to <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> will stay here."
title: Final Journey Home

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> asks you to perform special funeral rites that will mean <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> can never be resurrected.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> has a request regarding <<o:EventHouseLord>> deceased hero <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>, resting in your <hyperlink>Crypt</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "We are in deep mourning for <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>, but we firmly believe the dead must rest forever. We of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> share the tradition of performing funeral rites that ensure no necromancy can taint our <hyperlink>fallen brethren</hyperlink> on their journey through the afterlife. We humbly ask you to honor that tradition and conduct the rite for <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>, who has served you so well."
button_0: Perform the funeral rites <mana></mana> and send <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> to <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>.
button_1: Deliver <<G:body,EventHero>> to <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> where they will perform the rites.
button_2: "I cannot perform these rites for <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>."
button_3: "Foolish mortals. Let me educate you in the blessings of undeath."
title: Funeral Rites

body_footer: Do you let the scared <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and other creatures go, or attack them regardless?
body_header: Your troops engage the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> minions, but they cower in fear rather than put up a fight.
body_lore: Most of them try to hide, while others huddle on the ground. They seem to be begging for mercy through panicked hisses and cries.
button_0: Attack! <evilact></evilact>
button_1: Let them go. <goodact></goodact>
title: Fight or Flight

body_footer: Hungry, wild animals threaten the borders of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
body_header: Your villagers from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> report concerning sightings...
body_lore: "Beasts, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>! We saw them lurking in the dark, and we found dead livestock on our fields. These beasts are driven by hunger, and almost took the mason's son when he went into the woods! If we don't do something, they're sure to attack our homes next! Think of the children, my <eventColor>{Player.Title}</eventColor>. Think of the mason's son!"
button_0: "Poison some food <food></food> and leave it for the animals in the fields."
button_1: "Poison enough food <food></food> to drive them back to their <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor>."
button_2: "Let them come, we are not afraid of a few hungry beasts."
title: Lurking in the Wilds

body_footer: How do you wish to celebrate this fruitful feat?
body_header: The harvest in the domain of your city <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> has been bountiful this year.
body_lore: The city is well-known for its impressive agriculture, and now it has outdone even itself. Food stalls turn the grand square into a maze filled with aromas and flavors, as children parade the streets with baskets full of the latest yield. There is no doubt that all of the other rulers are in awe of this display of prosperity.
button_0: Sell <gold></gold> the extra produce from this year's harvest.
button_1: Donate the excesses of this year's harvest with your poorest families. <goodact></goodact>
button_2: Commemorate the laborers of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> <happiness></happiness> for their hard work.
button_3: Throw lavish parties for the lesser Lords <influence></influence> in this realm.
title: Harvest Festival

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> freezes when an ear-piercing shriek resounds through the cave and the same bloodthirsty <eventColor>{EnemyUnit.Name}</eventColor> emerges from the dark, <<o:EnemyUnit>> rabid eyes fixed on <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>.
body_header: As <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> approaches the cave, <<p:EventHero>> smells fresh blood, but finds no signs of life.
body_lore: Having entered the cave, <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> and <<o:EventHero>> companions find the remains of a brutal fight. The carcass of an adult <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> lies alongside her offspring; the two of them appear to have been ambushed in what was supposed to be a safe haven. Upon closer inspection, it looks as though the animals were viciously attacked by a wild <eventColor>{EnemyUnit.Name}</eventColor>.
button_0: "No time to waste! Attack!"
button_1: Try and calm the crazed <eventColor>{EnemyUnit.Name}</eventColor> before putting it down.
button_2: Feed the beast <food></food> until it can barely move, then attack.
button_3: Flee.
title: Cave of Carnage

hero_is_playerle: You freeze when an ear-piercing shriek resounds through the cave and the same bloodthirsty <eventColor>{EnemyUnit.Name}</eventColor> emerges from the dark, <<o:EnemyUnit>> rabid eyes fixed on you...
As you approach the cave, you smell fresh blood, but find no signs of life.

Having entered the cave, you and your companions find the remains of a brutal fight. The carcass of an adult <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> lies alongside her offspring; the two of them appear to have been ambushed in what was supposed to be a safe haven. Upon closer inspection, it looks as though the animals were viciously attacked by a wild <eventColor>{EnemyUnit.Name}</eventColor>.

body_footer: A young <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> has survived the carnage at the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> and clings to <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>.
body_header: The wild threat has been dealt with and <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> has the opportunity to search the cave.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> orders the bodies of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> and her offspring to be removed. As others go to lift the heavy animal, something softly whines from underneath it — and a young <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> emerges, the sole survivor of the pack. It seems as though its mother's body protected it from harm. It looks up to <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> and whines again.
button_0: Keep the <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> and raise it as your mount. <mount></mount>
button_1: Nurse the <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> to strength and release it into the wild. <goodact></goodact>
button_2: The hide of this <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> would make a for a very fine <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor> <item></item>...
title: Cave of Carnage: Aftermath

hero_is_playerle: A young <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> has survived the carnage at the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> and clings to you.
The wild threat has been dealt with and you have the opportunity to search the cave.

You order the bodies of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> and her offspring to be removed. As others go to lift the heavy animal, something softly whines from underneath it — and a young <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> emerges, the sole survivor of the pack. It seems as though its mother's body protected it from harm. It looks up to you and whines again.

body_footer: You are invited to celebrate the name day of <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor>. What gift will you bring?
body_header: You receive an official invitation from the friendly <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "The great <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>! We of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> hereby humbly invite you to join the name day celebration of our <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor>. We would be honored if you would attend, and we look forward to your gift."
button_0: Order your finest artists <gold></gold> to paint a flattering portrait of <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor>.
button_1: A small trinket <gold></gold> will suffice.
button_2: Present the <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> with a tamed beast from the homeland of the <eventColor>{PlayerRace.Name}</eventColor>.
button_3: Make an excuse to not attend the celebration.
button_4: "My gift is that <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> is allowed to live another day." <evilact></evilact>
title: Name Day Celebration

body_footer: "I ask you to kindly lend me your cooks, to teach my people how to make a proper meal."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> has a question regarding your <<gu:cuisine,EventRace>>.
body_lore: "We have heard stories about the delicacies made by the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>. Delightful appetizers, roasts worthy of a song, desserts to die for... Meanwhile, I sit here, eating dry bread and raw meat, because my cooks do not know how to make a decent meal. This cannot go on. The <eventColor>{EventHouseRace.Name}</eventColor> must be educated in the culinary arts!"
button_0: "Very well. Chefs <food></food> from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> will instruct yours for a time."
button_1: What a perfect opportunity to poison the citizens of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>... <evilact></evilact>
button_2: "I have my own people to feed..."
button_3: "I propose a trade. Your builders <structureprod></structureprod> for my chefs <food></food>."
title: Culinary Curiosity

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> bows. "I bow before your arcane expertise, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, and humbly ask for your scholars to instruct mine."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> has heard of your progress in education and knowledge.
body_lore: "Every time I hear about <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, I am amazed by your newest arcane breakthrough. It seems like you are advancing by leaps and bounds, while we still crawl like newborn babes. Would you, the brilliant <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, be interested in educating my people, so that we may follow you on this path of knowledge?"
button_0: "Knowledge should be shared. Scholars from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> <knowledge></knowledge> will enlighten yours."
button_2: "I need all my scholars at my side..."
button_3: "I will personally tutor you, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor>."
button_4: "Scholars from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> <knowledge></knowledge> will enlighten yours, for a fee." <gold></gold>
title: Knowledge Sharing

body_footer: "It would certainly put the citizens of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> at ease if they saw the great <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> you are."
body_header: Your supporter, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>, ponders your diplomatic bonds.
body_lore: "It has been an honor to get acquainted with you, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> basks in your glory. Yet, there are still those who question our bond with you. Some of my citizens are... wary of you. My word alone is not enough to convince them."
button_0: Use your influence <influence></influence> to promote yourself in <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: Give an eloquent speech to delight <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
button_3: "It is not my responsibility to convince your people."
button_4: Send a sizeable gift <gold></gold> to <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> to appease the citizens.
title: Bonds and Benevolence

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> looks at you, jaw clenched and slightly trembling. "Others dare not defy you, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>... but I will!"
body_header: The critical <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> stands before you, defiantly.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. For too long, the good people of this realm have bowed to you. No more! No longer shall we be inveigled or intimidated by you. <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> will stand against the blight you cast upon this realm!"
button_0: "If you want a war with a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, so be it!"
button_1: Attempt to mend your diplomatic relations <influence></influence> with <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: "Remember that you address a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. Mind your tone, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor>"
title: Daring Defiance

body_footer: "Please, share some of your architectural wisdom with me, so I can protect my citizens!"
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> appears before you, concerned about the defenses of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, I have long been impressed by your feats of construction and humbly ask for your help. My building plans have seen some delays, and now <<g:defenses,EventHouse>> are falling behind. With rising tensions in the realm, I fear my city may not withstand a siege, were such a thing to happen."
button_0: "My builders <structureprod></structureprod> from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> will support yours for a while."
button_1: "I will personally help you with your defenses."
button_3: "My builders <structureprod></structureprod> will help you, for the right tribute <gold></gold>."
button_4: "You admit your weakness. A foolish mistake. Rally the troops!" <evilact></evilact>
button_5: "I will not share the secrets of my defenses with you."
title: Decaying Defenses

body_footer: "I beg of you, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. Lend me some of your wisdom to save <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> from an uprising."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of malevolent <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> is in a somber mood.
body_lore: "I don't understand, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>!" <<cp:EventHouseLord>> says. "I thought I was doing everything right. I hanged those who sowed dissent, banished those who spoke ill of me. And yet my citizens grow more and more angry every day. They are at my gates as we speak, shouting about tyranny. But you, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>... Everyone respects you."
button_0: "My envoys <influence></influence> will help to improve your legacy."
button_1: "Convincing people requires hard work and sacrifice, not gallows and banishments." <goodact></goodact>
button_2: "I need to focus on my people. You should do the same."
title: Pursuit of Happiness

body_footer: "I plead for your support and would be forever grateful."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> seems desperate.
body_lore: "Noble <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, I am ruined. I have gotten myself and my people into debt. My treasury lies empty, and my former benefactors are out for my blood. They have taken members of my family hostage, making threats of mutilation and death."
button_0: "To err is mortal. Tell me how much <gold></gold> you need."
button_1: "I will help you to make your lands more profitable."
button_2: "Your family will pay the consequences of your actions."
button_3: "Your creditors shall meet a painful end."
title: Debt and Death

body_footer: Do you acknowledge the farmers' concerns regarding <<g:agriculture,EventCity.Name>>?
body_header: Your farmers from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> declare that there's an issue with their yields.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, we farmers are your humble servants, but it seems we aren't enough to support your ambitions. We hear tales about <eventColor>{EventGoldenCity.Name}</eventColor>, where the pastures are greener, and the people have food to last them forever. We struggle to feed our children, and there they feast like kings. Why can't we live like them? Why aren't we thriving like they are?"
button_0: Improve <gold></gold> these peasant's tools to secure better yields <food></food>.
button_1: Swear <influence></influence> to assign temporary laborers <population></population> to the fields.
button_2: Consult your lore to increase the quality of the crops and yields.
button_3: Ignore their concerns.
title: Greener Pastures

body_footer: It seems <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> and your empire have become a laughing stock regarding its level of education.
body_header: A council member from your city <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> approaches you, waving a pamphlet.
body_lore: "We received this pamphlet from <eventColor>{EventGoldenCity.Name}</eventColor>, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>! It took a while to decipher, but I believe they are laughing at us and calling us idiots! What does "dulbert" even mean? Is that even a word? We can't just let them insult us like this, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. There must be something we can do to prove them wrong..."
button_0: Invest <gold></gold> in educating <knowledge></knowledge> the citizens of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
button_1: <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> needs schools. Swear <influence></influence> to recruit more builders. <production></production>
button_2: Tutor the citizens of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> yourself for a while.
button_3: Do not get involved.
title: Eloquent Insult

body_footer: How would you have the winner serve you?
body_header: A local tournament is hosted at your city <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: The city is well known for its local military prowess, and it shows. Cheers echo through the streets as contestants clash in the city square. Although each round is harmless in nature, the duels get more serious as victory draws closer. Eventually one contestant, a <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor>, kneels before you, badly bruised but victorious!
button_0: The winner shall be your gladiator. As patron, you claim the spoils <gold></gold>!
button_1: Hire the winner to instruct recruits <unitprod></unitprod> in the arts of battle.
button_2: Congratulate and praise the winner <happiness></happiness> for <<o:EventUnit>> well-deserved victory.
button_3: Allow the winning <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> <unit></unit> to join your army.
title: Bread and Circuses

body_footer: What will you say to end the escalating argument between <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{EventHouseBLord.TitleName}</eventColor>?
body_header: During diplomatic negotiations, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> invites you and <eventColor>{EventHouseBLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouseB}</eventColor> to an evening of friendly chatter.
body_lore:
As the evening progresses, {EventHouseLord} and {EventHouseBLord} start to argue.
"The Astral Sea is a flat plane, you dolt!" {EventHouseLord.FirstName} yells, gesturing wildly.

"No, it behaves like a sphere, stretching in every direction!" {EventHouseBLord.FirstName} slams <> hands on the table.

Then both turn to you, expecting a {PlayerLeader.Title} to settle their quarrel.
button_0: "<eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> is right. The Astral Sea is flat."
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventHouseBLord.Name}</eventColor> makes a compelling argument. It looks more like a sphere."
button_3: Appeal to their friendship <influence></influence> to quell the debate.
button_4: Cast a projection of the Astral Sea that is flat AND spherical.
title: Heated Debate

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> offers you the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. "I took the weapon for you, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, to help you gain victory!"
body_header: Before resuming diplomatic negotiations, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> accuses one of your <hyperlink>Heroes</hyperlink>. "<eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> stole my coveted <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor>!"
body_lore:
{EventHouseLord.TitleName} is fuming. "I would not accuse anyone of theft without proof, my {PlayerLeader.Title}. But two of my servants caught {EventHero.Name} in the act! I trust in your judgment and expect the weapon to be returned to me post haste."

Upon inquiry {EventHero.FirstName} immediately admits the theft to you without any regret.
button_0: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> is right. Keep the <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor>. <item></item>
button_1: Secretly sell <gold></gold> the <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor> before <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> accuses you further.
button_2: Return a forgery of the <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor> to <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>. Keep the original. <item></item>
button_3: Make <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> formally apologize <happiness></happiness>. <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> receives the <eventColor>{EventItem.Name}</eventColor>.
button_4: Return the weapon and send <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> to <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> for punishment.
title: Sticky Fingers

body_footer: <<Cp:EventStackLeader>> gestures at you. "Would you care to play a tune?"
body_header: The troops of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> stationed at the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> are listening to a musical performance.
body_lore: The soft strains of music reach the ears of <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> when <<p:EventHero>> draws closer. A <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> looks up and approaches. "Please, tarry with us a while. We were just enjoying some sweet melodies played by our highly talented friends. You serve <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, do you not? A <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> who knows something of culture! Pray tell. Are you skilled in the musical arts as well?"
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> will agree <influence></influence> to leave this location to me."
button_2: "My music will bring you to tears. In return, you will grant me the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>."
button_3: "The only instruments I play are the drums of war! Attack!"
button_4: "We're just appreciating the music. Please, do go on..."
title: Sweet Melodies

hero_is_playerle: The soft strains of music reach your ears when you draw closer. A <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> looks up and approaches you. "Please, tarry with us a while. A <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> who knows something of culture! Pray tell. Are you refined in the musical arts as well?"

body_footer: "I know we're supposed to be guarding this location, but you're good folk, right? Have a drink!"
body_header: The troops of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> are dancing around the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> and barely notice the approach of <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: The troops were meant to guard the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, but instead they are celebrating. "Our general got married, so we have the day off duty," says the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> when <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> inquires about their behavior. "Well, he didn't really give us the day off... but we seized the initiative and took it off anyway. Join us!"
button_0: "Your <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> won't mind <influence></influence> if you take even more time off."
button_1: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> joins the party to trick them into giving up the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>...
button_2: "In this distracted state they will be easy pickings! Attack!"
button_3: "We will be on our way, have fun..."
title: Work Hard, Feast Hard

hero_is_playerle: "I know we're supposed to be guarding this location... but you understand, right, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>? Have a drink!"
The troops of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> are dancing around the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> and barely notice your approach.

Join the festivities to trick them into signing the location over to you...

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>'s scouts found a hidden weak spot in the city's foundations. What does <<p:EventHero>> do with the information?
body_header: During the siege of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> led by your <hyperlink><<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>, <<o:EventHero>> scouts return with exciting news.
body_lore: "We found a weakness in the southern wall, my <eventColor>{EventHero.Title}</eventColor>," the scout proudly proclaims, after catching his breath. "Its foundations are crumbling, and it's barely being supported. All it will take is some concentrated effort to tip the scales—and the wall—in our favor!"
button_0: "Put some extra effort <structureprod></structureprod> into assaulting these weakened defenses!"
button_1: "With some well-placed precision attacks, we may break through..."
button_2: "We will continue as we did before."
title: Shaky Foundations

hero_is_playerle: Your scouts found a hidden weak spot in the city's foundations. Do you want to use it to your advantage?
During the siege of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, your scouts return with exciting news.

"We found a weakness in the southern wall, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>," the scout proudly proclaims, after catching his breath. "Its foundations are crumbling, and it's barely being supported. All it will take is some concentrated effort to tip the scales—and the wall—in our favor!"

body_footer: "Our reluctance to obey forced us into this life of savagery," the deserters claim, "but we will fight for what is right and survive, we will even claim <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> itself if we have to!"
body_header: A group of <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>, who are deserters, have claimed an area near <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> and are now threatening your citizens!
body_lore:
They steal from villages surrounding {EventCity.Name} and despoil travelers who enter their "territory." Despite this, they now profess a love for peace.

"Lay down your weapons. We mean no harm! We refused to fight in hopeless wars, and now we're shunned everywhere we go. But we will fight for a righteous cause—our freedom!"
button_0: Help the encroaching group to find refuge in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, despite public protest <happiness></happiness>. <goodact></goodact>
button_1: Allow all willing deserters from the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor> to live in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, upsetting the populace <happiness></happiness>. <goodact></goodact>
button_2: "We do not fear or share sympathy for deserters who threaten <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>."
button_3: Order your garrison <unitprod></unitprod> to hunt down the group threatening <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> directly.
button_4: Promise all willing deserters sanctuary in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, then execute them for their crimes.<evilact></evilact>
title: Shunned Deserters

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> stands firm before your might. "Give us the information we seek, or we will have to resort to more extreme measures."
body_header: A group of bandits who call themselves "aspiring astral travelers" are encroaching on your borders near <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "We have toiled in this damned realm long enough. We're looking for a way to leave, and the only safe way to do so seems to be through something called "<hyperlink>World Gates</hyperlink>" to the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. We know that you <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> know how to build them. We want that knowledge! We’ll take it by force if necessary. Anything so we can get to paradise!"
button_0: Grant these "travelers" limited access to your knowledge <knowledge></knowledge> to keep them busy... for now.
button_1: Allow these "travelers" to learn what they want <knowledge></knowledge>, quelling the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor> for a while.
button_2: If they dare approach <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> they will know the true cost of knowledge.
title: Astral Aspirations

body_footer: Creatures threaten to infest <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> and only seem to be appeased with sweets and pastries.
body_header: A group of creatures led by a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> is threatening your villages near <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, driven by a particular craving.
body_lore: According to local folklore, the creatures hunt for villagers, unless they are placated with sweets and other sugary goods. Villagers have resorted to leaving piles of confections in offering at the edges of the empire, in hopes of appeasing the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor>, but it seems the <<g:cravings,EventStackLeader>> for sweets are not so easily satisfied...
button_0: Gather some sweets <food></food> to appease those closest to <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
button_1: Gather all the pastries <food></food> the city can muster to satiate the entire <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor> for a while.
button_2: Let them come, our revenge shall be sweeter than any confection.
title: Sweet Cravings

body_footer: "Give shinies!" The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> roars, "or <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> eat!" <<o:EventStackLeader>> <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> sniffs and growls, moving closer and closer to <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
body_header: A nearby group of <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> pets are getting closer and closer to <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, your city.
body_lore: The message of the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> is simple. "<eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> smell shinies. Sniff sniff. <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> finds. I take. If little <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> keep shinies, <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> eat <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>. Then I take."
button_0: Appease this <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> with some gold shiny <gold></gold>.
button_1: Leave enough shiny gold <gold></gold> for the entire <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor> to be satisfied for a long time.
button_2: "I do not give into petty demands like these. Let them come."
title: Scent of Gold

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> wonders if <<p:EventHero>> should allow the summoning ritual to continue, or stop it before it is too late.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventHero>> retinue approach the grand <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, decorated with depictions of stern-looking <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> hears eerie chanting coming from within and espies a group of hooded figures performing some sort of ritual. Suddenly, a blood-curdling scream echoes through the temple. The group is summoning something... Something big, and otherworldly. <<Cg:companions,EventHero>> swallow nervously as they look on, awaiting orders.
button_0: "Stop this ritual NOW! To arms!"
button_1: Delay the ritual for as long as possible <mana></mana> and attack.
button_2: Leave.
button_3: "Faith will help us in delaying this desecration!"
button_4: Take over the ritual. Whatever is summoned belongs to you.
title: Scrolls of Terror

hero_is_playerle: You wonder if you should allow the summoning ritual to continue, or stop it before it is too late...
You and your retinue approach the grand <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, decorated with depictions of stern-looking <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>.

You hear eerie chanting coming from within and espy a group of hooded figures performing some sort of ritual. Suddenly, a blood-curdling scream echoes through the temple. This group is summoning something... Something big, and otherworldly. Your companions swallow nervously as they look on, awaiting orders.

body_footer: The demonic scroll is silent, and yet incredibly captivating. So much knowledge rests within...
body_header: With the cultists gone and their ritual undone, the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> at last falls silent and <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> is free to investigate.
body_lore: The cultists were not praising the deities for whom the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> was built at all. A malicious-looking scroll sits in the center of the ritual circle: an artifact used to summon beings from a world called Obbadoth, bearing illustrations of beings like <<m:EventUnit>>. It seems the cultists were using this scroll to call on this demonic power.
button_0: The knowledge <knowledge></knowledge> contained within this fiendish scroll could certainly be of use to you...
button_1: Use the scroll to summon and control a unit <unit></unit> of true evil origin... <evilact></evilact>
button_2: Burn the scroll. Cleanse the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>. <goodact></goodact>
title: Scrolls of Terror: Aftermath

hero_is_playerle: With the cultists gone and their ritual undone, the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> at last falls silent and you are free to investigate.

body_footer: "Will you take down <eventColor>{TargetHouse}</eventColor> so we of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> will no longer be harassed?!"
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> approaches you with <<o:EventHouseLord>> jaw set.
body_lore: "We of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> have a long and bloody history with <eventColor>{TargetHouse}</eventColor>. The rivalry between our cities started generations ago for reasons even I do not know. Yet, any attempts at peace have resulted in treachery and more bloodshed. I feared it would never end. But with a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> like you on our side, no one will dare cross us ever again."
button_0: "I hear you. I will take down <eventColor>{TargetHouse}</eventColor>."
button_1: "I decree that <influence></influence> you both shall be united as friends <goodact></goodact> under my protection instead."
button_2: "I have no time for the petty squabbles of minor cities."
title: Bitter Rivalry

body_footer: What do you ask of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> for your troubles?
body_header: You have successfully conquered <eventColor>{TargetHouse}</eventColor>, resulting in a very happy <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "I can't believe you've done it! You actually crushed them! I knew your prowess was legendary, but I have never seen the like of it in all my days. I am grateful, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, truly grateful. <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> owes you a great debt. We have not much to offer a great <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> like you, but know that you have made a friend for life in us."
button_0: "Let us seal this great achievement with a new treaty <allegiance></allegiance>!"
button_1: "I could use some of your fighting men and women <unit></unit> on my side."
button_3: My people paid with blood. You will pay with gold <gold></gold>.
title: Bitter Rivalry: Aftermath

body_footer: It seems <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> has unexpected "allies" on the inside in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>. Does <<p:EventHero>> call for their help?
body_header: During the siege of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, your <hyperlink><<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> receives a hastily written note that was tied to a rock and thrown over the wall.
body_lore: "We share no love for <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> or <eventColor>{EventCityLord.TitleName}</eventColor>. Will help from within, for safety and gold. Deliver answer and reward at midnight and it will be done."
button_0: Pay <gold></gold> the turncoats for their help.
button_1: Promise to pay them when the siege is over... and then "forget" all about it.
button_2: "We will continue as we are."
title: Friends On the Other Side

hero_is_playerle: It seems you have unexpected "allies" on the inside in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>. Do you call for their help?
During the siege of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> you receive a hastily written note that was tied to a rock and thrown over the wall.

body_footer: Smugglers and thieves from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> are offering their expertise in getting supplies into the city, for a promise of leniency.
body_header: While your city <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> is besieged by <eventColor>{EnemyUnit.Name}</eventColor> you receive an unexpected offer of help.
body_lore: A shady <eventColor>{EventUnit.Name}</eventColor> bows sarcastically and grins. "I represent a 'particular' enterprise within these city walls. We have ways of moving contraband in and out of this patch, even during times like these. Now, none of us have ever gotten nabbed, and we'd like to keep it that way. So, if we lend you a hand, we need your guards to sniff elsewhere in the future, if you catch my drift."
button_0: "I accept your offer, and will ensure your future exploits are... overlooked."
button_1: "Show me your routes or I'll have you 'nabbed' before this city falls!"
button_2: "I do not need help from petty criminals."
title: Honor Among Thieves

body_footer: Acknowledging a shared ancestry with the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> would overjoy <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor>, yet will cause controversy among your people.
body_header: During diplomatic negotiations, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> believes an important discovery has been made.
body_lore: "I knew it," <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> yells in excitement, "I knew that we of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> are destined for greatness. Forgive my impulsiveness, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, but the wisest scholars among the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> have been poring over countless scrolls delineating family trees and it seems evident that you and I... share common ancestors. Isn't this wonderful!?"
button_0: "Well, if it delights you, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.FirstName}</eventColor>... You may call me cousin."
button_1: "Me, related to the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>? Laughable!"
button_2: Avoid the subject.
button_3: "All life is connected. Related or not, our people should live in harmony."
title: Family Reunion

body_footer: Silence descends on the gathering. All look to you, expecting you to perform the famous dance...
body_header: During an illustrious gathering to advance your political bonds with <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> boasts about <<o:EventHouseLord>> dancers.
body_lore:
"We of {EventHouse} may not have the military might of a {PlayerLeader.Title}, but the {EventRace} have dancers who know no equal in this realm!"

Incited by the atmosphere and one drink too many, one of your courtiers rises up, claiming you are better. "{PlayerLeader.TitleName} is the epitome of grace! Hic! <> can dance the fabled Dance of the 10,000 Veils!"
button_0: "Dance? 10,000 veils? Sure! how hard can it be?"
button_1: Call forth <mana></mana> a captivating tune, inspiring everyone else to dance instead.
button_2: "Hear that drunkard? A coin <gold></gold> to whoever makes him dance!"
button_3: "I have studied the Dance of the 10,000 Veils for years. Observe!"
button_4: "<<m:PlayerLeader.Title>> don't dance. They are entertained. Music! Dancers!"
title: A Perilous Dance

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> would appreciate it if you forge a <hyperlink>Eventpact</hyperlink> with 2021, <<g:city of origin,EventHero>>.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> asks to speak to you. "As you know I was born in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, a city I still hold dear."
body_lore: "Barely a day goes by without me thinking about my hometown. The bright lights in the towers at night, the hubbub of the marketplace... It's unlike any other. A particular thought has become a growing obsession with me, and I must speak my mind, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, for it would bring me much joy if you forged a closer bond with <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>."
button_0: "Together with <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> we shall prosper."
button_2: "I do not have time for <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>."
title: City of Birth

body_footer: "You have done me and my beloved <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> a great favor. Please, tell me what we can do for you."
body_header: You have successfully forged a <hyperlink>Eventpact</hyperlink> with <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>. <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> is grateful.
body_lore: "I am glad you have seen the beauty of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, and even gladder to know it sheltered by your protecting hand. My heart is at peace, yet my spirit is kindled evermore to perform great deeds in your name!"
button_0: "Through tale and song, you shall herald the glory <influence></influence> of my empire."
button_1: "Further the bonds with <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> even more."
button_3: "Convoke the lieges <unit></unit> of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> to reinforce my armies."
title: City of Birth: Aftermath

body_footer: The hellspawn cannot get away with their flagrant rampage. Won't you save your people and purge these devils, Holy <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>?
body_header: After bolstering your empire through order and discipline, you receive reports that demons are assembling near <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, striking fear into your citizens' hearts.
body_lore: The fiendish infestation, demons who either killed or escaped their masters, are led by a gruesome <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>. Like diabolical moths, the infernal deviants are drawn to the gleaming light that hallows your empire, preying on the meek and weak-willed among your followers. Several pious citizens have reportedly been tempted, seduced, tricked, compromised, or simply slain by these godless guests.
button_0: "These profane invaders will be cleansed by my holy fire!"
button_1: "After they've devoured the faithless, these orderless demons will surely scatter."
button_2: "An unchecked <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>? My zealous incantations <mana></mana> will dominate <unit></unit> it <ordercrisis></ordercrisis>!"
title: Infernal Invaders

body_footer: From <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, inquisitive citizens prepare to pilfer the abandoned hoard. You must declare what is yours and what is theirs to collect.
body_header: The impious demons are vanquished! Divine order is restored to your realm. Scouts report what the fiends stockpiled in their nest.
body_lore: The unholy invaders had raided the surrounding lands for several days. Bloodstained treasure is piled high on the nest's edges. Perched atop the highest heap, a <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> is found, riddled with claw marks. Dozens of dead animals were dragged into the center of the rallying point. Some of the slain cattle is partially devoured, but most fresh carcasses remain untouched.
button_0: Take the besmirched treasure <gold></gold> and order it to be washed clean.
button_1: Send the untainted carcasses <food></food> to <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> before rot sets in.
button_3: Claim the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> to commemorate your pious might.
button_4: Take all rewards <gold></gold> <food></food> <item></item> for yourself. They do not befit commoners <evilact></evilact>.
title: Infernal Invaders: Aftermath

no_city: As your troops begin to pilfer the abandoned hoard, you must declare what is yours and what is theirs to collect.

body_footer: <hyperlink>Elya</hyperlink> the Maer joins you as you leave for Magehaven, victorious.
body_header: You have cast the Siren Goddess into the void and claimed the Enchanted Archipelago from her drowning embrace!
body_lore: From your capital, the mythical <hyperlink>Maer</hyperlink> emerges once more. "I thank you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, for hearing my song and freeing the realm. I fear I have naught that resembles a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>'s reward... But if you allow me to join you on your travels, I may share what I have learned as Nimue's prisoner."
button_0: Elya the Maer joins you as you leave for Magehaven victoriously.
title: The Enchanted Archipelago: Victory

elya_not_freed: From her hidden prison a mythical <hyperlink>Maer</hyperlink> emerges, floating on unseen currents. "I thank you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, for hearing my song and freeing the realm. My name is <hyperlink>Elya</hyperlink>. I fear I have naught to give as a reward for a Godir... But if you allow me to join you on your travels, I may share what I have learned as Nimue's prisoner."

body_footer: "Great <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, can you relieve us of these dissenters?"
body_header: Your <hyperlink><<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>, appointed governor of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, approaches you in distress.
body_lore: "Wise <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, I would like to ask for your advice on the following matter. A group of disgruntled veterans have been stirring up trouble in the city. They have set up camp just outside the gates, where they continue to sow dissent and make demands. Yet, the city guard does not want to take up arms against their own."
button_0: "I will deal with these insurrectionists."
button_2: "Are you not the governor of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>? You will find a solution."
title: Troublesome Veterans

body_footer: "It seems the veterans of the city are eager to show their worth once more. What should we have them do?"
body_header: You dealt with the disgruntled veterans and restored peace to <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> is relieved.
body_lore: "Thank you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, for restoring order in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>. The citizens are very impressed by your actions. They won't rise up again for a while. Even the elderly are more motivated than ever!"
button_0: Give them a say in the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> council. <happiness></happiness>
button_1: Let them protect trade caravans <gold></gold> traveling to and from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
button_3: Use their experience to train <unitprod></unitprod> the guards of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
title: Troublesome Veterans: Aftermath

body_footer: "We do not wish to fight you, o <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. But we will fight for the well-being of those who served you."
body_header: You encounter the insurrectionists of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, a group commanded by a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, who takes a brave stance when seeing your troops.
body_lore: "So you've heard about our protest?" <<p:EventStackLeader>> asks. "Then you must have heard about the way we are treated, too. Long have we guarded your city, fought alongside you. But what then? The old and wounded are tossed aside, like old dishrags. No more! Our work and sacrifice deserves respect. We demand food and shelter for the wounded and elderly!"
button_0: "You made your bed, now die in it. <evilact></evilact> To battle!"
button_1: "I will make sure the veterans of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> are looked after <food></food>." <goodact></goodact>
button_2: "Please return to <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> <population></population>, I promise you will no longer go unrecognized."
button_3: Leave.
title: Encountering Troublesome Veterans

body_footer: Will you conquer <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> for the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>?
body_header: The Council of the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> requests an audience concerning the war with the independent city of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, our protector, we want to lay before you the misdeeds of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> against our people. Since the war broke out innocent <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> have been subject to persecution and murder. For us this war with <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> can only end in one way: with the end of the dynasty of <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor>, the instigators of this murderous campaign."
button_0: "You will have their heads."
button_1: "Wanton destruction brings no profit. I will find more lucrative ways <materiumboon></materiumboon> to use <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>."
button_2: "There could still be other ways to resolve this conflict."
title: Heads on a Platter

body_footer: "How do you wish your people to remember this momentous day, oh <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>?"
body_header: You have defeated <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>. The Council of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> rejoices.
body_lore: "Blood for blood. Bone for bone. The end of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> gives comfort to all <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> who had to suffer by their hands. The spoils of conquest will not mend all wounds, but they spread a sense of justice even if some wrongs may never be repaid."
button_0: "Remember the glorious battles <unitprod></unitprod> that brought down our enemies."
button_1: "Remember our grand cities <structureprod></structureprod>, whose walls gave shelter to us all."
title: Heads on a Platter: Aftermath

body_footer: Will you stop these ice creatures before they freeze everything within their grasp?
body_header: Through fate or blind luck, the currents of change and chaos bring your attention to a chilling scene.
body_lore: A <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> frost-ridden followers are slowly turning the area around them to ice. They freeze the earth, beast and man alike, leaving behind a desolate lifeless wasteland. All will to live, movement and impulse is quenched as if the entire region had become frozen in time.
button_0: "Winter is over. Let's melt some ice!"
button_1: "Change comes and goes. Their ice won't last for long."
button_2: "Stop them? I will support <mana></mana> this experiment in freezing!"
title: Eternal Freeze

body_footer: What reward do you choose to save before chaos reduces it to astral dust?
body_header: With the frost creatures gone, their magical ice starts to melt.
body_lore: Icicles shatter and water drips as the cold fades away, revealing various objects that had been locked in the ice. You see weapons, gold, and a stack of books. But, as the ice melts, chaos and decay make up for lost time, for you can see the objects deteriorate in front of your very eyes. You have to choose fast.
button_0: Grab a <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> <item></item>.
button_1: Grab a chest of riches <gold></gold>.
button_3: Grab a tome of ancient knowledge <knowledge></knowledge>.
button_4: Let all the objects decay and gather the magical reagents afterwards. <Mana></Mana>
title: Eternal Freeze: Aftermath

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> asks for your permission to breed <<o:EventHouseLord>> own mount with your <eventColor>{EventMount}</eventColor>.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> seeks a favor concerning your mount.
body_lore: "Great <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, you ride a <eventColor>{EventMount}</eventColor> almost matching your own grace and power. Meanwhile my faithful <eventColor>{HouseLordMount}</eventColor> was wounded and I can no longer ride <<p:HouseLordMount>> into battle. I humbly ask you to consider breeding yours with mine. With some <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> magic, I expect our combined mounts will make a magnificent creature that will bring new glory to <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>."
button_0: "No! Such crimes against nature <natureboon></natureboon> would only produce abominations."
button_1: "For a generous compensation <gold></gold> I may allow our mounts to breed."
button_2: "No, you may not breed my mount."
button_3: "In all my generosity, I will gift you my <eventColor>{EventMount}</eventColor>."
button_4: "They may breed, but their first offspring <mount></mount> is mine."
title: Quality Breeding

body_footer: This rebellious scribe is only a symptom of the underlying <happiness></happiness> <hyperlink>City Stability</hyperlink> issues this city is facing.
body_header: You have neglected the needs of your populace in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> and now someone in your city is writing inciting poetry on the buildings.
body_lore: The guards drag in a young scribe who looks at you defiantly. "You don't care about us," <<p:EventUnit>> says, "not unless we damage your legacy. Do what you must, your people already know what type of <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> you are." The city guards look to you with unease and the scribe closes <<o:EventUnit>> eyes, awaiting your judgment.
button_0: Pay <gold></gold> to have the writing removed. <happiness></happiness>
button_1: Use your transmutation powers to restore the walls. <happiness></happiness>
button_2: Set the scribe free. <goodact></goodact> Criticism is a gift.
button_3: Publicly execute the scribe <evilact></evilact>. That should be a lesson to all. <happiness></happiness>
button_4: "I have no time for this."
title: Writing on the Wall

body_footer: <<Co:EventHeroB>> pensive gaze shifts to the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. "I do not ask this lightly, <<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>>... But this corrupted <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> must be stopped."
body_header: While approaching the majestic <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> is stopped by a regal <eventColor>{EventHeroB.Title}</eventColor> emerging from a hut nearby.

Souls of the dead roam like the living. Many who lived here either fled or perished themselves, their souls unable to move on. Something... or someone, is keeping them here."
button_0: "Go on..."

Perhaps those are the voices I keep hearing, whispering..." She gazes over the realm, and seems to remember something. "I heard this realm was home to many Elven cities. Surely, one of them withstood this ghostly incursion."

"Her husband arose from the grave and attacked her. When she fled, she saw other... other bodies, shambling toward the city."

button_3: "Well done. Let this victory strengthen your faith <orderboon></orderboon> and convictions."

hero_is_playerle: A <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> bearing the banner of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> steps forward as you approach.

body_footer: The army guarding the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> seems downtrodden and demoralized.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> comes across an army of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>, their appearance ragged and unkempt.
body_lore: "Thank the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>! We are so happy to see a friendly face!" their leader says, relieved to have found some company. "We were tasked with guarding the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, but we've been here for ages without relief... We're sick, hungry, and weary!" The guards behind <<P:EventStackLeader>> grumble in agreement.
button_0: "Would some food <food></food> persuade you to leave this location to us?"
button_1: "Join us! You will never be weary again..."
button_2: "We will end your suffering, then. To arms!"
button_3: "We are merely passing through..."
title: Restless Guards

hero_is_playerle: You come across an army of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>, their appearance ragged and unkempt.

"I shall end your suffering, then. To arms!"
