body_footer: You vastly outnumber these guards. Do you let them leave the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> without a fight?
body_header: As your troops approach the band of mercenary guards, they raise the white flag.
body_lore: "We were hired by a rich merchant to look after the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>," the leader of the gang, a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, explains. "We expected to protect it from roaming scoundrels, not against a full-fledged assault! Please accept our surrender and let us go!"
button_0: "That's what you get for becoming mercenaries! <evilact></evilact> Attack!"
button_1: "We have no quarrel with you. <goodact></goodact> Leave in peace."
button_2: "How about we change your contract <gold></gold>... to serve me!" <unit></unit>
title: Occupational Hazard

body_footer: Do you let them go and plead for peace with <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>?
body_header: Your troops catch an enemy division who have split off from <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: Anxiously, they send forth their captain, a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, to negotiate their surrender. "Our <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> is a great governor, but a weak marshal. We are losing this war. <<Co:EventHouseLord>> other generals are too proud to admit it, but someone has to stand up to <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor>. Let us retreat, and I promise there will be peace again."
button_0: "This war has only just begun. <evilact></evilact> Attack!"
button_1: "Today, you may leave unharmed. <goodact></goodact> But know that there will not be peace tomorrow."
button_2: "You may leave if you ensure our good intentions are known to <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor>."
title: Lost Cause

body_footer: The troops see your prowess and want to join your cause!
body_header: The enemy army from <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> welcomes your troops with friendly cheers.
body_lore: With a pathetic air, their captain comes forward: "Salutations, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>! Long live the <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> whose feats on the battlefield command the admiration of even <<o:PlayerLeader>> enemies. My division has long dreamed of following a leader of such might. We are sick of the lowly <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventHouseLord>> <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>—allow us to fight in your name!"
button_0: "Allowing an enemy to join forces? Die <evilact></evilact>, you fools!"
button_1: "There is no room for traitors within my ranks <goodact></goodact>. Begone!"
button_2: "Who would reject the service <unit></unit> of someone with such good taste?"
title: Daring Defectors

body_footer: How do you wish to commemorate the ingenuity displayed by your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>?
body_header: At the grand square of your city <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, a construction fair is taking place.
body_lore: Builders from all across the continent have gathered to marvel at the latest machines and inventions devised by the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>. The production methods developed by your people have piqued the interest of many rulers.
button_0: Sell <gold></gold> the production plans to the highest bidders.
button_1: Give a speech <happiness></happiness> about the importance of Production for your empire.
button_2: Look to the future and the innovations <knowledge></knowledge> still to come.
title: Engines of Awe

body_footer: Will you back up their ambitions to increase productivity at <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>?
body_header: Your builders' guild at <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> requests your support.
body_lore: "The apprentices from our guild are crestfallen!" their master craftsman exclaims. "On their journeys through the empire of <eventColor>{EventGoldenCityPlayer.Name}</eventColor>, they have witnessed the elaborate workmanship and monumental buildings in <eventColor>{EventGoldenCity.Name}</eventColor>. Now they dream of equal grandeur, but our own means are limited..."
button_0: Invest <gold></gold> in materials and tools <structureprod></structureprod> to get them started.
button_1: Vow <influence></influence> to attract more workers <population></population> to <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: Bend stones and earth to your will to inspire them.
button_3: Ignore their request.
title: Foreign Wonders

body_footer: A hollow echo shakes the cavern: "Disssciplesss of the Gorgon Goddesss, choossse your sssacrificcce... Lessst you find your greedy heartsss turned to ssstone."
body_header: As soon as <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> enters the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, <<p:EventHero>> notices it is infested with snakes.
body_lore: The entire scene looks like a shrine dedicated to an outlawed deity. Ornate rock formations surround a stone-shaped altar, where the idol of a snake-haired woman stands. The living serpents lurk in a distance, until <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> touches the altair.
button_0: "I'm not afraid of any goddess or her slithering guardians. To arms!"
button_1: "We offer the people <population></population> of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> <evilact></evilact> to feed thy protectors, O Serpent."
button_2: Stone magic is one of your strengths. Use it to predict the targets of the Gorgon's Curse.
button_4: Retreat.
title: Pit of Vipers

hero_is_playerle: As soon as you enter the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, you notice it is infested with snakes.

Stony serpents loom like pillars in the heart of the underground maze. The entire scene looks like a shrine dedicated to an outlawed deity. Ornate rock formations surround a stone-shaped altar, where the idol of a snake-haired woman stands. The living serpents lurk at a distance, until you touch the altar. The idol grins and crumbles, the snakes hissing in anticipation.
"I offer the people <population></population> of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> <evilact></evilact> to feed thy protectors."

body_footer: Does <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> keep the scroll of litho-shaping or use it to revive the petrified victims <<p:EventHero>> found?
body_header: Having survived the trial of the Gorgon Goddess, a shifting stone plate reveals her chamber of offerings.
body_lore: Inside the hidden room, a line of petrified adventurers bears silent witness to the magic of the Curse <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> withstood. <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> finds a scroll created by the old worshipers of the Gorgon Goddess, which seems to contain a litho-shaping spell.
button_0: "Their time has passed. The scroll <knowledge></knowledge> will help us in future battles."
button_1: "Bring the victims to life! They are free to return to their homes <influence></influence>." <goodact></goodact>
button_2: "Revive the victims of the curse! Our army <unit></unit> can use these <<m:EventUnit>>!"
title: Pit of Vipers: Aftermath

hero_is_playerle: Do you keep the scroll of litho-shaping or use it to revive the petrified victims you found?

Inside the hidden room, a line of petrified adventurers bears silent witness to the magic of the Curse you withstood. You find a scroll created by the old worshipers of the Gorgon Goddess, which seems to contain a litho-shaping spell.
"Their time has passed. The scroll <knowledge></knowledge> will help me in future battles."
"Revive the victims of the curse! My army <unit></unit> can use these <<m:EventUnit>>!"

body_footer: The beasts are a threat even to <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> itself. What will you do to end this terror?
body_header: A pack of the mighty <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> is roaming the plains near your city <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: The blood-crazed beasts have been terrorizing the surrounding villages, a broken spear still stuck in the flank of the alpha <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>. Many stories have been told about the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor> in the region and the wild animals emerging from its depths. None of them end well.
button_0: Arm the villagers <unitprod></unitprod> to drive the pack off our borders.
button_1: Muster the populace <unitprod></unitprod> to force the pack back to its <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor>!
button_2: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> looks like it’s suffering. Carefully tending its wounds might make it turn docile... though the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor> will remain.
button_3: Let the animals come. Our garrisons are prepared.
title: Terror in the Fields

body_footer: To declare the winner, you are asked to pick the most compelling dictum.
body_header: On the high rostrum at <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> the grand scholars of your empire are competing in public debate.
body_lore: Demonstrating the knowledge and wits that the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> have become famous for, each of the participants is laying out the inevitable proof of his own world theory in eloquent ways. Their performance marks another high point in this scholastic golden age of your people.
button_0: "The world is a lock. Knowledge <knowledge></knowledge> is the key."
button_1: "Knowledge inspires people <happiness></happiness> to greatness."
button_2: "Knowledge is the wind <mana></mana> that lets us sail the astral sea."
title: Battle of Wits

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> desires the service of your hero <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>.
body_header: During diplomatic negotiations, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> contacts you with an unusual request.
body_lore: "In <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Pronoun}</eventColor> begins, "it is customary to seal a new friendship with an exchange of servants. Your envoys showed me a drawing of the fair <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> devoted to your cause. I want <eventColor>{EventHero.PronounObject}</eventColor>. I demand <eventColor>{EventHero.PronounObject}</eventColor>! Choose any of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>'s heroes in return..."
button_0: "It's a deal: My <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> for your <eventColor>{EventHouseHero.Name}</eventColor>!"
button_1: "I might be convinced <gold></gold>, to let <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> join you. But <eventColor>{EventHero.Pronoun}</eventColor> comes at a different price <evilact></evilact>..."
button_2: "The people serving me have their own free will <goodact></goodact>. I will not force <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>."
title: Personnel Exchange

body_footer: "Now that you have heard about us being condemned to this unworthy task, what is it that brings you here?"
body_header: Approaching the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> meets the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, who seems to be lamenting <<o:EventStackLeader>> fate of having to lead the guards of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "We should be out in the wilds," <<p:EventStackLeader>> says, "slaying a dragon, or assaulting the castle of a robber-knight. Instead, we're stuck keeping watch over the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> that nobody cares about. It's a job so lowly, only peasants should have to do it."
button_1: "I will set you and your men free and buy <gold></gold> this <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> from <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>."
button_2: "Do you hear that? You're being called back to the defense of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>!"
button_3: "I am here to grant you a heroic fight - to the death!"
button_4: "Just seeking adventures. We will be on our way..."
title: A Job for Peasants

hero_is_playerle: "Now that you have heard about us being condemned to this unworthy task, what is it that brings you here, o <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>?"

Approaching the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, you meet the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, who seems to be lamenting <<o:EventStackLeader>> fate of having to lead the guards of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.

body_footer: What are your orders?
body_header: Your troops engage with a military contingent of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: The army of <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> is on the move, with little time or interest in diplomatic pleasantries. Still, their captain is respectful enough to leave time to parley, as an opportunity for your troops to make contact.
button_1: Arrange a diplomatic audience with <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor>.
button_3: Attack! This is the opportunity to strike!
button_4: Disengage and let them be on their way.
title: Troop Movement: <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>

stackleader_is_p: You engage with a military contingent of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.

The army of <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> is on the move, with little time or interest in diplomatic pleasantries. Still, their captain is respectful enough to leave time to parley, as an opportunity for your troops to make contact.

body_footer: "Not so shy! Dare to join the rout and play? The winner takes the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>. It's your skulls against ours!"
body_header: The rowdy troops of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> stationed at the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> are indulging in a morbid game.
body_lore: They keep re-arranging the same set of suspiciously humanoid looking bones, only to later knock them over again with skulls hurled from a distance. Their leader, a fierce-looking <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, eyeballs <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> and laughs.
button_1: "Why settle for bones when you could have enough cattle <food></food> to feast on for weeks?"
button_2: Grant strength to <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> to play.
button_3: "Game over. We'll smash your bones for real!"
button_4: "You keep playing. We will watch from afar..."
title: Skull Bowling

hero_is_playerle: "Not so shy, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>! Dare to join the rout and play? The winner takes the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>. It's your skulls against ours!"

They keep re-arranging the same set of suspiciously humanoid looking bones, only to later knock them over again with skulls hurled from a distance. Their leader, a fierce-looking <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, eyeballs you and laughs.
Gather your strength to play.

body_footer: "Now I keep thinking, was this man's death supposed to be my own? Do you seek my demise, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>?"
body_header: After a diplomatic dinner with your envoys, you are contacted by a pale <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "I know I am just a lesser <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> in the eyes of a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>," <<p:EventHouseLord>> says anxiously. "But I need to learn the truth... After trying the stew you <eventColor>{PlayerRace.Name}</eventColor> are famous for, my food taster bloated with gas until the poor man was ripped apart from within, turning the buffet into a nauseating mess..."
button_0: "This was a tragic accident. Let my treasury <gold></gold> vouch for our friendship."
button_1: "If I wanted you dead, you would be <evilact></evilact>."
button_2: "It is not my fault you <eventColor>{EventHouseRace.Name}</eventColor> can't stomach our delicacies..."
button_3: "A third party must have poisoned the stew to sabotage negotiations!"
title: Toxic Stew

body_footer: "Grand <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, will you share some of your power, so we can create a magical fruit for <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor>?"
body_header: In light of the negotiations with <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor>, a group of farmers from <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> is contacting you with a plea.
body_lore: "We love our <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor>!" their <<EventUnit<eventColor>{spokesman/spokeswoman}</eventColor>>> explains. "And we want to create a new fruit to honor <<o:EventHouseLord>> name. Magical delicious fruit that tastes more exquisite with every bite. <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> will be enamored with it!"
button_0: "Your request <mana></mana> shall be granted!"
button_1: "Study <knowledge></knowledge> the arcane arts at <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> to learn the enchantments yourselves."
button_2: "I don't have any mana to spare for this."
button_3: "Infusing plants with magic is my favorite pastime."
title: Magical Fruit Infusion

body_footer: "We've been abandoned by our <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor>. We would happily work for anyone but <<P:EventHouseLord>>.”
body_header: As <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> approaches the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, the bedraggled guards from <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> look up tiredly.
body_lore: "Are you interested in this <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>," the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> asks. "<eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> demands it be patrolled, but we lack the resources to defend ourselves properly. We lost many good <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> to monsters already. <<Cp:EventHouseLord>> says it's our duty to follow orders, but why follow the orders of a <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> that abandoned us?"
button_1: "I'll take this <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> off <<g:hands,EventHouseLord>> <gold></gold>. You may go."
button_2: "I will buy <gold></gold> both the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> and your service."
button_3: "Lazy cads! Your weakness makes you an easy target."
button_4: "I will think about it. Honestly..."
title: Bedraggled Guards

hero_is_playerle: As you approach the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, the bedraggled guards from <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> look up tiredly.

"Are you interested in this <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>," the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> asks. "<eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> demands it be patrolled, but we lack the resources to defend ourselves properly. We lost many good <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> to monsters already. <<Cp:EventHouseLord>> says it's our duty to follow orders, but why follow the orders of a <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> that abandoned us?"

body_footer: "Will you sanctify the code of pacifism we have compiled, o <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, so that we all may openly strive for peace?"
body_header: The <<EventUnit <eventColor>{chairman/chairwoman}</eventColor>>> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> Council approaches you in a calm, trance-like state.
body_lore: "Over time, we <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> have learned to abhor the violence that dominates this realm. We seek to lead a more secluded life, protecting what we have built if we must, but otherwise abandoning the grand battles and plots which only bring the horrors of forceful conflict upon the land and its people."
button_0: "Your wisdom pleases me. The <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> shall be known as a peace-loving people."
button_1: "I must forbid <influence></influence> such pacifism. Your ideals, while noble, would bring doom upon the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>."
button_2: "You have been lulled by the vanities of peace. War and violence <evilact></evilact> shall return to dictate the fates <happiness></happiness> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>."
title: Swords to Plowshares

body_footer: "By decree of our Council, we wish to establish a custom of pilgrimage to the imperial hoard, so that all <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> may marvel at its glittering beauty."
body_header: The chairman of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> Council approaches you with a glimmer of greed in his eyes.
body_lore: "These are truly blessed times for us <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. We prosper as things of beauty and worth are kept safe within the divine treasury of your making, o <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. Other empires look at us with envy, for they can only dream of the material bliss we safeguard and enjoy."
button_0: "Proceed as you desire. The worth of gold shall truly be known to all <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>."
button_1: "If gold is so dear to the Council, surely a generous donation <gold></gold> would change your minds."
button_2: "Worshiping riches is folly <happiness></happiness>. I will not encourage the greed of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>."
title: Wealth Beyond Measure

body_footer: "We have compiled a book of tutelage, ready for transcription, so that all <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> may be guided to study the past."
body_header: The <<EventUnit <eventColor>{chairman/chairwoman}</eventColor>>> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> Council comes before you, an ornate book in <<o:EventUnit>> hands.
body_lore: "This," <<p:EventUnit>> says with pathos, "is the legacy of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. In ages past, tribes, kingdoms and entire realms have disappeared into the mists of time, their knowledge seemingly lost forever. But with great dedication and spellcraft, much that was forgotten can be rediscovered, like runic messages carved deeply into the hidden roots of this world."
button_0: "You are wise. This ancient knowledge will reshape the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>."
button_1: "The past is not comprehensible to the masses. Let me enlighten <knowledge></knowledge> you..."
button_2: "I forbid <happiness></happiness> such dwelling in the past. Shape rather the future, ere all the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> have turned to dust."
title: Delvers of Secrets

body_footer: "Please, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, name any offering or service I can give to save me and my family from this curse."
body_header: A merchant of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> from <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, widely known for <<o:EventUnit>> depraved feasts, has come before your throne, pleading for absolution.
body_lore: "Do not look with wrath upon this poor sinner, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>," the <<EventUnit <eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>> begs, <<o:EventUnit>> voice thick with fear. "For too long have I ignored the divine bidding of thy faith. Now a dark curse has befallen me, slowly destroying all I hold dear. Even my own health is dwindling, draining any strength I have left."
button_0: "Renounce your worldly possessions <gold></gold> and your soul shall find rest."
button_1: "Study the holy scriptures <knowledge></knowledge> and the path of redemption will reveal itself to you."
button_2: "Embark on a pilgrimage <orderboon></orderboon> to seek the light of true faith."
title: Divine Absolution

body_footer: "Oooo, how long have we waited in darkness... Release us... Free us!"
body_header: Hazy whispers emerge from the depths of your crypt, drawing your attention to a sealed jar of unknown origin.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>... come beneath the shadows. Listen to us... <<p:PlayerLeader>>, who can hear our voice. Dark magic was our crime. Eternal imprisonment our sentence."
button_0: Dispel the jar's curse <mana></mana> to free the spirits <shadowboon></shadowboon>.
button_1: Channel <mana></mana> the jar's souls <souls></souls> for your dark magic.
button_2: Leave the jar in your crypt.
button_3: Subdue the ancient spirits to harness their secrets <knowledge></knowledge>.
title: Whispers of Woe

body_footer: "Which hideous new shape should I give this spy of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>? Frosty beasts are my specialty..."
body_header: In the days of the war with <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> an unexpected guest appears at your court: a wicked <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> from the far north.
body_lore: "Tremendous <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, long have I observed your intriguingly eerie reign. It chilled my senses and tingled my frozen veins. I have come now with a gift." She shows a vicious smile as she presents a man of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> trapped in a floating cage of ice.
button_0: "Make him a <eventColor>{TargetWolf}</eventColor> <unit></unit>, let his howl scare all <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>."
button_1: "As a <eventColor>{TargetSpider}</eventColor> <unit></unit>, he will trap other spies in his net."
button_2: "Leave him to me. His knowledge of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> <garrison></garrison> will be their downfall."
button_3: "Turn him to eternal ice <shadowboon></shadowboon>. He shall be a fitting ornament for my court."
title: Wicked Homage

body_footer: Do you try to prevent the destruction that could strike the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> near your city of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>?
body_header: Through your deep link to the world underneath you sense the movements of an elder earth elemental.
body_lore: Disturbed in its ancient slumber, the elemental is rumbling restlessly, shaking the world that is built on its back. A tectonic disaster seems to be imminent as the elemental slowly moves toward <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
button_0: Commune with the elemental <mana></mana> to lull it to sleep again. <materiumboon></materiumboon>
button_1: Channel your magic <mana></mana> to divert the elemental to a rival's domain.
button_2: Ignore the elder elemental until it reaches <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
title: Moving Earth

body_footer: The prison warden chokes off the <<G:pitiful sputterings,EventUnit>>. "What should we do with this spy from treacherous <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>?"
body_header: A <<EventUnit<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>> lies before you, raw agony reflected in <<o:EventUnit>> face. "Please... I'll do anything. Please don't kill me!"
body_lore: Your prison warden yanks the <<G:iron leash,EventUnit>>. "Caught spying for <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>!" An audible gasp echoes through the chamber. Every courtier expresses their shock, saying they would never do such a thing, not for any reward. The spy continues to plead. "<eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> will kill my family. Please! I am no one. I meant no harm to your vast empire."
button_0: Hang <<P:EventUnit>> from the gate <evilact></evilact> as a message [relationLvl-3/] to <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>.
button_1: Discretely contact <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> to barter a ransom <gold></gold>.
button_2: End <<o:EventUnit>> life. <<Co:EventUnit>> traitorous body joins my loyal undead warriors. <shadowboon></shadowboon>
button_3: Use <<P:EventUnit>> to feed favorable information <relationLvl3></relationLvl3> to <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor>.
button_4: "This <<EventUnit<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>> has been tortured enough. <goodact></goodact> Set <<P:EventUnit>> free!"
title: The Prying Eyes of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>

body_footer: "We have the Gildercoil, the only key to the world vault called Grexolis. Yet it may only be used when all of Grexolis is under our control."
body_header: Looking at the fragmented continents of <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink>, you are approached by your <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> allies.
body_lore: "A world sacrificed to a greater purpose - commendable, yet in vain." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> speaks slowly and with gravity, as if every word <<p:EventPlayer>> pronounced was a challenge in itself. "The <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> did what they deemed to be just, but their strength was dwindling. Where they saw danger, we see potential."
button_0: Hear more of Grexolis and its warden.
title: The World Vault

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> descends to the crater and, without hesitation, activates the Gildercoil.
body_header: As <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> holds up the Gildercoil, the fragmented continents of <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink> are set in motion, like the cogwheels of a gargantuan engine.
body_lore: The earth shakes and buildings collapse, until a giant hollow is formed. Glowing runes surrounding the hollow point you toward the center.
button_0: Brace yourself for the opening of the World Vault.
title: Opening Grexolis

body_footer: Inspired by the moment, you feel empowered and capable of conjuring an object from the Astral Sea yourself.
body_header: The breach at the mana node hums like an arcane echo as the raw magic of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> returns to resonate with its <hyperlink>Astral Flows</hyperlink>.
body_lore: The astral invaders have been repelled, leaving a haunting impression of the dangers lurking beyond <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>. Yet you can't shake off the feeling of having glimpsed something grand, a window opening up between worlds.
button_0: Summon a magical artifact <item></item>.
button_1: Draw in a large mana crystal <mana></mana>.
button_2: Conjure a magical companion <unit></unit>.
title: Hunters from Beyond: Aftermath

body_footer: To protect your people and restore their faith in your rule you must seek out the <hyperlink>Astral Sea Monsters</hyperlink> near <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_header: For a brief while your people had found respite in this Valley of Wonders. But now panicked shouts start to echo in the streets of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "Doom is upon us! Monsters from the beyond!" Your scouts arrive shortly after the uproar. Creatures from the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> have been sighted near the city. The fear of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> quickly leads to doubt. Was <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> right? Have your magic powers attracted the creatures from afar?
button_0: These otherworldly horrors will find that the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> are no easy prey.
title: Hunters from Beyond

body_footer: It is clear that the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> is striking fear into the hearts of your soldiers. What do you do?
body_header: As you approach the creatures from the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, their horrific nature becomes fully revealed.
body_lore: Haunting eyes gaze from disturbingly flowing limbs. An eerie quiet surrounds the monsters, while the air around them crackles with magically charged strokes.
button_3: Fearsome or not, these monsters must die. Attack!
button_4: Set a bounty <gold></gold> on the head of the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>.
button_5: Channel your magic prowess to force the creatures back into the Astral Sea.
button_7: Flee.
button_8: Remind the troops of the grandeur <influence></influence> and bravery of their forefathers.
title: Encountering the Hunters from Beyond

body_footer: "I will talk to you through visions like these. Follow my advice and you will claim victory."
body_header: From the shrouded mists of your mind emerges a <<EventHero<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>> all clad in ethereal silk. "I see you have arrived in the Crimson Caldera, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <<p:EventHero>> says, and you recognize <<P:EventHero>> as <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "All <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> have put much faith in your talents. Remain alert! Mistakes are deadly in this <hyperlink>demonic realm</hyperlink>, in which everyone is a prisoner of war. Betrayal looms over each moment to come, be it through the enemy, the land viciously changing shape, or even your own soldiers."
button_0: "Speak to me of the Gildercoil and its bearings."
title: Emissary of the Shad'rai

body_footer: "Let me conquer your heart, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>, just as I will conquer your cities. Please resist, it will be all the more alluring."
body_header: "A new pawn has entered the playground of lust. Does it know passion? Is it the <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{seducer/seductress}</eventColor>>> or the seduced?" Soft whispers announce to you the coming of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Title}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> looks at you with glaring lechery. Or feigned lechery, for <<p:EventPlayer>> surely trained this act to perfection. <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> makes a lascivious gesture. "Embrace your carnal desires, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. Pleasure is a feast without satiation and I invite you to take a bite."
button_0: Bear the unsettling speech in silence. You will respond on the battlefield <unitprod></unitprod>.
button_1: Listen unmoved. A focused mind <knowledge></knowledge> won't be bothered by this charade.
button_2: <<Co:EventPlayer>> sins will be <<o:EventPlayer>> downfall. Your empire is a bastion of virtue <orderboon></orderboon>.
button_3: You accept the challenge. No one can beat your <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor> in their violent revelry <chaosboon></chaosboon>.
title: The Madness of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: "Many of the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> have expressed their desire to lend more aid. Choose what you deem the most helpful for your campaign."
body_header: "I applaud your determination, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>." <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> claps her hands ostentatiously.
body_lore: "You truly have become a weaver of nightmares. The trap has been prepared—time to lure your victims to their doom."
button_0: Choose the <eventColor>{EventUnit01}</eventColor> <unit></unit> of Yaka Enkhanan.
button_2: Take the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> <item></item> of Ydgaard Worldbender.
button_3: Summon the <eventColor>{EventUnit02}</eventColor> <unit></unit> of Nimue the Siren Queen.
button_4: "They help now my victory is drawing near? The glory <influence></influence> will be mine alone!"
title: Nightmare Weaver: Aftermath

body_footer: "Cast the Mind Thread spell on a Godir, and you shall find a way to force out what they know of the Gildercoil."
body_header: "You have found your first suspect, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>." <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> shows a cold smile. "Then it is time to teach you about the Mind Thread spell."
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> continues: "As our <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> ally <eventColor>{ArachnaSecondary.FirstName}</eventColor> would say, a spider does not openly attack its prey; it finds a way to trap its victim in its webs. The Mind Thread spell works in similar ways. It allows you to invade the mind of a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> to learn of their nightmares and trap them within their innermost fears or ambitions."
button_0: "Insidious. I like it <evilact></evilact>."
button_1: "This seems like a necessary evil."
title: Nightmare Weaver

body_footer: "The bloodshed of the battlefield is only the appetizer. Once the vanquished enter the slaughterhouse, the true fun begins."
body_header: A flickering flame taunts your eyes as <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> ascends from a pool of scarlet ichor.
body_lore: "Some say the blood of men would be an aphrodisiac," <<p:EventPlayer>> says with a malicious smile. "I say it is a source of power. I drink, while my <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> consume flesh and bones. It's a fair share, don't you think?"
button_0: "Cannibalism? This is disgusting..." <goodact></goodact>
button_1: "We shall see who laughs last."
button_2: "While I appreciate your morbid methods <evilact></evilact>, you must still fall before my throne."
title: The Madness of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: "I don't have the Gildercoil. I killed many to earn it as my prize, but to no avail. Now, take this thing away—please!"
body_header: At the sight of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> freezes.
body_lore: Seemingly unable to act or flee, <<p:EventPlayer>> expresses growing terror as the horrible creature slowly draws close to <<P:EventPlayer>>.
button_0: Let the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> drag <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> to the Astral Sea. <evilact></evilact>
button_1: "Leave now and never come back!" <goodact></goodact>
button_2: "If I save you, you serve me."
title: Tormented Past: Aftermath

body_footer: "Lay down your weapons and you may find peace in the afterlife. All who resist will be struck down and purged."
body_header: "Begone, foul spawn of <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink>!" A righteous shout pierces the skies as <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> descends from above with holy fury.
body_lore: "Your dark disguises cannot fool my true sight, for your inner demons have betrayed your purpose. The Crimson Caldera is an ever-flowing chalice of violence and death. I will drink from it."
button_0: "You shall have your war."
title: The Madness of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: "There is one such <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> chained to the Crimson Caldera. Free <<p:EventUnit>> and <<p:EventUnit>> won't deny you the judgement of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>."
body_header: "The demons of <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> bask in corruption," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> elaborates. "More than destruction, they seek to foster the inner demons of their victims."
body_lore: "On rare occasions, those fiends succeed in dragging a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to their demonic realm, where they bind and attempt to turn it through never-ending rituals."
button_0: "Judgment day will be coming."
title: Unholy Ambitions

body_footer: "I do not have the Gildercoil. But take what you want, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. Anything to avert the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> from my path."
body_header: The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> ascends to the clouds above <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. <<Co:EventUnit>> mere presence causes <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> to unravel.
body_lore: "Your unholy powers are beyond what I expected, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. I shall withdraw from the Crimson Caldera and not return." Anxiously, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> gazes at the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> and then back at you.
button_0: "Let it be known throughout the realm <influence></influence> that you withdraw at my mercy."
button_1: "Make your most zealous troops <unit></unit> pledge allegiance to me."
button_2: "I don't need your pitiful offerings. Judgment awaits <evilact></evilact>."
title: Unholy Ambitions: Aftermath

body_footer: "What you need is a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to threaten <<ge:judgment,EventPlayer.FirstName>>."
body_header: "There is an old saying that what an inquisitor fears the most is the inquisition itself." <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> speaks slowly, interpreting the glimpse of <<ge:mind,EventPlayer.FirstName>>.
body_lore: "It seems that the zeal of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> is driven by <<o:EventPlayer>> fear of not being worthy <<r:EventPlayer>>. By culling evil, <<p:EventPlayer>> attempts to prove <<o:EventPlayer>> purity of faith, yet <<p:EventPlayer>> fears the true path to ascension is still hidden from <<P:EventPlayer>>."
button_0: "The plan is good, yet where would I find a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> in a demonic realm?"
title: Judging the Judge

body_footer: "There are three <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> dedicated to Atyngwe far to the southwest. Negotiate well, and <<ge: contract,EventPlayer.FirstName>> will be yours."
body_header: "A contract with the Princes of <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> can't be broken. But it can be altered."
body_lore: "If Atyngwe signs over <<ge: debt,EventPlayer.FirstName>> to you, <<p:EventPlayer>> will be at your mercy. Atyngwe himself has no holdings in the Crimson Caldera, but there are ways of making yourself heard."
button_0: <<ge: schemes,EventPlayer.FirstName>> are about to end.
title: Infernal Dealings

body_footer: "Tell me, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, what is it that you have to offer in exchange for the soul of a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>?"
body_header: At last, Atyngwe himself answers your calls. "I have come."
body_lore: "What you seek will be costly, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>." Within Atyngwe's hands, a parchment scroll signed in blood appears. "A contract with a Prince of <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> is no mere trade good. But you have piqued my interest..."
button_0: "My victories <influence></influence> in the Crimson Caldera will be dedicated to you, O Atyngwe, greatest of all Demonic Princes."
button_1: "I gift your majesty an army <unitprod></unitprod> to command."
button_2: "One soul for the souls of a nation <population></population>, a sacrifice worth making <evilact></evilact>."
button_3: This price is too high. Better to take on <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> the conventional way.
title: Meeting the Devil

body_footer: "<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> is not the captive of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, but <<p:EventPlayer>> lost <<o:EventPlayer>> soul to the Demonic Prince Atyngwe and must, by contract, abide to his will."
body_header: "Oh my, oh my..." <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> raises an eyebrow. "Even for <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, this mind is a maze not easily navigated."
body_lore: "<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> dwells in deception and trickery. Anything <<p:EventPlayer>> speaks seem to be lies, yet there is one ironic truth in <<o:EventPlayer>> staged plea for help."
button_0: Ask how this will aid with your cause.
title: Weakness of Truth

body_footer: It is clear that nothing of use can come from talking to the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>.
body_header: As you call out to Atyngwe, a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> emerges from the closing infernal rift the cultists had summoned. "You calls my master, yes, yes?"
body_lore: Having heard your case, the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> shakes <<o:EventUnit>> head, giggling. "Silly wizard, demon contractses are not for trade, no, no." <<Cp:EventUnit>> mockingly jumping from leg to leg in a twitchy manner. "But I can throw you a burny rock. One, two and it bites!"
button_0: Let the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> return to <<o:EventUnit>> master.
title: Meeting the Dirt Beneath the Devil's Advocate's Shoes

body_footer: Which <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> will be the target of your dark intrusion?
body_header: Performing the ritual taught to you by <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>, you recite the incantations of the Mind Thread spell:
body_lore:
"When darkness falls
and shadows creep
a weaver comes to those who sleep.
Spin me a thread of dreams and fears,
a net that takes me to their tears."
button_0: <eventColor>{DarkAI}</eventColor>
button_1: <eventColor>{BarbAI}</eventColor>
button_2: <eventColor>{IndusAI}</eventColor>
button_3: <eventColor>{Frikka}</eventColor>
button_4: <eventColor>{HighAI}</eventColor>
button_5: No one to target
title: Casting the Mind Thread Spell

body_footer: "Patience. Were you not aware that we demons invented bureaucracy? It was a stroke of genius."
body_header: Once more you challenge Atyngwe to show himself. This time a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> comes forward.
body_lore: "A contract modification concerning the lessee <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>? Delightful," <<p:EventUnit>> says in a dry voice. "Well, fill in the forms and we will evaluate the request. No specific deadline assured."
button_0: Let the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> return through the infernal rift.
button_3: Command the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to call forth <<o:EventUnit>> master directly.
button_4: Threaten to smite the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> with holy light.
title: Meeting the Devil's Advocate

body_footer: "You may own me in the afterlife, but until then I am free to go. Take what pleases you most as a toll for my debt."
body_header: Noting the very familiar parchment scroll in your hands, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> shows clear signs of panic.
body_lore: "How... generous of you to redeem my contract and set me free from Atyngwe's demanding grip." Seeing your amused reaction, <<p:EventPlayer>> stops. "Well played, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. If I had the Gildercoil, it would be yours."
button_0: "Empty your treasury <gold></gold>, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>!"
button_1: "Send all mana <mana></mana> you have stored!"
button_2: "Share your secrets <knowledge></knowledge>, trickster mage!"
title: Infernal Dealings: Aftermath

body_footer: "This hammer owes its power to the soul of a Storm Giant dwelling inside. Which of my artifacts will yours inhabit, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>?"
body_header: The fanfare of a thousand hammers hitting an anvil heralds the coming of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, Demonic Prince of the Forge.
body_lore: "Welcome, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, to a <hyperlink>world of reclamation</hyperlink>, where even the most loathsome soul receives its purpose. Work in the crucible, fuel the fires of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> or prove worthy to augment my machines and weaponry with your life force. Either way, you are a valuable resource to <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>."
button_0: "I will be your executioner's sword."
title: The Madness of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> twitches at <<o:EventHero>> ethereal web, which starts moving as liquid shades violently devour the horn. "When a foe can't be trapped, it must be overwhelmed."
body_header: Trying to stalk the mind of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, you sense a strong force pushing your astral grip aside, like plated armor deflecting an arrow.
body_lore: "Invading the memory of a Demonic Prince? I admire your ambitions, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>." <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> takes out the horn of a bull and slowly covers it in dark astral strings. "But it seems that ages of competition and betrayal have taught the Princes of <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> to protect their minds well."
button_0: Accept the gift <unit></unit> of <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>.
title: Mind Barrier

body_footer: While contemplating that the Gildercoil was not to be found with either of the present <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, you are approached by a suspiciously familiar figure - <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>!
body_header: The fields of the Crimson Caldera have been drenched with the blood of your adversaries.
body_lore: You have demonstrated valor and skill as a general on the field of battle and broken the curse of never-ending war in this realm. Whether the Princes of <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> will tolerate your foothold on their demonic world remains to be seen. For now there is peaceful silence.
button_0: Let <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> speak.
title: The Bounty of the Crimson Caldera

body_footer: The Gildercoil is not to be found with <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. You cast <<P:EventPlayer>> into the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink> as a testament to what becomes of your foes.
body_header: Armor was shattered, strongholds breached, and <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> lies defeated at your feet.
body_lore: "We all came to the Crimson Caldera to claim the Gildercoil for ourselves. The whispers of the realm... promise it as a reward to the last who lives. A demon I once seduced called out the name Perumplex, but I have yet to hear its meaning."
button_0: We must keep searching.
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

button_0: We must keep searching.
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_header: Armor was shattered, strongholds breached, and <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> lies defeated at your feet.
body_lore: "Cursed be the name of Gontro, lowest and most despicable of all the Demonic Princes. He shaped this arena of eternal battle, luring in victims to fight over it to the death. The Gildercoil... I will have it... another day."
button_0: We must keep searching.
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

button_0: We must keep searching.
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: The Gildercoil is not to be found with <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. A hell rift opens up below <<p:EventPlayer>> into which <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> is dragged by claws of pure shadow.
body_header: Armor was shattered, strongholds breached, and <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> lies defeated at your feet.
body_lore: "Oh <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, why have you no mercy with a poor soul in need? My hour of doom draws near... I will pay for these words, but Atyngwe is who you must seek."
button_0: We must keep searching.
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: "You have earned the bounty of the Crimson Caldera, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. The Gildercoil gave me what I desired, and I have no regrets about signing over the item of eternal <hyperlink>Archon</hyperlink> wrath to your name."
body_header: "Many have come and died in this arena of my personal disport. They all sought power and found ironic death—except you."
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> makes a gesture, as if putting down a mask, briefly revealing a horned, infernal visage. "I have many names. Atyngwe, Liztia, Perumplex, Zhitur, Gontro... people get creative when it comes to the Demonic Prince of Deceit."

body_header: "Victory!" is what echoes in the streets of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, "Victory!" is what's engraved in the hearts of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> for <eventColor>{EventEnemy}</eventColor>, <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> of Fire, has been defeated.

Was it truly a <hyperlink>Mortal Hero</hyperlink> that took down the <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventEnemy.FirstName}</eventColor>? Or had your journey of knowledge and power already altered your destiny?

body_footer: Elya the Maer joins you as you leave for Magehaven, victorious.

I fear I have naught to give as a reward for a Godir... but if you allow me to join you on your travels I may share what I have learned as Nimue's prisoner."

I fear I have naught to give as a reward for a Godir... but if you allow me to join you on your travels I may share what I have learned as Nimue's prisoner."

body_lore: "<eventColor>{TargetPlayer}</eventColor> is the first of the <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> and a loyal friend of the Archons. <<Cp:TargetPlayer>> could have been a god. Instead <<p:TargetPlayer>> became a mere watchman, waiting for a foe to strike <<P:TargetPlayer>> down."
