title: The Battle for Grexolis

body_footer: "Nothing can withstand our combined magical force. Together, we will cast a spell that shakes the foundations of <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink>."
body_header: "Enough talk. Destiny does not wait." <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> ignites the shards of the broken figurine until they incinerate.
body_lore: "It does not matter who or what stands in the way of our victory. We are <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>. We are <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink>! Gone are the cursed times when we had to trust in the schemes of lowly mortals to achieve our goals."
button_0: Perform <<gu:ritual of the pyre,EventPlayer.FirstName>>.
button_1: Perform <<gu:ritual of the drowned,Nimue.FirstName>>.
button_2: Perform <<gu:ritual of shattered earth,Ydgaard.FirstName>>.
button_3: Perform <<gu:ritual of the mirror curse,Arachna.FirstName>>.
title: Shad'rai Magic

body_footer: "You cannot fathom the evil which I guard. It is not the warden you should fear, but the prisoners."
body_header: A harsh voice, which seems to resonate from the depths of the Astral Void, commands you to leave <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink>: "Flee, you fools!"
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> comes forward, stern and immovable like a lone rock within the tide. "You have come to a forbidden world. Leave now and you may live. Stay and you will meet your doom."
button_0: Heed your allies. Empty Archon lies won't scare away the Shad'rai.
title: The First Godir

body_footer: The <hyperlink>Covenant</hyperlink> have followed the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> to <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink>. They will do anything to foil your plans.
body_header: From the fog of war, <eventColor>{Meandor}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Sundren}</eventColor>, and <eventColor>{Fangir}</eventColor> emerge.
body_lore:
"It seems you forgot to invite us to your mad attempt at unleashing cosmic disaster," {Meandor.FirstName} says coldly.

"First you brought conflict to innocent worlds," {Sundren.FirstName} continues, "and now... this." {Fangir.FirstName} nods silently. <> does not fancy frivolous banter.
button_0: They are trapped in past conflicts. But the victor rewrites history.
title: The Covenant

body_footer: Give <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> one of your <whisperingStone></whisperingStone> <hyperlink>Whispering Stones</hyperlink> to start <hyperlink>Negotiation</hyperlink> and gradually improve their <hyperlink><allegiance></allegiance>Allegiance</hyperlink> with you.
body_header: You meet <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor>, who parted ways with the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> loyal to <<P:EventHouseLord>> as your tribe entered the <hyperlink>Valley of Wonders</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "So we speak again, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> says with a stern voice. "Remember, we of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> seek no quarrel. It was magic that caused the loss of our homeland, magic that killed the elder of our tribe. When you took up the elder's <hyperlink>Tome</hyperlink> you asked for doom. We keep our distance. Evading all magic will keep us safe."
button_0: "Let us formally begin a diplomatic relationship."
button_2: "We shall see what this means for the future of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. For now, we part."
title: Meeting the Separatists

body_footer: The ruins would make for a formidable location to found a <hyperlink>City</hyperlink> and let the burdened past make way for a new future.
body_header: Within the depths of the valley, your <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> comes across a large area of overgrown ruins.
body_lore: What has now largely been reclaimed by nature must have once been the thriving city of a great civilization. However, a lingering force of bitterness dwells beneath the peaceful surface. You can sense there are <hyperlink>spirits</hyperlink> which still begrudge the ancient woe that happened here.
button_0: "I will consider this."
button_2: "These old spirits give me a prime opportunity to study <knowledge></knowledge> the past."
button_3: "Past atrocities are the pawns that sow what I shall reap <souls></souls>..."
button_4: "These people had a strong link to the spirits of nature. I shall call forth their guardian."
title: Remnants of a Distant Past

hero: Within the depths of the valley, your hero <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> comes across a large area of overgrown ruins.
lord: Within the depths of the valley, you come across a large area of overgrown ruins.

body_footer: "Your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> may be of use to raise the monuments of my glory after all. Kneel down and save them. Now!"
body_header: Columns of smoke rise above the <hyperlink>Valley of Wonders</hyperlink> and <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Name}</eventColor> is taunting you to surrender.
body_lore: "There is no victory against the raging storm, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. The great empires of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> could not stop our mere servants, the Shadowborn. Now they crumble before the full might of the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink>."
button_0: "We will never surrender to an invading <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Title}</eventColor>!"
title: <<ge:Claim,EventPlayer.FirstName>>

body_footer: "You are not alone in this, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. The creatures of the Valley are joining our cause. They will answer your call..."
body_header: "Well spoken, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>!" <eventColor>{AllyPlayer}</eventColor> shouts with a fierce glimmer in <<o:AllyPlayer>> eyes.
body_lore: "The people of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> are resourceful. Greater forces than this have failed to claim our world before. <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> would know this were <<o:EventPlayer>> immense ego not shrouding <<o:EventPlayer>> memory."
button_0: Invoke the wardens of the forest.
button_4: Let your voice echo through the mountains about.
button_5: Call to the ancient spirits, keepers of the ages past.
title: <<ge:Retaliation,AllyPlayer.FirstName>>

body_footer: "I am immortal. If I fall, I return. Your life however,... it ends."
body_header: A calm settles on the battlefield near <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. Or so it seemed, for <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> does not tolerate silence.
body_lore: "Any victory you could achieve today will be meaningless, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> is but a pawn in this game of power. We came to punish the infidels, reward our loyal servants. In the meantime the plans of the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> are coming to fruition, beyond your reach or comprehension."
button_0: "Then let us end this, one way or the other!"
title: <<ge:Fury,EventPlayer.FirstName>>

body_footer: "The Covenant are sending you a gift from <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, 0000042800000747. You will bring down <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>, end <<o:EventPlayer>> onslaught!"
body_header: "Don't listen to those lies, 0000042800000747." <eventColor>{AllyPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> raises <<o:AllyPlayer>> <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. "Fighting for the ones you love is never in vain!"
body_lore: "<eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> may claim that the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> are the undisputed Rulers beyond <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, but they are not. In <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, they are only one faction among many. We of the <hyperlink>Covenant</hyperlink> condemn their actions. And we confront them, where we can."
button_0: Your trust in my abilities will not be misplaced.
title: <<ge:Retaliation,AllyPlayer.FirstName>>

body_footer: "You are making a grave mistake, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. In the end, the Shad'rai will be the only winners in this needless war."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> looks at you with contempt: "So it has come to this, and the refugees in need of shelter have become the invaders."
body_lore: "History keeps repeating itself. Betrayal and aggressive migration have challenged my people in each of the ages past. Yet we persist, and will push back your <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> now that we must."
button_0: "I will break the cycle of ages. We <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> will claim this Valley of Wonders—and keep it."
button_5: "I write my own legend, and that has your head mounted on my throne room wall. <evilact></evilact>"
title: The War with <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: Before you can act or move, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> vanishes in a blue swirl of magic, escaping to the Astral Sea.
body_header: The forces of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> have fallen on the field of battle or scattered into the woods. <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> <<r:EventPlayer>> stands alone.
body_lore: "Stay back, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, or I will plunge your soul into the Astral Void!" <<Cge:Appearance,EventPlayer.FirstName>> has changed. <<Cp:EventPlayer>> looks pale and ferocious, grim hatred burning in <<o:EventPlayer>> eyes. It makes you recall the myths of Dark Elves preying on the unwary in times before the old Commonwealth came to be.
button_0: "Flee in shame, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. The glory of this victory <influence></influence> shall be mine regardless."
title: Vanquishing <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: <eventColor>{AllyPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> turns to you: "The Valley of Wonders is yours to protect now, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>!" Then she vanishes in a swirl of magic, escaping to the Astral Sea.
body_header: <<Co:AllyPlayer>> <eventColor>{AllyRace}</eventColor> forces have fallen or scattered and <eventColor>{AllyPlayer}</eventColor> stands alone against the tide of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "Stay back, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>, or I will plunge your soul into the Astral Void!" <<Cge:Appearance,AllyPlayer.FirstName>> has changed. <<Cp:AllyPlayer>> looks pale and ferocious, grim hatred burning in <<o:AllyPlayer>> eyes. It makes you recall the myths of Dark Elves preying on the unwary in times before the old Commonwealth came to be.
button_0: "My people will succeed <unitprod></unitprod>, where the <eventColor>{AllyRace}</eventColor> failed."
button_5: "All hail <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor> <influence></influence>, Athla's last hope."
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{AllyPlayer}</eventColor>

sundren_not_befr: Before <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> can act or move, <eventColor>{AllyPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> vanishes in a blue swirl of magic, escaping to the Astral Sea.

body_footer: "You will not journey anywhere, old man." <eventColor>{AllyPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> comes forward, conjuring a shadow prison into which <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> is forced to enter. "Only a fool would dismiss the secrets lingering within your ancient mind."
body_header: Even in <<o:EventPlayer>> darkest hour, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> stands tall, a mountain within a raging storm.
body_lore: "I have failed," <<p:EventPlayer>> says, <<o:EventPlayer>> eyes staring beyond the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> toward the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>. "I long... for Emnora. Yet it cannot be. Perhaps it is time for the last journey of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>. The <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> will know."
button_0: "The glory <influence></influence> of vanquishing the first Godir is ours!"
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: "The fight is over," 4 responds with authority. "We owe you no proof of our personal strength."
body_header: With <<o:EventPlayer>> armies vanquished on the field of battle, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> is being cornered by the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> Godir.
body_lore: "Come! Fight me, if you dare!" <<g:roar,EventPlayer.FirstName>> shakes the earth underneath while <<p:EventPlayer>> raises <<o:EventPlayer>> <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> to challenge <<o:EventPlayer>> enemies to direct combat. "If I die, my spirit will join with Cantarra and bolster its strength before darkness falls."
button_0: Seal <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> in a cage of magic suppression.
title: The Fall of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: Which spell of your Shad'rai allies do you choose to break the remaining opposition on <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink>?
body_header: A momentous achievement asks for momentous magic to follow.
body_lore: Empowered by their victory and the mana stored in the Wizard's Tower of the fallen enemy, the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> are ready to perform another ritual.
button_0: Perform <<gu:ritual of the pyre,EventPlayer.FirstName>>.
button_3: Perform <<gu:ritual of the drowned,Nimue.FirstName>>.
button_4: Perform <<gu:ritual of shattered earth,Ydgaard.FirstName>>.
button_5: Perform <<gu:ritual of the mirror curse,Arachna.FirstName>>.
title: Shad'rai Magic

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> has retreated with grave wounds into the Wizard's Tower of <eventColor>{AllyPlayer}</eventColor>. There <<p:EventPlayer>> will rest until enough of <<o:EventPlayer>> strength has been restored.
body_header: The battle for <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink> rages relentlessly. The clashing armies of the <hyperlink>Covenant</hyperlink>, <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> and the warden of Grexolis can bring down even a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "Impossible!" <<Cg:cry of dismay,EventPlayer.FirstName>> rends the air of Grexolis as <<p:EventPlayer>> is overwhelmed by the host of the enemy. "I am the <eventColor>{EventPlayer.Title}</eventColor>. My might bows before none, nor will I fall... today."
button_0: Where <<p:EventPlayer>> lost, my troops will claim victory! This is not over yet.
title: The Retreat of <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>

body_footer: "Stop! Do not move just yet!" <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> who, like the Covenant Godir, has been rendered a powerless spectator, raises <<o:EventPlayer>> voice.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>, the <hyperlink>Covenant</hyperlink> - neither of them could withstand the might of the Shad'rai. With <hyperlink>Grexolis</hyperlink> secured, <eventColor>{AllyPlayer}</eventColor> beckons you to take out the Gildercoil.
body_lore: "It is time, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>. Use the power of the Gildercoil! Do what was forbidden!" <eventColor>{AllyPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> entices you with a lavish smile, as if <<p:AllyPlayer>> needed to grant you an excuse for a sin of cosmic scale. Evidently, even the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> are anxious about the moment to come.
button_0: Listen to <<g:words,EventPlayer.FirstName>>.
title: The World Vault: Aftermath

body_footer: <eventColor>{AllyPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> steps forward, making a gesture as if <<p:AllyPlayer>> were introducing <<r:AllyPlayer>>. "You are right, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>. It is time <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor> learned the truth..."
body_header: "You think you know well the consequences of opening the World Vault, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> begins, "but look around at whose words you trusted on this journey to oblivion."
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> points his hand at all the present <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink>: "A self-proclaimed god-pharaoh, burning whoever questions his ego. An obsessed siren, drowning her own children. A hoarder of wealth who sold his head and heart for power. And then this one..." <<Cg:eyes,EventPlayer.FirstName>> rest on <eventColor>{AllyPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>. "You don't even know <<o:AllyPlayer>> true name."
button_0: Wait for <eventColor>{AllyPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> to finish.
title: <<g:Intervention,EventPlayer.FirstName>>

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> turns to you. "I'm sorry, but this is too important." Without warning, a summoned hand snatches the Gildercoil from you, putting it in <<g:hands,EventHero.FirstName>>.
body_header: "<eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>!" The name is gasped by the present <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> as <eventColor>{AllyPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> magically shifts her appearance, revealing <<r:AllyPlayer>> to be <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "As can be witnessed here," <<p:AllyPlayer>> says slowly, "things are often not as they first seem. Releasing what was seen as harmful in ages past may be the solution to problems present. The <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> are losing their war, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor>. Slowly but steadily the shadows are creeping forward, unless... some unexpected guests were to appear." Now it is <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> whose voice reveals dismay: "The Endailon! You must be beyond desperate."
button_0: Watch <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> open the World Vault.
title: The revelation of <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventPlayer.FirstName}</eventColor> remains silent. It seems <<p:EventPlayer>> does not deem <<g:words,AllyPlayer.FirstName>> worthy of any reaction.
body_header: "It need not be like this, <eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor>." <eventColor>{AllyPlayer}</eventColor> speaks with a tender voice, looking <<P:EventPlayer>> straight in the eyes.
body_lore: "We have much in common. Why fight amongst us <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> when the true enemy is breeding new darkness by the day? Would it not be wise to leave this post and join the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> in their fight, while retaining peace with the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink>, who could be valuable future allies?"
button_0: <<Cp:EventPlayer>> had <<o:EventPlayer>> chance for peaceful surrender.
title: Tempting the Untemptable

body_footer: How will you protect the citizens of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> from the appetite of the roaming Undead?
body_header: One of your city guards from <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> has unsettling news to share.
body_lore: "These creatures are kept alive by foul magic alone!" the head of the guard explains. "Restless Undead, risen from a <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor>! First, they horrified our local farmers, who found their cattle with their brains sucked out at dawn. Now, it seems that the Undead hunger for more."
button_0: Repel the Undead <mana></mana> with a warding spell.
button_1: Channel enough mana <mana></mana> into the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor> to trap the Undead there.
button_2: "Let me seal the earth at the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor>. That will put them to rest."
button_3: "These pathetic brain-eaters are no match for our defenses!"
button_4: "If it's brains they want, we have a few scholars <knowledge></knowledge> to spare... <evilact></evilact>"
button_5: "By the will of Nature, I will make these corpses rot away. Now!"
title: Braingorgers

body_footer: How do you respond to the terrible threat of the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> they call the "Horror of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink>" and its <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor>?
body_header: Rumors of an occultist group near your city <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> have long spread fear amongst your population. Now that fear is given a new form.
body_lore: "Deliver your children to us!" the hysterical voice of a cultist can be heard from beyond the city gate. "Or we will invoke the Horror of <hyperlink>Urrath</hyperlink> to drag your souls to the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>!" They gesture wildly to the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> in your domain.
button_0: Rally a mob <unitprod></unitprod> to drive the cultists away.
button_1: Rally the entire city <unitprod></unitprod> to root out the very <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: Ignore them. This "Horror of Urrath" sounds pathetic.
button_3: Actually deliver the children <population></population>. That will be the end of it. <evilact></evilact>
button_4: Invoke this <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> yourself.
title: Dark Extortion

body_footer: Will you appease the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> with a sacrifice - or put an end to <<g:tradition,EventCity>>?
body_header: Your people of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> share a special link with the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: They worship the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and its feathered kin, believing that a great bird supports the sun on its wings. However, the birds themselves mostly only care about the sacrificial offerings. They have grown more demanding over time, and now threaten to attack <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
button_0: "I respect their beliefs <happiness></happiness>. Let the livestock <food></food> of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> nurture the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>."
button_1: Bribe <gold></gold> their shamans to end this madness and repel all birds from the <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: The birds are no match for <<g:defenses,EventCity>>.
button_3: "Their primitive beliefs offend the gods. Cleansing <mana></mana> the birds and their <eventColor>{EventSpawner.Name}</eventColor> is the right path."
button_4: Foster their special link to tame the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>.
title: Birds of Pray

body_footer: "Will you help, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, in seeking the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> needed to reforge the weapon of my forefathers?"
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> approaches you with solemn determination.
body_lore: "These are the fragments of the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>," <<p:EventHero>> says, showing you a bundle of carefully wrapped weapon shards. "Long ago, it inspired fear in the enemies of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. Its keepers have long searched for a way to imbue it with new life, but never have we found the mythical <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> it is made of."
button_0: "I shall aid you. A hero is only as good as <<o:EventHero>> weapon!"
button_2: "There is no time for idle quests like this..."
title: <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> Reforged

body_footer: "I am in your debt, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>" <<p:EventHero>> says. "Any path you set out for me, I shall follow."
body_header: With the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> retreats to <<o:EventHero>> forge. At nightfall <<p:EventHero>> returns to you, the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> in <<o:EventHero>> hands.
body_lore: "At last! Our fabled weapon will return to battle, and we <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> will stand triumphant!" <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> shouts out in triumph, lifting the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> toward the sky. Then, after a while, <<p:EventHero>> relaxes <<o:EventHero>> posture and turns to you.
button_0: "Hone your smithing <unitprod></unitprod> skills! In <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> there are many men who need arms."
button_3: "Carry the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> for the glory <happiness></happiness> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>!"
button_4: "Magic artifacts are worthy of in-depth study. <knowledge></knowledge> Research and learn!"
button_5: "Train <xp></xp>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>. Become worthy of the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>."
title: <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> Reforged: Aftermath

body_footer: Will you promise to build more <farm></farm> <hyperlink>Farm</hyperlink> to still the "healthy" appetite of the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>?
body_header: The <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> Council sends their chief deputy to meet you with a request.
body_lore: "For too long have we <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> suffered want," the deputy, a well-fed <<EventUnit<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>>, explains. "It is clear now, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, that your cities are in need of more farmland, so we can enjoy a third breakfast like any civilized people should."
button_0: "A good man must eat, that is for sure!"
button_1: "A second breakfast will have to suffice, for now."
button_2: "This self-indulgent gluttony will make you <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> too soft <unitprod></unitprod> for war!"
title: A Fine Meal

body_footer: "The people want to thank you with a gift. What shall the Council proclaim?"
body_header: The first sowing of the season has passed, and returned to you a very pleased <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> Council deputy.
body_lore: "O jolly day!" the deputy starts his praise. "No longer must we <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> be afraid of starving when we fancy our third breakfast! Your name is on everyone's lips, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. Always remember: full <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> are happy <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor>."
button_0: "That they shall nurture the crops <food></food> they so eagerly asked for."
button_1: "That they must not forget to bring offerings to the spirits <mana></mana> of the land."
button_3: "That their firstborn shall serve the army of the <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> <unitprod></unitprod> in military service."
title: A Fine Meal: Aftermath

body_footer: You are at war with <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of the <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> greets you with hostility.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> will fight for our freedom and stand against anyone who threatens our <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink>, even when they are led by a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> like you. Don't think our shared racial heritage will curb our convictions."
button_0: Inspect the insolent <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: "So be it!"
title: Meeting Hostile <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>

body_footer: You are at war with <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of the <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> greets you with hostility.
body_lore: "We <eventColor>{EventHouseRace.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> will fight for our freedom and stand against anyone who threatens our <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink>, even when they are led by a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> like you. The blood of invaders, thieves and spies will nourish the fields."
button_0: Inspect the insolent <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: "So be it!"
title: Meeting Hostile <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> makes an elaborate gesture, after which a map showing the major strongholds of the Crimson Caldera appears. "This is where you must seek out all suspect Godir."
body_header: "The Gildercoil is not simply secreted somewhere in the Crimson Caldera," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> begins to explain. "It is safeguarded closely by its current owner."
body_lore: "The challenge is to find out by whom. All the present <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> are inherently suspect and must therefore be sought out. Just remember, they are all insane and will only tell the truth when forced to. Once you have found the first of them we shall talk again."
button_0: Take the map to begin your hunt.
button_1: The map is so primitive... Channel your arcane focus <mana></mana> to improve it.

body_header: As your troops move in to engage the ancient <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, <<p:EventStackLeader>> surprises them by simply sitting down.
body_lore: Though seated, the <hyperlink>primal being</hyperlink> still towers above your army, casting a long shadow that engulfs much of <<o:EventStackLeader>> surroundings. Once, <<p:EventStackLeader>> used <<o:EventStackLeader>> tremendous power to form the mountains and seas. Now the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> raises <<o:EventStackLeader>> arms in the timeless sign of surrender. Then <<p:EventStackLeader>> simply waits, <<o:EventStackLeader>> arms scraping the sky like two eerie pinnacles.
button_0: "Death to the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>!" <evilact></evilact>
button_1: "Go in peace, my gargantuan friend." <goodact></goodact>
button_2: "Go forth, <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, and tell all <influence></influence> that you live because I granted you mercy!"
title: Big Friendly <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>

body_footer: <<Cp:EventStackLeader>> gestures at <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> and then at himself and his opponent. "Who is worthier?"
body_header: Troops of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> watch two mighty but evenly matched warriors clash at the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, one of the battling warriors, stops and addresses <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> as they approach the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>. "Strength and glory! You serve <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, yes? Our <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> has decreed that whoever is stronger will have the honor of guarding this site. But we are evenly matched. You decide who is worthy and who can quit the field in shame!"
button_1: "Neither. You both require training! My men will train you, <unitprod></unitprod> and you will leave this site to me."
button_2: "Are you mewling pups?! Fight! The victor shall grant ME this site!"
button_3: "I see nobody worthy to guard this site. I see only a number of corpses to be!"
button_4: "I'll leave you to it..."
title: Dueling Barbarians

body_footer: <<Cp:EventStackLeader>> crosses <<o:EventStackLeader>> arms and stares <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> square in the eye. "What is best in life?"
body_header: Troops of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> stationed at the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> sit around a fire, discussing the merits of a barbarian's way of life.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> glances at <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> as <<p:EventHero>> approaches the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>. "I know you, you serve <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, no? You have learned much in your travels, yes? Help us settle an argument."
button_1: "Glory is best! <influence></influence> Leave and earn some for yourselves!"
button_2: "Valor is best. We are mightier than you. We claim this site!"
button_3: "Harmony is best. This land calls for <<g:rule,PlayerLeader>>."
button_4: "Battle is best! To crush your enemies, see them driven before you!"
button_5: "Honor is best. We honor your claim to this <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. Farewell."
title: Barbaric Philosophy

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> nervously awaits your response, one hand hovering close to their weapon.
body_header: There is something suspicious about the way a squad of troops from <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> warily watch your army's approach to <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>.
body_lore: As <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> approaches, they note standards and insignia of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> cast to the side. A frowning <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> says, "We just wish to be left alone, please move along." It would seem these troops are considering desertion...
button_0: "You are clearly deserters. Accept this donation <gold></gold> toward a fresh start. Now leave this place.
button_1: Compel them to repent and submit to you.
button_2: "Desertion is punishable by death!"
button_3: Leave them.
title: Just Deserters

body_footer: <<Cp:EventStackLeader>> gestures at <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>. "Are you an expert in magical energy convergences?"
body_header: The troops of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> stationed at the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor> seem to be observing the area whilst taking diligent notes.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> runs up to <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> as your army approaches the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>. "You can feel it as well, no?! A certain convergence of energies on this area! That must surely be why <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor> sent you! Are you here to study this obviously magical location too?"

button_1: "Witness the power of my magic while I claim this site!"
button_2: "Our blades will converge with your hearts!"
button_3: "We're merely passing through. Continue your studies undisturbed."
title: Converging Minds

body_footer: Do you allow the plaintive <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> gigantic clan to retreat, or will you attack?
body_header: The towering <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> gibbers in terror at your army's approach. <<Cp:EventStackLeader>> hunkers down, hiding <<o:EventStackLeader>> features behind gigantic fingers.
body_lore: Seeing their leader submit, the rest of <<o:EventStackLeader>> tribe follow suit. The area is soon filled with the sounds of mournful howls and deep-throated cries for mercy.
button_0: Slay them all! <evilact></evilact>
button_1: "Begone, gentle giants." <goodact></goodact>
button_2: Conscript <unitprod></unitprod> them as laborers <structureprod></structureprod> in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>.
title: Size Matters Not

body_footer: Will you avoid them and allow them to escape, or will you strike first?
body_header: An <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and other undead stare at your troops with fear and hunger in equal measure.
body_lore: Fear, however, soon seems to prevail, rendering the group unwilling to attack. The lifeless beings shuffle around, trying to keep their distance from your army.
button_0: "Death to these dead!"
button_1: Leave them dead and let them keep on causing mayhem. <evilact></evilact>
button_3: Using magic, <mana></mana> release their spirits and let these dead finally rest. <goodact></goodact>
button_4: "Stop wandering around aimlessly and join my ranks!"
title: A Lease on Unlife

body_footer: Will you grant them mercy, or will you attack?
body_header: A tortured-looking <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> minions gape at your army.
body_lore: Wordless, the vacant beings shuffle towards you, their limbs and features wrapped in grasping vines. Leaves shudder and bark creaks in silent supplication, but they make no otherwise hostile movements.
button_0: "Prune these shrubs!" <evilact></evilact>
button_1: Let them grow. <goodact></goodact>
button_2: Discover <knowledge></knowledge> how to carefully harvest <food></food> their vines and allow them to leave afterwards.
title: Seeds of Doubt

body_footer: Will you allow the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> folk safe passage or will you strike them down?
body_header: A group of hungry and frightened Fey folk do their best to hide behind <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> as your army approaches.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, putting on as brave a face as possible, tries to keep <<o:EventStackLeader>> group behind <<p:EventStackLeader>> and faces your troops defiantly, but otherwise says nothing and makes no hostile movements.
button_0: "No mercy!" <evilact></evilact>
button_1: "Peace, brave one." <goodact></goodact>
button_2: Trade them food <food></food> for Fey secrets <knowledge></knowledge> and allow them to leave.
title: Food for Thought

body_footer: Will you attack them, or allow <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> temperamental allies to retreat?
body_header: Temperatures in the immediate area rise and fall intermittently as a group of elemental beings panic at your army's approach.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, seemingly the leader of this group, wavers unsteadily before you. <<p:EventStackLeader>> seems aware that engaging you would result in almost certain death, but is unwilling to abandon <<o:EventStackLeader>> group.
button_0: Attack! <evilact></evilact>
button_1: Allow them to go. <goodact></goodact>
button_2: Demand a portion of their primal power <mana></mana> before they leave.
title: Elements of Surprise

body_footer: Will you allow them to summon their portal to <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> and leave these lands?
body_header: As your troops engage the group of fiends, it becomes apparent that they had been conjuring a portal to withdraw.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor>, the apparent leader of the gathering, casts a shrewd eye over your army. Seeing that there is scant hope of survival, <<p:EventStackLeader>> beckons <<o:EventStackLeader>> own troops to sit on the ground and submit before following suit <<r:EventStackLeader>>. <<Cp:EventStackLeader>> watches you with wary hope.
button_0: "Kill them all!" <evilact></evilact>
button_1: "Begone then, fiends, and do not return!" <goodact></goodact>
button_2: Bind the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> to you <mana></mana>.
title: Fiend or Foe

body_footer: Will you allow the airborne beasts to retreat with their eggs, or will you attack?
body_header: Your troops rush a group of winged creatures but notice that they neither attack nor retreat.
body_lore: Your foes fly around the area, flapping their wings and making alarmed noises. They don't wish to engage your superior numbers but appear loath to retreat too. It seems they are protecting some nearby nests.
button_0: "Cull them all." <evilact></evilact>
button_1: "Fly, you fowl!" <goodact></goodact>
button_2: Build an aviary <structureprod></structureprod> in <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor>, providing safety for the beasts <happiness></happiness>.
title: Flight or Fight

body_footer: Will you leave the macabre monsters to their terror or attack them anyway?
body_header: As your troops move to attack the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> collection of <hyperlink>horrors</hyperlink>, the enemy squeals and submits.
body_lore: Undulating flesh and writhing tentacles weave around in a grotesque show of panic, as your weapons surround the group of eldritch horrors from the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. While terrifying in aspect, these beings seem to have no fight in them. At least, not for you...
button_0: "Put them down!"
button_1: Allow them to flee and spread their terror in a rampage across the realm. <evilact></evilact>
button_2: Banish them <mana></mana> to the Astral Sea where they cannot harm anyone. <goodact></goodact>
title: Fathomless Intentions

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> ponders: "What shall it be then? Prudence, and we part as equals? Or glory, and one of us falls?"
body_header: Rather than engaging your approaching troops, the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> turns <<o:EventStackLeader>> sinewy neck as <<p:EventStackLeader>> regards them with an ancient, knowing gaze.
body_lore: "I see much in the way of strength and power before me," the great <hyperlink>dragon's</hyperlink> sonorous voice booms. Ages ago, <<p:EventStackLeader>> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> kin used primal forces to shape this realm. Now the serpentine monster pauses, casting a look of vast intelligence over your army. "I, too, you may agree, am mighty. Equally, we are matched, yes?"
button_0: "Glory, you overgrown worm! Attack!" <evilact></evilact>
button_1: "Peace, great dragon. Let us go our separate ways..." <goodact></goodact>
button_2: "Before we part in peace, a trade? Gold <gold></gold> for your hoard in exchange for ancient knowledge <knowledge></knowledge>."
title: Here Be Dragons

body_footer: "Kindly extend our receiver network to allow enhanced beamforming. Or, as your workers will understand it: please build additional <hyperlink><researchpost></researchpost>Research Posts</hyperlink>."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> respectfully greets you. "Wise <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, we chart the stars' movements. Our beamforming mages request your support."
body_lore: "Beamforming is quite straightforward. Starlight arrives here from the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> as rays. Our mages observe these rays for a minuscule moment. However, a star's distance and velocity cause a slight discrepancy in its rays' arrival at each of our <hyperlink><researchpost></researchpost>Research Posts</hyperlink>, causing noise. Combining channeled ray observations throughout our entire domain, slightly delayed to compensate for the discrepancy, forms a stronger and clearer signal.
button_0: "As you request. But I expect to share in your discoveries."
button_2: "Alternatively, I will share my own astral observations <knowledge></knowledge> with you."
button_3: "How about I directly manipulate the stars' movements instead, for you to observe?"
button_4: "This sounds like a waste of time and resources to me."
title: Astral Beamforming

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> bows. "Thanks to you, our <<m:EventUnit>> now harness the power of stars. We respectfully offer you any reward."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> returns to you shortly after you erected the final <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor>. "New revelations keep pouring in, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>!"
body_lore: "We were a bit uncertain about the attunement of the channeling delay at first, but we soon found we could offset the detections against the speed of magic over which we let flow our perceptions of the starlight pulses. This yielded new constellation charts, some of which we used to forge powerful <hyperlink>astral</hyperlink> visors, such as this!" <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> proudly holds up an immaculate <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>.
button_0: "Teach me some of the secrets the stars revealed to you!"
button_1: "Having a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> <unit></unit> in my service would benefit my own research!"
button_3: "In return for my aid, I welcome that beautiful <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> <item></item> you forged."
button_4: "I value our stellar friendship over any material reward, my friend."
title: Astral Beamforming: Aftermath

body_footer: Will you send a hunting party to <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> and join their hunt for the elusive Pyreborn <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>?
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> solemnly greets you. "Majestic <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> cordially invites you to join the Ceremonial Hunt of the Pyreborn <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>."
body_lore: "Once every decade, our finest hunters ride out in search of the Pyreborn <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>. We cull every creature we find and collect the meat for the glory of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>, until we finally catch that flame-infused <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>. You would grant us a tremendous honor by joining us."
button_0: "I am honored to join you."
button_2: "Unfortunately, I cannot spare any hunters currently. Good hunting!"
button_3: "I will send several hunters <unitprod></unitprod> from <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> to join you in my stead."
button_4: "I will have no part in your cruel rituals! <goodact></goodact>"
button_5: "Your hunt is brutal, not ceremonial. You can celebrate culture without bloodshed."
title: The Pyreborn Hunt

body_footer: "You outmatch us," <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> declares. "As the slayer of our venerable quarry, you are the first to claim your prize."
body_header: After slaying the Pyreborn <eventColor>{EventAnimal}</eventColor>, you hear the distant horns of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>. The Hunt is over!
body_lore: It is not long before <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> approaches you. <<Cp:EventHouseLord>> bows deeply. "The Pyreborn <eventColor>{EventAnimal}</eventColor> is slain! May the great Hunter <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor> usher in glory to our great <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>!" The minstrels in the <<G:entourage,EventHouseLord>> sing a short ballad of triumph. The Hunters gather every animal killed in the hunt, forming a respectable mountain of game.
button_0: "I will claim all the meat <food></food> that we collected today."
button_1: "You may keep the meat, but I will take the pelts <gold></gold>."
button_3: "Allow me to enlist <unit></unit> one of your formidable <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> hunters."
button_4: "Mounting the head of the <eventColor>{EventAnimal}</eventColor> shall symbolize my Empire's supremacy <influence></influence>."
title: The Pyreborn Hunt: Aftermath

body_footer: "The bad news is, those wretches over in <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> secretly stashed it in their vaults for ages! We must reclaim it!"
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>, your <hyperlink><<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink> requested an urgent audience with you. "My liege, I have at last located the long-lost <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>!"
body_lore: "The legends that surround the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> inspired me to become an adventurer. The relic's mythos is so entwined with my people's culture! Even today I heard the children of <eventColor>{HeroCity}</eventColor> sing their nursery rhyme: '<eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> / all <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> know its name / bakers, butchers, brigadiers / none deny its fame.' For centuries it was lost, but today I discovered its location!"
button_0: "We will defeat the tyrants of <eventColor>{TargetHouse}</eventColor> and reclaim <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>!"
button_2: "I will not wage war over your forgotten relic."
button_3: "You never told me you desire a <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. Let me replicate it!"
title: <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>, Reclaimed

hero_race_=_play: "The legends that surround the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> inspired me to become an adventurer. The relic's mythos is so entwined with our people's culture! For centuries it was lost, but today I discovered its location!"

body_footer: "We rightfully possess the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> once again! The vaults of <eventColor>{TargetHouse}</eventColor> are ours to plunder, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. What trophy will you claim?"
body_header: After your victory against <eventColor>{TargetHouse}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> immediately visits you. "You vanquished the <eventColor>{TargetRace}</eventColor>! The <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> is finally ours to claim!"
body_lore: "I already had some custodians search the city's vaults, my liege. They tell me that the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> was kept in pristine condition. Moreover, the vault is laden with treasures and relics! Ours for the taking! Let us loot—no—liberate these prizes from the greedy <eventColor>{TargetRace}</eventColor>, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>!" A feverish gleam has settled in <<G:eyes,EventHero>>.
button_0: "I will take their priceless treasures of gold and silver <gold></gold>."
button_1: "<<CG:crown jewels,TargetHouse>> will decorate my throne hall, elevating its splendor <influence></influence>."
button_3: "Who desires treasure when the city is ripe with souls <souls></souls> to harvest! <evilact></evilact>"
button_4: "Reap everything <food></food> <gold></gold> <influence></influence> they possess. The <eventColor>{TargetRace}</eventColor> shall witness the supremacy of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor> <evilact></evilact>."
button_5: "Reap everything <food></food> <gold></gold> <influence></influence> <souls></souls> they possess. The <eventColor>{TargetRace}</eventColor> shall witness the supremacy of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor> <evilact></evilact>."
title: <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>, Reclaimed: Aftermath

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> frowns. "I can manufacture Golems, defenders of our homelands. However, building them requires some <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>. Could you secure that?"
body_header: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, I urgently request an audience!" Your <hyperlink><<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> visits you with a concerned look in <<o:EventHero>> eyes. "Our defense is lacking."
body_lore: "I arduously serve your ambitions. For you, I venture into the wilderness or invade your rivals' territories." <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> kneels. "But now that I've started a family, my priorities have shifted. These days, my mind lingers with my family inside your borders. I've witnessed the ferocity of our enemies' forces. Our realm's protectors cannot withstand them. We need powerful reinforcements."
button_0: "Golems offer my people extraordinary protection, <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>. I will deliver the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>."
button_2: "I empathize with you, <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor>, yet my priorities lie elsewhere."
button_3: "You should settle <unit></unit> in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, to protect your family and train troops <unitprod></unitprod>."
title: Hearts of Iron

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> used the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> you found to construct two <<m:EventUnitB>>. <<Cp:EventHero>> gratefully offers you a shield. Will you accept the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>?
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> returns to you, visibly relieved. "Great news, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>! Now that we have the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>, I've built the Golems!"
body_lore: "These <<m:EventUnitB>> can defend your borders now. I can once again embark on journeys of conquest and exploration in your name, liberated from concern and hesitation." <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> produces an <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. "My eldest <<EventUnit<eventColor>{son/daughter}</eventColor>>> took the leftover <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> and made this in the smithy where <<p:EventUnit>> apprentices. Please accept this gift from my family to you."
button_0: "Have your <<EventUnit<eventColor>{son/daughter}</eventColor>>> equip the shield <<EventUnit<eventColor>{himself/herself}</eventColor>>> and serve me as a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>."
button_3: "Thank you, <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>. I will carry the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> <item></item> with pride."
button_4: "With this <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>, your eldest will protect your family when you're off adventuring <goodact></goodact>."
button_5: "Paint my coat of arms onto the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. It will adorn my throne room <influence></influence>."
title: Hearts of Iron: Aftermath

body_footer: "<<Cp:EventKnight>> is a liability, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. Eventually, some travelers visiting <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> will die. Unless we stop <<P:EventKnight>>."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>, your <hyperlink><<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink>, greets you with a warning: "Courageous <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, it has come to my attention that a dangerous Silver Knight is attacking travelers!"
body_lore: "This tyrannical warrior has declared <<r:EventKnight>> the <<G:sentinel,EventStructure>> and stops anyone traveling through. <<Cp:EventKnight>> issues the challenge of defeating <<P:EventKnight>> in close combat. Supposedly, <<p:EventKnight>> is a formidable duelist. No one is able to best <<P:EventKnight>>. I would love to challenge this Knight myself, given the opportunity."
button_0: "I must find this Silver Knight. And see to <<o:EventKnight>> defeat."
button_2: "I'm sure this matter will sort out itself eventually."
title: The Silver Knight

We delighted in the fruity nectars that its blossoms secrete. But that same cursed perfume lured the ravenous <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> horde!"

The company, led by a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, does not even care to what degree you actually pose a threat to the lands and its peoples. You are simply a means to bring honor and titles to their names.

Fresh bodies and <hyperlink>Souls</hyperlink> are burdensome to acquire, so when lambs lead themselves to the slaughter, you make efficient use of the opportunity. The symphony of death rattles that rises from the motionless bodies is a testament of your success.

button_1: Tease out the secrets <knowledge></knowledge> from their dying brains.

button_4: Raise some <eventColor>{RandomWarriorTitle}</eventColor> to serve you as <<m:EventUnit>> <unit></unit>.

You recently learned of ancient Prime Evils, who have cast the longest and darkest shadows in history. They bound their malice to animals, objects, even servants. A heinous ritual that demands great sacrifice.

The last of <<o:EnemyPlayerLeader>> misguided troops flee to hide in the hills and woods. <<Co:EnemyPlayerLeader>> <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, their spirits crushed by their false idol's yoke, now find themselves at your mercy, O glorious <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>!

button_0: Buy <gold></gold> troops <unit></unit> from <eventColor>{EventHouseB.Name}</eventColor>.
button_1: "You will voluntarily aid <unit></unit> us, in honor <influence></influence> of my majesty."
button_2: Reject their offer.
title: Wartime Profiteer

body_footer: "What say you? Will you concede defeat and bring peace to our kingdoms?"
body_header: Your enemy, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>, smugly offers a chance of surrender.
body_lore: "War is a terrible thing, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>, doubly so when you lose it! My troops are closing in on your city. You have done well, but perhaps it is time to end this. Let us spare our people further bloodshed."
button_0: "I... concede." <influence></influence>
button_1: "Concede? We have not yet BEGUN to fight!"
button_2: "Losing? I was just waiting for the corpses to pile up!"
button_3: "I shall call upon the land to aid its true master!"
title: One Last Chance

body_footer: "Please end this war with <eventColor>{EventHouseBLord}</eventColor>. Otherwise... well, this mediation attempt has fulfilled my duty."
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> approaches, an air of tired exasperation about <<P:EventHouseLord>>.
body_lore: "I crave a humble boon, mighty <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>. You war with <eventColor>{EventHouseBLord.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouseB}</eventColor>, who happens to be my bumbling <<EventHouseBLord<eventColor>{brother/sister}</eventColor>>>-in-law... Do not ask, 'tis a strange tale. <eventColor>{EventHouseB}</eventColor> is unlikely to win against a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> like yourself. Even if it does, theirs will be heavy losses. Our family honor dictates that I attempt to save my <<EventHouseBLord<eventColor>{brother/sister}</eventColor>>>-in-law."
button_0: "Nay. But your family will soon have one less bumbling fool!"
button_1: "Not a very heartfelt entreaty. But you moved me nonetheless. <goodact></goodact>"
button_2: "I shall become famous <influence></influence> for vanquishing your entire family! <evilact></evilact>"
title: Familial Obligation

body_footer: "As one Ruler to another... surrender! I beg you..."
body_header: Your enemy, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>, approaches. A thin veneer of pride fails to hide <<o:EventHouseLord>> obvious desperation.
body_lore: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>, we're at war. It could go either way. For you, mighty <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, this would be just another notch on your war-table. For me, it would mean more. In truth, I fear that my subjects are losing faith in me as their <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor>. In our culture, this has... lethal consequences!"
button_0: "No. Return and put your affairs in order."
button_1: "This war is trivial to me. Very well. Claim your victory. <goodact></goodact>"
button_2: "Naturally... after you sweeten the deal <gold></gold>."
button_3: "You're pathetic <influence></influence>. And all of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> will know. <morale></morale>"
title: Surrender! Please?

body_footer: "My <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, your saga needs to include who you were before becoming a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>." What can you tell the scribe?
body_header: "My <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>? Do you remember?" The young scribe's words startled you, as you recollect your former life.
body_lore: His straightforward question makes your mind regress to simpler times. Back when you were mortal, dreaming modest dreams, pursuing mundane ambitions. To ascend, you've had to sacrifice so many worldly attachments. Sacrifices that caused you to stop looking back. That caused you to forget. Only vague memories of what you were before linger.
button_0: "<matter></matter> I built bulwarks <structureprod></structureprod> to protect us from invading Wizard Kings!"
button_1: "<nature></nature> I peacefully raised a family <population></population> when the Wizard Kings invaded."
button_2: "<chaos></chaos> I stirred my tribe <unitprod></unitprod> to raid the invading Wizard Kings!"
button_3: "<order></order> I defended <influence></influence> my vassals against the invading Wizard Kings."
button_4: "<arcana></arcana> I drew power <mana></mana> from the invading Wizard Kings' Astral attunement.
button_5: "<shadow></shadow> I repelled invading Wizard Kings using serfs <unitprod></unitprod> and dark lore <knowledge></knowledge>."
button_6: "I unified all peoples under one banner. Mine <unit></unit>."
button_7: "I surveyed fertile lands in which our tribe thrived <food></food>."
button_8: "I was a student of obscure lore <knowledge></knowledge>."
button_9: "I was a peacemaker, befriending <happiness></happiness> all peoples living in our realm."
title: Humble Origins

body_footer: In the darkness, you had but one thing to hold on to, a piece of who you were before. What memory preserved your sanity?
body_header: As a <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink>, you have seen the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>, and memories of it haunt you. Even now, you find your mind drifting back.
body_lore: You are <hyperlink>haunted</hyperlink> by lonesome centuries spent floating in the vast nothingness of the Void, where monstrous voices from your past twisted and distorted your deepest convictions. You saw visions of a grim future riddled by loss and insanity. More than once you felt your soul dissolve in the endless void.
button_0: "I founded empires <influence></influence> that impressed Wizards and Kings!"
button_1: "I mastered the forbidden and lost lore <knowledge></knowledge>!"
button_2: "<order></order> I commanded legions of fervent paladins <unit></unit>!"
button_3: "<chaos></chaos> I spawned <population></population> a host of savage minions!"
button_4: "<arcana></arcana> I was an artist of the arcane <mana></mana>!"
button_5: "<matter></matter> I crafted unparalleled treasures <gold></gold> envied by dragons."

button_3: "<<Cp:EventUnit>> is capable, all right. Now behold how the Godir perform magic tricks!"
button_4: "Excuse my earnestness, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor>. I am pondering the bright future of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> under my protection."
title: Foolish Games

body_footer: "Surely, you will contribute to the celebration of the great <eventColor>{EventGodir}</eventColor>! What can we expect from you, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>?"
body_header: After today's diplomatic negotiations, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> announces that their city wants to celebrate a Godir they are in awe of: <eventColor>{EventGodir}</eventColor>.
body_lore: They wish to commemorate the day <eventColor>{EventGodir}</eventColor> became a Godir, and intend to make this an annual event. "It was my idea," <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> declares. "And my people's morale has never been better! May we all be blessed by the might and glory of <eventColor>{EventGodir}</eventColor>!"
button_0: "<eventColor>{EventGodir}</eventColor> inspires us all. I will sponsor <gold></gold> your festivities."
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventGodir}</eventColor> was a FOOL! You ought to worship ME instead <influence></influence>!"
button_2: Teach <knowledge></knowledge> <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> about <eventColor>{EventGodir}</eventColor> and <<o:EventGodir>> accomplishments.
button_3: "Celebrating <<G:supremacy,<eventColor>{EventGodir}</eventColor>>> is incomplete without a touch of magic."
button_4: "These vulgar celebrations do not deserve my attention."
title: <<G:Day,EventGodir>>
