body_footer: The prospector requests miners from <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> to unearth a magical stone deposit. Your share will allow a special project.
body_header: An old prospector covered in dirt hails you. <<Cp:EventUnit>> keeps a pouch close to <<o:EventUnit>> chest.
body_lore: The grimy prospector's voice is gravelly, <<o:EventUnit>> enthusiasm unbridled. "So ye be the Forge Keeper around here, eh?" <<Cp:EventUnit>> grinningly takes a pebble from the pouch. "See this? Flowrock! I know of a secret deposit! But I cannot move it on me own. Spare some workers to help me, and we'll split the bounty!"
button_0: Send miners <structureprod></structureprod> and erect an obelisk to commemorate the discovery <materiumboon></materiumboon>.
button_1: Send miners <structureprod></structureprod> and forge a <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> <item></item>.
button_2: Send miners <structureprod></structureprod> and construct an <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> <unit></unit>.
button_3: "Flowrock? That's the most ridiculous thing <materiumcrisis></materiumcrisis> I've ever heard."
title: Precious Opportunity

body_footer: Yet the clay is rapidly decaying! You have mere seconds to decide what new element to create!
body_header: You've devoted your <hyperlink>Materium</hyperlink> mastery to the creation of the mythical transmuter's clay. Today, you succeeded!
body_lore: Only the primordial <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> successfully fashioned this clay which, according to legends, gives its user the power to shape never-before-seen materials! After countless unsuccessful tries, you accidentally knocked over an unlabeled flask today, spilling its contents into your cauldron. The tincture sizzled... popped... and once the fumes cleared, the clay was there!
button_0: Transform wheat <food></food> from <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> into a mind-sharpening vapor <knowledge></knowledge>!
button_1: Transmute gold <gold></gold> into an elixir <materiumboon></materiumboon> that resurrects <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> <unit></unit>!
button_2: Transmute <<g:teardrops,EventCity>> <happiness></happiness> into gold coins <gold></gold>!
button_3: Allow the transmuter's clay to disintegrate.
title: Elementary Transmutations

body_footer: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, you may learn a destructive spell in exchange for... a quart of your blood."
body_header: A hooded hermit requests an audience. <<Cp:EventUnit>> bears three pages that were clearly ripped from their <hyperlink>Tomes of Magic</hyperlink>.
body_lore: "You have a reputation of being a scholarly <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>." The hermit's voice is deep and honeyed. You discern the outline of a barbed tail under <<o:EventUnit>> robes. "I carry... forbidden knowledge that can be yours. If you are determined enough to claim it." Small horns protrude from under the hermit's hood.
button_0: Exchange your blood for the flame-licked page.
button_1: Exchange your blood for the frosty page.
button_2: Exchange your blood for the illuminated page.
button_3: Turn away the trickster. The price of knowledge has its limits <astralcrisis></astralcrisis>.
title: Devious Deal

body_footer: Who will become your apprentice? Your mentee's family will gift you the resource they produce.
body_header: In keeping with traditions, any self-respecting Master of the <hyperlink>Astral</hyperlink> takes on a pupil.
body_lore: You invite every seventh child of a seventh child to your court. Three answer the call. The first one barges in and immediately picks a fight: a hot-headed lumberjack's <<EventHeroA<eventColor>{son/daughter}</eventColor>>>. The second calmly takes a seat at your table: a steel-faced steward's <<EventHeroB<eventColor>{son/daughter}</eventColor>>>. The third greets the guards and pours <<EventHeroC<eventColor>{himself/herself}</eventColor>>> a drink: a friendly baker's <<EventHeroC<eventColor>{boy/girl}</eventColor>>>.
button_0: "<eventColor>{EventHeroA.FirstName}</eventColor> <unit></unit>, the lumberjack's <<EventHeroA<eventColor>{son/daughter}</eventColor>>> <structureprod></structureprod>, shall be my apprentice <knowledge></knowledge>."
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventHeroA.FirstName}</eventColor> <unit></unit>, the lumberjack's <<EventHeroA<eventColor>{son/daughter}</eventColor>>> <structureprod></structureprod>, shall be my apprentice <knowledge></knowledge>."
button_2: "<eventColor>{EventHeroB.FirstName}</eventColor> <unit></unit>, the steward's <<EventHeroB<eventColor>{son/daughter}</eventColor>>> <gold></gold>, shall be my apprentice <knowledge></knowledge>."
button_3: "<eventColor>{EventHeroB.FirstName}</eventColor> <unit></unit>, the steward's <<EventHeroB<eventColor>{son/daughter}</eventColor>>> <gold></gold>, shall be my apprentice <knowledge></knowledge>."
button_4: "<eventColor>{EventHeroC.FirstName}</eventColor> <unit></unit>, the baker's <<EventHeroC<eventColor>{boy/girl}</eventColor>>> <food></food>, shall be my apprentice <knowledge></knowledge>."
button_5: "<eventColor>{EventHeroC.FirstName}</eventColor> <unit></unit>, the baker's <<EventHeroC<eventColor>{boy/girl}</eventColor>>> <food></food>, shall be my apprentice <knowledge></knowledge>."
button_6: "What am I doing? Apprentices are for fools! <astralcrisis></astralcrisis>"
title: Sorcerer's Apprentice

body_footer: The Astral Storm threatens to evaporate the citizens of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. Are you capable of deflecting the imminent mayhem?
body_header: Your <hyperlink>Astral</hyperlink> eye senses a terrible storm of <hyperlink>magical currents</hyperlink> gathering over your throne city.
body_lore: The flowing energies of the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>, that fickle mistress, ebb and flow between its main conduits. When the astral waves collide and crash, too much energy can flood a realm that houses any <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> of note. Today, that <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> is you.
button_0: Save <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> by absorbing the devastating energies <mana></mana>.
button_1: Scatter the storm <mana></mana> to scry three Astral nexuses.
button_2: Cast the Storm into a mold and forge <structureprod></structureprod> a <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> <item></item>!
button_3: Distill the currents into two <<m:EventUnit>> <unit></unit> with your summoners' aid <unitprod></unitprod>!
button_4: Do nothing. The Astral Sea gives <astralboon></astralboon>, and consumes <population></population>.
title: Astral Storm

body_footer: To a <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Master/Mistress}</eventColor>>> of Shadow, these risen warriors are a gift! What purpose shall they serve?
body_header: <hyperlink>Shadows</hyperlink> covering your realm cause long-dead soldiers to rise from their graves at a forgotten battle site near your city of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_lore: Drawn to your dark radiance, the army marches upon <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. <<m:EventUnitB>> claw at your gates. <<m:EventUnitC>> gnaw on your walls. <<m:EventUnit>> howl at the few living souls that remain in your throne city. Where others would faint at the mere sight of this revenant horde, you see opportunity.
button_0: Bind <unit></unit> the undead company to your command using magic <mana></mana>.
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>! Dispatch these undead! Their souls <souls></souls> are mine."
button_2: "Necromancers <unitprod></unitprod>! Pick their brains to harvest the ancient secrets <knowledge></knowledge>."
button_3: Open the gates <happiness></happiness>! The dead are welcome in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> <population></population>.
button_4: Leave them be. The dead will soon resume their rest.
button_5: "Guards <unitprod></unitprod>! Dispatch these undead! I require their souls <souls></souls>."
title: Revenant Horde

body_footer: "What say you, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>? Will you grant me access to your troves of knowledge?"
body_header: During negotiations, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> unexpectedly demands that you share your wisdom and lore with <<P:EventHouseLord>>.
body_lore: The words of <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> betray <<o:EventHouseLord>> ambition. "I confess that I seek your tutelage in the ways of Magic. I can advance my aspirations through your generosity and compassion. Knowledge is what I desire, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. I would become a powerful ally to your cause!"
button_0: "I will share some of my lore <knowledge></knowledge> with you."
button_1: "My secrets <knowledge></knowledge> can be yours... for a price! <gold></gold>"
button_2: "No. Mastering magic is a journey, not a destination, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor>."
button_3: "You covet the secrets of a Godir? Behold them, and despair!"
button_4: "Although your plea amuses me, I cannot comply with your request."
title: Sharing Secrets

body_footer: "Celebrate spring's fertility with me, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>! Expose me to your dominion's potency!" Can your expansion impress the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>?
body_header: A <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> comes frolicking from faraway fields and dances before you, flowers springing up from wherever <<o:EventUnit>> feet land.
body_lore: You are drawn into the depths of <<o:EventUnit>> eyes, like bottomless pools of cool green water. <<Co:EventUnit>> dance grows more feral and intense. The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> seems to receive pleasure from her exaggerated movements, until <<p:EventUnit>> suddenly stops in a suggestive pose, <<o:EventUnit>> ravenous gaze lingering on your body.
button_0: Collapse the mine <structureprod></structureprod> near <eventColor>{EventCityB}</eventColor> to sow seeds <food></food> there.
button_1: Boost the birth rate <population></population> <happiness></happiness> of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> with fine wine <gold></gold>.
button_2: Fortify warrior bloodlines <unitprod></unitprod> in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> by increasing their rations <food></food>.
button_3: Commission a husbandry expert <gold></gold> to breed a <eventColor>{EventMount}</eventColor>.
button_4: "Do not seduce me, Forest Witch <naturecrisis></naturecrisis>!"
title: Beckoning of Spring

body_footer: "Your fascination with my <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> flatters me," <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> says, "but only a generous offer can convince me to part with it."
body_header: During a lengthy discussion on trade terms, you discover an exquisite <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> mounted on the wall of <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>.
body_lore: You admire the craftsmanship of the object. Even through the Whispering Stone, you can sense the powerful energy flowing from the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. This is an artifact that belongs in the hoard of a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, not on a <<g:wall,<eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor>>>! <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor> soon notices your interest in the object and smirks.
button_0: Offer jewels <gold></gold> in exchange for the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> <item></item>.
button_1: Trade the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> <item></item> for your immortal wisdom <knowledge></knowledge>.
button_2: "That is certainly a spectacular <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>! You must be very proud. <influence></influence>"
button_3: Study its designs and craft a copy for yourself.
button_4: "I don't want your frivolous trinket."
title: Trade Negotiations

body_footer: "We are keepers of the cycle, you and I. For new life to sprout, the elder must die. So, choose."
body_header: Without warning, a flurry of leaves engulfs you. A dour <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> steps forward. "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>! Limit your growth!"
body_lore: With a voice like wind through a hollow tree, the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> incants: "<hyperlink>Nature's</hyperlink> way is not unending bloom. Such a foray causes everyone's doom. After the season of winter brings death, that void is the reason newborns draw breath." The servant of Nature draws a circle with <<o:EventUnit>> staff on the ground.
button_0: Prune the population of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. A young hero <unit></unit> will bloom.
button_1: Reap seeds already sown <unitprod></unitprod> and till your realm's soil <natureboon></natureboon>.
button_2: "Relieved from the yoke of my ambitions <influence></influence>, my people shall multiply <population></population>."
button_3: "You are wrong <naturecrisis></naturecrisis>! My empire's expansion is boundless <influence></influence>."
button_4: Prune the population of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. A young hero <unit></unit> will bloom.
title: Redemption of Winter

body_footer: It has fallen to you to add spice to this dreadful "feast." How will you proceed?
body_header: Your steward insisted you hold a formal feast for your distinguished subjects. Unsurprisingly, the event is tedious and insipid.
body_lore: Guests wearing suffocating dresses and awkward robes sit at long tables, solemnly chewing bland meals. Troubadours play dull tunes reserved for refined banquets, per tradition. A dancing bear has fallen asleep. A conjurer fruitlessly tries to retrieve his doves from the great hall's rafters. Someone sneezes, then promptly apologizes.
button_0: Share your best wines and ales <gold></gold>! Cheers, everyone! <happiness></happiness>
button_1: Magically set the curtains ablaze <mana></mana>! Behold the spectacle! <happiness></happiness>
button_2: Seek pleasure in inhibited forms of entertainment <chaoscrisis></chaoscrisis>.
title: Revel Without a Cause

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> draws <<o:EventUnitB>> blade with quivering hand and lingering doubt in <<o:EventUnitB>> eyes. How to deal with <<P:EventUnitB>>?
body_header: A <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> in shining armor confronts you. "Today, my blade will end you, infernal scum!"
body_lore: "This is the oath I took before the <eventColor>{RandomWarriorTitle}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{RandomIdol}</eventColor>: to find and dispatch the emerging <hyperlink>Chaos</hyperlink> <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{Master/Mistress}</eventColor>>> that wreaks havoc on this realm! 'Tis to be my final test after leaving behind a life of sin and depravity! That fiend I am no longer!"
button_0: Offer riches <gold></gold> to corrupt the <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> into a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> <unit></unit>.
button_1: Reveal infernal secrets <knowledge></knowledge> to corrupt the <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> into a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> <unit></unit>.
button_2: Immolate <mana></mana> the <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> <evilact></evilact> for Chaos <chaosboon></chaosboon>.
button_3: Use Chaos magic <mana></mana> to lift <goodact></goodact> <<G:oath,EventUnitB>> <chaosboon></chaosboon>."
button_4: "Stay your zealous tongue, Oathbound! Leave me in peace <chaoscrisis></chaoscrisis>."
title: Oathbreaker

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> notices you and bellows: "Embody Chaos, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>! Demolish this false idol!" Do you dare interfere?
body_header: In a recurring dream, a terrible <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> endlessly battles a radiant <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> atop a mountain plateau.
body_lore: You've had this terrible dream since you embraced <hyperlink>Chaos</hyperlink>. But tonight, it feels as if avatars of Chaos and <hyperlink>Order</hyperlink> will settle their eternal conflict and determine who shall inherit the <hyperlink>Astral Sea's</hyperlink> ashen ruins. You discern more <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> of Order and Chaos, all witnessing the duel, their eyes flooded with fear.
button_0: Strike down the <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> and bind <unit></unit> the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to your will.
button_10: Avert your eyes <chaoscrisis></chaoscrisis> until the vision ends.
button_2: Immolate <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor>, and yourself in a pandemonium of coiling flames <chaosboon></chaosboon>!
button_9: Slay the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, and the <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> grants you <<o:EventUnitB>> secrets <chaoscrisis></chaoscrisis>.
title: Pandemoniac

body_footer: "Assassins are after me! Do you desire to strengthen the bonds between our Houses? Then please, keep me safe!"
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> interrupts your negotiations. "I can't pretend anymore! Why negotiate when I'll be dead tomorrow anyway!"
body_lore: <<g:voice,<eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Name}</eventColor>>> trembles: "I'm certain that pretenders to my throne are stirring up my people against me. They spread lies about my incompetence as a Ruler! And now—I'm certain of it!—they intend to make their move... by taking my life!"
button_0: "Guards <unitprod></unitprod> from <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> will keep you safe."
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> <unit></unit> shall be your personal bodyguard, my friend. <goodact></goodact>"
button_2: "Bloodthirst will compel your pretenders to butcher each other <evilact></evilact>."
button_3: "Inquisitors will judge these pretenders before a tribunal of my design!"
button_4: "Assassins?! Your imagination is running wild, <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor>. You'll be fine."
title: Saving The Meek

body_footer: "Will you help me find my <<EventUnit<eventColor>{brother/sister}</eventColor>>>, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>? I worry for <<o:EventUnit>> safety! Let me mark the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> on your map."
body_header: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>!" Your <hyperlink><<EventHero<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventHero.Name}</eventColor> kneels before you, distressed. "My little <<EventUnit<eventColor>{brother/sister}</eventColor>>>! <<Cp:EventUnit>> went dowsing for precious stones, yet never returned!"
body_lore: "<<Cp:EventUnit>> migrated to <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> when you recruited me. <<Cp:EventUnit>> has been prospecting for precious stones and metals since <<p:EventUnit>> was a wee <<EventUnit<eventColor>{boy/girl}</eventColor>>>, carrying around an oversized dowsing rod. Recently, a faraway <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> caught <<o:EventUnit>> attention. Normally, my <<EventUnit<eventColor>{brother/sister}</eventColor>>> returns with a sizable haul within three days. Today is the eighth day since <<p:EventUnit>> left." <<G:eyes,EventHero>> turn misty.
button_0: "I will look for your <<EventUnit<eventColor>{brother/sister}</eventColor>>>, <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>. I'm sure <<p:EventUnit>> is fine.
button_2: "I cannot aid you. May <<p:EventUnit>> return soon."
title: Treasured <<EventUnit<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> sighs gratefully. "For rescuing me, please accept the treasure I discovered. My skills are at the service of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>."
body_header: Your troops search the area and tunnels. When they pass a crack beneath the central <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, someone whispers: "Are they gone?"
body_lore: A <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> crawls out of <<o:EventUnit>> hiding spot. "I knew someone would come looking for me eventually! I hid down there for days—I think—eating larvae and slimy moss to survive." The <<EventUnit<eventColor>{boy/girl}</eventColor>>> chuckles and produces a satchel. "But it was worth it! The tunnels surrounding this <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> are teeming with rubies!"
button_0: "Your expertise on metal and stone <structureprod></structureprod> will make <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> thrive."
button_1: "Teach <knowledge></knowledge> me about precious stones and metals, as well as the behavior of the <<m:EventUnitB>>."
button_3: "I accept your service as an <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> <unit></unit>."
button_4: "I require no reward <goodact></goodact>. I am happy that you are safe."
title: Treasured <<EventUnit<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>: Aftermath

body_footer: How could anyone survive this infestation? Is it foolish to believe that <<G:sibling,EventHero>> is still alive?
body_header: Upon arrival at the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, it becomes clear that the spawn of a <eventColor>{EventSireUnit}</eventColor> hatched a few days ago.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> is overrun with the writhing bodies of the <<m:EventUnit>>. Their corrosive mucus oozes into the nearby fissures. The screech of their sire can be heard echoing from deep tunnels from which the <<m:EventUnit>> hatched. The <<m:EventUnit>> have been feasting on <eventColor>{RandomAnimalA}</eventColor>, judging by the partial dissolved remains that litter the area.
button_0: Attack the <<m:EventUnit>> to clear the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> anyway!
button_1: Lure the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> away from the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> with fresh cattle <food></food> from <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
button_2: Cover your troops' bodies in <eventColor>{EventSireUnit}</eventColor> mucus to repel the <<m:EventUnit>>.
button_3: Leave. There's nothing anyone can do here.
title: Treasured <<EventUnitB<eventColor>{Brother/Sister}</eventColor>>>: Location

body_footer: How will you use your powers against the Wizard Kings?
body_header: You know about the dangers that <hyperlink>Wizard Kings</hyperlink> bring. <eventColor>{PlayerLeaderWizard.Lord.TitleName}</eventColor> who you met on this realm is only one of them.
body_lore: Throughout your lifetime, you heard countless stories of the powerful Wizard Kings pillaging and plundering the realms. Now you face them with your own powers. You mastered the arcane arts and gained the ability to navigate through the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink>. You have <hyperlink>ascended</hyperlink>. When you saw your reflection today, you noticed your powers match those of Wizard Kings. A scary thought? Or a hopeful one?
button_0: "I will personally support my army <unitprod></unitprod>."
button_1: "My powers <mana></mana> will support my people <food></food> <happiness></happiness>."
button_2: "I will hone my powers. They will overcome theirs <mana></mana>."
button_3: "A better understanding <knowledge></knowledge> of the Astral Flows will give us an advantage."
title: Danger of the Wizard Kings

body_footer: "What shall we do against these monsters?"
body_header: Tales of sea monsters at the coast of <eventColor>{EventCity.Name}</eventColor> catch your attention.
body_lore: Ghost stories about creatures at the <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> are not uncommon, but recently these tales became more frequent. Your citizens describe attacks by dreadful monsters like the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> in shocking detail. One of your advisors suggests: "We could focus our military on the issue, or we could hire some mercenaries to take the <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> out. Of course, there is always the option to take care of these so-called ghosts ourselves..."
button_0: Order your military instructors <unitprod></unitprod> to drive the monsters from your coast.
button_1: Pay <gold></gold> mercenaries to put the <eventColor>{EventSpawner}</eventColor> to rest.
button_2: Do nothing. You will take care of it yourself.
button_3: Ghost stories are your forte. Show these monsters some horrors of your own...
title: Dreadful Tales

body_footer: "We must bring Meandor to the Covenant. We cannot allow the Shad'rai scheme to continue without us being able to interfere."
body_header: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> approaches you. "Meandor's state of mind is... concerning."
body_lore: "I can't help but feel the <hyperlink>Shad'rai</hyperlink> are behind this. Typical of those fools to mess with <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> they were told to avoid—never mind. <eventColor>{Meandor.FirstName}</eventColor> is crucial for the <hyperlink>Covenant</hyperlink> to follow the Shad'rai in time. And, I have to admit, I have... personal reasons for searching for him, too. With my father gone, and my mother missing... I have questions and doubts that only he can answer."
button_3: "Understood."
title: Dark Heritage

body_footer: Suddenly you feel weary. Perhaps you do need to lie down, watch the stars for a while... Something is not right, but you feel your eyes close...
body_header: Whilst traveling the Eternal Court, your path is blocked by an apparition, claiming to be a spirit from your own past!
body_lore: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>, you may have forgotten about me... So many Godir forget their past. This 'quest' of yours is so tiresome. Lie down with me instead, gaze at the stars with me, like we did before. Remember? Take my hand... take your rest..." The stars behind <<P:EventHero>> blink, and for a moment they seem like eyes.
button_2: <Order></Order> Use holy light to pierce through this apparition.
button_3: <Nature></Nature> Focus on the being behind the apparition.
button_4: <Chaos></Chaos> Smash through the apparition.
button_5: <Arcana></Arcana> Enhance your vision to see through this apparition.
button_6: <Shadow></Shadow> Use your knowledge of deception to see through this apparition.
button_7: <Matter></Matter> Reach through the apparition to find the truth behind it.
title: Enchanting Past

body_footer: "Six mighty forces of creation wage war to uphold their laws. And you, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. How will you end this endless war of balance and hope?"
body_header: After establishing yourself on the realm torn by war, a distant roar calls for your attention. "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, you tread upon the cosmic battlefields of the Ashen War."
body_lore: The voice turns mournful. "Six Elder <hyperlink>Dragons</hyperlink>, brothers and sisters in Creation, torn asunder by strife. On one side, the Reshapers. <eventColor>{CreatorDragon.FirstName}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{DestroyerDragon.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{DeathDragon.FirstName}</eventColor>, guarding cosmic balance of creation and destruction. On the other, the Dawnwardens <eventColor>{NatureDragon.FirstName}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{OrderDragon.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{AstralDragon.FirstName}</eventColor>, fighting to maintain the precious beauty of life and spirit."
button_0: "Life is sacred and must be protected. I agree with the Dawnwardens."
button_1: "There needs to be balance between creation and destruction. The Reshapers seem to understand that."
button_2: "This Ashen War will end by my hand and mine alone."
title: The Ashen War

body_footer: Your people cheer you on as you return to <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, victorious.
body_header: You have allied with the Dawnwardens and secured a victory for the defenders of life and spirit.
body_lore: Under your watchful eye, the realm flourishes with life as the victorious <hyperlink>Dragons</hyperlink> rise in the sky to spread justice, knowledge and verdant glory. Perhaps the cosmos needs destruction and death, but not this realm. Not this day.
button_0: A glorious victory for <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>.
title: The Ashen War: Dawnwarden Victory

body_footer: Your people cheer you on as you return to <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, victorious.
body_header: You have allied with the Reshapers and secured a victory for the guards of rebirth and balance.
body_lore: Under your watchful eye, the cycle of life and death continues. From ashes new life sprouts, from mourning new creations emerge. Life is beautiful, but it means nothing without death. This cosmic balance will not be disturbed. Not this day.
button_0: A glorious victory for <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>.
title: The Ashen War: Reshaper Victory

body_footer: Your people cheer you on as you return to <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, victorious.
body_header: Through tremendous effort you have brought together both the Dawnwardens and the Reshapers in an alliance they could never imagine.
body_lore: Negotiations are difficult. <hyperlink>Dragons</hyperlink> are not known for their patience and forgiving nature. But you, the one they deem Dawnshaper, manage to bring them together as they were before. Life and Death, Order and Chaos, the ethereal and the physical. Destruction must not be wanton, but it is necessary to truly allow progress. You manage to form a renewed alliance between them, bringing balanced peace to the realm.
button_0: A glorious victory for <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>.
title: The Ashen War: Peace and Balance

body_footer: Please
body_header: <eventColor>{Laryssa.Name}</eventColor> greets you. "Hi. <eventColor>{Reaver.Name}</eventColor> and her <eventColor>{ReaverRace.Name}</eventColor> are fighting against <eventColor>{Progenitor.Name}</eventColor> and the <eventColor>{ProgenitorRace.Name}</eventColor>. This is crazy

body_footer: The Godir called <eventColor>{EventLithyl.FirstName}</eventColor> attempts to argue further but <eventColor>{EventNimue.FirstName}</eventColor> dismisses her, unaware that you overheard this conversation.

body_lore:
"What is this I hear about the imprisoned Maer?" The unknown Godir says. "We agreed that you would set her free. She has served her purpose."
{EventNimue.FirstName} scoffs. "We discussed it. And I decided against it. My work is not yet done, {EventLithyl.FirstName}!"
The half-masked Godir answers, annoyed, "You fool. The Covenant is investigating already. If they find out about the Gildercoil..."
button_0: Leave the Shad'rai to their bickering.
title: Nearing the Prison

<hyperlink>Elya</hyperlink>'s song grows louder, you feel her prison is nearby. Suddenly a rift opens, allowing you to spy on a half-masked <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> speaking to the prison guards.

body_footer: Your guard catches your attention by speaking up: "Mighty <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, what are we to do with the thief?"

body_lore: "We found this thief trying to steal the <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> from your hoard," the guard explains. The thief looks up at you with fear in <<o:EventHero>> eyes. <<Cp:EventHero>> realizes how sacred a thing the hoard of a <hyperlink>Dragon</hyperlink> is, and how wrathful Dragons are known to be. Having entered your vault, <<p:EventHero>> needs to be punished.
button_0: "Strip <<P:EventHero>> of <<o:EventHero>> belongings and take what is valuable to my hoard." <item></item>
button_1: "If <<p:EventHero>> values <<o:EventHero>> life, <<p:EventHero>> will enrich <gold></gold> my hoard instead."
button_10: "The strong prey upon the weak. Remember this as I feast upon this thief." <evilact></evilact> <natureboon></natureboon>
button_11: "Hold a ceremony. <<Cp:EventHero>> shall be sacrificed to our faith." <evilact></evilact> <orderboon></orderboon>
button_12: "Bind <<o:EventHero>> soul to my vault to guard the place for all eternity." <evilact></evilact> <shadowboon></shadowboon>
button_2: "Kill the thief and burn down <<o:EventHero>> home village. Nobody touches my hoard!" <evilact></evilact> <influence></influence>
button_3: "Exile <<P:EventHero>>! <<Cp:EventHero>> will tell tales of my hoard." <influence></influence>
button_4: "Summon the terrors of the Astral Sea upon <<P:EventHero>>." <evilact></evilact> <astralboon></astralboon>
button_5: "Kill the thief and burn down <<o:EventHero>> house. Nobody touches my hoard!" <evilact></evilact> <chaosboon></chaosboon>
button_6: "Bathe <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> in the gold <<p:EventHero>> so desires... until <<p:EventHero>> drowns." <evilact></evilact> <materiumboon></materiumboon>
title: Thief

body_footer: "Please, accept our tribute!" The leader of the group removes the tarp with a flourish, revealing a giant egg. A Dragon egg.
body_header: You hear wheels of a wagon coming closer. A tarp covers a large, round object underneath.
body_lore: A group of hooded figures dragging the wagon is headed straight towards you. As they bow down in front of you, you realize they are citizens of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>. Their leader speaks: "We traveled far to bring you this as a tribute, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. It was kept safe in a hidden shrine, until a worthy Dragon returned."
button_0: "I will hatch and grow it <food></food> to become a powerful Dragon <unit></unit>."
button_1: Eat it <evilact></evilact> to gain its power <xp></xp>. "I shall be the only one!"
button_2: "It would be an honor to see <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> hatch a new Dragonkin <allegiance></allegiance>."
title: The Gift

body_footer: Your can sense two groups of quarry worthy of a Dragon of your statute.
body_header: Ancient urges inside you awaken, and you feel the desire to hunt suddenly overcome you.
body_lore: As a <hyperlink>Dragon</hyperlink> you have sheer limitless power. You can fly higher than birds, channel magic unknown to wizards. Kings bow before your might. However, sometimes the beast within you awakens and you get cravings. Cravings to hunt.
button_0: Hunt cattle <food></food> on their way to <eventColor>{PlayerCity}</eventColor>.
button_1: Devour <evilact></evilact> the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> in one of the border villages of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>.
button_2: Suppress <morale></morale> the urge. You are not a slave to your cravings.
title: Craving a Hunt

body_footer: You know <<G:location,EventHero>>. Do you want to engage?
body_header: A challenge passed from mouth to mouth catches your attention. <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> proclaims <<r:EventHero>> a Dragon slayer and you as <<o:EventHero>> target.
body_lore: There are rumors that <<p:EventHero>> killed Dragons before. <<Cp:EventHero>> is said to be a <hyperlink><<EventRuler<eventColor>{hero/heroine}</eventColor>>></hyperlink> who takes revenge for the terror inflicted by <hyperlink>Dragons</hyperlink> throughout the ages. "We should teach <<P:EventHero>> a lesson, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>", one of your subordinates says.
button_0: We will deal with this so-called "hero".
button_1: Ignore <<P:EventHero>>.
button_2: "I refuse to fight <goodact></goodact>, and will convince <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> <influence></influence> that not all dragons are evil."
title: Dragon Slayer

body_footer: Your people look toward you expectantly as you ponder the fallen Dragon Slayer. What do you do?
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> lies dead in the dirt. The fight is over.
body_lore: "You bested <<P:EventHero>>, but more could always follow. In the history of your kin there are always dragon slayers involved. In <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, a world quite like this, <hyperlink>Dragons</hyperlink> were hunted to extinction. You will not let that happen here. You need to send a signal."
button_0: Let this be a lesson. No <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, nor the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> will bow to puny Heroes. <influence></influence>
button_1: Display <<o:EventHero>> scorched body in your capital, as a message to other ambitious "Dragon slayers." <happiness></happiness>
button_3: Give <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> a Dragon burial to honor <<P:EventHero>>. <goodact></goodact>
button_4: Feed on the corpse for power. <evilact></evilact> <xp></xp>
title: Dragon Slayer: Aftermath

body_lore: "Greetings, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>! You, like us, seem to understand what is necessary to discard the fetters that burden this realm. Your folk is united under the banner of progress. Our interests align. Let us act upon it."
button_0: Inspect their military might.
button_2: Leave them be. You have other plans.

With our technology and your expertise as <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> we can make this realm truly ours. Why don't we set up communication and become powerful allies?"
button_0: Inspect <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: Decline the offer, for now.

body_lore: "What do you want on this realm, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>? Conquer? Pillage? Destroy? Our weapons are sharp, our guns are loaded. We will fight you if we must, but let us not grind ourselves to death. A peaceful solution would be more practical. Do you agree?"
button_0: Investigate whether <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> is worthy of your attention.
button_2: Keep your business to yourself.

body_footer: You are at war with <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.TitleName}</eventColor> of the <minorcity></minorcity> <hyperlink>Free City</hyperlink> <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> greets you with hostility.
body_lore: "You are in our way, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Name}</eventColor>! War is inevitable. We <eventColor>{EventHouseRace.Name}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor> are proud people and will fight for our freedom. With our spears sharpened and magelocks loaded we can defeat everyone else who threatens us, even the likes of you."
button_0: Inspect the insolent <eventColor>{EventHouse.Name}</eventColor>.
button_2: "So be it!"

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> nods sternly. “Unfortunately, I need to ask you to leave. This place belongs to <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>.”
body_header: The sound of gunfire shatters the sky. Thick clouds gather around the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>. A company of fighters of free city is practicing with magelock weapons.
body_lore: One of the soldiers tries to get your attention. With a proud smile <<p:EventStackLeader>> explains: “These guns are the pinnacle of technology, strong enough to slay any beast! By flipping a switch anyone can become a powerful fighter. Your aim is important, of course, but seriously …”, <<p:EventStackLeader>> shoots the head off a practice dummy to underline <<o:EventStackLeader>> point. “We created something truly magnificent here.”
button_1: "Leave and <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> will give you the best training possible."
button_2: "I claim this <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> will fall!"
button_3: "I will leave you to your training."
button_4: "Enter my service instead and I will shower you in gold!"
button_5: "I challenge you to a duel! The winner gets the <eventColor>{EventStructure.Name}</eventColor>."

body_lore: Time has passed since. You have already gained a following and made a name for yourself. The years of <hyperlink>torment</hyperlink> lie behind you now and you are able to live in the moment again. The <hyperlink>Astral Flows</hyperlink> bend to your will. It is time to look forward.

button_4: <arcana></arcana> Explore how to recreate this power surge <knowledge></knowledge>.
button_5: <matter></matter> Inspire your builders <structureprod></structureprod>.
button_6: <nature></nature> Fill <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> with plants of your home realm <happiness></happiness>.

body_footer: Having found no way of defeating you, the mechanical guardian seems to await your reaction. What do you do?
body_header: While moving in to attack your army, the mechanical <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> suddenly comes to a halt and inspects your troops.
body_lore: The gears inside <<o:EventStackLeader>> metal body are turning. Smoke escapes the crevices of <<o:EventStackLeader>> hull. With a bone-chilling gaze the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader.Name}</eventColor> inspects every single opponent, looking for weaknesses. <<Cp:EventStackLeader>> does not seem to find any.
button_0: Attack them anyways.
button_1: Give them a new purpose and send them on their way. <goodact></goodact>
button_2: Use their stunned state to disable <evilact></evilact> and disassemble them. <knowledge></knowledge>
button_3: Attempt to change their directives to serve you. <unit></unit>
title: Failure to Follow Directive

body_footer: In the darkness, you had but one thing to hold on to, a piece of who you were before. What memory preserved your sanity?
body_header: As a <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink>, you have seen the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>, and memories of it haunt you. Even now, you find your mind drifting back.
body_lore: You are <hyperlink>haunted</hyperlink> by lonesome centuries spent floating in the vast nothingness of the Void, where monstrous voices from your past twisted and distorted your deepest convictions. You saw visions of a grim future riddled by loss and insanity. More than once you felt your soul dissolve in the endless void.
button_0: "I founded empires <influence></influence> that impressed Wizards and Kings!"
button_1: "I mastered the forbidden and lost lore <knowledge></knowledge>!"
button_2: "<order></order> I commanded legions of fervent paladins <unit></unit>!"
button_3: "<chaos></chaos> I spawned <population></population> a host of savage minions!"
button_4: "<arcana></arcana> I was an artist of the arcane <mana></mana>!"
button_5: "<matter></matter> I crafted unparalleled treasures <gold></gold> envied by dragons."
button_6: "<nature></nature> I tended both plant and beast, and savored their bounties <food></food>."
button_7: "<shadow></shadow> I endlessly reshaped <unitprod></unitprod> my subjects in the shadows!"
button_8: "Feeble mortals reveled <happiness></happiness> in my splendor!"
button_9: "I erected <structureprod></structureprod> grand towers in infinite realms!"

body_footer: While reliving past moments from your life, you find one more item that reminds you of where you came from. What is it?
body_header: When looking through your army's supplies, one of your <eventColor>{EventRace.Name}</eventColor> finds a container with items you thought long lost.
body_lore: The box contains belongings that survived your travels and adventures. Every item contains memories of your former life. A memory of your childhood. Of the first time you used a spell. Of the time you became a leader.
button_0: A weapon <item></item> taken from a fierce enemy.
button_1: A ring <item></item> representing your bond with a special someone.
button_10: The <eventColor>{EventItemArmor}</eventColor>, a gift from a late friend <item></item>.
button_2: <order></order> An artifact <item></item> of your faith.
button_3: <chaos></chaos> The powerful <eventColor>{EventItemChaos}</eventColor> <item></item> that accompanied you whenever you created chaos.
button_4: <arcana></arcana> An enchanted item <item></item> that helped you learn magic.
button_5: <matter></matter> An item <item></item> you helped to create.
button_6: <nature></nature> The <eventColor>{EventItemNature}</eventColor> <item></item>, representing your bond with nature.
button_7: <shadow></shadow> A memory <item></item> of the first time you walked the shadows.
button_9: Lingering in the past will only hold you back. Sell everything <gold></gold>.
title: Mementos of your former life

body_footer: It seems there are rumors among your people that you have grown distant from them. How do you respond?
body_header: The <<EventUnit <eventColor>{chairman/chairwoman}</eventColor>>> of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> Council approaches you: "Greetings <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, may I speak openly?"
body_lore: Without waiting for your response <<p:EventUnit>> continues: "You were always one of us common people, but now you have <hyperlink>ascended</hyperlink>. With your magical abilities and your immortality, you are far above us and we fear you will become like the <hyperlink>Wizard Kings</hyperlink>."
button_0: Throw them a feast <gold></gold> to show your affection <happiness></happiness>.
button_1: Organize <structureprod></structureprod> a fair that honors <influence></influence> the PlayerRace past.
button_2: Investigate <knowledge></knowledge> the rumors and learn what exactly your people want <happiness></happiness>.
button_3: Suppress those rumors with force <unitprod></unitprod>. They shall not question you! <happiness></happiness> <evilact></evilact>
button_4: Ignore them <happiness></happiness>. You have other problems.
title: The Cost of Ascension

body_footer: One of your advisors steps up: “We need to respond to them, otherwise their aggressive claims will cause unrest in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. What is your plan?”
body_header: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, we do not want you here," declares the tough looking <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> who approaches you without hesitation.
body_lore: “I am the chosen representative of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. We were here long before you set foot in this realm. We have heard stories of <hyperlink>Wizard King</hyperlink>. You bring nothing but destruction! We will rise against you!” While one of your guards seizes the troublemaker, another guard speaks up to you: "I've heard of them. They set up their camp near <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>...”
button_0: “Assuage them with food <food></food> to show your good will." <goodact></goodact>
button_1: "Send our scholars <knowledge></knowledge> to negotiate a treaty. Have them join <population></population> our nation."
button_2: “Offer great riches <gold></gold> to everyone that would join my forces." <unit></unit>
button_3: “Kill <<P:EventHero>> and <<o:EventHero>> conspirators. Use all force necessary." <unitprod></unitprod>
button_4: "Throwing <<P:EventHero>> in our prison will deter any opposition." <evilact></evilact>
button_5: "Leave them be." <happiness></happiness>
title: Native Opposition

body_footer: Though the worst has passed, the volatile energies of the realm remain in flux, driving many towards violence and delirium still—especially on the battlefield.
body_header: The roaring beneath the earth recedes, yet the taint of madness still clings to every soul upon across the Azh'Ruun Pit.
body_lore: Though the earth no longer convulses with anger and the boiling seas settled back into uneasy calm, the precedent of mayhem remains. Across <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink>, many blood-crazed denizens wander the smoldering streets with wild eyes and trembling hands, while a thunderous rumble still echoes faintly from the abyss below. The <hyperlink>Demon Overlords</hyperlink> have relented their manic goading... but only slightly.
button_0: "We endured. Heads down and work on." <production></production>
title: Mayhem Begets Carnage

body_footer: The Carnage Ritual falters, thus riots break out across the Pit as the outraged abyss drives many denizens of the realm to senseless slaughter.
body_header: The earth shakes. The boiling seas churn. Across The Azh'Ruun Pit, something vast has grown hungry.
body_lore:
Lesser Fiends scatter in shrieking terror, hurling themselves into molten fissures and scalding rivers alike. Then the roar begins. Vast. Endless. A chorus of abyssal hunger clawing through every soul upon Obbadoth.

"Carnage! Carnage! More! MORE!" The Demon Overlords demand their due.
button_0: Steel yourself.
title: A Crisis of Carnage

body_footer: The worst of the abyssal hunger has thus passed, yet the Carnage Ritual still demands its endless tribute, lest this ravenous ire be awakened again.
body_header: The turbulent madness subsides as the raging abyss beneath the realm withdraws its ravenous ire from The Azh'Ruun Pit.
body_lore:
Slowly, the screams fade. The trembling earth stills.
Across Obbadoth, blood-soaked denizens stagger from their murderous delirium as though waking from a nightmare. Deep beneath the world, the ravenous fury of the Demon Overlords recedes once more into the dark.

For now, the abyss is sated.
button_0: "The work continues..." <production></production>
title: The Nether Realms Subside

body_footer: As the Carnage Ritual falters, volatile magical currents surge across the realm, driving all but the strongest minds into frenzied abandon.
body_header: The abyss roars anew as escalating madness sweeps across <hyperlink>Obbadoth</hyperlink> like a plague of slaughter.
body_lore:
The ritual falters once more. Again the boiling earth convulses. Again the skies howl with that dreadful chorus rising from beneath the world. Yet this time, the fury is greater. Sharper. Angrier. Across The Azh'Ruun Pit, entire villages abandon all restraint, while frenzied denizens butcher neighbor and kin alike beneath the unseen gaze of the wrathful Demon Overlords.

"More Carnage! MORE!"
button_0: Hold fast through the mayhem.
title: The Pit Gone Rabid

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> has grown frustrated with <<o:EventHero>> current ambition. Will you permit <<P:EventHero>> a change of heart?
body_header: You are approached by your <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>. <<Co:EventHero>> expression betrays dejection and vexation.
body_lore: After a deep sigh, <<p:EventHero>> declares: "My whole life, I've always thought of myself as <<a:CurrentDestiny>>. But as of late, I am haunted by doubt. Is this my destined path towards <renown></renown> <hyperlink>Renown</hyperlink>? Or will plotting another course lead me to the success and satisfaction I currently lack, yet desperately crave?"
button_0: "Stay your course. Your destiny shall be fulfilled."
button_1: "Being <<a:ReplacementDestiny1>> suits you better."
button_2: "Being <<a:ReplacementDestiny2>> is an admirable ambition."
title: Change of Heart

body_footer: The <eventColor>{StructureResource}</eventColor> is expected to reside in your domain for <eventColor>{TurnCount}</eventColor> turns before moving on.
body_header: Scouts report that a <eventColor>{StructureResource}</eventColor> traded the wilderness for your domain, and has set up camp <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "We have not yet seen him with our own eyes, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>." You detect admiration in your scout's voice. "But we have found his camp and the many creatures <<p:ShopKeeper>> keeps there. The <eventColor>{ShopKeeper}</eventColor> has a reputation for selling them as mounts to whoever has the coin for these prized beasts." You consider what additions would benefit your stable.
button_0: "As long as <<o:ShopKeeper>> creatures don't eat my <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>, <<p:ShopKeeper>> is welcome."
button_1: "Break up <<o:ShopKeeper>> camp. <<Co:ShopKeeper>> miscreants are not welcome here."
title: Merchant of Mounts

body_footer: The Training Camp will depart after <eventColor>{Turns}</eventColor> turns.
body_header: Rumors reach you that a renowned <eventColor>{ShopKeeper}</eventColor> set up a <eventColor>{StructureResource}</eventColor> in your domain, <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{ShopKeeper}</eventColor> arrives in your court to pay <<o:ShopKeeper>> respects. "Strength and wisdom to you. I was in service of renowned <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> an' rulers. Now, I walk own path. It be my honor to offer services to such great <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> as you." Then, lowering <<o:ShopKeeper>> voice, <<p:ShopKeeper>> adds: "Or whatever other <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> or <hyperlink>Hero</hyperlink> come visit me."
button_0: "Welcome, instructor! May you teach my Heroes well."
button_1: "Begone, mercenary! Peddle your tricks elsewhere!"
title: Trader of Talents

body_footer: The Mystical Seer will depart after <eventColor>{Turns}</eventColor> turns.
body_header: An advisor reports that a <eventColor>{StructureResource}</eventColor> set up shop <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, offering knowledge of faraway territories and rulers.
body_lore: <<Cp:ShopKeeper>> visits you the same day. "I sell secrets, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. I know much about this realm and its <hyperlink>denizens</hyperlink>. And what little I know not, I divine." Your advisor then leans in and whispers: "It is worth noting that <<p:ShopKeeper>> keeps the same information on you and yours for your rivals to exploit." The <eventColor>{ShopKeeper}</eventColor> presents an innocuous smile.
button_0: "This excites me. Let me inspect your shop right away."
button_1: "My realm is no place for <<m:StructureResource>>!"
title: Shop of Secrets

body_footer: "I follow where my animals lead me. Not other way around. Perhaps they lead me back here some day."
body_header: The <eventColor>{StructureResource}</eventColor> that resided in your domain has led <<o:ShopKeeper>> full menagerie before you to announce <<o:ShopKeeper>> departure.
body_lore: Despite the aural explosion of growls, neighs, and bellows, the <<G:voice,ShopKeeper>> still sounds most clear. "I go now. But I wanted to thank you for allowing my presence." The <eventColor>{ShopKeeper}</eventColor> gestures to his creatures. "We not always welcome everywhere." <<Cp:ShopKeeper>> clicks <<o:ShopKeeper>> tongue and the beasts walk away in a line, like a procession. Two <<m:EventMount>> pull the <<G:cart,ShopKeeper>>.
button_0: The pursuit of new beasts and critters is fickle.
title: Merchant of Mounts: Aftermath

body_footer: "Horizon beckon me. I go seek new <hyperlink>Heroes</hyperlink> to train. Farewell!" The <eventColor>{ShopKeeper}</eventColor> sets <<o:ShopKeeper>> carriage in motion and drives away.
body_header: The <eventColor>{ShopKeeper}</eventColor> has packed up the <eventColor>{StructureResource}</eventColor> <<p:ShopKeeper>> set up in your domain and is ready to depart.
body_lore: "Many <hyperlink>Heroes</hyperlink> come to me. Now I must go to <hyperlink>Heroes</hyperlink> again." The <eventColor>{ShopKeeper}</eventColor> draws a wooden sword and salutes you. "But not here. Elsewhere. Away from you." You wonder if this was meant as an insult.
button_0: Such is the life of a wandering instructor. Until next time.
title: Trader of Talents: Departed

body_footer: "Would say hope we meet again. But I already know outcome." And with that, the <eventColor>{ShopKeeper}</eventColor> turns around and drives her cart out of sight.
body_header: The <eventColor>{StructureResource}</eventColor> who spent some time in your domain has packed up and is ready to depart.
body_lore: <<Cp:ShopKeeper>> has come to find you to say <<o:ShopKeeper>> goodbyes in person. "Profitable my stay was. Very few regrets. Now, time to go."
button_0: Perhaps your destinies will meet again in the future.
title: Shop of Secrets: Departed

body_footer: You find yourself between two Godir who fight over nature's domain. With whom do you side?
body_header: Soon after meeting <eventColor>{EventPlayer.TitleName}</eventColor>, <<p:EventPlayer>> contacts you. "Nature's blessings-" <<p:EventPlayer>> starts, but before <<p:EventPlayer>> can finish her greeting, <<p:EventPlayer>> is interrupted by none other than <eventColor>{EventPlayer2.TitleName}</eventColor>!
body_lore:
Immediately the two <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> start bickering. "The blessings of <nature></nature> <hyperlink>Nature Affinity</hyperlink> should be protected, not twisted and devolved," <eventColor>{Serena.FirstName}</eventColor> sneers: "All who threaten my domain will be exterminated, even mad 'goddesses' like <eventColor>{Nimue.FirstName}</eventColor>."

<eventColor>{Nimue.FirstName}</eventColor> scoffs. "Whilst you were hiding in your forests, I was evolving my <eventColor>{NimueRace}</eventColor>. Only the strongest survive, and for that, you must adapt. Allow me to demonstrate!"
button_0: Side with <eventColor>{Serena.TitleName}</eventColor>.
button_1: Side with <eventColor>{Nimue.TitleName}</eventColor>.
button_2: Pick no side, let nature (and war) take its course.
title: The Primal Dispute

body_footer: Your people cheer you on as you return to <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink>, victorious.
body_header: You have resolved the conflict between the two bickering <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> of <nature></nature> <hyperlink>Nature Affinity</hyperlink>, one way or another. A sense of peace returns to the realm.
body_lore:
Whether this peace will last is unclear. Alliances crumble, friendships change, and the Void twists any mind it touches. In the Astral Sea, few things are eternal.
But for now, the lands of {RealmName} are devoted to your rule.
button_0: Victory is ours!
title: The Primal Dispute: Resolved

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.TitleName}</eventColor> claims this realm for her own, Defeating <<P:EventLeaderDefeated>> will make your rule undeniable.
body_header: The ghostly visage of <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.TitleName}</eventColor> appears before you and addresses you with a contemptuous tone, as though this meeting were beneath <<P:EventLeaderDefeated>> station.
body_lore: "You trespass on my realm, warmblood. Stay out of my way and perhaps I'll see fit to let that blood run through your veins for a few moons more. Interfere, and it will feed the earth of my realm as all who came before."
button_0: The Lich Queen must fall.
title: Domain of the Lich Queen

body_footer: At last, you alone stand victorious in the <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> throne room, none can deny your power now. The Realm is yours.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated}</eventColor> falls with a final curse on her lips, the undead legions that served her collapse to the earth as your troops revel in their victory.
body_lore: The great necropolis of <<g:former throne city,EventLeaderDefeated>> holds an unfathomable count of souls, a necromantic power none can deny, and few could defy.
button_0: Bingbong the Lich is dead!
title: The Lich Queen falls

body_header: Header Text
body_lore: Lore Text

button_2: Bind the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to your will.

body_footer: Will you permit the Order of the <eventColor>{RandomIdol}</eventColor> to build their stronghold in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>?
body_header: A <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> arrives before you. "Hail, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>! I represent the <eventColor>{RandomWarriorTitle}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{RandomIdol}</eventColor>. I have a proposal for you."
body_lore: "Word has reached us of your resolute measures against the Demonic cult in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>. We are looking for a patron in our everlasting battle against evil and its wicked servants. We seek to establish a knightly order in your fair city. The Order of the <eventColor>{RandomIdol}</eventColor>."

button_1: Help the <eventColor>{RandomWarriorTitle}</eventColor> build <structureprod></structureprod> their stronghold. It will strengthen <<G:defenses,EventCity>>. <fortification></fortification>
button_2: Refuse and force the <eventColor>{RandomWarriorTitle}</eventColor> to leave their weapons <unitprod></unitprod> behind.

body_footer: "Sturdy empires are built with mighty blocks of stone! My <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, build more <hyperlink><quarry></quarry>Quarries</hyperlink>!" The chancellor awaits your response rhapsodically.
body_header: "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, we must converse." A grave chancellor approaches you. "While your armies fight in faraway lands, what defends your people?"
body_lore: "I'll tell you what," the chancellor continues. "Walls as high as mountains! As thick as the trunks of ageless oaks! If we are to prosper, we must build, build, build!" The chancellor dispenses <<o:EventUnit>> industrious propaganda with fervent consumption. <<Cp:EventUnit>> wipes <<o:EventUnit>> chin dry. "Or, we build recruitment halls, granaries... Anything that helps us win the war!"
button_0: "I subscribe to your industrious ambition! We need those Quarries!
button_1: "Forget it. Laborers <structureprod></structureprod> in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> just need to work harder. <happiness></happiness>"
button_2: "I know of a faster way to win blocks of stone."
button_3: "Begone, laborious fool. I have no desire for stone."
title: Structured Defenses

body_footer: "Your cities rejoice! They build anything we want!" Stone now congests your cities' streets. How will you spend the excess?
body_header: Your chancellor gleefully hops back into your throne room. "<hyperlink><quarry></quarry>Quarries</hyperlink>! [hyperlink,GLOBAL.QuarryConcept]<quarry></quarry>Quarries[/hyperlink] as far as I can see!"
body_lore: The chancellor proceeds to tell in great detail how the stone is hauled into your cities. "All across your realm, in every city, your citizens talk about how safe they feel, knowing that we have the materials for defensive structures." The chancellor claps <<o:EventUnit>> hands and smirks.
button_0: "Sell the stone in markets. <gold></gold>"
button_1: "<eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> lies unprotected. We will build walls there."
button_2: "Build statues and monuments to celebrate me! <influence></influence>"
button_3: "Use the excess stone for hammerheads and axe-shafts <unitprod></unitprod>."
button_4: "Transform <mana></mana> the blocks into a <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor>."
button_5: "Boost your production in every city. <structureprod></structureprod>"

body_footer: "I suggest befriending <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.FirstName}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. So <<p:EventHouseLord>> may declare war on <eventColor>{TargetPlayer}</eventColor>." Will you support this scheme?
body_header: One of your more cunning advisors proposes a compelling scheme.
body_lore: Your advisor grins. "My <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>! Too long has your pesky rival, <eventColor>{TargetPlayer}</eventColor> of the <eventColor>{TargetRace}</eventColor>, thwarted your goals. Someone ought to challenge <<P:TargetPlayer>>!" You are about to educate your advisor on the risks and costs of warcrafting, when <<p:EventUnit>> continues. "But YOU needn't raise your blade! What if we can pit the disposable City of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> against <eventColor>{TargetPlayer}</eventColor>?"
button_0: "Once <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> is friendly towards us, they will attack my rival!"
button_1: "Cease your underhanded warmongering! <influence></influence> I do not condone backstabbing! <goodact></goodact>"
button_2: "I fight my own battles. Leave me."
title: Puppet Master

body_footer: You inveigled <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> to wage war on <eventColor>{TargetPlayer}</eventColor>. How will you aid their war effort from the shadows?
body_header: Good tidings! The <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor> has succumbed to your charms. <<Cp:EventHouseLord>> considers you <<o:EventHouseLord>> friend.
body_lore: "We are grateful for you pointing out the schemes of <eventColor>{TargetPlayer}</eventColor> and <<o:TargetPlayer>> treacherous <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> against my people. They will pay for their crimes." The <eventColor>{EventHouseLord.Title}</eventColor> bows dutifully before you. "We have already declared war on <eventColor>{TargetPlayer}</eventColor>, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>!" Your scheming advisor hungrily nods from behind a curtain.
button_0: "I will conscript <gold></gold> a <eventColor>{EventUnitA}</eventColor> to reinforce their army."
button_1: "I will summon <mana></mana> a <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> for their army!"
button_2: "I will focus on strengthening my bond with <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>. <allegiance></allegiance>"
button_3: "Their war allows me to forge a casus belli against <eventColor>{TargetPlayer}</eventColor>!"
title: Puppet Master: Aftermath

body_footer: Your recruitment efforts are significantly enhanced upon acquiring <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>. Will you seek out the rare material?
body_header: You send out brave warriors to fight wars. But will their numbers suffice? Your council has a suggestion.
body_lore: "The millstones of war continue to grind, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. We would benefit from augmenting our recruitment efforts. The more troops we send into battle against <eventColor>{EnemyLeader}</eventColor>, the sooner we claim victory. We caught wind of an enchanted substance that quickens your warriors' training. You should claim this 0000048 for yourself."
button_0: "I will conquer the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> and amass a vast army!"
button_1: "Send our builders' hammers <structureprod></structureprod> to the blacksmiths <unitprod></unitprod> of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> instead."
button_2: "I don't need to find <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>. I can shape it myself!"
button_3: "I can already muster all the warriors that victory requires."
title: Battle Upgrades

body_footer: In addition to boosting recruitment, what other bonus should your alchemists draw from the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>?
body_header: Your alchemists murmur excitedly upon learning that you added <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> to your stores. Your council congratulates you.
body_lore: "Mark my words, seas of our warriors will flood the battlefields. Our enemies will be unable to escape our might." One council member examines the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> and cries out: "My <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, this substance is so potent, your mages and alchemists can extract a secondary application!" The council awaits your response expectantly.
button_0: Boost the morale of our troops. <morale></morale>
button_1: Augment the body and skills of <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>.
button_2: Assemble a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>. <unit></unit>
button_3: Extract mana <mana></mana> from the <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>.
title: Battle Upgrades: Aftermath

body_footer: Your chancellor summarizes: "After heroically defeating the mindless <<m:EventUnitB>> that we unleashed ourselves... We claim that <eventColor>{EnemyPlayer}</eventColor> ordered the attack."
body_header: You war with <eventColor>{EnemyPlayer}</eventColor>! Your people are suffering under this war you declared. Most notably the city of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_lore: One of your chancellors gulps. "If it pleases my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, I may know a way to regain your people's support." Before you can respond, <<p:EventUnit>> continues, "Commoners endorse fights against heinous villains. So, we unleash some <<m:EventUnitB>> within our borders." You notice the sweat glistening on your chancellor's brow. "Then, we let them wreak havoc."
button_0: Order the false flag attack and summon <<m:EventUnitB>> near <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
button_1: "Risk civilian lives? No, I shall invest <gold></gold> in popular support! <happiness></happiness>"
button_2: Instead, invoke your people's sense of duty to support this war.
button_3: These trifling issues bore me. I have a war to win!
title: Rally 'Round the Flag

body_header: Before the last <eventColor>{EventUnitB}</eventColor> falls, you hear cheers rise up from <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_lore: You send your chancellor to address the population. "People of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>! These monstrous <<m:EventUnitB>> that threatened to destroy your homes and eat your children were instructed to invade our lands by the treacherous <eventColor>{EnemyPlayer}</eventColor>. Our <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> opposes <<o:EnemyPlayer>> fell intent. Will you join the just fight?" More cheers rise up from the city streets.

button_1: Dispatch envoys to raise support in your other cities too <happiness></happiness>
button_2: Encourage the production of structures. <structureprod></structureprod>
button_3: Attract more people <population></population> to join the city that supports you so.
title: Rally 'Round the Flag: Aftermath

body_footer: "These traders proclaimed that they will travel into your realm," the scout concludes. How will you welcome them?
body_header: A scout reports to you that <<p:EventUnit>> spotted a strange band of merchant <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> in the wilderness.
body_lore: "There was something off about these <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>," the scout informs you. "They swear that they are traders. However, I noticed they carried concealed weapons." The scout then leans in and whispers: "These 'traders' possess surprisingly few wares to trade. Yet their mounts were sturdy and bred for battle."
button_0: Seek out the suspicious traders.
button_1: Send guards <unitprod></unitprod> from <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> to repel the traders from your realm.
button_2: Conceal the paths leading across our borders.

title: Cross Purposes

body_footer: What will you do with this fool and <<o:EventHero>> far-fetched claims about a <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> lost to the mists?

"They spread from the fields, creep through the cracks in your city walls... and then—swoosh—everyone is gone! Stolen by the Fey!" The <<EventHero<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>> stares into space until <<p:EventHero>> takes out a broken 3. "This," <<p:EventHero>> yells, shaking <<o:EventHero>> fists, "is all that's left of my <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>."

button_2: Jail the troublemaker for causing public unrest.

title: For Doom the Bells Toll

A their center, a 3 feeds a gluttonous <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> rotting carcasses to empower it. The cultists chant about the coming of The World Devourer, augured to consume the realm. Once the <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> is sufficiently fed, the cultists will unleash it.

button_1: Magically hasten <mana></mana> your fighters to quickly strike at the flesh piles.

button_6: Beguile the <eventColor>{EnemyUnit}</eventColor> to view your army as most unappetizing.

body_lore: Even with the freedom of the depths below them, the creatures tense up and remain frozen with their eyes wide open and fixed on your troops. The only sound coming from them is the occasional splash of water as they fearfully await their fate.
button_0: Attack! <evilact></evilact>
