title: Deep Fear

body_footer: "Aid us, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>! Three Kjörnoe will merge for one to return! Riches, prosperity, and power will be our reward!"
body_header: You have collected the <eventColor>{CauldronRelic}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{MirrorRelic}</eventColor>, and <eventColor>{GrailRelic}</eventColor>. Now, a strange cultist approaches you. "You hold the relics of the <hyperlink>Kjörnoe</hyperlink>," <<p:EventUnit>> whispers.
body_lore: "I am a <<EventUnit<eventColor>{Son/Daughter}</eventColor>>> of the Kjörnoe, destined to reawaken the <hyperlink>Giant Kings</hyperlink> who were so unfairly declared 'Traitors.' For long, we have followed the Artifacts you now possess, waiting for someone to aid us. With the Sins of Three, your powers as a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, and an unwitting sacrifice, we can mend the Kjörnoe and return them to us!"
button_0: Initiate the ritual to bring back a Traitor King.
button_1: Use the Artifacts to rule the Sons of the Kjörnoe yourself.
button_2: Reject the cult of the Sons of the Kjörnoe. <goodact></goodact>
title: Return of the Kjörnoe

body_footer: "We were shattered, fragmented. Now we... I am <eventColor>{TraitorKingLord.FirstName}</eventColor>. My fate, bound to you. I pay our debts. Name yours."
body_header: Using your own <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> powers and the Artifacts of the <hyperlink>Traitor Kings</hyperlink>, you guide their fragmented souls to an unwilling host.
body_lore: Unable to respond to the sudden assault, <eventColor>{PreviousPlayer}</eventColor> is cast into the <hyperlink>Astral Void</hyperlink>. <<Co:PreviousPlayer>> fading screams and the manic laughter of the Sons of the <hyperlink>Kjörnoe</hyperlink> herald the arrival of the <hyperlink>Traitor Kings</hyperlink>. Their fragmented souls merge to form one <hyperlink>Giant King</hyperlink>, who roars with three voices before finding <<o:TraitorKingLord>> composure. <<Cp:TraitorKingLord>> turns to you: "You have reawakened us."
button_0: "Grant me the riches <gold></gold> I was promised."
button_1: "I was told you brought prosperity." <food></food>
button_2: "Grant me your reverence!" <influence></influence>
title: Return of the Kjörnoe: Reawakening

body_footer: The cultist wails in ecstasy. "Channel the souls of the Kjörnoe, mend their fragments whole! Guide them to their host and throne!"
body_header: Tears well in the eyes of the cultist. "Yes! We shall commence the ritual immediately!"
body_lore: Later, you find yourself in the center of an elaborate rune, the Artifacts of the <hyperlink>Traitor Kings</hyperlink> placed around you. Dark smoke envelops you as the cultist chants. "The Kjörnoe sense your power," <<p:EventUnit>> exclaims. "With you as their conduit, they lack merely a host, an unwitting <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> lamb to sacrifice! Find one, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>! Grant the <hyperlink>Void</hyperlink> its prize!"
button_0: Guide the fragmented souls to the chaos of <eventColor>{ReplacedPlayerChaos}</eventColor>. <evilact></evilact>
button_1: Guide the fragmented souls to the steadfast aura of <eventColor>{ReplacedPlayerMaterium}</eventColor>. <evilact></evilact>
button_2: Guide the fragmented souls to the thunderous spirit of <eventColor>{ReplacedPlayerAstral}</eventColor>. <evilact></evilact>
button_3: Guide the fragmented souls to the cold soul of <eventColor>{ReplacedPlayerShadow}</eventColor>. <evilact></evilact>
button_4: This goes too far. Stop the ritual and banish the cultist. <goodact></goodact>
title: Return of the Kjörnoe: Dark Ritual

body_footer: The distance may be a blessing. For now the Umbral Abyss may slumber, but their forces may be overwhelming if you stir them without preparation.
body_header: You have settled on an island off the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>. A light mist rests on the islands around you, obscuring the coast in the distance.
body_lore: You remember the description of the realm you were given. To the north and south, you see the outlines of jagged islands, small patches of land dotting the ocean. To the east, you imagine the looming Cliffs of Sordünn, claimed by the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. The ocean blocks them from your reach—and you from theirs.
button_0: We must prepare our invasion of the Umbral Abyss.
title: The <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>

body_footer: Or is it?
body_header: Defeat <eventColor>{Merlin.TitleName}</eventColor>
body_lore: T'is the only way
button_0: Mayhaps
title: Save the Realm

body_footer: Your soldiers sweep across the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>, clearing out the last infestations of Umbral influence. This <hyperlink>World</hyperlink> and its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DreamersLoreConcept]Dreamer[/hyperlink] can heal once more.
body_header: You have defeated <eventColor>{Merlin.TitleName}</eventColor> and <<o:Merlin>> <hyperlink>Umbral forces</hyperlink>. <<Cp:Merlin>> sinks to the ground. <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> appear and kneel next to <<P:Merlin>>.
body_lore: <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> gently closes <<o:Merlin>> eyes. "I am sorry, my old friend." <<Cp:Julia>> whispers, a single tear running down <<o:Julia>> face. <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> fixes her gaze on you. "I tried to do right by my father, mother, and mentor. Perhaps I was wrong. Take me to Magehaven, to face my judgment, as <eventColor>{Merlin.FirstName}</eventColor> did here."
button_0: A hard-earned victory.
title: The <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>, liberated

body_footer: "I sense a familiar presence, wreathed in shadows. My nature rejects the darkness, and yet a part of me urges us to investigate... I implore you to do so, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. I feel it is important."
body_header: As you travel the <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> contacts you. "<eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>, I know we have an important mission to focus on, but I sense another presence on this realm."
body_lore: "Something, or someone, reaches out to me from the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. It feels familiar, yet twisted, almost as if... No, I must not hope in vain." <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> pleads: "Whoever they are, they need our help."
button_0: "We shall see."
title: Flicker in the Dark

body_footer: <eventColor>{Sundren.FirstName}</eventColor> barely reacts to her mother's stern tone. "I did not make my decisions lightly, mother... I am here to save those I care about."
body_header: You have defeated the last <hyperlink>Umbral Demon</hyperlink> that threatened the entity hidden in the watchtower. Now, a figure emerges from it.
body_lore:
"You recognize the figure as a female Elf, wreathed in defensive shadows. {Julia.FirstName} gasps. "... Sundren? Is it truly you?"
The harsh gaze of the shadowy Elf shifts and her eyes widen. "Mother?!"" {Sundren.FirstName} exclaims, and {Julia.FirstName} and {Sundren.FirstName} reunite, emotionally.
"I have scoured the Astral Sea for you," {Sundren.FirstName} finally says.
{Julia.FirstName} nods. "I have heard much of your endeavors, my daughter... And the ire you provoke."
button_0: Keep listening.
title: Flicker in the Dark: Aftermath

body_footer: "There is a watchtower, where I made my stand. Free me, and I will be in your debt." The voice pauses for a moment. "... Please."
body_header: Your troops enter the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. Immediately, a whisper reaches you, growing into an ethereal voice carried through the heavy air of the Umbral Abyss.
body_lore: "I am on an important mission that will change the war against the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink>. But these cursed <hyperlink>Umbral Demons</hyperlink> have proven to be... challenging. Help me, so I can finish my mission."
button_0: "I will consider this."
title: Flicker in the Dark: Into the Abyss

body_footer: "As a token of goodwill, I offer you the knowledge to traverse the seas of Sordünn. I also realize you may have more questions for me."
body_header: You are approached by a regal Elven woman. <<Co:Julia>> stature is proud, but <<o:Julia>> eyes betray ages of strife, loss, and hope.
body_lore: "Hail, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>," <<p:Julia>> says. "My name is <eventColor>{Julia.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{Julia.Title}</eventColor>. I was sent here by the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> to aid you on this realm." <<Cp:Julia>> gazes upon the coast in the distance, and her voice fades for a moment. "So many worlds, ravaged by the darkness... We must fight back."
button_0: "Who are you?"
button_1: "Do you know anything about the Prophecy that brought us here?"
button_2: "Have you fought the Umbral Abyss before?"
button_3: "I accept your aid. Let us fight the Umbral Abyss, together."
title: The Archon Champion

body_footer: "The <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor> used to be part of <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>. The <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> believe themselves to be the divine guard, and we are the new powers to rise. As for the stanza about Traitor's Blood... They could not agree upon its interpretation."
body_header: <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> nods slowly. "I know of the Prophecy of Golianth."
body_lore:
<eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> recites: "Divine Myopia, Balance Enchained;
Giant Empires Fall, Corruption Reigns;

From Traitor’s Blood, Fate’s Trail Divides;
Darkness Slain, Through Fractured Light;

Divine Guard must Rest, For New Powers to Rise;
Who Weigh the Cost of Mercy, To a Vengeful Demise."
button_0: "Who are you?"
button_1: "Do you know anything about the Prophecy that brought us here?"
button_2: "Have you fought the Umbral Abyss before?"
button_3: "I accept your aid. Let us fight the Umbral Abyss, together."
title: The Prophecy of Golianth

body_footer: "I was found by an <hyperlink>Archon</hyperlink> vanguard and led to Emnora. Since then I have traveled the <hyperlink>Worlds Within</hyperlink>, preserving life and rebuilding where I can."
body_header: <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> sighs and nods. "I have fought the forces of the <hyperlink>Umbral Abyss</hyperlink> many times before... The final time, I lost."
body_lore: "When the <hyperlink>World Gates</hyperlink> opened, the Empires of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink> were already torn by war and conspiracy. We stood valiantly, but... My husband, he was—assassinated. I was captured instead." A bitter tone creeps into <<o:Julia>> voice as she continues: "One day, I was freed, through an act as kind as it was foolish."
button_0: "Who are you?"
button_1: "Do you know anything about the Prophecy that brought us here?"
button_2: "Have you fought the Umbral Abyss before?"
button_3: "I accept your aid. Let us fight the Umbral Abyss, together."
title: Lithyl's Prisoner

body_footer: "... But above all, I am a mother. To my two children: Thannis and <hyperlink>Sundren</hyperlink>... wherever they may be."
body_header: <eventColor>{Julia.FirstName}</eventColor> smiles with a profound sadness. "Who am I? That is a hard question to answer..."
body_lore: "I am the daughter of the late Emperor Inioch of <hyperlink>Athla</hyperlink>, who I have loved and warred against. I am sister to <hyperlink>Meandor</hyperlink>, who I have warred against and loved. I am-" her voice catches, only shortly: "... Widow to my beloved king Saridas. I have warred, loved, followed and reigned. I have seen great atrocities, and beautiful kindness... I have been an outcast, and a queen to many."
button_0: "Who are you?"
button_1: "Do you know anything about the Prophecy that brought us here?"

body_footer: The ghost sighs, the scent of roses almost overwhelms you. "How beautiful we were. How passionate our love..."
body_header: You have found the source of the alluring call you heard before. The scent of roses and ashes grows stronger.
body_lore:
Not long after, a faint figure appears before you. "My Prince..." She pauses. "You are not my Pale Prince... But you carry his curse... my curse." She wails. "Oh Urvatogh, what have I done..."

She turns to you and gestures to the {EventStructure}. "This is where we fought, this is where I cursed him. Where we betrayed each other..."
button_0: "Tell me more."
button_1: "I've had quite enough of this ghost story. Begone."
title: Fire and Roses: Aftermath

body_footer: "Those beautiful roses, turned to <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor>... Forever out of my reach!" She wails again, lost in agony. "Why did he keep the roses away from me? Why? WHY?!"
body_header: The ghost continues. "I was a witch, blessed by Chaos... he was a Prince, favored by Shadow."
body_lore: "My Prince... He grew roses of glass... Such beautiful roses! We fell in love. I gave him... Everything. And yet, he would not. He spared no rose for me. Why would he keep them from me? Our love turned to ash. And so, I decided to take what he would not give. I betrayed him, I... I..."
button_0: "I will claim <eventColor>{EventMaterial}</eventColor> for you."
button_1: "Find something else to obsess over."
title: Heart of Glass

body_footer: "Now, I can rest... And I give you my weapon, to grant him the same relief." The witch disappears, the scent of roses fading with her memory.
body_header: You have claimed the <eventColor>{EventIngredient}</eventColor>. You hear a deep sigh as the ghost appears once more.
body_lore: "...I betrayed my <hyperlink>Pale Prince</hyperlink>, tried to take a rose by force. We fought," she continues. "My Chaos met his Shadow... In our final moment, I cursed him and his roses... He consumed me in his rage. I did not know... He had been growing a rose for me all along."
button_0: Have your scholars <knowledge></knowledge> chronicle this story.
button_1: Guide the lost soul <mana></mana> on her way to the Astral Sea. <goodact></goodact>
button_2: Drain the witch of her essence <mana></mana> as she fades. <evilact></evilact>
title: Heart of Glass: Aftermath

body_footer: "Find me," the voice whispers, the scent almost irresistible: "Return to me... My Prince..."
body_header: As you travel through <eventColor>{EventRealm}</eventColor>, a faint scent catches your attention. It smells of fire, and roses, and passion.
body_lore: Your attention shifts to the strange scent, and as you focus you start hearing a voice, a faint whisper on the wind. "Vampire... My Prince. Find me... Where we fought... Where we fell... Where my blood touched your lips."
button_0: Follow the alluring scent.
button_1: Focus on your other tasks.
title: Fire and Roses

body_header: Tales of a wicked <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> make even the most tenacious of your people shiver. While investigating these tales, you are contacted by none other than <eventColor>{EventRuler.TitleName}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "It seems my <hyperlink>reputation</hyperlink> precedes me... And so does yours. Many so-called Rulers lack the willpower to claim and conquer what is theirs to take, but you don't hesitate. We have that in common. Accept my offer, and I can aid you on your path of domination, through any means necessary."
button_0: "I accept your offer. Let us conquer the realm." <unit></unit>
button_1: "Currently, I cannot accommodate your arrival, but I will welcome your aid in the future."
button_2: "Begone, scoundrel! I have no place for you."
title: A Notorious Godir's Aid

body_header: One of your messengers approaches you. "Benevolent <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, a message from <hyperlink>Magehaven</hyperlink> has arrived. <eventColor>{EventRuler.TitleName}</eventColor> contacts you."
body_lore: You have heard poems and songs about virtuous <eventColor>{EventRuler.Name}</eventColor> in the past. "Greetings, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>," <<p:EventRuler>> says. "I am traveling the realms, helping out fellow <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> who are fighting for a noble cause. Seeing that you have a <hyperlink>good heart</hyperlink> as well, I offer to join you and lend you my aid. "
button_0: "I accept. Let us bring peace and prosperity to this Realm together!" <unit></unit>
button_1: "You are most welcome. I will enlist you as soon as fate permits."
button_2: "I thank you for your offer, but I need to find my own way."
title: A Virtuous Godir's Aid

body_header: The <hyperlink>Astral Flows</hyperlink> are restless today. A powerful <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> contacts you through the arcane haze.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventRuler.TitleName}</eventColor> appears before you. "I see you have learned the arcane arts, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. The <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> hums with your presence. Your studies of the <hyperlink>Astral</hyperlink> are of interest to me. Allow me to walk amongst your <eventColor>{PlayerRace}</eventColor>, so I can learn from you and your people. In return, I offer my expertise."
button_0: "Join me and together we can master the arcane." <unit></unit>
button_1: "I will prepare for your arrival and will invite you in the future."
button_2: "No, I have other plans."
title: An Astral Godir's Aid

body_header: A strange current in the <hyperlink>Astral Sea</hyperlink> catches your attention. An enticing feeling of anarchy and passion overcomes you, as a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> contacts you.
body_lore: In the vision of turbulent heat, <eventColor>{EventRuler.TitleName}</eventColor> appears. "Your <hyperlink>Chaos</hyperlink> causes inconsistency in this perpetual universe. I like it. Anarchy and mayhem will lead us to true freedom! What say you, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, if I join your forces and we shake the very foundations of this realm?"
button_0: "I always have room for powerful Godir." <unit></unit>
button_1: "I will prepare for your arrival and will welcome you later, my <<EventRuler<eventColor>{brother/sister}</eventColor>>> in chaos."
button_2: "I do not need your help."
title: A Chaos Godir's Aid

body_header: A handcrafted contraption with arcane engravings is delivered to you. After you accept it the contraption opens, revealing that none other than <eventColor>{EventRuler.TitleName}</eventColor> has an offer for you!
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventRuler.Title}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventRuler.FirstName}</eventColor> appears. "Your interest in <hyperlink>Materium</hyperlink> has caught my eye. The power of creation and transmutation runs through you, and the elements bend to your will. I ask only to join you in your quest to master all matter. Will you welcome me?"
button_0: "Join me and you will see all the wonders of this realm." <unit></unit>
button_1: "You can join me as soon as I have the capacity."
button_2: "I do not need your help."
title: A Materium Godir's Aid

body_header: In the rustling leaves and rushing water, you hear the voice of a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>.
body_lore: <eventColor>{EventRuler.TitleName}</eventColor> appears before you. "The winds of spring whisper of another <hyperlink>friend of nature</hyperlink>. It seems you embrace life and growth as much as I do. Let us join forces. Together we can bring prosperity to this realm!"
button_0: "I accept your offer. Join me on this realm!" <unit></unit>
button_1: "Currently, I cannot accommodate your arrival, but I will welcome your aid in the future."
button_2: "No, I have to follow my path alone."
title: A Nature Godir's Aid

body_header: In a beam of celestial light, a formal message is delivered to you.
body_lore:
"To the just {PlayerLeader.TitleName} of the {PlayerRace},
I wish to express my approval of the Path of Faith you have chosen. As Godir, we must stand strong against the lawless and the darkness. Therefore, I ask you to enlist me in your army, so I may walk among mortals once more and aid you in your quest.
May faith and order guide you on your path.

- {EventRuler.TitleName}."
button_0: Enlist <eventColor>{EventRuler.Title}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventRuler.FirstName}</eventColor> in your army. <unit></unit>
button_1: Explain that you can not accommodate <eventColor>{EventRuler.FirstName}</eventColor> at the moment, but would like to in the future.
button_2: Decline <<o:EventRuler>> offer.
title: An Order Godir's Aid

body_header: Shadows around you shimmer and shift, until a figure appears from the darkness. It is none other than <eventColor>{EventRuler.TitleName}</eventColor>!
body_lore: "You, who gazes into the <hyperlink>Shadow</hyperlink> without fear, have caught the attention of those beyond oblivion. Death becomes thee, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>. Allow me to join you on your path to become Eternal.
button_0: "Join me in shadows, <eventColor>{EventRuler.Title}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventRuler.Name}</eventColor>!" <unit></unit>
button_1: "Currently, I cannot accommodate your arrival, but I will welcome your aid in the future."
button_2: "I walk this path of shadow alone."
title: A Shadow Godir's Aid

body_footer: Your courtiers warn you, with all that's going on in the Empire of the <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, this may very well be a trap...
body_header:
Your courtiers deliver a letter from the Empire of the {IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.Title}, found hidden amongst regular merchandise.
"To the great {PlayerLeader.Title}..."
body_lore: "I do not call upon the help of a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> lightly, but it has become clear our <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> has succumbed to forces beyond our own, in a plot that spans beyond our Empire. The <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimPlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor> has eyes and ears everywhere. If you are truly the savior we need, we shall meet at the <eventColor>{EventOverlay}</eventColor>. - A Concerned Citizen."
button_0: Send a party to meet the <eventColor>{IntrigueVictimUnit}</eventColor>.

body_header: The air starts to sizzle with arcane energies as <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> enters your throne room.
body_lore: "Your magecraft is awe-inspiring, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>," <<p:EventHero>> says with a respectful voice. "As your humble servant I seek to emulate just a fraction of your powers. You are a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, capable of raising Wizard's Towers that pierce the sky. I am a simple mage. Yet I dream of a <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor> where sorcery can be practiced by the initiates of the arcane, to the glory of our <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>."
button_0: "Your ambitions flatter me, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>. Proceed."
button_1: "Despite your sweet-talk, I have no interest in your <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>."
title: Sorcerer's Spire

body_footer: "This <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor> is a mere droplet in your pool of arcane wealth. Still, if you desire anything it offers, you may take it."
body_header: Visiting the <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor> of <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>, you are welcomed by a <eventColor>{MagicUnit}</eventColor> familiar.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{MagicUnit}</eventColor> shows you round the different levels of the tower, from the mana cellar to the library, the training grounds and at last the sorcerer's spire at the top. There <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> greets you, overjoyed: "Excuse my initial absence, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>. But the opportunities this tower provides are exhilarating and it costs me to put my studies aside..."
button_0: "Share the findings of your mystic studies <knowledge></knowledge>, <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor>."
button_1: "Embrace this role as a sorcerer <unitHero></unitHero>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>. It suits you well."
button_2: "I like your <eventColor>{MagicUnit}</eventColor> familiar <unit></unit>. Let me keep it."
title: Sorcerer's Spire: Aftermath

body_footer: has the urge to release <<o:EventHero>> astral energies and create the <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor> at your will.
body_header: Drawing astral energies from the <conduit></conduit> <hyperlink>Conduit</hyperlink> you constructed for <<P:EventHero>>,  has finalized <<o:EventHero>> preparations to shape the <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "You have empowered me, my <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>!" <<Cp:EventHero>> speaks with confidence, <<o:EventHero>> eyes flashing with blue light. "The <hyperlink>Astral Flows</hyperlink>, they surge through my body; the mana, it runs through my veins. I must unleash its creative potential while the vision of the <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor> is strong within me. <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, please..."
button_0: "Where the Conduits hum, your <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor> will thrive..."
title: Sorcerer's Spire: Interlude

body_footer: Will you construct the <farm></farm> <hyperlink>Farm</hyperlink> to supply <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> with the crops required for <<o:EventHero>> <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor>?
body_header: With pious solemnity you are visited by <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>, holding a figurine that appears to model—you!
body_lore: "O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>!" <<p:EventHero>> calls out, briefly pausing in <<o:EventHero>> devotion. "Officially I may serve you as a general. But you are not just a ruler to me. You are <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, a <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, I worship and adore. In the Order of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor> many desire to render your <eventColor>{EventPlayerAttribute}</eventColor> religious service. We seek to build an <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor> where we can commune as monks. Alas, we lack the farming grounds to grow the crops for our rituals..."
button_0: "Worshiping my <eventColor>{EventPlayerAttribute}</eventColor>? You may proceed..."
button_1: "Your order should restrain themselves, for now."
button_2: "Come to your senses, <<EventHero<eventColor>{brother/sister}</eventColor>>>! Only to the Allfather we should pray..." <goodact></goodact>
title: The Order of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>

body_footer: "The disciples eagerly await the prophetic words of their <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>: where shall we build the <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor>?"
body_header: Your <farm></farm> <hyperlink>Farm</hyperlink> have harvested the crops <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> needed for <<o:EventHero>> <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "O most generous <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventHero.FirstName}</eventColor> shouts in excitement, "these herbs and progeny will serve our ritual masters well. In the meantime," <<p:EventHero>> continues, "your followers have not been idle, securing architects, work force and building materials for the <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor>."
button_0: "Once I have inspected my cities, you will be given a sign..."
title: The Order of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>: Interlude

body_footer: "Our order and this <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor> exist solely to do you service. How may we please you, our <eventColor>{EventPlayerType}</eventColor>, today?"
body_header: Carrying a tome adorned with your countenance, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> welcomes you at the new <eventColor>{EventImprovement}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "You bless us with your presence, O <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>!" <<Cp:EventHero>> lifts <<o:EventHero>> arms, preaching to the monks gathering in the <<Ge:central court,EventImprovement.Name>>. "Through our rituals we can now transcend our consciousness and grow closer to your <eventColor>{EventPlayerAttribute}</eventColor>. But nothing is nearly as elevating as our <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> walking among us."
button_0: "Inscribe your rituals and epiphanies into holy books of knowledge." <knowledge></knowledge>
button_1: "Spread the words of my godly nature in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>!" <happiness></happiness>
button_2: "Let the faith of your order strengthen my reign." <influence></influence>
button_dragon: "I crave your order's relics for my hoard!" <item></item>
button_eldritch: "[runicfont]The tentacle gives and the tentacle takes.[/runicfont]"<thralls></thralls>
title: The Order of <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.FirstName}</eventColor>: Aftermath

body_footer: Eager to hunt for the treasures of the old Giant Kings, your men await further orders.
body_header: Making their way through the underground, your troops enter a cavern glittering in shades of gold.
body_lore: It appears indeed that there once must have been an abundance of the precious metal in the region. Scattered ruins of Myrridan architecture connected by a railroad network and a myriad of mining carts suggest that in the days of ancient <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink> this must have been a flourishing gold mining complex. What still remains of this gilded splendor remains to be seen, but the glimmer in the eyes of your troops speaks volumes.
button_0: Allow them to press on. <movementgeneral></movementgeneral>
button_1: You sense danger. They should rest <hp></hp> before they continue.
button_2: Refrain from giving any special orders.
button_3: Connect with the earth to scry for the riches lying ahead.
title: Entering the Gilded Wastes

body_footer: Scared by the ghostly whispers your soldiers seek your guidance.
body_header: As the sound of chinking coins echoes through the cavern it is answered by the uttered sighs of a thousand mouthless voices.
body_lore: "Leave us!" "Save us!" "Join us!" "Savior!" "Traitor!" "Damned!" The roused whispers filling the cave, discordant and covetous, instill your troops with fear. Some of them claim to see armed ghostly figures moving in the dark. Eventually the voices subside and the Gilded Wastes return to a state of silence. But it is no longer a silence that knows comfort.
button_0: Dismiss their fears <happiness></happiness>.
button_1: Appeal <influence></influence> to their bravery.
button_2: Demonstrate your arcane might <mana></mana>. The phantasms should tremble!
title: Gilded Wastes: Phantasmal Whispers

body_footer: Armed phantasms step out of the shadows, blocking any path forward or backward.
body_header: After your troops salvaged another stash of gold within the ruins, a single wrathful voice fills the cavern.
body_lore: "Raiders! Looters! Thieves!" the voice shouts, violently booming in the ears of your troops. "You are all guilty of greed, staining your hands with the blood of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor>. We mined till death. We smelted till death. Crumbling beneath the iron feet of <eventColor>{EventGiantKing}</eventColor>. Accursed is <<o:EventGiantKing>> name. Accursed, the gold. Accursed, all who touch a single coin!"
button_0: "Take up arms! These ghosts are no match for us!"
button_1: "Our hearts know no greed. To prove it, we will sacrifice our wealth <gold></gold>."
title: Gilded Wastes: Phantasmal Rage

body_footer: Blinded by agony, the phantasm sends out more of <<o:EventHero>> brethren to falsely avenge their fate.
body_header: With more gold taken from the ruins, the phantasm voice returns in anger.
body_lore: "Stop! Stop! Why won't you die, relentless raiders? Have we not suffered enough..." The phantasm sounds desperate, defeated. "<eventColor>{EventGiantKing}</eventColor> craved tireless golems to do <<o:EventGiantKing>> bidding, without rest, will or needs," the voice continues. "When the forges failed <<o:EventGiantKing>> demands, <eventColor>{EventGiantKing}</eventColor> turned to wicked magic, attempting to twist our bodies into a race of golem servants. Instead... we became this!" The phantasm reveals <<o:EventHero>> face, half ghostly flesh and half metal.
button_0: "Stand together! No mercy for the merciless!"
button_1: "Your troubled souls seek rest. Allow me to aid <mana></mana> you..."
title: Gilded Wastes: Phantasmal Sorrows

body_footer: "I am opening the path to <eventColor>{EventGiantKing}</eventColor> and <<o:EventGiantKing>> treasury. Slay the accursed, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, fulfill our revenge!"
body_header: You have taken many of the Gilded Waste's treasures. The phantasm hero comes before you, calm at last.
body_lore: "Perhaps," <<p:EventHero>> says, half to <<r:EventHero>>, "this is not a moment of bane but of fortune. When the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> rode to justice and <eventColor>{EventGiantKing}</eventColor> foresaw <<o:EventGiantKing>> doom, <<p:EventGiantKing>> hid <<o:EventGiantKing>> soul inside a grail powering a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>. There <<p:EventGiantKing>> survived the fall of <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>, and though we locked <<P:EventGiantKing>> inside <<o:EventGiantKing>> own treasury we could never complete our vengeance as <<o:EventGiantKing>> powers are beyond our own."
button_0: "This <eventColor>{EventGiantKing}</eventColor> will be no match for us!" <influence></influence>
button_1: "I accept your calling, but your phantasms <unit></unit> will join me in battle."
title: Gilded Wastes: Phantasmal Vengeance

calmed_phantasm: Your actions have calmed the phantasm hero. <<Cp:EventHero>> seems to be able to see past <<o:EventHero>> rage again.

body_footer: The phantasm bows to you, before it leaves: "The Gilded Wastes are yours now, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>."
body_header: With an earsplitting noise the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> collapses at the feet of your troops. The leader of the phantasms appears, the gilded core containing <<ge:soul,EventGiantKing>> in <<o:EventHero>> hands.
body_lore: "It is done," <<p:EventHero>> says, staring in disbelief at the gleaming artifact. "You relieved us from our curse. At last, the souls of the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> can rest in peace." The phantasm hero hands you the <eventColor>{EventRelic}</eventColor>. "Take it. You will know how to destroy or contain <eventColor>{EventGiantKing}</eventColor>." As you touch the trinket, you can sense great power, but also—disruption! This is no integral soul dwelling inside the <eventColor>{EventRelic}</eventColor>. It is a fragment, a wretched memorial to the vain pursuit of immortality.
button_0: "I claim these lands to renew the splendor <influence></influence> of ancient Myrrida."
button_1: "We will not rest until each coin <gold></gold> left in those mines is ours."
button_3: "The mysteries uncovered here, I gift to the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>." <allegiance></allegiance>
title: Gilded Wastes: Aftermath

body_footer: The flows within the barrier are overwhelming your astral senses, making it impossible to descry what is lying inside.
body_header: Nearing the eye of the storm, your troops find their path blocked by an impenetrable vortex barrier.
body_lore: Here, the astral discharges are charged up to a maximum—sending anyone through the barrier would amount to a death sentence. Within the barrier the shape of something enormous can be glimpsed, like a titan kept in stasis by the maelstrom around.
button_0: "We will retreat, for now."
title: Crystalstorm Plateau: Storm Barrier

body_footer: The crystal storm entices you, seizing your attention. Yet how will you protect your troops from the dangers lying ahead?
body_header: At the top of the mountain slopes <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> your troops find themselves in an elevated area sizzling with astral energy.
body_lore: Bizarre crystalline formations are spread throughout the region, some growing from the ground, others kept in levitation by the shearing forces of the storm raging at the center of the plateau. In the distance, an abundance of Lithorine creatures can be seen roaming the landscape. Whether they were attracted by the crystals, created them, or protect them is uncertain.
button_0: Cast upon them <mana></mana> a spell of warding <resistance></resistance>.
button_1: Order them to ground themselves <defenselightning></defenselightning> at the expense of a slower <movementwalk></movementwalk> advance.
button_3: The troops will manage without your direct support.
title: Climbing the Crystalstorm Plateau

body_footer: "Bring crystal cores of Lithorine," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> concludes, "and I shatter ward."
body_header: As your troops step away from the storm barrier, they are approached by a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> signaling <<o:EventUnit>> peaceful intentions.
body_lore: "Strong magic of the <hyperlink>Giant King</hyperlink>," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> calls out, "many runestones buried beneath mighty realm." <<Cp:EventUnit>> reaches under <<o:EventUnit>> shabby cloak to reveal a polished orb, bearing semblance to the seeing stones of the Godir. "See past. See future. Can destroy spell of giant kin—Hastefolk pay prize."
button_0: Accept the deal of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>.
button_1: Overwhelm the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to make <<P:EventUnit>> break the barrier by force.
title: Crystalstorm Plateau: Runestones of the Past

body_footer: "Whatever the <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink> intends to do with the caged beasts, it cannot be good," the druid concludes. "You free them, we all win, right?"
body_header: Entering a fiery cavern <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, your troops hear the hushed shouts of a <<EventHero<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>>, desperate to draw their attention.
body_lore: "Shush—over here!" As your <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> approaches the <<EventHero<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>> clad in druid's clothing, <<p:EventHero>> stares at <<P:EventStackLeader>> in disbelief, but does not recede. "See the large figures down at the fissures? Those are <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink> grunts," <<p:EventHero>> whispers. "They have captured the beasts of the land, badgering them in cages, brutalizing them for combat." The druid anxiously bites <<o:EventHero>> nails. "I... cannot bear this any longer. This maltreatment must end!"
button_0: "Fine. We will take care of the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.FireClanLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>."
button_1: "I feel your sorrows. Those poor creatures must be freed!" <goodact></goodact>
button_3: "Once chained to my lash, those war beasts will be free... to kill!" <evilact></evilact>
title: Discovering the Molten Scar

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> and <<o:EventStackLeader>> <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink> fighters are closing in on your troops. How do you order your army to engage them?
body_header: Carefully taming the caged <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, your troops are taken by surprise as they become surrounded by the war cries of the <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink>.
body_lore: Led by a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, the brutes of the <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink> encircle your army, blocking any paths of retreat. "Who thinks can steal from giant clan? Free beasts? Break chains?" they shout, baring their hideous teeth. "Now Hastefolk put in cage. Squeak and twitch! When <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor> wakens, Hastefolk become fodder."
button_0: Let them engage the attackers without giving special orders.
button_1: Tell the troops to rush at the enemy <movementwalk></movementwalk>, exposing their own flanks <armor></armor>.
button_2: Make them stay in a tight formation <armor></armor>, sacrificing their own mobility <movementwalk></movementwalk>.
button_3: Summon <mana></mana> a body of water above them, to protect them <defensefire></defensefire> from fiery attacks.
title: Molten Scar: <eventColor>{GLOBAL.FireClanLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor> Ambush!

chained_creature: Binding the "freed" <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> with a chained necklace, your troops are taken by surprise as they become surrounded by the war cries of the <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink>.
freed_creature: Watching the unpent <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> escape into the wilds, your troops are taken by surprise as they become surrounded by the war cries of the <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink>.

second_event: The <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink> brutes almost sound desperate, seeing that you cross their plans one by one. "Shoo, pesky Hastefolk! Beasts trained for war. When <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor> sees, joins mighty <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink>." They mount an enormous cauldron on a hastily lit bonfire. "Tonight we eat'za Hastefolk stew!"

body_footer: "While scouting the region I learned of all the cages the <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink> set up," <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> concludes. "Here, let me show you..."
body_header: While your troops tend to the caged <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, the druid from the cavern entrance returns to talk.
body_lore: "It is good to see people handling their animals with respect," <<p:EventHero>> says, showing a smile. "I am <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>, wildspeaker and veteran adventurer enlisted in the <hyperlink>Company of Lost Treasures</hyperlink>. When I heard of an uncovered map that would lead to the Molten Scar, I knew the path that was laid out for me..."
button_0: Learn the locations of the remaining cages.
button_1: Let the fool babble. <<Cp:EventHero>> might still be of use.
title: Molten Scar: A Formal Introduction

chained_creature: "As a wildspeaker I know all life is sacred," <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> concludes, "but seeing your brutish actions, I feel doubt in my heart."
As your troops grimly enchain the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, the druid from the cavern entrance returns, full of bitterness.
freed_creature: As your troops carefully set the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> free, the druid from the cavern entrance returns, overjoyed.

chained_creature: "This display of violence is infuriating!" <<p:EventHero>> shouts, clearly dismayed. When I heard of an uncovered map that would lead to the Molten Scar, I knew the path that was laid out for me..."
freed_creature: "It is clear that the blessing of nature runs within your veins," <<p:EventHero>> says with a hearty smile. "I am <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>, wildspeaker and veteran adventurer enlisted in the <hyperlink>Company of Lost Treasures</hyperlink>. When I heard of an uncovered map that would lead to the Molten Scar, I knew the path that was laid out for me..."

body_footer: The Flowrock key revealed to you a <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>. Without doubt, this is where the <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink> and "their" <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor> are to be found.
body_header: To the surprise of your troops, there is no creature to be found in the last opened cage, but a large block of Flowrock.
body_lore: As your soldiers touch the block, the Flowrock shifts into the shape of an enormous key—without a doubt a work of ancient giant magic. The key seems to register your <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> powers. It calls to you, drags your attention to the <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> the Molten Scar. You see a dungeon island amidst boiling lava, chains leading to darkest prison depths... until you hear the echo of a primal scream.
button_0: Send out one of your heroes to face the dangers of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
title: Molten Scar: Caged Visions

body_footer: "I feel that the <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink> must know about the myth of <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> ends <<o:EventHero>> speech. "If only I... I mean, their presence here can't be a coincidence!"
body_header: While your troops tend to the caged <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> returns to talk.
body_lore: "To those versed in the lore of the land, the Molten Scar is a place of legend," <<p:EventHero>> begins to narrate. "It is said that <hyperlink>in the days of the Great Hunt</hyperlink>, when the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Elder Giants[/hyperlink] fought the Primordial Beasts, a <eventColor>{PrimordialUnit}</eventColor> called <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor> dwelt in this region. When <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor> clashed with the giant hunters, their mighty blows split the earth, pouring boiling magma from the depths of this world; the forming chasms a memorial, for eternity."
button_0: Thank <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> for <<o:EventHero>> insights.
button_1: The time for <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> has not come... just yet.
title: Molten Scar: Primordial Myths

chained_creature: "If <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor> was still around," <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> ends <<o:EventHero>> speech with morbid glee, "it would surely avenge your sins against nature."
As your troops grimly enchain the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> returns, full of bitterness.
freed_creature: As your troops carefully set the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> free, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> returns, overjoyed.

body_footer: "I had aeons to bear a grudge," <eventColor>{DruidHero}</eventColor> squeals, while large compound eyes light up in the darkness above. "Now I must feed, and feed I shall!"
body_header: When your troops reach the brim of the lava lake, the Flowrock key shifts into a razer-thin slope, forming a bridge to the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> in the middle.
body_lore:
Once inside, the unworldly squeal of 2 can be heard. Large corridors, spun into moth web tunnels, lead to the hall in which the {PrimordialUnit} was imprisoned. Now, the celestial chains lie broken on the ground, at the feet of the triumphant Fire Clan.

Suddenly a strangely familiar voice begins to speak: "It is unusual for prey," it says, "to come freely to its own engulfment. Yet freely <> came, seeking to soothe my rage. button_1: Gain the blessing of Giants <mana></mana> and let the Great Hunt commence once more!
button_2: Leave, for now.
