body_header: With the mighty <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor> subdued and returned to its chains, <eventColor>{DruidHero}</eventColor> comes to <<o:DruidHero>> senses again.
body_lore: "What... what have I done?" <<p:DruidHero>> calls out in dismay, looking at <<o:DruidHero>> hands, still searing with primordial fire. "I thought I could bond with <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor>, amend what the Great Hunt had afflicted in the creature I called noble. Instead I found burning hatred, incinerating my beliefs within moments. I was defenseless. If the <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink> unleashed <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor>, its primal wrath would have devoured the realms..."
button_0: "A <<DruidHero<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>> with your talents is welcome <unitHero></unitHero> in my army."
button_1: "Your compassion with the creatures of the land <natureboon></natureboon> is inspiring. Do not abandon this path!" <goodact></goodact>
button_2: "I shall consume you and the powers <xp></xp> you leeched from <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor>!" <evilact></evilact>
button_3: "You will be a valuable asset to extort <gold></gold> the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.ColtLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>."
button_4: "Use your powers as a wildspeaker to bolster my ranks <unit></unit>!"
title: Molten Scar: Aftermath

ape: "What... what have I done?" <<p:DruidHero>> calls out in dismay, looking at <<o:DruidHero>> hands, still pulsing with primordial fury. "I thought I could bond with <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor>, amend what the Great Hunt had afflicted in the creature I called noble. Instead I found unbounded hatred, crushing my beliefs within moments. I was defenseless. If the <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink> unleashed <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor>, its primal wrath would have devoured the realms..."
serpent: "What... what have I done?" <<p:DruidHero>> calls out in dismay, looking at <<o:DruidHero>> hands, still dripping with primordial poison. "I thought I could bond with <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor>, amend what the Great Hunt had afflicted in the creature I called noble. Instead I found venomous hatred, corroding my beliefs within moments. I was defenseless. If the <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink> unleashed <eventColor>{EventBeastName}</eventColor>, its primal wrath would have devoured the realms..."

body_footer: "The Creator watches over these halls," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> concludes. "Solve its enigmas and you can carve out your own reward. Seek bloodshed, however, and that too you will find."
body_header: Climbing down pristine stairs hewn into stone, your troops find their path blocked by a <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, towering at a large hall's entrance.
body_lore: "Halt," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> says slowly, <<o:EventUnit>> voice echoing from the walls. "Halt, foreigners, before you enter the hallowed halls of the <hyperlink>Rock Clan</hyperlink>. Here, we ponder the enigmas of the material world. Unlike the other clans, we seek no quarrel with the Hastefolk. We create." Indeed the chambers stretching out behind the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> are not ruined like other remnants of old <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>. They are built anew, a monument to the raw potential still dwelling within the Giant kin.
button_0: Enter the Hall of Enigmas.
title: Entering the Hall of Enigmas

body_footer: "For long none were worthy of even a flask. If I were your servant, what would be my task?"
body_header: At the heart of this chamber, a Flowrock fountain sputters earth and stone. As your troops come close, it shifts into a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> and begins to speak:
body_lore:
"The Giants granted me sinew and bone.
Am I a liquid or am I a stone?
Myrrida I raised, halls and towers, sublime.
My walls unaffected by the ravages of time.
Withstood Dragon fire, withstood Archon wrath.
Yet lost were my masters on their ill-fated path."
button_0: Do not answer the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, for now.
button_1: "To rise as elementals, invulnerable warriors of rock!"
button_2: "To build walls high and mighty <structureprod></structureprod>, a new empire's core."
button_3: "To erect monuments <influence></influence> for the aeons to behold!"
button_4: "To engrave the world's wisdom <knowledge></knowledge> in tomes of stone."
title: Hall of Enigmas: Visions of Flowrock

enigma_solved: You already answered this enigma. Go to the other chambers to continue the trial.
Your troops return to the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> at the center of this chamber.
The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> stays silent, as if <<p:EventStackLeader>> is still pondering the answers you gave.

body_footer: "We did all their bidding, yet their hearts sank in mist. They sought life and saw failure. Say: when does life exist?"
body_header: In this chamber clinking with crystalline energies, your troops are greeted by a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>:
body_lore:
"We were gemstones of the earth, lucent and tall.
The Giant King mined us and lighted their halls.
Forged us into weapons, ground, and smelted each day.
They were the sculptors, and we were the clay.
At last they imbued us with faces and soul.
We were wondrous and wondering and foreign to all."
button_0: Do not answer the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, for now.
button_1: "Alive is he who fights for survival!"
button_2: "All the living must feed <food></food> and sprout."
button_3: "Life is the magic spark <mana></mana> that kindles our souls."
button_4: "As Godir <influence></influence> we grant life to whatever we desire."
title: Hall of Enigmas: Visions of Lithorite

enigma_solved: You already answered this enigma. Go to the other chambers to continue the trial.
Your troops return to the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> at the center of this chamber.
The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> stays silent, as if <<p:EventStackLeader>> is still pondering the answers you gave.

body_footer: "The essence they bound fuels the forges to this date. Yet which item is the most worthy to make?"
body_header: Between two mighty pillars, a lone <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> awaits your troops in this chamber. It speaks with a tinny voice:
body_lore:
"Rich are the elements beneath the earth's shade.
Rich who distills their purity grade.
The Giant King gifted like none were before
Refined and bound the material core.
Forgemasters, mages, and anvil in one
They fashioned marvels that rivaled the sun."
button_0: Do not answer the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, for now.
button_1: "The sword that cuts through enemy lines!"
button_2: "The ring that binds all <influence></influence> to my will!"
button_3: "The forging hammer <bindingessence></bindingessence> that enhances all future creations."
button_4: "The scrying orb <mana></mana> that lets me glimpse both future and past."
title: Hall of Enigmas: Binding Visions

enigma_solved: You already answered this enigma. Go to the other chambers to continue the trial.
Your troops return to the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> at the center of this chamber.
The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> stays silent, as if <<p:EventStackLeader>> is still pondering the answers you gave.

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> begins to talk: "I observed, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. I know your convictions."
body_header: As your troops return to the center chamber, immovable energies weigh on you like a mountain, threatening to slowly crush all your senses.
body_lore: Despite this fundamental clutch, you feel invigorated, inspired to create, build, shape what no <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink> has devised before...! Then you notice the entity observing you, giving itself the guise of a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>. Yet, you instinctively know its true form is much larger. Insurmountable. Encompassing the cosmos. This Creator worshiped by the <hyperlink>Rock Clan</hyperlink>, could it be the <hyperlink>Endailon</hyperlink> of Materium?
button_0: Flee the grasp of the Creator.
button_1: "I am the earthquake that crumbles the world."
button_2: "I am the builder <structureprod></structureprod>, raising cities and walls."
button_3: "I am the artisan <influence></influence> who perfects his work."
button_4: "I am the architect <knowledge></knowledge> of civilizations to last."
title: Hall of Enigmas: Visions of the Creator

body_footer: "You have earned the possession of these halls, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>," the Creator ends as his presence fades. "Take the <eventColor>{EventRelic}</eventColor>. The <hyperlink>Rock Clan</hyperlink> is a rough diamond. Refine or sell—I observe."
body_header: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> nods. "Constant creation is the purest material virtue. Yet without focus the creator may immure himself within a maze."
body_lore: "The <hyperlink>Giant King</hyperlink> were favored beyond comparison," the Creator continues. "They shaped the realms, tamed the <hyperlink>Urwilderness</hyperlink>, championed the elements through might and through craft. Their kingdom, <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>, fanned the flames of civilization and their cosmic knowledge challenged even the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>." The entity sighs like a mountain during a stormy night. "They abandoned the path of creation. Though they lasted longer than any before or after."
button_0: Accept the gift of devastation. <unit></unit>
button_3: Accept the gift of ambition. <mine></mine><quarry></quarry><conduit></conduit>
button_4: Accept the gift of creation. <bindingessence></bindingessence>
button_5: Accept the gift of wisdom. <knowledge></knowledge>
title: Hall of Enigmas: Aftermath

ambition: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> nods. "Immaculacy is the ideal of creation. Such ambitions can lead to eternity—or the void of an unfinishable task."
devastation: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> nods. "Destruction paves the way for creation. From devastation new civilizations can be born—or all turned to dust."
wisdom: The <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> nods. "Only the connoisseur of the elements may employ them to their greatest effect. Unless the knowledge collects dust within a tome never put into practice."

body_footer: The <hyperlink>Storm Clan</hyperlink>, <hyperlink>Fire Clan</hyperlink>, and <hyperlink>Rock Clan</hyperlink> regard you as the one to fulfill the Legend of Thagnokar and lead their clans to a war against the realm. Do you accept their fealty?
body_header: Studying the inscriptions on the Myrridan Menhirs you possess, you are interrupted by a delegation of the three major Giant clans.
body_lore:
The begins to speak: "For long we have awaited the coming of one, who is like Thagnokar, the Enduring, who fell in defense of Titan's Henge."

"One, who summons the storm that breaks the thrones of all Hastefolk," the {StormGiant} continues, "and hews the cornerstone of a new Myrrida."

"You wrested the , {StormRelic}, and {StoneRelic} from our clans, {PlayerLeader.TitleName}," the {FireGiant} concludes. "You are the flame that can forge us into one. If only you ignite the spark..."
button_0: "The reign of the Giant kin shall be restored!"
button_1: "I cannot lead you to war. But I can grant your kin sanctuary within my realm."
button_2: "Myrrida was built upon peace and equality, not bloodshed and slaughter!" <influence></influence><goodact></goodact>
title: Thagnokar's Heir: Introduction

body_footer: The Giant Clans are planning an assault upon the empires of this realm. How do you wish to prepare for their onslaught?
body_header: Alarming rumors are reaching your empire, speaking of rallying armies of Giants all across the realm.
body_lore: Indeed the earth has been trembling ever so slightly and the clouds darkened with thunder, instilling not only the people of your own empire with fear. Everywhere the word is spreading that the different Giant Clans are invoking the name of Thagnokar's Heir, a leader that has risen to unite their clans and return them their rightful place above all smaller races.
button_0: Connect with the land <mana></mana> to discern their movements beneath the earth.
button_1: Send heralds <influence></influence> to muster anyone willing to defend <unitprod></unitprod> their homes.
button_2: "We are well prepared to face any foe. Be it Demon, Dragon or Giant."
title: Thagnokar's Heir: Growling Thunder

body_footer: The Giants and their monstrous troops are marching towards <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, determined to raze it to the ground.
body_header: Tremors announce the invasion of the <eventColor>{EventClan}</eventColor> army, their leader, the dreaded <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>, towering above the <eventColor>{EventGeo}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.
body_lore: Even from a great distance the shouts of <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> can be heard: "The Age of the Hastefolk has reached its abrupt ending," <<p:EventHero>> declares, swinging <<o:EventHero>> <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor>. "For Thagnokar's Heir, <eventColor>{EventPlayer.TitleName}</eventColor>, has returned our kin to unity. Now, we reclaim our rightful place as rulers of this realm!"
button_0: "<eventColor>{EventPlayer}</eventColor> will pay for this in time!"
title: Thagnokar's Heir: Attack on <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>

body_footer: "I am chosen to be your general in this war that ends all, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>," <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> concludes. "Which clan army do you wish me to command?"
body_header: Tremors announce the invasions of the Giant Clans all throughout the realm. One of their leaders, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor>, proudly approaches you.
body_lore: "So it begins, Heir of Thagnokar!" <<p:EventHero>> says, pointing to a far distance invisible to you. "We have raised armies worthy of even the mightiest <hyperlink>Giant King</hyperlink>. Walls will be breached; thrones will be shattered; and our kin shall rise as lords from the ashes!"
button_0: "Lead the blazing legion <unit></unit> of the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.FireClanLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>!"
button_2: "Field the sturdy troops <unit></unit> of the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.StoneClanLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>!"
button_3: "Command the tempestuous hordes <unit></unit> unleashed by the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.StormClanLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>!"
title: Thagnokar's Heir: The Clans Unleashed

body_footer: The battlefield abounds with the bodies and equipment of the <eventColor>{EventClan}</eventColor>. What do you order your troops to salvage in your name?
body_header: You have bested the <eventColor>{EventClan}</eventColor> and saved <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>!
body_lore: The colossal corpses of the Giants and the churned earth still give testament to the momentous clash with the primal forces of the <eventColor>{EventClan}</eventColor>. They sought glory and destruction and they achieved it—twisted by fate into their own demise. For many generations to come the <eventColor>{EventRace}</eventColor> will remember this day when the Giants were felled at their doorsteps.
button_0: "The weapons and armor to resmelt <bindingessence></bindingessence> in the forges."
button_2: "The primitive adornments of gold <gold></gold> and of gemstones."
button_3: "The enchanted trinkets <item></item>, a sizable reward for my heroes."
button_4: "Leaving their souls <souls></souls> untouched would be misplaced mercy..."
title: Thagnokar's Heir: Crumbling Giants

city_razed: You have bested the <eventColor>{EventClan}</eventColor>, though your empire will long mourn the destruction of <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>.

body_footer: Will you face the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> to retrieve the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor> for the Crystal Dwelling?
body_header: The <hyperlink>Eternal Sages</hyperlink> approach you with a request.
body_lore: "We have long kept records of a relic called the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>. At last, we have learned of <<o:EventArtifact>> location in the <eventColor>{EventGeo}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>," they say to you in a monotonous voice. "We wish to study the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor> and store it within our vast crystalline libraries. However, <<p:EventArtifact>> is defended by a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> and its army."
button_0: "I will win you this relic."
title: Retrieving the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>

body_footer: The <hyperlink>Eternal Sages</hyperlink> are eager to study the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>. Will you complete your quest and return it?
body_header: You have wrested the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor> from the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor> have already spied on your triumph, contacting you from afar. "You have done well, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>," their emissary speaks to you. "At last we can satiate our curiosity and learn what there is to know of the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>."
button_0: Give the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor> to the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>. <allegiance></allegiance>
button_1: Keep the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor> for yourself, angering the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>.
title: Retrieving the <eventColor>{EventArtifact}</eventColor>: Aftermath

body_footer: "As we cannot leave <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>, you possess the power to retrieve what we cannot procure ourselves," the <hyperlink>Eternal Sages</hyperlink> conclude. "Will you lend us your aid in this quest for wisdom?"
body_header: The <hyperlink>Eternal Sages</hyperlink> greet you from within their crystalline library in <eventColor>{EventHouse}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "Welcome, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>," the <eventColor>{EventHouseLord}</eventColor> hums. "We predicted your interest in helping us. Curiosity and ambition define most <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>, which makes you valuable allies in our pursuit of knowledge. We chronicle and collect all there is to know of the cosmos."
button_0: Ask the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor> for a quest.
button_1: Ask the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor> for a challenging quest.
button_2: Leave the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor> to their studies for now.
button_3: Pay <mana></mana> the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor> to reveal a location of special interest.
button_4: Share your insights as a <eventColor>{EventPlayerType}</eventColor> <knowledge></knowledge> with the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>.
button_5: Offer your <eventColor>{EventItem}</eventColor> <item></item> for the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor> to study.
title: Eternal Thirst for Knowledge

body_footer: "To capture the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> you must employ this Lithorite capsule. It will seal the creature within a crystal, ripe for our studies."
body_header: The <hyperlink>Eternal Sages</hyperlink> approach you with a request.
body_lore: "We have an interest in studying and preserving the different specimens growing on each world," they lay out to you. "Among the creatures we still aim to collect is the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>. We have learned of a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> in the <eventColor>{EventGeo}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>."
button_0: "I shall return with the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>."
title: Capturing <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>

body_footer: The <hyperlink>Eternal Sages</hyperlink> are eager to study the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>. Will you complete your quest and return it?
body_header: You have encapsulated the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> within a large Lithorite crystal.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor> have already spied on your triumph, contacting you from afar. "You have done well, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>," their emissary speaks to you. "At last we can satiate our curiosity and learn what there is to know of the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>."
button_0: Offer the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> to the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor> <allegiance></allegiance>.
button_1: Tame the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> for yourself <unit></unit>, angering the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>.
title: Capturing <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>: Aftermath

body_footer: "Tread this excavation site at your own risk and watch the <<m:EventUnit>>", <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> concludes. "This bedrock requires some big bombs to break."
body_header: Delving into the depths <eventColor>{EventDirection}</eventColor> <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor>, your troops are startled by echoing explosions and the sound of bustling pickaxes.
body_lore: "Careful, over there!" someone yells, and emerging from among a group of workers, a richly clad <<EventHero<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>> plants <<r:EventHero>> before your troops. "<eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> of the <hyperlink>Company of Lost Treasures</hyperlink>," <<p:EventHero>> introduces <<r:EventHero>>. "We are excavating the ruins of an entombed city from the ancient kingdom of <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>. Our adventurers are well outfitted to deal with whatever hazards we may encounter. However —" <<p:EventHero>> eyes your troops one by one "— capable contractors are always welcome. For a fair share of the spoils."
button_0: Enter the excavation area.
button_4: Use the opportunity to conscript <gold></gold> some workers <structureprod></structureprod> for <eventColor>{PlayerCity}</eventColor>.
button_5: Ask <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> about the famous adventurer's gear <item></item> sold <gold></gold> by the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.ColtLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>.
title: Entering the Deepglitter Chambers

body_footer: The spiders and their <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> pose a severe threat to anyone trying to delve deeper into the ruins.
body_header: Digging through the earth, your troops find themselves in a chamber covered with thick cobwebs.
body_lore: Hissing noises echo in the darkness, while many-legged silhouettes lurk without movement, awaiting the arrival of new prey. In the center of the chamber where the webbing is the most dense, your troops believe they spot a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, likely the queen of this infestation.
button_0: Prepare to wipe out the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
title: Deepglitter Chambers: Arachnoid Nightmares

body_footer: The dungeon is filled with traps and deathless defenders. It seems clear that what lies beyond must have been of greatest value...
body_header: Breaking through a mound, your troops reach a well-preserved dungeon area.
body_lore: Masterfully built, this chamber endured the ages undamaged. Undoubtedly its purpose was to deny passage into the most precious chambers of the city—and to eradicate anyone daring to intrude. Deadly dungeon traps hang on pillars and walls as a clear warning, with likely more hidden along the way. <<m:EventStackLeader>> can be spotted in a distance, tirelessly patrolling the paved floors, while animated weapons lurk in the shadows.
button_0: "We will break down these dungeon defenses!"
title: Deepglitter Chambers: Dungeon Crawling

body_footer: While your troops still marvel at <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, a series of booming explosions is rupturing the chamber the <hyperlink>Company of Lost Treasures</hyperlink> have forced their way in from the other side!
body_header: Wearing out pickaxe after pickaxe, your troops carve their path through ever frozen ground until they reach a new chamber at last.
body_lore: Glittering in a rare beam of refracted sunlight falling through endless layers of ice in the ceiling, <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> towers at the center of this last chamber. Built from immaculate flowrock marble the likes only the <hyperlink>Giant King</hyperlink> of old could hew, <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> is a symbol of overwhelming power and craftsmanship alike.
button_0: Let all make haste to reach <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>!
title: Deepglitter Chambers: <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>

body_footer: The <hyperlink>Company of Lost Treasures</hyperlink> have betrayed your agreement and lay sole claim to <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
body_header: Arriving at the grand gates of <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> finds the structure complex already roaming with looting adventurers.
body_lore: "Vacate the premises!" the familiar voice of <eventColor>{ColtHero}</eventColor> can be heard shouting from afar. "This archaeological site has been found and registered by the <hyperlink>Company of Lost Treasures</hyperlink>. We are the rightful owners of this area and we will use force to defend our new property, if necessary." A glimpse into the throne room indeed reveals drawn weapons and grim faces hiding behind hastily setup barricades.
button_0: "They must pay for this insolence. Attack!"
button_1: Create your own <production></production> <eventColor>{GLOBAL.UNITS.DEVASTATOR_SPHERE_UNIT}</eventColor> in <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> to blow away their barricades.
button_2: Flee.
title: Deepglitter Chambers: A Company of Thieves

hero_is_ruler: Arriving at the grand gates of <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, you find the structure complex already roaming with looting adventurers.

body_footer: You defended your claim to the Deepglitter Chambers. Taking the <eventColor>{EventRelic}</eventColor>, the fate of the pitiful <eventColor>{ColtHero}</eventColor> remains yours to decide.
body_header: Just as the last of <<o:ColtHero>> adventurers is felled by your troops, <eventColor>{ColtHero}</eventColor> reveals <<o:ColtHero>> hiding position, raising both hands in surrender.
body_lore: "I give up!" <<p:ColtHero>> squeals in deadly terror, holding up an ornate strongbox. "Here, take this! I am rich. I am of greatest value to the <hyperlink>Company of Lost Treasures</hyperlink>... when alive, I assure you!" <eventColor>{ColtHero}</eventColor> slowly regains <<o:ColtHero>> countenance, opening the strongbox. "Behold, the <eventColor>{EventRelic}</eventColor>, the gem of this Giant King's treasury—a worthy present for a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>, is it not?"
button_10: Interrogate <eventColor>{ColtHero}</eventColor> to learn all about <<o:ColtHero>> stashed equipment hoard. <item></item>
button_11: Send <eventColor>{ColtHero}</eventColor> as a gift <allegiance></allegiance> to the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>, so they may recover Myrridan secrets pillaged by the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.ColtLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>.
button_3: Barter a ransom <gold></gold> with the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.ColtLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>.
button_9: Sentence <eventColor>{ColtHero}</eventColor> and expose <influence></influence> the shady practices of the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.ColtLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor>.
title: Deepglitter Chambers: Aftermath

body_footer: The earth violently shakes as the <<m:EventUnit>> blast open a tunnel towards the First Chamber.
body_header: Just as the conversation with <eventColor>{EventHero}</eventColor> ends, warnings from the far end of the cavern give notice of the <<m:EventUnit>> set up for detonation.
body_lore:
"Light the fuses
Expect some bruises
They built these halls in centuries past
We bring 'em down, an instant blast
3... 2... 1...
BOOM!"
button_0: Time to do some digging!
title: Deepglitter Chambers: Devastating Excavation

second_tunnel: The earth violently shakes as the <<m:EventUnit>> blast open a tunnel towards the Second Chamber.
third_tunnel: The earth violently shakes as the <<m:EventUnit>> blast open a tunnel towards the Third Chamber.

second_tunnel: With the spiders culled, the <hyperlink>Company of Lost Treasures</hyperlink> are burning away all cobwebs, opening the path for their <<m:EventUnit>>.
third_tunnel: With the dungeon defenders destroyed, the <hyperlink>Company of Lost Treasures</hyperlink> carefully disarm most of the remaining traps, opening the path for their <<m:EventUnit>>.

body_footer: "Draconic brood, ever envious of the Giants' work, has intruded in this garden," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> ends. "Cull them. Root out this weed before it can spread!"
body_header: Gazing at the enormous, ancient colonnade encircling a black-peaked mountain, your troops are startled by a thundering voice.
body_lore: "May you enter in peace!" The command echoes from the mountain as a large <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> emerges between the pillars. "For the foundations of this garden date back to the times of blessed <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>, and I shall not have it destroyed." The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> lowers <<o:EventUnit>> staff, sheltering a bird's nest. "Albeit the peace it long brought is yet in jeopardy once more."
button_0: Ask the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> for the location of these Draconic creatures.
button_dragon: "I shall reclaim this 'brood', puny giant, to help you in your misery."
title: Entering Colonnade Garden

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> plucks a fruit from a twig of <<o:EventUnit>> tangly mantle. "My magic has preserved this progeny for ages. Come, taste the glory of <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>!"
body_header: As your troops fell the Draconic creatures one by one, the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> returns, pensively.
body_lore: "These branches have witnessed the ripening of the fruits of peace, these roots tasted the wine of unburdened life," <<p:EventUnit>> says slowly, touching the eldest of the trees. "Within the grand cities of <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>, the small people found prosperity and shelter. Never again were the harvests so bountiful, the fields so irenic."
button_0: Send the fruit to <eventColor>{EventCity}</eventColor> to nourish <food></food> the populous.
button_4: Eat the fruit <xp></xp>.
button_5: Portion the fruit, so it may strengthen <xp></xp> your troops.
button_6: Immolate the fruit in a bonfire. <chaosboon></chaosboon>
title: Colonnade Garden: Overgrown Past

body_footer: "The Dragon that devastated this city was called <eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor>," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> ends <<o:EventUnit>> doleful speech. "But I call <<P:<eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor>>> the Calamity."
body_header: With growing satisfaction, the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> watches your troops kill the Draconic creatures.
body_lore: "They were called allies of the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>, fighting for justice and order," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> growls. "But the <hyperlink>Dragons</hyperlink> descended upon <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink> as harbingers of death and destruction." The <<Ge:fists,EventUnit.Name>> are shaking with rage. "Too long had the Dragons envied the civilization we built. This was their opportunity to retaliate upon the Giant kin—and the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> stayed blind to their ravages after they had so harshly condemned all <hyperlink>Giant King</hyperlink>."
button_0: Leave the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> to <<o:EventUnit>> thoughts.
title: Colonnade Garden: War and Woe

body_footer: A sudden storm is gathering as the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> raises <<o:EventUnit>> staff. Dark clouds thicken until a mighty lightning bolt shatters the black mountain, revealing the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> within.
body_header: Your troops have culled the Draconic creatures within Colonnade Garden. The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> approaches them with stern determination.
body_lore:
"I have watched over these ruins throughout the ages, and as they slowly became overgrown, I too became one with the forest." The leaves covering the {EventUnit} have turned colorful, as if they spruced themselves up for a last golden autumn day.

"Now, however, my vigil is nearing its end. Hidden inside the black mountain, doused in enchanted sleep lies {EventDragonName}, the Calamity. This is how I trapped <{EventDragonName}>>, waiting for someone powerful enough to end the beast. That someone is you, {PlayerLeader.TitleName}!"
button_0: "The fame <influence></influence> of slaying <eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor> will be mine, and mine alone!"
button_4: "Lend me the aid of your forces of nature <unit></unit> in this upcoming fight!"
title: Colonnade Garden: An Autumn Storm

body_footer: A gentle breeze takes the <<Ge:foliage,<eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>>> scattering it to the four winds. <<Co:EventUnit>> antlers and staff remain, passing the stewardship of Colonnade Garden unto you.
body_header: With <eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor> gone, the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> carefully examines the remainders of the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
body_lore: "Peace, at last," the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> calls out, combing through rubble and broken eggshells. The <<Ge:leaves,<eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>>> have lost most of their color, wearing a brown that heralds the coming of winter. Near the center of the hollow the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> suddenly stops. "Behold," <<p:EventUnit>> calls out, "the <eventColor>{EventRelic}</eventColor>! Most bountiful among the marvels of blessed <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink>. A gift worthy of any <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>." The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> places the <eventColor>{EventRelic}</eventColor> on a pedestal. "My vigil has ended, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. Yours only just begun..."
button_0: Use antlers and staff to build the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> a shrine. <natureboon></natureboon>
button_3: Connect with the staff to call forth a servant <unit></unit> of nature, one last time.
button_4: Beseech <eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor> to share <<o:<eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor>>> ancient knowledge <knowledge></knowledge> with you before leaving.
button_5: Invite the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor> <allegiance></allegiance> to study the Myrridan ruins of Colonnade Garden.
button_6: Claim the antlers as an adornment <influence></influence> for your throne.
title: Colonnade Garden: Aftermath

dragon_ally: <eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor> departs into the skies, leaving you with the <eventColor>{EventRelic}</eventColor>, the antlers, and the staff of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>—and the dominion over Colonnade Garden.
With the mighty <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> felled, <eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor> reascends the flattened peak of the black mountain in triumph.

"My slumber has ended," <eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor> speaks with majesty, "and the last of the detested Giants is no more." <<Cp:<eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor>>> lets <<o:<eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor>>> gaze wander towards the horizon. "The times have changed. The reach of the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink> has grown distant and much that was spoken of only in prophecy has awoken. I must wander once more, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>. Take this, the <eventColor>{EventRelic}</eventColor>, for your deeds. It was crafted by the Giant lords of this ruined city, but brought me only ill."

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor> fixes you with <<o:<eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor>>> enormous, piercing eyes: "You must decide, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, will it be truth or death?"
body_header: Nearing the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, the sneering voice of <eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor> calls out to you.
body_lore: "So, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.TitleName}</eventColor>, do you really trust the words of a Giant," <<p:<eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor>>> asks, grinning through enormous teeth. "They never speak of what caused the Great War or which casualties they inflicted. Convenient, isn't it? As if the <hyperlink>Traitor Kings</hyperlink> and their soulcurses never existed..."
button_0: "Death! Your desolation ends now, <eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor>!"
button_4: "Truth! Let us fight the vengeful <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> side by side!"
button_dragon: "There must be no quarrel among primal equals, my <<EventDragonName<eventColor>{brother/sister}</eventColor>>>."
title: Colonnade Garden: <<ge:Spite,<eventColor>{EventDragonName}</eventColor>>>

body_footer: "Will you share their fates?" the voice pronounces as it fades, "Or will you learn from their folly, demonstrating the worth to inherit the secrets of Trinity Island?"
body_header: Navigating the seas, with a distant archipelago in sight, your troops hear a deep voice resonating inside their skulls.
body_lore: "Raiders. Looters. Thieves." Each word has the gravity of an accusation, yet the unison voices pronouncing them reveal no emotion. "Throughout the ages many have come to these isles to steal the secrets of the <hyperlink>Eternal Council</hyperlink>. We evaluated their intentions. And then we detained them, appalled by their vulgar ambitions." Visions of large expressionless faces, carved into crystal, manifest themselves in your troops' minds. "Now they exist as living statues, a warning to all those who seek power without sagacity."
button_0: "A <<<eventColor>{EventPlayerType}</eventColor>>> needs no proof of their splendor!" <influence></influence>
title: Discovering Trinity Island

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> questions with authority: "Among the many atrocities that the <hyperlink>Traitor Kings</hyperlink> committed, what was their greatest sin?"
body_header: Examining the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> frozen in crystals, your troops hear the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> speak to them once more.
body_lore: "Power-hungry as their deceased masters, the <hyperlink>Sons of the Kjörnoe</hyperlink> are a posthumous enemy of the <hyperlink>Eternal Council</hyperlink>." The voice of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> grows louder. "When the <hyperlink>Traitor Kings</hyperlink> tried to steal the secret of our immortality, they made a crucial mistake. They took our knowledge. They took our crystals. They experimented on their followers in gruesome rituals. Yet when the time came, they only fractured their souls, an immortalized shadow of their former selves."
button_0: Do not answer the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, for now.
button_1: "Treachery. They betrayed their oath as Giant Kings and the people they ought to protect."
button_2: "Greed. <gold></gold> Where the Giant Kings mined riches to craft and create, the Traitor Kings hoarded wealth without reason."
button_3: "Pride. <influence></influence> They acted as capricious gods, sacrificing all to the pursuit of immortality."
button_4: "Ignorance. <knowledge></knowledge> They sought forbidden knowledge without comprehending the doom it brought upon themselves and ultimately all Giant kin."
title: Trinity Island: Trial of Sin

completed: You have already answered this trial. Visit the prisoners on the other islands to obtain the judgment of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>!
Your troops return to the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, sealed within the crystal prison of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>.
One can only wonder if the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> is still truly alive or if the confinement within the crystals has detained all <<o:EventStackLeader>> thoughts and sensations.

body_footer: The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> asks: "Imagine a library with the collected history of a realm being gifted to a <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>>. What should the <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>> do?"
body_header: As your troops find a lone rogue, sealed within a Lithorite crystal, the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> speaks of <<o:EventStackLeader>> fate.
body_lore: "<<Co:EventStackLeader>> name is <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, yet <<p:EventStackLeader>> was merely an expendable tool for the <hyperlink>Company of Lost Treasures</hyperlink>." While the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> speaks, your troops begin to see the shape of a large crystalline structure glimmering within the coastal waters. Yet as the voice continues, the image vanishes again, like a mirage: "They outfit and hire adventurers to raid <hyperlink>Myrrida's</hyperlink> secret treasures, destroying much of its legacy beyond retrieval. Thus, they are the counter force to the <hyperlink>Eternal Sages</hyperlink>, who chronicle and preserve all knowledge within their crystal libraries."
button_0: Do not answer the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, for now.
button_1: "Burn the library! History is written by the victors!"
button_2: "Share the library with the local governors, to reform the administration <food></food><structureprod></structureprod> system."
button_3: "Use the knowledge within to forge grievances <influence></influence> against rival kingdoms."
button_4: "Study the chronicles <knowledge></knowledge> to learn from past empires' mistakes."
title: Trinity Island: Trial of Wisdom

completed: You have already answered this trial. Visit the prisoners on the other islands to obtain the judgment of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>!
Your troops return to the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, sealed within the crystal prison of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>.
One can only wonder if the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> is still truly alive or if the confinement within the crystals has detained all <<o:EventStackLeader>> thoughts and sensations.

body_footer: The voice inquires with determination: "A troll and a <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>> seek justice in the court of a <hyperlink>Giant King</hyperlink>. Who should the <hyperlink>Giant King</hyperlink> favor?"
body_header: Astounded by the huge crystal encapsulating a <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, your troops hear the deep resonating voice return.
body_lore: "Alas, this is what the progeny of Giant kin has become: Uncivilized brutes, eager to steal their own heritage." The voice falters for a moment, as if lost in thought. Then it continues: "The Giant Clans accuse the 'Hastefolk' of suppression, yet they themselves stoke hatred against the smaller kin, evoking a vision of <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink> that never existed."
button_0: Do not answer the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>, for now.
button_1: "The <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{man/woman}</eventColor>>>! A troll is a degenerate offspring that must be culled from the realms!"
button_2: "Both! Mercy <goodact></goodact> is a gift granted by true kings."
button_3: "The troll! In a Giant Kingdom the Giants rule supreme!" <influence></influence>
button_4: "Neither! Justice should be dispensed only after studying <knowledge></knowledge> all evidence!"
title: Trinity Island: Trial of Balance

completed: You have already answered this trial. Visit the prisoners on the other islands to obtain the judgment of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>!
Your troops return to the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, sealed within the crystal prison of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor>.
One can only wonder if the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> is still truly alive or if the confinement within the crystals has detained all <<o:EventStackLeader>> thoughts and sensations.

body_footer: The unison voices end their ordeal: "To inherit our secrets, speak one last time: Which quality must a <<PlayerLeader<eventColor>{king/queen}</eventColor>>> represent above all?"
body_header: Your troops carefully approach the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, floating amidst the three islands, awaiting <<o:EventStackLeader>> judgment.
body_lore: "You have answered our trials," the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> speaks, "and we have deemed your responses worthy of a <eventColor>{PlayerLeader.Title}</eventColor>." There are crystal reflections in the water, blinding your troops, but they vanish again as the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor> continues: "The <hyperlink>Giant King</hyperlink> ruled <hyperlink>Myrrida</hyperlink> with great wisdom. There was equality between giants and the smaller kin and even the <hyperlink>Giant King</hyperlink> themselves abided by the law and the verdicts of the <hyperlink>Eternal Council</hyperlink>."
button_0: Do not answer the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>, for now.
button_1: "Your trials are an insult to my power. Die now, vexatious <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>!"
button_2: "Tenacity." <structureprod></structureprod><materiumboon></materiumboon>
button_3: "Nobility." <influence></influence><shadowboon></shadowboon>
button_4: "Prudence." <knowledge></knowledge><astralboon></astralboon>
title: Trinity Island: The Ordeal of the <eventColor>{EventStackLeader}</eventColor>

body_footer: Where the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> floated, now only an artifact is adrift in the waves. It is the <eventColor>{EventRelic}</eventColor>, reward and proof of your dominion over Trinity Island.
body_header: The <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> hums. "A sagacious response. With this, we can lift our spell and return to the glimmering halls of our brethren. Marvel at the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{PlayerLeader}</eventColor>, and its secrets that are now yours!"
body_lore: An arcane sizzling stirs up the waters of Trinity Island and as the illusion of the <eventColor>{EventUnit}</eventColor> fades away, large monumental crystals become revealed to your troops. They form a structure complex stretching between the three islands, a <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor> holding the crystallized knowledge of the <hyperlink>Eternal Council</hyperlink>.
button_0: Activate the dormant Lithorine guards <unit></unit> hidden within the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
button_4: Claim any magical items <item></item> stored among the knowledge crystals.
button_5: Absorb the abundant astral energies <mana></mana> impounded within the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
button_6: Invite the <eventColor>{GLOBAL.EternalSagesLoreConcept.Name}</eventColor> <allegiance></allegiance> to the <eventColor>{EventStructure}</eventColor>.
title: Trinity Island: Aftermath

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.Name}</eventColor> holds a strong influence over this realm. Defeating <<p:var>> will assure your dominance.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.TitleName}</eventColor> regards you with contempt, weighing the relevance of your intrusion into <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> realm.
body_lore: "I shall not suffer the presence of pretenders in my realm. Stay out of my way and perhaps you'll survive the cold long enough to regret coming here."
button_0: This realm will be ours.
title: Realm of the Frost Queen

body_footer: With the power of the Frozen Heart in your hands, none can stand in your way. This realm is yours.
body_header: 993 is defeated. As <<p:EventLeaderDefeated>> is cast into the void, <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> control over this realm falters.
body_lore: Ransacking through the <<g:former throne city,EventLeaderDefeated>>, the secret to <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> control of the realm is revealed: a frozen heart seemingly made of many elemental creatures, gruesomely melded together.
button_0: Victory is ours!
title: The Frost Queen Defeated

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.TitleName}</eventColor> is the prime threat to your control of this realm. Defeating such a powerful being will leave no doubts about your right to rule.
body_header: With roaring flames, <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.TitleName}</eventColor> appears, <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> eyes flickering with a terrifying intensity.
body_lore: "A new lamb arrives in my realm." <<Cp:EventLeaderDefeated>> regards your form, appraising you as one would select cattle for slaughter. "You have not yet lost your fire. This is good... I will enjoy taking it from you."
button_0: "<eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.TitleName}</eventColor> must fall."
title: Realm of the <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.Title}</eventColor>

body_footer: The <<g:final defeat,EventLeaderdefeated>> proves your supremacy over this realm. With <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> powers added to your own, the other lords surrender or scramble to flee.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.TitleName}</eventColor> is embraced by the flames <<p:EventLeaderDefeated>> once called <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> own, roaring as <<p:EventLeaderDefeated>> is taken.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.Title}</eventColor> is defeated, <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> armies scattering and succumbing to infighting. You now wield the power to command <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> legions, or to banish them.
button_0: Victory is ours!
title: The <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.Title}</eventColor> Defeated

body_footer: Through conquest or diplomacy, <eventColor>{WarlordLeader.Name}</eventColor>, <eventColor>{BastardLeader.Name}</eventColor> and <eventColor>{HeirLeader.Name}</eventColor> must be brought to heel.
body_header: Having met with the kings that rule the remnants of this once mighty kingdom, you have a new goal set before you, the reunification of Vossin... under your banner.
body_lore: The once-mighty kingdom of Vossin is now shattered, its people suffering as kings squabble. Something must be done.
button_0: Vossin shall be made whole under my banner.
title: The Conquest of Vossin

body_footer: The throne is now yours to ascend and the reforged Kingdom of Vossin yours to command.
body_header: With your control over the last splinter kingdom assured, there is now no doubt as to your claim to this realm.
body_lore: The remaining kings swear fealty to you, their subjects hailing you as a great uniter, the one who reforged a shattered kingdom.
button_0: Victory is ours!
title: Vossin Conquered

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.Name}</eventColor> holds a strong influence over the houses of this realm, defeating <<P:EventLeaderDefeated>> will prove your dominance.
body_header: An image of <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.TitleName}</eventColor> appears surrounded by an imperious air; <<p:EventLeaderDefeated>> smiles warmly.
body_lore: "Welcome, pretender. You enter a Realm already saved, enlightened by the will of the <hyperlink>Archons</hyperlink>. You would be wise to fall in line and join our covenant... or find yourself banished."
button_0: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.TitleName}</eventColor> must fall.
title: Realm of the <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.Title}</eventColor>

body_footer: With the Houses bent to your will, none can stand in your way. This Realm is yours.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.Title}</eventColor> is defeated. Yet, as <<p:EventLeaderDefeated>> is cast into the void, no divine retribution comes.
body_lore: The <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.Title}</eventColor> could bleed after all... as a representative of the many Houses, we surrender our allegiance to you, vanquisher of prophets. May you show us mercy.
button_0: Victory is Ours!
title: The <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.Title}</eventColor> Defeated

body_footer: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.Name}</eventColor> is working on some terrifying arcane work on this realm, defeating <<P:EventLeaderDefeated>> will thwart <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> scheme and turn <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> power over to you.
body_header: A projection of <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.TitleName}</eventColor> appears, not acknowledging your presence as it speaks.
body_lore: "More meddlers to disrupt my work... See that you do not, or you will find the meaning of the words 'Knowledge is power.'"
button_0: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.TitleName}</eventColor> must fall.
title: Realm of the Librarian

body_footer: With the librarian's Tomes and <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> arcane device at your disposal, this Realm is yours.
body_header: <eventColor>{EventLeaderDefeated.Title}</eventColor> is defeated. As <<p:EventLeaderDefeated>> is cast into the void, <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> schemes are left incomplete.
body_lore: Ransacking through the <<g:former throne city,EventLeaderDefeated>>, the secret to <<o:EventLeaderDefeated>> arcane scheme is revealed: An imprisoned <hyperlink>Lost Wizard</hyperlink>, its power siphoned off to grant a fraction of the power of a full <hyperlink>Godir</hyperlink>.
button_0: Victory is ours!
title: The Librarian Defeated

text: A harbor is automatically assigned to the first water <hyperlink>Province</hyperlink> that a city claims. Water <hyperlink>Unit</hyperlink> built in a city will appear in its harbor once completed.

description:
Terraforming effects can change the appearance and Province Feature in a Province. Terraforming can change what Province Improvement can be built in a Province, but does not destroy or change already built Province Improvements.

When terraforming originates from a source, such as a City or Province Improvement, then removing the source will revert the terraforming effects. When there is no source that can be removed, terraforming is permanent until overwritten by a new terraforming effect.

World Map Spell can apply terraforming effects. When you cancel a sustained effect such as a Sustained World Spell, its terraforming changes will not be reverted.

Certain provinces or features, such as Lava, Water, and Uninhabitable provinces, cannot normally be terraformed.

description:
Landmarks are a type of location the size of an entire region. Landmarks themselves cannot be annexed or claimed. Instead, landmarks grant effects to all adjacent Province.

If a City has a certain amount of provinces in their domain adjacent to one Landmark, they gain an additional bonus effect depending on the type of landmark.

Landmarks count as Handcrafted Region, meaning they can be disabled with the Untouched Realm Trait.
name: Landmark

description:
Spell may have a chance of backfiring.

When a spell can backfire, the chance is displayed in the casting menu. Upon casting the spell, you will be informed if the spell backfired or not. When a spell does not backfire, the spell is resolved as normal and nothing else happens.

When a spell backfires, its original effects are still resolved, but additional effects are added to the spell. These additional effects are random and usually affect the targets of the original spell.

For example: When a Healing Spell backfires, it could have the additional effect of teleporting the unit that was healed up to 3 hexes away from its location.
name: Spell Backfiring
